en:
The records, inscribed with that burning quill, are endless.

Yet the prophet must write.

Because the future is also endless.
cn:
以燃烧的羽毛笔书写下的文字，一定见不到尽头吧。

但它不得不书写。

因为崭新的未来同样永无止境。

en:
Looking closely at it... it appears to be a gem of sorts.

Born after a long, long time of waiting...

Born in the ebb and flow of the filth that fills and leaves that thing with its every movement.

Taking its gem would be equivalent to taking its reason for existence away. It may fall apart without it.
cn:
仔细观察后，发现那似乎是类似于宝石的东西。

那是，在漫长的等待后……

从伴随它每次行动不断吐出又重新填满的污秽中，终于孕育而生的吧。

既然如此，只要夺走那宝石，它就会因失去存在的意义而崩溃吧。

en:
Where did that flotsam float from?

From where, and how did it end up here?

After so many years, even that flotsam may no longer recall from whence it came.

... As long as it can be used to stop that Abnormality's attack.
cn:
那是从何处漂来的漂浮物吗？

是从何处，又是如何漂流而来，最后矗立于此的呢？

时光流逝，也许连漂浮物本身都遗忘自己由何而来。

但，如果能用这漂浮物来抵挡那异想体的攻击就好了。

en:
"Yeah, of course we should."

As soon as we decided to check underneath the boat, a powerful shock rocked the stern of the boat.

"Mermaids! Hostiles are climbing from the bottom of the ship..."

"We can minimize our losses by having one of us go push them off the ship before they latch on."

As soon as that was decided, two Sinners jumped from their seats and approached me.

"I will go, Executive Manager!"

"No. I am better suited for this task."

The two Sinners begin bickering.
cn:
“理所当然。”

检查船体底部的途中，船尾突然传来强烈的冲击。

“是人鱼！它们是想从船底爬上来吗……”

“让一人上前，在它们全部爬上来之前将其拖开，能够将损伤控制在最小范围。”

听到这话，有两名罪人立刻起身靠近我。

“请让我出阵，执行经理！”

“不，这种时候让我去就可以。”

两名罪人各执一词，都坚称让自己上前会更加有效地解决。

en:
We entered a narrow waterway of sorts.

"... Executive Manager."

I see Mermaids swimming under the ship.

Mermaids latched onto the walls are glaring at us as well.

"This place, hard to steer. Steer and keep track of directions, hard to do at once."

Someone'll have to keep track of the directions.
cn:
似乎行驶到狭窄的水路中了。

“……执行经理。”

能看到水下的人鱼。

紧贴在墙上的人鱼也在看着我们。

“窄、这里。驾驶，转向。困难，向哪边？”

似乎需要谁决定前进方向，才能帮助船航行。

en: "Exit. Still far."
cn: “还。离出口。很远。”

en:
"Almost there. We escape soon. To next area."

We're almost there.
cn:
“快到了。就快，出去了。向下一个地方。”

快到出口了。

en:
After defeating the Abnormality, we sailed for a while without much incident. That was when...

"A wall..."

... a thick, solid wall appeared before us.

"Artery. Beyond this wall."

"Wall opens. Closes. Opening is very short. Don't get grabbed by Mermaid there. Chopped in half, if grabbed by mermaid."

And with a heavy rumble, the wall immediately started to open.

"Keep Mermaids off ship. They slow us down, we get cut in half."

The Mermaids must've sensed the rumbling. They begin rushing at our ship.
cn:
和异想体交战后，本以为已经前进不少了……

“墙壁……”

面前突然出现了无比厚实的墙壁。

“前面，有。动脉。”

“开的时间，有。很短。那时候。被人鱼抓住，会坏。被分成两半。”

话音刚落，伴着一阵剧烈的震动，面前的墙壁打开了。

“人鱼，远离。快点，慢的话。分成两半。”

或许是感受到震动，原本安静的人鱼突然袭击过来。

en:
"This is much tougher than I expected..."

The artery appeared much sturdier than we had initially assumed.

Cutting it open with a single strike won't be an easy task... but if we delay too much here, we won't be able to arrive at the rendezvous area in time.
cn:
“比想象中更厚……”

正如其言，那并非通过动脉这词所能联想到的，脆弱且薄的样子。

似乎难以一次性切断，而且如果在这里花费太多时间，就会错过预定的会合时间。

en:
We stopped before a crate with the Twinhook Pirates' logo on it.

"This crate appears to be locked."

"It's all rusted... I don't think we can even try to pick the lock."

"Then let's smash it open!"

... But the box itself looks pretty flimsy. We risk smashing its contents as well.
cn:
我们站在画着双钩海盗团标记的箱子前。

“上着锁。”

“生锈了……想要拆除应该很难。”

“这种时候直接打破就好了！”

……但是箱子本身相当脆弱，力道不当说不定会破坏里面的东西。

en:
This crate has the LCCB logo on it.

This one looks sturdy enough... we probably can't smash it open.

"This appears to have been sealed by an intricate locking mechanism."

"Doubt I'll be able to just smash this open..."

"Wait, I think I remember something..."

Maybe a Sinner who's used an LCCB Identity in the past may know something about this.
cn:
这箱子上画着LCCB的标记。

看上去无法轻易破坏。

“似乎是精密的电子锁装置。”

“看上去不会砰一下打开……”

“感觉要想起什么了……”

确实。如果是拥有LCCB人格相关经验的罪人，应该能看出些端倪。

en:
Sure, you could say that.

But... her own answers matter the most here, no?

"......"

Her breathing is quick and shaking. She deliberates.

What answer awaits you at the end of this deliberation?
cn:
你当然会那样说。

但是……归根到底，她本人内心的真实想法才最重要吧？

“……”

她的呼吸很急促。似乎是在烦恼。

烦恼的结果会是什么？你的结论又是什么？

en:
"<Ishmael.>"

"<It's not over yet.>"

"<It's too early to decide. There's still time.>"

"<And when the time comes... no one will make that decision in your stead.>"

"<Not me. Not Ahab.>"

"<I know that you can reach your own answers. Find your own way.>"

"……."

Ishmael does not reply. Instead, she tightens the grip on her weapon arm.
cn:
“<以实玛利。>”

“<还没有结束。>”

“<还没到下结论的时候，一切都还没有结束。>”

“<并且那个结论……没有人能帮你决定。>”

“<不论是我，还是亚哈。>”

“<直到你能够自己思考的时候，自然会得出结论。>”

“……”

以实玛利没有回答，而是重新握紧了武器。

en:
Heathcliff from another world glares at Heathcliff.

Every strand of vein in his bloodshot eyes are pulsating with burning hatred.

"Your puerile adventure... ends here."

"Cast yourself off the cliffside of suffering. Let the sorrow agonise you until your body strikes the earth cold."

"That is the smallest atonement you could pay to Cathy, as her murderer."

"Bastard, even now...?!"

Heathcliff bolts forward, unable to stop himself.
cn:
另一个世界的希斯克利夫瞪着希斯克利夫。

每一条血丝都像是被刻在眼球上那样，饱含着仇恨。

“你那无聊的冒险就要在这里结束了。”

“把自己扔进痛苦的深渊，在粉身碎骨之前受尽折磨吧。”

“那就是你能为因希斯克利夫而死的凯茜而做的小小的赎罪。”

“你这狗杂种直到最后都……！”

希斯克利夫似乎再也听不下去了，猛地冲了出去。

en:
Heathcliff the Heartbroken is shaking and stumbling.
What is that fluid dribbling from his mouth? Is it blood... or tears of sorrow?
... This might be our chance to convey something to Heathcliff.
cn:
心被撕碎的希斯克利夫，摇晃着，颤抖着。
从他口中流出的液体是血，还是饱含悲伤的泪？
也许，现在是我们向希斯克利夫传达信息的机会。

en:
Once again, Heathcliff the Heartbroken falls to the ground.

He is hyperventilating and shaking his head wildly. It is a difficult sight to bear.

The fluid pooled and pooled on the ground until it became a small puddle.
cn:
心被撕碎的希斯克利夫再次失去了重心倒在地板上。

他喘着粗气、摇晃脑袋的样子令人不禁心生怜悯。

落在地板上的液体，已经积成了浅浅的水洼。

en: A woman stands before us. Her body and mind are spent, weighed down, and sinking into the oblivion of time.
cn: 身心俱疲，被岁月浸没之人正茫然伫立。

en:
"What is... happening...?"

A frail, desperate voice echoes. The voice shudders so terribly.

"This is not at all what I wished for, no..."

I carefully ask the voice a question.

"<So all of this is...>"

"I never wanted a Heathcliff who exists for Catherine and only Catherine..."

... I don't think she can hear our voices.

"All I wanted... was for every Heathcliff to be happy..."

"All I wanted... was to kill every existence of myself..."

"Please, someone... help me."

"Can anyone hear me?!"
cn:
“到底是……怎么回事……”

微弱而哀切的声音颤抖着响起。

“我所希望的并不是这样……”

我谨慎地对那混乱的声音搭话。

“<那么，引起这一切的果然是……>”

“我从没希望过拥有只属于我的希斯克利夫……”

……我的声音似乎没有传达到。

“我只是，希望所有希斯克利夫都能幸福。”

“只是……只是为了这个愿望，我才想抹杀所有我的存在……”

“拜托了……谁来帮帮我。”

“没人能听到我吗？！”

en:
"Cathy, I...!"

Just as Heathcliff began to speak, a shrill cry tears through our heads.

"Catherine!!! Do not obstruct me now!!!"

"We promised, didn't we? We promised to kill all of us so that Heathcliff may find happiness!!!"

That cutting voice is tinged with an odd warmth, like a different voice.

"No, I..."

Maybe the two Catherines are vying for control.

One of her colossal hands is twitching and stumbling.

... Maybe this is our chance to neutralize that hand.
cn:
“凯茜！我……！”

正当希斯克利夫想要喊出声时，响起了震耳欲聋的凄厉尖叫。

“凯瑟琳！！！别再妨碍我了！！！”

“我们约好了的，为了所有的希斯克利夫的幸福，要杀了所有人！！！”

在刺耳的尖叫声里，一道温和的声音响起。

“不……我……”

两个凯瑟琳正在互相争吵吗。

凯瑟琳的巨手扭动着，不断抽搐。

也许可以趁着这个机会让那手无力化？

en:
Dammit, this is...

... Cathy's coffin.

It's so cold... and dark inside.

... You remained trapped here all along...

Just for... my happiness...

You, who hated the dark so, so much...
cn:
妈的……这里是……

装着凯茜的……棺材。

又冷……又暗。

……你在这里待了这么久……

只为了我的……幸福……

你明明那么怕黑的呀……

en:
The lasso is aiming straight for us...

The lasso, powered on by the hunter's movements, flies right at us.
cn:
套索精准地瞄准了我们。

一瞬间，充满力量的套索向罪人们挥来。

en: Maybe we can visit the Confessional again; we didn't do much there earlier. We decided to head to the Confessional, as advised by some of the Sinners. Please come here, should you wish to confess your sins and partake in a consultation. A voice echoes from inside the confessional. Maybe, if we were to confess our sins, the path will open before us. Which Sinner can bare their honest heart?
cn:
既然之前在告解室没有做出什么行动，我们也许可以回去看看？

听从几名罪人的意见，我们再次前往告解室。

希望坦白罪孽，接受谈话的人请到这里来。

能听见从内部传来的声音。

如果如声音所言坦白罪孽，也许能打开出去的道路。

应该让哪位罪人对其敞开心扉呢？

en:
"How unfortunate; there were no more adventures waiting for them."

"It was time for the Knight and the Squire to return home."

"To home, where their Family has been enduring and waiting for their return."

"If you would like to know what came to pass thereafter, please make your way through the brambles."
cn:
“很遗憾，此处再无足以期待的冒险了。”

“不论骑士还是侍从，都该回家了。”

“回到苦苦忍耐着，等待着的家人身边。”

“如果好奇故事的后续，那就请穿过荆棘之路继续前进吧。”

en:
We need every single coin we can get to come in second place.
It looks dangerous, but... we have to take the risk.
cn:
为了拿到第二名，连一枚铜钱都不能忽视。
虽然很危险……也只能一试了。

en:
We need to collect as many coins as we can, no matter what it takes.
I feel sorry for the prisoner, but...
... I ask the Sinners to punish him anyway.
cn:
必须尽可能多收集一些铜钱。
虽然对囚犯感到抱歉……
但我决定拜托罪人给予他们惩罚。

en:
'Oho, but we're not stopping here!'
'This prisoner has committed a very, very serious crime! He deserves more punishment, more!'
'Are ya ready?!'
cn:
“不能这样结束！”
“这名囚犯罪孽深重，需要受到更多的惩罚！”
“准备好了吗？”

en:
We carefully approach the jar to inspect what's inside...
A potent, ominous energy is seeping from the opening.
The closer we get, the louder becomes the eldritch noise crawling out of the depths of the jar.
cn:
为了调查瓮里的情况，小心翼翼地接近后……
半开的盖子缝隙中，散发出不妙的气息。
越靠近，瓮内深处越是传来奇妙的声音，越来越响。

en: 'Ah, so there's a mutual agreement between the two candidates! The wager it is, then!' 'Very well! Place five of your coins in front of you, and...' '... send out a member of your clan, and have them give a presentation on why their 'candidate' is more deserving of the Family Hierarch seat!' 'Refute your opponent's argument while reinforcing your own, and... our dear audience will choose the winner.' 'Alright, then! Send out your most articulate and persuasive representatives!'
cn:
“看来两位候选人都希望‘打赌’啊？”

“非常好！那么双方请交出五枚铜钱……”

“请候选人各派出一位部下出列，简述自己的‘候选人’值得成为家主的理由！”

“驳斥对方的论点，强调自己的观点……观众们会决定胜负。”

“那么各位候选人！请让对口才有自信的成员出列！”

en:
Attacking that fairy again will reveal its true form.

This isn’t your first time facing this entity. It won’t be as hard as the first time.

The Sinners seem to agree.

The fairy simply sat there in near complete stillness, only interrupted by its intermittently vibrating wings. It was as though the fairy knew you were coming.
cn:
再次攻击那只精灵，或许就能让它显露真容。

既然是已经见过的敌人，与之战斗不会再像第一次一样折磨了吧。

罪人们貌似也是这么想的。

似乎察觉到有人在靠近自己，精灵就像在注视着他们般静静地坐着，只是时而扑扇着翅膀。

en:
A dark shadow lingers at the center of the flaming moth.

Its form was vague and mercurial, yet... somehow, you can tell that the shadow is the very core of the moth.

If that shadow could be separated from the flames, perhaps its heat may momentarily subside.
cn:
在那形如火焰的飞蛾中心，一道黑影缠绕其中。

它的形态模糊且变幻莫测……但隐隐约约能知道，那黑影就是蛾的核心。

如果能将其剥离，或许可以暂时熄灭火焰。

en:
The lasso is aiming straight for us...

The lasso, powered on by the hunter's movements, flies right at us.
cn:
套索精准地瞄准了我们。

一瞬间，充满力量的套索向罪人们挥来。

en:
Attacking that fairy again will reveal its true form.

This isn’t your first time facing this entity. It won’t be as hard as the first time.

The Sinners seem to agree.

The fairy simply sat there in near complete stillness, only interrupted by its intermittently vibrating wings. It was as though the fairy knew you were coming.
cn:
再次攻击那只精灵，或许就能让它显露真容。

既然是已经见过的敌人，与之战斗不会再像第一次一样折磨了吧。

罪人们貌似也是这么想的。

似乎察觉到有人在靠近自己，精灵就像在注视着他们般静静地坐着，只是时而扑扇着翅膀。

en:
If this fight’s been anything to go by, it’ll soon emerge from one of the dimensional rifts.

If we can intuit its next point of emergence, maybe we can deal a fatal blow against it before it fully emerges from the dimensional rift.
cn:
如果和之前一样，那不久后它应该就会从次元裂隙中冲出来。

如果能提前预料到它会从哪里袭击，那或许就能顺势反击，给它致命一击。

en: Dense shadow pools under the lone Knight. Susurrus of teeming flesh sliding against flesh can be heard from beneath. "... Art they gathered to defeat the knight?" "They must've first gathered there, believing him to be one of them, until they came to a realization..." "... that the knight is a traitor to the great will." The knight leaps off from the surface, but the sea rises violently in response to drag him back down. The waves crest high, gnawing upon the knight, crashing him back down to the water's surface. But he leaps once again, the cresting waves as his stepping stones. He belongs not to the sea. He stands tall against the great will, his head held high in eternal defiance. The unremittent Knight rides across the watery mountains, and charges at us.
cn: 孤身伫立的骑士脚下，浓重的阴影笼罩而来。 那里传来像是肌肤相互摩擦的声音。 “……为了对抗那位骑士，竟聚集到如此程度吗？” “最初以为他是同族，所以一直在观察。后来才意识到。” “那个骑士，是背叛伟大意志的叛徒。” 骑士踏碎水面，纵身跃起时，大海就像要捕获他一般波涛汹涌。 浪潮高高涌起、撕咬、压制，试图将骑士拖入水下。 即使如此，骑士也再次踏着浪潮纵身跃起。 大海，不是他应停留之地。 抵抗着伟大意志，昂然向前。 不屈的骑士跨越大海，来到了这里。

en: They might not, but there has to be someone who needs your help.
cn: 只是他们不需要而已，总有人正迫切地需要你的帮助。

en:
We returned to the Training Team hallways again.

According to the Work Education manual, we're going to need the Physical Intervention Shield to survive the Noon of Violet's shockwave.

We stood huddled together at the hallway, remembering what Hod, the Sephirah of the Training Team told us. It wasn't long before the same bullets from earlier struck us.

Red barriers began to form around the Sinners who were struck by the bullets.

'Let's see... According to the schedule, we have some time until the next Noon arrives.'

One of the Sinners noticed an Emergency Response manual posted on the hallway walls.

On it were instructions on how to use a console installed in the hallways to activate the Regenerator systems connected to the Safety Team.

'This seems like it'd be worth a try.'

If we hurry, we might be able to activate the Regenerator before the Noon arrives.
cn:
我们回到了培训部的走廊。

按照工作培训手册上的信息，我们需要使用物理屏蔽力场以抵御紫罗兰的正午的冲击波。

我们挤在走廊里，想着Hod，培训部的Sephirah所言，一颗和之前相同的子弹很快就会重新击中我们。

被子弹击中的罪人身前升起了红色的力场。

“让我看看日程表，下一次的正午来临之前应该还有一段时间。”

一位罪人注意到走廊上挂着的应急预案守则。

那上面记录着该如何使用走廊上的终端来启用与安保部连接的再生反应堆。

“看起来值得一试。”

如果我们动作快些，没准能在正午到来前启动再生反应堆。

en: There are some leftover items on the desk.
cn: 桌子上有剩下的行李。

en:
A heart torn into thousands of pieces must be kept from all eyes, thus it burrowed into the ground and tangled itself.

Yet, someone has to pull up these thorny roots,
as there is no wound that can remain unearthed.

The Sinners gave each other looks.
Being coiled in piercing, sharp pain was something to avoid even in one’s dreams.
cn:
千疮百孔的心不愿被任何人知晓，于是它钻入地下，作茧自缚。

即使如此，为了不留下任何伤口，
总要有人攥住那些棘手的根，将它引出。

罪人们面面相觑。
哪怕是在梦中，也不会有人想品尝被刺伤遍全身的痛苦。

en:
The ground began to tremor ever so slightly.
The Sinners remained quiet, but they could read from each other’s glances the single thought they shared:
“Shouldn’t one of us step up to endure the pain so that the rest will be spared from suffering?”
cn:
地面突然开始微微震动。
罪人们相顾无言，彼此心领神会。
只一人忍受痛苦，总比所有人一起要好得多吧？

en:
As if to demonstrate the unrewarding harshness of life, and in spite of enduring so much pain, not a single flower seemed to bloom from the corpse.
Instead, the Sinners discover fruits borne on it.

One audibly swallows to drain their salivations.
An urge to know the taste of a fruit made fertile with a Sinner starts to grow.
cn:
人生就是如此，生时无论忍耐了多少苦痛，死尸却连一朵花都无从寻觅。
不过，罪人们的发现并非花朵，而是尸体上结满的果实。

有人发出吞咽口水的声音。
不知以罪人为养分的果实会流出怎样的汁液呢，这般渴望在心底滋长。

en:
The Sinners peered at its face.
They gazed upon the weathered memories within…

Down to the holes left by pests.

An apple does not culminate when it ripens to a glossy red.
When the apple browns, cracks, shrivels, and attracts lowly creatures…
That is when it has met its golden bliss.

The Sinners knew now was the time to bring the apple to the earth.
cn:
罪人们凝视着那张脸庞，
凝视着其中风化的记忆。

凝视着虫蚀的洞穴。

苹果的成熟并非始于它染上鲜红。
直到它氧化、开裂、枯萎，呼唤起四周微不足道的生命。
那时的苹果才终于迎来醉人的黄金时代。

罪人们明白，苹果的落期正是现在。

en:
The apple’s body broke, and the raging fruit still grew.
Could the Golden Bough really be in there?

“I’ll go check it out!”
Yuri said to the others.

The Sinner with a bug’s arm seems nervous about this.
Does he want to go with her, perhaps?
cn:
苹果的躯体遭到破坏，狂暴的果实陷入了平静。
金枝真的就在其中吗？

“我去确认一下！”

尤莉自告奋勇道。
拥有虫臂的罪人似乎心神不宁。
他是想说，自己也一起去吗？

en: It looks like one of the Sinners will have to do a clay doll’s job.
cn: 似乎只能献上罪人，代替土偶了。

en: It looks like one of the Sinners will have to do a clay doll’s job.
cn: 似乎只能献上罪人，代替土偶了。

en: It looks like one of the Sinners will have to do a clay doll’s job.
cn: 似乎只能献上罪人，代替土偶了。

en: The knot of desires must be undone.
cn: 必须要解开欲望交缠的绳结。

en:
A soldier was crushed under rubble, gasping in agony.

“Please just kill me… It hurts too much.”

You can’t ignore this person.
cn:
一位士兵被埋在爆炸的残骸下面，在痛苦中呻吟。

“请杀了我吧……实在是太痛了。”

无法对他视而不见，不能就这么离开。

en:
“Liking red color! Liking red color! Like it! Like it!”

A group of cyborgs yelled along to a strange rhythm.

“Red 4!!!”

Exulting the number high, they spun the roulette.
Then they handed a roulette ball to one of the Sinners.
cn:
“红色好！红色好！好颜色！好颜色！”

一群改造人跟随着奇妙的节奏，兴高采烈发出呐喊。

“红4！！！”

刚一叫出数字，他们就疯狂地转起了轮盘。
接着，将一个轮盘赌的小球交给了罪人。

en:
“No time now~ To stay all~ H. U. R. T!”

The chuckling cyborgs went back to the roulette.

“Like yellow color! Like yellow color! Yellow! Yellow! Yellow!”

“Yellow 6!!!”
cn:
“没~有时间~痛，苦，咯！”

改造人们一边咯咯笑着，一边再次转起了轮盘。

“黄色好！黄色妙！黄！黄！黄！”

“黄6！！！”

en:
“Can’t say no to fun! Not. One. Little tiny bit!”

The singing group of cyborgs spins the wheel.

“Liking blue color! Liking blue color! Bluey! Bluey! Bluey!”

“Blue 8!!!”
cn:
“愉悦的心，情，受不了啦！”

改造人们唱着小曲，转动轮盘。

“蓝色好！蓝色好！蓝！蓝！蓝！”

“蓝8！！！”

en:
The steel is thick, but it might not be impossible for a Sinner to move it ajar.
Who would be the right person to do that?
cn:
就算铁门再厚，也不应该低估罪人们的蛮力。
谁最适合这项任务呢？

en:
There’s got to be some way through other than brute force.
Perhaps a thorough look around could reveal something.
cn:
除了像个莽夫一样从正面踢门，应该还有其他办法。
在附近仔细调查的话，或许就有什么派得上用场。

en:
The forest is dense, but there are still gaps within it.

If we tread carefully, we might be able to strike the Inquisitors from behind.
It’d give us a considerable advantage in the upcoming battle.
cn:
这片森林看似郁郁葱葱，但也并非密不透风。

善加利用森林的话，或许就能摆脱审判官的视线，从背后偷袭他们。
如果能成功，战况会变得相当有利吧。

en:
We might be able to distract them by making some noise.
The problem is how to go about it…

“Hear ye, hear ye—for I have a plan!”

Might as well hear her out.

…You’re not sure if it’s the best idea exactly, but it might not hurt, either.
cn:
如果在别的地方制造骚乱，或许就能引走他们的注意。
问题是该如何引发那样的骚乱呢……

“吾有一计！”

听听罪人的意见吧。

……虽然不知是不是最好的办法，但也不会差到哪里去吧。

en:
“Heretics! The heretics have appeared!”

As the Sinners approached, the Inquisitors cast their victims aside to charge at us.

“You bastards!”

Sinclair stood against them at the forefront.
But, that hammer might be too big for Sinclair’s weapon to stop.
cn:
“异端！是异端！”

罪人们刚一靠近，审判官就丢下拷问到一半的人，纷纷赶来。

“狗娘养的杂种们！”

站在最前方的辛克莱首当其冲，迎上了审判官。
但是，仅凭辛克莱的武器，貌似难以防下那巨锤的攻势。

en:
A Sinner easily enticed by trinkets and baubles would probably be willing to dig through this morbid mess to take the item.
On the other hand, someone uninterested in such things will not be happy to do this order.
cn:
如果是最爱闪闪发光的小玩意的罪人，即使要为了它翻找恶心的尸体，应该也不在话下。
换而言之，让不感兴趣的罪人来也只会起反效果。

en:
“…It won’t work. Too many Inquisitors are guarding the other route.”

We had a Sinner scout the perimeter, and it looks like this is the path of least resistance.
Someone with a burning will might be able to bear this pain.
cn:
“……行不通的吧。其他路上的审判官太多了。”

一名罪人被派去周围侦查，结论是要想减少伤亡，就唯有通过这条路。
如果是热血沸腾的人，就能经受住熊熊燃烧的痛苦吧。

en:
It appears that sitting on the chair is how you begin the rite.
What kind of rite it may be is unclear… but it’s the only way to open the gate.
cn:
坐在椅子上后仪式就会开始。
虽然不知道是怎样的形式……但没有别的方法开门。

en: Someone must step on the spikes and impale their own limbs.
cn: 必须要有人站在荆棘上刺伤自己的四肢才行。

en: There doesn’t seem to be any other way; conversation is our only option.
cn: 除了对话以外，实在想不到什么特别的办法了。

en:
An inscription above the closed gate reads:

Prove your terror and fears
Fill this vessel with tears
cn:
紧闭的大门上写有文字。

“证明你的恐惧与恐怖。
用眼泪填满器皿。”

en:
You see a door on the other side of a red-hot passage.
The sign next to it reads:

Prove your weakness and suppuration
Sear a path with mobilization
cn:
在热到泛红的道路前方能看到大门。
道路前方写有文章。

“证明你的弱小与软弱。
用灼伤的足迹开路吧。”

en:
A passage is written above the large gate.

Only those who repent may find motion
Thorn yourself, atone through flagellation
cn:
巨大的门上写有文字。
“唯有忏悔者能够通过。
用荆棘刺伤你的身体，以痛苦来赎罪。”

en: Let’s try to talk things out first.
cn: 用谈话代替暴力来解决吧。

en:
After getting in position, it leaps for us.
It’s approaching faster than expected.
cn:
刚一做好准备动作它就向我们扑来。
我们以比想象中更快的速度缩小了距离。

en:
The rampage continues.
It might reach a critical point faster than expected.
cn:
愤怒持久不息。
可能会比预想中更早到达极限。

en:
Kromer feigns the appearance of being calm and collected.
But the nail in her hand gleams like a poniard, waiting to tear through the facade of calm.
cn:
克罗默似乎在整理自己的想法，很快就恢复了冷静。
然而，手握长钉的她只是强装冷静，正如怀中匕首，蓄势待发。

en:
Kromer is breathing heavily. Perhaps it’s a side effect of the transformation.

Her posture is unstable, and her eyes are looking elsewhere.

With her focus disrupted, we might be able to land a critical strike.
cn:
克罗默深深地喘着气。或许正是她成为那副姿态的代价。

她的姿势凌乱，眼神则不知凝视着何方。

克罗默已经精神涣散，如今正是给她致命一击的时机。

en:
Its abdomen has filled with red liquid.
It looks like it might expel it at any moment.
A bubbling splash of blood can be seen around its severed neck.
cn:
它腹中装满了鲜红的液体。
看上去似乎马上就会溢出来。
能看见它被斩断的头部周围涌出一团团冒泡的鲜血。

en:
Purple flashes are jumping between the poles.
If they aren’t captured, something bad will happen.
cn:
电线杆之间有紫色的电光四处飞溅。
如果不抓住，也许会发生不妙的事。

en:
The toad had taken a deep breath, inflating its belly.
A blue teardrop or two welled in its huge, round eyes.
This cavern will be filled with an air of gloom once its mouth opens.
It would be best to knock the wind out of it.
cn:
蟾蜍鼓起肚子，深吸一口气。
那如铃铛般瞪开的双眼中噙着蓝色的眼泪。
或许在蟾蜍开口的瞬间，它那阴郁的感情就会扩散至洞穴各处。
还是让它不要哭比较好。

en:
The mechanical puppet stretched its wires onto the ground.
Those wires then dug underneath like roots.
Is it trying to get electricity from the floor?

The robot’s terminal printed out:

<Please Cooperate!>

“…Hold on, doesn’t that mean it can’t do anything while it’s charging?”

The Sinners seem rather unwilling to listen to its request.
cn:
机器人向地面延伸出电线。
随后，那些电线像是扎根一般深深刺入地面。
它是想要充电吗？

“请您配合！”

它胸前的显示屏上出现了这样一句话。

“……也就是说，它现在完全无法行动是吗？”

罪人们似乎完全没有配合它的意思。

en:
It feels as though you find peace in merely looking at it.
The statue seems to be embracing the agony and anguish of all.
There is no self within—only everyone.
It can only make sense that one would lose the will to fight.
However, no man can wholly shoulder another’s suffering in their stead.
Before we all are allured by its false compassion, someone has to break the statue.
cn:
仅仅是像这样望着它，内心便得享安宁。
好似是雕像将万般的痛苦与烦恼以身代之，吞纳入体。
其中无我，而兼有众生。
所有人只一望向那尊雕像，就逐渐丧失了战意，这也是理所当然吧。
然而，不论是谁，都无法分担他人的痛苦。
在众人沉迷于虚假的慈悲之前，必须有人去粉碎那尊雕像。

en:
The chicken holding some stitching supplies pleads with chicky eyes.
Someone has to do this. Those eyes cannot be ignored.
cn:
用翅膀拿着针线的鸡两眼闪闪地望向了罪人。
总得有人来做。可没法对那祈求的眼神视而不见。

en:
The Shock Centipede's body is starting to coil up into one spot.
"It seems electricity is gathering."
As the Sinner pointed out, sparks are flying from the center of its coiled body.
It might be a good idea to stop it.
cn:
电击蜈蚣的身体逐渐向中心缩成一团。
“它似乎是在积蓄电流。”
正如罪人所说，蜷缩的身体中不断地飞溅出火花。
还是让它不再积蓄比较好。

en:
Old umbrellas are lined up around the Drifting Fox.
Old, worn, holed umbrellas.
The umbrellas look like they've been standing there for Wings know how long trying to protect the fox, but it certainly doesn't seem like they're doing a good job at it.
"……."
Then, a Sinner slowly walked toward it.
The fox noticed the Sinner approaching, but it doesn't growl, nor does it happily relax.
It stays still, keeping its ever-constant place.
cn:
流浪狐狸的身旁矗立着一把伞。
那是把古老的、破旧的、漏洞的伞。
那把不知从何时起便存在的伞，仿佛是在试图守护着狐狸，却似乎并未起到应有的作用。
“……”
有一位罪人慢慢地向狐狸面前走去。
狐狸不在意谁靠近了它。它既没有发出声音，也没有愉悦地放松下来。
它只是站在原地，守着它从未改变的位置。

en:
The wooden doll stopped in place as if nothing was happening.
Its head was tilted slightly downward like it was examining its talismans...
Or perhaps it could have been looking at the Sinners' talismans.
"……."
As if possessed, the Sinners began to walk toward the wooden doll.
It was like they forgot they were fighting just moments ago.
And they started removing the talismans entangled on their bodies.
Just what could be going on?
cn:
那木质人偶，就像无事发生一般矗立着。
它微微低着头，就像是在静静地观察着贴在自己身上的护符……
又或者，它是在观察罪人们身上贴着的护符。
“……”
于是罪人们就像是被附身了一般，向着矗立着的木质人偶缓缓走去。
就好像忘记了自己刚刚还在战斗。
之后，他们开始一个接一个撕下自己身上的护符。
到底发生了什么？

en:
The Fairy Gentleman spoke with a jolly laugh.
"Huhu... Didn't think this much would be gulped down."
A short hiccup could also be heard.
"I admit, it caught me off guard a tiny bit... Just a tiny bit."
The fairy then puts the cup in his hand to his mouth.
"Hey! Is that thing trying to sober up?"
"We must keep the blackguard disoriented!"
…It seems the fairy must be stopped from drinking from the cup.
cn:
绅士精灵笑吟吟地开口。
“呼呼……没想到能喝下这么多。”
还传来了短促的嗝声。
“稍微有点……有点吓到了。”
精灵一边说着，一边将手中的酒杯拿到嘴边。
“啊！那个，它是要解酒吗？”
必须让它一直醉着才行！
……似乎必须要阻止精灵向嘴中倾斜那酒杯。

en: A Sinner good at searching should be able to help.
cn: 善于搜索的罪人大概能帮上忙。

en:
Considering our experiences with receiving gifts from Abnormalities,
we might just be able to get something to help with exploring the dungeon here.
cn:
回想一下目前为止从异想体那里收到的礼物。
也许也能得到对探索迷宫有帮助的什么东西。

en:
When you look closer, you can almost see something else in there.
A Sinner with keen eyes might be able to get something good.
cn:
更仔细地观察一下，会发现那里面有什么不一样的东西。
如果是观察力优异的罪人，或许能拿到更好的东西。

en: All the Sinners faced the window.
cn: 全体罪人都朝向了窗户。

en:
"……."

Yi Sang walked ahead.

"I must insist... that I mark the end for Dongrang."

"...For that would be most ideal."
cn:
“……”

罪人李箱走上前去。

“东朗的末路……应当由我来做这了断。”

“……那才最为理想。”

en:
The giant plant that the fairy made grow was as thick as it was tall.

It did have its perks.

Like hiding behind a building's column, one Sinner managed to escape the fairy's view.

The Sinner then carefully struck at the stem.
cn:
精灵制作出的巨大植物，几乎与它自己一样高。

也许正因如此。

就像是藏到建筑物的柱子后一样，一位罪人得以从精灵的视野中脱身。

那名罪人小心翼翼地，从视线死角向那茎干突击。

en:
The chicken holding some stitching supplies pleads with chicky eyes.
Someone has to do this. Those eyes cannot be ignored.
cn:
用翅膀拿着针线的鸡两眼闪闪地望向了罪人。
总得有人来做。可没法对那祈求的眼神视而不见。

en:
We could very easily get swept up in this kind of action before we even know it.

Leaving is an option, but... a hasty retreat would risk drawing the attention of the other Bloodfiends who haven't had the chance to touch the syringe.

Getting into a large-scale conflict is generally inadvisable... maybe there's a Sinner who can somehow get us out of this situation?
cn:
这狂乱的活动随时有可能把我们卷入其中。

但若是贸然离开，也有可能引来那些还没能碰到注射器的血魔。

要避开大规模战斗的话……或许有一位罪人可以收拾这个局面？

en:
Upon closer inspection, the carousel seems to be spinning much faster than these things usually do.

"... Aught seems to be within."

I follow where the Sinner's finger points, and find a strange light emanating from within.
cn:
凑近一看，那旋转木马似乎转得异常之快。

“……在那之中，似有某物。”

顺着罪人指着的方向望去，那其中似乎正射出某种奇妙的光线。

en:
We walked up to the Abnormality. Its desperate attempts at breathing were buried under the loud, exhaling-inhaling noise of an unknown gas.

When the Sinners inhaled the gas, they began to murmur amongst themselves about how it seemed to be clearing their heads.

"Nice, let's sit around here for a while and reap the benefits of this Abnormality before we—"

A dark silhouette, shaped like a human, jumped out of the Abnormality.
"Don't take my breath away," it seems to convey.
cn:
我们走向这异想体。能听到它悲哀的喘息声，被某种气体发出的巨大的“呼哧、呼哧”声所淹没。

吸入这种气体后，罪人们纷纷表示神清气爽、头脑舒畅。

“既然如此，那就先在这里享受会儿这异想体的好处之后再……”

罪人话音未落，那异想体中便跳出了一个黑色的人影。
“不要夺走我的吐息。”它仿佛在这么说。

en: Its thorns are even uglier and sharper up close.
cn: 近看，那荆棘更为狰狞，更为锋利。

en:
Old umbrellas are lined up around the Drifting Fox.

Old, worn, holed umbrellas.

The umbrellas look like they've been standing there for Wings know how long trying to protect the fox, but it certainly doesn't seem like they're doing a good job at it.

"……."

Then, a Sinner slowly walked toward it.

The fox noticed the Sinner approaching, but it doesn't growl, nor does it happily relax.

It stays still, keeping its ever-constant place.
cn:
流浪狐狸的身旁矗立着一把伞。

那是把古老的、破旧的、漏洞的伞。

那把不知从何时起便存在的伞，仿佛是在试图守护着狐狸，却似乎并未起到应有的作用。

“……”

有一位罪人慢慢地向狐狸面前走去。

狐狸不在意谁靠近了它。它既没有发出声音，也没有愉悦地放松下来。

它只是站在原地，守着它从未改变的位置。

en:
The Shock Centipede's body is starting to coil up into one spot.
"It seems electricity is gathering."
As the Sinner pointed out, sparks are flying from the center of its coiled body.
It might be a good idea to stop it.
cn:
电击蜈蚣的身体逐渐向中心缩成一团。

“它似乎是在积蓄电流。”

正如罪人所说，蜷缩的身体中不断地飞溅出火花。

我觉得还是让它不再积蓄比较好。

en:
The Fairy Gentleman spoke with a jolly laugh.

"Huhu... Didn't think this much would be gulped down."

A short hiccup could also be heard.

"I admit, it caught me off guard a tiny bit... Just a tiny bit."

The fairy then puts the cup in his hand to his mouth.

"Hey! Is that thing trying to sober up?"

"We must keep the blackguard disoriented!"

…It seems the fairy must be stopped from drinking from the cup.
cn:
绅士精灵笑吟吟地开口。

“呼呼……没想到能喝下这么多。”

还传来了短促的嗝声。

“稍微有点……有点吓到了。”

精灵一边说着，一边将手中的酒杯拿到嘴边。

“啊！那个，它是要解酒吗？”

必须让它一直醉着才行！

……似乎必须要阻止精灵向嘴中倾斜那酒杯。

The wooden doll stopped in place as if nothing was happening.

Its head was tilted slightly downward like it was examining its talismans...

Or perhaps it could have been looking at the Sinners' talismans.

"……."

As if possessed, the Sinners began to walk toward the wooden doll.

It was like they forgot they were fighting just moments ago.

And they started removing the talismans entangled on their bodies.

Just what could be going on?
cn:
那木质人偶，就像无事发生一般矗立着。

它微微低着头，就像是在静静地观察着贴在自己身上的护符……

又或者，它是在观察罪人们身上贴着的护符。

“……”

于是罪人们就像是被附身了一般，向着矗立着的木质人偶缓缓走去。

就好像忘记了自己刚刚还在战斗。

之后，他们开始一个接一个撕下自己身上的护符。

到底发生了什么？

en:
The giant plant that the fairy made grow was as thick as it was tall.

It did have its perks.

Like hiding behind a building's column, one Sinner managed to escape the fairy's view.

The Sinner then carefully struck at the stem.
cn:
精灵制作出的巨大植物，与那天几乎一样高。

也许正因如此。

就像是藏到建筑物的柱子后一样，一位罪人得以从精灵的视野中脱身。

那名罪人小心翼翼地，从视线死角向茎突击。

en:
Attacking that fairy again will reveal its true form.

This isn’t your first time facing this entity. It won’t be as hard as the first time.

The Sinners seem to agree.

The fairy simply sat there in near complete stillness only interrupted by its intermittently vibrating wings. It was as though the fairy knew you were coming.
cn:
再次攻击那只精灵，或许就能让它显露真容。

既然是已经见过的敌人，与之战斗不会再像第一次一样折磨了吧。

罪人们貌似也是这么想的。

似乎察觉到有人在靠近自己，精灵就像在注视着他们般静静地坐着，只是时而扑扇着翅膀。

en:
If this fight’s been anything to go by, it’ll soon emerge from one of the dimensional rifts.

If we can intuit its next point of emergence, maybe we can deal a fatal blow against it before it fully emerges from the dimensional rift.
cn:
如果和之前一样，那不久后它应该就会从次元裂隙中冲出来。

如果能提前预料到它会从哪里袭击，那或许就能顺势反击，给它致命一击。

en:
Vacuum tubes in the center of the Steam Transport Machine’s torso are glowing.

Slowly, or rapidly, the numbers displayed in the vacuum tubes decreased…

And its broken, rusted chassis began to reconstruct itself.

Did the Steam Transport Machine return to when it was first produced?

Leaving behind everything it’s gone through.

The older the machine gets, the more of itself it will have to reconstruct.

Maybe the Steam Transport Machine can be stopped… if someone could reach into its vacuum tubes?
cn:
蒸汽运输机身体中的真空管不断闪耀。

时而缓速，时而迅捷。那管中的数字持续减少……

它破损生锈的外壳正随着那些数字的减少而重归完美。

蒸汽运输机，是想回归到自己被制作出的那段年代吗？

甚至不惜舍弃自己积累至今的经验与时间。

机械运作得越久，所需要修复的部位当然也就越多。

如果能够触碰到它的真空管……那蒸汽运输机也会就此停止吧？

en:
A dark shadow lingers at the center of the flaming moth.

Its form was vague and mercurial, yet... somehow, you can tell that the shadow is the very core of the moth.

If that shadow could be separated from the flames, perhaps its heat may momentarily subside.
cn:
在那形如火焰的飞蛾中心，一道黑影缠绕其中。

它的形态模糊且变幻莫测……但隐隐约约能知道，那黑影就是蛾的核心。

如果能将其剥离，或许可以暂时熄灭火焰。

en:
As the fight prolonged, more and more vines from the Gossypium begin puncturing the Sinners.

The vines continue to drain blood from them, and the red patch on the white cotton part of the Gossypium grows.

How can these vines be detached from the Sinners?
cn:
随着战斗的进行，罪人们身上留下了越来越多被棉花藤蔓刺穿的伤口。

藤蔓持续吮吸着血液，白色棉花上的红斑也不断扩散。

如何将藤蔓从罪人们身上扯下？

en: The gaze that cleaves all can cleave even the Spiral of Contempt.
cn: 那撕裂一切的锐利视线，甚至能撕裂轻蔑螺旋自身。

en: The gaze that pierces all can pierce even the Spiral of Contempt.
cn: 那贯穿一切的锐利视线，甚至能贯穿轻蔑螺旋自身。

en: The gaze that crushes all can crush even the Spiral of Contempt.
cn: 那粉碎一切的锐利视线，甚至能粉碎轻蔑螺旋自身。

en: The gaze that burns all can burn even the Spiral of Contempt.
cn: 那燃尽一切的锐利视线，甚至能燃尽轻蔑螺旋自身。

en: The gaze that wounds all can wound even the Spiral of Contempt.
cn: 那折磨一切的锐利视线，甚至能折磨轻蔑螺旋自身。

en: The gaze that beholds all can make even the Spiral of Contempt behold.
cn: 那目见一切的锐利视线，甚至能目见轻蔑螺旋自身。

en: The gaze that devours all can devour even the Spiral of Contempt.
cn: 那吞噬一切的锐利视线，甚至能吞噬轻蔑螺旋自身。

en: The gaze that beglooms all can begloom even the Spiral of Contempt.
cn: 那停滞一切的锐利视线，甚至能停滞轻蔑螺旋自身。

en: The gaze filled with scorn for all things can scorn even the Spiral of Contempt.
cn: 那蔑视一切的锐利视线，甚至能蔑视轻蔑螺旋自身。

en: The gaze filled with envy for all things can envy even the Spiral of Contempt.
cn: 那嫉妒一切的锐利视线，甚至能嫉妒轻蔑螺旋自身。

en:
At the end of each cable strewn about the floor is a plug.

Perhaps the sheep knows what it implies.

It lets out a sorrowful cry.

As the Sinners converge on the sheep, the greater, more desperate its screams grow.

The sheep begins to thrash wildly.

Its resistance will only intensify.
cn:
地面上散落着电缆，以及电缆另一端的插头。

那只羊也许知道这意味着什么。

羊悲鸣着。

随着罪人们慢慢靠近，那阻止他们的悲泣声越来越大……

终于，羊开始奋力挣扎。

它的抵抗一定会越来越激烈吧。

en:
'I am a butler of this manor.'

'Yet I do not recognize your faces.'

'I cannot help but be wary; perhaps you seek to mire this manor again in sorrow.'

'If you claim otherwise, then allow me to inquire. Which of these portraits is that of my master?'
cn:
“我是守护这座宅邸的执事。”

“然而，各位又是谁呢？”

“我有些怀疑各位想再度给这座宅邸带来悲伤。”

“若非如此，那敢问各位。其中哪一幅是我家主人的肖像画呢？”

en:
Donning the mask once again summons the ardent emotions that slowly simmer into your heart.

The sorrow rises through the fog of heated battle; its dense weight pierces deep, deep into your emotions.
cn:
再次戴上假面，一股炽热的情感慢慢渗入内心。

被战斗的热浪所遮盖的悲伤逐渐攀升，深压在我们的心头。

en:
'Stop.'

'I don't even remember anymore. I can't even recall if they were even real to begin with.'

'But you... you still remember your loved ones.'

'I'll blast your skulls apart. Every single one of you.'

There's an old pendant hanging from the shooter's neck.

Perhaps it could be the key to resolving this battle.
cn:
“到此为止。”

“我已经什么都想不起来了。连其是否存在过都模糊不清。”

“可你们……却依然记得所爱之人。”

“我要把你们的脑袋全部打爆。一个不留。”

就在这时，注意到了射手的脖子上挂着一枚陈旧的吊坠。

或许那枚吊坠会成为解决这场战斗的关键。

en: Core
cn: 本体

cn: 本体

cn: 本体

cn: 本体

en:
So soon after setting sail...

"Woah!"

... We started hearing something shaking underneath the ship.

"What's that...?"

"Forsooth, there may be a foe underneath our ship, scratching!

"... Yeah, that's ominous. We should check it out."

What do we do?
cn:
在船开始移动后不久……

“哇！”

从船底传来了咯吱咯吱的噪音。

“怎么回事……？”

“好像有什么东西在抓挠着船底！”

“……确实不太妙。我们最好去检查一下。”

我们该怎么做？

en: This has to be the artery Ahab was talking about. Once we cut this thing open... our path to the center of the heart will open.
cn: 这里无疑就是亚哈提到过的动脉。一旦我们切开这东西，通往心脏中央的道路就会敞开。

en:
"Is that... a wooden crate?"

The Sinners found a haphazardly thrown pile of crates.

"It can be extrapolated from their appearances that they were to be used as supply crates."

Some boxes has the Twinhook Pirates' logo drawn on them. Some of them has the Before Team's logo.

The Whale must've swallowed these crates, too.

"'Tis wise to procure some of them as our provisions!"

Right. We don't know what'll happen once we get to the heart.

Should we take some of them, just in case?
cn:
“那些是……木箱吗？”

在罪人们所指的方向，能看到一些杂乱堆放的箱子。

“看起来像是为了进行补给而准备的物品。”

一些箱子上有着双钩海盗团的纹样，而另一些箱子上绘有LCCB的标志。

这些东西一定是被鲸一起吞下去的。

“吾认为从这里取得一些补给乃是明智之举！”

确实。我们还不知道在心脏附近会发生什么。

以防万一，是不是该从这里带点东西去呢？

en:
"I failed."

"<...!>"

Is that an illusion? Or... is that also Ishmael?

Behind the Captain appears a silhouette of Ishmael, encased in that pale membrane.

"I couldn't solve anything. I failed everything."

"All I managed to do was survive. Pathetically, like a wretch. Hanging on to my dear friend's coffin."

The Captain guffaws madly. "Indeed, Ishmael! You couldn't save anyone! Not your crew! Not your friend! Nobody!"

"And you will give up again. Because you are afraid! You will give up even before you start!"

The Sinners start to get agitated.

"That bloody bastard...!"

"Don't listen to her, Ishmael! S-she doesn't know what she's talking about!

"<......>"

The Manager holds their silence.

Then utters.
cn:
“我失败了。”

“<……！>”

那是幻象，还是另一个以实玛利？

在船长的身后，出现了一个被白色黏膜覆盖全身的以实玛利的轮廓。

“到最后，我也什么都没能解决。”

“我只能可悲地挣扎着，像个可怜虫一样，拼尽全力地抓住朋友的棺材，然后一个人孤零零的活下去。”

船长疯狂地大笑。“没错！以实玛利！你谁都救不了！救不了与你我一同航行的船员！救不了你的朋友！救不了任何人！”

“然后你肯定又会放弃。因为你害怕！你觉得这是不可能的事情！”

罪人们开始焦躁起来。

“这个该死的混蛋……”

“以实玛利小姐！请不要听她的话！她、她只不过是在胡言乱语！”

“<……>”

经理保持着沉默。

然后，静静地开口。

en:
"Can you hear me? Can you hear my voice?!"

I suddenly realize that an unfamiliar voice is echoing directly in my head.

"<Is this... is this sound coming directly through the Golden Bough...?>"

"... You hear that too, Clockhead?"

I turn around to look at Heathcliff. He appears exhausted from the prolonged battle, both in body and spirit.

The Golden Bough that once pierced his chest was long removed after my clock turned...

... but its influence seemed to be lingering for some reason.

"Catherine...?"

Heathcliff whispers.
cn:
“能听见吗？能听见我的声音吗？！”

突然间，我意识到有个声音直接在脑海中回响。

“<这是……我通过金枝所听到的吗？>”

“……钟表头。你也听见了吗。”

回头看去，希斯克利夫因为长时间的战斗而身心俱疲，露出了僵硬的表情。

而扎在他胸口处的金枝，也在我倒转时钟后被拔了出来。

但不知为何，那种影响还没有消失。

“凯瑟琳……？”

希斯克利夫小声地自言自语道。

en:
My head fills with the voice once again.

"I never should have summoned that Catherine here..."

"I thought... I thought Heathcliff would never have to suffer again if every Catherine were to no longer exist..."

"... But I should have known that Heathcliff would have thought the very same...!"

I can feel her heartrending sorrow.

"... Ah... I never should have fled. I should have talked to her instead of running away."

Heathcliff was right. Every unspoken word, every unshared discussion only broke their hearts further apart from each other... until their words began to run parallel, never to converge.

"If only I could go back..."

"Is there truly no way out of this trap that woman set for us...?"
cn:
那声音再次填满了我的脑海。

“我不该召唤那个凯瑟琳的……”

“我本以为如果我和所有凯瑟琳全都消失的话……希斯克利夫就不会再不幸了……”

“但是希斯克利夫不可能没有同样的想法……！”

撕心裂肺般的强烈悲伤向我传来。

“……呜。那个时候，我应该和她谈谈，而不是逃跑的。”

就像希斯克利夫带着悔恨的话语所说……那些被省略、被咽下的话语，最终造就了这分歧的平行线。

“就算现在能回到过去……”

“也没办法……从那个人设下的陷阱中逃脱吗？”

en: A bear plush looks at us with a sad expression. Several sharp nails are impaling its body.
cn: 被数根尖钉刺穿的玩具熊茫然地看着我们。

en: We approached the faded signpost in this twisted space. Welcome to La Manchaland. Two types of tickets and their prices are written underneath that logo. Looks like we'll have to purchase a ticket here to enter... Which one should we purchase?
cn:
我们在扭曲的空间里靠近了一块模糊的告示板。

欢迎来到拉·曼却领。

告示板下写着的文字里列出了所贩卖的门票以及价格。

看样子想要进去就必须购买门票。

应该买哪一种门票呢？

en:
We walked past the entrance and into La Manchaland.

Which Area should we visit first in order to escape this maze-like amusement park?
cn:
穿过入口，我们进入了拉·曼却领。

为了逃出这个像迷宫一样的游乐园，我们应该先去哪个区域呢？

en:
We made it to the Parade Area without wasting any more time.

After a while of walking along the Parade to the front, a Bloodfiend suddenly came up to us.

"Why not take a commemorative pic with the Parade as the background?"
"A little bit of blood, and you can remember this moment for-ever-and-ever!"

What should we do?
cn:
我们前往了永无止境的游行区域。

沿着队伍前进时，不知从何处出现的血魔过来搭话。

“要不要拍一张以游行为背景的纪念照？”
“只要稍微支付一点血液，就能将这一瞬间永远保存下来！”

该如何抉择？

en: We see a door to a giant containment chamber. We're going to have to get through that to escape this maze. There's an unfamiliar machine on the road to the chamber. It must be a raffle machine La Manchaland used during event periods. A little bit of blood for something very useful! There's an advertisement written in elaborate typography. Maybe we'll be able to find 'something very useful' in there?
cn:
能看到巨大的收容单元的门。

为了离开迷宫，我们不得不穿过那里。

路边能看到未知的机器。

那貌似是在拉·曼却领活动期间会使用的抽奖机。

只需少量血液便能得到实用的商品！

气派的橱窗上写着这样的宣传语。

也许机器里确实能抽到什么有用的东西？

en:
A little bit of blood didn't give us anything.

Is the advertisement text lying to us?

Or maybe we were just unlucky.

What should we do?
cn:
只支付少量血液并没有拿到有用的奖品。

难道是宣传语造假了吗？

也许只是运气太差了。

该如何抉择？

en:
"While the noble Knight and his Squire was on their most wonderful adventure..."

"The rest of their Family waited, chewing slowly on what subsistence they were availed."

"Though it is unclear whether all that waiting was worth it."

A sarcastic, disembodied narration echoes from somewhere.

Before the Sinners, the 'subsistence' that the Family was eating appeared.
cn:
“骑士与侍从外出进行伟大冒险之时。”

“他们的家人仅靠着被赐予的食物度过了孤独的时光。”

“虽不知那份等待是否有所价值。”

从某处传来了语气中含着嘲弄的旁白声。

在罪人们面前，那些家人们吃剩下的食物留在原地。

en:
"They gobble down on that dry, flavorless 'food'."

"But their hunger is not the kind to be sated by such supplements."

"Unable to bear that hollow feeling, they tried to eat more of that food."

"As though they were trying to convince themselves that gorging on that thing would free them from this starvation."
cn:
“他们狼吞虎咽地吞咽着，吞咽着那干燥难吃的食物。”

“然而，这份饥饿仅凭那些应该无法满足吧。”

“难以忍受那份空虚，他们再次伸手握住食物。”

“似乎认为只要继续吃下去，这份饥饿便能够消退。”

en: "Once again, they gobbled up the food." "They ate, and ate, and ate until they could no longer stuff any more of it into their mouths." "But oh, how unfortunate... They were still hungry." "The Family once again witlessly begins to set their table with that flavorless food."
cn:
“他们这次也狼吞虎咽地吞咽着食物。”

“吞食，再吞食，直到口中被食物塞得满满当当。”

“然而，令人遗憾的是……他们仍然感到饥饿。”

“愚蠢的家人们又一次……将那难吃的食物，尽情地摆在眼前。”

en:
"It seems that they, in their endless naïveté, still believe that they simply haven't eaten enough food."

"Let's see how long this... meaningless banquet lasts."
cn:
“即便如此，天真的他们仍然觉得是因为吃的太少才没能满足。”

“他们还会重复这无意义的进食多久……让我们默默观看吧。”

en:
A mass of brambles, its thorns sharp, stands in our way.

"The Knight and the Squire adventured together for a long, long time."

"They enjoyed so many adventures together."

"Which one of them was the most interesting?"

The narration, again.

What should we say?
cn:
锋利的荆棘堵塞了道路。

“骑士与侍从的冒险持续了许久。”

“他们经历过许许多多形形色色的愉快冒险。”

“在那之中哪一次冒险最为有趣呢？”

旁白问道。

该怎么回答呢？

en:
A dilapidated wall blocks our path.
There's a device on it with a label that says "Pick up your entry cards here". Next to it is a dial of sorts.

'Looks like they won't let us through so easily.'
'Is anyone particularly good with these devices? I can't seem to figure it out...'
cn:
陈旧的墙壁挡住了去路。
写着发放通行证的装置和表盘引人注目。

“看样子不会轻易让我们过去。”
“有谁对这种装置有研究吗？我对这玩意儿是一窍不通……”

en:
There are several talismans glued to the wall.

I can feel the wind blowing through the barely visible cracks on the wall.

'Seems like there's something on the other side.'

Maybe there's a hidden passageway here?

The Sinners take a moment to investigate the room, and find a wall with conspicuously arranged talismans of different colors.

'Ohh~ These must be colors that match each of the cardinal directions~'
'Looks like we'll have to peel these talismans in the correct order.'

Should we try peeling the talismans?
cn:
裂了缝的墙上贴满了符咒。

有风从裂缝那头吹来。

“似乎对面也有空间。”

有没有通过这里的办法呢？

罪人们分散开调查后，发现一处贴着几张与别处符咒颜色不同的符咒的区域。

“啊~好像各个方位上都贴着相应颜色的符咒呢~”
“看样子，我们需要按顺序将符咒撕下。”

要试着撕下符咒吗？

en:
There's something written on the blue talisman to the West.

Looks like they're indicating that this is the first talisman to be removed.

When I remove the talisman, the walls begin to shake.

Which one should I remove next?
cn:
墙壁西侧贴着的青色符咒上似乎印着什么。

看样子是让我们从这里开始撕下符咒的意思。

撕下符咒后，墙壁开始摇晃。

接下来要撕下哪个方位的符咒呢？

en:
I remove the red talisman in the North.

The walls are now shaking with greater intensity.

Which one should we peel next?
cn:
撕下了墙壁北侧贴着的红色符咒。

墙壁的摇晃似乎更加剧烈了。

接下来要撕下哪张符咒呢？

en:
I remove the yellow talisman in the center.

The walls are now shaking with greater intensity.

Which one should we peel next?
cn:
撕下了墙壁中央贴着的黄色符咒。

墙壁的摇晃似乎更加剧烈了。

接下来要撕下哪张符咒呢？

en:
I remove the white talisman in the East.

The walls are shaking like they're about to crumble any minute.

There's just one more talisman to peel.
cn:
撕下了墙壁东侧贴着的白色符咒。

墙壁几乎像是要垮塌一般剧烈摇晃着。

只剩下一张符咒了。

en:
Ahem. You must be Jia Baoyu... and his clan, right?'

'I, uh... got separated from my faction when the walls suddenly burst from the ground.'

'Some are still with me, but I don't think I'll get very far like this...'

'Can you help me find where the rest of my faction is?'

'Hey, if you help me out today, I'll look out for you when I become the Family Hierarch.'

'C'mon, man. Help me out!'
cn:
“咳咳。你们是那个贾宝玉的部下……没错吧？”

“实际上呢。都怪突然升起来的墙壁，害得我和自己的部下走散了。”

“只靠这些跟上我的家伙，还是很难继续前进……”

“所以，你们能帮我找找我的下属在哪儿吗？”

“如果能帮我找到，我在成为家主后也能多照看你们一下。”

“愣着干嘛？还不快想个办法然后告诉我？”

en: One speaks a hollow lamentation, The other yearns in an empty desire. One is a moon on the water's surface, a reflection, And the other is a blossom's image in a mirror. Flowers have bloomed over the bodies of the prisoners. I don't see any movement... looks like they're all dead. 'These flowers possess... the augmentative qualities of H Corp.' 'They will most likely provide some advantage in the battles to come.' Which flower should we pick?
cn: 一个枉自嗟呀， 一个空劳牵挂。 一个是水中月， 一个是镜中花。 在被打倒的鸿园囚犯身上，盛开着鲜花。 他们一动不动了，看来已经气绝身亡。 “这里的花……蕴含着H公司的强化技术。” “如果带走的话，应该能在之后的战斗中发挥作用。” 要折下哪朵花呢。

en:
We enter a new room and see a bound prisoner next to a Bolus on a table.
There, we see a candidate standing around as though they've been waiting for someone to arrive.

'Ah, now we have enough people for this special game to commence!'

'Please direct your attention to the Bolus on the table! Observe it well!'

'It is a Bolus currently in development here at H Corp; it is yet to be commercialized for mass-market use.'

'Apparently it can help restore your vitality once taken, but... let's see how true that is, shall we?'

'Do you think this is indeed a successful new product, or... is it a failure?'

'Now's the time to place your bets with your coins! Guess—is it a success, or a failure?'

'The candidate who gets this question right gains all the coins in the pool!'
cn:
我们来到了新的房间，房间里有一位被拘束的鸿园囚犯，一旁的桌子上放着丸。
这里有一位候选人像是在等待着谁一般伫立着。

“来得好，这样就凑够人数了！”

“现在请仔细观察这边桌子上放着的丸！”

“这些丸是H公司正在开发中的新产品，还没有商品化。”

“据说其有着激发活力的功效……果真如此吗？”

“这种丸是真的具有这一功效的成功品呢，还是具有其他功效的失败品呢。”

“请各自决定预测的答案，以铜钱下注吧！”

“答对的候选人将赢得这一局的所有铜钱！”

en:
The other candidate bets on 'failure'.

How many coins should we wager?
cn:
另一位候选人下注给“失败品”。

要赌上几枚铜钱呢？

en:
The other candidate bets on 'success'.

How many coins should we wager?
cn:
另一位候选人下注给“成功品”。

要赌上几枚铜钱呢？

en: No wisdom nor virtue can change the past and the future, and human connections and fate make strangers of neighbors. 'Welcome, candidates! Congratulations on making it to the basement!' 'Did you know that there are far more opportunities down here to collect those coins that you all want?' 'In fact, there are so many opportunities that... there's one right under your feet, in that hole!' 'Who will dare make the dark descent to claim the coins?!' The hole leads into the pitch-black darkness of the building ruins. We don't need to go down there to know that it's probably a pretty risky trek. We do need the coins, but... this might be too big a risk to take. What if we get injured or, even worse, killed? What should we do?
cn: 过去未来，莫谓智贤能打破； 前因后果，须知亲近不相逢。 “欢迎来到地下的各位候选人！” “你们知道吗？在这里，收集铜钱的机会比在地面上更多。” “比方说……现在，诸位的脚下也藏着一枚铜钱。” “向下进入险象环生之地，最终夺得铜钱的候选人究竟会是谁呢！” 一看便知是危机四伏的废墟，又深又暗的下层区域。 虽然确实需要铜钱，但稍有不慎便有可能受重伤乃至死亡。 该怎么做呢？

en:
We enter the room to find a condemned of Hongyuan bound to a wall.
In front of him are several punitive weapons like whips and batons.

'The man who sits before you is a prisoner of H Corp. He is a condemned who has committed a grave crime.'
'Punish the condemned, candidates, and you'll be rewarded with coins!'

What should we do?
cn:
房间里绑着一名囚犯。
其面前摆满了鞭子棍棒等各种武器。

“现在被绑在诸位面前之人，是在H公司曾犯下重罪的囚犯。”
“给予这个囚犯惩罚的候选人将获得铜钱！”

该如何抉择？

en:
We enter a new room with a collection of jars at its center.
I wonder if they're Xue Pan's jars he didn't get to use?

I notice that one of the jars is cracked open.
There's a sound coming from within...

Maybe someone's trapped in there, but...
... I don't know if it's a good idea to fiddle with these things.

What should we do?
cn:
房间中央有许多瓮放在一起。
这是薛蟠还没来得及使用的瓮吗？

其中一个开着口的瓮尤其引人注目。
似乎从里面传来了什么声音。

也许有人被困在了瓮中。
但感觉这不是可以轻易触碰的东西。

该如何抉择？

en: Resentment is an avenging cycle of infinite weight, every meeting and reunion an immutable destiny; thus, karma of one’s previous life measures their worldly stay before the final flight. Wealth in the twilight of life is a fortune most rare; those who understand this leave their home for temples, and those who are seduced by it fill their time with empty air. Birds, their bellies full with feed, flutter away to the forest; the field of white snow remains pristine, nary a footstep marring its immaculacy. 'I see a candidate who just lost a bunch of coins!' 'Someone among the audience wishes to grant an opportunity to rebound!' 'Well, seems like... we'll have to send you some wooden dummies to recoup your lost coins!'
cn: 冤冤相报实非轻， 分离合聚皆前定。 欲知命短问前生， 老来富贵也真侥幸。 看破的，遁入空门。 痴迷的，枉送了性命。 好一似食尽鸟投林， 落了片白茫茫大地真干净！ “看到有候选人因丢了铜钱而遗憾？” “观众们说想给他们一个机会！” “那么……是不是得给诸位送来一些能从中获得铜钱的木人呢？”

en: Streams turn crimson with fallen petals, and unspeakable sorrow becomes a vast, innumerable system of roots; thus, the unresolved resentment blames naught but the springtime breeze. There are two large jars in the room, with two mysterious devices hanging from above them. The host's voice booms from the speakers the moment we approach the jars. 'Another chance to earn yourself some coin!' 'The conditions are simple: remain as long as you can inside those jars.' 'Try sending in a clan member who's not so easily rattled, and pick up your coins! Easy, right?'
cn: 花落水流红， 闲愁万种， 无语怨东风。 能看到两个巨大的瓮，其上方安装着不明装置。 靠近瓮时，扬声器中传出了主持人洪亮的声音。 “这又是一次获得铜钱的机会！” “条件很简单。只要在瓮中待尽可能久的时间就好了。” “只要派出能忍受恐惧的部下……便能轻易获得铜钱！”

en: Springtime’s dream scatters like clouds in the wind, and falling petals float away on the stream; thus, to every son and daughter, we pose this question: why seek and wander for such vain suffering? There's another candidate in this room. The moment we enter the threshold, the door shuts behind us, and the host's voice booms from the speakers once again. 'Defeat the opposing candidate, and be granted the opportunity to find yourself a new path with even better opportunities!' 'But... we don't want to make this fight too boring, do we? Let's add some variables.' With a heavy thunking noise, suspicious plumes of smoke begin to seep from the ground. The Sinners who inhaled it begin to cough violently. ... That can't be good.
cn: 春梦随云散， 飞花逐水流； 寄言众儿女， 何必觅闲愁？ 进入房间后，我们看见了另一位候选人。 就在下一瞬，房门砰然关闭，主持人的声音随之响起： “击败对手并获得胜利的候选人，将有机会前往蕴含更多机遇的房间！” “不过……如果只是普通地战斗，那可就和在外面战斗没什么区别了，对吧？” 伴随着咔咔声，奇怪的烟雾从地板缝隙间悄然冒出。 吸入烟雾的罪人们表情逐渐僵硬，房间四处传来剧烈的咳嗽声。 ……情况似乎不妙。

en:
'Well, whichever method you used to arrive in this room... congratulations are in order!'
'As a reward for finding this secret room... feel free to take a helpful artifact! Just one, though.`
`Also... some of these artifacts might be off-limits to those who don't have enough coins!'
'Please choose carefully. They're precious artifacts from the great houses.'

Which one should we choose?
cn:
“无论你是通过何种方式抵达此地……恭喜你！”
“作为抵达这间隐藏房间的奖励……你可以从中带走一件有助于家主评审的器物。”
“不过要注意……如果你持有的铜钱不足，将无法选择某些器物！”
“这些都是各个家族提供的珍贵器物，请慎重抉择。”

要选哪一件器物呢？

en: Happiness and laughter are but illusions. Sorrow and grief are but illusions also. Avarice, yearning, and longing are but manifestations of one's vacuity. We run into a different candidate's clan in a narrow hallway. 'Feel free to duke it out, but... with the candidates' mutual agreement...' 'I think we can turn this battle into a more interesting game.' 'It's up to the both of you, though!'
cn: 喜笑悲哀都是假， 贪求思慕总因痴。 在狭窄的走廊里，遇到了另一位候选人的部下。 “虽然也可以在这里战斗，但如果两位候选人都同意的话……” “我们可以采用一种别开生面的对决方式。” “作出你们的决定吧！”

en: I mean, do we have to hand over our coins? Why don't we just beat them up and take our coins back? Actually... hey, nothing's stopping us from beating them up and taking their coins, too! The question is... should we?
cn:
真的有给出铜钱的必要吗？
反正只要再将其战胜，便能拿回铜钱。
不仅如此，甚至还能得到对方候选人的铜钱。

但是……可以这么做吗？

en:
"H-hang on. What's going on with this thing? It doesn't feel like the same entity we ran into in the Mirror Dungeon!"
"... If we are to delve deeper, it appears to mirror the one we encountered in the Refraction Railway."

"... While Hohenheim does harbor some interest in this subject..."

"He is not great enough a genius to turn that curiosity into reality."
"Then why could this possibly be happening...?"

"Hold on—someone left this here."
"Hm. It seems to be a torn page of a note. It's covered in fluorescent paint so it would be easier to spot."

Whoever left it couldn't have known we were coming. It's probably a note meant for possible survivors.
No reason not to read it.

- Observation Record: Irregularities
Written by Moses, LCD On-site Investigative Reasoning Team Leader

This entity abruptly escaped its containment unit during the assault.
Readers of this note should be warned that this entity shows some irregularities that have not been observed previously.
cn:
“等、等一下。这孩子怎么了？和在镜像迷宫里见过的那个，有点不一样吧？”
“……如果要比较的话，像在折射轨道……那个地方见到的样子。”

“……虽然霍恩海姆确实对该领域抱有兴趣……”

“但他并非那种能将兴趣转化为成果的天才。”
“那，这究竟是……”

“等等，好像这里有谁留下了什么东西？”
“嗯。看起来像是从笔记本上撕下来夹在这里的。为了看起来显眼，甚至涂了荧光涂料。”

写下笔记的人应该没想到来的会是我们，这应该是为幸存者留下的笔记。
读一读也不会有损失。

- 特别事项记录
记录人：LCD部门，现场推理小队 队长 摩西

该个体于袭击时，突然从收容单元出逃。
此事疑似属于尚未查明的异常事项，故留此记录。

en: A bear plush looks at us with a sad expression. Several sharp nails are impaling its body.
cn: 被数根尖钉刺穿的玩具熊茫然地看着我们。

en:
"Hey, you've come at just the right time. Listen, I need your advice."

We walked into a room with two Heishou glaring at each other, both of their buggy eyes bloodshot and clearly angry.

They explained to me that a Heishou of the You branch, in service of Xichun, happened to get into a kerfuffle with another Heishou.

"... And that's about the gist of it. Good thing they're both from my branches. A simple punishment wouldn't have been enough otherwise."

Like Xichun said, it seemed that they had decided to punish the Heishou of the You branch, who started the fight.

"How should I go about this?"
cn:
“来得正好。我正需要你们的建议。”

我们刚踏入这个喧闹的空间，便看到两只黑兽正以充血的眼睛相互瞪视。

听完来龙去脉后，我们得知似乎是惜春麾下的一只黑兽 - 酉与其他黑兽发生了冲突。

“……事情就是这样。唉，幸好他们二人都是我的部下，否则便不是简单处罚一下就能了事的了。”

正如惜春所言，她似乎决定处罚引发骚乱的黑兽 - 酉来平息事态。

“你们觉得怎么处置比较好？”

en:
One after-school afternoon.

Xichun invited the Sinners to her office.

One of the Sinners notices a piece of red cloth on the ground, and inquires about it—but she only tilts her head curiously.

"That's not mine. That's... weird. I thought I cleared out all of the former Jia Mu's stuff..."

The red cloth was soaked in what appeared to be ominous, tarnished blood.
cn:
课程全都结束后的某个下午。

惜春将罪人们邀请至自己的办公室。

当一名罪人问起掉落在地上的红布时，贾惜春歪头表示困惑。

“那不是我的东西。奇怪……我应该已经把前任家母的东西全部清理掉了才对……”

那块红布已被令人不快的污血浸透了。

en:
It's another day of classes for Jia Xichun, who's trying her best to prove her right to be the Family Hierarch.

After class...

... Jia Xichun came to visit the Sinners who taught today's classes.

"Guys, is it office hours? There were some things I didn't quite understand about today's class..."

The Sinners... or, rather, the teachers, turned to pay attention to Jia Xichun's questions.
cn:
为了证明自己是足以成为家主的人才，贾惜春今天也在认真听课。

在课程结束后的课余时间里。

贾惜春拜访了为她授课的罪人们。

“关于今天所学的部分。有些地方我还不太明白……”

罪人们……不，老师们欣然地倾听了贾惜春的提问。

en:
It's another day of classes for Jia Xichun, who's trying her best to prove her right to be the Family Hierarch.

After class...

... Jia Xichun came to visit the Sinners who taught today's classes.

"Guys, is it office hours? There were some things I didn't quite understand about today's class..."

The Sinners... or, rather, the teachers, turned to pay attention to Jia Xichun's questions.
cn:

在课程结束后的课余时间里。

贾惜春拜访了为她授课的罪人们。

“关于今天所学的部分。有些地方我还不太明白……”

罪人们……不，老师们欣然地倾听了贾惜春的提问。

en:
It's another day of classes for Jia Xichun, who's trying her best to prove her right to be the Family Hierarch.

After class...

... Jia Xichun came to visit the Sinners who taught today's classes.

"Guys, is it office hours? There were some things I didn't quite understand about today's class..."

The Sinners... or, rather, the teachers, turned to pay attention to Jia Xichun's questions.
cn:
为了证明自己是足以成为家主的人才，贾惜春今天也在认真听课。

在课程结束后的课余时间里。

贾惜春拜访了为她授课的罪人们。

“关于今天所学的部分。有些地方我还不太明白……”

罪人们……不，老师们欣然地倾听了贾惜春的提问。

en:
The black market of District 8 Backstreets were full of interesting yet dangerous items.

Boluses that make you smarter at the cost of hair loss.

An Anamnaworm of someone who has tasted all kinds of wonderful cuisines.

But the one that stood out to us was...

"...? What's that doing there?"

"Dante, that thing's clearly been fenced. Maybe we can... "yoink" it, if ya know what I mean?"
cn:
8区后巷的黑市中，充斥着各种稀奇古怪而危险的物品。

有能让脑袋变聪明却同时会脱发的丸。

有尝遍世间山珍海味之人的虫。

而其中最引人注目的则是……

“……？那东西怎么会在这种地方？”

“但丁，那个怎么看都像是赃物啊……不过如果能顺利的话，说不定咱们能轻松地把它搞到手？”

en: One day, wheat grains he planted did not sprout. One day, he stopped feeling the scent of life between his breaths. Thus, he rides against the currents, hunting after waves. He seeks the waves, reproaches them, and eventually brings about their destruction. Faint memories, having blinked through Amiya's fathoms, flash briefly before my eyes, and the Seaborn knight wields his great lance against surfaced Sea Terrors. He shudders as though with repulsiveness, but he does not stop. "You obstruct progress and cover the lands." "That is impermissible." "This is... the land." The knight and the Sea Terrors don't necessarily seem to be on the same side. Perhaps diplomacy may be a viable solution here?
cn: 那一天，他种下的小麦不再发芽。 那一天，他再未闻到生命的气息。 于是他开始逆流而行，狩猎海浪。 他搜寻海浪，斥骂海浪，最终将其击碎。 久远的记忆，通过阿米娅的心象，在我眼前闪过。 与此同时，那位被称为海嗣的骑士，向登陆的恐鱼挥起长枪。 身体虽然如同抗拒一般颤抖不已，但是骑士没有停下。 “你们要阻挡前路，吞噬大地吗。” “此事，绝不容许。” “这里是……大地。” 看来骑士与恐鱼们的目的并不一致。 或许与之沟通是可行的？

en: The Sinners' relentless assault upon the knight begins to slow. Though we don't have anything in common with the knight... Cold, cold loneliness rides his bellow, insidious under the faint light. Are we waves, or rocks in his eyes? The sea wets our hems, giving us no time to answer the question.
cn: 罪人们对最后的骑士猛烈的攻势也开始变得迟缓。 我们和骑士，明明没有任何相同之处…… 微弱的灯光下，伴随着骑士的咆哮，冰冷的孤独扩散开来。 在他眼中，我们是浪潮，还是岩石呢。 还来不及解开疑问，大海已打湿了我们的衣襟。

en: The knight rides upon the violently whinnying steed. Lance raised skyward, the knight races across the sea, splitting its waves. "We won't succeed at this rate..." "Stall him, please... even for a second." Irene directs her hand cannon toward the knight. Her aim and will undulates on the same frequency with the waves. We need but a moment to recover. Topple the waves. Go for his legs, not his lance.
cn: 骑士跃上了正凶猛嘶鸣的烈马。 高举着长枪，骑士破浪而行，在浪潮之上疾驰。 “这样下去不行。” “即使只有一瞬间也好……请务必阻止他。” 艾丽妮举起手炮，瞄准骑士。 准心和意志，与浪潮一同起伏着。 即使只是片刻也没关系。 击碎海浪吧。 瞄准他的腿，而非长枪。

en:
Mayors's Despair.

The repulsiveness of people's ill-intent.

And the faint hope from the light found within.

All kinds of emotions and memories rise to the surface of Amiya's fathoms, then sink again.

Those same thoughts seep into me as well, unfiltered.

"... The sins that people have committed won't just go away."

"Humanity's ill-intent will propagate unimpeded, too."

"But the tides that Miss Mayors is trying to summon to douse it..."

"... will devour humanity, their civilization, and the City they came from."

"So... I don't think that's the right way to go."

"Not as long as Dante, and the people of Limbus Company, refuse."

This isn't like the time I retrieved the E.G.O.

In place of the light, a speck of darkness casts a shadow.
cn:
梅厄斯曾体会过的绝望。

对人们恶意的抗拒。

甚至在这夹缝中寻得的，对光明的希望。

无数的感情与记忆在阿米娅的心象之上浮现，又再次沉没。

而阿米娅浮现出的所有思绪，都未经过滤地直接渗透进我的内心。

“人们犯下的罪，不会消失。”

“人类心怀的恶意，也将无止境地蔓延开来吧。”

“但梅厄斯为了熄灭这些而召唤来的浪潮……”

“会把人类、文明……以及各位所来自的都市，都尽数吞没吧。”

“我认为……那样的事情，是不应该发生的。”

“除非但丁经理，以及边狱公司的各位希望如此。否则绝不应该。”

与打捞E.G.O时不同。

眼前落下的并非光芒，而是微小的黑暗。

en:
Tides carry away the windows to Mayors's past, soon devouring them beyond vision.

It's almost as if Mayors and the Dungeon of the Fathoms—no, the ocean itself is fusing into one.

"A majority of Distortions encountered by the Bus team have assumed a form generally recognized as an 'organic entity'."

"However, there is nothing preventing a Distortion's form from breaking that boundary and taking a different shape, as it may vary by the individual's desires."

"If her Distortion is allowed to exacerbate undeterred, it may eventually corrode this very space in which we stand."

As we were taking some time to catch our breaths, a few small machines tumbled to the ground, shot from one of the trembling fathoms.

It must be one of those mysterious machines in Mayors's home we saw when we peered into her memories.

The machines continued to whir loudly as though the waves broke them...

We saw that there were various apparatus attached to the sockets on their sides.

"Expensive they appear, yet how... numerous they are."

"Well, you know. Maybe she's similar to one of those Fixer fellas who are always hell-bent on picking up every new cutting-edge Workshop tech."

"Huh, it says... "Little Handy" down here."

"This has an oddly similar structure to the "Hand of the Saint" the Inquisitor brought."

"Gasp! Then shalt this fantastically wanda-ful machine be of assistance in our battles?!"

Rhodes Island already seems to have their hands full holding the line against the tide of Sea Terrors.

We should probably take just one and leave the rest to help them out.

After a quick discussion with the Sinners, we decided to take just one of the machines.
cn:
心象迷宫内，若干似乎属于梅厄斯过往的光景，随着海浪的冲刷逐渐消散了。

仿佛……梅厄斯正在与心象迷宫，不，正在与大海本身融为一体。

“我们所遭遇的大部分扭曲，都是以‘生命体’的形态存在。”

“扭曲的形态，会因个人的欲望不同而千差万别。”

“如果这里的扭曲进一步加深的话……恐怕会侵蚀这个空间本身。”

稍作喘息，从摇曳的心象的角落里，滚落出几台带有车轮的奇妙机器。

这似乎正是在我们窥见的记忆里，曾在梅厄斯家的地板上到处乱窜、莫名其妙的机器。

不知是不是因海浪冲击而受损还是什么，机器不断地发出嗡嗡的低鸣声……

在它们侧面的接口上，各自安插着不同的器具。

“看起来是相当昂贵的机器……可数量却多得惊人。”

“就像收尾人里面，也有那种工坊每次推出什么新武器就立刻抢着去买的人。”

“机器下面写着……小帮手。”

“和审判官带来的那件叫圣徒之手的装置……结构很相似啊。”

“哈！那便意味着这台神奇又帅气的机器，想必将对此后之战斗大有裨益？！”

正在抵挡无数恐鱼的罗德岛那边，一看就知道已经十分吃力。

只带走一台，其余的都留给罗德岛比较好。

在征得罪人们的同意后，我们决定只带走其中一台机器。

en:
There seems to be a commotion at the village square.

Villagers are surrounding someone with a clear intent to threaten.

"The evil sorcerer's gone, so why won't this calamity end? Explain!"

"Be honest! You just couldn't stand to watch Iberia thrive, could you?! If it weren't for that calamity, we would've..."

"L-look, please. I'm just here to... I'm just here to share some research notes—"

"What, how to fight those sea monsters? Oh, now you're looking to help us? Newsflash, it's too damn late! These scraps of paper won't do anything to help us."

The locals firmly believe that the calamity was brought here by Ægirs.
cn:
喧闹的广场。

村民们正围住、威胁着某人。

“邪恶的咒术师明明已经消失……为什么灾厄还没有结束？”

“老实交代！昔日辉煌的伊比利亚，如此让你们嫉妒吗？若不是你们带来了灾难，我们本该……”

“我……我只是，想给你们研究资料……”

“对付海怪的办法？如此荒唐可笑的研究，现在又有什么用。”

这里的居民坚信，是阿戈尔人带来了灾难。

en:
"Thank you."

"... As you can see, I hail from Ægir."

"Ever since the Profound Silence, I devoted myself to studying Seaborns and nethersea brand to help the land-dwellers."

"I don't know where my colleagues have all gone, but..."

"What's the point of this anymore?"

"They don't want my help, so why should I give it to them?

He seems crestfallen by his experience at Iberia.
cn:
“非常感谢。”

“……如你所见，我来自阿戈尔。”

“在大静谧后……为了帮助陆地人，我研究海嗣与溟痕持续至今。”

“虽然不知道曾经与我一起研究的同僚们，如今身在何方……”

“但事到如今，我也不禁开始思考，这些研究究竟能帮到什么呢。”

“把他们并不想要的东西强加给他们，又能有什么意义呢？”

面对伊比利亚的现状，他似乎失去了动力。

en:
We come across a cavern, full of sunken ship remnants and golden treasures that have washed up inside.

There are all kinds of unfamiliar sculptures and twinkling golden coins...

There's a whole pile of treasures here.

"Hey, the records here say that this used to be a ship that sailed all across Terra."

"It must be a ship built for conquest, built during the golden age of Iberia."

"Look, it says here that this is a golden chalice made in Sargon."

"Combine an armada of tall, proud sails, unparalleled technological innovation, and... a certain king's greed, and you get this."

"It's... the kind of glory we can barely hope to retrieve, now."

These items would be extremely valuable outside, but none of them seem very helpful for the situation at hand.

Should we continue to look, just in case?
cn:
沉没着船只残骸和黄金财宝的洞窟中。

从陌生造型的雕像，到闪闪发光的金币。

堆满了看上去价值连城的物品。

“看这里的记录，写着这艘船曾航行过整个泰拉大陆……是吧？”

“似乎是伊比利亚黄金时代建造的征服舰船。”

“这个……上面写着是在萨尔贡制造的金杯。”

“高高扬帆的舰队。无人能及的技术发展……这些东西是与国王的欲望交织的结果吧。”

“现如今……就连想要重拾荣光也困难重重了。”

这些东西在外面或许很有价值，但眼下却找不到能派上用场的东西。

要不要再调查一下呢？

en:
Atop a steep, coastal cliff...

An old man is staring out to the far ocean, peering through the gale.
cn:
海岸边，陡峭的断崖上。

在汹涌翻腾的海浪之间，一位老人正凝望着大海。

en:
I look to where the old man points, but I don't see any lighthouses there.

Just tall, cresting waves mercilessly pummeling the cliffs.

"I miss those days dearly. Days of brilliance, when I would illuminate the vast ocean."

"Once the Profound Silence came and went, Iberia became too... quiet, too dark."

The old man's fingers gently caress the keys in his hand, eyes full of longing.
cn:
老人所指的方位上，并没有灯塔的影子。

只有汹涌的巨浪不停拍击着断崖。

“真怀念那时候啊，灯塔辉煌地照亮辽阔大海的岁月。”

“大静谧过去之后，伊比利亚就变得……无比寂静与黑暗了。”

老人一边摆弄着手中的钥匙，一边带着遗憾的目光望向大海。

en:
There is a long line of people waiting outside a run-down building.

Inside, people in hoods are distributing something to the visitors.

"I thank the ocean's blessings."

"No, no. We only wish to help you sate your hunger, even a little. ... Hm?"

"We haven't seen you around here. Clearly, you've traveled far to get here—welcome, welcome."

"Sorry, everyone—please understand, they're new here."

People in hoods dragged us inside.

"It's not much, but... this should hopefully be able to sate your hunger."

Dried fish, huh... Amiya and Irene called them "finbeasts".
cn:
一座破败的建筑前，有一大批人在排队等待着什么。

往里面看去，有戴着头巾的人们正向进来的人们分发些什么。

“这都多亏了大海的恩赐。”

“没有没有。至少先在这里填饱肚子再走……嗯？”

“没见过的面孔呢。看样子是远道而来，快请进吧。”

“这几位是新来的客人，各位请多包涵。”

在戴着头巾的人们的指引下，我们进入了屋内。

“我们实在拿不出什么像样的东西……不过吃这个多少能填点肚子。”

风干的鱼……据阿米娅和艾丽妮所说，好像是一种被称作鳞兽的食物。

en:
Through the ocean wind blowing between white buildings,

someone stands with a lamplight and looks around, the bloom illuminating the piles of sea monster corpses.

Given the clear similarities between his and Irene's outfit... he must be an Inquisitor, too.

"What are the civilians doing out here, on the front lines?"
cn:
海风吹拂而过的纯白色建筑之间。

有人站在堆积如山的海怪尸骸之上，高举提灯，环顾着四周。

从与艾丽妮相似的装束来看……他似乎也是一名审判官。

“为何还有公民留在最前线？”

en:
At the center of what appears to be an ark symbolizing the City,

at the center of that brilliant, golden light... must be Mayors.

"Let's take a quick break here."

"Are you alright, Doctor?"

"I just need to take a... quick breather..."

"Fuhu... You should probably work on your cardio, or Miss Amiya might have to piggyback you around."

"Yeah, well... once we get back, I'll start working out like Kal'tsit suggested."

"Hmph. Executive Manager, if it ever comes to it, you may trust me with the piggybacking."

<I'm good.>

Perhaps being in close proximity to Mayors's vision of utopia and the center of the light did something...

Seaborns near us only gave us a passing glance without attacking us.

Something about the way they looked at us felt like... they were concerned about us—the Sinners couldn't help but look away with a funny feeling.

"I feel... sorrow, regret... Maybe these feelings are denials for all those times she spent agonizing over this."

"Can we really bring back Miss Mayors?"

<We'll help her return. That's what we're here to do, after all.>

<Alright, let's rest up for a bit before moving on.>
cn:
在宛如都市具象化一般的方舟中央。

那耀眼的光芒摇曳之处……梅厄斯大概就在那里。

“……先稍微休息一下再走吧。”

“你没事吧，博士？”

“稍微休息一下……应该就好点了……”

“呼呼……不增强体力的话，说不定就得靠阿米娅小姐背着你走来走去了哦。”

“回去之后……得按凯尔希说的，好好锻炼才行。”

“哼。万一出了什么事，尊敬的执行经理，就由我来背您吧。”

<不必了。>

或许是因为我们已逐渐接近梅厄斯所期盼的理想乡，那片光芒的中心了吧。

游荡的海嗣们只是默默地盯着受伤的我们看了一会，却并未发起攻击，只是径直从我们身旁经过。

那目光……让人感觉像在担忧我们。大多数罪人因此露出复杂的神情，并移开了视线。

“我感受到传达过来的情绪，像是悲伤……悔恨……或是否定自己长久苦恼过的时光。”

“梅厄斯小姐还能恢复原样吗？”

<我们必须要让她恢复。正因如此，我们才来到这里。>

<再休息一会儿，就继续前进吧。>

en:
"Ah, there...!"

I turn around to see someone precariously stumbling by the railings... before falling.

Falling... like a feather dropping from a height that is neither too high nor too low, like someone slowly sinking in water.

"WATCH THYSELF!!!"

One of the Sinners shouts vigorously to alert us to the danger.

We all sprinted toward the area where the person was falling, but it seemed that they were still falling by the time we got there, and we even had time to catch our breath.

Something about the ponderousness of their fall made me wonder if it would be as easy and light as grabbing a gently falling piece of paper to grab them.

"... Mass as a factor can hardly be ignored in this case. Despite the ponderous speed with which they fall, if we were to bring them to a sudden stop..."

"We'll get to watch every millisecond of their spine slowly turning to crumbles, and the subsequent, decidedly final agony, stretched to minutes." 

"Eww..."

We still have some time before they hit the ground. We have to find something to break their fall...
cn:
“啊，那边……”

转头一看，发现有人失去了平衡摇晃着，然后直直掉了下去。

从一个不高也不低的地方，像羽毛一样……或者，像是在水中游泳一般缓缓下坠。

“危险！！！”

这时，一位罪人大声地发出警告。

我们向那个人跑去，但当我们赶到，调整呼吸抬头看时，那人还在从高处缓缓坠落着。

就好像，这样接住他会像接住飘落的纸片一样简单。

“……质量亦不应被忽视。若如此接住的话……”

“会目睹这位市民在感受到脊椎慢慢碎裂的同时立刻死亡吧。”

“呃……”

距离完全坠落还有一些时间。如果能找到什么东西来缓冲的话……

en:
"Halt! This area is off-limits to outsiders!"

A man wearing a tall top hat, presumably an employee of T Corp., stops us.

"Only those contracted by T Corp., or those with special authorization slips, may pass through here."

Realizing that we were just standing there dumbfounded and unsure as to what we must do, he points to the side and continues.

"Hmm, looks like you do have the right to pass through here. Perhaps you've misplaced your pass."

"You can request for a reissuance there, off to the side. Go try your luck there."
cn:
“站住！这里是禁止外人进入的区域。”

一位头戴高帽子、似乎是T公司员工的人拦下了我们。

“只有受T公司委托，或获得特别许可之人，才可通过此处。”

或许是因为我们不知所措、一脸困惑的神情，那人指着一旁接着说道。

“看你那反应，是有资格通过却忘了带证明的人吧。”

“忘掉的东西可以在那边申请补发。你们去那边看看吧。”

en:
We turn into a corner and come across a rather crudely drawn poster.

Written on the poster is a brief introduction next to a small note with directions.

'Running low on time, but burning full of frustration? Then come join the Yurodiviye.

Are you content with letting the inequity walk all over you?

Or would you rather live for its destruction?

Desire it, desire it hard!

Take this poster, let it be your train ticket.

At the ■■■ alley, face the ■■ road and walk at a speed of 120km per day. Alone.'
cn:
某条小巷中，贴着一幅画得相当粗糙的海报。

海报上写着简短的介绍文字，以及前往某处地点的指南。

“没有时间，只剩不满的你，来加入圣愚吧。

你是愿意忍气吞声、接受不合理之事而活，

还是愿意粉碎不合理之事而活？

只要诚心所愿，恳切所求，便有可能实现。

如果你愿意加入我们，就撕下这张海报，当作火车票。

从XXX巷，往XX度方向，以时速120公里，独自前来吧。”

en:
A desperate voice echoes from afar.

"Join us. Let's tear down the inequities, together."

Another voice speaks.

"We're saving time from their poor, miserable deaths. This is a holy deed."

Another voice speaks excitedly.

"Join us, mate. Become one of the phantom thieves. Know them blokes, right? The gentleman thieves, the thieves who serve justice... Hm, or are we more like muggers of justice?"

... Maybe we can use this as an opportunity to trick them.
cn:
远处传来了恳切的声音。

“你也来成为我们的一员吧。让我们一起粉碎这等不合理之事。”

另一个声音接着说了下去。

“这可是拯救濒死的可怜时间之工作，是圣行啊。”

又另一个声音兴奋地说。

“来当怪盗吧。怪盗，你懂的吧？就是那种正义的盗贼啊。不，或者说是强盗？”

……如果趁此机会骗一下他们，也不知好不好。

en:
Looks like we can restore one of the deactivated systems of the Safety Team, apart from the basic functionalities of the Regenerator.

Which one should we reactivate?
cn:
在再生反应堆的基础功能之外，似乎还可以启动另外一个未激活的系统。

应该启动哪一项？

en:
We came across a containment unit as we were making our way across the hallway. Its door is letting off sparks of lightning.

Looks like the generator's shorted; the door refuses to close. But it doesn't seem like whatever Abnormality in there's escaped.

Try as we might to take a better look inside, the sheer darkness of the containment unit makes it hard to tell what's going on in there.

The webs haning from the ceiling and the suspiciously pitch-black floor were quite bizarre to behold, however.
cn:
我们穿过走廊时，发现了火花四溅的收容单元。

虽然发电机出了故障，门无法合上，但似乎里面的异想体并没有出逃。

我们看向房间内部，其中昏暗无比，什么也看不清。

只有天花板上的蜘蛛网和异常的漆黑地板令人毛骨悚然。

en:
Every corner of this room is filled with an emerald light.

Somebody spilled a bunch of Enkephalin on the table, enough to start slowly dripping to the floor.

'Executive Manager, we've found some Enkephalin here.'

'Mm. It will likely be helpful to our endeavors should we collect them'

'T.T.G.G.C.C?'

'"Take that glass gas canister, capiche?" ... she says...'
cn:
在满是翡翠色光芒的房间之中。

不知是谁洒落的脑啡肽滴滴答答地从桌上滴下。

“执行经理，此处有脑啡肽。”

“嗯，如果带走很有可能派上用场。”

“比·绿·玻·气。”

“她是说，比起绿色的液体，她更喜欢那边玻璃罐里的气体……”

en:
A strand of light peeks through the glass and the ajar door.

Beyond the glass is a bizarre skull...

A floating skull bound by thorns to a cross, surrounded by a circular light.

The empty eye sockets of the skull gaze straight into us.

'This Abnormality's denomination is 'One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds.'

'Of course, it is not the same entity that once resided inside the L Corp.'

'Fathomless depths lie within the hollows of its eyes; piercing us.'
cn:
光从紧闭的门扉间隙与玻璃中透出。

玻璃另一头是诡异的骷髅。

骷髅被荆棘捆绑于十字架之上，释放出圆形的光辉浮在半空。

头盖骨空洞的眼窝凝视我们。

“这个异想体名为‘一罪与百善’。”

“当然，它应当与存在于L公司内的那只个体并不相同。”

“两个漆黑的眼窝，仿佛看透我们一般，无比深邃。”

en:
We look up to see white butterflies above us.

Though given wings, the butterflies wander the hallway, fluttering to nowhere.

We make our way to where it seems to rest a while, and we see a large coffin past the transparent glass window.

It was too grand for a one, yet too small for many.

'A lonesome coffin lies.'

'Eugh, a coffin...? I have a bad feeling about this. We probably shouldn't touch it, right?'

'That'd be the safer choice, yeah... but what if there's something in there that could help us?
cn:
在冰冷彻骨的走廊中抬起头，面前满是纯白的蝴蝶。

即使拥有翅膀，蝴蝶也无法飞至某处，而只是飘浮于走廊中。

移步走向它们格外驻留许久的地方，透明的玻璃后是一口巨大的棺材。

一人躺入其中过于宽裕，而多人躺入其中又过于狭窄。

“一口棺材被孤单地放置于此。”

“唔，居然是棺材……总觉得有点不舒服。应该不能碰吧？”

“虽然不碰比较安全……但说不定里面放着什么有用的东西。”

en:
The factory is brightly lit with red and green light fixtures.

Amidst the chaotic din of machines and clanking tools...

... are tiny gnomes, scurrying about busily between the assembly lines.

'Let's g-ome! Hurry up-ome!!'

'Put 'em on the conveyor belt-ome!!'

'Let's get packin'-ome!!'
cn:
这里是充满红色与绿色灯光的工厂。

在这能听到按压某物的声音与咔哒作响的工具声的地方……

小小的矮人们正在忙碌着。

“快点动起来诺姆！！”

“搬到传送带上诺姆！！”

“要打包好诺姆！！”

en:
An old, creaky bed sits solemnly in the middle of the room.

It is surrounded by numerous lanterns and candlesticks.

Some are burnt out, their remains ashen and cold, leaving only dark singes as testament of their old flames...

But the others were still lit, their warm flames diligently traveling down the wicks.

Yet, the chillingly dark shadows lurking at the bed's legs, next to the sheets half-sliding off the bed, are shrouded still.

An odd tremor vibrates the floor.

And soon, I hear a sound of something dragging across the floor accompanied by a sensation of a cold, clammy gaze peering intently in my direction...

What could possibly lie beneath that bed?
cn:
房屋中央放着一张吱呀作响的陈旧的床。

床的四周排列着许多提灯和烛台。

其中一些已经冷却，只剩下焦黑的灰烬……

而另一些的灯芯仍然在燃烧，散发出温暖的光亮。

然而垂下的被子附近的床脚处那片深邃的黑暗，似乎完全不会被照亮。

床正在微微颤动。

能感受到若有若无的窥视，以及某物蠢蠢欲动的声音。

那床下难道有什么东西吗？

en:
Amidst this blue-aura filled place, a shadowy being approaches us and holds out his hand.

In the palm of the being is a bullet. It pulsates with a foreboding aura.

'This is a magic bullet that will never miss, no matter what.'

'But... it has one condition. The final bullet will always fly toward the one you love most.'

'If you are still willing to fire this bullet, or have someone you would like to shoot... I can grant you that.'
cn:
在这充满了蓝光的地方，有什么摇曳着黑色的存在向我们伸出了手。

它手里有一颗充满不祥气息的子弹。

“这是能击中任何人的魔弹。”

“但是……使用最后一发子弹时，子弹会射向你的心爱之人。”

“哪怕这样你也有想要射杀的人的话……我允许你使用。”

en:
Gunfire echoes from a close distance.

When we sought out the sound, we only found ourselves the bloody remains of a battle.

The combatants must've already left the scene; it is quiet here.

Several gears, now inert, litter the bloodied floor.

Amidst them is an intact chair.

There's a gear on the chair that's still turning.
cn:
不远处传来枪声。

在我们靠近之时，那里只剩下地板上满是鲜血的战斗痕迹。

参战者们已经离去，此处只剩寂静。

有许多不再转动的齿轮在沾满鲜血的地板上滚动着。

在那个中央，有一把完好无损的椅子。

椅子上有一枚不断转动着的齿轮。

en:
We found ourselves in what appeared to be a rather empty office building.

There were Fixers here, discussing the details of their upcoming contract.

'Got it. We'll bring just two sniper rifles for this contract.'

'I'd say we need an assault rifle just in case.'

'Fine by me.'

As soon as the discussion was over, the Fixers picked up their packs and left the room.
cn:
我们走进了一栋似乎荒芜已久的办公楼里。

那里有几个正讨论着委托的收尾人。

“明白了，那这次委托就带两支狙击枪去吧。”

“以防万一，还是带一支突击步枪吧。”

“那就带上吧。”

讨论结束后，他们便收拾好行李出去了。

en:
I can hear the sounds of gun assembly and flipping book pages.

This place seems to be an educational facility of sorts. Rather serious, too.

Maybe the Sinners can learn something from one of the instructors.
cn:
这里充斥着组装枪支和书本翻页的声音。

在有些严肃的氛围中，人们教授着什么，同时也学习着什么。

罪人们也许能从看上去是教官的人身上学到点什么。

en:
This is an Abnormality of despair that has gone through a repeated cycle of faith and betrayal, leaving only the emotion that is expressed through black tears.

The hero, once a self-proclaimed knight and a protector of justice, is nowhere to be seen.

So many things that were once thought to be immutable changed, and her once-steadfast pride lay weathered and eroded.

Her eye socket, the endless wellspring of tears, is now twisted black; only the dark, burnt teardrop remains beneath it.
cn:
这是一个反复经历着信任与背叛的圆环，唯有黑色的泪水成为了全部感情的，绝望的异想体。

曾以守护正义之骑士自居的英雄，如今已无处可寻。

许多本以为不会改变的事物都改变了，本以为绝不会消失的自尊心也已逐渐磨损。

不断流泪的眼窝如今已被扭曲为一片漆黑，那下面只留下了烧焦的泪痕。

en:
The Containment Unit's door was open.

Inside the unit was a girl, whispering, muttering to herself while curled up on the ground in gloom.

"There's good, and there's evil in this world."

"Where there's light, there's darkness. It can't entirely be one way or the other."

"I'm good, so they're evil."

"I am a chosen one."

"Am I unnecessary?"

"I hate... peace...?"

Anxiety. Compulsion. Obsession. Exhaustion.

Dark energy radiates around her like a materialization of those very words.
cn:
收容单元的门是开着的。

里面有着一个被忧郁笼罩，倒在地上喃喃自语着的少女。

“世界上存在着善良与邪恶。”

“像是有光明就有黑暗一般，不能只存在其中一方。”

“因为我是善良的一方，所以其他人都是邪恶。”

“我是被选中的。”

“我不被需要了吗？”

“和平……讨厌……吗？”

不安，强迫，执着，疲惫。

仿佛这些关键词在她身边飘浮着一般，四周萦绕着阴暗的气场。

en:
There's a report on a Central Command Team Clerk's desk.

<DAY ■■, ■■ ■■ Research Service Postmortem Report>

The report was partially censored, but it seemed to be talking about a newly developed shield bullet of sorts.

'The Trauma Shield can protect its user from psychological damages from external sources for a ■■■■■■■ ■■■■ or ■■■■■■■■■.'

'If Shield bullet ■■■■■■ is needed, request the manager or a ■■■■■■■■ for assistance.'

Next to the heavily redacted report is a box labeled 'Trauma Shield sample & manual'.
cn:
中央本部的文职办公桌上放着一份报告书。

<第■■天，■■ ■■研究业务结果报告书>

虽然部分被删改了，但其内容似乎是关于新型屏蔽力场子弹的。

“精神屏蔽力场可以在■■■■内防止自外部而来的■■■■精神伤害。”

“关于屏蔽力场子弹的■■，请咨询主管或■■■■■■■■。”

在这份被删改了大量内容的报告书旁边，有一个写着“精神屏蔽力场样品及说明书”的箱子。

en:
We're in a storage room at Lobotomy Corporation.

There's a broken machine—filled with what look like chunks of flesh.

"What... is that? Why's that just lying around in a storage room?"

"Faust explains that it is the remains of a previous iteration of a Sephirah, disposed upon replacement."

"... So it's a dead body?"

"Not exactly. Only its memories are reset; with replacement, the identical version of the Sephirah upon its initial production is reproduced."

"Almost a selfsame way in which we are rewound."

"Yeah, kinda like us, huh?"

Things got a bit awkward.

What can I, as the manager, say to lift the mood?
cn:
这里是脑叶公司的仓库内。

破损的机械残骸中，混杂着像是肉块一样的东西。

“那是……什么？仓库里为什么会有那种东西？”

“据浮士德所说，那是一具脑叶公司的Sephirah更换时的旧机体残骸。”

“……也就是说是尸体？”

“有些不同。只是记忆被初始化，每次制造的都是与最初制造时相同的，同一个体。”
