“像是被复原了。”

“那啥，跟我们很像啊。”

气氛似乎变得有些尴尬。

作为执行经理，有没有什么鼓励的话能说呢？

en: The Qliphoth Overload siren blares loudly through the hallway. We see a cute, small bird through the window of the overloaded containment unit. There's a note taped to the wall next to this unit—"Insight Work is effective." The Qliphoth Counter has already dropped to 10, but we don't see any Agents around. "I think, uh, Miss Hod or someone warned us about something like that in one of our past visits...?" "Mm. We were told that an increase in the Meltdown Gauge could trigger the arrival of Ordeals." "Wha? Then we'd better get crackin'! Hurry inside, you lot!" "Y-ya sure it's a good idea for us to go in there?" Would it be okay if we just left this here and moved on?
cn:
走廊上响起了发生逆卡巴拉熔毁的警报声。
在发生熔毁的收容单元里，可以看到一只可爱的小鸟。
墙上贴着一张纸条，上面写着“洞察工作”很有效。
尽管计时器已降到10，却仍未见到员工的身影。

“前阵子来的时候，好像有个叫Hod的人说过类似的事情……”
“嗯。那人警告说，随着熔毁计量表的增加，考验将会来临。”
“什么？现在不是说这些的时候吧，应该赶快进去啊！”
“我、我们真的可以进去吗？”

就这样放着熔毁不管真的没关系吗？

en: The Qliphoth Overload siren blares loudly through the hallway. We look through the overloaded containment unit, but it's obscured with gray, grainy static noise of some sort. There's a note taped to the wall next to this unit—"Repression Work is effective." The Qliphoth Counter has already dropped to 10, but we don't see any Agents around. "I think, uh, Miss Hod or someone warned us about something like that in one of our past visits...?" "Mm. We were told that an increase in the Meltdown Gauge could trigger the arrival of Ordeals." "Wha? Then we'd better get crackin'! Hurry inside, you lot!" "Y-ya sure it's a good idea for us to go in there?" Would it be okay if we just left this as-is and moved on?
cn:
走廊上响起了发生逆卡巴拉熔毁的警报声。
在发生熔毁的收容单元里，充满了灰色的噪点，什么也看不见。
墙上贴着一张纸条，上面写着“压迫工作”很有效。
尽管计时器已降到10，却仍未见到员工的身影。

“前阵子来的时候，好像有个叫Hod的人说过类似的事情……”
“嗯。那人警告说，随着熔毁计量表的增加，考验将会来临。”
“什么？现在不是说这些的时候吧，应该赶快进去啊！”
“我、我们真的可以进去吗？”

就这样放着熔毁不管真的没关系吗？

en:
In the staff lounge, we come across employees in E.G.O Gears standing around, chatting amongst themselves.
Each of them holds a white coffee mug in their hand.

"Eh? Haven't seen you guys around. Which department are you from?"
cn:
休息室里，穿着E.G.O装备的员工们正围坐在一起轻声交谈。
他们手里都拿着装有咖啡的白色马克杯。

“嗯？是没见过的面孔，你们是哪个部门的？”

en:
The elevator door opens into a dark, unlit hallway.
We can smell the vivid and intense aroma of fresh, blossoming flowers that have grown over the walls and the floors of the hallway.

Lying lethargically atop the bed of flowers are employees, their eyes shut as though in drowsiness.
cn:
电梯门打开后，看到的是不见一丝光明的走廊。
自墙壁与地板上绽放的无数花朵中，清新的香气扑鼻而来。

在那里，被花瓣逐渐侵蚀的员工们正如酣睡般闭着眼睛。

en:
By the time we had finished moving the employees to the elevator,
we heard a chilling scream echoing from the center of the hallway.

There, we saw panicked employees curled up into balls...
... and an eyeless monster looming over them, its body shaped like a ceramic doll.

It was at that moment when a large flower bloomed by the monster's feet.
cn:
当我们把所有员工都搬到电梯后。
从走廊中央传来了人的悲鸣。

在那里的是陷入恐慌，蜷缩着身体的员工……
以及如同陶瓷娃娃一样，眼窝中空无一物的怪物。

正在那时，怪物的脚下绽开了巨大的花。

en:
Another huge flower is blooming by the eyeless monster's feet.
We've saved everyone we could.
What now?
cn:
不知何时，眼窝中空无一物的怪物脚下再度绽开了一朵巨大的花。
我们救下了所有能够救到的员工。
之后要怎么办呢。

en:
The employee at the laboratory began in a level voice.

"Ah, you're right on time. The higher-ups ordered us to observe the subject's responses to types of Work other than Insight Work."
"Don't worry, it won't be very complicated. Just hold your breath, take this piece of meat, and hand it over to the bees.
"I'd really appreciate your help, if it isn't too much trouble."

I followed his gaze to the surveillance monitor of the containment unit, its camera pointed toward a massive bee with a torso that looked more like a beehive.
cn:
研究室中的员工用冷静的语气向这边搭话。

“啊，来得正好。高层下达了指示，要求调查该个体对于洞察工作以外的其他工作的反应。”
“不是什么难事。只需要屏住呼吸，拿着我给你的肉进入收容单元，再交给蜂群就结束了。”
“要是不忙的话，就拜托你了。”

跟随那人的视线看向监控画面。
在那个收容单元里的，是有着如同巨大蜂巢一样的身体的蜂。

en:
There's someone crying inside the containment unit.
We peered inside to find a suspicious figure, wearing an outfit that stood out from those of the employees.
Noticing our presence, he suddenly approached us, beaming.

"I-I have to tune my instrument to perfect accuracy, but I don't have anyone to help me."
"Do you... like music? Help me, and I'll give you one of my instruments."
"H-how about it? Deal?"
cn:
收容单元的深处传来了谁的哭泣声。
在那里的是穿着不同于员工的服装，无论怎么看都很可疑的人。
那人察觉到了我和罪人们的存在，突然露出灿烂的笑容接近过来。

“我、我必须把乐器调整到完美的音调，但是没有能帮忙的人。”
“你们……喜欢音乐吗？如果帮我，我就给你们一件我有的乐器。”
“怎、怎么样？”

en:
The instrument sounds much better, finally tuned correctly.
Upon reviewing the instrument he gave us, it was clear that it would be of much help to us going forward.
We asked if there was any way we could get more instruments out of him.

"N-no. I can't hear its beautiful music anymore."
"... Keep playing the music, until I feel satisfied. T-then I'll hand you an extra instrument."
cn:
应该是调音结束了，乐器的音色变得好了一些。
检查了一下收到的乐器，应该能在之后派上用场。
我询问了有没有得到其他乐器的方法。

“不、不行。那样一来就听不到美妙的乐曲了。”
“……直到乐曲满足我为止，再让我多听一些。之、之后我就把乐器给你们。”

en:
The instrument sounds much better, finally tuned correctly.
Upon reviewing the instrument he gave us, it was clear that it would be of much help to us going forward.
We asked if there was any way we could get more instruments out of them.

"N-no. I can't hear its beautiful music anymore."
"... Keep playing the music, until I feel satisfied. T-then I'll hand you an extra instrument."
cn:
应该是调音结束了，乐器的音色变得好了一些。
检查了一下收到的乐器，应该能在之后派上用场。
我询问了有没有得到其他乐器的方法。

“不、不行。那样一来就听不到美妙的乐曲了。”
“……直到乐曲满足我为止，再让我多听一些。之、之后我就把乐器给你们。”

en:
They’re rummaging through corpses, looking for something.
Relentless demands for an offering ring in the ears.
They look like they might jump us at any second.

You see a dying person nearby, gasping for air.
Should you offer this person up?
Or…
cn:
土偶们似乎在尸体堆里翻找着什么。
要求献上祭品的叫喊声不绝于耳。
它们看上去仿佛马上就要袭击我们。

正巧，你看到附近有一个奄奄一息濒临死亡的人。
要将这个人作为祭品献上吗？
还是说……

en:
Looks like the Sinners are out of the question.

Should you offer up this dying person?
Or…
cn:
似乎罪人们不是很愿意当这个祭品。

那么只好把这个将死之人作为祭品献上了？
或是说……

en:
You hear a faint voice.

“Please, help…”

Do you follow the sound? Or…
cn:
从什么地方传来了细微的呻吟。

“帮帮我……”

应该去发出声音的地方看看情况吗？还是说……

en:
While traversing a narrow passage, a swarm of cockroaches crawled into the way.
The rustling visage is almost revolting.

Do you walk past them? Or…
cn:
在狭窄的通道里前进时，一群蟑螂密密麻麻地涌了出来。
沙沙作响的声音令人几欲作呕。

应该避开它们走过去吗？又或者……

en:
In the middle of the factory, you find a vending machine with large buttons.

They’re colorful and fancy…
You feel a strong compulsion to press them.

Which one will you press?
cn:
在工厂的正中央，你找到了一个有着巨大按钮的自动贩卖机。

多彩又可爱的按钮……
你有种非按不可的感觉。

你要按下哪个按钮呢？

en:
Exiting the passage, you see a group of cyborgs gathered around a huge roulette.

“Oh. Highly. Excited. Thoroughly. Amusing.”
“Da GAME of DE—ATH!”

They approach you, chanting in strange beats.
It looks like they want you to play a game of roulette. What should you do?
cn:
一出通道，能看见前面有一群改造人聚集在一个巨大的轮盘赌周围。

“哦。太棒了。太兴奋了。太彻底了。太有趣了。
巨大的死亡游戏！”

它们不停吟诵着奇怪的韵律，慢慢靠近过来。
好像是想玩一局轮盘赌游戏。该怎么办呢？

en:
A thick glass door stood strongly in the pink frame.
The electronic display above suddenly flashed to life, offering a question.

“Are you happy?”

What will be your answer?
cn:
一扇厚实的玻璃门伫立在涂成粉红色的门框中，门扉紧闭。
门上的电子屏幕突然闪动了一下，提出了一个问题。
“你感到幸福吗？”
该如何回答？

en:
“There’s a pair of pink shoes that can bring you to happiness.”

The display glowed red.

“Would you like to try them on?”
cn:
“这里有一双粉红色的鞋，它可以给你带来幸福。”

电子屏幕变成了红色。

“你想试穿一下吗？”

en:
There’s a machine in this dilapidated room.
A long, bulky lever is at the center of the machine adorned with springs.

The urge… to pull it… is growing… stronger… and stronger.

What will you do?
cn:
破旧的房间里放着机械装置。
在到处装着大大小小的发条的装置的正中央，有一个又大又长的杠杆。
推动它……这样的冲动越来越强烈……越来越强烈……

该如何抉择？

en:
Putting a spontaneous thought into action is as impulsive and uninhibited as a child reaching for off-limits marshmallows.

When you pull down the lever, a clack follows soon after.
The springs begin to turn, some slow, some quick.
Some clockwise, others counter-clockwise.

Watching the machine’s rumble grow wilder, you feel anxious.
cn:
把想法付诸于行动就像站在棉花糖面前伸手去拿的孩子一样，是一件冲动而甜蜜的事情。

拉下杠杆后，装置传出咔嚓咔嚓的声响。
发条开始或快或慢地转动起来。
有些沿顺时针方向，另一些沿逆时针方向。

看着装置传来的隆隆声越来越大，我感到有些焦虑。

en:
A steel door rests on one side of the room.
It looks too thick to be easily broken or breached with force.

“There’s gotta be something totally valuable through here if it’s guarded this tight~!”

The Sinner might be right, treasure might be waiting behind the door.
What should you do?
cn:
房间的一侧有一扇由钢打造的门。
一眼就能看出它非常厚，很难强行打碎或穿透。

“如果需要如此严密保护，这里一定藏有一些非常有价值的东西~！”

正如罪人所说，门背后可能隐藏着巨大的宝藏。
应该怎么做？

en:
You see a large gate in the distance.
There’s something eerie about the pointed fences and stone walls.

It looks to be the only way through this area, but it’s guarded by a large number of Inquisitors.
Is there anything we can do about them?
cn:
可以远远地看到巨大的门扉。
锋利的栅栏和石墙营造出怪异的氛围。

看起来那里是唯一能通过这一区域的路，但它被大量的审判官把守着。
我们能对此做些什么吗？

en:
Dozens of old, broken crates littered the floor.

“Eyuck, cobwebs…”

Clearing things away, you found three particularly large crates buried underneath.

“These are all locked.”

“Looks like the keyholes have the same shape!”

“…Alas, the key is of a soft constitution. It won’t be feasible to use it again once it has been inserted into a lock.”

Sounds like you get only one try.
Which one should you open?
cn:
几十个破旧的板条箱散落在地板上。

“呃，蜘蛛网……”

将其清理开后，你发现下面放着三个特别大的板条箱。

“这些都是锁着的。”

“看起来钥匙孔的形状是一样的！”

“但钥匙的材质十分柔软。一旦它被插入锁中，就无法再次使用了。”

听起来你只有一次机会。
应该打开哪一个？

en:
The N Corp. Inquisitors were busy torturing someone.

“GIAAAAH!”

A filtered scream fills the cramped room.
Their victims are people with prosthetic bodies.

“……”

Sinclair didn’t utter a word, but his eyes full of wrath and fear were fixed on the torturers.
He breathed heavily at irregular intervals, his body shaking; he looks like he might charge forth at any second.

Do you stop him?
Or…
cn:
N公司的审判官们正在进行拷问。

“咕啊啊啊！”

狭小的房间充斥着鬼哭狼嚎。他们正在拷问着装有义体的人们。

“……”

尽管辛克莱一言不发，但是他却在一直盯着他们，眼神里满是恐惧和愤怒。
他的身体不停颤抖，一直凌乱地喘着气。仿佛随时都会冲上前去。

要阻止他吗？
还是……

en:
“Gehk, what’s this odor…”

The Sinners frowned at the olfactory assault.
Following their eyes, you find an Inquisitor collapsed on the floor.

“Definitely dead…”

The smell must be coming from the rotting corpse.
While everyone was hesitant to approach, you see something sparkle.

There seems to be something amidst the writhing manes…
What will you do?
cn:
“呃，什么味道……”

罪人们纷纷皱起眉头，捏住了鼻子。
顺着他们视线的方向看去，一个审判官倒在角落。

“死了啊……”

弥漫的腐烂味道应该源自尸体。
每位罪人都对接近它十分反感，此时我看到了某个闪着光的东西。

在蠕动的鬃毛中间，好像有什么东西……
该如何抉择？

en:
You hear snappy mechanical noises through the closed door.

“Sounds like a cry for help…”

As you focus your attention, you begin to hear footsteps.

“Steel… Those are clangs of steel…”

Sinclair froze.
It looks like an Inquisitor is coming for them.
What will you do?
cn:
封闭的房间里传来断断续续的机械音。

“好像是在求救……”

刚想仔细听一听，后面便传来了某人的脚步声。

“是……是钢铁碰撞的声响……”

辛克莱表情凝重。
看来是审判官在接近。
该怎么办？

en:
The passage was red-hot.

“Yeesh, that’d melt my shoes.”

The Sinners carefully approached the road, only to retreat from the overwhelming heat.
Something was written on the sign in front of the passage:

Prove your humanity 
And through weakness and suppuration
Sear a path with mobilization

It took no time at all to figure out what that meant.
…What will you do?
cn:
前方的道路被酷热灼烧成一片赤色。

“呜啊，鞋好像都要融化了。”

尽管罪人们小心翼翼地靠近前路，酷热仍然逼着他们迅速返回。
立于道路前方的告示牌上写着这样的一段话：

“以懦弱与腐朽证明人性，
抑或是以灼热的足迹铸就前路。”

即使不多加思考我也能理解这段话想表达什么。
……该怎么办呢？

en:
You see a pedestal adorned with the engravings of a nail and hammer.

“Must have something to do with N Corp.”

A Sinner mutters, and you agree.
Should you try to get some info on N Corp? Or…
cn:
看到了装饰着钉与锤的基座。

“肯定是和N公司有关。”

一名罪人嘀咕道，而我也是这么认为的。
应该试着从这里搜寻N公司的情报信息吗？还是……

en:
An inscription above the closed gate reads:

Prove your terror and fears
Fill this vessel with tears

Looking around, you find the supposed vessel next to an unpleasant-looking chair.
What will you do?
cn:
紧闭的大门上方刻写道：

“直面你的恐惧，证明你的感情。”

“以泪水填满容器。”

环顾四周，能看到一把看起来很不舒服的椅子旁边有一个所谓的容器。
该怎么做？

en:
You find a row of glass containers in a corner of the main area.
Inside them are dried organs and pieces of life showing active movement.

“A tragic display…”

The containers can be opened easily. You could take one of the pieces if you want to.
What will you do?
cn:
在中心区域的一个角落发现了一些玻璃棺。
里面是已经干瘪的和仍有活动迹象的生物器官。

“一场悲剧的展览……”

玻璃棺看起来很容易打开，如果我们想的话，也能带走一些生物器官。
该如何抉择？

en:
A passage is written above the large gate:

Only those who repent may find motion
Thorn yourself, atone through flagellation

It looks like it wants us to impale ourselves on spikes.
What will you do?
cn:
大门上方写着一段话：

“用荆棘穿刺自身，以痛苦忏悔自身。”

看起来它想让我们用荆棘刺穿自己。
该如何抉择？

en:
Hideously transformed N Corp. Inquisitors stood guard at the gate.
You moved to attack, but they don’t appear to be hostile in any capacity.

“Only. Exceptional… ones. Are allowed. In, this place.”

“To… pass. You, will. Prove yourself. Worthy.”

You aren’t exactly sure what they mean by “proving yourself”.
What should you do?
cn:
形体扭曲的N公司审判官镇守在大门前。
尽管我们试图攻击，但他们似乎没有任何敌意。

“唯有。特殊……之人。才可。进入此处。”

“意图……通过。你们。需要。证明自己身怀。资格。”

我并不是很清楚“证明自己”意味着什么。
应该怎么做？

en:
You met an N Corp. Inquisitor.

Instead of attacking, they ask us if we loathe prosthetics.
What should you say?
cn:
遭遇N公司审判官。
审判官并未发动攻击，转而询问是否厌恶义体。
该怎么办？

en:
N Corp. Inquisitors are torturing prosthetic people.
You see Sinclair tremble with fear and anger.
What will you do?
cn:
N公司审判官正在折磨装有义体的人。
辛克莱似乎正因恐惧和愤怒而颤抖。
该怎么做？

en:
Strangely shaped N Corp. Inquisitors guard the gate.

“Only… those with worth… may enter.”

“To pass… you will show… your worth.”

What will you do?
cn:
奇形怪状的N公司审判官们镇守在门前。

“只有……特别之人……才能进入此处。”

“若想通过……展示……资格。”

该怎么办？

en:
There are many ways to calm one down,
but this Abnormality seems to like gifts the most.
A fresh batch of blood might be able to appease it.
cn:
有很多方法可以使场面平静下来，
但供奉祭品似乎是这个异想体最喜欢的方法。
一股鲜血似乎可以将其安抚。

en:
To weaken the flame, you’ll need cool water.
Since we aren’t carrying any buckets of water, we should offer up someone cool instead.
cn:
想要削弱火势，就需要冷水。
因为没有带水，所以我们需要献上冷血之人作为替代。

en:
The stars are twinkling.
When they shine, they’ll rob us all of our sight.
What gift would the stars like?
cn:
众星闪闪发光。
每当众星闪耀，它们的光芒便会夺取我们的视线。
星星们会喜欢怎样的礼物？

en:
How do those cyborgs keep coming back?
The Sinners were discussing.

“Perhaps those beings are not alive.
That way, they would not be able to die.”

“No, we’re not getting philosophical here.”

“Hmm~ To me, it looked like rebuilding a brick wall.”

“…I think I’m hearing something from that factory in the back.”

The group turned their gaze to the factory behind the cyborgs.
Metallic clanking could be heard from the place that was quiet until moments ago.

Maybe you should take a look at that shady facility?
cn:
那些改造人怎么源源不断？
罪人们纷纷讨论着原因。

“本就是未曾拥有生命之物。
如此，自然无法逝去。”

“不，别在这里大谈哲学。”

“呣~我感觉，他们像是在不停地重新砌墙那般永不停歇。”

“……我想后面那座工厂似乎传出了什么声音。”

罪人们看向改造人身后的那座工厂。
先前安静的地方，现在却传出了金属碰撞的杂音。

或许应该去调查一下那可疑的工厂？

en:
Pinning down the largest cyborg as planned, you got to the factory in time.

“Huh, this is…”

“Looks like some kind of toy plant.”

The Sinners comment on the huge mechanism.

“Ah! Come behold this curiosity!”

The Sinner pointed to a control panel with several buttons attached to it.

<DO YOU LOVE THE CITY YOU LIVE IN?>

What should you press?
cn:
按照计划，瘫痪最大的改造人之后出现了突破口。

“这、这里是……”

“看起来就像是玩具厂。”

看着眼前的巨大机械，罪人们一句句发表着想法。

“啊！看看这个！”

罪人所指之处是一台拥有多个按钮的操作装置。

<您热爱自身所处的这座都市吗？>

该按下哪个呢？

en:
Continuing augmentation.

You
must
become
strong.

Please proceed with the input.

<DO YOU LOVE THE CITY YOU LIVE IN?>

What should you press?
cn:
开始进行强化。

你
必须
变强。

请再次进行输入。

<您热爱自身所处的都市吗？>

该按下哪个呢？

en:
Incorrect input.

You
must
become
strong.

Please input your answer again.

WARNING: Pressing the button three times will cause the facility to shut down.

<DO YOU LOVE THE CITY YOU LIVE IN?>

What should you press?
cn:
输入错误。

你
必须
变强。

请再次进行输入。

注意！检测到3次相应按钮输入后，将会终止设施运行。

<您热爱自身所处的都市吗？>

该按下哪个呢？

en:
A voice travels between the fluttering ribbons.

“What is your desire?”

“Put me on.”

“I’ll carry you wherever you wish to go.”

The suggestions are incredibly suspicious, but for some reason, the Sinners are struggling to decide what to do.

What do you say?
cn:
摇曳的缎带之间回荡着话语。

“你所渴求的欲望是什么？”

“穿上我。”

“我将带你前往所愿之处。”

虽然听起来匪夷所思，但是不知为何罪人们迟迟没有做出选择。

那么，该怎么办？

en:
You see an empty lot ahead where the Sinners can take a rest.

There, you find a vending machine with a number of buttons on it.
You see drinks as well, but you can’t recognize what they’re supposed to depict.
What will you do?
cn:
前面有一片空地，罪人们也许可以在那里休息。

在那里有一台自动贩卖机，上面有很多按钮。
其中也有饮料的按钮，但包装上尽是些不知所云的图案。
该如何抉择？

en:
Some folks are blocking the way.
They’re sitting on a deck, yelling at each other.
“Look at this succulent piece! The rich juice running down the fibers of luscious meat… This is what chicken is about!”
“Wrong. This piece has a clean taste, with not an ounce of grease tainting the tongue. This is the real deal.”
The two turn around at the same time to face you.
“You there! Tell us which is better!”
cn:
几个人挡住了前进的路线。
他们坐在桌前，互相大声争吵着。
“看这多肉的一块！丰富的汁水正在顺着那些甘美肉质的纤维流淌……这就是鸡肉存在的意义！”
“大错特错。这一块有着纯净的口味，没有一点油脂会玷污你的舌尖。这才是真正的好货。”
两个人同时转身看了过来。
“嘿，那边的！告诉我们哪个更好！”

en:
A bright spotlight shines on a portion of the noisy area.
It seems as though the chickens are attending a… ball.
“That’s the tango.”
Looking at their movements which might be a dance or a tussle, you notice sauce leaking from one of them.
It doesn’t seem to be aware of this…
cn:
闪耀的灯光照射着一片嘈杂的地方。
似乎正在举办一场鸡群的舞会……
“这是探戈啊。”
看着它们那像是跳舞又像是摔跤的动作，注意到其中一只鸡身上流出了酱汁。
它似乎并没有注意到这一点……

en:
A broken K Corp. drone is tumbling on the floor.
I can only revive Sinners where I can see the star, so in the meantime...
We might be able to find an ampule to use if we search through it.
cn:
一架破损的K公司无人机正向地面坠落。
直到看见星星之前，我无法复活罪人……
如果仔细搜索一下，也许还能找到能用的安瓿。

en: Give the drone another try?
cn: 要试着再寻找一次吗？

en:
It's filled with K Corp's ampules.
"Ooh~ Good for us! Hey Dante, can't we take at least one of those?"
"Negative. The ampule injector is only in this room, so it will not be possible to use them outside of this place."
...What will we do?
cn:
这个房间摆满了K公司的安瓿。
“哦~太好了！但丁，我们就不能拿一个走么？”
“不行。安瓿注射器只有这个房间有，所以除了这里没有地方能使用安瓿。”
……该如何抉择？

en:
"Lo, warnings are written on the ampules!"
Skimming through the glass bottles, I could see tiny notices attached to them.
However, the text was too dense to read properly.
"Missing parts… insufficient… stop? I have no idea what this is saying."
"Manager Esquire! It would appear that this device has two modes: single and group!"
It certainly looks like it's up to me to choose.
What will we do?
cn:
“这里写着使用再生安瓿的注意事项！”
看向玻璃瓶的旁边，写着小小的注意事项。
但是，密密麻麻的字很难准确地看清楚。
“受伤的部位……不足……终止？到底写着什么？”
“经理老爷！这个装置，可以一个人用也可以集体用！”
确实，注射器按钮的选择权貌似在我手上。
该如何抉择？

en:
"Are these... eggs?"
"Please be careful. It might be an Abnormality."
Come to think of it, I was told that the underground lab K Corp. set up also managed eggs from the L Corp. branch.
"Whoa, hey... Is this thing twitching?"
As the Sinner observed, an egg begins to move.
What will we do?
cn:
“这是……卵？”
“小心，这也许是异想体。”
还记得，在K公司地下研究所的旧L公司异想体卵管理处闻到过这种味道。
“那、那个……这颗卵是不是在动？”
和他说的一样，有一颗卵突然开始动起来。
怎么办才好呢？

en:
The area twisted, and a cabinet appeared from it.
You see some items in its drawers.
cn:
随着空间的扭曲，架子出现了。
架子上有着各种各样的东西。

en:
"Are those... stars up there?"
Looking up, we saw a scenery that looks like a night sky through a crack.
"Lo, a shooting star!!"
I heard that making a wish while a shooting star falls can make it true.
Maybe we'll try it?
cn:
“那些……是星星吗？”
抬头望去，我们透过裂缝看见了像是夜空一样的景色。
“此乃流星！！”
我听说当流星划过天空时许愿会成真。
我们也许个愿怎么样？

en: AFloweringTreestands inthemiddleofthePlain. NootherFloweringTreesarenearby(近處). TheFloweringTreestood WithFlowersbloomedinEarnest(熱心) MuchlikehowitthinksofFloweringTreesinitsThoughtsinEarnest. What will you do?
cn: 在田野中心有一棵花树。 附近没有一棵花树。 花树就像热心地想象 自己所想象的花树一样 热心地开放着花朵。 该如何抉择？

en:
The space twists.
At the same time, a familiar cry is heard from behind.
It somehow bears resemblance to the cry of an Abnormality we reduced to an egg earlier.
"Start running!!"
Thirteen Sinners haphazardly rushed down the path.
"In there!"
"T-That looks like a dead end..."
The Sinners seem scared... Do we still go in there?
cn:
空间扭曲着。
同时，似曾相识的哭声紧追而来。
不知为何，那像是我们曾使其变回成卵的异想体的哭声。
“总之先跑起来！！”
十三位罪人在路上飞奔。
“往那里面！”

“那、那看上去像是死胡同……”似乎罪人们都十分恐惧……即便如此也该进去吗？

en:
We keep running down the closed street.
"W-We'll get hit by that thing if we keep up!"
"That bull will only grow faster as the chase goes on..."
The unease is palpable.
What should we do?
cn:
继续向着死胡同疾驰。
“再、再这样下去最后会撞上吧！”
“那个公牛的速度只会越来越快不是吗……”
每个人都难掩不安的神情。
怎么做才好？

en:
We keep running anyway.
"It would be preferable if there were no other circumstances to worry about.
A Sinner muttered a peculiar remark.
"Huh?!"
Just then, the wall ahead of us morphed into a wide area.
What will we do now?
cn:
即使如此我们依旧在跑。
“没有其他的事情反而更好。”
一名罪人突然说出一句令人难以理解的话。
“啊？！”
于是堵在眼前的墙壁，变为了宽敞的空间。
现在，应该怎么做？

en:
Mysterious figures glimmer in the window.
Should we do something?
cn:
窗户中有未知的身影在晃动。
怎么办才好？

en:
Dongrang no longer feels pity for test subjects.

Even if his technology isn't recognized...
Even when he thinks of the yellow calf in his hometown...
He isn't sad anymore.

"The past is all useless. I'll burn it all."

"And Yi Sang, I'd like you gone as well."

Dongrang begins to rush at Yi Sang.
cn:
东朗不再为实验体而感到一丝怜悯。

即便，他的技术久久不被承认……
即便，他再度忆起家乡的小黄……
他也不再悲伤了。

“往日一无是处，尽数焚毁吧。”

“还有你，李箱，我希望你也就此永远消失。”

东朗朝着李箱一头冲去。

en:
"I've... decided to erase all of the past."

"In other words, I will have no business left with you once Yi Sang is gone."

Dongrang frowned, seeming quite displeased.

"And yet... Why do you keep interrupting?"

Dongrang seems to be preparing for a powerful attack. Maybe this gap could be exploited.
cn:
“我……决定要抹去过去的一切。”

“换句话说，只要李箱消失，我与你们再无瓜葛。”

东朗皱起眉头，满是恼怒。

“既然如此……为什么还要阻挠我呢？”

东朗似乎正打算蓄力一击。我们也许可以利用其间的空隙。

en:
"I really shouldn't be wasting my time like this."

Coming to a sudden realization, Dongrang stopped in place.
And he looked at the ceiling as though he was looking up at stars in the sky.

"At this very moment... I'm losing out for each second it spends without crying."

"The opportunities and time to change the world... are scattering."

Dongrang then glared with bloodshot eyes.

"Yi Sang... It's you, you're the only one who needs to go for this to be over!"
cn:
“我真不应该如此荒废时日。”

恍然大悟过后，东朗停在了原地。
仿若观星一般，他抬头望向天花板。

“此时此刻……其未曾哭泣的每时每刻，都是虚度的光阴。”

“眼前改变这个世界的机会……正摇摇欲坠。”

东朗用他爬满血丝的眼睛望向我们。

“李箱……如果你，只要你能消失，那就都结束了，对吧？！”

en:
Many objects appeared in the hidden compartment.
They might be useful for the coming encounters.
What should we take?
cn:
隐藏空间里出现了许多东西。
拿走的话或许会对之后的战斗有所帮助。
既然如此，要拿什么呢？

en:
We stand at the entrance of the Dungeon of the Fathoms.

In an empty space, we find a lone vending machine.

Where does it get its power...?

Besides that, what's with this uncanny feeling...?

Standing in front of the vending machine, we see rows of buttons.
cn:
心象迷宫的起点。

在一片空旷的区域中，不知为何立着一台自动贩卖机。

它是从哪里接通电源的呢……？

而且，这股既视感又是……？

我站在自动贩卖机前，看见上面排布着各种按钮。

en:
In an empty space,
you find a lone vending machine.

Where does it get its power…?

Besides that, what’s with this sound of crashing waves?

Regardless, this vacant lot looks to be a good place
for your Sinners to take a break.

Standing in front of the vending machine, you see rows of buttons.
cn:
在一片空旷的区域中，
不知为何立着一台自动贩卖机。

它是从哪里接通电源的呢……？

还有，这波浪声又是从哪里传来的呢？

刚好，前方有一片整洁的空地。
就让罪人们在这里休息吧。

我站在自动贩卖机前，看见上面排布着各种按钮。

en:
In an empty space,
you find a lone vending machine.

Where does it get its power…?

Besides that, what’s with this sound of crashing waves?

Regardless, this vacant lot looks to be a good place
for your Sinners to take a break.

Standing in front of the vending machine, you see rows of buttons.
cn:
在一片空旷的区域中，
不知为何立着一台自动贩卖机。

它是从哪里接通电源的呢……？

还有，这波浪声又是从哪里传来的呢？

刚好，前方有一片整洁的空地。
就让罪人们在这里休息吧。

我站在自动贩卖机前，看见上面排布着各种按钮。

en:
In an empty space,
you find a lone vending machine.

Where does it get its power…?

Besides that, what’s with this sound of crashing waves?

Regardless, this vacant lot looks to be a good place
for your Sinners to take a break.

Standing in front of the vending machine, you see rows of buttons.
cn:
在一片空旷的区域中，
不知为何立着一台自动贩卖机。

它是从哪里接通电源的呢……？

还有，这波浪声又是从哪里传来的呢？

刚好，前方有一片整洁的空地。
就让罪人们在这里休息吧。

我站在自动贩卖机前，看见上面排布着各种按钮。

en:
Up ahead, you see some sort of ray of light.

Looking closely, there are numerous tall mirrors.
They all face each other.

While examining them,
you feel the need to stand before the mirrors.

The room, wall-to-wall with reflections, is quiet and chilly.
cn:
向前望去，有什么东西在闪闪发光。

我上前查看，发现是几面很高的镜子，
面对面地摆在一起。

细细检查，我的心里涌出一股
站到镜子面前的冲动。

被镜子围绕的房间寂静无声，令人心底发凉。

en:
The machine seemed to be well-maintained.
Not a single speck of dirt rested on its surface.

[Please select an ampule and go atop the table.]

Those were the instructions on the display next to it.

Behind that display, you see ampules containing
liquids of various colors, like red, green, and white.

You carefully get on the cold operating table.
cn:
这个机器像是一直被谁管理着一样，
一尘不染，十分整洁。

[请选择想要的安瓿，然后平躺在台上。]

机器前方的屏幕上显示着这样一段话。

显示屏的后面可以看到很多安瓿瓶，
装着红、绿、白等等各种颜色的液体。

小心翼翼地躺到冰冷的手术台上。

en:
Orange circles float in the air before your eyes.
The lights flutter and dance in the air, creating a haze.

Something is burning to death within.
Would you be scorched as well if the flames touched you?
cn:
几个橘色的球状物晃晃悠悠地飘浮在空中。
光芒在空中闪烁着，形成一片雾蒙蒙的微光。

光雾之中，有什么快要燃尽了的东西。
倘若触碰那片火焰，那我们也会被灼烧吧。

en:
Blood pours from above; the land of gold lies beyond.
The spiral ahead loudly screeches.

It must have reached this depth after burrowing and burrowing.
Although it has no eyes, it creaks to face you.
cn:
鲜血倾注而下，黄金乡就在彼方。
眼前的螺旋发出刺耳的金属声。

它大概是在不断的渗透之中，才渗入至此处。
尽管没有眼睛，它仍嘎吱作响地转向我们。

en:
A cry rings out in the ashen wilderness.
From the distance, an undulating wall of fog rises.

Its shape resembles a human.
Yet, it could be a spirit or a ghost taken form.

Its mouth, agape as if crying in despair, is completely dark.
cn:
哭声响彻灰色的荒野。
浓雾从远方飘飘忽忽地涌来。

浓雾有如人形。
或者说，如同亡灵或幽灵般，正在逐渐成型。

张开的嘴巴仿佛在尖叫，其中一片漆黑，深不见底。

en:
It gives blood to those who need it.
The only blood it has to give is its own.

Even those who don’t need a transfusion
are bled dry with scissors, forced to accept.

Thus, its road is filled with receivers that need blood.
cn:
它将血分给需要的人。
但是，能分出的也只有它自己的血。

即便是不需要血的人
它也会用剪刀放干对方的血，再注入自己的血液。

正因如此，它的面前只有需要血的人。

en:
A wail fills the forest.
You can’t help but wonder what it’s so sorrowful for.

There’s a coffin in the middle of the woods.
It has been tied with multiple cords and ropes,
in what appears to be a desperate attempt to keep its contents from escaping.

However, the coffin continues to rumble and creak.
cn:
哭声响彻整片森林。
哭得如此声嘶力竭，是在憎恨着什么吗。

森林的正中间摆放着一口棺木。
像是无论如何都不能让棺中之物逃脱一般，
数根绳子将棺木捆住。

但是，棺木一刻不停地咔咔作响。

en:
“Who are you, and what brings you here?”

A piece of paper rustles.

“Well, you came just at the right time for me;
I’ve urgent business that needs doing.
Won’t you take the job?”

It held out another piece of paper with lousy letters written on it.
Unfortunately, you can’t make sense of these lines and dots.

“How’s about it? You up for it?”
cn:
“你是何人？来这里做什么？”

一个折纸人沙沙地向我搭话。

“我这里有些挺着急的工作，你来得正是时候。
能接受这份工作吗？”

折纸人递给我的纸张上写着华丽的文字。
很可惜，是我读不懂的点和线。

“怎么样？要试试吗？”

en:
“Look at those butterflies! Aren’t they just beautiful?”

“And gander at that sunset, too!
Really makes you want to go for a stroll.”

“Why don’t you stop for a moment
and take a breather here?”

Something yellow gestures warmly at you.
cn:
“看看这些蝴蝶，十分美丽吧？”

“这里的晚霞又如何呢？
真让人想永远在这条路上慢慢散步呢。”

“你也在这里休息一下
之后再上路怎么样？”

一个黄色的东西用温和的语气说着，向我招手。

en:
A teddy bear suffers from having nails lodged into its body.

The bloodstains decorating it
are a telling sign of all the time it spent in pain.

The holes where its eyes should be are empty.
Nothing but dry red marks remain inside.

In spite of that, it stands with its arms wide,
endeavoring to fulfill its duty of giving hugs.
cn:
这是一只被扎着钉子，正在忍受着痛苦的泰迪熊玩偶。

钉子的间隙中渗着血迹，
我似乎可以想象到它强忍痛苦的日子。

原本是眼睛的位置空空如也
只剩下干涸的血迹。

即使这样，它也像是要完成义务般，
像要抱住我们一样张开双臂站立着。

en:
Candles quietly burn away.
Scribbling sounds are all that fill the air.

A trio of eyes takes turns glaring
into a grand tome, bound in skin.

You can’t tell what it’s referencing,
or if there is any deliberation in its writing;
hands are busy nonetheless.

Yearning for destruction and doom,
it writes and writes and writes.

You feel the passages it’s writing may be prophecies for someplace and sometime.
cn:
蜡烛静静地燃烧着。
四周只能听到在写着什么的声音。

三只眼睛轮流凝视着
一本巨大的由皮肤制成的书。

不知它是在写下所见之物，
还是在边思考边书写，
但它从未停止记录。

热切地渴望着毁灭与灭亡，
写下去，写下去。

似乎是在写着能成为预言的文句与章节。

en:
A bell occasionally tolls in the red room.
It’s a heavy, subduing sound.

The statue is chanting something.
You’re unable to recognize its words.

But, you feel that whatever it is,
is not a joyous thing.

There’s a brass ring on the statue’s finger.
cn:
赤红色的房间中时不时响起钟声。
这钟声低沉，令人喘不过气。

佛像好像在念着什么。
我无法听清佛像低喃的内容。

但我确信
它说的并不是什么令人愉悦的话。

佛像的手指上镶嵌着一轮黄铜戒指。

en:
An alleyway garbage dump.
Its atmosphere is stuffy and unpleasant thanks to the humidity from the rain.

A pile of old and torn umbrellas sits in a corner.

The umbrellas jiggled.
Looking closer, there’s a large fox underneath.

The umbrellas’ rusted iron blades have firmly rooted themselves in its back.
cn:
这里是小巷中的垃圾堆。
想来是刚下过雨，潮湿的空气令人感到不快。

一堆老旧撕裂的伞被丢弃在巷里。

那些伞摇曳着。
仔细看去，伞下是一只巨大的狐狸。

锈蚀的伞骨深深嵌在那狐狸的背上。

en:
You hear the quiet flickering of candles.
In this cramped room, you find a wooden doll, standing.

Are the talismans filling the room for a wish?

Does this wooden doll wish for anything?
cn:
这里能听到蜡烛静静燃烧的声音。
在狭小到仿佛让人呼吸困难一样的房间中，站着一个木人偶。

贴满房间的护身符，是用来许愿的吗？

木偶是有什么愿望吗？

en:
A pained moan echoes across the heat.
It’s hard to tell if it comes from a beast or a human.

A sizzle spreads into the air
along with the smell of burning flesh.

“Please! I need water!
Won’t someone give me water to drink?”
cn:
痛苦的声音从热气中传来。
难以分清那到底是野兽的声音，还是人的声音。

火焰噼啪作响，
伴着皮肉被烧焦的臭味回荡在空气中。

“求你了！哪怕一口也好，
有谁能给我一口水吗！”

en:
The cavern is full of smells, good and bad.

“Been a while since I had visitors! I oughta give you a right treat.”

“Plum outta luck for eatery, I’ve already had all the food.”

“Straight as you can see, this glass o’ fairy wine is all I have.”

“Would ya care for a drink?”

A thick, slimy hand makes its offer.
cn:
这是个混杂着香气与恶臭的洞窟。

“许久没见到的客人呢。我可要好好招待你们一番。”

“这里能吃的东西似乎都被吃完了。”

“如您所见，剩下的只有我手中这杯精灵酒了。”

“要喝一杯精灵酒吗？”

厚重又黏稠的手伸向我们。

en:
It records right and wrong.
Its job is to record the judgement of the one above.

It does not assess what it writes.
To lay down judgement is not a secretary’s role.

The scribe silently presented an emerald tablet.
cn:
它记录着对错，
记录着那位大人降下的对错。

仅仅记录，不加判断。
判断不应是佐官的工作。

佐官沉默着，递给我们绿宝石色的石板。

en:
What does this signboard say?
It hangs itself on a tree, trying to make its content known.

Its desperation is almost pitiable.
cn:
这个告示牌好像在指示着什么。
为了广而告之，它将自己绑在树上。

那种迫切地想告诉我们什么的姿态，令我感到些许哀伤。

en:
The barren mudflat reeks of salt and rot.
What little jade-colored seawater is left there
doesn’t seem to have anything inside.

A giant clam walks before you.
With each step it takes, it sprays a fetid green muck.

Is the clam the source of the contamination,
or is it working to contain the filth?
cn:
这是一片混杂着盐味与恶臭的荒凉滩涂。
勉强残留下的翡翠色的海水里
好像什么都没有一样。

我的面前有一个巨大的贝壳在移动着。
贝壳一边移动，一边撒下散发着恶臭的绿色污物。

这些污物是贝壳从外面摄入的，
还是贝壳本身产生的呢？

en:
A field of white, yet somehow dark flowers is ahead.
The sky is red, the air windy and bleak.

One giant flower flutters amidst the field.

It resembles a person waving from afar.
cn:
一片开着白花，却又稍显晦暗的花田在眼前绵延。
这里的天空是红色的，凛冽的寒风吹拂着。

花田的正中，一朵巨大的花朵摇曳着。

就像是在远处向某人招手一样。

en:
You see a poor passenger, stranded between dimensions.
Most will never realize that this person ever disappeared.

Well, the transport company would know,
but they’ll simply pretend that the passenger never existed.

Lost and abandoned, tossed out like trash,
having no place left in the City.
cn:
我看到了在次元裂隙中因为事故被抛下的可悲的乘客。
大部分人连这个乘客消失的事都没有察觉吧。

起码运输公司应该是知道的，
但公司只是将事故隐瞒下来，就好像这个乘客原本就不存在一般。

于是，它不仅仅是在裂隙中迷失，
更是失去了在都市中的存在本身，成为了毫无意义的废弃品。

en:
Sometimes, the mind wanders.

Where does such a mind end up?

If it had a physical destination,
then it must look like this.

An empty, humanlike statue
is where that mind would decide to settle.

Now, it extends its arms, trying to grab at anything.
cn:
有时，心会迷失方向。

那样的心将会前往何处？

如若存在收留迷失的心的地方，
那一定是眼前这样的场景吧。

面对着空荡荡的人形石像，
我的心平静了下来。

随后，它像是想要抓住什么似的伸出手。

en:
A resentful tree stands among a desolate plain.

The place has an air of umbrage.
Something feels discordant about the sky.

You note one twig growing out of the tree like an arm.

Though the tree is unmoving, it seems to want something.
cn:
荒野中，一棵饱含怨念的树孑然独立。

在这交杂着令人不悦的气氛的空间中，
连天空都似乎不得安宁。

那根如手臂般伸出的树枝令人印象深刻。

这棵树虽没有任何动作，但似乎在渴求着什么。

en:
“Croohoo, croohoo, croohoo.”
A giant toad cries inside a cave.

Patches of dark blue resin cover the cave.

This resin is like gloom.
A sap of gloom, not quite like tears or sadness.

The toad holds this resin.
cn:
呱、呱、呱。
巨大的蟾蜍在洞穴中叫着。

洞穴各处粘着青黑色的黏液。

这些黏液好似忧郁的凝聚。
不同于眼泪或哀伤的，忧郁的精华。

蟾蜍正不断生产这种黏液。

en:
A person stands in the square.

They look this way, waving an arm.

The cavity in their head may be an eye,
or a bullet hole.

If it is, it must have been the work
of the revolver in their hand.

That person points the gun at you.
cn:
广场上有谁孤身独立。

它挥舞起一只胳膊盯着我们。

头上的孔洞看上去既像它的眼睛，
也像洞穿的弹痕。

那一定是它手中的
那把左轮手枪制造的空洞。

它将枪口对准了我。

en:
A cluster of eyes looks this way.
The thing in the middle has the appearance of a tree branch, but it is human.

Heaven sometimes burrows;
other times, it makes a home in the heart.

Once taken root, that heaven
will only be visible through the eyes of others.
cn:
无数的眼球望向这边。
深隐在其中的是盘根错节的树枝，但那实际都由人类构成。

天堂有时会埋藏自身，
也有时会成为人们的心中的归宿。

一旦这天堂在心中生根发芽，
便只能透过他人之眼来慢慢欣赏。

en:
Oh, how blue this is.

The pure hue of blue
allows nothing to approach.

When you try to go near, your body is pushed away.
And yet, it is so, so blue.

You wish to have that color.

The irresistible allure
is almost tearing you apart.
cn:
啊啊，何等碧蓝。

这样纯粹的碧蓝，
何人能够接近？

愈是接近，身体愈被排斥。
只是，如此碧蓝。

想成为那碧蓝。

无比强烈的冲动，
似乎要撕裂身体，喷涌而出。

en:
It’s a spider’s nest made of thorny vines
and filled with flowers, perhaps once used for celebration.

The buds appear to be filled with someone’s blood.
The bride and groom crawl between them.

As they scuttle around,
blood seeps out of their hands and feet.

It appears that they change sides
before the bottom one loses too much blood.
cn:
这里是由棘蔓交织而成的蜘蛛巢。
蜘蛛巢中盛满了或许曾用于庆祝的花朵。

仿佛由某人的血盛满了的花之中，
是新郎与新娘在爬行。

每爬行一步，
其手脚便渗出鲜血。

在一方的血流干之前，
另一方会与之上下交换，就这样交替爬行着。

en:
It carries heavy objects without a word.

As it does its work,
the number on the electronic display seems to update.

Machines exist for a purpose.
You feel like you should give it an order.
cn:
它只是在默默搬运着。

每多搬运一次，
真空管中的数字也会随之更新。

机器只为达成目的而存在。
也许让它做些什么比较好。

en:
It’s a dark cityscape,
but the buildings are well-lit.

It appears that they are powered
by the massive buzzing cloud at the center.

The cloud has a head and two pairs of legs.
It resembles a sheep.

The “electric sheep” seems to be in pain.
Is it being siphoned of its power?
cn:
这里是暗无边际的城市，
但建筑物的光亮清晰可见。

这座城市貌似是从其中央的巨大雷云中
获取电力，加以使用。

乌云有着头和脚。
那副姿态就如同羊一般。

电子羊痛苦不堪。
是因为电力被夺走了吗？

en:
“This centipede is capable of discharging a high voltage.”

That’s what the sign attached to the tank says.

Is this an aquarium, or a laboratory?

The segments of the creature spark each time they move,
suggesting faulty connections.

There are two buttons at the tank.

One is shaped like a thunderbolt, while the other looks like a waterdrop.
cn:
“这种蜈蚣能够发出超高压电流。”

水槽旁的介绍这样写着。

这里是水族馆？又或是研究室？

蜈蚣的体节好像无法顺畅移动，
每次动作都会飞溅出火花。

水槽前设置了两个按钮。

一个是闪电状的，另一个是水滴状的。

en:
This dark place might be a factory.

A sharp mechanical noise zips through the air.
Illuminating eyes are fixed on you.

A robot slowly approaches.

It appears to be incomplete, as suggested by the bare wires protruding with each movement.

Is that leakage antifreeze, or blood?

While you were wondering, the terminal on its chest flashed to life.

Looks like you can write something.
cn:
虽然很黑，但这里应该是一座工厂。

尖锐的机器轰鸣声不断回响。
如同眼睛般的荧光色照明物注视着我。

一个机器人缓缓走来。

或许是因为尚未完工，
每动一下都能看见它四处裸露的电线。

那滴答而下的液体是防冻液，还是说是血呢？

正当我思考时，机器人胸口处的终端发光了。

似乎可以输入什么。

en:
“This here’s ma turf.”

“Here folks play by ma rules, or else!”

Sounds like there can be dire consequences.

“Let’s play rock, paper, scissors!”

“I’ll go fer scissors. How ‘bout you?”
cn:
“这里是独属于我的空间。”

“所以必须要按照我的方法来玩！”

这里似乎是不遵从规则就会发生坏事的地方。

“来玩石头剪刀布吧！”

“我出剪刀，你呢？”

en:
A thing wearing human skin was dancing in place, clicking and creaking.
It soon spots me.
Clopping like a spider, it talks to me.

"I made this face yesterday."

Fwip-pip. Tap-trrt.
"What face do you think I'll make tomorrow?"

Fwip. Trrt-tap.
"What face should we make?"
cn:
一个披着人皮的东西在原地起舞，咔咔作响。
它很快就发现了我。
就像蜘蛛一样，它咔嗒咔嗒地爬了过来向我搭话。

“我昨天做了这个表情。”

咻咻。嗒哒哒。
“你认为我明天应该做什么样的表情呢？”

咻。嗒哒哒。
“我们应该做出什么样的表情？”

en:
The air is thick with steam.

It's not simply gaseous water; the steam's color is brown.

Beyond the veil of steam, you hear a voice.

"Mhm! It's only right to drink straight from the bottle!"

"The ones from the west are good-tasting these days."

"You there! You like booze?"
cn:
空气中弥漫着浓浓的蒸汽。

这些不仅仅是水汽，那蒸汽的颜色是棕色的。

透过蒸汽的帷幕，你听到了一个声音。

“嗯嗯！对瓶吹才尽兴嘛！”

“西边来的这批货味道不错。”

“嘿！你喜欢喝酒吗？”

en:
This is a dark cavern.

Sounds of hard objects hitting each other loudly echo at random intervals.

The noise is coming from three large skulls. They approach us, clacking and rattling.

They have no bodies. So they roll. They make noises endlessly even as they roll.

Looking at the three skulls that rolled at our feet, we find they have different expressions.

Should we choose one of them?
cn:
这是一个黑暗的洞穴。

不时从里面传来坚硬的东西相互碰撞而产生的巨大回声。

噪音的来源是三个硕大的骷髅头。它们吱嘎作响地靠近了我们。

它们没有身体，所以它们滚动前进。一边向我们滚来，一边不断发出噪音。

三个骷髅头滚到了我们脚边，它们三个都有着各自的表情。

我们应该选择其中一个吗？

en:
This flower was once a rose that could have been tiny and beautiful.

But now, the blood it holds gives off a cruel smell.

Drinking and growing giant, it sucked in blood that overflowed from a spring.

Without an end.

It greedily gobbles up the stream of blood with its branched roots.
cn:
这朵花曾是一朵娇小玲珑的玫瑰。

但如今却全部为鲜血所浸染，散发出残酷的气味。

饮下血液变得巨大的玫瑰，啜饮着自某处泉水中溢出的鲜血。

无尽无休。

以其分杈的根贪婪地痛饮着涌流的血溪。

en:
Something that creaks, squeaks, and shakes is stood before us.

Inside it is a pink liquid.

It heaves whenever the liquid container shakes.

Or it might be the liquid's movement that causes the massive glass body to move.

The liquid seems to consist of multiple things and beings.

Each droplet has its own face.

One sad-looking droplet is pushed away by its mean-faced peers.

The glass giant trembles, and a pink droplet is ejected.

The droplet is crying.
cn:
我们面前立着一个正在吱嘎作响，摇摇晃晃的东西。

它的内部有着一种粉红色的液体。

每当容器摇晃起来，它便上下起伏。

或许是液体的摇动让这硕大的玻璃瓶也动了起来。

那液体并不单调，而是由不同的液滴混合勾兑而成。

每个液滴都有自己的脸。

其中一滴看起来很悲伤的液滴被它面露鄙夷的同伴们推开了。

巨大的玻璃瓶颤抖了一下，那粉红色的液滴流了下来。

这液滴一直在哭泣着。

en:
"I wipe everything."

"Cleaning is enjoyable."

"I like to be the same as others."

"……."

"I am frankly troubled."

"The model next to mine boasted that it has multiple parts that others don't."

"Is that what makes one special?"

"Am I special the way I am?"
cn:
“我可以把一切都擦得干干净净。”

“清扫让人感到愉悦。”

“我喜欢和其他人一样。”

“……”

“老实说，我很烦恼。”

“我旁边的那个型号夸口说自己有了独特的部件。”

“那种东西就能让我变得特别吗？”

“我真的显得特别吗？”

en:
The room's ceiling was too high. Yet it was so narrow that it felt like a tight space.

Something that looks like an old person sits on a chair, staring into a painting on the wall. It didn't so much as flinch.

A dark, thick, and sticky smoke crawls out from behind it.

Perhaps that's what loneliness might look like if it's visualized.

"What's a young one like you doing in this room."

It spoke to us, its eyes still glued to the painting. How long has it been aware?

"Are you interested in hearing my stories?"
cn:
这间房间的天花板很高。然而，它也很狭窄，所以从外观来看它只是一处狭小的空间。

在房间内，看起来像是一位老人的东西坐在椅子上，一动不动地盯着墙上的一幅画。

在它身后，一股黑暗，厚重且黏稠的烟雾蔓延出来。

也许这就是孤独在被可视化后所展现的样子。

“像你们这样的年轻人来这间屋子做什么？”

它在对我们说话时依然目不转睛地盯着那幅画。它意识到这点有多久了？

“你们想听听我的故事吗？”

en: What will you do?
cn: 该如何抉择？

en:
Stars glow blue in the dark.

Looking at them up close, those weren't actually stars.

It was a person waving their arms with blue marbles in their hands.

"These are stars."

The person claims what they're holding are stars.

As if they read my mind and knew what I was thinking.
cn:
黑暗中有蓝星熠熠生辉。

凑近一看，那并非真正的星星。

只是一人手中紧攥着几颗蓝色的玻璃珠。

“这是星星。”

但，它断言那玻璃珠就是星星。

仿佛已经看穿了我的心思。

en:
The centipede-like thing donned a rotten sheet of cloth.

The cloth reeks of rotting bodies, like it was used to dress a corpse.

There are strange booklets hanging all over its body.

Looking closely, those are prayer books.

What does it believe in, and what does it pray for?
cn:
这条蜈蚣般的东西包裹在腐烂的布片中。

那块织物不断散发着腐肉的气味，就像是它在被解下来之前曾经包裹着腐烂的尸体。

它的身上挂满了奇怪的小册子。

仔细观察的话，那些是祈祷书。

它信仰什么，又是为了什么而祈祷？

en:
That must be snakes, bugs, or the symbolization of fulfilled peace.

Looking closely, the fence of wire and the countless corpses caught up in it can be seen moving.

Those sacks of flesh entangled in painful ways must be the remains of those who perished in a war fought in the past.

Now, it moves like a living thing, wandering where the Smoke War may have taken place.

The concertina wire was a line crossed between you and me, and a separator.

However, this rusted, bloodstained wire now binds us together and squeezes us so our flesh and eyes meet.
cn:
那可能是蛇、虫子，或是象征着圆满和平的形象。

仔细观察的话，可以看到铁丝围栏与纠缠在其中的无数尸体正在移动。

那些以痛苦的方式纠缠在一起的肉块，是那些曾在过去的战争中丧生的武装人员的遗体。

现在，它像是一个活物一般移动着，在曾发生过烟霾战争的区域徘徊。

铁蒺藜像是隔离器一般，在你我之间划出一条分界线。

然而，如今这条生锈而布满血迹的铁蒺藜却将你我死死地绞缠在一起，使我的眼睛嵌入你的肉体。

en:
Tang- Tang- Tang-

The sound of plastic crashing is accompanied by the sloshing of a liquid.

It looks like something that used to be an employee of a company.

Its identity is evidenced by the now-worn formal outfit and the employee card.

The card is almost too battered and contaminated to recognize.

Wearing a box filled with Enkephalin on their head, the employee rams it into what looks like the door to a containment unit.

A rubber O-ring is worn around their neck. Could it be there to prevent Enkephalin from spilling?
cn:
铛——铛——铛——

塑料撞击的声音伴随着液体晃荡的声音传来。

它看起来曾是某公司的员工。

已然破旧的正装和员工证证明了其身份。

那员工证又旧又脏，近乎无法辨认。

它的头上戴着一个装满了脑啡肽的盒子，正在不断的用头撞向一个似乎是收容单元的门。

它的脖子上戴着一个环形垫圈。也许是为了防止脑啡肽溢出？

en:
This is a dark forest, full of fog and vine.

An apple, rotten but still moving, runs to me in a hurry.

"Please help me, I need to hide."

"I'm just a poor, tiny apple... Cursed and thrown away."

Before I could answer, the apple hid its small body behind my leg.

"......."

Amidst the fog of the viney forest, the clop of a horse is heard.

It's a giant horse made of vines.

Mounted on it was a being with the head of a rose.

The vine horse stands before me and lets out heavy breaths that reek of green grass.

"I am on the hunt for someone. It needs to be taken care of urgently."

"What I am looking for is an apple that will become a princess, not knowing its rightful place."

"It must have passed this way. Do you know what direction it has taken?"
cn:
这是一片漆黑的森林，充斥着浓雾与藤蔓。

一颗看似腐烂却依旧移动着的苹果，急切地奔向我。

“请帮帮我，我需要藏起来。”

“我只是个可怜的，小小的苹果……被诅咒后又被抛弃。”

我没来得及回答，苹果就把它小小的身体藏在了我的腿后。

“……”

在长满藤蔓的森林的雾中，隐约可以听见马蹄声。

那是巨大藤蔓组成的马。

骑在马上的是一个有着玫瑰头的实体。

由藤蔓组成的马站在我面前，吐着充斥青草味的粗气。

“我在猎杀某人，需要尽快处理。”

“我正在找的是个将要成为公主的不自量力的苹果，却不知道它的准确方位。”

“它一定经过了这里。你知道它去哪儿了吗？”

en:
A giant lizard-like thing with the cold skin of a machine stands before us.

Its long tail, shaped like the human hand, bends in all directions before straightening to point at me.

"The heavenly commander is who I serve."

"It is the duty of the commander's servant to follow commands."

"Tell me what you command."
cn:
一个巨大的，蜥蜴样的机器站在了我们前面。

它长尾的形状酷似一只人手，在向各个方向弯曲后朝着我们的方向伸直，并径直指向了我们。

“我所侍奉的乃是天之发令官。”

“天之发令官仆人的义务就是遵从命令。”

“告诉我，你的命令是什么？”

en:
Clackle-

Clackle-

A mountain made out of holed rocks. It's shrouded with white fog.

Rocks can be heard clashing with each other.

There's a being with long limbs and stone-like skin piling up a tower.

Could it be a stone tower being made for a wish?

Or is it a cairn that is burying someone alive?
cn:
咔啦——

咔啦——

随着白雾弥漫，眼前是一座用带孔的石头组成的山。

不知哪里传来岩石相互碰撞的声音。

有一个四肢修长、皮肤如石质般的生物正在堆起这座塔。

这是一座为了祈愿而堆起的石塔吗？

还是一个活埋某人的石冢？

en:
Damp and slippery, this is the emerald forest.

A green rain was pouring down, seeming quite sticky.

You see someone next to you holding a large piece of grass like an umbrella.

'Oh dear, I'd advise against being hit by this rain.'

'Come on, get under this umbrella, all of you.'

'If you stand in the rain, you might melt down head first.'
cn:
这便是翡翠森林，又湿又滑。

看起来很黏稠的绿色的雨倾泻而下。

你看到边上有个像拿着雨伞一样拿着一片草的人。

“哎呀，我可不建议被这场雨淋到。”

“来来，快来伞底下。”

“要是你站在雨里面的话，很快就要从头开始被融化掉了。”

en:
It's an empty room of cement.

Yet I can shake off the creeping feeling that something might be here.

Other Sinners scoff at me in disagreement.

There's a switch in the room.
cn:
这是一间空无一物的水泥房。

但我无法摆脱或许有什么东西在这儿的毛骨悚然感。

其他罪人们不同意我并嗤之以鼻。

房间里有一个开关。

en: What will you do?
cn: 该如何抉择？

en:
In the middle of a quiet and peaceful forest, a delicate tree branch is placed.

A small fairy with a green glow sits atop it.

Saying no words, the fairy waves at us, inviting us to come over and take a break.

It looked like it was smiling, and it might have been dancing.
cn:
在一片宁静祥和的森林中央，放有一根纤细的树枝。

一位散发着绿色微光的小小精灵坐在上面。

精灵一言不发，向我们挥挥手，邀请我们过来休息一下。

它看起来像是在微笑，又好像在跳舞。

en: What will you do?
cn: 该如何抉择？

en:
An alleyway of black and white.

The single streetlamp lighting the path makes the scenery all the more hazy.

Someone is standing in the light.

Pipipipip-

The device in the Abnormality's hand sounds an alarm.

'The results of the job interview for the big company I had last month are out today.'

'Everyone in this street prepares for exams and interviews.'

'They wait for the results to be announced, staking all they have on them, and once they're told they failed, they go far away and disappear.'

'So I changed my head; I'd like to fly away even if I don't make it.'

'Will you check the results for me?'

The device displayed a message that it didn't pass.

'What does it say? Did I pass?'
cn:
一条由黑白构成的小巷。

照亮道路的只有一盏路灯，让整个场景看起来更加模糊不清。

有什么人站在灯光下。

那人的头是蝴蝶，胸前伸出的手臂握着一块电子终端。

哔哔哔哔哔——

异想体手中的终端响起了提示音。

“我上个月去一家大公司面试的结果今天出来了。”

“这条街的所有人都为考试和面试而做着准备。”

“他们赌上了一切，等待结果的公布。一旦听到淘汰的消息，他们就会远走异乡，从此消失。”

“所以，我换了换脑子。就算没有被录取，我也会欣然飞走。”

“能帮我看一下结果吗？”

终端的屏幕上，显示着面试被淘汰的信息。

“怎么样？我合格了吗？”

en:
'This is a warzone.'

'And my gun must blow someone up.'

The Abnormality spoke with clarity, loading its shotgun loudly.

'In this gory war, the devil approached me one day to suggest a deal.'

'It promised to give me a gun that can blow up anything, but the catch was that its last shell would land on the head of my beloved.'

'I accepted the gun and the ammunition with laughter.'

'My beloved, huh….'

'Did I ever have people I held that dearly? I couldn't be sure anymore.'

'I had to have joined this war for someone I loved, that much I remember.'

I noticed an old pendant worn on the shooter's neck.

'Thanks to that, I'm free to point the barrel at anyone I want. No matter where I fire it, this shotgun can blast anyone into fireworks like it hit them point blank, how wonderful is that?'

'I bet that fellow had their beloved.'

'Yup, I'm talking about the one whose head I just blew up.'

'They might have remembered what I don't. That makes this just too exhilarating.'

'Killing people who remember their loved ones, I mean.'

The shooter keeps firing its gun as it speaks.

The shotgun shoots out pellets as easily and lightly as the shooter laughs.

'By the way, whose side are you on?'
cn:
“这里是战场。”

“而我的枪必将打爆谁。”

伴随着霰弹枪装填之声，异想体明确地说。

“在这场血肉横飞的战争中，有一天恶魔向我提议做个交易。”

“它许诺给予我一把能够打爆任何事物的枪，但最后一发子弹将会打爆我所爱之人的头颅。”

“我笑着接过了枪与子弹。”

“所爱之人啊……”

“我曾有过那样的人吗？如今我已记不清了。”

“我明明应该是为了自己的所爱之人，才参加这场战争的。”

就在这时，注意到了射手的脖子上挂着一枚陈旧的吊坠。

“因此我随意将枪口指向任何人都没问题。这把霰弹枪无论从哪儿开火，都能像就在面前射击一般，华丽地轰碎呢？”

“或许那个人也有其所爱之人。”

“没错，就是刚刚被我轰碎脑袋的那个家伙。”

“我不记得了，但他们说不定还记得。所以才这么有趣又痛快。”

“我要杀死那些记得自己所爱之人的人。”

射手在说话的过程中也时不时地射出子弹。

霰弹枪伴随着它发出的笑声一同轻而易举地发射。

“话说回来，你站在哪一边？”

en:
I see a room filled with papers.

It was probably once spacious, but now, it's cramped thanks to the stacks of papers with scrawls occupying much of it.

Something swims this way in this sea of papers and documents.

The serpent made of papers slithered up to talk to me.

'This is hell.'

'The hell for homework and assignments all the people in the world have neglected to do.'

'People may think an assignment that they didn't get to finish is no big deal... How little do they know.'

'The assignments wanted to be completed and submitted on time!'

'This is where the overdue and forgotten assignments end up.'

'They're then plummeted into a hell where they suffer for eternity, forever left procrastinated.'

'How cruel students are! You may have seen us as little tasks you could put off, but we wished nothing more than to be handed over!'

'Let me ask you this... Have you ever been behind with an assignment? It doesn't matter if it was by unavoidable circumstances, tell me if you have abandoned any poor assignments!'
cn:
我看到一个被纸塞满的房间。

也许它曾经很宽敞，但现在，由于成堆的潦草文件占据了大部分空间，它变得很狭窄。

在这纸张和文件组成的海面上，有什么东西向我们游来。

由文件构成的东西像蛇一样蠕动着，对我说：

“这是地狱。”

“这是世界上所有的人所忽略了的逾期作业和任务的地狱。”

“人们也许以为没有完成作业是件小事……他们什么都不知道。”

“这些作业也想被按时完成并上交！”

“所有逾期以及被遗忘的作业都会来到这里。”

“然后他们就会坠入地狱，永远受苦，永远被拖延。”

“学生们真是残忍啊！你可能觉得我们只是你可以推迟的小任务，但我们只是想被上交！”

“让我问问你……你有没有逾期上交过作业？我不管你有什么特殊情况，告诉我你有没有遗弃过任何可怜的作业！”

en:
This is a hospital.

It's dark and bleak, like the hallway of the hospital always has been.

From the end of the hallway where the lights flicker, something giant approaches.

It slides down at a constant pace, making the sound of rusted wheels.

A person is tightly tied to the dusty hospital bed; could they have been a patient in the past?

When they reached the thought that there was no point in trying to fathom how long they had been lying in it,

It began to move at last, one with the bed.

Having earned the freedom to freely run after too long,

It fiercely charges at us, dragging its wheels along.
cn:
这是一间医院。

它黑暗而荒凉，但医院走廊一直都是这样。

在灯光闪烁着的走廊尽头，一个巨大的身影向我们走来。

它以稳定的速度向我们滑来，传出生锈的轮子拖拽的声音。

一个人被紧紧绑在布满灰尘的床上，也许是昔日的病人？

当它终于意识到，自己无论躺在那张床上多久，都已经毫无意义的时候，

它终于动了起来，连床一起。

它现在终于能够享受可以自由奔跑的特权。

它拖着它的轮子，猛烈地冲向了我们。

en:
This place resembles the operating room of an abandoned hospital.

A few clangs and rumbles later, a blinding white light flashed the eye.

The light is soon blocked by a being with multiple heads.

Those heads were all wearing masks and surgical caps, facing me at the same time.

'Ah, a patient's here.'

'Right, a patient's here.'

'The patient needs curing.'

'Where?'

'The abdomen?'

'The legs?'

'No, the head. The frontal lobe.'

Each head gives its opinion as they prepare for surgery.
cn:
这个地方让人想起废弃医院里的手术室。

哐当几声之后，眼前闪过一道刺眼的白光。

这道光马上就被一只有着数个头颅的生物所遮挡。

这些头都戴着口罩和手术帽，所有的目光都汇聚在我身上。

“啊，有病人来了。”

“对的，有病人来了。”

“病人需要治疗。”

“哪里？”

“腹部？”

“腿部？”

“不对，是头部。前额叶。”

这些头一边各自表达看法，一边准备手术。

en:
The long-necked thing has a hammer on its head.

It resembles a toy somewhat, but this one is undoubtedly an Abnormality.

The way it stood, it looked like it could fall from its precarious stature at any moment,

And as suspected, its head slammed the floor, unable to withstand the weight of the steel.

The flask on its back may have to be filled for this hammer to be lifted back up.
cn:
那长脖的东西头上有一柄锤子。

它看起来有些像一个玩具，但它无疑是一个异想体。

从它摇摇晃晃站着的样子来看，它似乎随时都会坠落，

而正如我们所怀疑的那样，它的头承受不住钢铁的重量，狠狠地砸到了地板上。

也许要装满它身后的烧瓶，才能让锤子重新举起。

en:
Could these five appendages protruding from the urn be a palm?

Or is it a naked person who put their head into the golden urn?

What did this person see in the urn to cause them to shove their face into it? 

As if that wasn't enough, the whole body turned into a hand that tries to grasp everything it can.

If it finally takes hold of everything in the world, will its grip loosen at last?
cn:
从瓮中伸出的五个附肢是个手掌吗？

还是一个裸体的人将自己的头伸进了这金瓮之中？

这个人在瓮中看到了什么，才会让它把自己的头塞入瓮里？

仍不满足于头部的紧缚，它的身体仿佛化作了一个手掌，试图抓取一切。

它若是抓住了这世上的一切，最终是否会稍稍松手呢？

en:
There's a long, wide road ahead.

You see someone with a sign at the entrance.

'This is a one-way road. No U-turns.'

'If you take this road, it'll take ages to come back here.'

As the person claims, the road seems to be stretched almost endlessly into the distance.
cn:
面前是一条绵长而宽广的路。

你看到什么人在入口处举着路标。

“单行道，无法掉头。”

“走了这条路，要再回到这可要花上几个世纪。”

如它所说，这条路似乎一直延伸下去，无穷无尽。

en:
A cry rings out in the ashen wilderness.
From the distance, an undulating wall of fog rises.

Its shape resembles a human.
Yet, it could be a spirit or a ghost taken form.

Its mouth, agape as if crying in despair, is completely dark.
cn:
哭声响彻灰色的荒野。
浓雾从远方飘飘忽忽地涌来。

浓雾有如人形。
或者说，如同亡灵或幽灵般，正在逐渐成型。

张开的嘴巴仿佛在尖叫，其中一片漆黑，深不见底。

en:
A wail fills the forest.
You can’t help but wonder what it’s so sorrowful for.

There’s a coffin in the middle of the woods.
It has been tied with multiple cords and ropes,
in what appears to be a desperate attempt to keep its contents from escaping.

However, the coffin continues to rumble and creak.
cn:
哭声响彻整片森林。
哭得如此声嘶力竭，是在憎恨着什么吗。

森林的正中间摆放着一口棺木。
像是无论如何都不能让棺中之物逃脱一般，
数根绳子将棺木捆住。

但是，棺木一刻不停地咔咔作响。

en:
“Who are you, and what brings you here?”

A piece of paper rustles.

“Well, you came just at the right time for me;
I’ve urgent business that needs doing.
Won’t you take the job?”

It held out another piece of paper with lousy letters written on it.
Unfortunately, you can’t make sense of these lines and dots.

“How’s about it? You up for it?”
cn:
“你是何人？来这里做什么？”

一个折纸人沙沙地向我搭话。

“我这里有些挺着急的工作，你来得正是时候。
能接受这份工作吗？”

折纸人递给我的纸张上写着华丽的文字。
很可惜，是我读不懂的点和线。

“怎么样？要试试吗？”

en:
The blocks are turning, interlocking and noisily grinding against one another.

The entity changes shape with every offering from surrounding clay dolls.

Sometimes its blocks rotate, and sometimes chunks of its red flesh shrink and stretch.

Something falls to the ground from its endlessly distorting form.

One of its blocks fell out of place, pushed out amidst the constant change.

Even the clay dolls stop making their offerings, confused. They stare at the block.
cn:
伴随着哗啦哗啦的声音，石块互相嵌合着旋转起来。

每当周围的土偶献上祭品时，它的形态就会变化。

石块缓缓旋转，红色的肉片时而收缩，时而膨胀。

从那无尽交缠的结构中，传来了某样东西掉落的声音。

一块石块变形到最后无法嵌合，滚落到了地板上。

献上祭品的土偶们也不知所措，停止了动作，注视着那石块。

en:
A thunderous howl booms from where lightning strikes.

There lies a hound with numerous heads; multiple telepoles are protruding from its back.

I can see violet flashovers sparking from all of them, though they were all of differing sizes.

The hound hasn't noticed our approach just yet.

Maybe we can take one of them if we sever its wire.
cn:
落下闪电的地方，传来如雷鸣般的叫声。

那里有一只背上伸出无数根电线杆，拥有好几个头的狗。

那些大小不一的电线杆都释放着紫色的闪光。

那只狗似乎还没有察觉到我们的靠近。

也许可以切断连接着的电线，把电线杆带走。

en:
This place is brimming with the high-pitched screech of metals and industrial machine hammers slamming into something.

Following the clamor led us to what looks like a plastic toy model of a factory.

This smoke-fuming factory of mysterious products churns on and on.

A large octagonal screw tumbles out of the factory.
cn:
周围传来刺耳的金属声和咚咚的冲压声。

顺着噪音回头一看，有一个看起来像是塑料玩具一样的工厂。

这座工厂冒着烟，不知在生产什么，忙碌地运转着。

就在这时，一颗巨大的八角螺丝从工厂里面滚了出来。

en:
A forsaken tavern.

Warm, hearty aroma of stew wafts from the empty kitchen.

Following the trail of that delicious scent leads us to a coiling lizard with a head not unlike a cauldron.

Within its head is a hotly roaring fire and a modest cauldron dangling from above it.

Ancient stew boils vigorously from within the cauldron. It's been boiling for so long that it's become impossible to tell what the original ingredients may have been.

As I stood there wondering what must be done with this stew, a voice echoes from underneath the cauldron.

There lies a sentient hearthflame, speaking to us.

'There isn't anyone left here to enjoy the stew.'
'Would ya mind removing the cauldron?'
cn:
人迹罕至的旅馆。

空无一人的厨房飘出了香浓的炖菜味。

顺着诱人的香气走入其中，能看见一只脑袋如同大锅一样的蜥蜴盘绕在屋内。

它的头中悬挂着炙热的火焰和一个小小的锅。

锅里的炖菜煮得浓稠，已经无法分辨其中的原料了。

正犹豫着拿那炖菜如何是好时，从锅的下方传来了声音。

是摇曳的炉火在向我们搭话。

“这里已经没有人会来吃这炖菜了。”
“请帮我把锅拿下来吧。”

en:
There is an indent on the earth, filled with water.

Something that lies within is constantly making ripples on its surface.

A closer approach revealed a headless fish swimming in that shallow puddle.

Its splashing movements are spirited, despite the glaring lack of a head.

Is it twisting its body from pain?

Or is it merely glad to be swimming in water?
cn:
凹陷的土地里充满了水。

里面似乎有什么正不断地荡起波浪。

靠近一看，一条没有头的鱼正在浅浅的水坑里游动。

尽管没有头，那条鱼仍然活蹦乱跳地拍起水花。

那是因痛苦而做出的挣扎吗。

又或者，只是涸鱼得水的兴奋？

en:
Whirr-clink. Whirr-clink.

Sounds of sticky, oily clockwork echoes.

It is the sound of each cog indents clicking into each other. It is the sound of flowing streams of water conjoining.

A tired, downcast duck stands before you.

The clockwork whirrs vigorously, but the rabbit appears weary.

... No, perhaps this is a duck.

The Rabbit asks.

'What am I, in your eyes?'
cn:
滴-答 滴-答

黏腻的齿轮声不断回荡。

或是机械啮合的声响，又或是水流汇聚的声音。

疲惫不堪，低垂着头的鸭子站在我们面前。

齿轮声愈加强力，兔子却似乎无能为力。

不，或许这是只鸭子吧。

兔子提问。

“从你眼中观望，我是何种模样？”

en:
'What do you think?'

The shard, suspended in air, asks.

'Those things revolving along the track.'

'They're bound by an unseen force, aren't they?'

The shard is surrounded by two different types of tracks. Some rotate wildly, while some do so gently.

'But I'm not binding them here because I want to.'

'They're stuck to me, you see.'

'What do you think?'
cn:
“你怎么想？”

漂浮在空中的碎片出声询问。

“关于这些沿着轨道巡回的事物。”

“它们是被某种力量束缚了吧。”

碎片上缠绕着迅速旋转，以及缓慢旋转的轨道。

“但我也不喜欢被束缚。”

“不如说我才是被束缚的一方。”

“你的想法是？”

en:
This place is like a giant scrapyard.

All kinds of refuse find their way here, only to be burned.

The difference is that this scrapyard collects nothing but bones.

Human bones beast bones and the bones of something that is neither human nor beast

All kinds of bones find their way here.

A faint voice can be heard from the pile, but it is too feeble to be understood.
cn:
这里像是个巨大的垃圾处理场。

一切垃圾聚集于此，被舍弃，被焚毁。

若是说有不同之处，那就是这垃圾处理场只有尸骸。

人类的骸骨，野兽的骸骨，又或是并非这二者的某种骸骨。

一切尸骸聚集于此。

从那骨山中能听见声音，但由于太过微弱，难以辨别其传出的方向。

en:
Shhhh-chk.

Shhhh-chk.

There is a skeleton, making ominous, labored noises.

There is a shadow of somebody in its spine.

Does the shadow breathe, one must ponder.
cn:
嘶——

嘶——

有一具发出不祥声音的骸骨。

在它的脊椎中，能看见什么人的身影。

是那人的呼吸声吗。

en:
There is an entity bound to an extravagantly ornamented chair.

It appears as though the entity is shooting a stern glare this way.

It tries to say something... but its mouth is bound.

The King on the throne twists and thrashes, trying to approach... but the things that bind drags him away.

The beautiful yet cruel crimson strips of fabric. They pull mercilessly. They are...
cn:
它被绑缚在华丽的椅子上。

似乎正严肃地看着我们。

虽然它看起来想要说些什么，但它的嘴被绑住了。

坐在椅子上的王扭动身子试图向我们靠近……却立刻被绑住它的东西拉了回去。

美丽却残忍的红，无情地拉扯着它。这是……

en:
Sounds of heavy rocks scraping against each other.

What looked like palms are made of black rocks.

At the tip of the fingers attached to the palms are smaller palms and smaller fingers.

It reaches out with the hand of the hand.
cn:
听见了沉重的石块相互摩擦的声音。

本以为是手掌，但那实际上是黑色的石头。

手掌的指尖，又伸出新的手掌与手指。

它用那指尖的手，朝向我。

en:
The voice speaks.

'Yes. The deep sea is a dark place.'

'But at the end of that dark path is a light.'

'Because there are things that shine in the dark there.'

'Let's go there.'

'And we'll shine brighter than anything in that dark place.'

'We were all abandoned, yes. But we all had dreams, too. Remember?'

'Well, let's make our dreams come true. Let's sink together into the depths.'

The dim fluorescent lights impaling the entity's back flicker.
cn:
能听到声音。

“对，深海中很黑。”

“但在那黑暗尽头的是光。”

“因为，那里有能在黑暗中焕发光芒的东西。”

“往那里去吧。”

“我们将在至暗之处，散发出耀眼的光。”

“虽然我们都被抛弃，但仍旧心怀梦想，还记得吗？”

“走吧，为了实现梦想，深深地，深深地潜下去吧。”

插在它背后的荧光灯，闪着微微的光。

en:
This is a corridor of a large, wooden mansion. Its floorboards are ancient.

You can hear creaking noises approaching from a distance. Something walks in this direction.

'My master had a very unfortunate life.'

'I am the butler of this house.'

'Sad, sad things happened here. Many sad things.'

'I still carry with me my master's portrait because no one remembers them anymore.'

'How is it? Can you see it well?'
cn:
这里是古木建造的，宏伟宅邸的走廊。

从远处传来踩踏地板的吱呀声，有什么东西走了过来。

“我的主人是何等可怜啊。”

“我是这宅邸的管家。”

“这里曾发生过种种悲剧。”

“我一直带着主人的肖像，因为如今已经无人记得那位了。”

“怎么样，能看得清吗？”

en:
There is a massive, winged, marble statue.

Its arms and the head are not made of stone, however.

Instead, a translucent and solid light shimmers there.

The shimmering, mirage-like head is blowing a trumpet. One of its arms wields a blade.

What could this statue be commemorating?
cn:
那里有带着一对羽翼的巨型大理石雕像。

仔细一看，它的头部和手臂并不是石制的。

取而代之，半透明的光似乎摇晃着想要形成某种形态。

它如同海市蜃楼般的头正吹着喇叭，一只手上握着剑。

那是赞扬什么的雕像？

en:
Someone is breathing heavily and angrily.

A large, towering figure is trembling and shaking. Its breathing is labored.

It is unclear whether it was from wrath or sadness.

'You! Who's there?!'

The figure talks to you.

'Look at this. What the hell does it say here?'

The figure, shoving a piece of paper before you, appears to be blind. 

The paper says that the secret about... something... must be kept.

It is a record of a certain patient.

'Tell me. What does the paper say?'
cn:
能听见谁在喘着粗气。

一个大块头的东西，正气喘吁吁，浑身颤抖。

没时间探明那是出于愤怒还是悲伤。

“那边的！你、是谁！”

它向我们搭话。

“看这个，上面到底写了什么？”

它貌似是看不见，向我们递来一张小小的纸。

那纸上写着，必须要保守某件事的秘密。

是对某位患者的记录。

“这上面到底写了什么？”

en:
The bell tolls.

It creaks a few times...

And tolls again.

The bell tolls to tell the time. It swings all the way back, as though it's about to tip over... then balances itself again.

Every time it balances itself, the sound of a broken bell tolls.

The bell precariously swings back once again.
cn:
钟声响起。

在几声吱呀声后，

钟声再度响起。

那报时的钟看着摇摇欲倒，又找回平衡。

每当它恢复平衡，就能听到破碎的钟表声。

它又一次摇摇晃晃，几乎要倒下。

en:
A lone signpost stands atop a snowy mountain.

A closer inspection revealed that it was, in fact, not a signpost.

Yet it functions as a signpost.

Stiff corpses point to various directions with their frozen arms.

What awaits at the end of the paths these fingers point to?
cn:
雪山中矗立着被冻住的标识。

靠近一看，才发现那不是标识。

但，它依旧起到标识的作用。

冻僵的尸体，用各自的手指向不同的方向。

它手指向的方向上会有什么？

en: What happened here?
cn: 这里发生了什么？

en: What happened here?
cn: 这里发生了什么？

en: Should we rest a little?
cn: 稍微休息一下吧？

en:
Welcome. This is the city of peace, Metropolaris.

No one can be hurt here at Metropolaris.

The entity called it a city... but there's nothing here.

The only recognizable being here is the entity that greets you without even looking in your direction.
cn:
欢迎光临。这里是和平之城梅特罗波拉利斯。

在梅特罗波拉利斯谁都不会受到伤害。

然而，尽管被称作城市，这里看起来好像没有人。

唯一的说话者，也只是向我们机械地吐出迎接的问候，并没有朝我们的方向看一眼。

en: What will you do?
cn: 该如何抉择？

en: What will you do?
cn: 该如何抉择？

en:
Some folks are blocking the way.
They’re sitting on a deck, yelling at each other.
“Look at this succulent piece! The rich juice running down the fibers of luscious meat… This is what chicken is about!”
“Wrong. This piece has a clean taste, with not an ounce of grease tainting the tongue. This is the real deal.”
The two turn around at the same time to face you.
“You there! Tell us which is better!”
cn:
几个人挡住了前进的路线。
他们坐在桌前，互相大声争吵着。
“看这多肉的一块！丰富的汁水正在顺着那些甘美肉质的纤维流淌……这就是鸡肉存在的意义！”
“大错特错。这一块有着纯净的口味，没有一点油脂会玷污你的舌尖。这才是真正的好货。”
两个人同时转身看向了过来。
“嘿，那边的！告诉我们哪个更好！”

en:
A bright spotlight shines on a portion of the noisy area.
It seems as though the chickens are attending a… ball.
“That’s the tango.”
Looking at their movements which might be a dance or a tussle, you notice sauce leaking from one of them.
It doesn’t seem to be aware of this…
cn:
闪耀的灯光照射着一片嘈杂的地方。
似乎正在举办一场鸡群的舞会……
“这是探戈啊。”
看着它们那像是跳舞又像是摔跤的动作，注意到其中一只鸡身上流出了酱汁。
它似乎并没有注意到这一点……

en:
"It's us Kurokumo Clan's turf from here on out."

"Is it that hard for you to understand that you gotta pay the toll to use our road? Huh?"

People dressed in Kurokumo Clan garb stand in the way of unarmed civilians, threatening them.

"... I suppose that excuse was enough for them to tread on our territory as well."

Aeng-du does not hide her indignation. She is gritting her teeth.

What should we do about them?
cn:
“这里现在是黑云会管辖的地盘。”

“想过去就给我付过路费！”

手无寸铁的居民们被像是黑云会一样的人堵在路边威胁。

“……他们一有借口，就会像现在一样来我们的地区闹事。”

樱桃咬紧牙关，毫不掩饰心中怒意。

该怎么处理他们？

en:
"Thank you, thank you so much..."

The civilians, freed from the threat of the Kurokumo Clan, each bow and give us their thanks.

"But... You're not dressed like a local."

"If you don't mind us prying... who might you be?"
cn:
“哎呀，感激不尽……”

从黑云会的暴行下脱身的居民们，纷纷低头表示感谢。

“说起来……各位穿着罕见的装扮……”

“如果可以的话，各位方便透露身份吗？”

en:
"This must be a tavern..."

This bar or an inn is bustling, and its patrons are energetically chattering away. They all seem to be in a rather good mood.

A trio among the crowd is quite boisterously arguing and pointing fingers at each other.

"No, NO! I don't understand why this is even a matter of dispute! A blade is a weapon made for cutting, and the 'right' way to use a blade is to slash with it."

"You don't know what you're talking about! Stab a single point with all your might, and your foe shall surely fall!"

"... You're both wrong. Your half-hearted cuts and stabs won't do anything but piss 'em off. They'll be back on their feet immediately!"

"Smack their skulls with the blunt end—hilt or the scabbard, and knock them down for good! Make 'em too dazed to get up!"

The trio appeared to be talking about something pretty serious, so we'd stopped to listen to their debate...

They suddenly turned in our direction and called over to us.

"You there! Your band can clearly handle your weapons, am I wrong?"

"Answer us. What is the best way to wield your sword?"

"Of course, to slash is the best way to use a blade, is it not?"

What should I say to that?
cn:
“这里是酒幕吗……”

在貌似是酒馆的空间中，人们兴高采烈地喧闹着。

在那之中，有几人高声争论着什么。

“错了，错了！一直以来剑都是用来斩断其他事物的！劈斩才是正确的剑法。”

“你说什么呢！如果能将力量集中于一点，一口气刺入，不就能一击必杀了吗！”

“……你们说的都不对。耍出半吊子的劈斩和刺击，只会给敌人留下再起的余地。”

“直接用刀柄或者刀鞘往脑袋上敲，他们不就会头昏脑胀、起不来了嘛！”

他们似乎在争论某些深奥的事情，我们只是稍稍驻足听了一会儿……

他们看到我们，就朝我们搭话了。

“你们！一眼看上去就知道你们是武者！”

“回答我。最优秀的剑法是什么！”

“斩击当然是最棒的吧？”

该如何回答？

en:
"This is odd... this mist is..."

I don't know when it happened, but a thick layer of mist had descended all around us.

"I have heard a tale of one such nightly stroll. In this tale, a clueless traveler heedlessly wanders into a brumous haze, and finds himself afore an otherworldly being—"

"AAAGH! Stop, stop it!"

Just as the Sinners began loudly bickering with each other, I realized that there was something hazy standing in our way.

"Is that thing... dancing?"

A mysterious thing, dressed in white, danced gracefully before us with a large blade in hand.

When it met my gaze... or, when I thought it did...

... a sheathed blade had materialized in my hand.

What does it want me to do with it?
cn:
“有什么不对劲……是雾吗……”

不知何时，我们被雾包围了。

“我曾听闻。在夜间小道上，如果向浓雾处走去，将会遇见不属于人世的……”

“哇啊！别说了，住口！”

罪人们骚动不安时，某种朦胧的东西出现在我们面前。

“那是在……跳舞吗？”

穿着未知白色服饰的那东西，拿着一把大剑翩翩起舞。

而与它目光相对的那瞬间……

我手中不知何时握住了被收入老旧剑鞘中的剑。

是想让我们做什么吗？

en:
We hear a pair of voices as we walk alongside a stone fence. The two travelers are both carrying blades.

"I pity the people here..."

"Well, the decision of a Wing is absolute for its feathers. There is very little they can do about it."

One of them stands out—their clothing sets them apart from the locals. Maybe they're not from around here.

"Still, to allow the Kurokumo Clan to make their way in here? That's too much."

"The Wing cares about naught else but fluttering its wings. All else becomes insignificant."

Sounds like they're talking about the current S Corp.

"More outsiders, I see. How convenient."

The pair stops in their tracks, then turns around to face us.

"The Kurokumo Clan... no. You do not wear their garb. You don't appear to be peasants seeking to make some cash in the chaos of the Backstreets, either..."

"Well, then. What do you outsiders think of the current climate?"

How should I answer this?
cn:
我们沿着石墙行走，偶然间听见两位身带佩剑的行人的对话。

“这儿的人也真可怜啊……”

“唉，翼一声令下，他们区区翼中之羽又能做到什么呢。”

其中一位外貌略有不同，也许是外地人。

“但是我觉得黑云会那些人这样大张旗鼓地进攻进来，也太过火了吧。”

“就算不在乎这些小事，翼也忙着拍打翅膀呢。”

似乎是在说现在的S公司。

“正好外来者也变多了。”

不知何时向前行走的那两人停下脚步，看向我们。

“黑云会……看上去不像。也不像是想趁着后巷混乱大赚一笔的平民。”

“那么，你又如何看待最近的形势呢？”

该如何回答？

en:
Shimmering blue letters float before you.

The way that these similar words are ordered makes it difficult to understand what it's trying to say.

To say what is right is right and what is wrong is wrong is not right,

but that is not to say that to say what is wrong is right and right is wrong is wrong.

To say that what is wrong is right and right is wrong is not wrong,

and to say that what is right is right and what is wrong is wrong is, in turn, to say that this wrong is right.

... Does it want my impression of these words?

What is it talking about?
cn:
眼前漂浮着闪闪发光的青色文字。

那些文字是由相似的词汇罗列而成，令人难以理解。

“是是非非非是是，”

“是非非非是非是。”

“是非非是是非非，”

“是是非非是是非。”

……需要对这些话做出回应吗？

是什么意思呢。

en:
Just another busy, busy watch factory.

"!@#$!#$#!$@#$!$#@$."

A man in shiny dress shoes and a clean set of suit, clearly the factory's owner, is shouting at his employees in dirty, oil-gunked work clothes.

Something seems to catch his eye, causing him to glare at one of the employees and scream with anger.

The employee, who is already occupied with his work, gets flustered and tries to say something. But it takes him ages to even open his mouth.

The owner pulls out a recorder in a frustrated attempt to communicate, but it doesn't help.

"I just checked the security camera. You've been napping for two whole hours! Explain yourself."

"F… … … a… … …"

"… … c… … … t…"

"Can't you speak any faster, man?!"

Maybe there's something around here to resolve this situation?
cn:
一座繁忙劳作的时钟工厂。

“!@#$!#$#!$@#$!$#@$.”

一位穿着锃亮的鞋子和整洁服饰的厂长，正在大声呵斥身着满是油污的工作服的员工。

随后他突然看到了什么，怒目圆瞪着靠近某个员工，对他发起火来。

忙于工作的员工慌慌张张地想要说些什么，但由于太过迟缓，仅仅开口都要等很长时间。

厂长带着无可奈何的表情取出录音机复述自己的话，却仍然无法顺利交流。

“我刚刚看了摄像头，你这家伙睡了整整2个小时。有借口吗？”

“厂………………”

“……长…………”

“能不能说快点！”

周围也许有能解决这种状况的线索？

en:
A random T Corp. street. A Collection Staff is collecting taxes from someone.

"Will you be making your payments in time, or in cash?"

"Like I said, we already paid our Time Taxes in full! Besides, three-hundred-million Ahn? That's absurd...!"

"The records state that you have accrued additional Time Tax responsibilities due to the donation gift tax."

"No way. Is this because I gave away my time to those kids in the Backstreets?"

"I only gave them three hundred hours, so how the hell does that transform into a three-hundred-million Ahn in taxes?! That doesn't make any sense!"

"Tax calculations in T Corp. are always exceptionally accurate."

The Time Collector strides toward the citizen to neutralize them.
cn:
T公司的街上，时间征收人员正拦住某个人在收税。

“您是通过时间缴费？还是通过金钱缴费？”

“都说过……我们已经把时间税付干净了！而且是整整3亿眼……”

“这是由赠予税产生的时间税。”

“难道是因为我之前把时间分给后巷里的孩子们了？”

“只是送出去300小时就要缴3亿眼的时间税，这根本说不通啊！”

“T公司的税收计算始终是正确的。”

时间征收人员为了镇压市民，向他们大步逼近。

en:
People from all walks of life, all with different hours to spend in a given day, speak and move about in varying speeds.

The sound coming from this odd inequality fills the street with incongruence.

Two people catch your attention in that chaos.

A rich-looking youth, despite his apparent time affluence, is walking in a brisk pace toward the streets...

... and a poor-looking old man, despite his apparent time poverty, is slowly walking into an alley with a leisurely look on his face.

Who to follow?
cn:
时间各异的人们或慢或快地交流着，行走着。

这份差异造成的怪异声音，使街道满是不平衡感。

在那之中，两位看着时钟的人闯入我的视线中。

一位像是时间充裕的年轻人，却匆匆忙忙向着街上走去，

一位看似是时日无多的老人，却从街上怡然自得地走向小巷。

要跟着谁看看吗？

en:
A secret hideout of the Yurodiviye. A Yurodivy is fervently reciting the texts given to them by the Saint.

"We have become nothing but cogs in a machine that exists solely for the industrialists, the bourgeoisie, and the Wings."

"What else, what other human relation remains among the Citizens but the narrow self-interest and heartless bonds created by capital?

"Thus, we shall cast aside the cold, unfeeling metal we call coin; instead, we shall trade our warmth with one another based on our needs!"

"To the haves, the laws of the Nests are shields that protect their privileges; yet, to the have-nots, they are chains that shackle us!"

"Then we shall defy the laws of the Nest! We shall show them the wrath of the have-nots!"

"All that the Yurodiviye have to lose is our chains; all that we have to gain is a world without hunger!"

The Yurodivy suddenly points in our direction.

Looks like we're going to have to say something.
cn:
在圣愚的秘密据点里。某位成员正在热情朗诵着圣者传达的文章。

“如今，我们成为了厂长、富人们以及翼的道具。”

“除了赤裸裸的利益关系、无情的金钱关系以外，都市的人们之间还有其他联系留存吗？”

“正因此，我们才需要通过交换彼此所需的温暖来代替冰冷的货币，互相理解，不断分享！”

“巢的法律是保护富人安全的副产品，不也是束缚穷人的枷锁吗？”

“那么，我们将反对巢的法律，展现出穷人们的愤怒！”

“圣愚最后失去的只有枷锁，而能得到的是人人可以温饱的世界！”

话音刚落，正在朗读的成员指向我们的方向。

看样子我们必须做出反应。

en:
You see a victim of the Time Ripper.

You can't even touch them thanks to the spatio-temporal displacement superposition phenomenon.

Is there anything you can do here to help?
cn:
我们看到了因时间杀人魔攻击而陷入停滞的受害者。

由于时空转移叠加现象，我们无法触碰到他。

有办法帮助他吗？

en:
There's a bizarre-looking machine. In front of it is a coin.

Then there's a twinkling, glowing coin slot on the machine—it's almost enticing us to deposit the coin inside it.

A disembodied, mechanical voice echoes from somewhere when we walk up to the machine.

"Test your luck!"

Where did that vocalization come from? Did it come from within the machine, or was it this space itself whispering to me?

I barely catch myself after absentmindedly picking up the coin and walking up to the machine's coin slot. I should think this through.
cn:
眼前是一台奇妙的机器与一枚硬币。

在机器上，能看到一处闪闪发光的投币口，仿佛在告诉你要把硬币投进去。

站在机器前时，能听到不知从何处传来的机械声音。

“试试你的运气吧！”

是机器传出的声音，还是这个空间本身在对我低语？

仿佛被附身了一般，我一拿起那枚硬币就想把它投进投币口。好不容易才恢复了些许理智，最好还是好好考虑一下该如何决定。

en:
"In this endlessly... this eternally... blessed carnival..."

The parade brings happy exclamations and smiles to the spectators. It's gaudy and extravagant no matter where or how we look at it.

It's just like the lyrics... it feels as though the carnival really is eternally blessed to go on forever.

"Oh."

Someone lets out a brief cry of pain, and a rusty syringe clatters to the ground.

"B-blood! Blood!"
"J-just a drop, please...!"

The parade falls apart immediately as everyone rushes madly toward the syringe.
It's like they don't even realize who or what's around them; they seem just about ready to rip apart whatever that stands in their way.

Should we stop them?
cn:
“在这永无止境的……充满祝福的嘉年华……”

游行队伍中欢呼与笑容此起彼伏，无论远近来看，都显得十分华丽。

就如同歌词那样，幸福的游行仿佛将会永远持续下去。

“啊。”

某人短促的声音回荡在周围，一支生锈的注射器“哐当”一声掉在了地上。

“血、是血！有血啊！”
“一滴、就一滴也好……！”

队伍很快便混乱不堪，每个人都疯狂地飞扑向那注射器。
他们似乎根本不在乎周围的情况。尽是一副要是被妨碍就立刻将碍事者撕碎杀掉的眼神。

应该阻止他们吗？

en:
Is that... a carousel?

There's an incandescent, almost blindingly bright structure radiating brightly in this dark space.

“…….”

"Oh my, something wrong?"

"Hm? N-nay, 'tis naught to worry."

The carousel seems to be occupying some Sinners' minds.

Should we stop by?
cn:
那是……旋转木马吗？

昏暗的空间中，只能看到一座孤立的建筑，散发出耀眼的光芒。

“……”

“哎呀，怎么了？”

“嗯？不，吾没事……”

有几位罪人似乎对旋转木马很好奇。

要去查看一下吗？

en:
Something is breathing heavily. The source of it, its form strange, lay there.

It appears to be an Abnormality. The thing is struggling to even breathe—its every breath is laborious and irregular.

Is it... crying?
cn:
能听到从某处传来的“呼哧、呼哧”声，在那里有着一个形状怪异的东西。

那存在看起来像是异想体，似乎因呼吸困难，正不规律地喘息着，在悲闷之中发出了阵阵哀鸣。

它……是在哭泣吗？

en:
The bloodsteeped petals are so crimson that one might almost mistake it to be bleeding.

Its stems, siphoning blood from somewhere to feed the petals, are twisted, dark, and red.

Vicious and sharp thorns riddle its skin.

But curiosity takes hold—perhaps breaking off a thorn might cause it to bleed?
cn:
寄宿着血液的花瓣，宛如随时会滴落鲜血般红艳。

将不知从何处收集来的血液运输至花瓣的茎也显现出暗红色，怪异地弯曲着。

茎上长满了锋利的棘刺，令人毛骨悚然。

突然，一股好奇心涌上我心头。如果折断一根荆棘，从中会不会流出鲜红的血液呢？

en:
"Ah, there...!"

I turn around to see someone precariously stumbling by the railings... before falling.

Falling... like a feather dropping from a height that is neither too high nor too low, like someone slowly sinking in water.

"WATCH THYSELF!!!"

One of the Sinners shouts vigorously to alert us to the danger.

We all sprinted toward the area where the person was falling, but it seemed that they were still falling by the time we got there, and we even had time to catch our breath.

Something about the ponderousness of their fall made me wonder if it would be as easy and light as grabbing a gently falling piece of paper to grab them.

"... Mass as a factor can hardly be ignored in this case. Despite the ponderous speed with which they fall, if we were to bring them to a sudden stop..."

"We'll get to watch every millisecond of their spine slowly turning to crumbles, and the subsequent, decidedly final agony, stretched to minutes." 

"Eww..."

We still have some time before they hit the ground. We have to find something to break their fall...
cn:
"啊，那边……"

转头一看，发现有人失去了平衡摇晃着，然后直直掉了下去。

从一个不高也不低的地方，像羽毛一样……或者，像是在水中游泳一般缓缓下坠。

“危险！！！”

这时，一位罪人大声地发出警告。

我们向那个人跑去，但当我们赶到，调整呼吸抬头看时，那人还在从高处缓缓坠落着。

就好像，这样接住他会像接住飘落的纸片一样简单。

“……质量亦不应被忽视。若如此接住的话……”

“会目睹这位市民在感受到脊椎慢慢碎裂的同时立刻死亡吧。”

“呃……”

距离完全坠落还有一些时间。如果能找到什么东西来缓冲的话……

en:
"Halt! This area is off-limits to outsiders!"

A man wearing a tall top hat, presumably an employee of T Corp., stops us.

"Only those contracted by T Corp., or those with special authorization slips, may pass through here."

Realizing that we were just standing there dumbfounded and unsure as to what we must do, he points to the side and continues.

"Hmm, looks like you do have the right to pass through here. Perhaps you've misplaced your pass."

"You can request for a reissuance there, off to the side. Go try your luck there."
cn:
“站住！这里是禁止外人进入的区域。”

一位头戴高帽子、似乎是T公司员工的人拦下了我们。

“只有受T公司委托，或获得特别许可之人，才可通过此处。”

或许是因为我们不知所措、一脸困惑的神情，那人指着一旁接着说道。

“看你那反应，是有资格通过却忘了带证明的人吧。”

“忘掉的东西可以在那边申请补发。你们去那边看看吧。”

en:
We turn into a corner and come across a rather crudely drawn poster.

Written on the poster is a brief introduction next to a small note with directions.

'Running low on time, but burning full of frustration? Then come join the Yurodiviye.

Are you content with letting the inequity walk all over you?

Or would you rather live for its destruction?

Desire it, desire it hard!

Take this poster, let it be your train ticket.

At the ■■■ alley, face the ■■ road and walk at a speed of 120km per day. Alone.'
cn:
某条小巷中，贴着一幅画得相当粗糙的海报。

海报上写着简短的介绍文字，以及前往某处地点的指南。

“没有时间，只剩不满的你，来加入圣愚吧。

你是愿意忍气吞声、接受不合理之事而活，

还是愿意粉碎不合理之事而活？

只要诚心所愿，恳切所求，便有可能实现。

如果你愿意加入我们，就撕下这张海报，当作火车票。

从XXX巷，往XX度方向，以时速120公里，独自前来吧。”

en:
A desperate voice echoes from afar.

"Join us. Let's tear down the inequities, together."

Another voice speaks.

"We're saving time from their poor, miserable deaths. This is a holy deed."

Another voice speaks excitedly.

"Join us, mate. Become one of the phantom thieves. Know them blokes, right? The gentleman thieves, the thieves who serve justice... Hm, or are we more like muggers of justice?"

... Maybe we can use this as an opportunity to trick them.
cn:
远处传来了恳切的声音。

“你也来成为我们的一员吧。让我们一起粉碎这等不合理之事。”

另一个声音接着说了下去。

“这可是拯救濒死的可怜时间之工作，是圣行啊。”

又另一个声音兴奋地说。

“来当怪盗吧。怪盗，你懂的吧？就是那种正义的盗贼啊。不，或者说是强盗？”

……如果趁此机会骗一下他们，也不知好不好。

en:
Long eaves of the tile-roofing cast an impenetrable umbra. Beneath it stands a figure, submerged in the shadow, leaning against the wall.

They regard us in momentary silence before muttering in a low voice a question.

"Are you... prepared to yield your flesh, if it meant cleaving into your enemy's bones?"
"Take this blade, if you carry such determination."

Even at a glance, there's something about the sword in the figure's outstretched hand that gives off a disturbing air.
cn:
瓦檐之下，浓重的黑暗中，有人倚墙而立。

那人默默注视着我和罪人们，随后以低沉的嗓音抛出了一个问题。

“你们……能为了削去敌人之骨，而奉上自身之肉吗？”
“若已做好觉悟，便取走此刀。”

仅一眼就能看出，那柄递出的刀透着不祥之气。

en: Behind an old billboard that's seen better days stands a vending machine emblazoned with a half-faded T Corp. logo. The machine is tall, with dozens of thin clock hands ticking and turning down its cylindrical body; there's a promotional tagline written beneath it. "Stop borrowing time!" "Pre-pay with your disposable time, and buy time without delay when in a pinch!" There's a small slot next to the machine for users to insert their hands. Wait, underneath the slot—there are warnings written in nigh-illegibly small font. "Upon use of this device, with the proviso that the user makes a payment of a sum of temporal resource, the user will be imposed a temporary time shortage open parenthesis for the purposes of this agreement, the "temporary time shortage" mentioned will be predicated on the T Corp. Variable Time Scale; however, any sum of a day or greater will be measured based on the A Corp.
