Standard Time Scale close parenthesis; received time prepayment will automatically be deposited and amassed within the ancillary accumulation device within the machine and will be prepared for provision to the user upon circumstances in which they make a withdrawal request via undertaking a series of procedures or the fulfillment of refund conditions stipulated in the manual thereof, by summation of the user's total per-day hours and the extrapolated acceleration rate subsidies calculated by a distinct formula; the precise period, order, and limitations in reflecting these changes to the user's account balance is determined by the device's terms of service as described—" "V-very well. The full extent of this multiloquous writing needn't be recited in full." "Hang on, ain't this one of them things the Collectors wear on their arms?"
cn:
在破旧的广告牌后方，可以看到一台T公司标志已经剥落一半的自动贩卖机。

在细长的指针层层交错旋转的圆筒形机体下方，刻着宣传标语。

“别再借用时间了！”
“请预付不必要的时间，以在关键时刻使用！”

装置旁边有一个可以伸手进去的小槽口。
下面用难以辨认的小字写着注意事项。

<上面写了什么？>
“本装置以使用者在使用本装置前，预先支付特定时间资源的行为为前提，会对使用者造成暂时性时间下降，左括号，上述时间下降以T公司的浮动时间为基准计算，一天或以日为单位的范围将依据A公司的标准时间来计算，右括号，所回收的预付时间将自动储存于本装置内部的辅助积存模块中，并仅在使用者日后依照规定流程提出返还申请，或经确认满足使用手册所列返还条件时，将以依据另行计算公式得出的加速率加算至使用者每日时间总量的形式返还。具体的返还时间点、适用顺序与限制条件，依照本装置的运营规章……”

“够、够了，不继续读也无妨。”

“这不就是那帮叫什么征收人员的家伙总戴在胳膊上的那个玩意儿吗？”

en: We see an old voice recorder with a faded label. The "Play" button is smooth and worn from use—as though someone pressed it hundreds of times.
cn:
破旧的录音机上贴着一张褪色的标签。

《脑叶公司 ■■支部 生还者面谈记录》

播放键仿佛被人反复按了上百次，磨损得异常严重。

en:
We come across two bizarre lifeforms standing on either side of a table set with an old roulette wheel.

"Care you test your luck? A prize awaits those who have fortune's favor."
"Lose. No prize. Leave if don't want."

The old roulette wheel they point at is inscribed with strange symbols.

We cannot make sense of the symbols, but something about them keeps drawing our gaze.

What should we do?
cn:
在放着陈旧轮盘的桌子旁，站着两个奇异的生命体。

“要转转看吗？中奖的话会有奖金。”
“要是没中。就没有奖金。不想玩的话。就走开。”

它们指着的旧轮盘上，刻着陌生的图样。

虽然我们无法理解这些图样的意思，但目光总是不由自主地被其吸引。

该如何抉择？

en:
"Another spin, perhaps? Double the prize this time."
"Leave. If. Don't. Want."
cn:
“要再转一次吗？奖金翻倍哦。”
“不想玩的话。就走开。”

en:
"How about one last game?"
"Remember. Always. In moderation."
cn:
“要不要来最后一局？”
“差不多得了。知足吧。”

en:
'Eunbong's Bar & Fryers!'
'Dial 555-0102-0386-2664! That's 555-0102-Zero-EUN-BONG!'

We followed the weird, catchy jingle and found ourselves standing before an oddly familiar machine.

"Hey, that's a claw machine. It's got... Huh, these are..."
<... Why are there Bongy plushies here?>
"Didn't that guy say something about how the one he gave us was an invaluable, one-of-a-kind treasure? That there's nothing else like it?"
"... Such promise carries very little weight in the Mirror Dungeon."
"Mm. It may be an idiosyncrasy of the experience that is yet to be identified."
"Guys, hold on. Look at that plush there—I just saw a golden twinkle through its seams! There's gotta be money in these things!

There are Bongy plushies of various design inside the claw machine.
Which one should we go for?
cn:
“银凤炸鸡酒吧！”
“1588~银凤银凤！1588~银凤银凤！”

顺着奇怪的广告音乐声走去，发现了一台莫名眼熟的机器孤零零地摆在那里。

“这是台抓娃娃机。不过里面的玩偶是……”
<……这不是小凤吗？>
“可是那家伙不是说他给我们的是店里的无价之宝，再也找不出第二个来了吗？”
“……在镜像迷宫里，这种常识基本上是毫无意义的。”
“嗯。可能是未确认的特性。”
“等等。看到那边那个玩偶缝线的缝隙了吗？里面有金光，肯定装着值钱的东西！”

机器里能看到各种各样的小凤玩偶。
要以哪一个为目标呢？

en:
"Um, excuse me..."

As we were slowly looking around the streets of S Corp., a youth, after fidgeting and hesitating for a moment, walked up to us and asked for help.

The youth explained that, wishing to better his own status, he took the Royal Examination—akin to a public employment policy in S Corp.—and was able to attain a high grade for himself.

And that was where his problems began; as far as he knew, people who passed the exam with flying colors like himself had their travel expenses paid for the homeward trip and were to be granted a guide. But there must've been a misunderstanding or something, because when he left the exam grounds, no one was there to escort him.

Confused by the unexpected turn of events, he wandered away from the exam grounds in search of his escort, lost his bearings, and found himself in these alleys.

He's asking if we could help him with directions... What should we do?
cn:
“那个，恕我冒昧……”

在S公司的巷子四处走动的途中，一名青年战战兢兢地询问我们能否帮他一下。

听他讲述后得知，他怀有立身扬名的志向，参加了S公司的公开科举考试，并取得了好成绩。

但按理说，以好成绩及第的人会被提供返家的旅费和引路人，可不知哪里出了问题，没有任何人来接他，于是迷了路，一路走到这里来了。

他问能否告诉他附近的路，该怎么办才好呢？

en: Navigating our way through the streets of S Corp., we come across a young man hugging a blade, his gaze wandering blankly toward the sky. "... Ah." He seemed to have caught us staring—he turned his head toward us, gave us a once-over, then slumped back where he sat. "Pass on by, folks. I have no intent of bringing you harm." His voice was familiar... but I couldn't quite place my finger on it. "Search not for a revelation in the clouds drifting by, for they hold no answers." Kim blurted out of the blue as we were about to walk past the sword-hugging man. Oh, then that man must be... "... Do you know me?" "Must I know you to impart some unsolicited advice? A meddler in me simply cannot help himself when walking past a disadvantageous game of baduk." The man widened his eyes in brief surprise, then began in a contemplative voice. "You are a player of greater dan than I—that I can tell; so if you will, permit me to solicit some advice." "Shamed I am of my past plays, for they were dishonorable and deserving of ridicule; thus I had begun to wonder if I would be of better use should I become a blade for hire..." "Then, a man of incorruptible integrity, a just soul, sought me out and asked me that I serve as his blade. Yet, I worry that my filth may befoul his hands, too." "What say you? Would you say that I take this opportunity and make this play? Or..."
cn:
怀揣着剑的人随意地坐在路边，呆呆地望着天空。

“……啊。”

似乎察觉到了我们，他扫了一眼我们的打扮后，又重新瘫坐在原处。

“过去吧。我无意加害诸位。”

虽然有些不同，但总觉得在哪里听过他的声音……

“光是看着云的流动，可得不出答案啊。”

金笠这时突然对他说道。
……啊，那么那个人就是……

“……阁下认识我？”
“非得认识才能指点吗？路过棋盘旁边时，总会想说些什么的。”

那人夸张地睁大了眼睛，随即说起话来。

“至少阁下看起来比我段位高些，所以想请教一句。”
“回头看去，我下过的那一手又脏又羞耻，于是想在尘土中以刀剑为生。”
“一位清廉重义之人想捡起我，让我作为兵刃，我却担心会弄脏那位的手。”
“如何，阁下会下这一手吗？还是……”

en:
I catch a glimpse of a figure, staring off into the darkness of the unlit prison.

"Hah..."

Bamboo-hatted Kim lets out a sigh, but before he even fully exhales...

"Who goes there?!"

A sharp cry cuts through the stagnant air. Someone here must've noticed us.

What should we do?
cn:
在昏暗的牢狱中，有个人失魂落魄地坐着。

“哈……”

还没等金笠叹出的气息完全散开……

“什么人！”

尖锐的声音贯穿了那个空间。看来是被守狱之人发现了。

该怎么办才好呢？

en: "Are you not here to visit him as well? Might you be those who share his purpose?"
cn: “诸位也是来见那家伙的吗？是意图一致的人吗？”

en:
"What do you wish for?"

The Sign asks the sinners.

"A rose can bloom only when you clearly wish for something."

"The heavier your sins, the deeper the color of petals will be.

"See? Wish, wish for it. Knowing that it is a sin. Only then can you bloom such colorful roses."

"You have to bloom the roses. You want to escape this garden, don't you?"

"Let us... let me help you."

"Our only wish is that our garden will bloom full of flowers."

"Now, what will you do?"
cn:
“你的愿望是什么？”

注意到时，告示牌正在向罪人们搭话。

“如果你清楚自己内心的愿望，那花便会绽放。”

“罪孽愈是深厚，花儿愈是鲜艳。”

“明白了？明知是罪孽却依旧心怀愿望，而玫瑰会因那份心愿绽放。姹紫嫣红，满园芬芳。”

“玫瑰必须绽开。想要离开庭院吗？”

“我们，我会帮忙。”

“我们仅仅是期盼着庭院中鲜花盛放。”

“而你，想怎么做？”

en: You feel its inquisitive, intense gaze.
cn: 能感受到似乎想传达什么的强烈视线。

en: The intense gaze had transformed into a gaze of different sensations.
cn: 强烈的视线不知不觉间转变成了别样的凝视。

en:
An empty banquet hall, wreathed in ambient crimson light.

The solitary king, bound to his throne, raises his arm in an unhurried motion.

Your feet grow drenched in the cold mist of a vague tune.

The lone king gently points to a platform near you with an inviting cadence.

On it are masks, each depicting different spectrum of emotions.

There is a mask of joy. A mask of sorrow. A mask of wrath.

What face shall be worn in this audience with the king?
cn:
空荡的宴会厅，浸在血红色的灯光里。

大厅中央，独自受缚于王座上的王，缓缓抬起手臂。

冷雾一般的旋律浸透了你的脚踝。

仿佛是在邀请我们，孤独的王轻轻指向不远处的台面。

假面置于其上，各有不尽相同的表情。

一个假面无比喜悦，一个假面无比哀伤，一个假面无比愤怒。

我们该以何种表情来面对王呢？

en:
Passion grows hotter as the banquet slowly reaches a crescendo.

The King in Binds motions for the battle to pause.

This gives us enough time to leave our broken masks and don new ones for ourselves.

What new face shall we wear in audience of the king?
cn:
宴会渐入佳境、步入高潮。

缚王抬手示意，令战斗停歇。

由此一来，我们就有时间用新的假面将破损的假面换下。

我们该以何种新的表情来面对王呢？

en:
The great skull rears its head with a loud creaking noise; an eerie cackle echoes.

Underneath the calmed air vibrates an explosive energy; the skull is preparing to launch a powerful attack.

Yet it must have overstrained itself;

the body cracks and wavers, giving us an opening.

It might be better to attack the opening on its body instead of waiting for it to attack us.

What should we do?
cn:
巨大的骸骨慢慢地抬起头，嘎吱的噪音与诡异的笑声充满了这个空间。

沉闷的空气中涌动着一触即发的气息，骸骨正准备进行强力的攻击。

但也许是因为反作用力？

躯干出现了裂缝，摇晃着露出了缝隙。

与其一味等待，还不如趁机攻击躯干上的缝隙。

该如何抉择？

en:
The rose guzzles up the flood of blood, glistening in crimson.

But even this inundation of blood wasn't enough.

Its glossy eyes glowers at the Sinner from between the petals.
cn:
玫瑰贪婪地饮用着流淌的鲜血，炫耀着那抹鲜红。

可即便饮下如此多的鲜血，它仍不满足吗？

发亮的眼睛在花瓣间闪烁，凝视着罪人们。

en:
Something glowing yellow hurriedly steps in front of us, blocking our path.

"Would you mind stopping for a moment, please?"

"You see... there's a rather fussy child playing with her friends up ahead."

"Keeping the child entertained for as long as she wants is a tall order, so I've been waiting here to lend a helping hand."

"Tell me, which assistance would you like?"<size=0%>
cn:
某个泛着黄色光芒的东西，慌忙地挡在了我们面前。

“能请您稍等片刻吗？”

“其实……前面有个任性的孩子在和朋友们玩耍。”

“要陪那孩子一直玩到她满意实在不容易，所以我才在这里等着帮助你们。”

“那么您需要怎样的帮助呢？”<size=0%>

en:
Something glowing yellow is waiting for us.

"Hello. It's been quite a while."

"There's a child waiting all alone up ahead, unable to arrive at the story's ending."

"I've been waiting here to lend a helping hand to anyone who would show the child what it means to end."

"Tell me, which assistance would you like?"<size=0%>
cn:
某个泛着黄色光芒的东西在等着我们。

“好久不见。”

“前面有个未能抵达结局的孩子，正独自等待着。”

“为了使那孩子知晓结局，似乎需要我的帮助，所以我才在这里一直等着。”

“那么您需要怎样的帮助呢？”<size=0%>

en:
The final stop.

A wayfarer tinged in the glow of the sunset approaches us.

"It would seem there is no need to say much."

"Make yourself comfortable and rest awhile. Of course, feel free to leave now if you're in a hurry."<size=0%>
cn:
终点站。

一位沐浴着晚霞余晖的旅人向我们走来。

“我想已经无需多言了！”

“请好好休息吧。如果您很忙，提前离开也没关系。”<size=0%>

en:
We managed to peel off the strands of red thread wrapped around the Abnormality.

How should we proceed?<size=0%>
cn:
成功解开了缠绕在异想体身上的赤红丝线。

该如何抉择？<size=0%>

en:
"It's us Kurokumo Clan's turf from here on out."

"Is it that hard for you to understand that you gotta pay the toll to use our road? Huh?"

People dressed in Kurokumo Clan garb stand in the way of unarmed civilians, threatening them.

"... I suppose that excuse was enough for them to tread on our territory as well."

Aeng-du does not hide her indignation. She is gritting her teeth.

What should we do about them?
cn:
“这里现在是黑云会管辖的地盘。”

“想过去就给我付过路费！”

手无寸铁的居民们被像是黑云会一样的人堵在路边威胁。

“……他们一有借口，就会像现在一样来我们的地区闹事。”

樱桃咬紧牙关，毫不掩饰心中怒意。

该怎么处理他们？

en:
"Thank you, thank you so much..."

The civilians, freed from the threat of the Kurokumo Clan, each bow and give us their thanks.

"But... You're not dressed like a local."

"If you don't mind us prying... who might you be?"
cn:
“哎呀，感激不尽……”

从黑云会的暴行下脱身的居民们，纷纷低头表示感谢。

“说起来……各位穿着罕见的装扮……”

“如果可以的话，各位方便透露身份吗？”

en:
"This must be a tavern..."

This bar or an inn is bustling, and its patrons are energetically chattering away. They all seem to be in a rather good mood.

A trio among the crowd is quite boisterously arguing and pointing fingers at each other.

"No, NO! I don't understand why this is even a matter of dispute! A blade is a weapon made for cutting, and the 'right' way to use a blade is to slash with it."

"You don't know what you're talking about! Stab a single point with all your might, and your foe shall surely fall!"

"... You're both wrong. Your half-hearted cuts and stabs won't do anything but piss 'em off. They'll be back on their feet immediately!"

"Smack their skulls with the blunt end—hilt or the scabbard, and knock them down for good! Make 'em too dazed to get up!"

The trio appeared to be talking about something pretty serious, so we'd stopped to listen to their debate...

They suddenly turned in our direction and called over to us.

"You there! Your band can clearly handle your weapons, am I wrong?"

"Answer us. What is the best way to wield your sword?"

"Of course, to slash is the best way to use a blade, is it not?"

What should I say to that?
cn:
“这里是酒幕吗……”

在貌似是酒馆的空间中，人们兴高采烈地喧闹着。

在那之中，有几人高声争论着什么。

“错了，错了！一直以来剑都是用来斩断其他事物的！劈斩才是正确的剑法。”

“你说什么呢！如果能将力量集中于一点，一口气刺入，不就能一击必杀了吗！”

“……你们说的都不对。耍出半吊子的劈斩和刺击，只会给敌人留下再起的余地。”

“直接用刀柄或者刀鞘往脑袋上敲，他们不就会头昏脑胀、起不来了嘛！”

他们似乎在争论某些深奥的事情，我们只是稍稍驻足听了一会儿……

他们看到我们，就朝我们搭话了。

“你们！一眼看上去就知道你们是武者！”

“回答我。最优秀的剑法是什么！”

“斩击当然是最棒的吧？”

该如何回答？

en:
"This is odd... this mist is..."

I don't know when it happened, but a thick layer of mist had descended all around us.

"I have heard a tale of one such nightly stroll. In this tale, a clueless traveler heedlessly wanders into a brumous haze, and finds himself afore an otherworldly being—"

"AAAGH! Stop, stop it!"

Just as the Sinners began loudly bickering with each other, I realized that there was something hazy standing in our way.

"Is that thing... dancing?"

A mysterious thing, dressed in white, danced gracefully before us with a large blade in hand.

When it met my gaze... or, when I thought it did...

... a sheathed blade had materialized in my hand.

What does it want me to do with it?
cn:
“有什么不对劲……是雾吗……”

不知何时，我们被雾包围了。

“我曾听闻。在夜间小道上，如果向浓雾处走去，将会遇见不属于人世的……”

“哇啊！别说了，住口！”

罪人们骚动不安时，某种朦胧的东西出现在我们面前。

“那是在……跳舞吗？”

穿着未知白色服饰的那东西，拿着一把大剑翩翩起舞。

而与它目光相对的那瞬间……

我手中不知何时握住了被收入老旧剑鞘中的剑。

是想让我们做什么吗？

en:
We hear a pair of voices as we walk alongside a stone fence. The two travelers are both carrying blades.

"I pity the people here..."

"Well, the decision of a Wing is absolute for its feathers. There is very little they can do about it."

One of them stands out—their clothing sets them apart from the locals. Maybe they're not from around here.

"Still, to allow the Kurokumo Clan to make their way in here? That's too much."

"The Wing cares about naught else but fluttering its wings. All else becomes insignificant."

Sounds like they're talking about the current S Corp.

"More outsiders, I see. How convenient."

The pair stops in their tracks, then turns around to face us.

"The Kurokumo Clan... no. You do not wear their garb. You don't appear to be peasants seeking to make some cash in the chaos of the Backstreets, either..."

"Well, then. What do you outsiders think of the current climate?"

How should I answer this?
cn:
我们沿着石墙行走，偶然间听见两位身带佩剑的行人的对话。

“这儿的人也真可怜啊……”

“唉，翼一声令下，他们区区翼中之羽又能做到什么呢。”

其中一位外貌略有不同，也许是外地人。

“但是我觉得黑云会那些人这样大张旗鼓地进攻进来，也太过火了吧。”

“就算不在乎这些小事，翼也忙着拍打翅膀呢。”

似乎是在说现在的S公司。

“正好外来者也变多了。”

不知何时向前行走的那两人停下脚步，看向我们。

“黑云会……看上去不像。也不像是想趁着后巷混乱大赚一笔的平民。”

“那么，你又如何看待最近的形势呢？”

该如何回答？

en:
Shimmering blue letters float before you.

The way that these similar words are ordered makes it difficult to understand what it's trying to say.

To say what is right is right and what is wrong is wrong is not right,

but that is not to say that to say what is wrong is right and right is wrong is wrong.

To say that what is wrong is right and right is wrong is not wrong,

and to say that what is right is right and what is wrong is wrong is, in turn, to say that this wrong is right.

... Does it want my impression of these words?

What is it talking about?
cn:
眼前漂浮着闪闪发光的青色文字。

那些文字是由相似的词汇罗列而成，令人难以理解。

“是是非非非是是，”

“是非非非是非是。”

“是非非是是非非，”

“是是非非是是非。”

……需要对这些话做出回应吗？

是什么意思呢。

en: "Is this a tavern?" We walk into what seems to be a bar of sorts, its guests rowdily drinking and chatting about in groups. We find a seat to relax, but another group that was sitting nearby approaches us. "What's going on here? I haven't seen your faces around here before..." "This is a good day, boys—let this one slide. Don't stir up unnecessary trouble." "Yes, dame! Of course, dame!" That's when we realize that they're all carrying swords with them. Swords engraved with elaborate cloud patterns. "Did you hear about that new Syndicate that sprang up today?" "Ah, the... the group that primarily uses spears, right...?" "Dumbasses. Swords are the most superior form of weaponry there is, the apex of arms. And they use spears instead? "Let's all be completely honest here, guys. Sure, we're a Thumb subsidiary, but there's just something badass about a sword, huh? Way cooler than fists or guns." "Good thing we have these fine people here to give us a most fair assessment on the superiority of swords. We feel their gaze simultaneously turning to look at us.
cn:
“这里是居酒屋吗？”

在貌似是酒馆的空间中，人们兴高采烈地喧闹着。

我们自然地找了一个空位坐下休息，但坐在附近的人却过来向我们搭话。

“搞什么。没见过的脸啊？”

“今天是个好日子，坐吧。就算有什么让人不爽的，今天也都一概原谅。”

“是！明白了，大姐！”

周围的人都佩着刀。

刀上雕有宛如波浪般流动的奇异的云纹。

“你看到最近新成立的帮派了吗？”

“啊，那个……以长矛为主要武器的……”

“放着最棒的武器刀不用，竟然去用那玩意儿。”

“老实说，虽然我们属于拇指麾下，但比起拳头和枪，还是刀更帅吧。”

“正好这里有能公正看待事情的人呢。”

视线转向了我和罪人们。

en:
Walking along the stone brick wall, we hear a pair of voices conversing.

"I understand that you've been having some trouble as of late."

"We would not have had any troubles with the tributes if those Blade Lineage bastards had not suddenly appeared in our turf, sir..."

The outfit of one of the pair stands out.

I can hear some of the Sinners recognizing it as the uniform of the Thumb.

"First, exact the appropriate punishment for breaking into your turf..."

"Of course, sir."

"But don't forget to show the right respect for those who deserve it. Am I understood?"

"Wait. Who's there? Is it the Blade Lineage...? Hm, doesn't seem like it."

Noticing our presence, the pair turns around to face us.

"Hm. Why don't we ask for their opinion as well, now that they're here?"

"You there. What are your thoughts on the Kurokumo Clan's current status?"

"Better choose your words carefully."
cn:
我们沿着石墙行走，听到了两人的对话声。

“你们也辛苦了。”

“如果不是突然出现的剑契组成员，奉纳金的筹备本来不成问题……”

有一个人的服装与其他人不同。

我听到了几名罪人的窃窃私语，说那是拇指的制服。

“首先，必须惩戒那些侵入你们地盘的人……”

“那是当然。”

“但要礼貌对待那些应当尊重的人。明白了吗？”

“等等，你们是谁？剑契组的家伙……看起来不像。”

走在前面的两个人似乎是察觉到了这边的动静，回过头来。

“嗯。既然这样，不妨也问问他们的想法吧。”

“那边的。你们怎么看黑云会当前的形势？”

“你们最好给我认真回答。”

en:
We find a vending machine at the entrance of the Dungeon of the Fathoms.

We see rows of buttons on the vending machine.

What should we do?
cn:
心象迷宫的入口设有一台自动贩卖机。

自动贩卖机上排列着许多按钮。

该如何抉择？

en:
We come upon a familiar rest stop.

The glass door is locked, with a notice attached to it.

'We are closed today due to personal reasons. We apologize for the inconvenience.'

'However, our fusion device is available for use. Customers requiring fusion service are kindly asked to use the device beside the entrance.'

What should we do?
cn:
熟悉的休息区。

玻璃门是锁着的，上面贴着什么东西。

“非常抱歉。由于店长的个人原因，本日暂停营业。”

“合成装置仍可使用，请有需要的顾客自由使用入口旁边的装置，非常感谢！”

该如何抉择？

en:
"What plagues your mind, manager? Your suppression efforts seem to be smooth-sailing."

"Mm. It is exactly as you have seen, manager, save for a few parts that were censored. I concealed nothing from your view."

"I don't believe I have committed any wrong by escaping that place alone, leaving the others to be buried there."

"Ah, of course. It may be reprehensible from a moral standpoint. But why would anyone ever look at it from that perspective, manager?"

"Especially when you are well aware that, in the City, such a perspective is entirely irrelevant and worthless."

I can feel his gaze on me.

Like he said, the suppression is going well. But this feels wrong—that it shouldn't end like this.

What should I tell him?

What is Hohenheim trying to hide from us?
cn:
“镇压进行得相当顺利，但是是有什么让你在意的事情吗？”

“嗯。经理，你看到的就是实际情况。虽然经过了一些审查，但没有隐瞒什么就展示给你看了。”

“我并不认为抛下员工们，独自逃离是错误的。”

“啊，当然，我知道在伦理上这可能是错误的。但是经理，你也知道的吧？”

“在这都市中，这种观点是多么地空虚和无用啊。”

感受到了霍恩海姆的目光。

正如他所说，镇压进行得很顺利。但我有种直觉，事情不会就这样结束。

该说些什么呢。

霍恩海姆，究竟对我们隐瞒了什么呢。

en:
"It seems that there is something else you would like to tell me."

"Very well, you may go ahead and ask. I am prepared to answer any of your questions."

I can feel Hohenheim's gaze lingering on me.

What should I say this time?

What is Hohenheim trying to hide from us?
cn:
“你好像还有什么话想说。”

“说说吧。无论你想问什么，我都做好了回答的准备。”

我感受到了来自霍恩海姆的视线。

这次要说什么呢。

霍恩海姆，他想向我们隐藏什么呢。

en:
"I feel as though I have given you quite a few replies... But there is simply so much curiosity in your ticking noises."

"Perhaps you have some aptitude to be a researcher as well, aside from that of a manager."

"Yet... not all questions can be answered. This will be the last answer I provide you."

I can feel his gaze on me.

Let's ask him the final question.
cn:
“虽然已经回答了很多问题……但是你钟表滴答声中的好奇心似乎仍未消退啊。”

“能看出不仅是经理，作为研究者的资质似乎也不错。”

“但是……疑问并非总能得到答案的。这会是最后的回答了吧。”

能感受到霍恩海姆的目光。

最后一次向他搭话吧。

en:
We emerged into a dark and muggy cavern, filled with air so stale it almost felt stifling.

Up ahead, a thin ray of light shone through the darkness, seemingly guiding our path. Following the light led us to a four-way fork in the road.

A constant, powerful gust howled through one of the paths. Another was filled with a metallic tang—the smell of blood. Then, there was a path that was entirely silent, and the last one echoed with the harsh noise of sword striking against sword.

Which path should we choose?
cn:
进入里面后，出现了一个充斥着刺鼻而憋闷的空气的黑暗洞窟。

在那深处能看到一束细微的光，沿着那光向前走去时，看见了分成四岔的通道。

有强风呼啸的通道、飘散着血腥味的通道、只是寂静无声的通道、传来刀刃相碰声的通道。

走哪条路好呢？

en:
"Um, excuse me..."

As we were slowly looking around the streets of S Corp., a youth, after fidgeting and hesitating for a moment, walked up to us and asked for help.

The youth explained that, wishing to better his own status, he took the Royal Examination—akin to a public employment policy in S Corp.—and was able to attain a high grade for himself.

And that was where his problems began; as far as he knew, people who passed the exam with flying colors like himself had their travel expenses paid for the homeward trip and were to be granted a guide. But there must've been a misunderstanding or something, because when he left the exam grounds, no one was there to escort him.

Confused by the unexpected turn of events, he wandered away from the exam grounds in search of his escort, lost his bearings, and found himself in these alleys.

He's asking if we could help him with directions... What should we do?
cn:
“那个，恕我冒昧……”

在S公司的巷子四处走动的途中，一名青年战战兢兢地询问我们能否帮他一下。

听他讲述后得知，他怀有立身扬名的志向，参加了S公司的公开科举考试，并取得了好成绩。

但按理说，以好成绩及第的人会被提供返家的旅费和引路人，可不知哪里出了问题，没有任何人来接他，于是迷了路，一路走到这里来了。

他问能否告诉他附近的路，该怎么办才好呢？

en: Navigating our way through the streets of S Corp., we come across a young man hugging a blade, his gaze wandering blankly toward the sky. "... Ah." He seemed to have caught us staring—he turned his head toward us, gave us a once-over, then slumped back where he sat. "Pass on by, folks. I have no intent of bringing you harm." His voice was familiar... but I couldn't quite place my finger on it. "Search not for a revelation in the clouds drifting by, for they hold no answers." Kim blurted out of the blue as we were about to walk past the sword-hugging man. Oh, then that man must be... "... Do you know me?" "Must I know you to impart some unsolicited advice? A meddler in me simply cannot help himself when walking past a disadvantageous game of baduk." The man widened his eyes in brief surprise, then began in a contemplative voice. "You are a player of greater dan than I—that I can tell; so if you will, permit me to solicit some advice." "Shamed I am of my past plays, for they were dishonorable and deserving of ridicule; thus I had begun to wonder if I would be of better use should I become a blade for hire..." "Then, a man of incorruptible integrity, a just soul, sought me out and asked me that I serve as his blade. Yet, I worry that my filth may befoul his hands, too." "What say you? Would you say that I take this opportunity and make this play? Or..."
cn:
怀揣着剑的人随意地坐在路边，呆呆地望着天空。

“……啊。”

似乎察觉到了我们，他扫了一眼我们的打扮后，又重新瘫坐在原处。

“过去吧。我无意加害诸位。”

虽然有些不同，但总觉得在哪里听过他的声音……

“光是看着云的流动，可得不出答案啊。”

金笠这时突然对他说道。
……啊，那么那个人就是……

“……阁下认识我？”
“非得认识才能指点吗？路过棋盘旁边时，总会想说些什么的。”

那人夸张地睁大了眼睛，随即说起话来。

“至少阁下看起来比我段位高些，所以想请教一句。”
“回头看去，我下过的那一手又脏又羞耻，于是想在尘土中以刀剑为生。”
“一位清廉重义之人想捡起我，让我作为兵刃，我却担心会弄脏那位的手。”
“如何，阁下会下这一手吗？还是……”

en:
I catch a glimpse of a figure, staring off into the darkness of the unlit prison.

"Hah..."

Bamboo-hatted Kim lets out a sigh, but before he even fully exhales...

"Who goes there?!"

A sharp cry cuts through the stagnant air. Someone here must've noticed us.

What should we do?
cn:
在昏暗的牢狱中，有个人失魂落魄地坐着。

“哈……”

还没等金笠叹出的气息完全散开……

“什么人！”

尖锐的声音贯穿了那个空间。看来是被守狱之人发现了。

该怎么办才好呢？

en: "Are you not here to visit him as well? Might you be those who share his purpose?"
cn: “诸位也是来见那家伙的吗？是意图一致的人吗？”

en:
Someone carrying a sword on his belt and a sack on his shoulder leaped into a haystack near us.

A few moments later, a small squad of Ch'unokkuns, torches in hand, rushed in from the same direction the man had come from.

"We saw a criminal who has coveted the Kingdom's properties flee in this direction. Speak up if you have seen the wretch!"

The Ch'unokkuns began walking up to the civilians and questioning them about the criminal's whereabouts. Despite all having seen the man jump into the haystack, all of them shake their heads and refuse to give up the criminal.

Are they hiding him for some reason?

Soon, the Ch'unokkuns, having made their way through the crowd, approached us as well.

What should we do?
cn:
在人来人往的集市上，一个腰间佩着剑，背上背着袋子的人跑了过来，匆忙躲进了干草堆里。

过了片刻，沿着那人来时的方向，推奴人们举着火把成群地跑了过来。

“贪图国家财物的家伙逃到这里来了！有没有谁看到过！”

他们抓住每个路过的行人这样询问，明明大家都看见那人躲进了干草堆，却没人说出来。

是故意替他隐瞒吗？

不久之后，推奴人们也走到了我们面前。

该怎么办？

en:
A man with a sword hanging from his belt was wrestling an old woman, trying to take the bags she was carrying.

It soon became clear from their arguments that the old woman was the man's mother.

Though it seemed that the old woman was trying to reprimand her son, he responded by manhandling her and refused to let go of her bags.

"Should we do naught and watch, that man will surely injure the old woman...!"

Should we get involved?
cn:
一个腰间佩着剑的男人，正想从一位老妇人手中粗暴地夺走她的行李。

仔细听了他们争执的内容……那位老妇人似乎是佩剑之人的母亲。

看样子她是想责备儿子，但他根本不听，只是一味粗暴地使劲。

“再这般袖手旁观下去，老人家会倒下的……！”

是否应该介入这件事？

en:
Perhaps the containment unit's security management has grown lax.
The Ardor Blossom Moth drifts languidly along the corridor, trailing a cluster of bright-red embers and flames in its wake.

Before long, the facility's announcement system erupts with warnings of a containment breach. Researchers come rushing down the hallway, scrambling to respond.

Should we step in and help the researchers suppress the Abnormality, or leave it to them and be on our way?
cn:
难道是收容单元的管理松懈了？
红焰蛾伴随着一团熊熊燃烧的赤色火焰，在走廊上缓缓飘动着。

走廊里很快便响起了异想体出逃的警报。研究员们慌忙地赶了过来。

要帮助他们镇压异想体吗？还是交给他们自己处理，加快脚步离开呢？

en:
A fluorescent, glowing hue of teal is dancing and rippling somewhere down the hallway.

An inexplicable impulse to walk toward the light takes hold of us.

Yet, seeing the researchers rush toward it as though drawn by an irresistible lure, it becomes clear that this is the doing of an Abnormality.

Should we force the researchers back and help suppress the Abnormality, or should we steer clear of whatever trap may lie ahead and move on?
cn:
不知从何处，闪烁着荧光色的摇曳光影。

一股无法抗拒的吸引力笼罩了我们，想要走向那片摇曳的光影。

然而看到那些如同被蛊惑一般冲上前去的研究员后，我们才察觉到，这是异想体的引诱。

要拦住他们并协助镇压？还是避开前方暗藏的陷阱继续前进？

en:
We can see the Shock Centipede beyond the glass of the containment unit.

"Ah, we're in the middle of studying how the Shock Centipede becomes effectively 'immortal' for a short while right before suppression."

"You see, our team's research paper focuses on discovering potential energy sources that allow for highly efficient charging gears."

"I trust you're all aware of the name of the E.G.O Gift extracted from this Abnormality?"

... What was it again?
cn:
透过收容单元的玻璃，可以看到电击蜈蚣。
“啊，我们正好在进行关于电击蜈蚣在即将被镇压前出现的不死现象的实验。”

“我们研究团队目前进行的主要课题，就是寻找能够提取高效的充电设备的源头。”

“你们应该很清楚吧？从这异想体中提取的E.G.O饰品的名称。”

……叫什么来着？

en:
"Let's see what it says... 'Entry Forbidden'...?"

We'd just passed the wall inscribed with messy, frantic letters when another door came into view.

The door was riddled with dents, as though something massive had repeatedly slammed into it with brutal force.

"At this point... think we could just force it open?"

"Nay, the current yet courses through it. It would be more prudent to open it by the rightful means and keep from inviting the consequences of crude handling."

A card reader panel is attached beside the battered door.

What should we do?
cn:
“这里……写的是禁止入内吗？”

走过刻着杂乱文字的墙壁之后，又看见了另一扇门。

那扇门像是被什么沉重的东西狠狠撞过一般，已经扭曲变形了。

“这样的话……感觉靠蛮力也可以打开？”

“不，电源还接通着。还是用正确方式打开比较稳妥，以免因为粗暴处理而惹出后患。”

扭曲变形的门边上，似乎有一个可以识别卡片的感应器。

该怎么办？

该怎么办？

en:
We're at the starting point of the Dungeon of the Fathoms.

We found ourselves in a room that appears to be a workshop of E.G.O gears.

'If you have scored below 100% synchronization rate in the aptitude test, take only a single E.G.O from here.'

An ominous warning sign greets us all, and the same words repeat ceaselessly from the speaker.

The Sinners all go to take a look, enticed by the sign telling us that we can pick up E.G.O gears here... but what we find there are E.G.O Gifts.

"Wha? These ain't E.G.O gears. These are... them gifts or something, right?"

"It appears that E.G.O are manifest here in the shape of E.G.O Gifts."

"Hm. Can't we just take them all?"

"This is a Dungeon of the Fathoms. As it differs from the usual Mirror Dungeons, it is highly advisable that its rules are followed.

What should we do?
cn:
心象迷宫的起点。

走进了一个可以领取E.G.O装备的，像是维修站的房间。

“根据适应性检查结果，若同化率低于100%，请仅携带一个E.G.O。”

与这个措辞严厉的警示牌一起的，还有扬声器中不断重复播放着的警告录音。

听到E.G.O这个词，罪人们都一起查看起来，但是那里有的是……E.G.O饰品。

“什么啊。不是E.G.O装备，而是那个什么饰品啊？”

“E.G.O似乎是作为饰品的形态投影了出来。”

“嗯。不能全部带走吗？”

“这里是心象迷宫。和一般的镜像迷宫不同，还是遵循这个心象的规则比较好吧。”

该如何抉择？

en:
We came across a group of researchers passionately poring over various documents.

They're having a debate about two subjects: emotions and flame.

"Regular flames don't seem to hurt the Abnormalities very much. So why does this work, I wonder...?"

"Perhaps a greater degree of wrathful emotions opens up the room for the fire's heat to touch Abnormalities and Distortions, both entities of the unknown."

They must've noticed us listening in to their conversation intently—one of them approaches us with a glint in their eyes.

"Are you the 'sample' who's agreed to this experiment?"

"If so, try this on."

In the researcher's hands was what looked like an ignition plug... or a testing machine of sorts.
cn:
这是个聚集了许多热情地进行资料调查的研究员的场所。

研究员们正在讨论有关情感和火焰的主题。

“普通的火焰无法对异想体造成很大伤害。可是，这个为什么……”

“随着愤怒情绪的增强，也许那份热量就能触及异想体和扭曲这样的未知存在吧。”

也许是因为我们在专心地听着这些内容，一位研究员眼睛发亮地朝我们走来。

“你们就是同意参加那个实验的样本吗？”

“如果是的话，请试着装备这个。”

研究员递来一个看起来既像是火花塞，又像是检测仪的东西。

en:
Several researchers are moving about busily in a hectic-looking laboratory.

Did something escape, or something?

As we stood there gawking at the mess, someone walked up to the Sinners.

"Get outta my way!"

"A-actually, you know what? Perfect timing."

"Eat this. C'mon, we don't have much time 'till the clinical trial report deadline!"
cn:
在一个忙碌的实验室里，研究员们正在匆忙地来回走动。

也许是什么东西出逃了吧。

正当我们呆呆地站在那里想着发生了什么事的时候，有人朝罪人们走了过来。

“别挡在那里，让开！”

“不、不对。让你们尝尝看也行吧。”

“快尝尝看吧！距离提交临床试验结果，只剩下几分钟了！”

en:
We see the Ardor Blossom Moth within the containment unit.

Small, crimson particles of flame surround it like an aura.

The flaming wings die out one moment, only to roar vigorously in the next.

An incessant attempt to set fire to everything around it.

"What a beautiful specimen, this Ardor Blossom Moth. Have you finished your observations?"

"We've been learning a lot about the Abnormality recently."

"There's still a lot of unknowns, but still."

"Speaking of which, here's a pop quiz. What E.G.O Gift can you get from the Ardor Blossom Moth?"
cn:
在收容单元里，可以看到红焰蛾。

在它周围，红色火焰像尘埃一样散布着。

翅膀时而突然熄灭，又很快重新燃烧起来……

不断地试图点燃接触到的周围一切事物。

“红焰蛾是一个很美丽的异想体哦。您的观察结束了吗？”

“我们在这里得到了很多关于红焰蛾的情报。”

“当然，未知的事情也还有很多。”

“说起来，您知道从红焰蛾那里能获得的E.G.O饰品的名字吗？”

en:
We see the Faelantern within the containment unit.

A cyan-hued fairy flutters toward the wiry, ancient branches of the tree and softly lands on one of them.

The branch seating the fairy sways, as though to entice us to get closer to them...

Bright, countless yellow eyes glimmer from the shadows beneath its roots.

"What a beautiful specimen, this Faelantern. Have you finished your observations?"

"We've been learning a lot about the Abnormality recently."

"There's still a lot of unknowns, but still."

"Speaking of which, here's a pop quiz. What E.G.O Gift can you get from the Faelantern?"
cn:
在收容单元里，可以看到精灵提灯。

一只带着蓝光的精灵，飞到了像枯树缠绕的枝条上。

精灵栖息的枝条，像是在诱惑着我们靠近一样摇晃着……

在与树根相接的地方，无数只鲜艳的黄色眼睛注视着我们。

“精灵提灯是一个很美丽的异想体哦。您的观察结束了吗？”

“我们在这里得到了很多关于精灵提灯的情报。”

“当然，未知的事情也还有很多。”

“说起来，您知道从精灵提灯那里能获得的E.G.O饰品的名字吗？”

en:
At the end of this hallway, a group of researchers is having a discussion in front of an unnaturally dark place.

Noticing our presence, their faces brighten up as they approach us.

"Please, will you investigate this area ahead for us?"

"We will help with the best of our abilities should you accept."
cn:
在长长的走廊，黑暗处的前方，研究员们正在交谈。

发现我们后，研究员们看起来很高兴地走了过来。

“你们。能帮忙调查前面的区域吗？”

“如果接受的话……我们会全力帮助的。”

en:
Several messy, frantic letters are carved into the wall with knives.

I can practically feel the sheer horror and desperation of their writers from the wild letters.

Upon close inspection, the deep marks tell a tale written in terror.

'They're swarming us the monsters I hear them their breathing they're going to kill us all'

'Save me please someone anyone save me I dont want to die please'

'Fear is what drives men to madness. The monsters are near, I can feel the rumble of their feet. They are coming…'

There are unfinished sentences written on the wall.

Death has carved deep marks between them.
cn:
墙壁上布满了用刀刻下的文字。

凌乱刻下的字迹，完整地展现出了刻下这些字的人的绝望。

走近仔细观察，可以看到恐惧的话语深深地刻入了划痕之中。

“怪物们正在逼近我能听到它们的呼吸声它们会杀了我们所有人”

“救救我救救我拜托谁来救救我我不想死”

“人们都陷入了恐惧之中。怪物们近在咫尺。恐怕很快就要……”

断断续续的，可以看到一些不完整的句子。

这些仿佛未能来得及写完就逃走的痕迹中，深深浸染着死亡的气息。

en:
In the midst of our battle against the nigh-endless Bloodbag horde...

<Hm...?>

... we came across an ominous object on the ground.

While it resembled the Bloodbags' weapons somewhat, there was enough to distinguish it from them.

"It's gotta be a powerful weapon, right?"

"It has got to be a rather dangerous weapon."

"Verily, 'tis an item most puzzling!"

Clearly, the Sinners are having a hard time coming to a consensus.

... Looks like it's up to me to decide whether we're picking that thing up or not.
cn:
在与无尽涌来的血袋的战斗中……

<嗯……？>

我们发现了一个不祥的物体掉落在地。

那东西与血袋持有的武器相似，却又有哪里不同。

“看来似乎很强？”

“看来此物凶险。”

“看来吾搞不清！”

罪人们众说纷纭。

……看来是否捡起并使用它，全凭我的选择了。

en:
W Corp. Agents who turned into Bloodbags made for higher difficulty enemies than the other Bloodbags aboard the train.

Once they were defeated, we found a strange-looking gear from the aftermath of the battle.

I'd seen a W Corp. Identity with that gauntlet before.

"This gear is gunked up with gore; it'll be difficult to use it as-is."

Looks like we'll have to go through considerable trouble to bring it back to working order...
cn:
由W公司员工所变成的血袋，比起列车上的其他血袋要难对付得多。

将他们击倒后，原地掉落了一件奇形怪状的装备。

看起来像是曾在W公司的人格中见过的，那副W公司的护手。

“血肉黏连在一起，这样恐怕不能直接使用。”

若要使用它，大概得花上一番功夫了……

en:
Looks like it's almost fully repaired.

But maybe risking an injury to a Sinner isn't worth the effort.
cn:
看起来马上就能修好了。

但是没必要冒险让罪人受多余的伤吧？

en:
This section seems to be rather crowded with passengers.

Among them, we notice a surprisingly calm and collected passenger.

"Come closer, won't you...?"

There was a bottle full of suspicious looking pills in his outstretched hands.

The passenger proceeds to explain that his present sanity is thanks to the pills in his possession.

"Woud you like to try some yourself?"
cn:
一处挤满了乘客的空间。

其中，有一位乘客显得格外冷静。

“请靠近一点看看吧……”

他手中握着一枚可疑的药丸。

他说，自己还能保持冷静，全都是托了这药丸的福。

“要不要试一试……？”

en:
"Lo! A lone warrior battles a horde of Bloodbags!"

The Sinners were looking at someone wearing a W Corp. uniform.

He seemed rather skilled, but the sheer number of Bloodbags were about to overwhelm him.

<We've got to help—>

But I am cut off by another horde of Bloodbags that poured into this cabin, surrounding us.

"Dammit... prepare for battle!"

"Y-yet what of the lone warrior?!"

"Well—"
cn:
“那边！有人在独自与血袋战斗！”

罪人们循声望去，一个身穿W公司制服的人影映入眼帘。

他看似身手不凡，但血袋的数量实在太多，眼看就要支撑不住。

<得去帮他……>

话音未落，其他注意到我们的血袋便蜂拥而至，将我们团团包围。

“啧……准备战斗！”

“可、可是那个人怎么办！”

“那就……”

en:
A ticket booth inside a WARP train platform.

In front of it is a long line of people trying to get their tickets.

As we were waiting in line, a passenger approached us. They're dressed like an employee of a Wing...

"'Scuse me, can I ask you folks something?"

"Verily! Ask away!"

"If it's gonna take just ten seconds to get there anyway... what's the real difference between first class and economy class seats?"

"I did make bank from this work trip, but... first class ticket's probably a waste of money, right?"

The Sinners all turn to look at me as the passenger waits for our reply.
cn:
WARP列车停靠站内的购票所。

很多人都在为了乘坐WARP列车而排队。

在等待的时候，一位看起来像是翼的员工的乘客来搭话了。

“可不可以问你一个问题？”

“随便问！”

“10秒就能抵达，那头等舱和经济舱有什么区别呢？”

“虽然这次出差赚了不少钱……应该没有必要为了坐头等舱而浪费吧？”

在等待中的乘客的问题下，罪人们齐刷刷地看向了我。

en: A first class ticket...? That's like... my two months' salary. Are you sure it's worth that much money?
cn: 头等舱……要花我两个月的工资……这值得吗？

en:
As we were waiting around on the platform, we happened across a Fixer equipped with various prosthetic parts.

A cool costume and four mechanical arms.

That was more than enough to draw the interest of a few Sinners. They all look at them intently.

Maybe the Fixer felt their gaze.

They turn around and look back in our direction.

"I noticed that you've been watching me for a while. What's up?"
cn:
在停靠站等待的过程中遇到了义体收尾人。

时尚的服装和四只机械臂。

罪人中有几人带着好奇的目光看向了义体收尾人。

或许是感觉到了视线？

义体收尾人和罪人们对上了眼神。

“从刚才开始一直在看着我，有什么问题吗？”

en: Should we ask some more questions?
cn: 要不要再问点什么呢？

en: Should we ask some more questions?
cn: 要不要再问点什么呢？

en:
Past the dividing door, I see several W Corp. Cleanup Agents who have been turned into Bloodbags.

They're endlessly wandering the train car like they're patrolling the area.

Signs of a brutal fight litter the floor. Various agent gears covered in blood and viscera...

They haven't noticed us yet.

We could probably sneak by them...

... but maybe there's something we can use among the gears littered on the floor.
cn:
透过车厢的窗户，可以看到变成血袋的W公司清扫人员们。

他们在火车内不停地徘徊，就像在巡逻一样。

可能是经过了一场激烈的战斗，地上散落着一些装备，上面粘满了血管和血肉。

看起来好像还没有注意到这边。

如果悄悄地过去的话，说不定就能顺利出去……

周围的装备中可能有一些有用的东西。

en:
The Sinner in the vanguard looks to the left, to the right, then at me.

The Cleanup Agents are stepping on two different items on the floor.

Every single Bloodbag in this car will notice us as soon as we take even one of them.

Being greedy and trying to take both of them will slow us down too much.

Let's choose which of the two seems more useful to us.
cn:
走在前列的罪人左顾右盼后看向我。

能看到被清扫人员踩过的2件装备。

不论拿走哪一件，这节车厢所有的血袋都会察觉到罪人的位置。

全都要有些太贪婪了。

还是决定要拿哪一件吧。

en:
Hearts beating. Muscle tissues straining. Skin brushing.

Those were the sounds that filled the giant train car we emerged into.

Blue outlines of the WARP train flash intermittently between an imposing machine of blood and flesh.

It is a data center of sorts, made to store something. But the parts that form the machine are made from organic material of humans.

A voice speaks, saying that biometric authentication is needed for us to cross over to the next car.

We'll have to walk to the center of the room where the worming, intertwined mass of flesh is.
cn:
心脏搏动的声音，肌肉颤动的声音，皮肤摩擦的声音。

我们踏入了充满异样声响的车厢。

在血与肉制成的巨大机械中，WARP列车的蓝色光芒不断闪烁。

像是保存着什么的巨大数据中心一样。不过，构成它的是以人为原材料的有机体。

一道声音响起，说想要前往下一节车厢，需要通过生物验证。

为了进行认证，必须要进入肉块交缠的中心部位。

en:
A prosthetic body blocks the passageway between two train cars.

We approach them carefully, just in case that it is a Bloodbag.

... It is a Bloodbag, just dormant and immobilized.

A closer inspection through the mechanical joints reveals that any flesh that was once there has been completely desiccated.

The swollen veins broke through the steel armor, turning into red crystal growths all over the prosthetic body.

Though their expression is unobservable, it isn't hard to imagine that palpable pain must have been involved in this process. The Fixer's last moments left them in a twisted form that couldn't have been born from anything else but unimaginable pain.
cn:
可以看到义体堵塞在车厢与车厢之间的通道处。

那说不定是血袋，我们小心翼翼地接近过去。

那虽然是血袋，但似乎处于无法行动的状态。

仔细一看，机械构成的关节中，干枯的内部一览无余。

肿胀的血管从钢铁的缝隙内渗出，凝聚成红色结晶，从义体各处穿刺出来。

虽然看不到他们的表情，但从那扭曲的姿态不难看出，这过程伴随着剧烈的疼痛。

en:
Their duties completed, the Heishous are handing out the Mao Boluses they received from the Heishou-Xianren.

"And you, who are you? I haven't seen you around..."

"Perhaps they're the newly-initiated Hares?"

"... Identify yourselves."
cn:
完成任务的黑兽们正在分发黑兽仙人赐予的卯丸。

“你们是谁？没见过你们几个……”

“可能是新来的兔子？”

“……说明你们的身份。”

en:
We see a group of the Middle's thugs blocking the path ahead, all donning the same attire as the ones we saw at the Great Lake.

Going right through them would risk a battle.

Looking around, we find a lone boombox some distance from them.

Is that the source of the raucous music that plays in the background whenever these thugs show up?

Perhaps moving it somewhere else would bait the thugs away from the road with its music.
cn:
一群和我们在大湖那时见到的着装相同的中指成员堵住了前方的道路，似乎在寻找着什么人。

直接走过去可能会被抓住。

环顾四周，发现离他们稍远的地方放着一个孤零零的音响。

每次中指出场时，传来的音乐声的源头就是那个音响吗？

如果把它移到其他地方并播放的话，说不定就能引开这些守着巷子的中指成员。

en:
The night deepens.

Jade light shines through the window under the stifling moonless night sky.

As I conversed with the Sinner, something seemed to block out the light all of a sudden.

As we stood there, wary, someone ran into the room and swung a bladed instrument at us.

Thankfully, a Sinner unsheathed a weapon to block the intruder's attack.

They must've decided that the mission was a failure.

The opponent stared at us in silence for a moment before fleeing the scene.
cn:
深夜。

在无月的被遮蔽的天空下，玉色的光从窗外渗入。

与罪人交谈途中，突然有什么东西挡住了光。

正警戒时，伴随着尖锐的金属声，某人冲进房间挥动了刀刃。

所幸，及时拔出武器的罪人挡下了不速之客的攻击。

是意识到计划告吹了吗？

对方沉默地凝视我们片刻，随即遁逃入黑暗之中。

en:
We notice henchmen of the Middle standing in the distance, discussing something.

It is likely that they are searching for a target who happened to get themselves written up in their Book of Vengeance.

Upon our approach, they stop us in our tracks and show us a picture.

"Seen a guy like this before?"
cn:
远处，几名中指成员聚在一起讨论着什么。

看来他们正在寻找复仇账簿上的复仇对象。

一靠近，他们便将我们拦下，掏出一张照片。

“你们有没有见过长这样的家伙？”

en:
We come across a dark interior.

People dressed in dark clothes are standing in a group. They are all wearing bamboo hats.

It seems that this group is expecting enemies; they are busily preparing for something.

"We have intercepted intelligence that someone will be going after our lord tonight."

"Backup team, stay here and wait for your next order."

"Operation team, head to the enemy infiltration points and prepare for their arrival."

"You all know your missions. Stick to them."
cn:
昏暗的室内。

戴着斗笠的黑衣人们聚在一起。

他们就像在防备某人的入侵般，做好了万全的准备。

“今天我们得到情报，有人企图暗杀主公。”

“预备队在此等待下一个命令。”

“任务队向敌人的入侵路线出发，执行准备工作。”

“按照各自分配的队伍，行动起来。”

en:
It is that hour of the night when it becomes impossible to guess the time.

We'd gotten off the bus for some reconnaissance when I sense a sudden, ominous tremor.

I turn to face the origin of the tremor, only to see a massive flood of Sweepers rushing toward us, blinking with their red lights.

They will sweep everything clean in their wake.

The longer we hesitate, the closer they're getting.
cn:
无法分辨时间的漆黑夜晚。

为了调查下了巴士，走了一会儿后，感觉到了一阵奇怪的震动。

朝震源方向望去，只见远处闪烁着红光，清道夫们正如潮水般涌来。

他们所经之地，大概都会被清扫得一干二净吧。

还在犹豫的时候，清道夫们越来越近了。

en:
Just another busy, busy watch factory.

"!@#$!#$#!$@#$!$#@$."

A man in shiny dress shoes and a clean set of suit, clearly the factory's owner, is shouting at his employees in dirty, oil-gunked work clothes.

Something seems to catch his eye, causing him to glare at one of the employees and scream with anger.

The employee, who is already occupied with his work, gets flustered and tries to say something. But it takes him ages to even open his mouth.

The owner pulls out a recorder in a frustrated attempt to communicate, but it doesn't help.

"I just checked the security camera. You've been napping for two whole hours! Explain yourself."

"F… … … a… … …"

"… … c… … … t…"

"Can't you speak any faster, man?!"

Maybe there's something around here to resolve this situation?
cn:
一座繁忙劳作的时钟工厂。

“!@#$!#$#!$@#$!$#@$.”

一位穿着锃亮的鞋子和整洁服饰的厂长，正在大声呵斥身着满是油污的工作服的员工。

随后他突然看到了什么，怒目圆瞪着靠近某个员工，对他发起火来。

忙于工作的员工慌慌张张地想要说些什么，但由于太过迟缓，仅仅开口都要等很长时间。

厂长带着无可奈何的表情取出录音机复述自己的话，却仍然无法顺利交流。

“我刚刚看了摄像头，你这家伙睡了整整2个小时。有借口吗？”

“厂………………”

“……长…………”

“能不能说快点！”

周围也许有能解决这种状况的线索？

en:
You find yourself at a random T Corp. street. A Collection Staff is collecting taxes from a citizen.

"Will you be making your payments in time, or in cash?"

"Like I said, we already paid our Time Taxes in full! Besides, three-hundred-million Ahn? That's absurd...!"

"The records state that you have accrued additional Time Tax responsibilities due to the donation gift tax."

"No way. Is this because I gave away my time to those kids in the Backstreets?"

"I only gave them three hundred hours, so how the hell does that suddenly snowball into a three-hundred-million Ahn in taxes?! That doesn't make any sense!"

"Tax calculations in T Corp. are always exceptionally accurate."

The Time Collector strides toward the citizen to neutralize them.
cn:
T公司的街上，时间征收人员正拦住某个人在收税。

“您是通过时间缴费？还是通过金钱缴费？”

“都说过……我们已经把时间税付干净了！而且是整整3亿眼……”

“这是由赠予税产生的时间税。”

“难道是因为我之前把时间分给后巷里的孩子们了？”

“只是送出去300小时就要缴3亿眼的时间税，这根本说不通啊！”

“T公司的税收计算始终是正确的。”

时间征收人员为了镇压市民，向他们大步逼近。

en:
People from all walks of life, all with different hours to spend in a given day, speak and move about in varying speeds.

The sound coming from this odd inequality fills the street with incongruence.

Two people catch your attention in that chaos.

A rich-looking youth, despite his apparent time affluence, is walking in a brisk pace toward the streets...

... and a poor-looking old man, despite his apparent time poverty, is slowly walking into an alley with a leisurely look on his face.

Who to follow?
cn:
时间各异的人们或慢或快地交流着，行走着。

这份差异造成的怪异声音，使街道满是不平衡感。

在那之中，两位看着时钟的人闯入我的视线中。

一位像是时间充裕的年轻人，却匆匆忙忙向着街上走去，

一位看似是时日无多的老人，却从街上怡然自得地走向小巷。

要跟着谁看看吗？

en:
A secret hideout of the Yurodiviye. A Yurodivy is fervently reciting the texts given to them by the Saint.

"We have become nothing but cogs in a machine that exists solely for the industrialists, the bourgeoisie, and the Wings."

"What else, what other human relation remains among the Citizens but the narrow self-interest and heartless bonds created by capital?

"Thus, we shall cast aside the cold, unfeeling metal we call coin; instead, we shall trade our warmth with one another based on our needs!"

"To the haves, the laws of the Nests are shields that protect their privileges; yet, to the have-nots, they are chains that shackle us!"

"Then we shall defy the laws of the Nest! We shall show them the wrath of the have-nots!"

"All that the Yurodiviye have to lose is our chains; all that we have to gain is a world without hunger!"

The Yurodivy suddenly points in our direction.

Looks like we're going to have to say something.
cn:
在圣愚的秘密据点里。某位成员正在热情朗诵着圣者传达的文章。

“如今，我们成为了厂长、富人们以及翼的道具。”

“除了赤裸裸的利益关系、无情的金钱关系以外，都市的人们之间还有其他联系留存吗？”

“正因此，我们才需要通过交换彼此所需的温暖来代替冰冷的货币，互相理解，不断分享！”

“巢的法律是保护富人安全的副产品，不也是束缚穷人的枷锁吗？”

“那么，我们将反对巢的法律，展现出穷人们的愤怒！”

“圣愚最后失去的只有枷锁，而能得到的是人人可以温饱的世界！”

话音刚落，正在朗读的成员指向我们的方向。

看样子我们必须做出反应。

en:
You see a victim of the Time Ripper.

You can't even touch them thanks to the spatio-temporal displacement superposition phenomenon.

Is there anything you can do here to help?
cn:
我们看到了因时间杀人魔攻击而陷入停滞的受害者。

由于时空转移叠加现象，我们无法触碰到他。

有办法帮助他吗？

en:
We enter the Dungeon of the Fathoms. It resembles a T Corp. street.

Past the crowds of busy passers-by, we notice the glowing vending machine nearby.

With the streets completely devoid of color...

... the vending machine's light seems to resonate much more vibrantly with our heart.

Looking around, the other passers-by don't seem to notice anything unusual.

We see rows of buttons on the vending machine.

What should we do?
cn:
我们走进了像是T公司小巷一样的心象迷宫里。

在行色匆匆的人流间，并未褪色的自动贩卖机就在不远处。

也许是因为街道上的颜色都被夺走了吧？

它周围散发的光似乎更加强烈地射入了内心。

跟着光芒走去，我们来到了自动贩卖机前。

再次环顾四周，周围的行人们似乎并没有察觉到异样。

自动贩卖机上排列着许多按钮。

该如何抉择？

en:
We come upon a familiar rest stop.

The glass door is locked, with a notice attached to it.

'We are closed today due to personal reasons. We apologize for the inconvenience.'

'However, our fusion device is available for use. Customers requiring fusion service are kindly asked to use the device beside the entrance.'

What should we do?
cn:
熟悉的休息区。

玻璃门是锁着的，上面贴着什么东西。

“非常抱歉。由于店长的个人原因，本日暂停营业。”

“合成装置仍可使用，请有需要的顾客自由使用入口旁边的装置，非常感谢！”

该如何抉择？

en:
Researchers of the LCE are running about busily, each carrying various items recovered from the House of Spiders in their hands.

Recognizing something from the pile, we stood around gawking at the item—until one of the researchers finally decided to talk to us.

"Oh, those are samples taken from the Corridor that looked like the Ring's gallery. We're done with the component analysis, so feel free to take them."

What should we do?
cn:
LCE的研究员们拿着从蜘蛛巢回收的物品，忙碌地走来走去。

其中有些眼熟的东西吸引了我们，在附近停留时，一名研究员走过来搭话。

“啊，那边堆着的是这次从像是环指画廊的地方带回的样本。成分分析已经全部完成了，如果需要的话可以拿走。”

该如何抉择？

en:
A gentle, calming music playing from an unknown source tickles our ears.

Following the sound, we came upon an area containing multiple pieces of artwork.

We began taking a cautious look around, realizing that we'd probably just walked into one of the Ring's galleries... and came across a pedestal for an artwork—except it had no art on top of it.

It was small enough to lift with one hand, so it wouldn't be too much trouble to take it with us.

Should we?
cn:
似乎从某处传来了平静的音乐声。

顺着声音走去，出现了一个陈列着各种作品的空间。

看起来像是环指的画廊……查看周围时，发现有只摆着展台而没有作品的地方。

展台是仅凭单手便可搬起的大小，拿走也不坏。

要不要拿走展台呢？

en:
We explore the hall filled with endless stretches of display cases. The ceiling is so high that we can't even see where it ends.

At first, I tried counting how many toy boxes we'd walked past, but soon lost count...

"What's this?"

... and came upon an articulated hand model, standing proud in its lonesome glory.

The fingers are curled into a fist, as if to grasp something between them—a knuckle duster.

Maybe we can put that to use if we can manage to pry it from the fist?
cn:
在一个看不见天花板的空间里，我们徘徊在一排排无尽高耸的陈列架之间。

穿过数不清的玩具盒后……

“这是什么？”

我们发现了一个仿佛在炫耀般独自立着的木质手指模型。

在仿佛要抓住什么而弯曲的手指之间，嵌着一个指虎。

要是拿走它的话，会不会能派上用场呢？

  - Modify Skill pool: Gain 1 copy of Skill 3, but lose 1 copy of Skill 1
- Increase the amount of Burn, Bleed, Rupture, Sinking, or Tremor Potency inflicted with Skills by +2 (including 'Unique Status Effects')
- Base Skills that gain or spend Ammo deal +30% damage
- On Use with Base Skills that gain or spend Ammo, heal 10 SP for 1 ally with the lowest SP (including this unit)
- On Kill, activate the following:
· E.G.O Resource +2 to the Affinity that killed the enemy; E.G.O Resource +1 to all Affinities
· Next turn, inflict the remaining Burn, Bleed, Rupture, Sinking, and Tremor Potency and Count on the said enemy randomly between all enemies (min 1)

- 行动槽+1，将该人格的一个1技能替换为3技能
- 自身技能增加的烧伤 、流血 、破裂 、沉沦 与震颤 强度额外+2级(包括特殊负面状态)
- 获得或消耗弹药 的基础技能造成的伤害+30%
- 使用获得或消耗弹药 的基础技能时，使包括自身在内理智值最低的1名友方单位恢复10点理智值
- 击杀敌方单位时，触发以下效果
· 获得击杀敌方单位对应属性的E.G.O资源2个与所有属性的E.G.O资源各1个
· 下回合将阵亡敌方单位的烧伤 、流血 、破裂 、沉沦 与震颤 强度与层数随机施加给全体敌方单位(最少1点)

- Max Stack: 30
cn:
- 禁用被动技能“未来”
- 最大值：30

en:
- Passive "Past [過去]" activated
- Gain different effects based on Stack:
· 0~10: Skills inflict +1 more Burn Potency and Count
· 11~20: Clash Power +1; Skills inflict +2 more Burn Potency and +1 more Burn Count
· 21~30: Final Power +2; Skills inflict +3 more Burn Potency and +2 more Burn Count
- Max Stack: 30
cn:
- 激活被动技能“过去”
- 根据本效果层数获得不同效果：
· 0~10层：技能增加的烧伤 强度与施加的烧伤 层数额外+1
· 11~20层：拼点威力+1；技能增加的烧伤 强度额外+2级，施加的烧伤 层数额外+1层
· 21~30层：最终威力+2；技能增加的烧伤 强度额外+3级，施加的烧伤 层数额外+2层
- 最大值：30

en:
- Passive "Present [現在]" activated
- Gain different effects based on Stack:
· 0~10: Skills gain +1 more Poise Potency and Count
· 11~20: Clash Power +1; Skills gain +2 more Poise Potency and +1 more Poise Count
· 21~30: Final Power +2; Skills gain +3 more Poise Potency and +2 more Poise Count
- Max Stack: 30
cn:
- 激活被动技能“现在”
- 根据本效果层数获得不同效果：
· 0~10层：技能增加的呼吸法 强度与获得的呼吸法 层数额外+1
· 11~20层：拼点威力+1；技能增加的呼吸法 强度额外+2级，获得的呼吸法 层数额外+1层
· 21~30层：最终威力+2；技能增加的呼吸法 强度额外+3级，获得的呼吸法 层数额外+2层
- 最大值：30

en:
- Passive "Future [未來]" activated
- Gain different effects based on Stack:
· 0~10: Skills inflict +1 more Bleed Potency and Count
· 11~20: Clash Power +1; Skills inflict +2 more Bleed Potency and +1 more Bleed Count
· 21~30: Final Power +2; Skills inflict +3 more Bleed Potency and +2 more Bleed Count
- Max Stack: 30
cn:
- 激活被动技能“未来”
- 根据本效果层数获得不同效果：
· 0~10层：技能增加的流血 强度与施加的流血 层数额外+1
· 11~20层：拼点威力+1；技能增加的流血 强度额外+2级，施加的流血 层数额外+1层
· 21~30层：最终威力+2；技能增加的流血 强度额外+3级，施加的流血 层数额外+2层
- 最大值：30

en:
- Gain 1 Stack every time this unit switches between In the Past / In the Present / In the Future
- Take +(Stack x 15)% damage (max 150%)
- Turn Start: At 10 Stack, gain 5 Fragile
- Max Stack: 10
cn:
- 自身每次在过去形态/现在形态/未来形态间转换时，使本效果的层数增加1层
- 受到的伤害+(本效果层数×15)%(最多+150%)
- 回合开始时，若本效果层数为10层，则对自身施加5层易损 
- 最大值：10

en:
- Max Stack: 10
- Gain 1 Offense Level and 1 Defense Level for every 2 Stack
- At 5+ Stack, Final Power +1
- At max Stack, Coin Power +1
- When consuming Flower-burying Pin, give 1 E.G.O resource of the least-owned Affinity for every Stack consumed
cn:
- 最大值：10
- 本效果层数每有2层，使自身增加1级攻击等级与1级防御等级
- 若本效果层数不低于5层，使自身的最终威力+1
- 若本效果层数为最大值，使自身的硬币威力+1
- 消耗葬花针 时，每消耗1层，使敌方单位获得1个持有量最少的E.G.O资源

en:
- Max Potency: 50
- Turn End: Take 1% HP damage per Potency (min 1; cannot be Staggered by this effect)
- Lose 1 Count when using a Defense Skill (once per turn)
- Turn End: Double Potency and lose 1 Count
- This effect can be removed only by reducing Count to 0
cn:
- 最大强度：50
- 回合结束时，本效果强度每有1级，使自身受到体力上限1%的伤害(最少1点，不会因该效果而陷入混乱)
- 使用守备技能时，使本效果层数减少1层(每回合最多1次)
- 回合结束时，使本效果强度变为2倍，层数减少1层
- 本效果仅可在层数降至0层时解除

en:
- Take -100% damage
- When hit, expires at Skill End of the Skill that hit
cn:
- 受到的伤害-100%
- 受到攻击后，在该技能结束后解除本效果

en:
- Min & Max Speed +3
- Clash Power +2
- When hit, expires at Skill End of the Skill that hit
cn:
- 最小与最大速度值+3
- 拼点威力+2
- 受到攻击后，在该技能结束后解除本效果

en:
- Max Stack: 20
- Does not expire at 0 Stack
- Lose 1 Stack when taking damage due to Flower-burying Pin
- Take +10% damage for every Stack lost
cn:
- 最大值：20
- 层数为0层时不会解除本效果
- 受到来自葬花针 的伤害时，使本效果层数减少1层
- 每失去1层本效果，使自身受到的伤害+10%

en:
- Deal -100% damage using Unopposed Attacks
- Take +80% damage from Unopposed Attacks
- All Peccatulum Invidiae units, including this unit, equip only Defense Skills in their Skill Slots
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack
cn:
- 单方面攻击造成的伤害-100%
- 受到来自单方面攻击的伤害+80%
- 包括自身在内的全体嫉妒罪种仅在行动槽内装备守备技能
- 回合结束时，本效果的层数减少1层

en:
- Base Offense Level -20
- Base Defense Level -20
- Turn Start: Gain 7 Protection if The Ring Apprentice has not retreated from this Encounter
cn:
- 基础攻击等级-20
- 基础防御等级-20
- 若环指 子辈处于可战斗状态，则回合开始时使自身获得7层守护

en:
- Unopposed Attacks deal -100% damage
- Turn End: If 3+ allies are defeated in this Encounter, this effect expires
cn:
- 单方面攻击造成的伤害-100%
- 回合结束时，若本场战斗中阵亡的友方单位数不低于3名，则解除本效果

en: Deal and take +10% damage
cn: 造成与受到的伤害+10%

en: Deal and take +20% damage
cn: 造成与受到的伤害+20%

en:
- Panic
- Turn Start: Gain 5 Burn, +3 Burn Count, 5 Bleed, and +3 Bleed Count
cn:
- 陷入恐慌
- 回合开始时，使自身增加5级烧伤 强度与5级流血 强度并对自身施加3层烧伤 与3层流血

en:
- Low Morale
- Turn Start: Gain 5 Burn and 5 Bleed
cn:
- 士气低落
- 回合开始时，使自身增加5级烧伤 强度与5级流血 强度

en:
- Manifested Sinners can equip Identities and follow commands, but they lack independent will and retain no memory of their manifestation.
- The distance limit between the manager and the Sinners for equipping Identities increases vastly.
cn:
- 显现出装备人格的罪人，其可以执行命令，但不存在自我意识，也无法保持记忆。
- 极大程度扩展为罪人装备人格的距离限制。

en:
- Applied Effects:
 • Base Attack Skill Coins and Counter Skill Coins deal more Skill damage, gain Power, and are converted into Unbreakable Coins
 • When hit, does not become Staggered. Minimum HP is fixed to 10
 • Heal HP by a certain percentage of damage dealt with Base Skills
- Units that are killed, cannot be controlled, or immobilized cannot be selected.
cn:
- 适用效果
 · 使基础攻击技能与反击技能的威力与造成的伤害增加，并将其硬币转化为不可摧毁的硬币
 · 受到攻击时，不会陷入混乱，最小体力固定为10点
 · 恢复基础技能造成伤害量一定比例的体力
- 无法选择已阵亡、无法操作、无法行动的单位

en:
- Targeting for all Skills will be reset.
- Effects activated at Turn Start will not be updated.
cn:
- 所有技能的目标将被重置。
- 回合开始时触发的效果将不会被更新。

en: - Resets any slotted E.G.O Skills for all characters, and targeting for all Skills will be reset.
cn: - 所有角色生成的E.G.O技能将被初始化，技能目标也将被重置。

en: - For 3 turns, set all units' Offense and Defense Levels to the average of all units' values.
cn: - 3回合内，全体单位的攻击等级与防御等级调整为全体单位的平均值。

en: When inflicting [Combustion] with Skills against enemies, inflict +3 [Combustion] Count (3 times per turn)
cn: 通过技能效果对敌方单位施加[Combustion]时，额外施加3层[Combustion](每回合最多3次)

en: When inflicting [Burst] with Skills against enemies, inflict +3 [Burst] Count (3 times per turn)
cn: 通过技能效果对敌方单位施加[Burst]时，额外施加3层[Burst](每回合最多3次)

en: If the unit's Speed is faster than the target's, gain +(Speed/3) Clash Power. (max 3)
cn: 若自身的速度值高于目标，则使拼点威力+(速度值/3) (最多+3)

en:
The following effect applies to the first Skill to deal damage to an enemy.

Inflict (damage dealt/3) [Laceration] Potency.
cn:
以下效果仅对每回合中首个对敌方单位造成伤害的技能生效。

使目标增加(伤害量/3)级[Laceration]强度。

en: Each turn, the first skill to deal damage to an enemy deals bonus fixed damage by half of the damage dealt.
cn: 每回合中首次使用技能对敌方单位造成伤害后，对其额外造成(伤害量/2)点固定伤害。

en:
Blunt Skills deal +10% damage

Final Coin of Blunt Skills inflict 2 [Vibration] Potency On Hit. (once per turn)
cn:
打击技能造成的伤害+10%

打击技能最后一枚硬币命中时，使目标增加2级[Vibration]强度。(每回合最多1次)

en: When an ally with Shield is hit by an enemy, reflect 3 fixed damage. (does not reflect damage when the ally did not take any Shield damage)
cn: 若友方单位带有护盾时受到敌方单位攻击，则反弹3点固定伤害。(护盾没有受到伤害时不反弹伤害)

en:
When an ally attacks an enemy that has [Burst] with a Skill that inflicts [Burst] Potency or Count, deal +([Burst] Count x 1.25)% damage. (max 50%)

When an ally recovers from Stagger, heal 20% of max HP. (2 times per Encounter)
cn:
友方单位增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的技能攻击带有[Burst]的敌方单位时，造成的伤害+(目标的[Burst]层数×1.25)%(最多+50%)。

友方单位解除混乱时，使其恢复其体力上限20%的体力(每场战斗最多2次)。

en:
Turn End: gain 1 [Breath] Potency next turn for every Attack Skill that dealt damage before Turn End.

In Focused Encounters: gain 3 [Breath] Potency for every Attack Skill that dealt damage before Turn End instead.
cn:
回合结束时，友方单位每有1个攻击技能造成了伤害，下回合使其增加1级[Breath]强度。

若是集中遭遇战，则改为增加3级[Breath]强度。

en: Turn Start: apply 2 [Breath], 2 [Breath] Count, and 2 [Protection] to the ally with the least HP.
cn: 回合开始时，使现存体力最低的友方单位增加2级[Breath]强度并使其获得2层[Breath]与2层[Protection]。

en:
Deal +(absolute value of SP/1.5)% damage. (min 0%)

When an ally with Plus Coin Skills recovers from Stagger, fully heal SP. (does not activate when Corroded)

For an ally with all Minus Coin Skills: gain 3 [Paralysis] at Turn Start.
cn:
友方单位造成的伤害+(该单位理智值的绝对值/1.5)%(最少+0%)

当拥有加算硬币技能的友方单位解除混乱时，使其恢复全部理智值(不对侵蚀的单位生效)。

回合开始时，对拥有的技能全部为减算硬币技能的友方单位施加3层[Paralysis]。

en:
First Turn Start of an Encounter: gain random E.G.O resources equal to the number of enemies.

If there are 4 or more Blade Lineage or Kurokumo Clan Identities participating in this Encounter(only counts Identities on the field at Encounter Start), gain E.G.O resources for the least-owned E.G.O Affinity instead.
cn:
关卡的首个回合开始时，根据敌方单位数，随机获得相应个数的E.G.O资源。

若参与本场战斗的属于剑契组或黑云会的人格不低于4名(以参战人员为基准)，则改为获得持有量最少的E.G.O资源。

en:
Turn Start: all allies gain 1 Slash Power Up.

Blade Lineage or Kurokumo Clan Identities gain 2 Slash Power Up instead.
cn:
回合开始时，使全体友方单位获得1层斩击威力提升 。

属于剑契组或黑云会的友方单位改为获得2层斩击威力提升 。

en:
During this Encounter: when inflicting [Laceration] Potency or 'Unique Bleed' for the first time against an enemy with an Attack Skill effect, inflict an additional +2 [Laceration] Count. (Once per Encounter)

Kurokumo Clan Identities, when inflicting damage against an enemy for the first time, inflict an additional 4 [Laceration] Potency and +4 [Laceration] Count instead.
cn:
本场战斗中，首次通过攻击技能效果使敌方单位增加[Laceration]强度或施加特殊流血时，额外对其施加2层[Laceration]。（每场战斗最多1次）

若为属于黑云会的友方单位，则改为首次对敌方单位造成伤害时，额外使其增加4级[Laceration]强度并对其施加4层[Laceration]。

en:
When an ally Critically Hits an enemy, deal an additional ([Breath] Potency/3) Pride damage.

Blade Lineage Identities, when they Critically Hit an enemy, deal an additional ([Breath] Potency/2) Pride damage instead.
cn:
友方单位对敌方单位造成暴击时，对目标额外造成(自身的[Breath]强度/3)点傲慢伤害。

若该友方单位属于剑契组，则改为暴击时对目标额外造成(自身的[Breath]强度/2)点傲慢伤害。

en: If the target has 1.5 or lower Slash Resistance, Slash Resistance +0.3.
cn: 若敌方单位的斩击抗性不高于1.5，则使其斩击抗性+0.3

en:
Turn Start: activates when there are 3 or more Kurokumo Clan Identities(only counts Identities on the field).

Turn Start: all allies gain 2 Slash Power Up, and deal +35% more Slash damage.

Turn Start: when a Kurokumo Clan Identity deals damage for the first time, inflict an additional 4 [Laceration] Potency and +4 [Laceration] Count. (Once per turn)
cn:
回合开始时，若属于黑云会的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果。(以参战人员为基准)

回合开始时，使全体友方单位获得2层斩击威力提升 并使其造成的斩击伤害+35%。

回合开始时，属于黑云会的人格首次造成伤害时，额外使目标增加4级[Laceration]强度并对其施加4层[Laceration]。(每回合最多1次)

en:
Turn Start: activates when there are 3 or more Blade Lineage Identities(only counts Identities on the field).

Turn Start: all allies gain 2 Slash Power Up, and deal +35% more Slash damage.

Turn Start: when a Blade Lineage Identity hits critically, deal additional Pride damage equal to [Breath] Potency on self.
cn:
回合开始时，若属于剑契组的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果。(以参战人员为基准)

回合开始时，使全体友方单位获得2层斩击威力提升 并使其造成的斩击伤害+35%。

属于剑契组的人格造成暴击时，对目标额外造成(自身的[Breath]强度)点傲慢伤害。

en:
Turn Start: activates when there are 3 or more Blade Lineage Identities(only counts Identities on the field).

All allies deal +50% more Slash damage

Blade Lineage Identities: if the ally has [Breath], Critical rate is fixed to 100%.

Blade Lineage Identities: inflict x1.5 more damage on Crit
cn:
回合开始时，若属于剑契组的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果。(以参战人员为基准)

全体友方单位造成的斩击伤害+50%。

属于剑契组，且带有[Breath]的友方单位暴击率固定为100%。

属于剑契组的友方单位暴击倍率增加至1.5倍

en:
Turn Start: Activates when there are 3 or more Blade Lineage Identities (only counts Identities on the field)

All allies deal +50% more Slash damage

Blade Lineage Identities: Skill 1 gains Coin Power +1; Single-Coin Skill 1 gains Coin Power +3

[Blade Lineage Mentor Meursault Only] Cannot be Staggered for the turn this unit equips "Yield My Flesh". "Yield My Flesh" Skill Final Clash Power -36, "To Claim Their Bones" Skill deals +50% damage
cn:
回合开始时，若属于剑契组的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果。(以参战人员为基准)

全体友方单位造成的斩击伤害+50%。

属于剑契组的友方单位1技能的硬币威力+1，若该技能为单硬币技能，则改为硬币威力+3。

[剑契组 头领 默尔索专属] 装备了技能“肉斩”的回合内，自身不会陷入混乱，技能“肉斩”的拼点最终威力-36，技能“骨断”造成的伤害+50%。

en:
When dealing damage to an enemy with Attack Skills(except E.G.O Skills) that inflict [Vibration] Potency, Count, or Unique Tremor, deal +10% damage.

If the Skill triggered [VibrationExplosion] on the enemy for the first time this turn, inflict +2 [Vibration] Count next turn (once per turn)
cn:
增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的攻击技能(不包括E.G.O技能)对敌方单位造成的伤害+10%

若该技能本回合首次使敌方单位[VibrationExplosion]，则下回合对其施加2层[Vibration](每回合最多1次)

en:
When Clashing with a faster enemy, Clash Power +1.

When dealing damage to a faster enemy, inflict 3 [Vibration] Potency and +2 [Vibration] Count next turn. (once per turn)
cn:
与速度值高于自身的敌方单位拼点时，使自身的拼点威力+1。

对速度值高于自身的敌方单位造成伤害时，下回合使该敌方单位增加3级[Vibration]强度并对其施加2层[Vibration](每回合最多1次)。

en:
Turn End: Inflict 1 [Binding] to the fastest enemy next turn. (for Abnormalities, a Part)

If the target has [Vibration] or 'Unique Tremor', inflict 2 [Binding] instead.

When an ally attacks targets with [Binding], deal +(5 + (2.5 x [Binding] value)) more damage. (max 15%)
cn:
回合结束时，对速度值最高的1名敌方单位在下回合施加1层[Binding](若是异想体，则改为1个部位)。

若目标带有[Vibration]或特殊震颤，则改为施加2层[Binding]。

友方单位攻击带有[Binding]的目标时，造成的伤害+(5+(目标的[Binding]层数×2.5))%(最多+15%)。

en:
First Turn Start of a wave: inflict (9 - current Speed) [Vibration] Potency to 3 enemies with the slowest Speed. (min. 3)

Deal +10% damage against targets with 12+ [Vibration] or 'Unique Tremor' at Turn Start.
cn:
波次的首个回合开始时，使速度值最低的3名敌方单位增加(9-当前速度值)级[Vibration]强度(最少3级)。

对回合开始时带有的[Vibration]或特殊震颤强度不低于12级的敌方单位造成的伤害+10%。

en:
First Turn Start of a wave: inflict (9 - current Speed) [Vibration] Potency (min. 3) and (9 - current Speed)/2 [Vibration] Count to 1 enemy with the fastest Speed. (rounded up; for Abnormalities, a Part)

Take -10% damage from targets with 12+ [Vibration] or 'Unique Tremor' at Turn Start.
cn:
波次的首个回合开始时，使速度值最高的1名敌方单位增加(9-当前速度值)级[Vibration]强度(最少3级)并对其施加层数相当于该数值一半的[Vibration](向上取整，若是异想体，则改为1个部位)。

受到回合开始时带有的[Vibration]或特殊震颤强度不低于12级的敌方单位的伤害-10%。

en:
When an ally with Attack Skills(except E.G.O Skills) that inflict [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor' wins a Clash, inflict 2 [Vibration] Potency and +2 [Vibration] Count. (2 times per turn)

Yurodivy Identities: inflict 3 [Vibration] Potency and +3 [Vibration] Count instead (3 times per turn)

If the affected Identity Clashes against targets with higher Offense Levels, Clash Power +2; deal +20% damage when attacking after winning the Clash.
cn:
拥有增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的攻击技能(不包括E.G.O技能)的友方单位与敌方单位拼点胜利时，使目标增加2级[Vibration]强度并对其施加2层[Vibration](每回合最多2次)。

属于圣愚的人格改为增加3级[Vibration]强度并施加3层[Vibration](每回合最多3次)

该人格与攻击等级高于自身的敌方单位拼点时，使该友方单位的拼点威力+2，拼点胜利后造成的伤害+20%。

en:
