回合开始时，对全体敌方单位施加1层某2种随机效果，该效果可能为“暴怒~嫉妒易损”

en:
Gain 2 [Breath] Potency next turn based on the number of allied Attack Skills that dealt damage by Turn End
- In Focused Encounters, gain 4 [Breath] Potency instead.

Turn Start: apply 2 [Breath], +2 [Breath] Count, and 2 [Protection] on the ally with the least HP.

Deal +(absolute value of SP)% damage. (min 0%)

When an ally with Plus Coin Skills recovers from Stagger, fully heal SP. (does not activate when Corroded)

For an ally with all Minus Coin Skills: gain 5 [Paralysis] at Turn Start.
cn:
回合结束时，友方单位每有1个攻击技能造成了伤害，下回合使其增加2级[Breath]强度。
- 若是集中遭遇战，则改为增加4级[Breath]强度。

回合开始时，使现存体力最低的1名友方单位增加2级[Breath]强度并使其获得2层[Breath]与2层[Protection]。

友方单位造成的伤害+(该单位理智值的绝对值)%(最少+0%)

当拥有加算硬币技能的友方单位解除混乱时，使其恢复全部理智值(不对侵蚀的单位生效)。

回合开始时，对拥有的技能全部为减算硬币技能的友方单位施加5层[Paralysis]。

en: If there are no surviving [RequestedTarget], inflict the [RequestedTarget] effect against the first enemy to be attacked by an ally. (once per turn)
cn: 若没有存活的[RequestedTarget]，则对友方单位攻击的首个敌方单位施加[RequestedTarget]。(每回合最多1次)

en:
[Effect applies only to #1 Deployed Identity]

Gain 2 [Enhancement] and 1 [Vulnerable] every turn

If the main target currently has a reduced Defense Level, gain 5 [Breath] before attack

Pride Pierce Skills deal +(50 / # of Coins)% damage (including E.G.O)
cn:
[第1顺位友方单位专属]

每回合使自身获得2层[Enhancement]并对自身施加1层[Vulnerable]

若主要目标减少了防御等级，则攻击前使自身增加5级[Breath]强度

傲慢突刺技能造成的伤害+(50/硬币数)%。(包括E.G.O)

en: If the target has 1.5 or lower Pierce Resistance, Pierce Resistance +0.3
cn: 若敌方单位的突刺抗性不高于1.5，则使其突刺抗性+0.3

en:
Turn End: if any allies Retreated this turn, 1 ally with the fastest Speed gains 2 [Enhancement] and 1 [AttackDmgUp] at the next Turn Start

Combat Start: if any allies were Substituted in this turn, allies that were Substituted in gain 2 [Enhancement] and 2 [Endurance]
cn:
回合结束时，若本回合有撤退的友方单位，则下回合开始时使速度值最高的1名友方单位获得2层[Enhancement]与1层[AttackDmgUp]

战斗开始时，若本回合有解除待命的友方单位，则使解除待命的友方单位获得2层[Enhancement]与2层[Endurance]

en:
Turn Start: if this unit has [Breath], gain 2 [DefenseUp] and 1 [Endurance]

If this unit has [Breath], the first Coin to hit deals +10% damage

If the said Coin hits critically, +20% Damage on Critical Hit
cn:
回合开始时，若自身带有[Breath]，则使自身获得2层[DefenseUp]与1层[Endurance]

若自身带有[Breath]，则首个命中的硬币造成的伤害+10%

若该硬币命中时暴击，则使其暴击时造成的伤害+20%

en:
If a Skill that can spend [Bullet] does not spend [Bullet], gain 1 [Enhancement] this turn and next turn (once per turn)

When gaining [Bullet], Skill 3 deals +50% damage this turn and next turn when used

When using a Skill that spends [Bullet], gain 3 [Breath] and +1 [Breath] Count
cn:
若可消耗[Bullet]的技能未消耗[Bullet]，则本回合与下回合使自身获得1层[Enhancement](每回合最多1次)

获得[Bullet]时，本回合与下回合使3技能造成的伤害+50%

使用消耗[Bullet]的技能时，使自身增加3级[Breath]强度并使自身获得1层[Breath]

en:
On Clash Win with a Base Attack Skill that inflicts [Combustion] Potency or 'Unique Burn', inflict 2 [Combustion] Potency (2 times per turn per Identity)

On Clash Win with a Base Attack Skill that inflicts [Combustion] Count, inflict +2 [Combustion] Count (3 times per turn per enemy)

Base Attack Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn': each Skill gains Offense Level equal to the number of copies of each Skill(max 3).
- If a Skill has 3+ copies, gain 2 additional Offense Level.
cn:
增加[Combustion]强度或施加特殊烧伤的基础攻击技能与敌方单位拼点胜利时，使其增加2级[Combustion]强度(每回合每名人格最多2次)

施加[Combustion]层数的基础攻击技能与敌方单位拼点胜利时，对其施加2层[Combustion](每回合每名敌方单位最多3次)

增加[Combustion]强度，施加[Combustion]层数或施加特殊烧伤的基础攻击技能增加相当于其拥有量的攻击等级(最多3级)
- 若该技能拥有量不低于3个，则额外增加2级攻击等级

en:
On Clash Win with a Base Attack Skill that inflicts [Burst] Potency or Count against an enemy, inflict +3 [Burst] Count (2 times per turn per enemy)

On Hit: if the enemy does not have [Burst], Coin effects that inflict [Burst] Potency inflict [Burst] Count instead (max 4; 2 times per turn per enemy; for Abnormalities, for each Part)

Base Attack Skills that inflict [Burst] Potency or Count: each Skill gains Offense Level equal to the number of copies of each Skill(max 3).
- If a Skill has 3+ copies, gain 2 additional Offense Level.
cn:
施加[Burst]层数的基础攻击技能与敌方单位拼点胜利时，对其施加3层[Burst](每回合每名敌方单位最多2次)

命中时，若目标敌方单位未带有[Burst]，则增加[Burst]强度的硬币效果改为施加[Burst]层数(最多4层，每回合每名敌方单位最多2次，若是异想体则改为每个部位)

增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的基础攻击技能增加相当于其拥有量的攻击等级(最多3级)
- 若该技能拥有量不低于3个，则额外增加2级攻击等级

en:
Base Attack Skills that inflict [Combustion] Count: deal +20% damage and inflict +1 more [Combustion] Count. On Hit with these Skills against enemies with [Combustion] or 'Unique Burn': inflict 1 [DefenseDown] (2 times per turn per Identity)

Identities whose all Base Attack Skills inflict [Combustion] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn': at Turn Start, gain [AttackUp] equal to the number of surviving turns (except for the turn they join the Encounter; max 5)
cn:
施加[Combustion]层数的基础攻击技能造成的伤害+20%，施加的[Combustion]层数额外+1层。该技能命中带有[Combustion]或特殊烧伤的敌方单位时，对其施加1层[DefenseDown]（每回合每名人格最多2次）

回合开始时，使所有基础攻击技能均为增加[Combustion]强度，施加[Combustion]层数或施加特殊烧伤的技能的人格获得层数相当于其存活回合数的[AttackUp]（不包括登场回合，最多5层）

en:
On Hit with the final Coin against enemies with 15- [Burst] Potency when using a Base Attack Skill that inflicts [Burst] Potency or Count: inflict +3 [Burst] Count (once per turn per Identity)

Base Attack Skills that inflict [Burst] Count: Clash Power +1, deal +20% damage
cn:
增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的基础攻击技能的最后一枚硬币命中[Burst]强度不高于15级的敌方单位时，对其施加3层[Burst](每回合每名人格最多1次)

施加[Burst]层数的基础攻击技能的拼点威力+1，造成的伤害+20%

en:
Turn Start: All enemies (for Abnormalities, all Parts) gain +1~2 [Combustion] Count

When enemies take 5 hits from ally Attack Skills(including E.G.O Skills) that inflict [Combustion] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn': Trigger [Combustion] once, then reduce [Combustion] Count by 1 (2 times per turn per enemy; for Abnormalities, for each Part)
cn:
回合开始时，对全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为以部位判定)施加1~2层[Combustion]

带有[Combustion]的敌方单位受到友方单位增加[Combustion]强度，施加[Combustion]层数或施加特殊烧伤的攻击技能(包括E.G.O技能)的攻击5次时，触发该敌方单位的[Combustion]1次，并使其[Combustion]层数减少1层(每回合每名敌方单位最多2次，若是异想体则改为每个部位)

en:
Every time [Burst] activates 3 times on enemies with [Burst] due to getting hit by allies' Attack Skills(including E.G.O Skills) that inflict [Burst] Potency or Count, inflict 2 [AttackDown] on the said enemy next turn (3 times per turn per enemy; for Abnormalities, for each Part)

On Kill with a Base Attack Skill that inflicts [Burst] Count: inflict the remaining [Burst] Count on the defeated enemy on a random enemy next turn (2 times per turn)
cn:
带有[Burst]的敌方单位因受到友方单位增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的攻击技能(包括E.G.O技能)的攻击而触发[Burst]3次时，下回合对该敌方单位施加2层[AttackDown](每回合每名敌方单位最多3次，若是异想体则改为每个部位)

通过施加[Burst]层数的基础攻击技能击杀敌方单位时，下回合将阵亡单位的[Burst]层数随机施加给1名敌方单位(每回合最多2次)

en:
Limbus Company Identities: Skill 2 gains Offense Level +1 and deals +15% damage; Skill 3 gains Offense Level +2 and deals +30% damage

If there are 4+ Limbus Company Identities among the Backup Units, 2 random allies gain 2 [AttackUp] at Turn Start
cn:
属于边狱公司的人格的2技能攻击等级+1，造成的伤害+15%；3技能的攻击等级+2，造成的伤害+30%

若待命人员中属于边狱公司的人格不低于4名，则回合开始时随机使2名友方单位获得2层[AttackUp]

en:
During the Encounter, when an ally retreats or is defeated, randomly apply 3 [AttackUp] between all Identities at next Turn Start. (2 times per turn)
- When 3+ allies retreat or are defeated, randomly apply 6 [AttackUp] between all Identities at next Turn Start instead. (2 times per turn)

Turn Start: 3 allies with the lowest SP heals 15, 10, and 5 SP each (does not stack; the numbers apply in the ascending order; does not activate if the affected units are Panicked or Corroded)
cn:
战斗中友方单位阵亡或撤退时，下回合开始时随机使全体人格获得共计3层[AttackUp](每回合最多2次)
- 若阵亡或撤退的友方单位数不低于3名，则改为下回合开始时随机使全体友方单位获得共计6层[AttackUp](每回合最多2次)

回合开始时，使理智值最低的3名友方单位分别恢复15点，10点与5点理智值(不会重复生效，按理智值由低到高顺序，不对侵蚀或陷入恐慌的单位生效)

en:
Limbus Company Identities: Skill 2 gains Offense Level +2 and deals +20% damage; Skill 3 gains Offense Level +3 and deals +40% damage

Turn Start: a random ally gains 2 [AttackUp] for every Backup or defeated Limbus Company Identities.

During the Encounter, when an ally retreats or is defeated, randomly apply 3 [AttackUp] between all Identities at next Turn Start. (distributed equally, 2 times per turn)
- When 3+ allies retreat or are defeated, randomly apply 6 [AttackUp] between all Identities at next Turn Start instead. (2 times per turn)
- When 3+ Limbus Company Identities retreat or are defeated, randomly apply 8 [AttackUp] between all Identities instead.
cn:
属于边狱公司的人格的2技能的攻击等级+2，造成的伤害+20%；3技能的攻击等级+3，造成的伤害+40%

回合开始时，每有1名属于边狱公司的人格阵亡或待命，随机使1名友方单位获得2层[AttackUp]

战斗中友方单位阵亡或撤退时，下回合开始时随机使全体人格获得共计3层[AttackUp](平均分配，每回合最多2次)
- 若阵亡或撤退的友方单位不低于3名，则改为下回合开始时随机使全体友方单位获得共计6层[AttackUp]
- 若阵亡或撤退的属于边狱公司的人格不低于3名，则改为下回合开始时随机使全体人格获得共计8层[AttackUp]

en:
On Clash Lose, gain 1 [Protection] and heal 3~6 SP (once per turn per Identity)

When attacking an enemy with the [SuperCoin]'s effect of the Skill(except E.G.O Skills) that lost the Clash: 
- Plus Coin Skills receive Plus Coin Power +(3 / # of Coins) and deal +20% damage (min. Plus Coin Power gain 1)
- Minus Coin Skills deal +40% damage
cn:
拼点失败时，使自身获得1层[Protection]并恢复3~6点理智值(每回合每名人格最多1次)。

通过拼点失败的技能的[SuperCoin]效果(不包括E.G.O技能)攻击敌方单位时，加算硬币技能的加算硬币威力+(3/硬币数)，造成的伤害+20%(加算硬币威力最少+1)；减算硬币造成的伤害+40%。

en:
Turn Start: all allies gain 1 [ScarletResultUp].

Blade Lineage or Kurokumo Clan Identities gain 2 [ScarletResultUp] and 1 [SlashResultUp] instead.
cn:
回合开始时，使所有友方单位获得1层[ScarletResultUp]。

属于剑契组或黑云会的友方单位改为获得2层[ScarletResultUp]与1层[SlashResultUp]。

en:
Turn Start: activates when there are 3 or more Kurokumo Clan Identities. (only counts Identities on the field)

All allies gain 2 [ScarletResultUp] and 1 [SlashResultUp] at Turn Start.

Kurokumo Clan Identities' Base Attack Skills: gain Coin Power +(4 / # of Coins; min. 1), inflict an additional 1 [Laceration], +1 [Laceration] Count, and deal +(80/# of Coins)% damage

Nullify Kurokumo Clan Identities' first Stagger Threshold; at less than 50% HP, gain 2 [Protection] at Turn Start. Identities that took damage from enemies this turn gain 2 [Agility] next turn.
cn:
回合开始时，若属于黑云会的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果(以参战人员为基准)。

回合开始时，使全体友方单位获得2层[ScarletResultUp]与1层[SlashResultUp]。

属于黑云会的人格的基础攻击技能硬币威力+(4/硬币数)(最少+1)，增加的[Laceration]强度额外+1级，施加的[Laceration]层数额外+1层，造成的伤害+(80/硬币数)%。

属于黑云会的人格第一混乱阈值无效，回合开始时若现存体力低于50%，则使自身获得2层[Protection]。本回合受到敌方单位伤害且属于黑云会的人格在下回合获得2层[Agility]。

en:
Turn Start: activates when there are 3 or more Blade Lineage Identities. (only counts Identities on the field)

Turn Start: all allies gain 2 [SlashResultUp], and deal +35% damage.

Turn Start: when a Blade Lineage Identity hits critically, deal additional Pride damage equal to ([Breath] Potency / 2) on self.

If a Blade Lineage Identity has 30+ [Breath] Potency at Turn End, consume 10 [Breath] Potency and gain 2 [SlashDamageUp] next turn
cn:
回合开始时，若属于剑契组的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果(以参战人员为基准)。

回合开始时，使全体友方单位获得2层[SlashResultUp]并使其造成的伤害+35%。

属于剑契组的人格对敌方单位造成暴击时，对目标额外造成(自身的[Breath]强度/2)点傲慢伤害。

回合结束时，若属于剑契组的人格的[Breath]强度不低于30级，则消耗其10级[Breath]强度并在下回合使其获得2层[SlashDamageUp]。

en:
Turn Start: activates when there are 3 or more Kurokumo Clan Identities. (only counts Identities on the field)

On Hit with Base Attack Skill(except E.G.O Skills)'s [SuperCoin]: deal +(40/# of Coins)% damage
Kurokumo Clan Identities: deal +(80/# of Coins)% damage instead

Kurokumo Clan Identities with Slash Base Attack Skills: gain 2 [SlashDamageUp] at Turn Start. Kurokumo Clan Identities gain 1 [AttackUp] and 1 [DefenseUp] next turn for every 10% missing HP on self at Turn End. (max 5 each)

When a Kurokumo Clan Identity dies, all Kurokumo Clan Identities gain 2 [AttackDmgUp] next turn (once per turn)
cn:
回合开始时，若属于黑云会的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果(以参战人员为基准)。

使用基础攻击技能的[SuperCoin]命中时造成的伤害+(40/硬币数)%(不包括E.G.O技能)，若该人格属于黑云会，则改为造成的伤害+(80/硬币数)%。

使拥有斩击基础攻击技能且属于黑云会的人格获得2层[SlashDamageUp]，回合结束时属于黑云会的人格每失去10%的体力，下回合使其获得1层[AttackUp]与1层[DefenseUp](分别最多5层)。

若属于黑云会的人格阵亡，下回合使属于黑云会的全体人格获得2层[AttackDmgUp](每回合最多1次)。

en:
Blunt Skills: Clash Power +1
- The Middle Identities: gain Clash Power +1 and Coin Power +1 instead
- The Middle Identities: if the main target has [RetaliationBook], gain Clash Power +1, Coin Power +1, and deal +10% damage instead
cn:
打击技能的拼点威力+1
- 属于中指的人格改为拼点威力+1，硬币威力+1
- 属于中指的人格的主要目标带有[RetaliationBook]时，改为拼点威力+1，硬币威力+1，造成的伤害+10%

en:
When defeating a target with [Burst](for Focused Encounters, a Part) with an Attack Skill, inflict the [Burst] Potency on the target between all enemies(for Focused Encounters, all Parts) (max 2 per enemy, rounded down)

When defeating a target with [BurstAgility](for Focused Encounters, a Part) with an Attack Skill, inflict the [Burst] Potency and Count on the target between all enemies(for Focused Encounters, all Parts) (max 2 per enemy, rounded down)
cn:
自身的攻击技能击杀带有[Burst]的目标(若是集中遭遇战，则改为破坏部位)时，将目标的[Burst]强度施加给全体敌方单位(若是集中遭遇战，则改为所有部位)(每名敌方单位最多2级，向下取整)

自身的攻击技能击杀带有[BurstAgility]的目标(若是集中遭遇战，则改为破坏部位)时，将目标的[Burst]强度与层数施加给全体敌方单位(若是集中遭遇战，则改为所有部位)(每名敌方单位最多2点，向下取整)

en: If an ally's Speed is faster than the target's, the ally inflicts (Speed difference / 3) additional [Burst] or [Burst] Count when inflicting them with Skills (max 3)
cn: 若自身的速度值高于目标，则令自身通过技能增加破裂 强度或施加破裂 层数时额外增加(速度值之差/3)级破裂 强度或额外施加(速度值之差/3)层破裂 (最多3点)

en:
When hit, all allies in the same faction deal +5% more Blunt damage (15% per turn)

For The Middle Identities, gain 1 [AttackUp] and deal +10% more Blunt damage instead (3 per turn, 30% per turn)
cn:
友方单位受到攻击时，使与该友方单位属于同一阵营的全体人格造成的打击伤害+5%(每回合最多+15%)

属于中指的人格改为获得1层[AttackUp]并使造成的打击伤害+10%(每回合最多3次，每回合最多+30%)

en:
When clashing against targets with [Burst], gain ([Burst] on the target / 20) Clash Power (max 2)
- When clashing against targets with [BurstAgility], gain ([Burst] on the target / 15) Clash Power instead (max 3)

When dealing damage with [BurstAgility] effect, deal fixed damage by ([BurstAgility] damage / 3)
cn:
与带有[Burst]的目标拼点时，使自身的拼点威力+(目标的[Burst]强度/20)(最多+2)
- 与带有[BurstAgility]的目标拼点时，改为使自身的拼点威力+(目标的[Burst]强度/15)(最多+3)

通过[BurstAgility]效果造成伤害时，对目标造成([BurstAgility]伤害量/3)点固定伤害

en:
Turn End: Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Identities gain 2 [Agility] next turn

If an ally's Speed is faster than the target's, or when activating Unopposed Attacks, deal +10% more Slash damage for every (Speed difference / 3) (max 30%)

If an ally's Speed is faster than the target's, take -10% damage for every (Speed difference / 3) (max 30%)
cn:
回合结束时，使属于黑兽 - 卯的友方单位在下回合获得2层[Agility]

若自身的速度值高于目标或进行单方面攻击，则(速度值之差/3)每有1点，使自身造成的斩击伤害+10%(最多+30%)

若自身的速度值高于目标，则(速度值之差/3)每有1点，使自身受到的伤害-10%(最多-30%)

en:
Turn Start: activates when there are 2 or more The Middle Identities (only counts Identities on the field)

When hit, all allies in the same faction deal +5% more Blunt damage (15% per turn)

若其现存体力不高于50%，则改为获得(其[Charge]层数与特殊充能之和×2)点护盾。(每回合最多1次)

本场战斗中，属于多裂纹事务所的人格受到体力伤害时，下回合使其恢复上回合失去体力33%的体力(向下取整)

en:
Next turn: allies gain [Agility] and [Charge] Count equal to the number of [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge' gaining base Attack Skills they used this turn. (max 2)

When a MultiCrack Office Identity gains or consumes [Charge] Count with a base Attack Skill, they gain +1 additional [Charge] Count. (max 2)
cn:
根据友方单位本回合使用的获得[Charge]层数或特殊充能的基础攻击技能数，下回合使其获得相应层数的[Agility]与[Charge]。(最多2次)

属于多裂纹事务所的人格通过基础攻击技能获得或消耗[Charge]层数时，使其额外获得1层[Charge]。(最多2层)

en: Turn End: If this unit has [Laceration], halve the [Laceration] Potency on self and heal ([Laceration] Potency reduced x [Laceration] Count on self) HP. (rounded down. Can heal up to 10% of max HP at once)
cn: 回合结束时，若自身带有[Laceration]，则使自身的[Laceration]强度减半并使自身恢复(减少的[Laceration]强度×自身的[Laceration]层数)点体力。(向下取整，每次最多恢复体力上限10%的体力)

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that gain [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge' effects. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Plus Coin Base Attack Skills that consume [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge': gain Coin Power +1 and deal +(sum of [Charge] Count and 'Unique Charge' consumed by that Skill x 4)% damage (max 40%)
Minus Coin Base Attack Skills: Instead of gaining Coin Power, gain Base Power +(4 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down)

Turn End: allies with [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge' gain 1 [Agility] (max 2) and 1 [AttackDmgUp] (max 3) next turn for every instance they used a Base Attack Skill that consumes [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge' in this Encounter.

If a MultiCrack Office Identity has 5+ [Charge], they gain Coin Power +1 to base Attack Skills.
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有获得[Charge]层数或特殊充能的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果。(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)

消耗[Charge]层数或特殊充能的加算硬币基础攻击技能硬币威力+1，造成的伤害+(该技能消耗的[Charge]层数与特殊充能之和×4)%。(最多+40%)
- 减算硬币技能改为基础威力+(4/硬币数)，而非硬币威力(最少+1，向下取整)

回合结束时，带有[Charge]层数或特殊充能的友方单位根据本场战斗中使用的消耗[Charge]层数或特殊充能的基础攻击技能数，下回合使其获得相应层数的[Agility](最多2层)与[AttackDmgUp](最多3层)。

属于多裂纹事务所且[Charge]强度不低于5级的人格基础攻击技能的硬币威力+1。

cn:

消耗[Charge]层数或特殊充能的加算硬币基础攻击技能硬币威力+1，造成的伤害+(该技能消耗的[Charge]层数与特殊充能之和×4)%。(最多+40%)
- 减算硬币技能改为基础威力+(4/硬币数)，而非硬币威力(最少+1，向下取整)

带有[Charge]层数或特殊充能的友方单位基础攻击技能拼点时，使其拼点威力+2。拼点胜利时使其获得3层[Charge]，拼点失败时使其失去6层[Charge]。

嫉妒基础攻击技能拼点胜利时，对目标施加1层[VioletTakeDamageUp]。(最多叠加3层)

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that gain [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge' effects. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Plus Coin Base Attack Skills that consume [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge'(fixed Potency): gain Coin Power +1 and deal +(sum of [Charge] Count and 'Unique Charge'(fixed Potency) consumed by that Skill x 4)% damage (max 40%)
- Minus Coin Base Attack Skills: Instead of gaining Coin Power, gain Base Power +(4 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down)

In this Encounter, when an ally takes damage that would kill them, consume all [Charge] Count and 'Unique Charge'(fixed Potency) on self; then, immediately heal (10 + sum of [Charge] Count and 'Unique Charge'(fixed Potency) consumed)% HP (once per Encounter); then, gain 3 [Protection] until the ally is defeated.

※ For 'Unique Charge' that has both Potency and Count, its Count will be used for above calculations
cn:

消耗[Charge]层数或特殊充能(固定强度)的加算硬币基础攻击技能硬币威力+1，造成的伤害+(该技能消耗的[Charge]层数与特殊充能(固定强度)之和×4)%。(最多+40%)
- 减算硬币技能改为基础威力+(4/硬币数)，而非硬币威力(最少+1，向下取整)

带有[Charge]层数或特殊充能的友方单位基础攻击技能拼点时，使其拼点威力+1。回合开始时，本场战斗中每拼点胜利1次，使其获得2层[AttackUp]。(最多6层)

本场战斗中，友方单位受到致死伤害时，消耗其所有[Charge]层数与特殊充能(固定强度)并使其立即恢复体力上限(10+消耗的[Charge]层数与特殊充能(固定强度)之和)%的体力(每场战斗最多1次)。使该友方单位获得3层[Protection]直到其阵亡。

※ 拥有强度与层数的特殊充能以其层数计算

最大[Charge]层数+5。

en:
First Turn Start of an Encounter: gain random E.G.O resources equal to the number of enemies.

If there are 4 or more Blade Lineage or Kurokumo Clan Identities participating in this Encounter, gain E.G.O resources for the least-owned E.G.O Affinity instead.
cn:
关卡的首个回合开始时，根据敌方单位数，随机获得相应个数的E.G.O资源。

若参与本场战斗的属于剑契组或黑云会的人格不低于4名(以参战人员为基准)，则改为获得持有量最少的E.G.O资源。

en:
Turn Start: all allies gain 1 Slash Power Up.

Blade Lineage or Kurokumo Clan Identities gain 2 Slash Power Up instead.
cn:
回合开始时，使全体友方单位获得1层斩击威力提升 。

属于剑契组或黑云会的友方单位改为获得2层斩击威力提升 。

en:
During this Encounter: when inflicting [Laceration] Potency or Unique Bleed for the first time against an enemy with an Attack Skill effect, inflict an additional +2 [Laceration] Count. (Once per Encounter)

Kurokumo Clan Identities, when inflicting damage against an enemy for the first time, inflict an additional 4 [Laceration] Potency and +4 [Laceration] Count instead.
cn:
本场战斗中，首次通过攻击技能效果使敌方单位增加[Laceration]强度或施加特殊流血时，额外对其施加2层[Laceration]。（每场战斗最多1次）

若为属于黑云会的友方单位，则改为首次对敌方单位造成伤害时，额外使其增加4级[Laceration]强度并对其施加4层[Laceration]。

en:
When an ally Critically Hits an enemy, deal an additional ([Breath] Potency/3) Pride damage.

Blade Lineage Identities, when they Critically Hit an enemy, deal an additional ([Breath] Potency/2) Pride damage instead.
cn:
友方单位对敌方单位造成暴击时，对目标额外造成（自身的[Breath]强度/3）点傲慢伤害。

若该友方单位属于剑契组，则改为暴击时对目标额外造成（自身的[Breath]强度/2）点傲慢伤害。

en: If the target has 1.5 or lower Slash Resistance, Slash Resistance +0.3.

en:

Turn Start: all allies gain 2 Slash Power Up, and deal +35% more Slash damage.

Turn Start: when a Kurokumo Clan Identity deals damage for the first time, inflict an additional 4 [Laceration] Potency and +4 [Laceration] Count. (Once per turn)

回合开始时，若属于黑云会的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果。(以参战人员为基准)

en:

cn:

回合开始时，使全体友方单位获得2层斩击威力提升 并使其造成的斩击伤害+35%。

属于剑契组的人格造成暴击时，对目标额外造成(自身的[Breath]强度)点傲慢伤害。

en:

All allies deal +50% more Slash damage.

Blade Lineage Identities: if the ally has [Breath], Critical rate is fixed to 100%.

Blade Lineage Identities: inflict x1.5 more damage on Crit
cn:

属于剑契组的友方单位暴击倍率增加至1.5倍

When applying [Combustion] Potency or 'Unique Burn' to an enemy with [Combustion] or 'Unique Burn', randomly inflict a total of 3 [Combustion] Potency between all enemies.

After defeating 1 or more enemy using an Attack Skill, gain +1 E.G.O resource of that Attack Skill's Affinity at the next Turn Start.

If the Attack Skill's Affinity was Wrath, gain +1 E.G.O resource of all affinities the ally has at the next Turn Start instead.
cn:
通过攻击技能击杀不低于1名敌方单位时，下回合开始时获得1个击杀技能所对应的E.G.O资源。

若该技能为暴怒技能，则改为下回合获得击杀者所有攻击技能对应的E.G.O资源各1个。

en: Combat Start: if all enemies (or all Abnormality parts) have [Combustion] or 'Unique Burn', inflict 2 [Combustion] Potency on all enemies (or all Abnormality parts).
cn: 战斗开始时，若全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)都带有[Combustion]或特殊烧伤，则使全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)增加2级[Combustion]强度。

en: Combat Start: <style="upgradeHighlight">inflict 2 [Combustion] Potency on all enemies (or all Abnormality parts) with [Combustion] or 'Unique Burn'</style>.
cn: 战斗开始时，<style="upgradeHighlight">使带有[Combustion]或特殊烧伤的全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)增加2级[Combustion]强度</style>。

en: Combat Start: <style="upgradeHighlight">inflict 3 [Combustion] Potency on all enemies (or all Abnormality parts)</style>.
cn: 战斗开始时，<style="upgradeHighlight">使全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)增加3级[Combustion]强度</style>。

en:
When hitting an enemy with a Skill, heal 12.5% of the character’s missing HP. (Once per character per turn.)

If the Skill’s Affinity was Wrath, heal 25% of missing HP instead.
cn:
友方单位通过技能对敌方单位造成伤害时，使该友方单位恢复已失去体力12.5%的体力(每回合每名人格最多1次)。

若该技能为暴怒技能，则改为恢复已失去体力25%的体力。

en: When hitting an enemy with a Skill that inflicts [Laceration] Potency or 'Unique Bleed', inflict 4 [Laceration] Potency.
cn: 使用增加[Laceration]强度或施加特殊流血的技能对敌方单位造成伤害时，使目标增加4级[Laceration]强度。

en: When <style="upgradeHighlight">hitting an enemy with a Skill that inflicts [Laceration] Potency or 'Unique Bleed', or with a Wrath Affinity Skill</style>, <style="upgradeHighlight">inflict 5 [Laceration] Potency</style>.
cn: 使用<style="upgradeHighlight">增加[Laceration]强度或施加特殊流血的技能或暴怒技能</style>对敌方单位造成伤害时，使目标<style="upgradeHighlight">增加5级[Laceration]强度</style>。

cn: 使用增加[Laceration]强度或施加特殊流血的技能或暴怒技能对敌方单位造成伤害时，使目标增加5级[Laceration]强度<style="upgradeHighlight">并对其施加1层[Laceration]</style>。

en:
Turn Start: Gain +1 E.G.O resource of a random Affinity that does not correspond to any Attack Skill Affinity used last turn.

If a Lust Affinity Attack Skill was used last turn: Gain 1 of every Affinity E.G.O resource that does not correspond to any Attack Skill Affinity used last turn instead.
cn:
回合开始时，随机获得1个上回合使用的攻击技能属性以外的1种E.G.O资源。

若上回合使用了色欲攻击技能，则改为获得上回合使用的攻击技能属性以外的所有E.G.O资源各1个。

en:
Turn Start: When dealing damage with an Attack Skill for the first time, deal half its damage as fixed damage to a random enemy.

If the Attack Skill's Affinity was Lust, deal said damage to two random enemies instead.
cn:
回合开始时，随机对1名敌方单位造成首次对敌方单位造成伤害的攻击技能伤害量50%的固定伤害。

若该技能为色欲技能，则改为随机对2名敌方单位造成固定伤害。

en:
When hitting an enemy using a single-Coin Skill, inflict 1 [Laceration] Potency. Inflict 2 [DefenseDown] until the end of the next turn.
If the target already has [Laceration] or 'Unique Bleed', inflict 3 [Laceration] Potency instead.
cn:
使用单硬币技能造成伤害时，使目标增加1级[Laceration]强度并直到下回合对其施加2层[DefenseDown]。

若目标带有[Laceration]或特殊流血，则增加的[Laceration]强度改为3级。

en:
When hitting an enemy with a Lust Affinity Skill or a Skill that inflicts [Combustion] Potency or 'Unique Burn', inflict 3 [Combustion] Potency.

Turn Start: If the enemy has 20+ [Combustion] Potency, (Current [Combustion] Potency on enemy) x2
cn:
使用增加[Combustion]强度或施加特殊烧伤的技能或色欲技能对敌方单位造成伤害时，使目标增加3级[Combustion]强度。

回合开始时，使[Combustion]强度不低于20级的全体敌方单位的[Combustion]强度变为2倍。

en:

Turn End: Trigger [VibrationExplosion] on all enemies (or all Abnormality parts).

en:
When an ally with [Breath] at Combat Start Critical Hits an enemy, gain 5 [Breath] Potency and +2 [Breath] Count at the next Turn Start. (Once per turn)

If the Skill's Affinity was Gluttony, gain 7 [Breath] Potency and +3 [Breath] Count instead at the next Turn Start.
cn:
当战斗开始时带有[Breath]的友方单位使用技能对敌方单位造成暴击时，下回合开始时使该友方单位增加5级[Breath]强度并获得2层[Breath]。(每回合最多1次)

若技能为暴食技能，则改为下回合开始时增加7级[Breath]强度并获得3层[Breath]。

en:
This Gift activates when an ally has 15+ [Charge] Count at Turn Start. (including 'Unique Charge')

Combat Start: the ally with 15+ [Charge] Count loses 3 [Charge] Count and gains 5 'Offense Level' for the turn.
cn:
回合开始时，若有人格的[Charge]层数不低于15层，则发动效果。(包括特殊充能)

战斗开始时，该人格消耗3层[Charge]并在本回合内增加5级攻击等级。

en:
Turn Start: gain +1 E.G.O resource of a random Affinity for each non-Gluttony E.G.O skill used last turn.

If a Gluttony Affinity E.G.O Skill was used, gain +3 E.G.O resources of a random Affinity for each Gluttony E.G.O Skill used last turn instead.
cn:
回合开始时，上回合每使用一个暴食以外属性的E.G.O技能，随机获得1个E.G.O资源。

若上回合使用了暴食属性E.G.O技能，则改为上一回合每使用一个暴食属性的E.G.O技能，随机获得3个E.G.O资源。

en:
When hitting and dealing HP damage to an enemy with a Skill, inflict 3 [Sinking] Potency.

If the Skill's Affinity was Gluttony, inflict 5 [Sinking] Potency instead.
cn:
使用技能对敌方单位造成体力伤害时，使目标增加3级[Sinking]强度。

若该技能为暴食技能，则改为使目标增加5级[Sinking]强度。

en:
Turn Start: inflict 3 [Burst] Potency and +3 [Burst] Count on all enemies. (or all Abnormality Parts)

Turn End: Inflict ([Burst] Potency x [Burst] Count) Gluttony damage to all enemies. (for Abnormalities, all Parts) (counts up to 5 Rupture Count)
cn:
回合开始时，使全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)增加3级[Burst]强度并对其施加3层[Burst]。

回合结束时，对全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)造成(其[Burst]强度×[Burst]层数)点暴食伤害。(最多计入5层[Burst])

en:
Deal +12.5% damage and take -12.5% damage against enemies that had [Sinking] at Combat Start.

Allies with Gloom Affinity Attack Skills deal +20% damage and take -20% damage instead.
cn:
对战斗开始时带有[Sinking]的敌方单位造成的伤害+12.5%，受到来自以上单位的伤害-12.5%。

对于拥有忧郁攻击技能的友方单位，则改为对带有[Sinking]的敌方单位造成的伤害+20%，受到来自以上单位的伤害-20%。

en:
Turn End: allies with 7+ ([Charge] Count + 'Unique Charge') gain 1 [Agility] next turn.

If the ally has Gloom Affinity Skills, gain 2 [Agility] and 1 [ResultEnhancement] next turn instead.
cn:
回合结束时，使[Charge]与特殊充能层数之和不低于7层的友方单位在下回合获得1层[Agility]。

若该友方单位拥有忧郁攻击技能，则改为获得2层[Agility]与1层[ResultEnhancement]。

en:
Deal +35% damage against enemies suffering negative effects (Low Morale, Panic) from SP loss.

If the Skill inflicts [Sinking] Potency or Count(including 'Unique Sinking'), deal +10% damage in addition to the above.

When [Sinking]'s effect applies to enemies that are Non-SP Units, the Affinity of the damage inflicted changes to whatever is the most effective.
cn:
对因理智值降低而获得负面状态(士气低落，恐慌)的敌方单位造成的伤害+35%。

增加[Sinking]强度或施加[Sinking]层数的技能造成的伤害额外+10%(包括特殊<noparse>沉沦</noparse>)

对未带有理智值的敌方单位触发[Sinking]效果时，改为对其造成包括忧郁属性在内的所有罪孽属性中最有效的属性伤害。

cn: 战斗中通过技能伤害使敌方单位陷入混乱时，对目标造成其体力上限33%(若是异想体，则为相应的部位)的固定伤害，并在下回合对其施加2层[Vulnerable](每场战斗最多1次)。

Whenever an enemy dies, gain +2 Pride E.G.O resources and +1 E.G.O resource for 2 other random Affinities.

关卡开始时，获得5个傲慢属性E.G.O资源。

敌方单位阵亡时，获得2个傲慢属性E.G.O资源，并随机获得2种其余属性的E.G.O资源各1个。

Combat Start: Inflict 2 [Sinking] Potency on all enemies with less than 0 SP. (for Abnormalities, one random part)

For each Envy Affinity Skill used, randomly inflict 1 [Sinking] Potency between all enemies next turn. (for Abnormalities, one random part)

战斗开始时，使理智值低于0点的全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则随机对1个部位)增加2级[Sinking]强度。

使用嫉妒技能时，下回合随机使全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则随机对1个部位)增加共计1级[Sinking]强度。

en:
Combat Start: Inflict <style="upgradeHighlight">3 [Sinking] Potency</style> on all enemies with less than 0 SP. (for Abnormalities, one random part)

For each Envy Affinity Skill used, randomly inflict <style="upgradeHighlight">2 [Sinking] Potency</style> between all enemies next turn. (for Abnormalities, one random part)
cn:
战斗开始时，使理智值低于0点的全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则随机对1个部位)<style="upgradeHighlight">增加3级[Sinking]强度。</style>

使用嫉妒技能时，下回合随机使全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则随机对1个部位)增加共计<style="upgradeHighlight">2级[Sinking]强度</style>。

en:
Combat Start: Inflict <style="upgradeHighlight">4 [Sinking] Potency and +1 [Sinking] Count</style> on all enemies with less than 0 SP. (for Abnormalities, one random part)

For each Envy Affinity Skill used, randomly inflict <style="upgradeHighlight">3 [Sinking] Potency</style> between all enemies next turn. (for Abnormalities, one random part)
cn:
战斗开始时，使理智值低于0点的全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则随机对1个部位)<style="upgradeHighlight">增加4级[Sinking]强度并对其施加1层[Sinking]。</style>

使用嫉妒技能时，下回合随机使全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则随机对1个部位)增加共计<style="upgradeHighlight">3级[Sinking]强度</style>。

en: Turn Start: one ally under 50% HP heals 25% of Max HP. (Once per Encounter; does not activate if the ally is dead)
cn: 回合开始时，使现存体力不高于50%的1名友方单位恢复其体力上限25%的体力(单位阵亡时不触发，每场战斗最多1次)

en: Turn Start: Staggered allies heal by 12.5% of Max HP and gain 3 [Protection] for this turn.
cn: 回合开始时，若有陷入混乱的友方单位，则使其恢复体力上限12.5%的体力并在本回合获得3层[Protection]。

en: After winning a combat Encounter, gain 3 Cost for each enemy defeated.
cn: 战斗胜利后，获得(阵亡敌方单位数量×3)点经费。

en: Gain +20% Cost after winning a combat Encounter. (Not affected by Starter Buffs or other E.G.O Gifts)
cn: 战斗胜利后获得的经费增加20%(不受开局增益与其他E.G.O饰品的影响)。

en: Upon clearing Floor Boss: gain (80 + # of Identities participating in the Encounter x 5) additional Cost (unaffected by effects that raise Cost after clearing an Encounter)
cn: 通过阶层头目时，额外获得(80+该战斗参战人格数×5)点经费(不受通过战斗时获得经费增加的效果影响)。

en: After using a Plus Coin Skill, fully heal the ally's SP at the next Turn Start. (Unless corroded)
cn: 使用硬币类型为加算的技能后，在下回合开始时使该单位的理智值变为最大值(不包括侵蚀的单位)。

en: Upon Acquisition: All Deployed Identities gain 5 Levels.
cn: 获得该饰品时，编队中的所有人格提升5级。

en: Upon Acquisition: All Deployed Identities <style="upgradeHighlight">gain 7 Levels</style>
cn: 获得该饰品时，编队中的所有人格<style="upgradeHighlight">提升7级。</style>

en: Upon Acquisition: All Deployed Identities <style="upgradeHighlight">gain 10 Levels</style>
cn: 获得该饰品时，编队中的所有人格<style="upgradeHighlight">提升10级。</style>

en: All type and Affinity resistances of enemies (for Abnormalities, all Parts) change to 'Fatal'.
cn: 全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)的物理抗性及罪孽抗性全部变为“致命”。

en:
Turn Start: select one of the fastest allies and apply 5 [Agility] to them next turn.

Next Turn Start: select one of the other fastest allies (allies without the Ancient Effigy effect) and re-apply the Gift effect to them. (effect expires if no other allies can be selected)

At 10+ Speed, the ally gains (Speed difference with the target / 2) Offense Level (max 5; rounded down)
cn:
回合开始时，使速度值最高的1名友方单位在下回合获得5层[Agility]

下回合开始时，使未受古代雕像影响的速度值最高的1名友方单位获得该效果(若没有可选择的单位，则解除该效果)

若自身的速度值不低于10，则使自身增加(与目标的速度值之差/2)级攻击等级(最多5级，向下取整)

en:
Turn Start: A random ally deals +10% damage and gains Shield equal to 49% of max HP (effective until Non-disclosure Agreement effect expires)

The ally deals additional +10% damage every time it hits with a Skill and deals HP damage to an enemy (max +40% damage)

If the ally takes HP damage, the Gift's effect expires. At the next Turn Start, apply the same Gift effect to another random ally. (accumulated damage boost carries over; effect expires if no other allies can be selected)
cn:
回合开始时，随机使1名友方单位造成的伤害+10%并使其获得其体力上限49%的护盾(直到保密协议的效果被移除)

每当该友方单位使用技能对敌方单位造成体力伤害，使其造成的伤害额外+10%(最多+40%)

当该友方单位受到体力伤害时，移除该效果。下回合开始时，随机使另一名友方单位获得该效果。(保留额外增加的伤害；若没有可选择的单位，则移除该效果)

en:
Turn End: Inflict 2 [Binding] to enemies (for Abnormalities, their Parts) with 10+ [Vibration] Potency.

If the target has 20+ [Vibration] Potency, apply 2 [Binding] and 1 [Paralysis] instead.
cn: 回合结束时，对[Vibration]强度不低于10级的全体敌方单位(或异想体的对应部位)在下回合施加2层[Binding]。若该单位的[Vibration]强度不低于20级，则改为施加2层[Binding]与1层[Paralysis]。

en: After defeating an enemy with a [Combustion] effect, 2 allies with Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency gains 1 [AttackDmgUp] at the next Turn Start.
cn: 通过[Combustion]效果击杀敌方单位后，下回合开始时使拥有增加[Combustion]强度的技能的2名友方人格获得1层[AttackDmgUp]。

en: After defeating an enemy with a [Combustion] effect, 2 allies with Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency gains <style="upgradeHighlight">2 [AttackDmgUp]</style> at the next Turn Start.
cn: 通过[Combustion]效果击杀敌方单位后，下回合开始时使拥有增加[Combustion]强度的技能的2名友方人格<style="upgradeHighlight">获得2层[AttackDmgUp]。</style>

en: After defeating an enemy with a [Combustion] effect, <style="upgradeHighlight">3 allies</style> with Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency gains 2 [AttackDmgUp] at the next Turn Start.
cn: 通过[Combustion]效果击杀敌方单位后，下回合开始时使拥有增加[Combustion]强度的技能的<style="upgradeHighlight">3名友方人格</style>获得2层[AttackDmgUp]。

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Combustion] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn' (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Turn Start: Inflict +6 [Combustion] Count to all enemies and randomly inflict a total of 15 [Combustion] Potency between all enemies (or all Abnormality Parts; once per wave)

Plus Coin Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn': Final Power +1, Coin Power +1, inflicted [Combustion] Potency +1, inflicted [Combustion] Count +1
- Minus Coin Base Attack Skills: Instead of gaining Coin Power, gain Base Power +(4 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down)

When winning a Clash with a Skill that inflicts [Combustion] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn', inflict (# of remaining Coins + 1) [Combustion] Potency to the target enemy.
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有增加[Combustion]强度，施加[Combustion]层数或施加特殊烧伤的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果。(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)

回合开始时，对全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)施加6层[Combustion]并随机使全体敌方单位增加共计15级[Combustion]强度。(每个波次最多1次)

使增加[Combustion]强度，施加[Combustion]层数或施加特殊烧伤的加算硬币技能的最终威力+1，硬币威力+1，使目标增加的[Combustion]强度额外+1级，对目标施加的[Combustion]层数额外+1层。
- 减算硬币技能改为基础威力+(4/硬币数)，而非硬币威力(最少+1，向下取整)

增加[Combustion]强度，施加[Combustion]层数或施加特殊烧伤的技能拼点胜利时，使目标敌方单位增加(剩余硬币数+1)级[Combustion]强度

en:
When hitting and dealing 12+ HP damage to an enemy with a Skill, inflict 2 [Laceration] Potency.

When using a Slash Skill, inflict 4 [Laceration] Potency instead.
cn:
使用单个技能对敌方单位造成不低于12点体力伤害时，使其增加2级[Laceration]强度。

若该技能为斩击技能，则改为增加4级[Laceration]强度。

en:
When hitting and dealing 12+ HP damage to an enemy with a Skill, inflict <style="upgradeHighlight">3 [Laceration] Potency</style> on target.

When using a Slash Skill, inflict <style="upgradeHighlight">5 [Laceration] Potency</style> instead.
cn:
使用单个技能对敌方单位造成不低于12点体力伤害时，使其<style="upgradeHighlight">增加3级[Laceration]强度。</style>

若该技能为斩击技能，则改为<style="upgradeHighlight">增加5级[Laceration]强度。</style>

en:
Whenever an ally deals <style="upgradeHighlight">1+ HP damage to an enemy with a Skill</style>, inflict 3 [Laceration] Potency on target.

When using a Slash Skill, inflict 5 [Laceration] Potency and <style="upgradeHighlight">+1 [Laceration] Count</style> instead.
cn:
使用单个技能<style="upgradeHighlight">对敌方单位造成不低于1点体力伤害时</style>，使其增加3级[Laceration]强度。

若该技能为斩击技能，则改为增加5级[Laceration]强度<style="upgradeHighlight">并施加1层[Laceration]。</style>

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Laceration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Bleed'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Allies inflict double the amount of [Laceration] Potency and Count with Skill effects against enemies.

The ally with the earliest Deployment order: Plus Coin Skills that inflict [Laceration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Bleed': Coin Power +2 and deal +100% damage.
- Minus Coin Skills: Instead of gaining Coin Power, gain Base Power +(8 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down)
If the enemy attacked by or Clashed with the said ally dies, inflict the defeated enemy's remaining [Laceration] Potency randomly between all enemies. (for Focused Encounters, Parts)

Plus Coin Skills that inflict [Laceration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Bleed': Coin Power +1, deal +30% damage
- Minus Coin Skills: Instead of gaining Coin Power, gain Base Power +(4 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down)
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有增加[Laceration]强度，施加[Laceration]层数或施加特殊流血的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果。(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)

全体友方单位通过技能效果使敌方单位增加的[Laceration]强度与对敌方单位施加的[Laceration]层数变为2倍。

最先编入的人格增加[Laceration]强度，施加[Laceration]层数或施加特殊流血的加算硬币技能的硬币威力+2，造成的伤害+100%。
- 减算硬币技能改为基础威力+(8/硬币数)，而非硬币威力(最少+1，向下取整)
受到该人格攻击或与其拼点的敌方单位阵亡时，将阵亡的敌方单位的[Laceration]强度随机施加给全体敌方单位。(若是集中遭遇战，则改为以部位判定)

所有增加[Laceration]强度，施加[Laceration]层数或施加特殊流血的加算硬币技能的硬币威力+1，造成的伤害+30%
- 减算硬币技能改为基础威力+(4/硬币数)，而非硬币威力(最少+1，向下取整)

en: Inflict 1 [Vulnerable] this turn to enemies affected by [VibrationExplosion]. (Activates once per Attack Skill that triggers [VibrationExplosion])
cn: 使敌方单位[VibrationExplosion]时，本回合对其施加1层[Vulnerable](每个[VibrationExplosion]的攻击技能最多1次)。

en: Inflict 1 [Vulnerable] <style="upgradeHighlight">this turn and next turn</style> to enemies affected by [VibrationExplosion]. (Activates once per Attack Skill that triggers [VibrationExplosion])
cn: 使敌方单位[VibrationExplosion]时，<style="upgradeHighlight">本回合与下回合</style>对其施加1层[Vulnerable](每个[VibrationExplosion]的攻击技能最多1次)

en: <style="upgradeHighlight">Inflict 2 [Vulnerable]</style> this turn and next turn to enemies affected by [VibrationExplosion]. (Activates once per Attack Skill that triggers [VibrationExplosion])
cn: 使敌方单位[VibrationExplosion]时，本回合与下回合对其<style="upgradeHighlight">施加2层[Vulnerable]</style>(每个[VibrationExplosion]的攻击技能最多1次)

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Inflict 5 [Vibration] and +5 [Vibration] Count to all enemies. (or all Abnormality parts; once per wave)

Apply 5 [Vibration] Potency and 2 [Vulnerable] this turn and next turn to enemies affected by [VibrationExplosion]. (activates once per Attack Skill that triggers [VibrationExplosion])

After triggering 3 [VibrationExplosion] to a target this turn, Stagger the target at the next Turn Start and add a new Stagger Threshold at 66% and 33% marks of the target's current HP. (once per Encounter)

When triggering [Switch_Vibration] or [FusionVibration], inflict 1 [Vulnerable] (3 times per turn)
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有增加[Vibration]强度或施加[Vibration]层数的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果。(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)

回合开始时，使全体敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)增加5级[Vibration]强度并对其施加5层[Vibration]。(每个波次最多1次)

使敌方单位[VibrationExplosion]时，本回合与下回合使其增加5级[Vibration]强度并对其施加2层[Vulnerable]。(每个[VibrationExplosion]的攻击技能最多触发1次)

若本回合使1名敌方单位[VibrationExplosion]3次，则下回合开始时使其陷入混乱并在现存体力66%与33%处生成1条混乱阈值。(每场战斗最多1次)

造成[Switch_Vibration]或[FusionVibration]时，施加1层[Vulnerable](每回合最多3次)

en: Turn End: If there are enemies or Abnormality parts with [Burst], apply 1 [AttackDmgUp] or 1 [Agility] to a random ally next turn. Repeat (# of enemies(or # of Abnormality Parts) with [Burst] + 1) times.
cn: 回合结束时，若有敌方单位或异想体部位带有[Burst]，则下回合随机使1名友方单位获得1层[AttackDmgUp]或1层[Agility]。触发(带有[Burst]的敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)数量+1)次。

en: Turn End: If there are enemies or Abnormality parts with [Burst], apply 1 [AttackDmgUp] or 1 [Agility] to a random ally next turn. Repeat <style="upgradeHighlight">(# of enemies(or # of Abnormality Parts) with [Burst] + 3)</style> times.
cn: 回合结束时，若有敌方单位或异想体部位带有[Burst]，则下回合随机使1名友方单位获得1层[AttackDmgUp]或1层[Agility]。<style="upgradeHighlight">触发(带有[Burst]的敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)数量+3)次</style>。

en: Turn End: If there are enemies or Abnormality parts with [Burst], apply <style="upgradeHighlight">1 [AttackDmgUp] and 1 [Agility]</style> to a random ally next turn. Repeat (# of enemies(or # of Abnormality Parts) with [Burst] + 3) times.
cn: 回合结束时，若有敌方单位或异想体部位带有[Burst]，则下回合随机使1名友方单位<style="upgradeHighlight">获得1层[AttackDmgUp]与1层[Agility]。</style>触发(带有[Burst]的敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为所有部位)数量+3)次。

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Burst] Potency or Count. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

When hitting an enemy with a Skill, inflict 5 [Burst] Potency
- Skills that inflict [Burst] Potency or Count: Inflict an additional 3 [Burst] Potency and +1 [Burst] Count (once per Skill)

When [Burst] Count on an enemy drops below 1, consume 10 [Burst] Potency instead of [Burst] Count. (This effect ends when [Burst] Potency drops below 10)

If the target has less than 3 [Burst] Count, inflict +1 more Count when inflicting [Burst] Count. (3 times per Encounter)
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果。(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)

技能命中敌方单位时，使其增加5级[Burst]强度
- 令增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的攻击技能额外增加3级[Burst]强度并施加1层[Burst](每个技能最多1次)

Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

On Hit against an enemy with a Skill: inflict 5 [Sinking] Potency.

Turn Start: enemies or Parts with [Sinking] regain ([Sinking] Count each enemy lost On Hit last turn / 2) [Sinking] Count.

On Hit with a Base Attack Skill: deal ([Sinking] Potency on target / 10) Gloom damage (min 1 damage)

On Hit with an Attack Skill: if the target's SP is below 0, Skill deals more damage the further the target's SP is from 0 (+1% damage per SP)
- If the target is Panicked, deal +50% damage instead
- For targets that are Non-SP Units: Deal +1% damage for every 2 [Sinking] Potency on target. If target has 90+ [Sinking] Potency, deal +50% damage instead
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有增加[Sinking]强度，施加[Sinking]层数或施加特殊沉沦的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果。(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)

使用技能命中敌方单位时，使其增加5级[Sinking]强度。

回合开始时，对全体敌方单位或所有部位重新施加(其上回合因受到攻击而消耗的[Sinking]层数/2)层[Sinking]。

基础攻击技能命中时，对目标造成(其[Sinking]强度/10)点忧郁伤害(最少1点伤害)。

攻击技能命中时，若目标的理智值低于0点，则每低1点，使该技能造成的伤害+1%
- 若目标陷入恐慌，则改为造成的伤害+50%
- 若目标未带有理智值，则其每带有2级[Sinking]强度，使该技能造成的伤害+1%。若目标的[Sinking]强度不低于90级，则改为造成的伤害+50%

斩击技能的攻击等级+2

自身每带有1级[Breath]强度，使自身斩击技能造成的伤害+1.5%(最多+30%)

en:
Turn Start: Activates when there are 3 or more <noparse>Dawn Office</noparse> Identities (counts Backup Identities)

Turn 1: Apply 2 [DawnLight] on all allies
Combat Start: <noparse>Dawn Office</noparse> Fixer Sinclair heals 10 SP, and the said Identity may enter the "Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion" state via the Passive effect of "Unstable Shell of Ego" at 25+ SP instead of 40+ SP

[<noparse>Dawn Office</noparse> Identities Exclusive Effect]
On Hit using Base Skills, inflict 2 [Combustion] and 2 [Vibration] on target (once per Skill)

- <noparse>Dawn Office</noparse> Identities' Base Skills count as "Skills that inflict [Combustion] and [Vibration]"
Encounter Start: If <noparse>Dawn Office</noparse> Faust is on the field, apply 1 [Firstlight] on the said Identity

回合开始时，若属于<noparse>黎明事务所</noparse>的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果(以编队人员为基准)
首个回合开始时，使全体友方单位获得2层[DawnLight]
战斗开始时，使<noparse>黎明事务所</noparse> 收尾人 辛克莱恢复10点理智值，该人格通过被动“不稳定的自我外壳”进入不稳定E.G.O::蜡翼状态的理智值条件改为不低于25点

[属于<noparse>黎明事务所</noparse>的人格专属]

属于<noparse>黎明事务所</noparse>的人格视作施加[Combustion]与[Vibration]的人格

关卡开始时，若<noparse>黎明事务所</noparse> 收尾人 浮士德在场，则使其获得1层[Firstlight]

en:
Turn Start: Activates when there are 3 or more "The Thumb" Identities (only counts Identities on the field)
Turn Start: "The Thumb" Identities gain 1 [PlusCoinValueUp] and 2 [AttackDmgUp]
"The Thumb" Identities gain 1 [AttackUp] for every "The Thumb" Identity on the field (max 4)
Deal +1% damage for every [VibrationIgnition] on target (max 20%)
- Skills that spend [Bullet] deal an additional +1% damage (max 20%)
- "The Thumb" Identities deal an additional +1% damage (max 20%)

Units that triggered [VibrationExplosion] with their Skill effects gain 2 [AttackUp] next turn (3 times per turn)

At Attack End of The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather Rodion's Skill 3, apply 1 [EvolvingManual] on The House of Spiders: The Thumb Apprentice Heathcliff
cn:
回合开始时，若属于拇指的人格不低于3名，则触发该效果(以参战人员为基准)
回合开始时，使属于拇指的人格获得1层[PlusCoinValueUp]与2层[AttackDmgUp]
每有1名属于拇指的人格，使全体属于拇指的人格获得1层[AttackUp](最多4层)
目标每带有1级[VibrationIgnition]强度，使自身造成的伤害+1%(最多+20%)
- 消耗[Bullet]的技能造成的伤害额外+1%(最多+20%)
- 属于拇指的人格造成的伤害额外+1%(最多+20%)

自身的技能触发[VibrationExplosion]时，下回合使自身获得2层[AttackUp](每回合最多3次)

蜘蛛巢 拇指 父辈 罗佳3技能攻击后，使蜘蛛巢 拇指 子辈 希斯克利夫获得1层[EvolvingManual]

en:
Ishmael's level rises to 40.
Ishmael's Uptie and Threadspin Tiers rise to Tier 4.
Ishmael gains [AaCePaBa] at the start of every encounter.
cn:
以实玛利人格等级提升至40
以实玛利人格同步与异想解析提升至4阶段
以实玛利在每场战斗开始时获得[AaCePaBa]。

en: When winning a clash using a Gloom affinity Skill, 1 ally with the lowest SP heals 5 SP
cn: 忧郁技能拼点胜利后，使理智值最低的1名友方单位恢复5点理智值

en: Pride damage taken -10%
cn: 受到来自傲慢技能的伤害-10%

en:
Deal +10% damage with Envy, Wrath, and Gloom affinity Skills
Deal additional +10% corresponding affinity damage when activating 6+ Reson. with one of these affinities
cn:
嫉妒，暴怒与忧郁技能造成的伤害+10%
若以上罪孽共鸣数不低于6，则使对应属性技能造成的伤害额外+10%

en: Inflict 1 additional [Vibration] with a Skill that inflicts Tremor
cn: 令施加[Vibration]的技能使目标额外增加1级[Vibration]强度

en: Turn End: if more than 15% of the Max HP was lost this turn, gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn
cn: 回合结束时，若本回合自身失去不低于体力上限15%的体力，则下回合使自身获得2层强壮

en: When at less than 0 SP, Final Power +1 to Envy, Wrath, and Gloom affinities
cn: 理智值低于0点时，使自身的嫉妒、暴怒与忧郁技能的最终威力+1

en: Gain 1 Poise when a Skill's first coin Heads Hits against an enemy with [Laceration]
cn: 技能的第1枚硬币正面命中带有[Laceration]的敌方单位时，使自身增加1级呼吸法 强度

en: Identities with [Bullet] start encounters with +3 max Ammo
cn: 带有[Bullet]的人格弹药 上限+3

en:
Ishmael's Skills gain +2 Final Power
When an ally dies, remaining allies gain 1 Haste and 1 Attack Power Up next turn (Once per turn)
cn:
以实玛利技能的最终威力+2
友方单位阵亡时，下回合使剩余友方单位获得1层迅捷 与1层强壮 (每回合最多1次)

en:
Upon obtaining this E.G.O Gift, gain the following effects:
• Don Quixote's level rises to 50
• Don Quixote's Uptie and Threadspin Tiers rise to Tier 4
(If the Level, Uptie Tier, or Threadspin Tier are higher than the above values, then maintain those values.)
cn:
获得本E.G.O饰品后在迷宫中获得以下效果
· 堂吉诃德人格等级提升至50
· 堂吉诃德人格同步与异想解析提升至4阶段
(若人格等级、同步阶段、异想解析阶段高于此级别，则保持不变)

en: On Hit against targets with 10+ (sum of [Laceration], 'Unique Bleed', and [Burst]): gain 1 [Breath] Potency and Count (3 times per Skill)
cn: 攻击命中[Laceration]强度、特殊流血与[Burst]强度之和不低于10点的敌方单位时，使自身增加1级[Breath]强度并使自身获得1层[Breath](每个技能最多3次)

en: First Turn Start of an Encounter: all units gain 4 [Laceration] Potency and Count.
cn: 关卡的首个回合开始时，使全体单位增加4级[Laceration]强度并对其施加4层[Laceration]。

en:
On Kill with a Skill damage: 1 ally with the least SP heals 8 SP.
Attack End: If an enemy with 10+ (sum of [Laceration], 'Unique Bleed', and [Burst]) is defeated, the unit who killed that enemy gains 2 [AttackUp] next turn. (3 times per turn)
cn:
通过技能伤害击杀敌方单位时，使理智值最低的1名友方单位恢复8点理智值。
攻击结束后，若有[Laceration]强度、特殊流血与[Burst]强度之和不低于10点的敌方单位阵亡，则下回合使击杀该敌方单位的单位获得2层[AttackUp](每回合最多3次)。

en: When 1 ally with currently the highest HP percentage uses an Attack Skill, gain 10 [Laceration], 3 [AttackUp], and 3 [DefenseUp]. (once per turn)
cn: 现存体力比例最高的1名友方单位使用攻击技能时，使其增加10级[Laceration]强度并使其获得3层[AttackUp]与3层[DefenseUp](每回合最多1次)

en: Chain Battles: when a new enemy enters the battle, inflict 5 [Laceration] and +3 [Laceration] Count against that enemy at Combat Start.
cn: 连续遭遇战中有新的敌方单位登场时，战斗开始时使其增加5级[Laceration]强度并对其施加3层[Laceration]。

en:
When an ally dies, gain 1 E.G.O resource for each of that ally's Skills 1, 2, and 3 and 1 random E.G.O resource
Attack End: If the enemy is killed, gain 1 random E.G.O resource (once per Skill)
cn:
友方单位阵亡时，获得其1、2、3技能对应的E.G.O资源各1个与1个随机的E.G.O资源
攻击结束后，若敌方单位阵亡，则随机获得1个E.G.O资源(每个技能最多1次)

en:
First Turn Start of an Encounter: every Identity on the field loses 5 SP and gains 1 [Enhancement] for 3 turns.
If the said Identity is a Bloodfiend, lose 10 SP, gain 2 [Enhancement] for 3 turns, and inflict +1 more [Laceration] Potency and Count with its Skill & Coin effects
cn:
关卡的首个回合开始时，使全体参战的人格失去5点理智值，3回合内使其获得1层[Enhancement]。
若该人格属于血魔，则使其失去10点理智值，3回合内使其获得2层[Enhancement]，令其技能或硬币效果增加的[Laceration]强度与施加的[Laceration]层数额外+1

en:
On Clash Win with a Pride Skill: heal 5 SP.
On Hit after Clash Win with the said Skill: inflict +1 [Laceration] Count and +1 [Burst] Count (4 times per Skill)
cn:
友方单位傲慢技能拼点胜利时，使其恢复5点理智值。
该技能拼点胜利后命中时，对目标施加1层[Laceration]与1层[Burst](每个技能最多4次)

en:
On Hit against targets with [Laceration] or 'Unique Bleed': heal 2~5 HP.
Skills that consume [BloodDinner]: Coin Power +1
cn:
攻击命中带有[Laceration]或特殊流血的目标时，使自身恢复2~5点体力
消耗[BloodDinner]的技能硬币威力+1

en:
All of Don Quixote's Skills gain Final Power +2
When an ally dies, the remaining allies heal 15 SP, and at Turn End, gain 1 [Enhancement] next turn (max [Enhancement]: 3)
cn:
堂吉诃德所有技能的最终威力+2
友方单位阵亡时，使剩余的友方单位恢复15点理智值，回合结束时，下回合获得1层[Enhancement](最大[Enhancement]获得量：3)

en:
When hitting an enemy using a single-Coin Skill, inflict 1 [Laceration] Potency. Inflict 2 [DefenseDown] until the end of the next turn.
If the target already has [Laceration] or 'Unique Bleed', inflict 3 [Laceration] Potency instead.
cn:
使用单硬币技能造成伤害时，使目标增加1级[Laceration]强度并直到下回合对其施加2层[DefenseDown]。

若目标带有[Laceration]或特殊流血，则增加的[Laceration]强度改为3级。

en:
Turn End: Inflict [Burst] Potency on all enemies equal to their current Speed values.

When activating Lust Absolute Resonance, apply 3 [Burst] Potency and +3 [Burst] Count to a random enemy at Combat Start.
cn:
回合结束时，使全体敌方单位增加与其速度值相等的[Burst]强度。

激活色欲完全共鸣时，在战斗开始时随机使1名敌方单位增加3级[Burst]强度并对其施加3层[Burst]。

en: At the start of a non-Focused Encounter, all enemies take fixed damage equal to 20% of their Max HP.
cn: 非集中遭遇战开始时，对全体敌方单位造成其体力上限20%的固定伤害。

en:
When dealing damage to an enemy with Attack Skills(Not counting E.G.O Skills) that inflict [Vibration] Potency, Count, or Unique Tremor, deal +10% damage.

If the Skill triggered [VibrationExplosion] on the enemy for the first time this turn, inflict +2 [Vibration] Count next turn (once per turn)
cn:
增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的攻击技能(不包括E.G.O技能)对敌方单位造成的伤害+10%

若该技能本回合首次使敌方单位[VibrationExplosion]，则下回合对其施加2层[Vibration](每回合最多1次)

en:
When Clashing with a faster enemy, Clash Power +1.

When dealing damage to a faster enemy, inflict 3 [Vibration] Potency and +2 [Vibration] Count next turn. (once per turn)
cn:
与速度值高于自身的敌方单位拼点时，使自身的拼点威力+1。

对速度值高于自身的敌方单位造成伤害时，下回合使该敌方单位增加3级[Vibration]强度并对其施加2层[Vibration](每回合最多1次)。

en:
Turn End: Inflict 1 [Binding] to the fastest enemy next turn. (for Abnormalities, a Part)

If the target has [Vibration] or 'Unique Tremor', inflict 2 [Binding] instead.

When an ally attacks targets with [Binding], deal +(5 + (2.5 x [Binding] value)) more damage. (max 15%)
cn:
回合结束时，对速度值最高的1名敌方单位在下回合施加1层[Binding](若是异想体，则改为1个部位)。

若目标带有[Vibration]或特殊震颤，则改为施加2层[Binding]。

友方单位攻击带有[Binding]的目标时，造成的伤害+(5+(目标的[Binding]层数×2.5))%(最多+15%)。

en:
First Turn Start of a wave: inflict (9 - current Speed) [Vibration] Potency to 3 enemies with the slowest Speed. (min. 3)

Deal +10% damage against targets with 12+ [Vibration] or 'Unique Tremor' at Turn Start.
cn:
波次的首个回合开始时，使速度值最低的3名敌方单位增加(9-当前速度值)级[Vibration]强度(最少3级)。

对回合开始时带有的[Vibration]或特殊震颤强度不低于12级的敌方单位造成的伤害+10%。

en:
First Turn Start of a wave: inflict (9 - current Speed) [Vibration] Potency (min. 3) and (9 - current Speed)/2 [Vibration] Count to 1 enemy with the fastest Speed. (rounded up; for Abnormalities, a Part)

Take -10% damage from targets with 12+ [Vibration] or 'Unique Tremor' at Turn Start.
cn:
波次的首个回合开始时，使速度值最高的1名敌方单位增加(9-当前速度值)级[Vibration]强度(最少3级)并对其施加层数相当于该数值一半的[Vibration](向上取整，若是异想体，则改为1个部位)。

受到回合开始时带有的[Vibration]或特殊震颤强度不低于12级的敌方单位的伤害-10%。

en:
When an ally with Attack Skills(Not E.G.O Skills) that inflict [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor' wins a Clash, inflict 2 [Vibration] Potency and +2 [Vibration] Count. (2 times per turn)

Yurodivy Identities: inflict 3 [Vibration] Potency and +3 [Vibration] Count instead (3 times per turn)

If the affected Identity Clashes against targets with higher Offense Levels, Clash Power +2; deal +20% damage when attacking after winning the Clash.
cn:
拥有增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的攻击技能(不包括E.G.O技能)的友方单位与敌方单位拼点胜利时，使目标增加2级[Vibration]强度并对其施加2层[Vibration](每回合最多2次)。

属于圣愚的人格改为增加3级[Vibration]强度并施加3层[Vibration](每回合最多3次)

该人格与攻击等级高于自身的敌方单位拼点时，使该友方单位的拼点威力+2，拼点胜利后造成的伤害+20%。

en:
Deal +(5 + (2.5 x Speed difference))% damage against faster enemies with 2+ Speed difference. (max 15%)

Turn End: If an ally dealt damage with an Attack Skill (Not counting E.G.O Skills) this turn against faster enemies with 2+ Speed difference, inflict 2 [Binding] and 1 [ResultReduction] to the enemy next turn. (once per turn)
cn:
对速度值高于自身至少2点的敌方单位造成的伤害+(5+速度值之差×2.5)%(最多+15%)。

回合结束时，若本回合通过攻击技能(不包括E.G.O技能)对速度值高于自身至少2点的敌方单位造成了伤害，则下回合对该敌方单位施加2层[Binding]与1层[ResultReduction](每回合最多1次)。

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

To allies' Skill 3s that inflict [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor': Coin Power +2 and deal +25% damage.

When an ally that inflicts [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor' triggers [Switch_Vibration] on an enemy with Attack Skills(Including E.G.O Skills): multiply the [Vibration] Potency and Count by 1.5(only when actually Converting them into different 'Tremor' types) and inflict 5 [DefenseDown] next turn. (once per turn)

Turn Start: inflict (12 - current Speed) [Vibration] Potency (min. 6) to 3 enemies with the slowest Speed. (once per wave)
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)。

友方单位增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的3技能硬币威力+2，造成的伤害+25%。

增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的友方单位通过攻击技能(包括E.G.O技能)使敌方单位[Switch_Vibration]时，使该敌方单位转换后的[Vibration]强度与层数变为1.5倍(仅在转换为其他类型的[Vibration]时生效)并在下回合对该敌方单位施加5层[DefenseDown](每回合最多1次)。

回合开始时，使速度值最低的3名敌方单位增加(12-当前速度值)级[Vibration]强度(最少6级，每个波次最多1次)。

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor' effects. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

To allies' Skill 3s that inflict [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor': Coin Power +2 and deal +25% damage.

When an ally that inflicts [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor' deals damage to a slower enemy with 2+ Speed difference between them: deal +([Vibration] Potency on target, max 25)% damage and inflict 2 [DefenseDown] every time the ally deals damage (max 6)

Turn Start: inflict (12 - current Speed) [Vibration] Potency (min. 6) and (12 - current Speed)/2 [Vibration] Count to 1 enemy with the fastest Speed. (rounded up; for Abnormalities, a Part; once per wave)
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)。

友方单位增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的3技能硬币威力+2，造成的伤害+25%。

增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的友方单位与速度值低于自身至少2点的敌方单位拼点时，使该友方单位造成的伤害+(目标的[Vibration]强度)%(最多+25%)，造成伤害时对目标施加2层[DefenseDown](最多6层)。

回合开始时，使速度值最高的1名敌方单位增加(12-当前速度值)级[Vibration]强度(最少6级)并对其施加层数相当于该数值一半的[Vibration](向上取整，若是异想体，则改为1个部位，每个波次最多1次)。

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor' effects. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

To allies' Skill 3s that inflict [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor': Coin Power +2 and deal +25% damage.

Yurodivy Identities: Skill 3 gains Coin Power +2 and deal +(25 + (sum of [Vibration] Potency and Count on target))% damage. (max 100%)

Yurodivy Identities: gain +3 [Vibration] Count at Turn Start.
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)。

友方单位增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的3技能硬币威力+2，造成的伤害+25%。

属于圣愚的人格改为3技能的硬币威力+2，造成的伤害+(25+(目标的[Vibration]强度与[Vibration]层数之和))%(最多+100%)。

回合开始时，对属于圣愚的人格施加3层[Vibration]。

en:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor' effects. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

To allies' Skill 3s that inflict [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor': Coin Power +2 and deal +25% damage.

When an ally that inflicts [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor' Clashes against a faster enemy with 2+ Speed difference: Clash Power +2 and deal +([Vibration] Potency on target)% damage. (max 50%)

Turn Start: from slowest to fastest, the 3 slowest allies gain 5 [AttackUp], 3 [AttackUp], and 2 [AttackUp] respectively.
cn:
回合开始时，若拥有增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的攻击技能的人格不低于5名，则在本场战斗期间触发该效果(不包括E.G.O技能，不包括待命人员)。

友方单位增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的3技能硬币威力+2，造成的伤害+25%。

增加[Vibration]强度，施加[Vibration]层数或施加特殊震颤的友方单位与速度值高于自身至少2点的敌方单位拼点时，使该友方单位的拼点威力+2，造成的伤害+(目标的[Vibration]强度)%(最多+50%)。

回合开始时，使速度值最低的3名友方单位按速度值由低到高分别获得5层[AttackUp]，3层[AttackUp]与2层[AttackUp]。

en: All allies gain +5 Defense Level.

en: All allies gain +10% max HP.
cn: 全体友方单位的体力上限+10%。

en: At the start of the turn, allies with 50% or less health heal 5 HP.
cn: 回合开始时，使现存体力低于50%的友方单位恢复5点体力。

en: All allies gain +5 Offense Level and +5 Defense Level
cn: 全体友方单位的攻击等级+5，防御等级+5。

en: For the first 3 turns of battle, inflict 2 Bind on all enemies.
cn: 在战斗的前3回合对全体敌方单位施加2层束缚 。

en: On the first turn of battle, inflict 1 Burn on all enemies 5 times.
cn: 在战斗的第1回合使全体敌方单位增加1级烧伤 强度（可生效5次）。

en: All allies deal +10% damage.
cn: 全体友方单位造成的伤害+10%。

en: All allies gain +1 Speed.
cn: 全体友方单位的速度值+1。

en: All allies gain +10% max HP
cn: 全体友方单位的体力上限+10%。

en: At the start of the turn, apply 2 Protection to the ally with the least HP.
cn: 回合开始时，使现存体力最低的1名友方单位获得2层守护 。

en: At the start of the turn, apply 1 Protection to the ally with the least HP.
cn: 回合开始时，使现存体力最低的1名友方单位获得1层守护 。

en:
During battle, if an ally takes lethal damage, their HP won’t go below 1.
On the next turn, fully heal their HP and gain 3 Surgery.
They will die at the end of the battle.
(Activates once per dungeon, then the Gift expires.)
cn:
友方单位在战斗中受到使自身体力降至0点的伤害时，其体力不会低于1点。
下回合使其体力恢复至最大值，并使其获得3层手术 。
关卡结束后，该友方单位会直接阵亡。(一次性饰品，生效后消耗)

en: After winning a Clash using a Lust skill, inflict 1 Bind and 1 Fragile next turn.
cn: 使用色欲技能拼点胜利后，下回合开始时对目标施加1层束缚 和1层易损 。

Start the next 3 battles with 3 Haste.
Expires afterward.
cn:
关卡开始时，使全体友方单位获得3层迅捷 。
累计生效3次后失效。

en: Used in certain events. Expires on use.
cn: 在特定的事件中使用。使用后消耗。

en:
Allies with Lust skills gain the following effects:
If the unit took no damage from attacks this turn, gain 2 Haste and 2 Defense Power Up next turn.
If the unit took damage from attacks this turn, gain 2 Bind and 2 Attack Power Up next turn.
cn:
拥有色欲技能的罪人获得以下效果：
若本回合未受到攻击，则下回合获得2层迅捷 和2层忍耐 。
若本回合受到了攻击，则下回合获得2层束缚 和2层强壮 。

en: Used in certain events. Expires on use
cn: 在特定的事件中使用。使用后消耗。

en: For the Identity that undertook the rite: Boost the Power of Wrath skills by 2.
cn: 进行了相应仪式的人格得到以下效果：暴怒技能威力+2。

en: For the Identity that undertook the rite: Boost the Power of Gloom skills by 2.
cn: 进行了相应仪式的人格得到以下效果：忧郁技能威力+2。

en: At the start of the turn, if the character took 10+ damage last turn, heal 5-15 HP.
cn: 回合开始时，使上回合受到伤害不低于10点的友方单位恢复5~15点体力。

en: At the start of the turn, apply 2 Attack Power Up to allies at 25% or lower health.
cn: 回合开始时，使现存体力低于25%的友方单位获得2层强壮 。

en: Deal +10% damage in a won clash.
cn: 拼点胜利后造成的伤害+10%。

en: For the Identity that undertook the rite: Boost the Power of Lust skills by 2.
cn: 进行了相应仪式的人格得到以下效果：色欲技能威力+2。

en: All allies take -20% damage from Lust attacks.
cn: 全体友方单位受到的色欲伤害-20%。

en:
If an ally takes a lethal attack, they heal 50% of their max HP.
(Once per dungeon and expires after activation.)
cn:
友方单位在战斗中受到攻击时，若其体力低于1点，则使其恢复体力上限50%的体力。
(一次性饰品，生效后消耗)

en: Defense Skill Power +1
cn: 全体友方单位的守备技能威力+1。

en: When inflicting Tremor with skill effects, inflict 1 more at a 50% chance.
cn: 通过技能效果增加震颤 强度时，以50%的概率额外增加1级震颤 强度。

en: When inflicting Bleed with skill effects, inflict 1 more at a 50% chance.
cn: 通过技能效果增加流血 强度时，以50%的概率额外增加1级流血 强度。

en: When using a Pride skill, lose 5 SP, but boost its damage by 5%
cn: 使用傲慢技能时，失去5点理智值，并使该技能造成的伤害+5%

en: When inflicting [Combustion] with Skills against enemies, inflict +5 [Combustion] Count.
cn: 通过技能效果对敌方单位施加[Combustion]时，额外施加5层[Combustion]。

en: When inflicting [Burst] with Skills against enemies, inflict +5 [Burst] Count.
cn: 通过技能效果对敌方单位施加[Burst]时，额外施加5层[Burst]。

en: Allies gain Clash Power by half their Speed against opponents with lower Speed. (max 3)
cn: 若自身的速度值高于目标，则使拼点威力+(速度值/2) (最多+3)

en: Each turn, the first skill to deal damage to an enemy inflicts Bleed by 1/3 of the damage dealt.
cn:
以下效果仅对每回合中首个对敌方单位造成伤害的技能生效。

使目标增加(伤害量/3)级[Laceration]强度。

en: Each turn, the first skill to deal damage to an enemy deals bonus fixed damage by half of the damage dealt.
cn: 每回合中首次使用技能对敌方单位造成伤害后，对其额外造成(伤害量/2)点固定伤害。

en: At the start of the turn, allies under 40% HP heal 100% of max HP. (Once per floor)
cn: 回合开始时，使现存体力低于40%的友方单位恢复其体力上限100%的体力。(每层最多1次)

en: On the first turn of each encounter, gain 2 E.G.O resources of a random affinity in possession
cn: 关卡的首个回合开始时，随机使1种持有的E.G.O资源数量+2

en: Gluttony skills deal +10% damage
cn: 使暴食技能造成的伤害+10%

en: Pride skills deal +10% damage
cn: 使傲慢技能造成的伤害+10%

en: Sloth skills deal +10% damage
cn: 使怠惰技能造成的伤害+10%

en: When below 0 SP, Gloom and Sloth skills have +1 Final Power
cn: 理智值低于0点时，使自身的忧郁与怠惰技能的最终威力+1

en: When inflicting Sinking with skill effects, apply 1 more Sinking with a 50% chance
cn: 通过技能增加沉沦 强度时，以50%的概率额外增加1级沉沦 强度

en:
Take -10% Wrath-affinity damage
When hit, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn (Once per turn per Sinner)
cn:
受到的暴怒伤害-10%
受到攻击时，下回合使自身获得1层强壮 (每名罪人每回合最多1次)

en: When attacked, gain 1 Protection next turn (Once per turn per Sinner)
cn: 受到攻击时，下回合获得1层守护 (每名罪人每回合最多1次)

en: In a clash, Pride and Envy skills have +1 Clash Power
cn: 傲慢，嫉妒技能进行拼点时，拼点威力+1

en: Take -10% Pride-affinity damage "I would feel a desire to scatter into the winds in lush blue, sensing the sway of seeds plunging into my scrawling mind."
cn: 受到的傲慢伤害-10% “我升起一种欲望，想要消散在那葱葱郁郁的碧蓝之风中，感受着种子摇曳着嵌入躁动的心灵。”

en: Take -10% Gluttony-affinity damage "I saw no meaning in attempting to fathom the caprices of the weather. I would simply wait for things to calm, looking out for the day's arrival."
cn: 受到的暴食伤害-10% “试图了解变化无常的天气，在我看来是毫无意义的。我仅是等待那风雨平息，仅是抬首等待。”

en: Take -10% Gloom-affinity damage "Alas, I was careless in my assumption that I could simply observe slantwise as it comes to pass until it has seeped... Realization comes too late."
cn: 受到的忧郁伤害-10% “仅侧目一瞥，微有所感便觉足矣，不过是安于现状罢了……我如今才终于意识到这点。”

en: Take -10% Sloth-affinity damage "The explosion of the League of Nine shattered everything there was, and everything came to a halt for me as well."
cn: 受到的怠惰伤害-10% “九人会的崩裂粉碎了一切，我周围的一切也随之戛然而止。”

en: Yi Sang's skills gain +2 Final Power When an ally dies, remaining allies gain 1 Haste and 1 Attack Power Up next turn (Once per turn) "Taking a backward glance at our trails... all of us have been suffering great losses."
cn: 李箱的所有技能最终威力+2。 友方单位阵亡时，下回合使剩余友方单位获得1层迅捷 与1层强壮 (每回合最多1次) “回首过去的行迹……我们都失去了很多东西。”

en: Yi Sang's level rises to 35. Yi Sang's Uptie and Threadspin Tiers rise to Tier 3. "We were neither highfliers nor greedy vultures; we were merely children who loved technology."
cn: 李箱人格等级提升至35 李箱人格同步与异想解析提升至3阶段 “我们既非好高骛远之辈，也非贪得无厌之徒；我们只不过是喜爱技术的孩童。”

en:
If an ally consumed 10+ [Charge] Count in a single turn with its Base Skills, the said ally deals +20% damage with Base Skills next turn (excluding 'Unique Charge' with fixed Potency)
- If the [Charge] consumed was 'Unique Charge', inflict +1 more [Laceration] and [Laceration] Count next turn
cn:
若自身在一回合内通过基础技能消耗了不低于10层[Charge]，则下回合使自身基础技能造成的伤害+20%(不包括固定强度的特殊<noparse>充能</noparse>)
- 若消耗的[Charge]为特殊充能，则下回合令自身增加的[Laceration]强度与施加的[Laceration]层数额外+1

en:
Deal +20% damage with Blunt Skills against enemies that either have 35+ [Sinking] Potency or are at 15 or lower SP ([Sinking] Potency is calculated per-Part)
- If the said Blunt Skill is either a Gloom Skill or a Skill that inflicts [Laceration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Bleed', and hit the target, gain 1 [Enhancement] next turn (once per turn per Identity)
cn:
打击技能对理智值不高于15点或[Sinking]强度不低于35级的敌方单位造成的伤害+20%(沉沦 强度以部位判定)
- 若该打击技能为增加[Laceration]强度，施加[Laceration]层数或施加特殊流血的技能或忧郁技能，且该打击技能命中，则下回合使自身获得1层[Enhancement](每回合每名单位最多1次)

en:
The Ring-faction Identities: At Attack End, inflict 1 Stack of a random Attack Type Resist Down on target (2 times per turn)

The Ring-faction Identities deal +10% damage
cn:
属于环指的人格攻击后，对目标施加1层随机物理属性的抗性弱化(每回合最多2次)

属于环指的人格造成的伤害+10%

en:
Turn Start: Activates when there are 2 or more The Ring-faction Identities (only counts Identities on the field)

The Ring School of Corporism-faction Identities inflict 1 [SlashResistDown] On Hit with Base Skills (once per Skill; 2 times per turn)

The Ring Identities deal +20% damage

Turn Start: At 99+ total sum of [Laceration] Potency on all enemies, The Ring School of Corporism-faction Identities gain 1 [RingFingerPhysical]
cn:
回合开始时，若属于环指的人格不低于2名，则触发该效果(以参战人员为基准)

属于环指 人体派的人格基础技能命中时，对目标施加1层[SlashResistDown](每个技能最多1次，每回合最多2次)

属于环指的人格造成的伤害+20%

回合开始时，若全体敌方单位的[Laceration]强度总计不低于99级，则使属于环指 人体派的人格获得1层[RingFingerPhysical]

en:
Turn Start: Activates when there are 2 or more The Ring-faction Identities (only counts Identities on the field)

The Ring School of Fauvism-faction Identities inflict 1 [HitResistDown] On Hit with Base Skills (once per Skill; 2 times per turn)

The Ring Identities deal +20% damage

Turn Start: At 99+ total sum of [Laceration] Potency on all enemies, The Ring School of Fauvism-faction Identities gain 1 [RingFingerFauvism]
cn:
回合开始时，若属于环指的人格不低于2名，则触发该效果(以参战人员为基准)

属于环指 野兽派的人格基础技能命中时，对目标施加1层[HitResistDown](每个技能最多1次，每回合最多2次)

属于环指的人格造成的伤害+20%

回合开始时，若全体敌方单位的[Laceration]强度总计不低于99级，则使属于环指 野兽派的人格获得1层[RingFingerFauvism]

en: If the target has 1.5 or lower Blunt Resistance, Blunt Resistance +0.3
cn: 若敌方单位的打击抗性不高于1.5，则使其打击抗性+0.3

en:
At Attack End of a Skill that has 2+ Atk Weight, gain +(# of hits on an enemy / 2) E.G.O resource of that Skill's Affinity (rounded down; max 5 per Skill)

On Crit with a Skill that has 2+ Atk Weight, gain +(# of Coins that hit Critically) E.G.O resource of the least-owned Affinity at Attack End (max 3)
cn:
攻击容量不低于2的攻击技能攻击后，获得该技能对应属性的(该技能命中敌方单位次数/2)个E.G.O资源(向下取整，每个技能最多5个)

攻击容量不低于2的技能触发暴击后，在攻击后获得(触发暴击的硬币数)个持有量最少的E.G.O资源(最多3个)

en:
Max [Combustion] Potency +11

Triple the first [Combustion] Potency to be inflicted in the Encounter (once per Encounter)

When an enemy takes [Combustion] damage, deal Wrath damage equal to [Combustion] Potency

Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency, [Combustion] Count, or 'Unique Burn' deal +20% damage
cn:
最大[Combustion]强度+11

战斗中首次增加的[Combustion]强度变为3倍(每场战斗最多1次)

敌方单位受到[Combustion]伤害时，对其造成相当于其[Combustion]强度的暴怒伤害

增加[Combustion]强度，施加[Combustion]层数或施加特殊烧伤的技能造成的伤害+20%

en:
<style="upgradeHighlight">Max [Combustion] Potency +21</style>

Triple the first [Combustion] Potency to be inflicted in the Encounter (once per Encounter)

When an enemy takes [Combustion] damage, deal Wrath damage equal to [Combustion] Potency

Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency, [Combustion] Count, or 'Unique Burn' deal <style="upgradeHighlight">+25%</style> damage
cn:
最大[Combustion]强度<style="upgradeHighlight">+21</style>

战斗中首次增加的[Combustion]强度变为3倍(每场战斗最多1次)

敌方单位受到[Combustion]伤害时，对其造成相当于其[Combustion]强度的暴怒伤害

en:
Max [Combustion] Potency +21

Triple the first [Combustion] Potency to be inflicted in the Encounter (once per Encounter)

When an enemy takes [Combustion] damage, deal Wrath damage equal to ([Combustion] Potency x <style="upgradeHighlight">1.5</style>)

Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency, [Combustion] Count, or 'Unique Burn' deal <style="upgradeHighlight">+30%</style> damage
cn:
最大[Combustion]强度+21

战斗中首次增加的[Combustion]强度变为3倍(每场战斗最多1次)

敌方单位受到[Combustion]伤害时，对其造成<style="upgradeHighlight">(其[Combustion]强度×1.5)</style>点暴怒伤害
