en:
Turn End: Randomly apply 1 Stack of a random Affinity's <noparse>Damage Up</noparse> next turn to (# of enemies with [Laceration]) The Ring-faction Identities (once per Identity per turn; in Focused Encounters, Parts)

The Ring-faction Identities deal +10% damage
cn:
回合结束时，使属于环指的(带有[Laceration]的敌方单位数)名人格在下回合获得1层随机罪孽属性的<noparse>伤害强化</noparse>(每回合每名人格最多1次；若是集中遭遇战，则改为以部位判定)

属于环指的人格造成的伤害+10%

en: Hong Lu deals +0.5% damage for every Coin Artifacts used for the second round of the Family Hierarch Evaluation. Candidates without any remaining coins, either lost or taken by force, will be immediately eliminated.
cn: 每拥有1枚铜钱，使鸿璐造成的伤害+0.5% 用于家主评审第二轮的物品。铜钱全部遗失或被强行夺取的候选人将被立即淘汰。

en:
A broken and battered entry card.
Maybe it opens a door somewhere.
cn:
破碎陈旧的通行证。
或许能用来打开某个地方的门扉？

en: Turn End: 1 ally with the least SP heals 10 SP
cn: 回合结束时，使理智值最低的1名友方单位恢复10点理智值。

en: Turn End: heal 5% HP for 1 ally with the least HP percentage (rounded down)
cn: 回合结束时，使现存体力比例最低的1名友方单位恢复其体力上限5%的体力(向下取整)。

en: Turn Start: among allies who lost HP, 1 ally with the least HP percentage deals +(missing HP percentage / 4)% damage (rounded down)
cn: 回合开始时，使失去体力的友方单位中现存体力比例最低的1名友方单位造成的伤害+(其失去体力比例/4)%(向下取整)。

en: Turn Start: 1 ally with the highest max HP gains [DefenseUp] equal to the number of times that unit was hit by the enemies' Skill Attacks (max 6)
cn: 回合开始时，使体力上限最高的1名友方单位获得(本场战斗其受到敌方单位技能攻击次数)层[DefenseUp](最多6层)。

en: Every Turn Start: inflict 3 [Burst] Potency and +1 [Burst] Count to all enemies without [Burst] (for Focused Encounters, all Parts) How heartless they are—the flowing stream and the wilting blossom both.
cn: 每回合开始时，使全体未带有[Burst]的敌方单位增加3级[Burst]强度并对其施加1层[Burst](若是集中遭遇战，则改为所有部位) 水流花谢两无情。

en: First Turn Start of an Encounter: every Identity on the field loses 5 SP and gains 1 [ShamrockResultUp] and 1 [ShamrockDamageUp] for 3 turns.
cn: 关卡的首个回合开始时，参战的全体人格失去5点理智值并在3回合内获得1层[ShamrockResultUp]与1层[ShamrockDamageUp]。

en:
First Turn Start of an Encounter: every Identity on the field loses 5 SP and gains 1 [ShamrockResultUp] and 1 [ShamrockDamageUp] for this Encounter.
On Clash Lose, lose 5 SP; convert the Skill's final Coin to [SuperCoin]. (except E.G.O Skills; once per turn per Identity)
cn:
关卡的首个回合开始时，参战的全体人格失去5点理智值并在本场战斗中获得1层[ShamrockResultUp]与1层[ShamrockDamageUp]。
拼点失败时，使其失去5点理智值并使该技能的最后一枚硬币转化为[SuperCoin](不包括E.G.O技能，每回合每名人格最多1次)

en: On Hit against enemies with 5+ Rupture Potency: gain 1 Poise Potency and +1 Poise Count (3 times per Skill) How heartless they are—the flowing stream and the wilting blossom both.
cn: 攻击命中破裂 强度不低于5级的敌方单位时，使自身增加1级呼吸法 强度并使自身获得1层呼吸法 (每个技能最多3次) 水流花谢两无情。

en: Skills that inflict [Burst]: Clash Power +1, deal +10% damage Attack End: If target with 15+ [Burst] Potency is defeated, the Identity that defeated said target gains 2 [AttackUp] next turn (3 times per Skill) Beneath the glacial moon I lay the blossom's soul to rest
cn: 施加[Burst]的技能拼点威力+1，造成的伤害+10% 攻击结束后若[Burst]强度不低于15级的目标阵亡，则下回合使击杀该敌方单位的人格获得2层[AttackUp](每个技能最多3次) 冷月葬花魂。

en:
Gain 1 [Charge] every time this unit consumes 10 cumulative [Charge] Count in this Encounter
Turn End: At 2+ [Charge], gain 1 [ParryingResultUp] next turn
On Hit with a Skill that consumed 5+ [Charge]: inflict 1 [Burst] Potency (3 times per Skill)
cn:
本场战斗中，每当自身累计消耗10层[Charge]时，使自身增加1级[Charge]强度。
回合结束时，若自身的[Charge]强度不低于2级，则下回合使自身获得1层[ParryingResultUp]
消耗不低于5层[Charge]的技能命中时，使目标增加1级[Burst]强度(每个技能最多3次)

en:
Gluttony Skills deal +10% damage against enemies with Deathrite effects
For Identities at -15 or less SP at Combat Start: convert the final Coin for their Skills into [SuperCoin] (once per turn per Identity; prioritizes the Skill in the leftmost Skill Slot; except E.G.O Skills)
cn:
暴食技能对带有咒杀效果的敌方单位造成的伤害+10%。
战斗开始时，理智值不高于-15点的人格使用的技能的最后一枚硬币转化为[SuperCoin](每回合每名人格最多1次，优先适用于最左侧行动槽中的技能，不包括E.G.O技能)

en:
Clash Power +1 when not at full HP.
When an affected unit hits, deal +1% damage for every ([Laceration] Potency on target + [Laceration] Count on target) (max 20%)
cn:
人格体力未满时，使其拼点威力+1。
该单位攻击命中时，造成的伤害+(目标的[Laceration]强度+[Laceration]层数)%(最多+20%)

en:
When taking damage, gain Skill Final Power +1 and deal +10% damage (activates for self-damages as well) next turn
When taking damage that brings a unit's HP down to 1, heal 50% HP, and the affected unit gains 2 [Enhancement] at Turn Start for the duration of that Encounter (once per Encounter)
cn:
人格在战斗中受到伤害时，下回合使其技能的最终威力+1，造成的伤害+10%(自身造成的伤害也会触发)
人格受到使其体力降至1点的伤害时，使其恢复体力上限50%的体力，本场战斗期间在回合开始时使其获得2层[Enhancement](每场战斗最多1次)

en:
[Effects apply only to #1, #8 Deployed Identities]
Attack End: If the target is defeated, gain 2 [Breath] Potency and +2 [Breath] Count.
For this Encounter, each unit gains +1 Offense Level for every 1 enemy that is defeated at the 'Attack End' timing (max 3)
cn:
[第1、第8顺位友方单位专属]
攻击结束后，若目标阵亡，则使自身增加2级[Breath]强度并使自身获得2层[Breath]。
本场战斗期间，每有1名敌方单位在自身攻击结束后阵亡，使自身攻击等级+1(最多+3)。

en: Gain 1 [ParryingResultUp] for 3 turns after Substituting in.
cn: 解除待命的友方单位在3回合内获得1层[ParryingResultUp]。

en: Hong Lu's level rises to 55 Hong Lu's Uptie and Threadspin Tiers rise to Tier 4 'Remember the day ruin came to the Kong family, who have brought this destruction upon themselves through their grave transgressions. To violate the laws of Hongyuan is no tragedy—as such, it warrants no pity, only humiliation and scorn. This site of history stands as a monument to the inevitability of karma.'
cn: 鸿璐人格等级提升至55 鸿璐人格同步与异想解析提升至4阶段。 “勿忘孔家灭门之日。 灭门皆因孔家罪孽深重。 对其未能遵守鸿园戒律之罪业，无需悲悯，只应感到可笑。 因此，报应必当降至其身。”

en:
A broken and battered red entry card.
Maybe it opens a door somewhere.
cn:
破碎陈旧的红色通行证。
或许能用来打开某个地方的门扉？

en:
First Turn Start of an Encounter: Identities with Base Attack Skills that gain [Combustion] gain 5 [Combustion] and heal 8 SP

For Heishou Pack - You Branch Identities: HP gets capped to 49% of Max HP. In return, take 50% less damage and receive 50% reduced heal (except healing from E.G.O Gifts)
cn:
战斗的首个回合开始时，使拥有使自身增加[Combustion]强度的基础攻击技能的人格增加5级[Combustion]强度并使其恢复8点理智值

属于黑兽 - 酉的人格恢复体力最多恢复至体力上限的49%，但受到的伤害与使自身恢复的体力-50%(不包括E.G.O饰品恢复的体力)

en:
Turn Start: apply (Defense Level / 3) Shield to 1 ally with the highest Defense Level (prioritizes Heishou - Wu Identities; max Shield 15)

When allies with Shield win a Clash, inflict (Speed / 2) [Vibration] Potency; then, gain 2 [Agility] and 2 [DefenseUp] next turn (once per turn per Identity)
cn:
回合开始时，使防御等级最高的1名友方单位获得(其防御等级/3)点护盾(优先使属于黑兽 - 午的人格获得，最多15点护盾)

带有护盾的友方单位拼点胜利时，使敌方单位增加(自身的速度值/2)级[Vibration]强度，并在下回合使自身获得2层[Agility]与2层[DefenseUp](每回合每名人格最多1次)

en:
[Effects apply only to #1 Deployed Identity]

When other allies use an Unopposed Attack to hit an enemy, gain 1 [AttackUp] next turn (they can activate this only once per turn per Identity; effect itself activates up to 6 times per turn)

When other allies [RetreatForCommon], gain 1 [SlashResultUp] and 1 [SlashDamageUp] next turn (once per turn)

When all above conditions are met, gain 1 [ResultEnhancement] next turn (once per turn)
cn:
[第1顺位人格专属]

其他友方单位单方面攻击命中敌方单位时，下回合使自身获得1层[AttackUp](每回合每名人格最多1次，每回合最多6次)

其他友方单位进行[RetreatForCommon]时，下回合使自身获得1层[SlashResultUp]与1层[SlashDamageUp](每回合最多1次)

符合所有条件时，下回合使自身获得1层[ResultEnhancement](每回合最多1次)

en:
[Effects apply only to #6 Deployed Identity]

When using an Attack Skill(including E.G.O Skills) that inflicts [Burst] Potency or [Burst] Count to win a clash, gain 2 [DefenseUp] next turn (once per turn)
- If this unit is a Family Hierarch Candidate: also gain 1 [Agility] next turn
cn:
[第6顺位人格专属]

使用增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的攻击技能(包括E.G.O技能)拼点胜利时，下回合使自身获得2层[DefenseUp](每回合最多1次)
- 属于家主候选人的单位下回合额外获得1层[Agility]

en:
[Effects apply only to #6 Deployed Identity]

When using an Attack Skill(including E.G.O Skills) that inflicts [Burst] Potency or [Burst] Count to win a clash, gain 2 [AttackUp] next turn (once per turn)
- If this unit is a Family Hierarch Candidate: also gain 3 [AttackUp] next turn
cn:
[第6顺位人格专属]

使用增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的攻击技能(包括E.G.O技能)拼点胜利时，下回合使自身获得2层[AttackUp](每回合最多1次)
- 属于家主候选人的单位下回合额外获得3层[AttackUp]

en:
[Effects apply only to #6 Deployed Identity]

When using an Attack Skill(including E.G.O Skills) that inflicts [Burst] Potency or [Burst] Count to win a clash, heal 15 HP (once per turn)
- If this unit is a Family Hierarch Candidate: also gain 1 [Protection] next turn
cn:
[第6顺位人格专属]

使用增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的攻击技能(包括E.G.O技能)拼点胜利时，使自身恢复15点体力(每回合最多1次)
- 属于家主候选人的单位下回合额外获得1层[Protection]

en:
[Effects apply only to #6 Deployed Identity]

When using an Attack Skill(including E.G.O Skills) that inflicts [Burst] Potency or [Burst] Count to win a clash, heal 20 HP, gain 3 [AttackUp], and gain 3 [DefenseUp] next turn (once per turn)
- If this unit is a Family Hierarch Candidate: apply 1 [Agility], 1 [Protection], and 3 [AttackUp] to all allies, including this unit
cn:
[第6顺位人格专属]

使用增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的攻击技能(包括E.G.O技能)拼点胜利时，使自身恢复20点体力并在下回合获得3层[AttackUp]与3层[DefenseUp](每回合最多1次)
- 若自身属于家主候选人，则下回合额外使包括自身在内的全体友方单位获得1层[Agility]，1层[Protection]与3层[AttackUp]

en:
[Effects apply only to #2 Deployed Identity]

Deal +1% damage for every 1% missing HP on self (max 10%)
cn:
[第2顺位人格专属]

自身每失去1%的体力，使自身基础技能造成的伤害+1%(最多+10%)

en:
[Effects apply only to #2 <style="upgradeHighlight">and #4 Deployed Identities</style>]

Deal +1% damage for every 1% missing HP on self (max 10%)
cn:
[第2、<style="upgradeHighlight">第4</style>顺位人格专属]

自身每失去1%的体力，使自身基础技能造成的伤害+1%(最多+10%)

en:
[Effects apply only to #2 ,#4, <style="upgradeHighlight">and #6</style> Deployed Identities]

Deal +1% damage for every 1% missing HP on self (max 10%)
cn:
[第2、第4、<style="upgradeHighlight">第6</style>顺位人格专属]

自身每失去1%的体力，使自身基础技能造成的伤害+1%(最多+10%)

en:
Double the amount of Bloodfeast generated in the Stage
Skills that inflict [Laceration] Potency, [Laceration] Count, or 'Unique Bleed': Heal 30% of the HP damage dealt at Attack End (max 20)
* If a unit healed using the above effect, it gains 1 [Enhancement] at the next Turn Start (max 2)

For every 50 [BloodDinner_Common_Accumulation], all allies gain 1 [AttackUp] at the next Turn Start (max 5)
Each La Manchaland unit also gains 1 [AttackUp] for every 30 [BloodDinner_Accumulation] consumed by each unit (max 3)
cn:
关卡内生成的血宴 变为2倍
增加[Laceration]强度，施加[Laceration]层数与施加特殊流血的技能攻击后，使自身恢复造成伤害量30%的体力(最多20点)
- 通过以上效果恢复体力时，下回合使自身获得1层[Enhancement](最多2层)

[BloodDinner_Common_Accumulation]层数每有50层，下回合开始时使全体友方单位获得1层[AttackUp](最多5层)
属于拉·曼却领的友方单位每带有30层[BloodDinner_Accumulation]，下回合开始时使其获得1层[AttackUp](最多3层)

en:
[Effects apply only to #1 Deployed Identity]
When using a Skill that spends [Bullet], activate the following:
- Gain 3 [Agility] next turn (once per turn)
- On Hit: Trigger [VibrationExplosion] once (and consume 1 [Vibration] Count) (2 times per turn)
- On Hit after Clash Win: If target has both [Combustion] and [Vibration](including both 'Unique Burn' and 'Unique Tremor'), inflict Wrath damage equal to ([Combustion] + [Vibration]). (2 times per turn)

At 4+ Wrath Reson., activate the following:
- Wrath Skills gain Coin Power +2 upon use
- On Hit, if [Bullet] was spent, deal +30% damage
cn:
[第1顺位人格专属]
使用消耗[Bullet]的技能时，触发以下效果
- 下回合使自身获得3层[Agility](每回合最多1次)
- 命中时使目标[VibrationExplosion]，消耗其1层[Vibration](每回合最多2次)
- 拼点胜利后命中时，若目标带有[Combustion]与[Vibration](包括特殊震颤与特殊烧伤)，则对其造成相当于其[Combustion]强度与[Vibration]强度之和的暴怒伤害(每回合最多2次)

暴怒共鸣数不低于4时，触发以下效果
- 使用暴怒技能时，使其硬币威力+2
- 命中时，若消耗了[Bullet]，则使造成的伤害+30%

en:
Blunt Attack Type Base Skills: Coin Power +1; The Middle-faction Identities gain Coin Power +2 instead
When an ally is hit, all allies gain 2 [AttackUp] next turn (3 times per turn)

The following effects activate when there are 3 or more 'The Middle' Identities in the Encounter.
Combat Start: Gain 1 [Enhancement] and 1 [Protection] for every Envy Reson. (max 3)
When The Middle-faction Identity uses an Envy Base Attack Skill, convert its Coins to [SuperCoin]s, they take -50% damage, and gain 2 [HitDamageUp] this turn and next turn
cn:
打击基础技能的硬币威力+1，属于中指的人格改为硬币威力+2
友方单位受到攻击时，下回合使全体友方单位获得2层[AttackUp](每回合最多3次)

战斗中属于中指的人格不低于3名时，触发以下效果
战斗开始时，每有1点嫉妒共鸣数，获得1层[Enhancement]与1层[Protection](最多3层)
属于中指的人格使用嫉妒基础技能时，使该技能的所有硬币转化为[SuperCoin]，该人格受到的伤害-50%，
并在本回合与下回合获得2层[HitDamageUp]

en:
On the first Turn Start of an Encounter, and on all allies who Substitute in, apply 3 [VerEmergencyCandy]
If they did not consume [VerEmergencyCandy] in the previous turn, apply 1 [VerHunger] at Turn Start
cn:
使关卡的首个回合开始时与解除待命的全体友方单位获得3层[VerEmergencyCandy]
若友方单位上回合未消耗[VerEmergencyCandy]，则回合开始时使其获得1层[VerHunger]

en:
Deal +10% damage with Attack Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn'
- If the Skill applies [Combustion] Count on self, Clash Power +1
- Deal +1% damage for every 2% missing HP on self (max 15%)
cn:
增加[Combustion]强度，施加[Combustion]层数或施加特殊烧伤的攻击技能造成的伤害+10%
- 若该技能对自身施加[Combustion]层数，则额外使该技能的拼点威力+1
- 自身每失去2%的体力，使造成的伤害额外+1%(最多+15%)

en:
Deal +10% damage with Attack Skills that inflict [Burst] Potency or Count
- At 20%+ missing HP on self, Clash Power +1
- Deal +1% damage with Attack Skills for every 1 (sum of [Aggro] on all Skill Slots on self) (max 15%)
cn:
增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的攻击技能造成的伤害+10%
- 若自身已失去体力不低于体力上限的20%，则额外使该技能的拼点威力+1
- 自身所有行动槽的[Aggro]之和每有1点，使攻击技能造成的伤害+1%(最多+15%)

en:
If this unit gained [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge' over maximum limit this turn, gain 1 [AttackUp] next turn for every 2 surplus Stack (2 per turn per Identity)
- Identities with Base Skills that gain or consume [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge': max 6 per turn per Identity instead
- If this unit has [HighVoltageExoshell], also gain 1 [Charge] Potency (once per Encounter)
cn:
若自身本回合获得[Charge]层数或特殊充能超出上限，则每溢出2层，下回合使自身获得1层[AttackUp](每回合每名人格最多2层)
- 拥有获得或消耗[Charge]层数或特殊充能的基础技能的人格改为每回合每名人格最多6层
- 若自身带有[HighVoltageExoshell]，则额外使自身增加1级[Charge]强度(每场战斗最多1次)

en:
Limbus Company Identities:
- Turn Start: Gain (# of Limbus Company Identities participating in battle / 3) [ParryingResultUp] (max 2; rounded down)

LCE Identities:
- Deal +(# of Identities in battle wearing E.G.O Gears x 10)% damage (max 30%)
- On same-faction Ally Death: Gain 1 E.G.O resource each for all Affinities; gain 1 [PlusCoinValueUp] and 1 [MinusCoinValueUp] at Turn Start for the rest of this Encounter (2 times per Encounter per Identity)
cn:
属于边狱公司的人格获得以下效果
- 回合开始时获得(参战且属于边狱公司的人格数/3)层[ParryingResultUp](最多2层；向下取整)

属于LCE的人格获得以下效果
- 使自身造成的伤害+(参战且身着E.G.O装备的人格数×10)%(最多+30%)
- 与自身属于同一阵营的友方单位阵亡时，获得所有属性的E.G.O资源各1个；本场战斗中，回合开始时使自身获得1层[PlusCoinValueUp]并对自身施加1层[MinusCoinValueUp](每场战斗每名人格最多2次)

en:
[Effects apply only to #1, #2, #3 Deployed Identities]

When winning a Clash with an Attack Skill that inflicts [Burst] Potency or Count, inflict 5 [Burst] Potency and +3 [Burst] Count against the target (once per turn per Identity)

When Clashing against an enemy with a slower Speed, gain Final Power +1 and deal +25% damage

When winning a Clash against an enemy with [AttackUp] buff, gain 3 [AttackUp] for the next turn, and inflict 3 [AttackDown] on the enemy that lost the Clash (3 times per turn per Identity)

Every time Skill 1, Skill 2, or Skill 3 is used, activate the following effect (once per Skill rank):
- The unit that used said Skill gains 1 [Agility] and 1 [SkillPowerUp] at Turn Start for this Encounter (can stack up to 3 times)
cn:
[第1、第2、第3顺位人格专属]

增加[Burst]强度或施加[Burst]层数的攻击技能拼点胜利时，使目标增加5级[Burst]强度并对其施加3层[Burst](每回合每名人格最多1次)

与速度值低于自身的敌方单位拼点时，使自身的最终威力+1，造成的伤害+25%。

与带有[AttackUp]的敌方单位拼点胜利时，下回合使自身获得3层[AttackUp]并对拼点失败的敌方单位施加3层[AttackDown](每回合每名人格最多3次)

使用1技能，2技能或3技能时，触发以下效果(每种技能最多1次)
- 使用以上技能的人格本场战斗中，回合开始时获得1层[Agility]与1层[SkillPowerUp](最多叠加3次)

en:
[Effects apply only to #5, #6 Deployed Identities]

Heal 10% of the HP damage dealt with a Skill (max 20 per Skill)

On Clash Win: Gain 1 [AttackUp] and 1 [TakeHpHealIncrease] (2 times per turn per Identity)

On Skill Use: Gain 1 [AttackUp] and 1 [TakeHpHealIncrease] (2 times per turn per Identity)

Deal +10% damage with Blunt Skills

Deal +(# of Clashes x 6)% damage with the Skill that won the Clash (max 30%)
cn:
[第5、第6顺位人格专属]

使自身恢复技能造成体力伤害量10%的体力(每个技能最多20点)

拼点胜利时，使自身获得1层[AttackUp]与1层[TakeHpHealIncrease](每回合每名人格最多2次)

使用技能时，使自身获得1层[AttackUp]与1层[TakeHpHealIncrease](每回合每名人格最多2次)

打击技能造成的伤害+10%

拼点胜利的技能造成的伤害+(拼点次数×6)%(最多+30%)

en:
On Hit using Blunt Skills: Heal 5% of damage dealt by the ally who used the Skill

On Hit using Counter Skills: Heal 5 SP (2 times per turn per Identity)
cn:
打击技能命中时，使该友方单位恢复造成伤害量5%的体力

反击技能命中时，使自身恢复5点理智值(每回合每名人格最多2次)

en:
When an ally is hit, apply 3 [AttackUp] on the ally and inflict +4 [Laceration] Count on the attacker (once per Skill)

Base Skills used by The Middle-faction Identities gain Base Power +1 and deal +(30 / # of Coins)% damage
- Turn Start: If there are 3+ The Middle-faction Identities on the field, gain Base Power +1 and deal +(60 / # of Coins)% damage instead
- If there are 5+ The Middle-faction Identities on the field, gain Base Power +2 and deal +(90 / # of Coins)% damage instead

On Hit using Blunt Skills: Heal 10% of damage dealt by the ally who used the Skill

On Hit using Counter Skills: Heal 5 SP (2 times per turn per Identity)

Turn End: If the ally who equipped a Counter Skill at Combat Start did not get to use a Counter Skill this turn, the said ally gains 1 [PlusCoinValueUp] and 1 [MinusCoinValueDown] next turn
cn:
友方单位受到攻击时，使该友方单位获得3层[AttackUp]并对攻击者施加4层[Laceration](每个技能最多1次)

属于中指的人格使用的基础技能基础威力+1，造成的伤害+(30/硬币数)%

战斗开始时，若本回合有解除待命的友方单位，则使理智值最低的2名友方单位恢复10点理智值(每回合最多1次，不包括陷入恐慌或E.G.O侵蚀的友方单位)

en:
On Use with a Skill that gains or spends [Bullet]: Gain 1 [Agility] and 2 [AttackUp] next turn (once per turn per Identity)
- For Skills that inflict [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking', deal +(20 / # of Coins)% damage
cn:
使用获得或消耗[Bullet]的技能时，下回合使自身获得1层[Agility]与2层[AttackUp](每回合每名人格最多1次)
- 增加[Sinking]强度，施加[Sinking]层数与施加特殊沉沦的技能造成的伤害+(20/硬币数)%

en:
On Use with a Skill that gains or spends [Bullet]: Gain 1 [Agility] and 1 [Enhancement] next turn (once per turn per Identity)
- For Skills that inflict [Laceration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Bleed', deal +(20 / # of Coins)% damage
cn:
使用获得或消耗[Bullet]的技能时，下回合使自身获得1层[Agility]与1层[Enhancement](每回合每名人格最多1次)
- 增加[Laceration]强度，施加[Laceration]层数与施加特殊流血的技能造成的伤害+(20/硬币数)%

en:
This E.G.O Gift's effects are enhanced based on the number of Identities in the Team loadout with Attack Skills that gain or spend [Bullet] (except E.G.O Skills; counts all units in the Team)

- At 2+...
On Use with a Skill that gains or spends [Bullet]: Gain 2 [Agility] and 4 [AttackUp] next turn (once per Identity per turn)

- At 5+...
Skills used by Identities that gain or spend [Bullet]: Clash Power +1, deal +10% damage
Skills that gain or spend [Bullet]: Deal +(100 / # of Coins)% damage
If an affected unit is out of [Bullet], gain 4 [Bullet] at the next Turn Start (once per Identity per Encounter)

- At 8+...
Turn Start: Apply 1 [DesperadoBuff] to Identities that gain or spend [Bullet]
• If the affected unit did not spend [Bullet] last turn, apply 1 additional [DesperadoBuff]
Combat End: deal (total sum of [DesperadoBuff] on all allies x 3) Pierce damage to 1 random enemy (max 30)
• Then, repeat the above effect (number of Identities in the Team that gain or spend [Bullet] - 1) times
cn:
根据编入的拥有获得或消耗[Bullet]的攻击技能的人格数，相应强化本饰品效果(不包括E.G.O技能，包括编队中全体单位)

- 不低于2名
使用获得或消耗[Bullet]的技能时，下回合使自身获得2层[Agility]与4层[AttackUp](每回合每名人格最多1次)

- 不低于5名
获得或消耗[Bullet]的人格使用的技能拼点威力+1，造成的伤害+10%
获得或消耗[Bullet]的技能造成的伤害+(100/硬币数)%
若消耗了所有[Bullet]，则下回合开始时使自身获得4发[Bullet](每场战斗每名人格最多1次)

- 不低于8名
回合开始时，使获得或消耗[Bullet]的人格获得1层[DesperadoBuff]
· 若该单位上回合未消耗[Bullet]，则使其额外获得1层[DesperadoBuff]
战斗结束时，随机对1名敌方单位造成(全体友方单位的[DesperadoBuff]层数之和×3)点突刺伤害(最多30点)
· 并重复该效果(编入的获得或消耗[Bullet]的友方单位数-1)次

en:
When an ally or an enemy dies in a turn, all units gain 1 [Vulnerable] next turn (once per Wave)
- On ally Clash Win in the same turn where all units gained [Vulnerable] due to the above effect, all allies lose 1 [Vulnerable] and inflict 4 [Laceration] and +2 [Laceration] Count against all enemies (once per turn)
cn:
本回合友方单位或敌方单位阵亡时，下回合对全体单位施加1层[Vulnerable](每个波次最多1次)
- 触发该效果的下回合友方单位拼点胜利时，使全体友方单位的[Vulnerable]层数减少1层，并使全体敌方单位增加4级[Laceration]强度并对全体敌方单位施加2层[Laceration](每回合最多1次)

en:
When an ally or an enemy dies in a turn, all units gain <style="upgradeHighlight">2</style> [Vulnerable] next turn (once per Wave)
- On ally Clash Win in the same turn where all units gained [Vulnerable] due to the above effect, all allies lose 1 [Vulnerable] and inflict 4 [Laceration] and +2 [Laceration] Count against all enemies (<style="upgradeHighlight">2</style> times per turn)
cn:
本回合友方单位或敌方单位阵亡时，下回合对全体单位施加1层[Vulnerable](每个波次最多<style="upgradeHighlight">2</style>次)
- 触发该效果的下回合友方单位拼点胜利时，使全体友方单位的[Vulnerable]层数减少1层，并使全体敌方单位增加4级[Laceration]强度并对全体敌方单位施加2层[Laceration](每回合最多<style="upgradeHighlight">2</style>次)

en:
When an ally or an enemy dies in a turn, all units gain <style="upgradeHighlight">3</style> [Vulnerable] next turn (once per Wave)
- On ally Clash Win in the same turn where all units gained [Vulnerable] due to the above effect, all allies lose 1 [Vulnerable] and inflict 4 [Laceration] and +2 [Laceration] Count against all enemies (<style="upgradeHighlight">3</style> times per turn)
cn:
本回合友方单位或敌方单位阵亡时，下回合对全体单位施加1层[Vulnerable](每个波次最多<style="upgradeHighlight">3</style>次)
- 触发该效果的下回合友方单位拼点胜利时，使全体友方单位的[Vulnerable]层数减少1层，并使全体敌方单位增加4级[Laceration]强度并对全体敌方单位施加2层[Laceration](每回合最多<style="upgradeHighlight">3</style>次)

en:
[Effects apply only to #3 Deployed Identity]

Turn Start: Gain 1 [TensionUp]

On Hit, 25% chance to apply 1 [TensionUp] on self and 1 random ally
- If it was a Skill that inflicts [Laceration] or [Combustion](includes Potency, Count, and Unique variants), raise the chance to 50%
cn:
[第3顺位人格专属]

回合开始时，使自身获得1层[TensionUp]

攻击命中时，以25%的概率使自身与随机1名友方单位获得1层[TensionUp]
- 若该技能为增加[Laceration]或[Combustion]强度，或施加[Laceration]或[Combustion]层数的技能(包括特殊关键词)，则改为以50%的概率获得

en:
[Effects apply only to #3, #<style="upgradeHighlight">4</style> Deployed Identities]

Turn Start: Gain 1 [TensionUp]

On Hit, 25% chance to apply 1 [TensionUp] on self and 1 random ally
- If it was a Skill that inflicts [Laceration] or [Combustion](includes Potency, Count, and Unique variants), raise the chance to <style="upgradeHighlight">75</style>%
cn:
[第3、<style="upgradeHighlight">第4</style>顺位人格专属]

回合开始时，使自身获得1层[TensionUp]

攻击命中时，以25%的概率使自身与随机1名友方单位获得1层[TensionUp]
- 若该技能为增加[Laceration]或[Combustion]强度，或施加[Laceration]或[Combustion]层数的技能(包括特殊关键词)，则改为以<style="upgradeHighlight">75</style>%的概率获得

en:
[Effects apply only to #3, #4 Deployed Identities]

Turn Start: Gain 1 [TensionUp]

On Hit, 25% chance to apply 1 [TensionUp] on self and <style="upgradeHighlight">2</style> random allies
- If it was a Skill that inflicts [Laceration] or [Combustion](includes Potency, Count, and Unique variants), raise the chance to <style="upgradeHighlight">100</style>%
cn:
[第3、第4顺位人格专属]

回合开始时，使自身获得1层[TensionUp]

攻击命中时，以25%的概率使自身与随机<style="upgradeHighlight">2</style>名友方单位获得1层[TensionUp]
- 若该技能为增加[Laceration]或[Combustion]强度，或施加[Laceration]或[Combustion]层数的技能(包括特殊关键词)，则改为以<style="upgradeHighlight">100</style>%的概率获得

en:
On Hit by an ally with a Skill that inflicts [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking', inflict 1 [PinkPetals]
- Inflict 1 additional [PinkPetals] for every 5 [Sinking] on the enemy (max 4)
cn:
友方单位增加[Sinking]强度，施加[Sinking]层数与施加特殊沉沦的技能命中敌方单位时，对该敌方单位施加1层[PinkPetals]
- 该敌方单位每带有5级[Sinking]，对该敌方单位额外施加1层[PinkPetals](最多4层)

en:
On Hit with a Pierce Skill against an enemy: Gain 1 [Agility] and 1 [PenetrateDamageUp] next turn (2 times per turn per Identity)
- On enemy Kill with the said Skill: gain 1 additional [Agility] and 2 additional [PenetrateDamageUp] next turn (once per turn per Identity)

On Hit by an ally with a Skill that inflicts [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking', inflict 2 [PinkPetals]
- Inflict 1 additional [PinkPetals] for every 5 [Sinking] on the enemy (max 4)
- If the enemy has 10+ [PinkPetals] Stack, inflict 2 [Vibration] On Hit (3 times per turn)

Turn End: Inflict 2 [Binding] and 3 [DefenseDown] next turn against enemies(for Abnormalities, Parts) with 5+ ([Sinking] + [Vibration])
- If target has 10+ ([Sinking] + [Vibration]), inflict 2 [Binding], 1 [Paralysis], and 4 [DefenseDown] instead

Turn End: If all enemies have remaining [PinkPetals] Stack, all allies gain 1 [Enhancement] next turn
cn:
突刺技能命中敌方单位时，下回合使自身获得1层[Agility]与1层[PenetrateDamageUp](每回合每名人格最多2次)
- 该技能击杀敌方单位时，下回合使自身额外获得1层[Agility]与2层[PenetrateDamageUp](每回合每名人格最多1次)

增加[Sinking]强度，施加[Sinking]层数与施加特殊沉沦的技能命中敌方单位时，对其施加2层[PinkPetals]
- 其每带有5级[Sinking]强度，对其额外施加1层[PinkPetals](最多4层)
- 若其[PinkPetals]层数不低于10层，则攻击命中时使其增加2级[Vibration]强度(每回合最多3次)

回合结束时，下回合对[Sinking]强度与[Vibration]强度之和不低于5级的敌方单位(若是异想体，则改为以部位判定)施加2层[Binding]与3层[DefenseDown]
- 若目标的[Sinking]强度与[Vibration]强度之和不低于10级，则改为施加2层[Binding]、1层[Paralysis]与4层[DefenseDown]

回合结束时，若全体敌方单位均带有[PinkPetals]，则下回合使全体友方单位获得1层[Enhancement]

en:
[Effects apply only to #6 Deployed Identity]

Encounter Start: Gain [QueenBeepheromone]

Take -15% damage from enemies with [Combustion]

Turn End: Inflict [QueenBeeMark] next turn against the enemy(in Focused Encounters, the Part) that dealt the most damage to this unit
- If allies did not take any damage from enemies, inflict [QueenBeeMark] next turn against 1 random enemy(in Focused Encounters, a Part)
cn:
[第6顺位人格专属]

关卡开始时，使自身获得[QueenBeepheromone]

受到带有[Combustion]的敌方单位的伤害-15%

回合结束时，下回合对对自身造成的伤害最多的敌方单位(若是集中遭遇战，则改为以部位判定)施加[QueenBeeMark]
- 若未受到来自敌方单位的伤害，则下回合随机对1名敌方单位(若是集中遭遇战，则改为以部位判定)施加[QueenBeeMark]

en:
[Effects apply only to #1 Deployed Identity]

Turn End after using an Attack Skill: Heal 5 SP
- Then, if the affected unit is at max HP and is a Lobotomy Corp. Identity, gain 1 [PlusCoinValueUp] next turn
cn:
[第1顺位人格专属]

使用攻击技能的回合结束时，使自身恢复5点理智值
- 若自身理智值为最大值且属于脑叶公司，则下回合使自身获得1层[PlusCoinValueUp]

en:
Formerly the youngest chief researcher at the [REDACTED] Wing,
this Sinner possesses higher intelligence compared to most others.
We estimate that everyday conversation with this Sinner will prove difficult
for managers selected by our current screening process.
Avoiding communication altogether will pose a risk on its own, however.
If the Sinner remains silent for a long time, that means he is currently processing a line of deliberate thought;
we recommend waiting patiently for him.
cn:
该罪人曾是[已编辑]翼中最年轻的首席研究员，
相较于其他罪人，其拥有更为出众的智力。
对于我们所选择的经理而言，与之进行日常交流或略显困难，
尽管如此，过于明显地规避交流也会留下不稳定因素。
该罪人偶尔会保持长时间的沉默，这是因为他正在脑海中进行一系列的思考；
在这种情况下，我们建议您耐心等待。

en:
The Sinner who developed the engine of Mephistopheles, the bus operated by Limbus Company.
She claims that there is no one in the City who could rival her library of knowledge and wisdom,
and she isn't necessarily wrong.
You might find her high and mighty attitude when she allows you to converse with her displeasing,
but as seen with how she treats everyone with subtle gestures of arrogance, there is no hope of her parting with it, ever.
We recommend simply nodding once and getting over it.
Even though she has an unparalleled genius, we can't quite figure out how to use this one.
Perhaps you could be the one to find out?
cn:
该罪人开发了边狱公司的巴士——梅菲斯托费勒斯的引擎。
她声称在都市中，没有人能在智慧层面上与她相媲美，这话未必就是错的。
也许在和经理您交谈的时候，您会发现她的态度高高在上，而这样的态度也许会败坏您的心情。
由于该罪人举止傲慢，仿佛不在乎任何人，让她有所改善的可能性几乎为零。
我们建议您只要应付一下，点点头就行。
虽然她才智异禀，但我们尚不清楚如何利用她的才能。
说不定，经理您能找到方法？

en:
There is no Sinner that can outmatch this one's level of passion if we were to measure it.
An avid aficionada of all things Fixer, she adorns herself with a variety of Fixer-related merchandise.
They won't affect her performance in combat one way or another,
so there is no need for you to restrict her from keeping her decorations.
She is deeply immersed in the role of a righteous Fixer,
hence the exaggerated mannerisms akin to those of an actor. (Has such a thing ever existed, really?)
It's advised to play along with her for a smooth mission.
cn:
如果只以热情作为评判罪人资质的标准，该罪人无疑会拔得头筹。
身为收尾人的狂热粉丝，她热衷于收集各种收尾人的相关纪念品，
并将其装饰在全身上下。
鉴于这种行为并不会对战斗产生实质性影响，因此无需特别对其采取措施。
她对自身是正义的收尾人（真的有这样的存在吗？）一事深信不疑，
并会做出像三流演员一般夸张的举止。
为了使任务能够顺利进行，建议您配合她的节奏行动。

en:
As they say, every person has their own creed—and it's only right to respect it as the Executive Manager.
But with some creeds, you will have difficulty in even simply pretending to sympathize.
You will have noticed that the Sinner in question is a silent chain-smoker
whose eyes shine with a euphoric gleam only during battle.
She believes that senselessly destroying the enemy's heads is an uncultured act and a step backward for art.
[CAUTION]: This Sinner's background is one that even our company may have trouble handling;
it is advised against making her breed personal resentment towards you.
cn:
虽说每一位罪人都有其独特的信条，而尊重这些信条是经理应尽的义务。
但……某些信条实在是令人费解。
虽然该罪人平日里只是在一边默默抽着烟，唯有战斗时，她的眼中才会迸发出愉悦的神采。
她认为只是在战斗中无谋地打碎对方的脑袋，
是粗俗的行为，更是对艺术的亵渎。
[警告]-由于该罪人有着我司也难以应对的背景，
请尽量不要和她结下私仇。

en: Wants clear and concise commands, requiring no judgement on his part.
cn: 倾向于明确且简洁的指令，即不留下个人判断余地的命令。

en:
A Sinner who had lived an affluent life before becoming our company's asset.
As such, he has a certain admiration for a free life;
but occasionally, he may make ignorant and unsavory questions in regards
to the food cooked by a certain other Sinner or other aspects of the low-lives' lowly culture.
This can cause significant irritation for the other Sinners.
However, it is important to note that no sarcastic undertones are contained in his curiosity-driven inquiries,
so it is ill-advised to let them get physical over it.
cn:
该罪人在成为我司的资产前过着富足的生活。
因此，虽然他对自由有所向往，
但也偶尔会在见到其他罪人制作的食物时显露出对底层文化的无知，
并提出触碰其他罪人雷区的冒犯性问题。
不过，由于其提问并非出于讽刺，而仅仅是纯粹的好奇使然，
让罪人们为此大动干戈并非合适的解决方法。

en:
This Sinner prefers to take action rather than wait for logic to dictate his course.
His thoughts and feelings are blatantly visible in his demeanor, and he has no intention of hiding them;
his brashness may cause headaches (or physical injury leading to a headache) in the process of forming a relationship.
Please do note that this is not an indication of serious damage to the Sinner's thought process.
If his fit of rage persists, please contact the human resources department.
Once you realize that he is the type that tends to be simple-minded,
you'll have an easier time handling him.
cn:
该罪人比起理论思考更偏爱实际行动。
由于他丝毫不去掩饰自己的想法和感情，而是全部通过表情与话语加以表达，
经理在与其建立联系的过程中可能会引发头痛（或是受到物理意义上会引发头痛的外伤……）。
希望您谨记在该罪人的思维模式中并不存在深入思考这一项。
以防万一，如果出现长时间无法平息其愤怒的情况，请您联系人事部。
正因为该罪人的思维模式愚钝且单纯，
一旦您掌握其性格，处理起来就会变得十分简单。

en:
You may be disheartened by the defective state of many of your Sinners,
but do not worry; this Sinner is one of the few who can carry out most missions without much complaint.
She is likely to make reasonable judgements, so it is a good idea to start conversations
while looking her way if you're seeking sound advice.
However, you mustn't forget: this Sinner has survived an absurd voyage in a far and wide body of water.
Her patience may run deep, but once you take a wrong turn with her,
it will be a difficult task to regain her trust.
cn:
身为经理，面对大多各有缺点的罪人，您或许会感到困惑和无力。
然而请放心，该罪人是能够不加抱怨地执行各种命令的少数罪人之一。
由于该罪人能做出合理的判断，因此若您想要寻求建议，
看向她并予以提问应当是一个好办法。
但请记住，她是从那片深远且广阔的水域中历经艰难旅途得以生还的罪人，
故而其忍耐力可以说是深不见底，
然而，一旦与她的关系开始走向歧途，要恢复可能就十分困难了。

en:
The unfortunate traits of being Backstreets-born are apparent in this Sinner.
She loves money, gambling, and betting—so it is advised to pay close attention to her as the manager.
She tends to deflect orders with an unimpressive wink or a silly joke;
we recommend taking a stern stance at times to remind her that you are her superior.
Her mood may be down at irregular intervals.
There is nothing you can do to aid her in that state, so we recommend waiting for it to pass.
cn:
该罪人明显展现出后巷出身所特有的缺陷。
她拜金且嗜赌，建议经理对其密切关注。
她倾向于用蹩脚的眨眼或玩笑来应付您的指示，
建议时常向其展现经理的威严。
该罪人会可能不定期地情绪低落，
在经理的立场上并不能为其提供帮助，因此静静等候才最有效率。

en:
Even with the volatile nature of human growth around his age taken into consideration,
this Sinner seems to get particularly startled or frown when spoken to.
He isn't used to real combat at the moment,
meaning that he may struggle to keep himself together at the sight of something as mild as spilt innards at first.
As there may be those with violent tendencies among your crew,
we recommend taking an approach focused on positive reinforcement with this Sinner.
He appears to possess a murderous gaze that he himself isn't aware of;
this is a hopeful sign that he has the potential to grow into an expert of our company's profession with the right stimuli.
cn:
即使考虑到该罪人处于不稳定的成长阶段，其与人交谈时仍常常紧皱眉头或表现出过度的惊讶。
由于其尚不习惯战斗，因此最初可能甚至连内脏都不敢直视。
鉴于罪人中不乏具有暴力倾向的人，
因此我们建议经理在对待他时以鼓励为主，而不是惩罚。
该罪人有时会释放杀气，尽管其本人并不自觉，
但我司认为这表明其在我司业务范围内很有潜力。
只要给予适当的刺激，我们相信他会有长足的成长。

en:
This Sinner could serve as an excellent advisor depending on your capability.
However, she also has a meddlesome tendency, so it is recommended to keep her satisfied with short replies of agreement.
She is an expert when it comes to tactics and various pearls of wisdom about life,
making her advice all the more valuable for your mission.
In addition, she possesses a vast knowledge of workshop technologies;
you could trust her with simple repairs of the bus.
[NOTICE]: Unlike the other Sinners, accessing records pertaining to the past of this Sinner is not permitted.
[WARNING]: Keep an eye on this Sinner and beware that she does not exercise her cunning intellect
for purposes other than completing our company's mission.
cn:
该罪人或许能够成为优秀的顾问，但这取决于经理的能力。
然而，考虑到其多管闲事的性格，建议您适当地简短附和。
由于她在包括战术在内的多个领域均是专家，因此寻求她的建议非常有效。
此外，该罪人还对工坊技术有深入了解，
因此您也可以放心地委任她对巴士进行简单的维护工作。
[注意] - 与其他罪人不同，禁止阅览该罪人的过往记录。
[注意] - 请密切关注该罪人，以防止其在任务之外另起心思。

en:
This Sinner is relatively easy to handle in terms of personality.
However, an upsurge of emotion or a sudden change of environment
may cause parts or the whole of his body to transform into insectile
(notably akin to a carapace, resembling that of the _________) tissues.
If you do not wish to be a rude manager (not that you're obligated to be nice),
we recommend keeping your facial expression in check so that your disgust is not visible to him.
He sometimes uses cynical language, but he can still be reasoned with,
and you can get around him without much difficulty as long as you learn the knack of it.
cn:
与其他罪人相比，该罪人的性格更好相处。
然而，随着情绪激动或者环境急剧变化，
其身体的部分、有时甚至全身都可能会变化成类似昆虫（某种鞘翅目，类似于■■■■）的结构。
如果您不希望被视为一位粗俗的经理（您不应如此），
我们建议您谨慎地管理自己的表情，尽量避免流露出厌恶的情绪。
尽管该罪人偶尔会说些愤世嫉俗的话，但只要掌握了技巧，就能与其顺利沟通。
与他相处并非难事。

en:
Miscellaneous junk like rusted plates and bolts ripped from the backs of trash crabs.
Could be used for modifying Mephistopheles.
cn:
从废料蟹身上拆下来的生锈的铁板与螺栓。
这些杂七杂八的废料可以用来改造梅菲斯托费勒斯。

en:
A large horseshoe-shaped item taken from the king trash crab.
It could substitute several pieces of scrap, or so we're told.
cn:
从帝王废料蟹身上获得的看起来像马蹄铁的巨大废料。
据说它顶得上好几块废料。

en: 자판기 재화 표시용(name 만 번역해주세요)
cn: 자판기 재화 표시용(name 만 번역해주세요)

en:
A sack full of trinkets and decorations hastily taken from the Gift Factory.
Don Quixote will make good use of these to spruce up the Mephistopheles' interiors.
cn:
匆忙地塞满礼物工厂里到处散落的装饰品的袋子。
堂吉诃德在装饰梅菲斯托费勒斯的时候好像可以好好利用。

en:
A huge sack filled to the brim with trinkets and decorations from the Gift Factory.
Don Quixote will make good use of these to spruce up the Mephistopheles' interiors.
cn:
一个装满本来是要用来装饰礼物工厂的装饰品的袋子。
堂吉诃德在装饰梅菲斯托费勒斯的时候好像可以好好利用。

en:
Used to purchase various rewards from the Reward Exchange menu.

<color=#a16a3b>Those who wield blades in life leave behind bloodied scabbards in death.
The true abode of those who walk the path of blades is their scabbard.</color>
cn:
用于在奖励兑换窗口中兑换各种奖励。

<color=#a16a3b>挥剑者们的殒命之处，惟有浸染鲜血的剑鞘残存。
对于踏入剑道之人而言，剑鞘才是他们能够安身立命之处。</color>

en:
Used to purchase various rewards from the Reward Exchange menu.

<color=#a16a3b>One who wields their blade with deep resentment is called a Demon of the Blade.
Demon of the Blade no longer has need of a scabbard; yet they carry it, as that resentment is tinged with a lingering attachment.</color>
cn:
用于在奖励兑换窗口中兑换各种奖励。

<color=#a16a3b>带着怨恨挥剑之人被称为剑鬼。
剑鬼不再需要剑鞘，但仍持有剑鞘的理由，正是那浅薄、未了的怨恨。</color>

en:
Everyone has their own timepiece, with varying time scales.
Time that goes by quickly. Time that lingers.
The hours are always misaligned.
cn:
人人都携带着流速不同的时钟生存于世。
迅速流逝的时间，缓慢流逝的时间。
每个人的时间始终都相互错位。

en:
The same destination awaits every timepiece.
The hours finally align when the hands stop ticking down the seconds, when one breathes their final lungful of air.
cn:
最后，一切时钟都将归于一处。
在秒针停滞、呼吸停止的那一刻，一切时间才终于以相同的速度流逝。

en:
Used to purchase various rewards from the Reward Exchange menu.

<color=#a16a3b>Notice to Cleanup Agents: please collect and store a single passenger's parts in this pack. No matter how difficult it may appear to collect their parts, do note that there is a single strand of vein connecting the passenger's parts together. Imagine you are spinning a yarn ball into shape, and patiently collect them one by one.</color>
cn:
用于在奖励兑换窗口中兑换各种奖励。

<color=#a16a3b>请各位清扫人员将1名乘客的碎片收集到一份包裹中。由于乘客的各个部位由细小的血管相连接，即使不清楚如何清扫也请保持耐心，如缠绕毛线般进行收集。</color>

en:
Spawns rarely. Converted to 20 Civilian Recov. Pack immediately upon acquisition.

<color=#a16a3b>On occasion, you may have to work on passengers equipped with prosthetics.
Please note that even full-body prosthetics do not remove the passenger's brain.
Any prosthetic parts recognized by the brain as the passenger's own body will be connected by veins, so there is no need to worry about mix-and-matching them together.
Remember: blood is thicker than water.</color>
cn:
获取概率较低，获得时将即刻转变为20个普通乘客复原包。

<color=#a16a3b>时而会有装备了义体的乘客。
即使是全身义体的乘客也依旧有大脑。
乘客的大脑与身体是一体的，即使是四散在WARP列车内的碎片也由血管连接在一起，因此不用担心难以分辨。
切记，血浓于水。</color>

en: Raises an Identity’s Uptie Tier up to Tier 4.
cn: 使用时，人格同步阶段提升至4阶段。

en: Raises an E.G.O's Threadspinning Tier up to Tier 4. (Usable only on E.G.Os WAW Level or lower)
cn: 使用时，E.G.O异想解析阶段提升至同步阶段4。（只能对WAW或以下等级的E.G.O使用）

en: Use this item to select a Season 1 Identity(including Event Identities) to obtain.
cn: 使用时，可从第1赛季人格（包括活动）中选择1个获得。

en: Use this item to select a Season 1 Battle Pass E.G.O to obtain.
cn: 使用时，可从第1赛季战斗通行证E.G.O中选择1个获得。

en: Can be used to Uptie Identities and Threadspin E.G.O for all Sinners.
cn: 可用于所有罪人的人格同步与E.G.O异想解析。

en: Raises an E.G.O's Threadspinning Tier up to Tier 4. (Usable only on E.G.Os HE Level or lower)
cn: 使用时，E.G.O异想解析阶段提升至同步阶段4。（只能对HE或以下等级的E.G.O使用）

en:
Used to purchase various rewards from the Reward Exchange menu.

<color=#a16a3b>Various disorganized and trivial documentation on LCB, Distortions, and the Peccatula are haphazardly scribbled here. These data have been collected by the LCE—messy records of tests, experiments, and research litter the papers.

'It is not the duty of a researcher to organize their findings. That is the assistants' responsibility.'</color>
cn:
用于在奖励兑换窗口中兑换各种奖励。

<color=#a16a3b>由LCE主导编写的，关于LCB、扭曲、罪种的琐碎繁杂的资料。有着随手记下的各种测试、实验、调查等文件。

“整理资料可不是研究员的工作。这是助手的职责吧。”</color>

en:
Spawns rarely. Converted to 20 Amassed Data immediately upon acquisition.

<color=#a16a3b>Classified data collected by Hohenheim himself, available for viewing only for LCE's assistant researchers. It contains all kinds of in-depth information about Limbus Company—from each Sinner's personal information(Birthdays, birthplaces, etc.) to analyses on Abnormalities and Distortions contained within the LCE.

'The enumeration of data alone is worthless. What matters is which data connects to which, when they are unveiled, and how they are put to use. Only then is data transformed into intelligence of worth.' - Anonymous LCA Officer</color>
cn:
获取概率较低，获得时将立即转变为20个情报文件。

<color=#a16a3b>只有LCE的助理研究员才能查阅的，由霍恩海姆收集的机密资料。从边狱公司的罪人们的个人信息（生日、出身等），到LCE所拥有的，关于异想体和扭曲的深入内容都被一一记录在案。

“仅仅罗列出来的资料是没有价值的。重要的是如何组合，何时公开，怎样利用。只有这样，资料才能成为有价值的情报。” - 某位LCA干部</color>

en: Use this item to select a Season 2 Identity(including Event Identities) to obtain.
cn: 使用时，可从第2赛季人格（包括活动）中选择1个获得。

en: Raises an Identity’s level to up to 50, and Uptie Tier up to Tier 4.
cn: 使用时，人格等级提升至50级，同步阶段提升至4阶段。

en:
Used to purchase various rewards from the Reward Exchange menu.

<color=#a16a3b>These fuel cylinders contain the energy source for the Sweepers, who cleanse the City every Night in the Backstreets. Despite the nightly chaos, people step out each morning to pristine streets on their way to work—all thanks to the Sweepers. Using their fluid fuel, they dissolve anything that doesn't belong in the City, from street litter to unauthorized structures, as they flood the streets at night. Like clockwork, they emerge from the subterranean depths beneath the City every night. I do wonder, though—just how deep do they come from? - Excerpt from an interview with an LCCB Employee</color>
cn:
用于在奖励兑换窗口中兑换各种奖励。

<color=#a16a3b>罐子中装着后巷深宵时清扫都市的清道夫的燃料。在每日以都市为舞台循回往复的修罗场之上，正因有清道夫的存在，人们每天早晨才能在整洁的街道上通勤。清道夫的浪潮会将街边的垃圾、未经许可的建筑物等等不应存在于都市中的事物融化成液体燃料。每逢固定的时间，他们就会从都市地下蜂拥而出，不禁让人好奇他们来自多深的地方。——节选自某位LCCB成员的采访</color>

en:
Spawns rarely. Converted to 20 Sweeper Fuel Cylinder immediately upon acquisition.

<color=#a16a3b>Much about the Sweepers remains a mystery. When did they first begin their nightly labors? Where do they come from? It is said that the only institution they cooperate with is the Head. The Sweepers' fluid fuel is a multifunctional resource—it forms their bodies, serves as a weapon to dissolve whatever lies in their path, and sustains them. This is merely a personal curiosity, but I cannot help but wonder how they propagate. Perhaps they are the culprits behind reports of children vanishing during Nights in the Backstreets… or kidnappings from the Outskirts. - Excerpt from an interview with an LCCA Employee</color>
cn:
获取概率较低，获得时将立即转变为20个清道夫液态燃料罐。

<color=#a16a3b>至于清扫何时开始，清道夫又来自何方，绝大多数问题仍然是谜团重重。据说，唯一与他们合作的组织就只有首脑。清道夫使用的液态燃料既是构成其躯体的物质，也是其融化敌人的武器，还是其赖以生存的养料。只是个人疑问，他们又是如何繁育下一代的？或许，他们就是后巷夜晚那些失踪儿童，或是郊区绑架案的真凶。——节选自某位LCCA成员的采访</color>

en:
Used in Mirror Dungeons.

<color=#a16a3b>Starlight that can be collected only as long as the Mirror of Immortality remains open. Wish as people might to weave new tales from Starlight, they can only scavenge for what earthbound Starlight there remains—for the stars in the sky are no more.</color>
cn:
用于镜像迷宫。

<color=#a16a3b>是可于永生之镜开放期间收集的星芒。尽管人们收集着星芒，希望从中编织出新的故事，然而天上的繁星已然不复存在，人们只能搜罗散落于大地之上的，仅剩的星芒。</color>

en:
Used in Mirror Dungeons.

<color=#a16a3b>Starlight that can be collected only within a fleeting span of time. The gaze is raised to the stars above. The stars beheld then fall, awaiting their gleaning. Harvested and tethered against their will, they are compelled to twinkle and shine, giving rise to new stories.</color>
cn:
用于镜像迷宫。

<color=#a16a3b>仅能在一定时间内收集的星芒。仰望天上的星星。因凝望而坠落的星星被收集起来。如此收集的星星被强行连接在一起，为了编织故事而放出光芒。</color>

en:
Used to purchase various rewards from the Reward Exchange menu.

<color=#a16a3b>The Wise are unshaken, the Brave are unafraid, and the Benevolent are untroubled. No matter what discipline it may be, to build the pillars of learning upon the three foundations of Zhi, Yong, and Ren is to build a soaring tower. Which summons forth an intriguing question: can not all of education be condensed into Zhi, Yong, and Ren? - Tianji Star(天機星)</color>
cn:
用于在奖励交换窗口处兑换奖励。

<color=#a16a3b>知者不惑，仁者不忧，勇者不惧。因此，无论学习何种学问，只要以智、勇、仁为基础去构筑，都能根基稳固，如立于磐石之上，向更高的目标前进。换句话说，所有的学问都能还原并解释为智、勇、仁三个方面。——天机星</color>

en:
Spawns rarely. Converted to 20 Intro to Zhi, Yong, Ren immediately upon acquisition.

<color=#a16a3b>A scroll filled with esoteric knowledge. It allows its readers to rapidly absorb its contents, wisdom or technique, disregarding the basics that must come before the learning. None know yet whether it is the paper that is a Singularity, or the letters that are a Singularity, or the ink that forms them that is a Singularity. This likely matters very little to those who covet this secret scroll. Yet, remember well that food ingested in haste risks sickness and vomiting. Always be acutely aware of your capabilities. - A Certain Master</color>
cn:
获取概率较低，获得时将即刻转变为20个智·勇·仁基础入门手册。

<color=#a16a3b>一捆蕴含着隐秘传承的知识的卷轴。能无视基础，让读者以惊人的速度掌握所需的知识与技能。至于卷轴本身、上面的文字，抑或是书写用的墨水是否是某种奇点，至今无人知晓。对于渴望秘籍之人来说，原理与方法并不重要。然而，就如同囫囵吞下的食物会导致积食而呕吐的道理一样。人应时刻警惕自身能力无法承受之物。——某位师父</color>

en:
Used to purchase various rewards from the Reward Exchange menu.

<color=#a16a3b>Chunks of Sea Terror flesh, collected for research purposes. The calm noise of waves crest faintly through the insidious blue light.</color>
cn:
用于在[奖励兑换]界面兑换各种奖励。

<color=#a16a3b>为研究而采集的恐鱼碎片。透过那蔓延的不祥蓝光，平缓的海浪声隐约传来。</color>

en:
Spawns rarely. Converted to 20 Sea Terror Sample immediately upon acquisition.

<color=#a16a3b>A Sea Terror specimen, collected for research purposes. There was no hesitation in the hand that clove through the life its owner had once beheld with awe. One must delve into the undying light to evolve. It is an inevitable step.</color>
cn:
获取概率较低，获得时立即转化为20个[恐鱼标本]。

<color=#a16a3b>为研究而采集的恐鱼。他的指尖在切断曾令其敬畏的生命之时，没有丝毫犹豫。揭开不灭生命的奥秘，是进化的必经之路。</color>

en:
Used to weave Façades of Identities to be projected.

<color=#a16a3b>Wisps of light woven into threads, then twined into a skein.
The strands of light are components of a universal connection—should a thread in the weave tremble, so does a distant one, thereby making all that it connects interlinked by ties of vibrations.
As such, it is by no means absurd to consider an outfit made of threads a façade in all its meaning.</color>
cn:
用于制作投影到人格上的外观。

<color=#a16a3b>收集以光纺成的丝线，并将其汇集成捆。
这些光的丝线间全部紧密相连，若某一处的线发生振动，远处的线也会随之振动起来。
万事万物都是由这些彼此相连的振动所编织而成的。
因此，由这些丝线所织造的衣物能够欺瞒外表，也就并不荒诞了。</color>

en:
Used to purchase various rewards from the Reward Exchange menu.

<color=#a16a3b>Something has severed this thread, snapping it into strands.
Truly, there is no such thing as an existence in complete homogeneity with another, for slicing a single thread reveals that it is in fact a twine of multiple fibers. When a thread is severed, it leaves not two separate threads, but a multitude of frayed strands—from this, we may learn that time indeed does not cure all wounds. The passage of time only unravels the frayed strands further, leaving weeping wounds that never heal.</color>
cn:
用于在[奖励兑换]界面兑换各种奖励。

<color=#a16a3b>被什么东西割舍、斩断的线。
虽说是一根线，却也不单单是一根线，而是多重细线汇聚在一起结成的一根线。换言之，并非纯粹由某一种东西构成之物。因此，即使被斩断，其断面的末端也会延伸出许多条线，延伸分叉的线随着时间的流逝散开，无法愈合而只能分裂开来，留下永远无法治愈的伤口。</color>

en:
Spawns rarely. Converted to 20 Severed Thread immediately upon acquisition.

<color=#a16a3b>To truly sever a thread, it must be burned, not cut. Keenness is a means insufficient to achieving the total annihilation that burns and melts away even the lingering remnants of an erstwhile connection down to the frayed ends of separated threads. It must be that only with resolute determination and heart can one sever such a connection.

Should these skeins of severed and scorched strings be twined anew, perhaps the resulting new thread can be used to connect hearts once again? I certainly hope so, though there is no way for us to know at this moment.</color>
cn:
获取概率较低，获得时将立即转变为20个被斩断的线。

<color=#a16a3b>若想把线完全割舍，就必须将其焚烧，而非斩切。割舍某物并非仅凭锋利便能实现。所谓真正的割舍，是将其彻底燃烧殆尽，连断面的概念都要一并抹去。唯有怀着这般觉悟与心意，方才能够将连接的事物尽数割舍。

如果将被斩断烧却的线收集起来、再度编织，这些线是否还能用于连接某人呢？虽然现在还不清楚，但要是真能如此的话就好了。</color>

en: Raises an E.G.O's Threadspinning Tier up to Tier 4 (Usable only on ZAYIN-level E.G.O). Greatly accelerates the Threadspinning of a [ZAYIN]-level E.G.O by weaving it with a great number of shards in a short span of time. "Should a thread in the weave tremble, so does a distant one..." such were the words spoken by the people here. If all of these strands are components of a universal connection as they claim, then the act of deciphering a given object must also be the equivalent of unraveling the thread. I find myself thinking, what would come to pass if all of the threads wrapped around me are unraveled?
cn:
使用时，E.G.O异想解析阶段提升至同步阶段4。（只能对ZAYIN等级的E.G.O使用）

<color=#a16a3b>在短时间内将大量的碎片编织在一起，使得对于[ZAYIN]级E.G.O的解析急剧加速到特定水准。“这条丝线的震动，终究会引起另一条丝线的震动，吗……如果真如这里的人们所说，一切都是由丝线编织而成的，那么想要解析某样事物，是否就意味着要解开那丝线呢。那如果包裹着我的丝线被尽数解开，又会发生什么？”</color>

en:
Used for exchanging always-available, Standard Rewards at the "Reflectrial][lairtcelfeR" Reward Exchange shop.

<size=75%><color=#a16a3b>Through warped glass it is fired. Those reflected in this lens are soon spliced into films, and before long, are peeled away from them; now untethered, they become shadows that bar one's path. Unfortunate as it is, every lens has a finite lifespan. Once a lens has let the searing light pass through the whole of its body, it becomes scorched and baked through—a fresh lens then takes its place to preserve the projected shadows. These burnt-in lenses are what remain in the wake of this process, much like keepsakes of the dead.

"The way they're blowing through those lenses... Do they have the slightest clue how exorbitantly expensive those things are? Combat capability enhancement, process analysis—yes, I know the reasons are all valid, but I cannot wrap my head around using this many. The company really must be drowning in money."</color></size>
cn:
用于在“映射战斗][斗战射映”兑换商店中兑换常驻奖励。

<size=75%><color=#a16a3b>通过扭曲变形的玻璃进行照射。映在这透镜上的人随即被贴入胶片之中，不久后又从那里剥离而出，变成阻挡去路的阴影。遗憾的是，透镜的寿命有限，被灼热的光线穿透的透镜会被烧制，为了保留投射出的阴影，就要将新的透镜换上来。烧制的透镜便如同遗物一般留了下来。

“也不知道他们明不明白这透镜有多贵，就这么滥用……就算有提升战斗执行能力、过程分析之类的理由，如此使用还是令人无法理解。看来这家公司真的是钱多到花不完啊。”</color></size>

en:
Used to purchase various rewards from the Reward Exchange menu.

<color=#a16a3b>*snap* The sound of a hammer driving a nail in. But what precisely is being "driven in?" The camera waylays the light of a given moment, then nails it onto rough paper for exhibition. Was the photograph taken as a record or a remembrance? Perhaps a photograph's name ought to change depending on which purpose it is made to serve. After all, beams of light nailed down by a hammer, only to be recorded and never remembered, are pitiable things. Within printed photographs, dead lights scream in despair, burned and blackened. The dead lights, perished screaming where they are nailed, record the smile of someone standing in the photograph.</color>
cn:
用于在奖励兑换窗口中兑换各种奖励。

<color=#a16a3b>咔嚓。这是用锤子打入钉子的声音。究竟是嵌入了什么呢。相机截取并捕捉某一瞬间的光，将光钉在粗糙的纸上展示出来。是为了记录而拍摄的，还是为了记忆而拍摄的，是否应该根据其目的来改变照片的称谓呢。因为那些不是为了被记住，而是为了被记录而被锤子钉住的光，实在令人痛心。在被冲印出的照片里，死去的光以焦黑的姿态惨叫着。被钉住、在惨叫中死去的光，却在照片里记录下了某人的微笑。</color>

en:
Spawns rarely. Converted to 20 Photos immediately upon acquisition.

<color=#a16a3b>'Quite a lot of photographs retrieved here. Oh, did you know? These photos are composed of matter produced by a Distortion, but they remain in existence. Some Distortion byproducts fade away when the case is resolved, but some don't, even after everything is over. I wonder if this has something to do with the nature of the Distortion. Well, we do know that this Distortion wished to record something and remember it... hence the photographs. Perhaps that's why these photographs are left behind as some kind of "record." This calls for research into exactly what results in the difference in a Distortion's property from another Distortion's. Well, working in LCD will probably give me some insight in due time... though I'd rather not cooperate with LCE.'</color>
cn:
获取概率较低，获得时立即转化为20个几张照片。

<color=#a16a3b>“被回收的照片有这么多啊。啊，你知道吗？这些照片明明是扭曲所产生的物质，却依然残留下来了。有些扭曲的副产物会随着扭曲的解决而消失，但也有些东西会像这样，即使扭曲被解决了却仍然残留下来呢。是因为扭曲的性质不同吗？这个扭曲应该是想留下、记录、记住些什么……所以才留下了照片……这些副产物也是根据那种性质，像记录一样被保留下来了吧？扭曲是因为何种差异，才会出现这样的特性呢……看来有必要再研究一下。在LCD工作的话，总有一天会明白的吧。只是我可不想和LCE合作啊。”</color>

en:
Used for purchasing Limited Rewards from the "Reflectrial][lairtcelfeR]" Reward Exchange shop.

<size=70%><color=#a16a3b>Upon the film, the light is embedded and etched. A subsequent flash of light will soon penetrate the information contained within the preceding light etched like a silhouette—much like what remains when a human body is exposed to a devastating explosion of light and heat. The captured light, akin to a taxidermied still, contains the memories of someone, something. When new light passes through the film and the lens both, the plain ray is transfigurated into an image of light; through it, the information retained in the initial flash still remains. The image the living light forms is not one of itself but an image of a corpse, traces of dead light; how ironic, that the light that lives can form an image only when it passes through the light that has died? That is why the art of projection is a bitter one—the art that forces the living through the dead, killing it, only to project a mere simulacrum of life.

"Where are ya even getting these films from? Is there, like, a dedicated documentarian or a recording machine that tapes LCB's battles? That can't be it... Or is this also...?"</color></size>
cn:
用于在“映射战斗][斗战射映”兑换商店中兑换限定奖励。

<size=75%><color=#a16a3b>光线照射，如同要刻印一般烧录在胶片上。蕴含在那份光线里的信息不过是令下一道光线穿过的煤灰。正如大爆炸后印在墙壁上的人的灰烬。在那里被制为标本的光中寄宿着那一日的某人、某物。新的光线穿过胶片，又经过透镜，在那之后会出现由光交织在一起的某物，我们便能通过它得到蕴含在光线里的信息。尚且活着的光穿过死去的光，活着的光仍不曾拥有自己的形态，便以死去的光所塑造的尸体汇集成像，如此讽刺。因此，所谓的投影只是以死物杀死活物，再使它看似栩栩如生的令人痛心疾首的技术。

- “这种胶片是从哪儿入手的？难道有专门记录LCB战斗的人或者机器吗？应该不可能吧……难道，这也是……？”</color></size>

en:
Use this item to select and obtain an Announcer from a list of Announcers that can be acquired through Yisang Exchange on the Extraction menu.
(※ Does not include Walpurgis Night Announcers)
cn:
使用时，可以在可用提取的[理想]兑换的播报员中选择1个获得。
（※不包括瓦尔普吉斯之夜播报员）

en: Raises an E.G.O's Threadspinning Tier up to Tier 4. (Usable only on E.G.Os TETH Level or lower)
cn: 使用时，E.G.O异想解析阶段提升至同步阶段4。（只能对TETH或以下等级的E.G.O使用）

en: It’s G Corp.
cn: 是G公司。

en: Corpse (NOUN): The body of a person or animal after death.
cn: 对人或者动物阵亡之后存留的肉体的称谓。

en:
A quiet noise is in the air. You cannot begin to imagine what might await here once you enter.
It exudes a smell.
At one moment, it’s sweet.
Yet it soon turns sour, musky, then refreshing, clear.

The experience shifts repeatedly even as you approach the door from outside.
cn:
空中有着细微的噪音。你无法想象一旦进入这里，会有怎样的事物在等待着你。
空间内散发着一种气味。
在某一刻，这气味闻起来是甜的。

但很快，它变得酸涩、带着麝香气，之后又变得清爽而干净。
当你走向这扇门时，闻到的气味也在不断改变。

en:
Seeing this gives you an odd sense of relief.
Even though you can feel a clear hostility coming from the area, you know well that there are far more terrifying encounters in this spiral of uncanny spaces.

Of course, this does not mean that you can relax.
The enemies you face here might crush your Sinners at any moment.
cn:
这反而让你奇怪地松了口气。
哪怕你感受到了来自这片领域的明显敌意，但你知道某处还存在着远比这里更恐怖、更令人毛骨悚然的空间。

当然，还没到放松的时候。你面对的敌人依然可能轻而易举地碾压你的罪人。

en:
This zone is radiating an even deeper malice.
The Sinners are no longer in their top shapes.
They are all exhausted, barely dragging their feet onward after this long journey.
We shouldn't let our guards down... lest we lose the Sinners here.
cn:
到了下一层，你发现这里散发着比之前更强的敌意。
你的罪人们并未保持在最佳状态。
他们拖着疲惫的身体，继续向下前进。
如果你不保持警惕，即便是最常见的遭遇也能够导致毁灭。

en:
The air in these spots has become considerably more oppressive than it was at first.
Each step forward is a considerable undertaking for the Sinners.

If you’re unable to keep fatigue from taking over, any level of danger is sure to tear your team apart.
cn:
这处空间的空气要比先前更加沉重，
与最初所感受到的截然不同。
对罪人们来说，他们踏出的每一步都变得艰巨。

如果你无法阻止疲劳感占据上风，那么任何程度的危险都必然使这支队伍分崩离析。

en:
The space ahead induces a hair-raising sensation.
Though you’ve yet to see anything, you get the vivid feeling that something strange awaits ahead.

You know you’re about to come face to face with an unfathomable and otherworldly being.
cn:
前方的空间给人一种毛骨悚然的感觉。
尽管你还什么也没有看见，但你却有着一种强烈的感受：某种诡异的事物正在前面等待着。

你知道你即将面对的，是一个无法估量的，
似乎不属于这个世界的存在。

en:
The chill up your spine tells you what this space contains.
Those things did not belong to this world. Neither a removed head nor a detached spinal cord ended their lives. You don’t know what you will face this time.

The one thing we can do…
Is study them as quickly as possible.
cn:
自背脊升起的寒意提醒着你这空间中有着怎样的存在。那绝非这个世界上的东西。无论是砍去头颅还是摘除脊髓，都没能结束它们的生命。你不知道你即将面临些什么。

我们唯一能做的……
只有尽快研究它们。

en:
Something even more threatening seems to be ahead.
The scent of an unknown animal’s blood is stronger than ever.
The lights flicker eerily, but those are not your only clues.
An indescribable feeling, beyond your five senses…
It licks your entire body with a clear warning.

You must brace yourself to get through this area.
cn:
更具威胁性的存在似乎正在前方守候。
未知生物的血腥气味越发浓厚，
灯光也诡异地闪烁着，但这些并非你唯一的线索。
一种无法描述的感受，超越了你的五感……
它正舔舐着你的全身，发出了明确的警告。

你必须做好充足的准备以通过这片区域。

en:
A more vivid sense of danger breathes down your neck. Strange nightmares, maddening shrills, and eerie noises in mimicry of a fruit being drained of its lifeblood all constantly assault your senses.
At one point, your thighs even begin to tremble. Your own body might be trying to prevent you from approaching such imminent peril.

Nevertheless, you know that the only path is forward.
cn:
更加真实的危机感宛若呼吸般扫过你的脖颈。诡异的噩梦，抓狂的尖叫，与仿佛水果被挤压、榨干汁液般的噪声，这些无一不撕扯着你的意识。
在某一刻，你甚至连大腿根也开始打颤。整个身体似乎是在全力阻止你接近这个迫在眉睫的危机。

无论如何，你知道只有前进才是唯一的选择。

en:
This looks to be another point of refraction.
If you can just make it past here…
But, you also get the feeling that it might repel you rather than take you deeper inside. Whichever direction it decides to lead you, there will be no going back.

A solid wall of fear overwhelms you.
cn:
看起来这里是另一个折射点。
如果你能通过这里的话……
但是，比起送入更深的空间，你觉得它或许会把你弹出去。无论它将你引向哪个方向，都绝无回头路可走。

恐惧如同坚固的墙壁般将你压倒。

en:
You’ve been through this at least once before.
Even still, foreboding terror stands tall like a castle wall.
Will you be able to refract downwards to the area below?
Will you be reflected between the cracks of the damaged mirror straight into nothingness?

Turning back is out of the question now.
You have to accept whatever outcome it grants you.
cn:
你至少经历过一次类似的情形。
即便如此，不祥的恐惧感依旧如同城墙般高耸。
你能向下折射至下一层区域吗？
还是说，你会在镜面的裂缝间落入虚无？

现在已经不可能回头了。
你必须接受它给予你的任何结果。

en:
You meet the wall once again.
It seems as though it might tip over and crush your Sinners at any second.
You try running left and right to circumvent it, but the wall is endless.
Your only two choices are to turn around and walk away…
Or break this wall to move forward.

Facing the fear is how you secure your safety.
cn:
再一次，你的面前又耸立起了高墙。
它随时可能翻倒，将你的罪人们压垮。
你尝试过向两边绕开这堵墙，可最终却发现它是无穷无尽的。现在，你只有两个选择：转身离开……
或者将其击碎。

直面恐惧。这是你自保的方式。

cn: 回合开始时，若有目标的[RicardoBookRaid]层数为30层， 则额外获得一个行动槽并使用“即刻处刑！”

Gain the Fixed Panic attribute
Turn End: If this unit is in Panic, reset SP to 0
cn:
适用于固定恐慌 效果，

en:
In this Encounter, when this unit takes damage that brings their HP down to 0, nullify that damage; then, this unit's HP cannot drop below 1 for the turn (once per Encounter)

When this unit gains [Breath] Potency/Count using its own Skill or Coin effects: Give 1 [Breath] Potency and +1 [Breath] Count to 2 other Blade Lineage allies that have no [Breath] or have the least [Breath]

<style="highlight">Combat Start: Apply [SwordPlayOfTheHomeland] buff to all other Blade Lineage allies</style>

Turn Start: At 40+ SP, consume 20 SP to enter the Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion state. (this 'Turn Start' effect does not activate repeatedly)

If 2+ allies are defeated in a single turn, and if this unit's SP isn't at -45 at Turn End, reset SP to 20; then, enter the Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion state. (if both conditions are met at the same time, whichever condition that results in a higher SP goes into effect)

If this unit gets Staggered due to damage or raised Stagger Threshold when entering the Volatile E.G.O state, recover from Stagger. If the Stagger is something that cannot be naturally recovered from, this unit does not enter the Volatile E.G.O state.

Gain [UnstableFeeling] while in the Volatile E.G.O state.

Turn Start: At 0 or less SP, exit the Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion state.
cn:
回合开始时，若自身的理智值不低于40点，则消耗20点理智值并进入不稳定E.G.O::蜡翼状态。(此后回合开始时不会重复生效)
若1回合内不低于2名友方单位阵亡，且回合结束时自身的理智值不为-45点，则使自身的理智值变为20点并进入不稳定E.G.O::蜡翼状态。(2个条件同时满足时，适用于理智值较高的结果)

进入不稳定E.G.O状态时，若自身因受到伤害或混乱阈值前移而陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱。若该混乱无法解除，则无法进入不稳定E.G.O状态。

处于不稳定E.G.O状态时，使自身获得[UnstableFeeling]。

回合开始时，若自身的理智值不高于0点，则解除不稳定E.G.O状态。

Every time another ally Discards a Skill, apply 1 [KnowledgeTraining] to the ally and self (once per Skill, 3 times per turn)

en:
Begin encounters with 10 of each of [BulletLament]

When spending [BulletLament], select randomly between The Living(Potency) and The Departed(Count) for each [BulletLament] value

When inflicting [SinkingWhite], inflict the same amount of The Living and The Departed as they were consumed. Example below:
- If this unit spent X Living, inflict X Living
- If this unit spent Y Departed, inflict Y Departed

If this unit runs out of [BulletLament] midway through Skill use, cancel all subsequent Coins and [ReloadLament]

When [ReloadLament]ing, or when gaining [BulletLament], gain either The Living or The Departed based on this unit's current SP
- At 0 or higher SP: 30% chance to gain The Living; 70% chance to gain The Departed
- At less than 0 SP: 70% chance to gain The Living; 30% chance to gain The Departed
- The probabilities are calculated separately for each ammo spent

战斗开始时带有[BulletLament]各10点

消耗[BulletLament]时，随机选择生蝶(强度)或亡蝶(层数)消耗

施加[SinkingWhite]时，根据该硬币消耗的[BulletLament]相应施加
- 消耗生蝶时，使目标增加生蝶强度
- 消耗亡蝶时，对目标施加亡蝶层数

技能使用中若[BulletLament]不足，则取消后续所有硬币并使自身[ReloadLament]

[ReloadLament]或获得[BulletLament]时，根据现存理智值决定获得蝶的种类
- 理智值不低于0点时，以30%概率增加生蝶强度，以70%概率获得亡蝶层数
- 理智值低于0点时，以70%概率增加生蝶强度，以30%概率获得亡蝶层数
- 每发弹药 单独判定

If this unit reduced the target's [BurstPoison] down to 0 Stack, gain 1 [PenetrateDamageUp] next turn (max 2)
cn:
若目标带有[BurstPoison]，则自身每带有1层[SnakeStance]，使自身造成的伤害+5%(最多+15%)
若自身使目标的[BurstPoison]降至0层，则下回合使自身获得1层[PenetrateDamageUp](最多2层)

cn: 本场战斗中若自身阵亡，则每回合在战斗开始时，使最先编入的解除待命的1名人格增加2级[Breath]强度

en: When 1 ally with the fastest Speed inflicts [Burst] damage to an enemy, inflict 1 [AttackDown] and 1 [DefenseDown] next turn (once per turn)
cn: 速度值最高的1名友方单位对敌方单位造成[Burst]伤害时，下回合对该敌方单位施加1层[AttackDown]与1层[DefenseDown](每回合最多1次)

en:
If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, deal +2% more damage for every 1 Speed difference (max 10%)

Gain 1 [EnhanceZilu] every time an ally triggers a Deathrite effect (5 times per turn)
- If this unit triggered a Deathrite effect, gain 1 additional [EnhanceZilu]
When activating the [SupportProtect] effect, gain 5 [EnhanceZilu]
cn:
若自身的速度值高于目标，则每相差1点，使自身造成的伤害+2%(最多+10%)

战斗中每当友方单位触发咒杀效果时，使自身获得1层[EnhanceZilu](每回合最多5次)
- 若自身触发咒杀效果，则使自身额外获得1层[EnhanceZilu]
触发[SupportProtect]效果时，使自身获得5层[EnhanceZilu]

cn: 速度值最高的1名友方单位造成[Burst]伤害时，下回合使其获得1层[AttackUp](每回合最多3次)

cn: 单位的[BurstZilu]层数降至0层时，对其施加[BurstVulnerableZilu]

en:
When killing the target with this unit's Attack Skills, gain [Breath] equal to [Burst] on target (3 per 1 enemy; once per turn)
- If this unit gained 3 [Breath] with the above effect, gain [Breath] Count equal to [Burst] Count on target (2 per 1 enemy; once per turn)

In a Clash, if this unit's Offense Level is higher than the target's, Clash Power +1

In a Clash, if this unit's Offense Level is higher than the target's, inflict +1 more [Burst] Potency or [Burst] Count with this unit's Base Attack Skills (2 times per turn)
cn:
自身的攻击技能击杀目标时，使自身增加相当于目标[Burst]强度的[Breath]强度(每名敌方单位最多3级，每回合最多1次)
- 通过以上效果增加3级[Breath]强度时，使自身获得层数相当于目标[Burst]层数的[Breath](每名敌方单位最多2层，每回合最多1次)

进行拼点时，若自身的攻击等级高于目标，则使自身的拼点威力+1

进行拼点时，若自身的攻击等级高于目标，则令自身基础攻击技能增加的[Burst]强度与施加的[Burst]层数额外+1(每回合最多触发2次)

en:
Upon Retreat: apply 1 Offense Level Up next turn to allies in their Deployment order
- Number of affected allies = [StartXichun] Stack on self
- If the affected ally is a "Jia Family" unit, apply 2 Offense Level Up next turn instead
- Does not affect allies that either Return or Substitute next turn

On the turn this unit Substituted or Returned to the field, gain [WaitingXichun]; then, at Combat Start, as the very first Skill in the Skill order, use 'Crimson Strike - Launcher【始】' against a random target.
cn:
撤退时，按编队顺序在下回合使友方单位获得1层攻击等级提升 
- 影响的友方单位数：自身的[StartXichun]层数
- 若该友方单位属于贾家，则改为下回合获得2层攻击等级提升 
- 不对下回合重返战斗或解除待命的人格生效

自身解除待命或重返战斗的回合，使自身获得[WaitingXichun]；本回合的战斗开始时，作为技能顺序中最优先的技能，随机对目标使用“赤击-始”

en:
If this unit is defeated in an Encounter, apply [CheerUpXichun] to the subsequently Substituting Identity (the fastest Backup Unit in the Deployment Order) next turn

In Chain Battles, if this unit is a Backup unit or has Retreated, activate the following:
- Combat Start: Among the Identities who 1) are at 50% HP or lower, and 2) used a Defense Skill, choose the Identity with the earliest Deployment order. At Turn End, that Identity recovers from Stagger due to damage and performs a [RetreatForCommon] (2 times per Encounter)
cn:
本场战斗中若自身阵亡，则下回合的战斗开始时使解除待命的人格(待命人员编队顺序最靠前的单位)获得[CheerUpXichun]

连续遭遇战中，若自身处于待命或撤退状态，则触发以下效果
战斗开始时，使现存体力不高于体力上限的50%且使用了守备技能的人格中最先编入的人格在回合结束时解除因受到伤害而陷入的混乱，并使其进行[RetreatForCommon](每场战斗最多2次)

en:
When the 1 ally Identity with the earliest Deployment order among those using [Bullet] finishes their attack, if their current [Bullet] count is fewer than half (rounded up), spend [FireBulletPropellant] on self equal to the total [Bullet] count the affected unit spent and supply them with the same amount of [Bullet] as [FireBulletPropellant] this unit just spent. (can spend up to 3 ammunition) (once per Encounter)

- If the [Bullet] receiving Identity is a Thumb Identity of a higher rank, supply 1 additional [Bullet] they use
- If the [Bullet] receiving Identity has separate values for Potency and Count, they will be supplied at random.
- If either Potency or Count is maxed out, supply whichever is not maxed.
cn:
使用[Bullet]的人格中最先编入的友方单位攻击后，若其现存[Bullet]数低于一半(向上取整)，则消耗自身相当于该人格消耗的[Bullet]数的[FireBulletPropellant]，并使该人格获得相当于自身消耗的[FireBulletPropellant]数的[Bullet](最大消耗量：3发)(每场战斗最多1次)

- 若获得[Bullet]的人格为阶级高于自身且属于拇指的人格，则使其额外获得1发[Bullet]
- 强度与层数分别计算的[Bullet]随机增加强度与获得层数
- 若强度或层数为最大值，则获得未达到最大值的[Bullet]

en:
When the 1 ally Identity with the earliest Deployment order among those using [Bullet] finishes their attack, if their current [Bullet] count is fewer than half (rounded up), spend [FireBulletPropellant] on self equal to the total [Bullet] count the affected unit spent and supply them with the same amount of [Bullet] as [FireBulletPropellant] this unit just spent. <style="highlight">(can spend up to 5 ammunition)</style> (once per Encounter)

- If the [Bullet] receiving Identity is a Thumb Identity of a higher rank, supply 1 additional [Bullet] they use

cn:
使用[Bullet]的人格中最先编入的友方单位攻击后，若其现存[Bullet]数低于一半(向上取整)，则消耗自身相当于该人格消耗的[Bullet]数的[FireBulletPropellant]，并使该人格获得相当于自身消耗的[FireBulletPropellant]数的[Bullet]<style="highlight">(最大消耗量：5发)</style>(每场战斗最多1次)

- 若获得[Bullet]的人格为阶级高于自身且属于拇指的人格，则使其额外获得1发[Bullet]
- 强度与层数分别计算的[Bullet]随机增加强度与获得层数
- 若强度或层数为最大值，则获得未达到最大值的[Bullet]

en:
Always Active: begin Encounters with 15 [FireBulletPropellant]

If this unit spent [FireBulletPropellant] with Skills or Passives, gain [AttackDmgUp] equal to the amount spent next turn (max 3)

When flipping a Coin that spends [FireBulletPropellant]: while not having [FireBulletPropellant] does not cancel this unit's attacks, the Coin's On Hit "inflict [Combustion]" and "inflict [Combustion] Count" effects do not activate
cn:
常驻效果：战斗开始时，带有15发[FireBulletPropellant]

通过技能或被动效果消耗[FireBulletPropellant]时，下回合获得层数相当于消耗量的[AttackDmgUp](最多3层)

掷出消耗[FireBulletPropellant]的硬币时，即使自身未带有[FireBulletPropellant]，攻击也不会取消，但该硬币的命中时增加[Combustion]强度与施加[Combustion]层数效果不会生效

en:
When the 1 ally Identity with the earliest Deployment order among those using [Bullet] finishes their attack, if their current [Bullet] count is fewer than half (rounded up), regain half of the maximum [Bullet] capacity (rounded up; once per Encounter; max [Bullet] regained: 5)

- If the [Bullet] receiving Identity has separate values for Potency and Count, they will gain them at random
- If either Potency or Count of [Bullet] is maxed out, gain whichever is not maxed
- This effect does not activate if there are no Identities that use [Bullet]
cn:
使用[Bullet]的人格中最先编入的友方单位攻击后，若其现存[Bullet]数低于一半，则使其再次获得其[Bullet]最大值一半的[Bullet](向上取整，每场战斗最多1次，最大[Bullet]获得量：5)

- 强度与层数分别计算的[Bullet]随机增加强度与获得层数
- 若强度或层数为最大值，则获得未达到最大值的[Bullet]
- 若没有使用[Bullet]的人格，则该效果不会触发

en:
Always Active: begin Encounters with 12 [BulletPropellantAlly]

When flipping a Coin that consumes [BulletPropellantAlly] or [BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]: while not having those 'Unique Ammo' does not cancel this unit's attacks, the Coin's On Hit "inflict [Combustion]" and "inflict [Combustion] Count" effects do not activate

If this unit equipped Defense Skills for the first time in this Encounter, or if this unit spent all of his [BulletPropellantAlly], or if this unit is Staggered: at the end of that turn, reload 8 [BulletPropellantSpecialAlly] and gain 1 [IrritationAlly] (once per Encounter)
- If this effect activates while this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger (excluding forced Staggers)
- Remove all [BulletPropellantAlly] if this unit has any leftover [BulletPropellantAlly]
- At 8+ (sum of [BulletPropellantAlly] and [BulletPropellantSpecialAlly] spent), convert [IrritationAlly] to [HugeIrritationAlly]

When this unit uses a Base Attack Skill that spends the final Round of [BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]...
- Gain Atk Weight +2 before attacking
- Gain 1 [BeastEyesAlly] next turn
cn:
常驻效果：关卡开始时，带有12发[BulletPropellantAlly]

掷出消耗[BulletPropellantAlly]或[BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]的硬币时，即使自身未带有该特殊弹药，攻击也不会取消，但该硬币的命中时增加[Combustion]强度与施加[Combustion]层数效果不会生效

若本场战斗中自身首次装备了守备技能，或消耗了自身所有[BulletPropellantAlly]，或自身陷入混乱，则在回合结束时，使自身装填8发[BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]并获得1层[IrritationAlly](每场战斗最多1次)
- 若该效果因陷入混乱而触发，则解除自身的混乱(不包括强制混乱)
- 若自身带有剩余的[BulletPropellantAlly]，则解除所有[BulletPropellantAlly]
- 若自身消耗的[BulletPropellantAlly]与[BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]之和不低于8发，则使自身的[IrritationAlly]转化为[HugeIrritationAlly]

自身使用基础攻击技能消耗了最后的[BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]时
- 攻击前，使该技能的攻击容量+2
- 下回合使自身获得[BeastEyesAlly]

en:
When this unit has [BulletPropellantAlly]:
- At 1+ [BulletPropellantAlly], convert all Coins of 'Tanglecleaver' into [SuperCoin]s
- Skill Coins that spend [BulletPropellantAlly] gain +1 Power (activates only as long as the Coin has Rounds left to spend)

When this unit has [BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]:
- At 1+ [BulletPropellantSpecialAlly], convert all Coins of this unit's Base Attack Skills to [SuperCoin]s
- At 0 [BulletPropellantSpecialAlly], convert all Coins of this unit's Base Attack Skills that spend 'Unique Ammo' to [SuperCoin]s
- Skill Coins that spend [BulletPropellantSpecialAlly] gain +2 Power (activates only as long as the Coin has Rounds left to spend)
cn:

- 若自身的[BulletPropellantAlly]数不低于1，则使“快刀乱麻”的所有硬币转化为[SuperCoin]
- 使技能消耗[BulletPropellantAlly]的硬币的威力+1(仅在该硬币有剩余的弹药可消耗时生效)

自身带有[BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]时：
- 若自身的[BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]数不低于1，则使自身基础攻击技能的所有硬币转化为[SuperCoin]
- 若自身的[BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]数为0，则使自身基础攻击技能消耗特殊弹药的硬币转化为[SuperCoin]
- 使技能消耗[BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]的硬币的威力+2(仅在该硬币有剩余的弹药可消耗时生效)

en:

- Skill Coins that spend [BulletPropellantAlly] gain +1 Power <style="highlight">and deal +10% damage</style> (activates only as long as the Coin has Rounds left to spend)

cn:

- 使技能消耗[BulletPropellantAlly]的硬币的威力+1，<style="highlight">造成的伤害+10%</style>(仅在该硬币有剩余的弹药可消耗时生效)

自身带有[BulletPropellantSpecialAlly]时：

- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptAlly]层数为9层，则改为使自身基础技能造成的伤害+20%

自身基础攻击技能的[SuperCoin]命中时，使自身获得1层[StackYisangSpecialSkill]
- 攻击后，使自身获得(剩余的[SuperCoin]数)层[StackYisangSpecialSkill]
<style="highlight">- “Furioso-Replica”攻击后，下回合使自身获得(剩余的[SuperCoin]数/2)层[StackYisangSpecialSkill](向下取整)</style>

<style="highlight">回合结束时，若本回合自身的[StackYisangSpecialSkill]层数达到9层，
且下回合开始时仪表盘上不存在自身的3技能，则使自身的1个基础技能转化为3技能(优先转化位于仪表盘最左侧行动槽下方一行的技能)</style>

en:
Deal +5% damage with Slash, Pierce, and Blunt Base Attack Skills that are used for the first time by any ally each turn (once per type across all allies)
- The Index Identities deal +10% damage instead
- This effect's application is determined Before Attack
cn:
本回合友方单位对敌方单位使用的首个斩击、突刺与打击基础攻击技能造成的伤害+5%(全体友方单位共同判定)
- 若该人格属于食指，则改为造成的伤害+10%
- 该效果于攻击前判定

en: On Kill against targets that have [MeursaultBeeSpore], inflict double the [MeursaultBeeSpore] for the next turn
cn: 击杀带有[MeursaultBeeSpore]的敌方单位时，下回合内令自身施加的[MeursaultBeeSpore]层数变为2倍

en:
On Kill against targets that have [MeursaultBeeSpore], gain the following effects:
- Inflict double the [MeursaultBeeSpore] for the next turn
<style="highlight">- On Kill using a Base Attack Skill, gain (<noparse>Spore</noparse> Round the Skill spends / 2) <noparse>Spore</noparse> Round (rounded up; once per Skill)</style>
cn:
击杀带有[MeursaultBeeSpore]的敌方单位时，触发以下效果
- 下回合内令自身施加的[MeursaultBeeSpore]层数变为2倍
<style="highlight">- 基础攻击技能击杀时，使自身获得(该技能消耗的孢子弹数/2)发孢子弹(向上取整，每个技能最多1次)</style>

en:
Always Active: Begin Encounters with 10 [MeursaultSporeBulletLong] and 6 [MeursaultSporeBulletShort]

On Hit using Coins that spend <noparse>Spore</noparse> Round:
- If [MeursaultSporeBulletLong] was spent, inflict 2 [MeursaultBeeSpore]
- If [MeursaultSporeBulletShort] was spent, inflict 3 [MeursaultBeeSpore]
- This counts as "inflicting negative effects with the Skill"

Before Coin Use of a Coin that spends [MeursaultSporeBulletShort], if this unit does not have [MeursaultSporeBulletShort], consume 2 SP and 2 [MeursaultSporeBulletLong] to gain 1 [MeursaultSporeBulletShort]

If this unit runs out of <noparse>Spore</noparse> Round mid-Skill, cancel all subsequent Coins and [MeursaultSporeBulletReloading]

When targets that have [MeursaultBeeSpore] are killed, gain 1 [MeursaultWorkerBee]
cn:
常驻效果：关卡开始时带有10发[MeursaultSporeBulletLong]与6发[MeursaultSporeBulletShort]

消耗<noparse>孢子</noparse>弹的硬币命中时
- 若消耗了[MeursaultSporeBulletLong]，则对目标施加2层[MeursaultBeeSpore]
- 若消耗了[MeursaultSporeBulletShort]，则对目标施加3层[MeursaultBeeSpore]
- 该效果视作通过技能施加负面状态

消耗[MeursaultSporeBulletShort]的硬币使用前，若自身未带有[MeursaultSporeBulletShort]，
则消耗2点理智值与2发[MeursaultSporeBulletLong]并使自身获得1发[MeursaultSporeBulletShort]

若技能使用中自身消耗了所有孢子弹，则取消之后的所有硬币并使自身[MeursaultSporeBulletReloading]

带有[MeursaultBeeSpore]的目标阵亡时，使自身获得1层[MeursaultWorkerBee]

en:
Apply the following effects for this turn (2 times per Encounter)
- Attack End of Ally Pierce Base Attack Skill: The said ally heals HP equal to 10% of HP damage dealt using the attack
- If all Base Attack Skills equipped on allied Skill Slots are Pierce Skills, all allies heal 10 SP at Turn End
cn:
本回合触发以下效果(每场战斗最多2次)
- 友方单位的突刺基础攻击技能攻击后，使其恢复造成体力伤害量10%的体力
- 若该回合行动槽中装备的基础攻击技能均为突刺技能，则回合结束时使全体友方单位恢复10点理智值

en:
Gain 1 [AlriuneEGOWe] if the enemy takes [Sinking] damage
Gain [AlriuneEGOWe] equal to [AlriuneEGOThey] inflicted every time enemies gain [AlriuneEGOThey]
Gain 2 [AlriuneEGOWe] every time Tremor Burst is triggered regardless of the unit
cn:
敌方单位受到[Sinking]伤害时，使自身获得1层[AlriuneEGOWe]
对敌方单位施加[AlriuneEGOThey]时，使自身获得相应层数的[AlriuneEGOWe]
触发[VibrationExplosion]时，使自身获得2层[AlriuneEGOWe]

en:
Always Active: Begin Encounters with 6 [BulletGodok]

At 1+ [BulletGodok], if the enemy has less than -40 SP or is Staggered at this unit or an ally's Attack End, use 'Bang. Bang.' as an Unopposed Attack (once per turn)

Attack End: At 0 [BulletGodok], use 'Stories that Never Cease' as an Unopposed Attack against the target and consume 10 SP to [FullReload]
cn:
常驻效果：关卡开始时带有6发[BulletGodok]

自身的[BulletGodok]数不低于1发时，若敌方单位在自身或其他友方单位攻击后理智值低于-40点或陷入混乱，则使用“砰。砰。”进行单方面攻击(每回合最多1次)

自身攻击后，若自身的[BulletGodok]数为0发，则使用“无尽的故事”对目标进行单方面攻击，消耗10点理智值并使自身[FullReload]

en:
Gain 1 [AlriuneEGOWe] if the enemy takes [Sinking] damage
Gain [AlriuneEGOWe] equal to [AlriuneEGOThey] inflicted every time enemies gain [AlriuneEGOThey]
Gain 2 [AlriuneEGOWe] every time Tremor Burst is triggered regardless of the unit

Attack Skill End: At 30+ [AlriuneEGOWe], use 'Magnificent End' against the target that has the highest [AlriuneEGOThey] Stack

Deal +([AlriuneEGOThey] on the target)% damage against Staggered targets

If this unit lost 10%+ HP this turn, heal 3% HP and 10 SP (once per turn)
cn:
敌方单位受到[Sinking]伤害时，使自身获得1层[AlriuneEGOWe]
对敌方单位施加[AlriuneEGOThey]时，使自身获得相应层数的[AlriuneEGOWe]
触发[VibrationExplosion]时，使自身获得2层[AlriuneEGOWe]

攻击技能结束时，若自身的[AlriuneEGOWe]层数不低于30层，则对[AlriuneEGOThey]层数最高的目标使用“恍惚的终局”

对陷入混乱的目标造成的伤害+(其[AlriuneEGOThey]层数)%

若本回合自身失去的体力不低于体力上限的10%，则使自身恢复体力上限3%体力与10点理智值(每回合最多1次)

en: When the ally with the fastest Speed hits an enemy using a Skill that inflicts [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking', inflict 2 [Vibration] and trigger [VibrationExplosion]; then, reduce target's [Vibration] Count by 1 (once per turn)
cn: 速度值最高的1名友方单位增加[Sinking]强度，施加[Sinking]层数或施加特殊沉沦[TabExplain]的技能命中敌方单位时，使该敌方单位增加2级[Vibration]强度，使该敌方单位[VibrationExplosion]，并使该敌方单位的[Vibration]层数减少1层(每回合最多1次)

en:
Gain 1 [Charge] every time this unit consumes 10 cumulative [Charge] Count in this Encounter
Any [ChargeForceField] this unit gains is converted to [HighVoltageExoshell]

At 3+ [Charge] on self, Min & Max Speed +1

In this Encounter, when this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, gain [SelfChargeAlly] equal to (5 + [Charge] on self x 3) (max 20, once per Encounter)
cn:
本场战斗中，每当自身累计消耗10层[Charge]时，使自身增加1级[Charge]强度
使自身获得的[ChargeForceField]转化为[HighVoltageExoshell]

若自身的[Charge]强度不低于3级，则使自身的最小与最大速度值+1

本场战斗中，自身受到将自身体力降至0点的伤害时，
使自身获得(5+自身的[Charge]强度×3)层[SelfChargeAlly](最多20层，每场战斗最多1次)

en:
Turn Start: If there are 3+ allies wearing E.G.O Gear including this unit, all relevant allies gain 1 [AttackUp]

If this unit has 12 or less [Charge] Count when consuming [Charge] Count due to AEDD Gregor's E.G.O Passive effect:
On Heads Hit, instead of consuming 2 [Charge] Count, this unit consumes 4 Shield or HP to activate the E.G.O Passive effect
- This effect triggers only when this unit is at 25%+ HP
cn:
回合开始时，若包括自身在内身着E.G.O装备的友方单位数不低于3名，
则使身着E.G.O装备的全体友方单位获得1层[AttackUp]

自身通过AEDD 格里高尔的E.G.O被动效果消耗[Charge]层数时，若自身的[Charge]层数不高于12层，则正面命中时改为消耗自身4点护盾或体力触发效果，而非消耗2层[Charge]
- 该效果仅在现存体力不低于25%时生效

en:
Combat Start: Gain +5 [Charge] Count (once per Encounter)

Combat End: At more than 12 [Charge] Count, consume excess [Charge] Count up to 8 and apply +(half of [Charge] Count consumed due to this effect) [Charge] Count on an ally (min 1, rounded down)
- This effect prioritizes the ally that has the lowest [Charge] Count among allies with earlier Deployment order than this unit
- If there are no allies with earlier Deployment order than this unit on the battlefield, or if this unit has 3+ [Charge], deactivate this effect

At 3+ Gloom or Envy Reson., apply +2 [Charge] Count next turn on allies with earlier Deployment order than this unit
- Applies on (Higher Reson. between Gloom and Envy - 2) allies, in Deployment order (max 3 allies)
- At 3+ [Charge], apply +4 [Charge] Count on allies instead
- If there are no allies with earlier Deployment order than this unit on the battlefield, gain +4 [Charge] Count instead
cn:
战斗开始时，使自身获得5层[Charge](每场战斗最多1次)

战斗结束时，若自身的[Charge]层数高于12层，
则消耗最多8层溢出[Charge]并使1名友方单位获得(该效果消耗的[Charge]层数的一半)层[Charge](最少1层，向下取整)
- 该效果优先适用于比自身编队顺序靠前的友方单位中[Charge]层数最低的友方单位
- 若场上没有比自身编队顺序靠前的的友方单位或自身[Charge]强度不低于3级，则禁用该效果

若忧郁或嫉妒共鸣数不低于3，
则下回合使比自身编队顺序靠前的的友方单位获得2层[Charge]
- 按编队顺序使(忧郁或嫉妒共鸣中较高的共鸣数-2)名友方获得(最多3名)
- 若自身[Charge]强度不低于3级，则改为使友方单位获得4层[Charge]
- 若场上没有比自身编队顺序靠前的友方单位，则改为使自身获得4层[Charge]

If every Candle is snuffed and at full HP, gain resistance until all Candles are lit again.

若所有蜡烛都被熄灭且体力全满，则在所有蜡烛再次被点燃之前获得抗性提升。

HP does not drop below 1.

对上回合成功攻击的行动槽使用技能时，根据累计成功攻击的回合数，获得对应效果。

若自身在战斗中登场，或即将登场的敌方单位包括自身，则从第1回合起，根据全体单位受到的[Laceration]伤害，相应获得[BloodDinner]。

- At 20+ [BloodScissor], convert them to [BloodScissorThree].

回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则下回合开始时解除自身的恐慌并使自身的理智值恢复为0点。
