cn: 除非自身陷入混乱或部位被破坏，否则自身受到的暴击时造成的伤害减半。

en: Turn Start: to a random enemy, deal fixed damage equal to 5% of their HP.
cn: 回合开始时，随机对1名敌方单位造成其体力上限5%的固定伤害。

en:
Attack End: Heal Core and Part equal to 50% of the damage this unit dealt with its Attack Skill
- At 100% HP, gain 2 [AttackUp] next turn. (2 times max)
Based on the percentage of HP healed, gain the following effects (cumulative)
- At 1+ Stack: Gain 3 Defense Level Up at every Turn Start
- At 2+ Stack: Gain 3 [AttackUp] at every Turn Start
- At 3+ Stack: Gain +2 Min & Max Speed
- At 5+ Stack: Gain 3 [Enhancement] at every Turn Start
cn:
攻击结束后，使本体与部位恢复自身攻击技能伤害量一半的体力
- 自身体力为100%时，下回合使自身获得2层[AttackUp](最多2次)
根据已恢复的体力按比例获得累加效果
- 层数不低于1层：每回合开始时，使自身获得3层防御等级提升 
- 层数不低于2层：每回合开始时，使自身获得3层[AttackUp]
- 层数不低于3层：每回合开始时，使自身的最小与最大速度值+2
- 层数不低于5层：每回合开始时，使自身获得3层[Enhancement]

en:
Attack End: Inflict 1 [TinyCarmilla]
If the target has [Laceration], inflict 1 additional [TinyCarmilla] at Attack End
cn:
攻击结束后，对目标施加1层[TinyCarmilla]
若目标带有[Laceration]，则在攻击结束后额外施加1层[TinyCarmilla]

en:
If the target has [Burst] immediately before attack, 20% chance to inflict +1 [Burst] Count
When inflicting [ThornNoose], generate a 'Barbed Lasso' Unit.
cn:
攻击前，若目标带有[Burst]，则以20%的概率对目标施加1层[Burst]
对目标施加[ThornNoose]时，生成荆棘套索。

en: Gain Speed equal to the generated 'Barbed Lasso' Unit on the field
cn: 根据生成的荆棘套索相应增加速度值

en:
At 40%- HP, gain a new pattern
Every turn, inflict [Burst] equal to each enemy's Speed against each enemy
Inflict 2 [ThornNoose] instead
Gain 2 [AttackUp] and [DefenseDown] with every passing turn (max 12)
cn:
体力不高于体力上限的40%时，改变自身模式
每回合使全体敌方单位增加相当于其速度值的[Burst]强度
改为施加2层[ThornNoose]
每经过1回合，使自身获得2层[AttackUp]并对自身施加2层[DefenseDown](最多12层)

en:
Encounter Start: gain [Dreamy].
Encounter Start: the sleeping blood drenching the battlefield will surface, increasing [BloodDinner] by 400.
cn:
战斗开始时，对自身施加[Dreamy]。
战斗开始时，展现洒落在战场上的潜伏之血，获得400层[BloodDinner]。

en:
Upon hitting 80%, 60%, and 40% HP, no longer take damage and gain a new pattern
Upon gaining a new pattern, recover from Stagger and raise Speed to 10 next turn
cn:
剩余体力为80%、60%、40%时，体力不会降低并改变攻击模式
改变攻击模式时，解除自身的混乱并使自身下回合速度值为10

en:
On Hit, if the target has [Laceration], heal Part and Core by 40% of the damage dealt.
- This Passive heals +1% more HP for every [Laceration] Potency on self (max 20%)
- For Unbreakable Coins: this effect does not activate on Hit After Clash Lose.
Every Turn Start: heal ([BloodDinner]/10) HP. (max 50)
Every Turn Start: at -15 or less SP, consume (20 - current SP) [BloodDinner] to gain SP and gain 2 Clash Power Up
On Kill, gain 5 [BloodArmor]
cn:
攻击命中时，若目标带有[Laceration]，则使自身部位与本体恢复造成伤害量40%的体力。
- 自身每带有1级[Laceration]强度，使本被动的恢复量增加1%(最多20%)
- 不可摧毁的硬币拼点失败后命中不会触发该效果。
每回合开始时，使自身恢复([BloodDinner]层数/10)点体力(最多50点)
每回合开始时，若自身的理智值不高于-15点，则消耗(20-自身的理智值)层[BloodDinner]并使自身恢复理智值，并使自身获得2层拼点威力提升 
击杀敌方单位后，使自身获得5层[BloodArmor]

en: Turn End: Min & Max Speed +1 next turn for every 300 [BloodDinner]
cn: 回合结束时，每有300层[BloodDinner]，下回合使自身最小与最大速度值+1

en:
If this unit is on field, or is one of the units that can appear on this Stage, increase [BloodDinner] value by the amount of [Laceration] damage collectively received by every unit.
When this unit enters the field, the sleeping blood drenching the battlefield will flood the surface.
cn:
若自身在战斗中登场，或即将登场的敌方单位包括自身，则从第1回合起，根据全体单位受到的[Laceration]伤害，相应获得[BloodDinner]。
自身在战斗中登场时，完全展现洒落在战场上的潜伏之血。

en:
Combat Start: gain 1 [BloodArmor]
- [BloodArmor] cannot drop below 1
- At 10+ [BloodArmor], convert them to [BloodArmor_2nd].
- At 20+ [BloodArmor], convert them to [BloodArmor_3rd].
Gain Min & Max Speed based on the Stage of this effect (max 2)
If this unit consumes [BloodArmor] and drops below the above thresholds, revert to previous Stages accordingly
cn:
战斗开始时，使自身获得1层[BloodArmor]
- [BloodArmor]不会低于1
- [BloodArmor]不低于10时，转化为[BloodArmor_2nd]
- [BloodArmor]不低于20时，转化为[BloodArmor_3rd]
根据阶段相应使自身最小与最大速度值增加(最多2)
若[BloodArmor]被消耗至阈值以下，则转换至前一阶段

en:
Turn End: If Panicked, recover from Panic, and consume 100 [BloodDinner] to gain 3 [Enhancement]
- If this unit failed to consume [BloodDinner], gain 30 [Laceration], 3 [Enhancement], and 2 Damage Up
cn:
回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则解除自身的恐慌，消耗100层[BloodDinner]并使自身获得3层[Enhancement]
- 若未消耗[BloodDinner]，则使自身增加30级[Laceration]强度并使自身获得3层[Enhancement]与2层伤害强化

en: When this unit dies, the [ThornNoose] of the enemy bound to this unit expires
cn: 自身阵亡时，解除捕捉的敌方单位的[ThornNoose]

en: At Turn Start, apply 2 Defense Level Up to the ally who lost the most HP percentage between this Turn and last Turn
cn: 回合开始时，使现存体力与上回合体力相比减少比例最高的友方单位获得2层防御等级提升

en: When this unit is killed due to enemy attack or Status effect damage, increase [BloodDinner] by 30, and increase E.G.O resource of a random Affinity by 2. Does not activate if this unit killed itself.
cn: 自身被敌方单位的攻击或状态效果造成的伤害击杀时，获得30层[BloodDinner]，并随机获得2个E.G.O资源。被自身击杀时不生效。

en: If this unit is still alive by Turn End, use the self-detonation Skill next turn. If this unit is still alive at the same Turn End as the turn this unit used the self-detonation Skill, dies.
cn: 回合结束时若自身存活，则下回合使用自爆技能。使用自爆技能的回合结束时，自身阵亡。

en: Core HP does not drop below 1.
cn: 本体的体力不会降至1点以下。

en: Generates Gondolas filled with Bloodfiends and Bloodbags at a set interval. A certain number of Bloodfiends and Bloodbags may arrive at the field when a Gondola is generated.
cn: 以一定周期生成载有血魔与血袋的座舱。生成座舱时，一定数量的血魔与血袋将一同登场。

en:
Cannot be attacked when there is a Gondola on the field.
Does not lose HP due to Skill damage. Does not take HP damage due to [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], or [Sinking].
cn:
生成座舱时自身不会受到攻击。
不会因技能伤害失去体力。不会因[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]或[Sinking]受到体力伤害。

en: If [FerrisWheel] is at 0 and there are no units to be spawned next turn at Turn End or during the combat phase, move on to the next phase.
cn: 若回合结束时或战斗中自身的[FerrisWheel]为0层，且下回合没有单位登场，则进入下一阶段。

en: Gain [StarvingDonqui] at the start of the Encounter
cn: 战斗开始时，对自身施加[StarvingDonqui]

en:
- At 10+ [RegainedStrength], convert them to [RegainedStrength_2nd].
- At 20+ [RegainedStrength], convert them to [RegainedStrength_3rd].
- If this unit consumes [RegainedStrength] and drops it below the above thresholds, revert to previous Stages accordingly
cn:
- [RegainedStrength]的层数不低于10层时，转化为[RegainedStrength_2nd]
- [RegainedStrength]的层数不低于20层时，转化为[RegainedStrength_3rd]
- 若[RegainedStrength]的层数被消耗至阈值以下，则转换至前一阶段

en:
On Hit, if the target has [Laceration], heal this unit's Part & Core by 30% of the HP damage dealt.
For Unbreakable Coins: this effect does not activate on Hit after Clash Lose.
cn:
攻击命中时，若目标带有[Laceration]，则使自身部位与本体恢复造成体力伤害量30%的体力。
不可摧毁的硬币拼点失败后命中不会触发该效果。

en:
If this unit healed more than 15% of its max HP, or siphoned the enemy's [Laceration], gain 3 [Binding] next turn. (once per turn)
If this unit killed the target with its Skill, gain 2 [AttackDown] and 1 [DefenseDown] next turn. (3 times per turn)
cn:
若自身恢复的体力不低于15%，或吸收了目标带有的[Laceration]，下回合对自身施加3层[Binding](每回合最多1次)
若自身使用的技能击杀了目标，下回合对自身施加2层[AttackDown]与1层[DefenseDown](每回合最多3次)

en:
Turn End: If Panicked, recover from Panic at the next Turn Start and reset SP to 0.
When recovering from Panic:
- Consume 30 [BloodDinner] to gain 2 [Enhancement] and 1 [Agility] next turn, and heal 30 SP.
- If this unit failed to consume [BloodDinner], gain 40 [Laceration], immediately take the damage from [Laceration], then lose 5 [Laceration] Count.
- Then, gain 2 [Enhancement] next turn and heal 30 SP
cn:
回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则下回合开始时解除自身的恐慌并使自身的理智值变为0点
解除恐慌时
- 消耗30层[BloodDinner]，下回合使自身获得2层[Enhancement]与1层[Agility]，并使自身恢复30点理智值
- 若未消耗[BloodDinner]，则使自身增加40级[Laceration]强度并立即触发自身的[Laceration]，随后使自身的[Laceration]层数减少5层
- 之后，下回合使自身获得2层[Enhancement]并恢复30点理智值

en:
If this unit is eliminated, increase [BloodDinner] by 30
When killed by a Sinner, generate Memories of the Dreaming Adventure
cn:
若自身被去除，则获得30层[BloodDinner]
被罪人击杀时，生成梦中的冒险记忆

en:
When killed by Don Quixote:
- Don Quixote gains 5 [RegainedStrength].
- All Sinners take 30 Lust damage and gain 8 [Laceration] Potency and Count.
cn:
被堂吉诃德击杀时，
- 使堂吉诃德获得5层[RegainedStrength]。
- 对全体罪人造成30点色欲伤害，使其增加8级[Laceration]强度并对其施加8层[Laceration]。

en:
All Sinners gain 5 SP at every Turn Start.
Don Quixote the Sinner gains a special effect
cn:
每回合开始时，使全体罪人恢复5点理智值。
罪人堂吉诃德获得特殊效果

en: When killed by Don Quixote: Don Quixote gains 3 [Reduction] this turn and next turn.
cn: 被堂吉诃德击杀时，本回合与下回合对堂吉诃德施加3层[Reduction]。

en: When this unit is eliminated, the ally who was impaled by this unit will lose the [Penetration] status next turn.
cn: 自身被去除后，下回合解除被自身刺穿的友方单位的[Penetration]。

en: When this unit is eliminated, gain 3 E.G.O resources for the least-owned E.G.O resource.
cn: 去除自身后，获得3个持有量最少的E.G.O资源与3个随机的E.G.O资源。

en:
If this unit is not eliminated by the turn after its generation, this unit will be eliminated at Turn End, activating the following effect.
The ally who was impaled by this unit takes fixed damage equal to 30% of their max HP, and gains 10 [Laceration] Potency and +5 [Laceration] Count.
cn:
若自身未在生成的下回合被去除，则该回合结束时去除自身，并触发去除时生效的效果。
去除后，对自身刺穿的友方单位造成该友方单位体力上限30%的固定伤害，使其增加10级[Laceration]强度并对其施加5层[Laceration]。

en: When killed by true Don Quixote, activate the on-death effect, and the ally impaled by this unit will be killed.
cn: 被真正的堂吉诃德击杀时，触发阵亡时生效的效果，并击杀被自身刺穿的友方单位。

en: If this unit has [Precarious], Memories of the Dreaming Adventure will not be generated on death
cn: 若自身带有[Precarious]，击杀时不会产生梦中的冒险记忆。

en: Encounter Start: gain [ConfinementOfGoldenBranch].
cn: 战斗开始时，对自身施加[ConfinementOfGoldenBranch]。

en: When gaining a new pattern, halve the Potency of [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking] on this unit's Parts.
cn: 攻击模式改变时，使自身的部位的[Combustion]，[Laceration]，[Vibration]，[Burst]，[Sinking]强度减半。

en: Don Quixote gains Shield at every Turn Start.
cn: 每回合开始时，堂吉诃德获得护盾。

en: Turn End: if this unit lost a Clash this turn, gain 2 [Binding] next turn
cn: 回合结束时，若本回合自身拼点失败，则下回合对自身施加2层[Binding]

en:
First Turn Start: gain [RepressedMurderousIntendTwo]
Ends Encounter when Hong Lu dies
cn:
首个回合开始时，使自身获得[RepressedMurderousIntendTwo]
鸿璐阵亡时，战斗结束

en: First Turn Start: heal 30 SP and gain [ExaminationOfQiu]
cn: 首个回合开始时，使自身恢复30点理智值并对自身施加[ExaminationOfQiu]

en: If target has 4+ negative effects, Clash Power +1
cn: 若目标带有的负面状态不少于4种，则使自身的拼点威力+1

en: Deal +10% damage against targets with [BurstStop]
cn: 对带有[BurstStop]的目标造成的伤害+10%

en: Take -20% damage from targets with [BurstSuppress]
cn: 受到带有[BurstSuppress]的目标的伤害-20%

en:
Gains a new pattern at 85% HP
Enter a new phase at 60% HP
cn:
体力不高于85%时，改变模式
体力不高于60%时，改变阶段

en: Ends encounter when Hong Lu dies
cn: 鸿璐阵亡时，战斗结束

en: When an Identity's HP drops to 1 or below, retreat them from the Encounter
cn: 人格的体力不高于1点时，使其从战斗中撤退

en: Turn End: for every Clash this unit lost, gain 1 Binding next turn (max 6)
cn: 回合开始时，根据自身拼点失败次数，下回合对自身施加相应层数的束缚 (最多6层)

en:
First Turn Start: heal 30 SP
Gains a new pattern at 85% HP
Gain 500 Shield at Turn Start, at 60% HP
- After this effect activates, this unit does not drop below 1 HP
cn:
首个回合开始时，使自身恢复30点理智值
体力不高于85%时，改变模式
体力不高于60%时，回合开始时获得500点护盾
- 此后自身体力不会降至1点以下

en: First Turn Start: gain [ExaminationOfQiu]
cn: 首个回合开始时，对自身施加[ExaminationOfQiu]

en: If target has 3+ types of Deathrites, Coin Power +1
cn: 若目标带有的咒杀不少于3种，则使自身的硬币威力+1

en: Ends the Encounter at 50% HP
cn: 体力不高于50%时，结束战斗

en: When using 'Bring Forth a Real Answer', summon the Heishou
cn: 使用技能“想得答案”时，召唤黑兽

en: Begins the Encounter with half the Potency and Count for the following effects this unit had at the start of this phase: [Burst], [Combustion], [Sinking], [Vibration], [Laceration]
cn: 阶段开始时，使自身的[Burst]、[Combustion]、[Sinking]、[Vibration]与[Laceration]的强度与层数减半

en:
Attack End: heal 5 SP for every Deathrite on the target
On Hit, when the target's Deathrite is triggered, heal 3 SP for every Deathrite triggered
cn:
攻击结束后，目标每带有1种咒杀，使自身恢复5点理智值
命中时，若触发了目标的咒杀，则每触发1种咒杀，使自身恢复3点理智值

en:
Every Turn Start: Core and Part gain 900 Shield.
- When Hong Lu has [Teaching], lose 300 Shield per Stack on Hong Lu
- When Hong Lu has 3+ [Teaching], this unit does not gain Shield for the rest of the Encounter
cn:
每回合开始时，使本体与部位获得900点护盾。
- 鸿璐每带有1层[Teaching]，使自身获得的护盾减少300点
- 若鸿璐的[Teaching]层数不低于3层，则本场战斗期间自身不再获得护盾

en: Final Power +2 in Clashes against Hong Lu
cn: 与鸿璐进行拼点时，使自身的最终威力+2

en: Turn Start: gain [AttackUp] equal to the number of Jars defeated in this Encounter (max 5)
cn: 回合开始时，本场战斗每有1口瓮阵亡，使自身获得1层[AttackUp](最多5层)

en: Deal +1% damage for every 1% missing HP on self (max 50%)
cn: 自身每失去1%的体力，使自身造成的伤害+1%(最多+50%)

en:
On Hit with a Skill: heal 10% of the damage dealt (rounded down)
If target has [MadFeather], heal additional ([MadFeather] Stack on target)% HP
cn:
技能命中时，使自身恢复该技能伤害量10%的体力(向下取整)
若目标带有[MadFeather]，则使自身额外恢复(目标的[MadFeather]层数)%的体力

en: On Hit, heal 3 SP on self
cn: 自身的攻击命中时，使自身恢复3点理智值

en: Gain 1 [AttackUp] next turn every time this unit loses a Clash (max 3)
cn: 每当自身拼点失败时，下回合使自身获得1层[AttackUp](最多3层)

en: Whenever this unit hits the same target three times in the same turn, inflict 1 [Vulnerable] next turn
cn: 同一回合内自身每命中同一目标3次，下回合对该目标施加1层[Vulnerable]

en: Offense Level +1 and Defense Level -1 for every 15% HP this unit cumulatively lost in this Encounter (max 6)
cn: 本场战斗自身每累计失去15%的体力，使自身增加1级攻击等级并减少1级防御等级(最多6级)

en: Encounter Start: enters the battle with 80% HP
cn: 关卡开始时，以80%的体力开始战斗

en:
Turn End: at 20 or less SP, this unit siphons 10 SP from 3 random allies with the highest SP to heal its own SP

Turn Start: Apply 2 [AttackDmgUp] to all other allies with -20 or less SP
cn:
回合结束时，若自身的理智值不高于20点，则随机消耗理智值最高的3名友方单位10点理智值并使自身恢复相应的理智值

回合开始时，使全体理智值不高于-20点友方单位(除自身以外)获得2层[AttackDmgUp]

en: When inflicting [OminousTalisman] on an enemy, if the target already has [OminousTalisman], consume up to 3 [OminousTalisman] on the target and inflict the same value as [DefenseDown] Stacks to the target this turn and next turn
cn: 对敌方单位施加[OminousTalisman]时，若目标带有[OminousTalisman]，则消耗其最多3层[OminousTalisman]并在本回合与下回合对其施加相应层数的[DefenseDown]

en:
In this Encounter, if this unit takes damage that brings this unit's HP down to half or less, nullify that damage and end the turn. Then, move to the rearmost position of the Substitution order (when Staggered, recover immediately)

If there are no more enemies to Substitute in, or if there aren't enough of them left, (as in, if there are more dead enemies this turn than there are waiting to Substitute into the Encounter) this effect does not activate
cn:
本场战斗期间，若自身受到使自身体力降至体力上限一半以下的伤害，则无视该伤害并结束本回合，自身移动到登场顺序最靠后的位置(陷入混乱时立刻解除)

若没有即将登场的敌方单位或剩余敌方单位不足(本回合阵亡的敌方单位数多于即将登场的敌方单位)，则该效果不会触发

en: When Wang Qingshan loses all HP in this Encounter, the Encounter ends
cn: 本场战斗中，王清山失去了全部体力时，战斗结束

en: Turn End: at 7+ [Charge], gain 4 [DefenseDown] and 3 [AttackDmgUp] next turn
cn: 回合结束时，若自身的[Charge]强度不低于7级，则下回合对自身施加4层[DefenseDown]并使自身获得3层[AttackDmgUp]

en: If this unit inflicted 4 or more [Burst] during this turn, gain +3 [Charge] Count at Turn End (once per turn)
cn: 若本回合自身使单位增加了不低于4级[Burst]强度，则回合结束时使自身获得3层[Charge](每回合最多1次)

en: Turn Start: gain 1 [AttackDmgUp] for every [Charge] on self
cn: 回合开始时，自身每带有1级[Charge]强度，使自身获得1层[AttackDmgUp]

en: When Shi Hua... something? loses all HP in this Encounter, the Encounter ends
cn: 本场战斗中，史华？失去了全部体力时，战斗结束

en: Turn Start: if this unit has [Charge], gain (100 - (([Charge] - 1) x 10)) Shield. At 7+ [Charge], this unit no longer gains Shield with this Passive.
cn: 回合开始时，若自身带有[Charge]，则使自身获得(100-((自身的[Charge]强度-1)×10))点护盾。自身的[Charge]强度不低于7级时，此后本场战斗期间不会通过本被动获得护盾。

en: Turn Start: if this unit has 50% or less HP, sacrifice a random Shi Family Mercenary to heal (10% of this unit's HP + 50% of the sacrificed unit's HP) HP, heal 25 SP, and recover from Stagger (once per turn)
cn: 回合开始时，若现存体力不高于50%，则随机牺牲1名史家私兵并使自身恢复(自身体力上限10%+牺牲单位体力上限50%)的体力与25点理智值，解除自身的混乱(每回合最多1次)

en:
Turn Start: gain 5 [Protection]
- Gain fewer Stacks depending on this unit's [Charge]
- At 5+ [Charge], this unit no longer gains [Protection] with this Passive
cn:
回合开始时，使自身获得5层[Protection]
- 根据自身的[Charge]强度，相应使自身获得的[Protection]层数减少
- 自身的[Charge]强度不低于5级时，此后本场战斗期间自身不会通过本被动获得[Protection]

en: When Shi Sijing loses all HP in this Encounter, the Encounter ends
cn: 本场战斗中，史思静失去了全部体力时，战斗结束

en: When Xue Pan loses all HP in this Encounter, the Encounter ends
cn: 本场战斗中，薛蟠失去了全部体力时，战斗结束

en: When Shi Yihua loses all HP in this Encounter, the Encounter ends
cn: 本场战斗中，史易华失去了全部体力时，战斗结束

en:
Turn Start: heal 30 SP
Turn Start: gain up to 500 Shield
- This unit does not drop below 1 HP
cn:
回合开始时，使自身恢复30点理智值
回合开始时，使自身获得至500点护盾
- 自身的体力不会降至1点以下

en:
Take -30% damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking]

When flipping a Coin that consumes [BulletPropellant]: while not having [BulletPropellant] does not cancel this unit's attacks, the Coin's "inflict [Combustion]" and "inflict [Combustion] Count" effects do not activate

In a Clash, inflict +(1 + (# of Clashes / 3)) [Vibration] Count
(max 3; 3 times per turn against the same target)
cn:
受到的[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]伤害-30%

掷出消耗[BulletPropellant]的硬币时，即使自身消耗了所有[BulletPropellant]，攻击也不会取消，但该硬币的增加[Combustion]强度与施加[Combustion]层数的效果不会生效

进行拼点时，对目标施加(1+进行拼点次数/3)层[Vibration]
(最多3层，每回合每个目标最多3次)

en:
At Encounter Start, and at the Turn Start of gaining a new pattern:
- Gain 1 [Bothersome]
- Heal 5 SP for every 10% missing HP on self (max 40)
cn:
关卡开始时与改变模式的回合开始时
- 对自身施加1层[Bothersome]
- 自身每失去10%的体力，使自身恢复5点理智值(最多40点)

en:
Turn Start: inflict 1 [Prey] against the target that dealt the most damage to this unit last turn

After Lei Heng attacks the target with [Prey], if the target is:
- Staggered, all enemies lose 10 SP and gain 1 [ParryingResultDown] for this turn and next turn (once per turn)
- Defeated, activate the above effect once more
cn:
回合开始时，对在上回合对自身造成的伤害最高的目标施加1层[Prey]

雷横攻击带有[Prey]的目标后，若目标
- 陷入混乱，则使全体敌方单位失去10点理智值并在本回合与下回合对其施加1层[ParryingResultDown](每回合最多1次)
- 阵亡，则以上效果额外触发1次

en:
Unopposed Attacks deal +30% damage On Hit and inflict 1 [Vulnerable] next turn

Skill Coins that spent [BulletPropellant] deal +20% damage On Hit and inflict 2 [DefenseDown] next turn

The above effects do not activate if the target equipped a Defense Skill
cn:
单方面攻击命中时，造成的伤害+30%并在下回合对目标施加1层[Vulnerable]

技能消耗[BulletPropellant]的硬币命中时，造成的伤害+20%并在下回合对目标施加2层[DefenseDown]

若目标装备了守备技能，则以上效果不会生效

en:
Turn End: at 90% or less HP, or at the end of the 2nd turn, reload [BulletPropellant] and gain a new pattern next turn
- If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger
cn:
回合结束时现存体力不高于90%或第2回合结束时，使自身装填[BulletPropellant]并在下回合改变自身模式
- 若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

en:
Turn End: at 80% or less HP, or at the end of the 4th turn, gain a new pattern next turn
- Use a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver'), repeat every 3rd turn. +10 to Min & Max Speed for turns in which this unit uses this Skill
- At the start of that turn, gain 25 [BattleSense]
- If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger
cn:
回合结束时现存体力不高于80%或第4回合结束时，下回合改变自身模式
- 使用强力攻击(“快刀乱麻”)，每3回合重复该效果。使用该技能的回合使自身的最小与最大速度值+10
- 该回合开始时，使自身获得25层[BattleSense]
- 若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

en:
If this unit's HP dropped to 60% or below at Turn End, or if this unit is set to use a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver') next turn for the second time this Encounter, gain a new pattern next turn
- When that turn starts, gain 1 [Irritation]
- When that turn starts, gain 18 [BulletPropellantSpecial] and reload immediately
· If this unit spends all [BulletPropellantSpecial], convert the effect to [BulletPropellant] and summon 2 of "Stern Soldato of the Thumb" units next turn and have them supply this unit with [BulletPropellantSpecial]
- When Staggered, recover from Stagger
cn:
若回合结束时现存体力不高于60%或下回合将使用本场战斗的第2次强力攻击(“快刀乱麻”)，则下回合改变自身模式
- 该回合开始时，使自身获得1层[Irritation]
- 该回合开始时，使自身获得18发[BulletPropellantSpecial]并立刻装填
· 若自身消耗了所有[BulletPropellantSpecial]，则使其转化为[BulletPropellant]并在下回合召唤2名严格的拇指士兵为自身补给[BulletPropellantSpecial]
- 若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

en:
Turn End: at 40% or less HP, or if this unit is set to use a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver') next turn for the third time this Encounter, gain a new pattern next turn
- Replace the powerful attack 'Tanglecleaver' with 'Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades'. +15 to Min & Max Speed for turns in which this unit uses this Skill
- Convert [BattleSense] to [RestoredBattleSense]
- Convert [Irritation] to [HugeIrritation]
- If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger
cn:
若回合结束时现存体力不高于40%或下回合将使用本场战斗的第3次强力攻击(“快刀乱麻”)，则下回合改变自身模式
- 强力攻击“快刀乱麻”改为“超绝猛虎杀击乱斩”。使用该技能的回合使自身的最小与最大速度值+15
- 使自身的[BattleSense]转化为[RestoredBattleSense]
- 使自身的[Irritation]转化为[HugeIrritation]
- 若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

en:
Combat Start: based on this unit's Speed value,
- Heal SP equal to Speed value. At less than 0 SP, double the heal amount
- Gain (Speed Value / 3) [SlashDamageUp] (max 5)

Combat Start: if this unit has 3+ [Binding], the above effect does not activate; gain [DefenseDown] equal to [Binding] on self (max 9)
cn:
战斗开始时，根据自身的速度值
- 使自身恢复相当于自身的速度值的理智值。若自身理智值低于0点，则使恢复的理智值变为2倍
- 使自身获得(自身的速度值/3)层[SlashDamageUp](最多5层)

战斗开始时，若自身的[Binding]层数不低于3层，则以上效果不会触发并对自身施加层数相当于自身[Binding]层数的[DefenseDown](最多9层)

en: If this unit used a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver' or 'Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades'), gain [Complacency] next turn equal to the number of times those skills were used (max 5)
cn: 若使用了强力攻击(“快刀乱麻”，“超绝猛虎杀击乱斩”)，则下回合对自身施加层数相当于本场战斗期间自身使用该技能次数的[Complacency](最多5层)

en:
Turn Start: gain 5 [Vulnerable]
Turn End: supply [BulletPropellantSpecial] to Lei Heng

If this unit is killed, this unit cannot supply [BulletPropellantSpecial] for Lei Heng; Lei Heng gains 1 [Vulnerable] and 1 [ParryingResultDown] next turn
cn:
回合开始时，对自身施加5层[Vulnerable]
回合结束时，为雷横补给[BulletPropellantSpecial]

自身阵亡时无法为雷横补给[BulletPropellantSpecial]，下回合对雷横施加1层[Vulnerable]与1层[ParryingResultDown]

en:
On Hit against an enemy, inflict 1 [GazeReplica] (once per Identity per turn)
When attacked by an enemy, inflict 1 [GazeReplica] against the attacker (once per Identity per turn)
Turn Start: if Hong Lu is on the field, inflict 1 [GazeReplica] against Hong Lu
cn:
自身的攻击命中敌方单位时，对该敌方单位施加1层[GazeReplica](每回合每名人格最多1次)
受到敌方单位的攻击时，对攻击者施加1层[GazeReplica](每回合每名人格最多1次)
回合开始时，若鸿璐在场，则对其施加1层[GazeReplica]

en:
Prioritizes targets with [GraspReplica]
Gains a new pattern when there are targets with [GraspReplica]; +0.1 to all Resistances
cn:
优先指定带有[GraspReplica]的目标
有目标带有[GraspReplica]时改变自身模式，使自身的所有抗性+0.1

en:
After entering this Encounter, gain 1 [EgoErodeReplica] at every passing Turn End
- Turn End: at less than 50% HP, or at -20 SP or less, gain 1 additional [EgoErodeReplica]
cn:
自身登场后每经过1回合，回合结束时使自身获得1层[EgoErodeReplica]
- 回合结束时，若现存体力低于体力上限的50%，或自身的理智值不高于-20点，则额外获得1层[EgoErodeReplica]

en: If there are 4+ Sinners with 4+ [GazeReplica] Stacks, use the Skill 'Awe[TabExplain], Contempt[TabExplain] 【Unleashed】' Skill
cn: 若带有不低于4层[GazeReplica]的罪人不低于4名，则使用“敬畏[TabExplain]，轻蔑[TabExplain]【潜能解放】”技能

en: Where there are other surviving allies, if this unit becomes the main target from 5+ enemies, those enemies lose 10 HP and SP
cn: 其他友方单位存活时，若自身成为不低于5名敌方单位的主要目标，则使该敌方单位失去10点体力与理智值

en: On Hit, heal 5 SP; on Clash Lose, lose 5 SP
cn:
攻击命中时，使自身恢复5点理智值
拼点失败时，使自身失去5点理智值

en: On enemy Kill, gain +3 [Breath] Count
cn: 击杀敌方单位时，使自身获得3层[Breath]

en: At less than -20 SP, use a special pattern
cn: 若自身的理智值低于-20点，则使用特殊模式

cn: 若有除贾环以外的N公司员工体力低于50%，则使用特殊模式

en: Lose Encounter when Hong Lu dies. All Skills prioritize Hong Lu
cn: 鸿璐阵亡时战斗失败。所有技能优先指定鸿璐

en: On Hit after Clash Win against Hong Lu: inflict 1 [PileObedient] (once per Skill)
cn: 与鸿璐拼点胜利后命中时，对其施加1层[PileObedient](每个技能最多1次)

en: Encounter Start: gain [GoldenBoughSync]
cn: 战斗开始时，使自身获得[GoldenBoughSync]

en: Gain 1 [AttackUp] and 1 [DefenseDown] every time this unit uses a different type of Skill (3 times per turn)
cn: 自身使用不同种类的技能时，使自身获得1层[AttackUp]并对自身施加1层[DefenseDown](每回合最多3次)

en:
Turn End: if Panicked, recover from Panic at the next Turn Start and reset SP to 0

When recovering from Panic, gain 2 [Enhancement] and 2 [Endurance] next turn; if Hong Lu has [Obedient], heal 15 SP
cn:
回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则下回合解除自身的恐慌并使自身的理智值恢复为0点

解除恐慌时，下回合使自身获得2层[Enhancement]与2层[Endurance]，若鸿璐带有[Obedient]，则使自身恢复15点理智值

en: Lose Encounter when Hong Lu dies. If there are this unit's summoned units at Turn Start, heal 10 SP
cn: 鸿璐阵亡时战斗失败。回合开始时，若有自身召唤的单位在场，则使自身恢复10点理智值

cn: 第2阶段开始时，使自身获得[GoldenBoughSyncDistorted]

en:
Turn End: if Panicked, recover from Panic at the next Turn Start and reset SP to 0

When recovering from Panic,
- gain 2 [Enhancement], 2 [Endurance], and 1 [Agility] next turn
- If there are units summoned by this unit, heal 15 SP
- If Hong Lu has [Obedient], heal 15 SP
cn:
回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则下回合解除自身的恐慌并使自身的理智值恢复为0点

解除恐慌时

- 若有自身召唤的单位在场，则使自身恢复15点理智值

若自身的[Burst]强度不低于10级，则使自身受到的伤害+10%
若自身带有的负面状态不少于5种，则使自身受到的伤害+10%

en:
At 0 HP, the Body Part becomes Staggered next turn
Then, this Part becomes Severed, and the Body Part gains 2 [Vulnerable]
cn:
体力为0点时，下回合使躯干部位陷入混乱
之后本部位进入已截除状态，并对躯干部位施加2层[Vulnerable]

en: When this unit is present, Jia Mu gains 200 Shield for her Core and every Part
cn: 自身在场时，回合开始时使贾母的本体与所有部位获得200点护盾

en:
As long as this unit is present, apply the following effects to the caged unit:
- Become 'immobilized'
- This unit's buffs, HP, and SP cannot be changed
cn:
自身在场时，被关住的单位获得以下效果
- 处于无法行动状态
- 自身的状态效果、体力与理智值不会改变

en: When this unit is defeated, return the caged character to the battle next turn
cn: 自身阵亡后，下回合使被关住的单位重返战斗

en:
If this unit is defeated by the Sinners, activate the following effects:
- All allies heal 10 SP; all allies gain 2 [AttackDmgUp] next turn
- Inflict 5 [Binding], 3 [AttackDown], and 5 [Vulnerable] against Jia Mu for the next 2 turns
- The unit that was caged in this unit heals up to 45 SP. Gain 2 [Enhancement] upon its return
- Gain 3 E.G.O Resources to all Affinities
cn:
若自身被罪人击杀，则触发以下效果
- 使全体友方单位恢复10点理智值，下回合使全体友方单位获得2层[AttackDmgUp]
- 下2回合对贾母施加5层[Binding]，3层[AttackDown]与5层[Vulnerable]
- 使本单位关住的单位的理智值恢复至45点。重返战斗时使其获得2层[Enhancement]
- 获得所有属性的E.G.O资源各3个

en: Has the [SupremeEternalLife] effect
cn: 带有[SupremeEternalLife]状态

en:
HP does not drop below 1

At 1 HP, replace [SupremeEternalLife] with [ImperfectEternalLife]
cn:
体力不会降至1点以下
体力为1点时，使[SupremeEternalLife]转化为[ImperfectEternalLife]

en: If this unit's HP drops to 1 upon getting hit, heal 10 SP to the Sinner who attacked this unit; then, gain 3 random E.G.O Resources for the least-owned Sin Affinities (activates once for this unit)
cn: 受到攻击时，若自身体力降至1点，则使攻击自身的罪人恢复10点理智值，随机获得3个持有量最少的E.G.O资源(自身存活时可触发1次)

en:
Turn End: if this unit is Panicked, reset SP to 0

When recovering from Panic: at the next Turn Start, heal SP by this unit's missing HP (max 30)
cn:
回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则使自身的理智值恢复为0点

解除恐慌后，下回合开始时，根据自身已失去体力比例相应使自身恢复理智值(最多30点)

en: Encounter Start: gain [WeighedMurderousIntend]
cn: 关卡开始时，对自身施加[WeighedMurderousIntend]

en: When attacking targets with slower Speed than this unit's, inflict +1 more [Burst] or [Burst] Count and deal +10% damage
cn: 攻击速度值低于自身的目标时，使其增加的[Burst]强度或对其施加的[Burst]层数额外+2并使自身造成的伤害+10%

en: On Hit against enemy with [BurstAgility]: inflict +2 [Burst] Count on the target (6 times per turn)
cn: 命中带有[BurstAgility]的敌方单位时，对目标施加2层[Burst](每回合最多6次)

en: On Skill Use, if this unit's Speed is faster than the target's by 2 or more, Coin Power +1
cn: 使用技能时，若自身的速度值高于目标至少2点，则使自身的硬币威力+1

en:
Turn Start: all allies, including this unit, heal 10 SP
Take -20% damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], [Sinking]
cn:
回合开始时，使包括自身在内的全体友方单位恢复10点理智值
自身受到的[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]伤害-20%

en: Every time a Middle ally is killed in this encounter, gain 1 [AttackUp] (max 5)
cn: 本场战斗中每有1名属于中指的友方单位阵亡，使自身获得1层[AttackUp](最多5层)

en: If this unit loses 2 Clashes, gain 6 [DefenseDown] next turn
cn: 拼点失败2次后，下回合对自身施加6层[DefenseDown]

en:
When this unit or its ally is hit, inflict 1 [MiddleFingerBook] against the attacker, then gain 1 [AttackUp] next turn (max 5 per turn)
- When an allied unit from The Middle is killed by a Skill, inflict 2 additional [MiddleFingerBook] against the attacker
cn:
自身或属于中指的友方单位受到攻击时，对攻击者施加1层[MiddleFingerBook]，并在下回合使自身获得1层[AttackUp](每回合最多5次)
- 属于中指的友方单位被技能击杀后，额外对攻击者施加2层[MiddleFingerBook]

en: Begins Encounter with 40% less HP (including Parts)
cn: 关卡开始时，失去体力上限40%的体力(包括部位)

en: When in panic, recover from panic at the start of the next turn and reset SP to 0.
cn: 陷入恐慌时，下回合开始时解除恐慌，理智值恢复为0点

en:
At 10+ [Charge] Count, gain [AaCeSeBa] next turn.
At 30%- Core HP, gain [AaCeSeBa] every turn.
cn:
若自身的[Charge]层数不低于10层，则下回合使自身获得[AaCeSeBa]。
若本体体力不高于30%，则每回合获得[AaCeSeBa]。

en: Lose all [Charge] Count when this unit is Staggered.
cn: 自身陷入混乱时，失去所有[Charge]层数。

en: Lose 1 [Breath] when hit by an Attack Skill
cn: 被攻击技能命中时，使自身失去1层[Breath]

en: Base Power -2 to 'Let's Get Packing' if the Gift Sack Part is broken.
cn: 若礼物袋部位被破坏，则使技能“来包装吧”的基础威力-2

en:
After Clashing, inflict 1 [DuelEdge] against the target this unit Clashed against
In a Clash against targets with [DuelEdge], heal 3 SP for every [DuelEdge] Stack on target (max 15)
cn:
拼点结束后，对与自身进行拼点的目标施加1层[DuelEdge]
与带有[DuelEdge]的目标进行拼点时，其每带有1层[DuelEdge]，使自身恢复3点理智值(最多15点)

en:
Gain the following effects based on the target's [DuelEdge] Stack
- For every Stack, deal +5% damage against and take -5% damage from the target with [DuelEdge]
- At 1+ Stack, in a Clash against targets with [DuelEdge], gain Clash Power +1
- At 2+ Stack, in a Clash against targets with [DuelEdge], gain Base Power +1
- At 3+ Stack, in a Clash against targets with [DuelEdge], gain Coin Power +1 and inflict 3 [SeveredTendon] On Hit
- At 4+ Stack, in a Clash against targets with [DuelEdge], gain Final Power +1
cn:
根据目标的[DuelEdge]层数触发以下效果(可叠加)
- 每带有1层[DuelEdge]，对其造成的伤害+5%，受到其伤害-5%
- 若[DuelEdge]层数不低于1层，则与其拼点时使自身的拼点威力+1
- 若[DuelEdge]层数不低于2层，则与其拼点时使自身的基础威力+1
- 若[DuelEdge]层数不低于3层，则与其拼点时使自身的硬币威力+1，命中目标时，对其施加3层[SeveredTendon]
- 若[DuelEdge]层数不低于4层，则与其拼点时使自身的最终威力+1

en: If this unit's Skill effects triggered [VibrationExplosion], gain 2 [AttackUp] next turn (3 times per turn)
cn: 若自身的技能效果触发了[VibrationExplosion]，则下回合使自身获得2层[AttackUp](每回合最多3次)

en:
Every 3 turns, select a random enemy (except Ryōshū), reduce their Speed to 1, and target it with all of this unit's Skills
(If this effect could not be activated due to Stagger, activate it next turn)
cn:
每3回合，随机指定除良秀以外的1名敌方单位，使其速度值变为1点，自身所有技能指定其为目标
(若该效果因陷入混乱而无法触发，则改为下回合触发)

en:
Encounter Start: gain [TeachersCommand]
In a Clash against Ryōshū, Clash Power -3 and convert the Coins on this unit's Base Attack Skills into [SuperCoin]s.
Also, on Clash Lose, deal -80% damage and any "On Hit" effects do not activate
cn:
关卡开始时，对自身施加[TeachersCommand]
与良秀进行拼点时，使自身的拼点威力-3，基础攻击技能的所有硬币转化为[SuperCoin]，
拼点失败时使该技能造成的伤害-80%，且该技能的命中时效果不会生效

en:
If an Arm is Part Broken, convert the Coins on the remaining Arm's Skills to [SuperCoin]s, and they gain +1 Atk Weight
- When using a Skill affected by this effect, gain 1 [RapidGrowthApple]
cn:
其他手臂部位被破坏时，使剩余的手臂部位的所有技能转化为[SuperCoin]，攻击容量+1
- 使用适用该效果的技能时，使自身获得1层[RapidGrowthApple]

If this unit has Roots, gain 1 [HowDareYouApple] after its Fruit Part is hit

At 4 [HowDareYouApple], use a powerful Skill that inflicts powerful negative effects

If this unit does not have Roots, neither gain nor lose [HowDareYouApple]
When the Fruit Part gets broken, lose [HowDareYouApple]
cn:
若自身拥有根部，则果实部位受到攻击后，使自身获得1层[HowDareYouApple]

若自身的[HowDareYouApple]层数为4层，则使用施加负面状态的强力技能

若自身未拥有根部，则不会获得或消耗[HowDareYouApple]
此后，果实部位被破坏时，解除自身的[HowDareYouApple]

en:
Turn Start: inflict 2 [Binding] on all enemies
This lasts until the Roots are broken
cn: 若根部未被破坏，则回合开始时对全体敌方单位施加2层[Binding]

en:
The Roots Part gains 3 [Enhancement] for every unbroken Arm Part
Does not gain this effect if the Roots are broken
cn:
每有1个手臂部位未被破坏，使根部获得3层[Enhancement]
若根部被破坏，则不会获得

en:
Turn Start: if this unit isn't Staggered, gain 2 [Protection], 10 [DefenseUp], and Shield HP equal to 10% of this unit's current HP

Every time this unit uses "Repressed Flesh" Skill in this Encounter, gain 1 fewer [Protection], 5 fewer [DefenseUp], and reduce the percentage mentioned above by 5%
cn:
回合开始时，若自身未陷入混乱，则使自身获得2层[Protection]，10层[DefenseUp]与现存体力10%的护盾

本场战斗中自身每使用过1次“受压肉体”，以上效果的获得量减少1层[Protection]，5层[DefenseUp]与5%护盾

en:
If this unit isn't Staggered, when hit by the last Coin of an attacker, activate the following:
- Deal Pierce damage by 20% of the said Coin's damage and inflict 2 [Laceration] (max damage per Skill: 100)
- Damage from this effect cannot Stagger the target
cn:
若自身未陷入混乱，则自身受到攻击者最后一枚硬币攻击时，触发以下效果
- 对攻击者造成相当于该硬币伤害量20%的突刺伤害并使其增加2级流血 强度(每个技能最多100点)
- 该效果造成的伤害不会使目标陷入混乱

en:
Upon entry, heal 30 SP

At 60% HP, recover from Stagger and end the turn (once per Encounter)
cn:
登场时，使自身恢复30点理智值

自身体力降至60%时，解除自身的混乱并结束本回合(每场战斗最多1次)

en:
Take -30% HP, SP damage from [Combustion], [Burst], [Sinking]; -30% to Stagger Threshold raised by [Vibration]
Take -50% damage from [Laceration]
cn:
受到[Combustion]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]的体力伤害、理智伤害与混乱阈值前移量-30%
受到[Laceration]的伤害-50%

Turn End: at 2 [HumanFleshTheRings], [HumanFleshTheRings] expires next turn; then, gain [BoneBladeTheRings]

Turn Start: if this unit has [BoneBladeTheRings], use a powerful attack this turn

If this unit is hit by an Attack Skill before using the powerful attack, gain 1 [UnsteadyTheRings]
cn:
回合结束时，若自身的[HumanFleshTheRings]层数为2层，则下回合解除自身的[HumanFleshTheRings]并使自身获得[BoneBladeTheRings]

回合开始时，若自身带有[BoneBladeTheRings]，则本回合使用强力攻击

使用强力攻击前受到攻击技能攻击时，对自身施加1层[UnsteadyTheRings]

en: Attack Skill End: Deal (# of Slash Coins that hit Critically x 10) Slash damage against each target (cannot be Staggered due to this damage)
cn: 攻击技能结束时，对全体目标造成(暴击命中的斩击硬币数×10)点斩击伤害(不会因该伤害而陷入混乱)

en:
This unit's [Breath] Potency is capped at 25
Any excess [Breath] Potency gained past 25 will be converted to [DicipleLittleFinger]
cn:
自身的[Breath]强度无法超过25级
增加的超过25级的[Breath]强度将转化为[DicipleLittleFinger]

en: Encounter Start: gain 50 [DicipleLittleFinger]
cn: 关卡开始时，使自身获得50层[DicipleLittleFinger]

en:
If this unit has [DicipleLittleFinger], gain the following effects:
- SP does not drop below 0; if it was below 0, recover to 0
- Convert any SP damage taken into Gloom damage (save for SP changes due to "Base factors increasing/decreasing Sanity")
cn:
若自身带有[DicipleLittleFinger]，则触发以下效果
- 自身的理智值不会降至0点以下，低于0点时，使自身理智值恢复为0点
- 受到的理智伤害转化为忧郁伤害(不包括基础理智值增减条件)

In a Clash against targets that aren't Ryōshū, Clash Power -2
Take -20% damage from targets other than Ryōshū
cn:
与除良秀以外的目标进行拼点时，使自身的拼点威力-2
受到除良秀以外的目标的伤害-20%

en:
Turn Start: based on the number of units in the Encounter, inflict [FairyCharm] on Sinners with the slowest Speed
Number of [FairyCharm] units increases every time the Fairy Part is restored
cn:
回合开始时，根据参战人员数，按比例对速度值最低的罪人施加[FairyCharm]
精灵部位再生时，使施加[FairyCharm]的单位数增加

en:
Reveal body when the Fairy Part is broken
All Buffs and Debuffs expire when the Body hides again
cn:
精灵部位被破坏后，露出躯干
躯干再次隐藏时，解除自身的所有增益与减益效果

en:
Cannot damage Core HP by damaging the Fairy
A certain Skill gains Atk Weight based on the number of [FairyCharm] units
cn:
精灵部位受到攻击也不会消耗本体的体力。
根据已[FairyCharm]人数相应增加特定技能的攻击容量。

en:
When the Body is broken:
- Fairy will have 60% of its max HP upon restoration
- Core heals +20 more HP with Skill effects
cn:
躯干部位被破坏时
- 精灵部位再生时，以60%的体力再生
- 技能使本体恢复的体力+20点

en: Fairy gains 30% increased max HP with each restoration
cn: 精灵部位每次再生时，其体力上限增加30%

cn: 精灵阵亡时，下回合使所有人格增加5级[Breath]强度并获得2层[Breath]

en: Use more powerful Skills after the Fairy is restored for the second time
cn: 精灵第2次再生后，使用更强力的技能

en:
Starting from turn 2, this unit summons 4 random Dimensions and hides
- When all Parts are Staggered, this effect activates next turn
- Cannot be Staggered while hidden inside a 'Dimensional Rift'.
cn:
从第2回合起，每一定回合，随机召唤4个次元并躲进次元
- 自身所有部位陷入混乱时，下回合触发该效果
- 躲进次元时，自身不会陷入混乱

en:
When all 'Dimensional Rifts' are broken, this unit voluntarily emerges from a 'Dimensional Rift' next turn
Afterward, this unit loses 5 [Charge] Count and all of its Parts' Stagger Thresholds are raised by 30
cn:
所有次元被破坏时，下回合会主动撕开次元并出场。
随后失去5层[Charge]并使所有部位的混乱阈值前移30。

en:
When the Blade Part is broken, lose 5 [Charge] Count
At the next Turn End, consume 2 [Charge] Count to restore the broken Blade.

While the Blade Part is broken, gain 2 [AttackDown] at every Turn Start.
cn:
刀刃部位被破坏时，使自身失去5层[Charge]
下回合结束时消耗2层[Charge]并使被破坏的刀刃部位恢复

若刀刃部位被破坏，则每回合开始对自身施加2层[AttackDown]

en:
At 60% or less Core HP, end turn and gain a new pattern
- Deactivate "Dimensional Escape" Passive
- Deactivate "Trapped Dimensional Escape" Passive
- If neither of its Arms are broken, use a powerful Skill every few turns
cn:
本体体力不高于60%时，结束本回合并改变自身模式
- 禁用被动“次元逃逸”
- 禁用被动“脱离受困次元”
- 若双臂未被破坏，则每一定回合使用强力技能

en: Deal +10% damage after passing through the Hemorrhaging Dimension[TabExplain]
cn: 若穿过血流成河的次元，造成的伤害+10%

en: Core gains +20% max HP after passing through the Poisonous Dimension[TabExplain]
cn: 若穿过剧毒沸腾的次元，则使本体体力上限+20%

en: Gain 1 Speed after passing through the Tremoring Dimension[TabExplain]
cn: 若穿过震颤不止的次元，速度值+1

en: Gain +1 Coin Power after passing through the Electrifying Dimension[TabExplain]
cn: 若穿过电流涌动的次元，硬币威力+1

cn: 关卡开始时，使自身获得[TimeEntangleFour] 每个阶段的首个回合开始时，使自身获得(自身的[TimeEntangleDesc]阶段×400)层[TimeGapAb] (每个[TimeEntangleDesc]阶段最多1次) 在第3与第4阶段[TimeEntangleDesc]，若自身失去所有[TimeGapAb]，则改变自身模式并在下回合使自身陷入混乱 受到来自[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]的体力伤害、理智伤害与混乱阈值前移量-30%

en:
On hit with this unit's Coin, deal Slash damage equal to (the Coin's final damage / 10)
- This effect activates ([TimeEntangleDesc] stage) times; damage from this effect cannot Stagger target
cn: 自身的硬币命中时，对目标造成(该硬币最终伤害量/10)点斩击伤害(该效果最多触发(自身的[TimeEntangleDesc]阶段)次。该效果造成的伤害不会使目标陷入混乱)

en:
Attack Skill End: Deal (# of Slash Coins that hit Critically x 10) Slash damage against each target) (damage from this effect cannot Stagger target)

Attack Skill End: Consume every surplus [Breath] Potency past 20 on self and inflict [PhantomIncision] to target by [Breath] Potency consumed
cn:
攻击技能结束时，对全体目标造成(暴击命中的斩击硬币数×10)点斩击伤害(不会因该伤害而陷入混乱)

攻击技能结束时，消耗自身超过20级的所有[Breath]强度并对目标施加层数相当于消耗量的[PhantomIncision]

en:
Use a powerful attack pattern every 4 turns
- At 50+ [PhantomIncisionTotal], the pattern above becomes empowered
cn:
每4回合使用强力技能
- 若自身的[PhantomIncisionTotal]层数不低于50层，则强化使用的技能

en:
Deal -50% final damage with this unit's Skill against targets that used Defense Skill

Turn End: Gain 2 [Vulnerable] and 2 [AttackDmgUp] every 4 turn in this Encounter (applies cumulatively; max 2 times per Encounter)
cn:
自身技能对使用守备技能的目标造成的最终伤害-50%

每4回合的回合结束时，在本场战斗中对自身施加2层[Vulnerable]并使自身获得2层[AttackDmgUp](每场战斗最多2次)

en:
Upon death, all Skills are cancelled for the turn
Gain 10 [SelfCharge] when the effect above activates
cn:
本单位垂死时，取消本回合的所有技能。
触发以上效果时，使自身获得10层[SelfCharge]

en: Every 5 turns, gains a Shield equal to the head's HP
cn: 每5回合，获得相当于头部体力的护盾

en:
After using 'Coil Up', if the Shield is exhausted, spend all [SelfCharge]
All parts become Staggered next turn
cn:
使用“盘绕”后，若自身消耗了所有护盾，则消耗所有[SelfCharge]
下回合使所有部位陷入混乱

en: At 30%- HP, gain +1 more [MRcAiBa]
cn: 若现存体力不高于30%，则令自身获得的[MRcAiBa]层数额外+1层

en:
When the Wings Part is broken, inflict [MRcAiBb] equal to [MRcAiBa] Stack to the last attacker; then, all [MRcAiBa] on self expires.

When using 'Ardor Blossom Star' at 0 [MRcAiBa], use 'Stoke the Flames' as well
cn:
翅膀部位被破坏时，对最后的攻击者施加层数相当于自身[MRcAiBa]层数的[MRcAiBb]，解除自身的[MRcAiBa]

使用“红艳煞”时，若自身的[MRcAiBa]层数为0层，则额外使用“点燃火种”

en: Convert a number of non-Wrath Skills equal to [MRcAiBa] Stack into Wrath Skills
cn: 根据自身带有的[MRcAiBa]层数，将相应数量的非暴怒技能转化为暴怒技能

en:
If this unit has [MRcAiBa], convert a number of non-Wrath Skills equal to [MRcAiBa] Stack into Wrath Skills

On Hit, inflict [Combustion] equal to (# of Wrath Skills that the Ardor Blossom Moth will use this turn)

On Hit, heal HP equal to (# of Wrath Skills that the Ardor Blossom Moth will use this turn x 2)
cn:
根据自身带有的[MRcAiBa]层数，将相应数量的非暴怒技能转化为暴怒技能

技能命中时，使目标增加(红焰蛾本回合使用的暴怒技能数)级[Combustion]强度

技能命中时，使自身恢复(红焰蛾本回合使用的暴怒技能数×2)点体力

en: When the Wings Part is broken, gain 2 E.G.O Resource of all Affinity and heal all Sinners' SP by 15
cn: 翅膀部位被破坏时，获得所有属性的E.G.O资源各2个，使全体罪人恢复15点理智值

en:
Does not take [Combustion] damage

Turn End: Heal Core by ([Combustion] on self x 5)
cn:
不会受到[Combustion]伤害

回合结束时，使自身本体恢复(自身的[Combustion]强度×5)点体力

en: Encounter Start: Gain Shield equal to 20% of max HP (remains throughout this Encounter) Turn Start: - Gain [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] based on [UnlockBuff_Base] stage on self - Inflict [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] to a random enemy and prioritize attacking that enemy (excluding certain pattern) Deal +2.5% damage to [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 20%) - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], deal +30% damage to all targets instead
cn: 关卡开始时，使自身获得体力上限20%的护盾(该护盾在本场战斗期间维持) 回合开始时 - 根据自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段，使自身获得[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] - 随机对1名敌方单位施加[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]并优先攻击该单位(不包括特定阶段) 自身每带有1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]造成的伤害+2.5%(最多+20%) - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则改为对全体目标造成的伤害+30%

en: Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn, heal 15 SP and gain [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] by ([UnlockBuff_Base] stage + 1) (once per turn) Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed this turn, gain 1 [PressureOfPrescript] and 5 [KarmaOfIndexStudent] - If this unit does not have [UnlockBuff_Base], gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] at Turn End - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], does not gain [KarmaOfIndexStudent] - If this unit is under the effect of Effloresced[TabExplain] E.G.O::Procuration, double [KarmaOfIndexStudent] this unit will gain
cn: 若本回合自身执行了[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时使自身恢复15点理智值并获得(自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段+1)层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy](每回合最多1次) 若本回合自身未执行[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时使自身获得1层[PressureOfPrescript]并对自身施加5层[KarmaOfIndexStudent] - 若自身未带有[UnlockBuff_Base]，则回合结束时使自身获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则不会施加[KarmaOfIndexStudent] - 若自身处于绽放[TabExplain]E.G.O::代行状态，则令施加的[KarmaOfIndexStudent]变为2倍

en: Turn End: At 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] or at 90%-/75%-/60%- HP, - Gain [UnlockBuff_1]/[UnlockBuff_2]/[UnlockBuff_3] - Heal to 45 SP - Consume all [PressureOfPrescript] and recover from Stagger - Gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] in the turn after [UnlockBuff_Base] was gained for the first time If [UnlockBuff_Base] was gained based on HP conditional above, - Gain [KarmaOfIndexStudent] by (sum of healed SP / 15) - Increase [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] to 3/6/9 if this unit had less than 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]; gain 1 [DefenseDown] and 2 [KarmaOfIndexStudent] next turn for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] Stack gained Min & Max Speed +10 in the turn this unit uses its powerful attack
cn: 回合结束时，若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为3层/6层/9层或现存体力不高于90%/75%/60%， - 使自身获得[UnlockBuff_1]/[UnlockBuff_2]/[UnlockBuff_3] - 使自身理智值恢复为45点 - 消耗所有[PressureOfPrescript]并解除自身的混乱 - 首次获得[UnlockBuff_Base]的下回合，使自身获得[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] 通过体力条件获得[UnlockBuff_Base]时 - 对自身施加(恢复的理智值/15)层[KarmaOfIndexStudent] - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数低于3层/6层/9层，则使其层数变为3层/6层/9层， 每获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，下回合开始时对自身施加1层[DefenseDown]与2层[KarmaOfIndexStudent] 自身使用强力攻击的回合，使自身的最小与最大速度值+10

en:
Turn Start: if this unit has [UnlockBuff_Base] and is at 25+ SP, consume 15 SP to enter Effloresced[TabExplain] E.G.O::Procuration state and recover from Stagger
- Gain [Blandishment_Enemy] and a different set of Resistance values while in this state
- Turn Start: at 0 or less SP, exit Effloresced[TabExplain] E.G.O::Procuration state
cn:
回合开始时，若自身带有[UnlockBuff_Base]且理智值不低于25点，
则消耗15点理智值并进入绽放[TabExplain]E.G.O::代行状态，解除自身的混乱
- 处于该状态时，改变自身的抗性，使自身获得[Blandishment_Enemy]
- 回合开始时，若自身理智值不高于0点，则解除绽放[TabExplain]E.G.O::代行状态

en:
When Vespa enters the battlefield:
- If [UnlockBuff_Base] is below stage II, gain [UnlockBuff_3], heal SP to 45, and recover from Stagger
- Gain 1 [Blandishment_Shin_Enemy] and gain Shield equal to 50% of max HP (lasts for the rest of this Encounter)
- Disable the [PressureOfPrescript] cost of activating the 'Unlock[TabExplain]' Passive
- Intensify [PressureOfPrescript] to [PressureOfPrescript_2nd] and max out its Stack
- Turn Start: Gain 1 [PressureOfPrescript_2nd]
- Then, this unit's SP does not drop below 0

At 20% or less HP, max out [PressureOfPrescript_2nd] Stack
cn:
韦斯帕登场时，

回合开始时，若自身理智值不低于0点，则使自身获得1层[SojiAbiAgeFuture]

en:
Encounter Start: Gain Shield equal to 20% of max HP (remains throughout this Encounter)

Turn Start:
- Gain [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] based on [UnlockBuff_Base] stage on self
- Inflict [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] to a random enemy and prioritize attacking that enemy (excluding certain pattern)

Deal +2.5% damage to [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 20%)
- At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], deal +30% damage to all targets instead
cn:
关卡开始时，使自身获得体力上限20%的护盾(在本场战斗期间维持)

回合开始时
- 根据自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段，相应使自身获得[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]
- 随机对1名敌方单位施加[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]并优先攻击该敌方单位(不包括特定阶段)

自身每带有1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]造成的伤害+2.5%(最多+20%)
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则改为对全体目标造成的伤害+30%

en:
Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn, heal 15 SP and gain [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] by ([UnlockBuff_Base] stage + 1) (once per turn)

Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed this turn, gain 1 [PressureOfPrescript] and 10 [KarmaOfIndexStudent]
- If this unit's [UnlockBuff_Base] stage is below 2, gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]
- At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], does not gain [KarmaOfIndexStudent]

- Gain [EsteemNeeds] equal to [PressureOfPrescript] gained every time this unit gains [PressureOfPrescript]
cn:
若本回合自身执行了[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]，
则回合结束时使自身恢复15点理智值并获得(自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段+1)层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy](每回合最多1次)

若本回合自身未执行[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]，
则回合结束时使自身获得1层[PressureOfPrescript]并对自身施加10层[KarmaOfIndexStudent]
- 若自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段低于2，则回合结束时使自身获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则不会施加[KarmaOfIndexStudent]

- 每当自身获得[PressureOfPrescript]时，使自身获得相应层数的[EsteemNeeds]

en:
Turn End: At 6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] or at 80%-/60%- HP,
- Gain [UnlockBuff_2]/[UnlockBuff_3]
- Heal to 45 SP
- Consume all [PressureOfPrescript] and recover from Stagger

If [UnlockBuff_Base] was gained based on HP conditional above,
- Gain [KarmaOfIndexStudent] by (sum of healed SP / 15)
- Increase [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] to 6/9 if this unit had less than 6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]; gain 1 [DefenseDown] and 2 [KarmaOfIndexStudent] next turn for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] gained

Min & Max Speed +10 in the turn this unit uses its powerful attack
cn:
回合结束时，若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为6层/9层或现存体力不高于80%/60%，
- 使自身获得[UnlockBuff_2]/[UnlockBuff_3]
- 使自身理智值恢复为45点
- 消耗所有[PressureOfPrescript]并解除自身的混乱

通过体力条件获得[UnlockBuff_Base]时
- 对自身施加(恢复的理智值/15)层[KarmaOfIndexStudent]
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数低于6层/9层，则使其层数变为6层/9层，
每获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，下回合开始时对自身施加1层[DefenseDown]与2层[KarmaOfIndexStudent]

自身使用强力攻击的回合，使自身的最小与最大速度值+10

At [UnlockBuff_3], apply the following effects:
- [Blandishment_Shin_Enemy], gain Shield equal to 50% of max HP (lasts for the rest of this Encounter)
- Intensify [PressureOfPrescript] to [PressureOfPrescript_2nd] and max out its Stack
- Turn Start: Gain 1 [PressureOfPrescript_2nd]

获得[UnlockBuff_3]后，触发以下效果

This unit's [Breath] Potency is capped at 25
Any excess [Breath] Potency gained past 25 will be converted to [DicipleLittleFinger]

Gain [Fugacious] equal to [DicipleLittleFinger] lost every time this unit loses [DicipleLittleFinger] Stack

自身的[Breath]强度无法超过25级
增加的超过25级的[Breath]强度将转化为[DicipleLittleFinger]

If this unit has [DicipleLittleFinger], gain the following effects:
- SP does not drop below 0; if it was below 0, recover to 0
- Convert any SP damage taken into Gloom damage (save for SP changes due to "Base factors increasing/decreasing Sanity")

若自身带有[DicipleLittleFinger]，则触发以下效果

与除良秀以外的目标进行拼点时，使自身的拼点威力-2

- On Clash Win, inflict 3 [OffenseBug] on target

Take -50% HP, SP damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Burst], and [Sinking]; -50% to Stagger Threshold raised by [Vibration]
Cannot be Staggered due to this damage

en:
At 50% HP, or when Staggered, recover from Stagger and remove all negative effects on this unit and gain a new pattern
Then, gain the following effects:
- Reset SP to 0
- Gain 50 [DefenseBug]
- Double the amount of [OffenseBug] inflicted by the Passive "The Emperor's Legion"

体力降至50%或陷入混乱时，解除自身的混乱与所有负面状态并改变自身模式

en: A random weapon is assigned to every Coin. Each weapon has a unique effect. - [RienWeapon01Hatchet] - [RienWeapon02Stiletto] - [RienWeapon03Greatsword] - [RienWeapon04Rapier] - [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer] - [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword] - [RienWeapon07Lance] - [RienWeapon08Chain] - [RienWeapon09Scythe] When using an Attack Skill, gain 1 [StackRienSpecialSkill] (max 9) - Can be gained once per Skill; does not gain Stack from the same Skill twice Turn Start: At 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stacks, use a powerful Skill - Attack End: After using the powerful Skill for the first time, gain [Shin_Rien] - Reset the per-Skill [StackRienSpecialSkill] cap - Min & Max Speed +25 - Turn End: Gain 1 [Vulnerable] and 2 [ResultReduction] next turn Turn 5 Start: At less than 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill], bring its Stack to 9; then, gain (Stack gained x 5) [KarmaOfIndexRien] - Then, activate this effect every 4 turns

en: Turn Start: - Gain [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] based on [UnlockBuff_Base] stage on self - Apply [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] against a random non-Ryōshū Sinner, and prioritize attacking them - When using a Skill against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality], convert all Coins on that Skill to [SuperCoin]s · If [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] is killed, or if this unit can no longer attack that target, use the remaining Skills against a random non-Ryōshū Sinner (prioritizes targets with the least current HP) · When all other Sinners are killed, apply it to Ryōshū Deal +2.5% damage against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 20%) - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], deal +30% damage against all targets
cn: 回合开始时 - 根据自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段，相应使自身获得[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] - 随机对除良秀以外的1名罪人施加[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]并优先攻击该罪人 - 使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]使用的技能的所有硬币转化为[SuperCoin] · [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]阵亡或自身无法攻击目标时， 随机对除良秀以外的1名罪人使用剩余的技能 (优先指定现存体力最低的目标) · 其他罪人全部阵亡时，对良秀触发该效果 自身每带有1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]造成的伤害+2.5%(最多+20%) - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则改为对全体目标造成的伤害+30%

en: Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn, heal 10 SP and gain 3 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (once per turn) Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed this turn, gain 8 [KarmaOfIndexRien], and the Sinner who had [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] gains 1 [ParryingResultUp] next turn - If this unit does not have [UnlockBuff_Base], gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] at Turn End - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], does not gain [KarmaOfIndexRien]
cn: 若本回合自身执行了[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时使自身恢复10点理智值并获得3层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy](每回合最多1次) 若本回合自身未执行[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时对自身施加8层[KarmaOfIndexRien]， 使带有[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]的罪人在下回合获得1层[ParryingResultUp] - 若自身未带有[UnlockBuff_Base]，则回合结束时使自身获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则不会施加[KarmaOfIndexRien]

en:

Turn 4 End: At lower than [UnlockBuff_Base] stage 2, gain [UnlockBuff_Rien2]

第4回合结束时，若自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段低于2，则使自身获得[UnlockBuff_Rien2]

通过体力或回合条件获得[UnlockBuff_Base]时
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数低于3层/6层/9层，则使其层数变为3层/6层/9层，

en: Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn, heal 15 SP and gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (once per turn) Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed this turn, gain 10 [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase], lose 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], and the Sinner who had [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] gains 2 [ParryingResultUp] next turn - If this unit used a powerful Skill this turn, gain 15 [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase] and lose 3 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] instead

en:
In this Encounter, when this unit takes damage that brings their HP down to 0, nullify that damage and apply the following effects (once per Encounter):
- Heal max HP and remove all removable negative effects from this unit
- For this Encounter, gain 1 [Vulnerable] and fix [TimeEntangleUnstable] to 1. Take (# of current turn x 10) fixed damage at the end of every turn
- Afterward, end turn and the attack pattern becomes empowered
cn:
本场战斗中，受到使自身体力降至0点的伤害时，无视该伤害并触发以下效果(每场战斗最多1次)

- 本场战斗期间对自身施加1层[Vulnerable]，自身的[TimeEntangleUnstable]层数固定为1层
- 每回合结束时，使自身受到(当前回合数×10)点固定伤害
- 结束本回合，并强化自身模式

- 若最先编入的目标的[Teaching]层数不低于3层，则本场战斗期间自身不再获得护盾

en: If there are this unit's summoned units at Turn Start, heal 10 SP
cn: 回合开始时，若有自身召唤的单位在场，则使自身恢复10点理智值

en:
Turn End: at 90% or less HP, or at the end of the 2nd turn, reload [BulletPropellant] and gain a new pattern next turn
- If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger
cn:
回合结束时现存体力不高于90%或第2回合结束时，使自身装填[BulletPropellant]并在下回合改变自身模式
- 若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

en:
Turn End: at 80% or less HP, or at the end of the 4th turn, gain a new pattern next turn
- Use a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver'), repeat every 3rd turn. +10 to Min & Max Speed for turns in which this unit uses this Skill
- At the start of that turn, gain 25 [BattleSense]
- If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger
cn:
回合结束时现存体力不高于80%或第4回合结束时，下回合改变自身模式
- 使用强力攻击(“快刀乱麻”)，每3回合重复该效果。使用该技能的回合使自身的最小与最大速度值+10
- 该回合开始时，使自身获得25层[BattleSense]
- 若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

en:
If this unit's HP dropped to 60% or below at Turn End, or if this unit is set to use a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver') next turn for the second time this Encounter, gain a new pattern next turn
- When that turn starts, gain 1 [Irritation]
- When that turn starts, gain 18 [BulletPropellantSpecial] and reload immediately
· If this unit spends all [BulletPropellantSpecial], convert the effect to [BulletPropellant] and summon 2 of "Stern Soldato of the Thumb" units next turn and have them supply this unit with [BulletPropellantSpecial]
- When Staggered, recover from Stagger
cn:
若回合结束时现存体力不高于60%或下回合将使用本场战斗的第2次强力攻击(“快刀乱麻”)，则下回合改变自身模式
- 该回合开始时，使自身获得1层[Irritation]
- 该回合开始时，使自身获得18发[BulletPropellantSpecial]并立刻装填
· 若自身消耗了所有[BulletPropellantSpecial]，则使其转化为[BulletPropellant]并在下回合召唤2名严格的拇指士兵为自身补给[BulletPropellantSpecial]
- 若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

en:
Turn End: at 40% or less HP, or if this unit is set to use a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver') next turn for the third time this Encounter, gain a new pattern next turn
- Replace the powerful attack 'Tanglecleaver' with 'Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades'. +15 to Min & Max Speed for turns in which this unit uses this Skill
- Convert [BattleSense] to [RestoredBattleSense]
- Convert [Irritation] to [DerivativeHugeIrritation]
- If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger
cn:
若回合结束时现存体力不高于40%或下回合将使用本场战斗的第3次强力攻击(“快刀乱麻”)，则下回合改变自身模式
- 强力攻击“快刀乱麻”改为“超绝猛虎杀击乱斩”。使用该技能的回合使自身的最小与最大速度值+15
- 使自身的[BattleSense]转化为[RestoredBattleSense]
- 使自身的[Irritation]转化为[DerivativeHugeIrritation]
- 若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

en: If this unit used a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver' or 'Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades'), gain [Complacency] next turn equal to the number of times those skills were used (max 5)
cn: 若使用了强力攻击(“快刀乱麻”，“超绝猛虎杀击乱斩”)，则下回合对自身施加层数相当于本场战斗期间自身使用该技能次数的[Complacency](最多5层)

en:
At 10+ [FullCharon]...
- Turn Start: enter a forced Stagger State (for a turn)
- Turn End: remove [HungryCharon] and [FullCharon] completely
cn:
自身的[FullCharon]层数不低于10层时
- 回合开始时使自身强制陷入混乱(1回合)
- 回合结束时解除自身的[HungryCharon]与[FullCharon]

en:
Combat Start: Vergilius gains 1 [HungryCharon]
At 3 [HungryCharon], uses a devastating attack ("Vroom-Vroom")
※ Does not activate at "Combat Start" if this unit is Staggered due to [FullCharon]
cn:
战斗开始时，使维吉里乌斯获得1层[HungryCharon]
若自身的[HungryCharon]层数不低于3层，则使用强力攻击(“布隆布隆”)
※因[FullCharon]而陷入混乱时，战斗开始时不会触发

en: Turn Start: in Deployment Order, inflict 1 [GiveMeCandy] against 1 enemy without [GiveMeCandy]
cn: 回合开始时，按编队顺序对未带有[GiveMeCandy]的1名敌方单位施加1层[GiveMeCandy]

en: Inflict 1 [GiveMeCandy] to the target who attacked Kkomi
cn: 对攻击可米的目标施加1层[GiveMeCandy]

en: When this unit is killed due to enemy attack or Status effect damage, increase [BloodDinner] by 30. Does not activate if this unit killed itself.
cn: 自身被敌方单位的攻击或状态效果造成的伤害击杀时，获得30层[BloodDinner]。被自身击杀时不生效。

en: Apply special effect to all allies
cn: 使全体友方单位获得特殊效果

en: Turn Start: Inflict 3 [Laceration] and +1 [Laceration] Count against all enemies
cn: 回合开始时，使全体敌方单位增加3级[Laceration]强度并对其施加1层[Laceration]

en: Turn End: Apply 1 [RegainedStrength] on Don Quixote
cn: 回合结束时，使堂吉诃德获得1层[RegainedStrength]

en: The battle proceeds to the next phase after all the Clay Dolls are defeated
cn: 终末土偶被全部击杀后，进入下一阶段

en: If both Arms are destroyed or the main body’s HP is brought to 70%, the battle proceeds to the next phase
cn: 手臂被全部破坏，或本体体力不高于70%时，进入下一阶段

en: During phase 3, inflict 7 [Combustion] on all enemies every turn
cn: 第3阶段期间，每回合使全体敌方单位增加7级[Combustion]强度

en: When the Core HP is brought to 25% or lower, the battle proceeds to the next phase
cn: 本体体力不高于25%时，进入下一阶段

en:
Does not die at 0 HP; instead, remains on the stage as an immobile and untargetable unit.
Suppressed when the Doomsday Calendar is suppressed
cn:
体力归零时不会阵亡，并成为无法行动且不可选取的状态
终末日历被镇压时将被一并镇压

en: At 50+ [AccumulatedPastMirror], and if Core HP is at 80%-, the Core heals 200 HP by consuming 50 [AccumulatedPastMirror] at Turn End
cn: 若自身的[AccumulatedPastMirror]层数不低于50层，且本体体力不高于80%，则在回合结束时消耗50层[AccumulatedPastMirror]，并使本体恢复200点体力

en:
When the Body is broken, consume all [AccumulatedPastMirror]
When the Body is broken, starting next turn, all Attack Types and Affinities become Ineffective(0.5) for the rest of the Encounter
cn:
躯干部位被破坏后，消耗所有[AccumulatedPastMirror]
躯干部位被破坏后，下回合起使躯干部位的所有罪孽抗性与物理抗性在本场战斗中全部变为“抵抗”(0.5)

en:
When Steam Blaster is broken, completely lose [Breath] on all parts
Once Steam Blaster is broken, every time this unit gains [Breath], gain [Vulnerable] for every [Breath] gained
Once Steam Blaster is broken, lose 1 [Breath] On Use of an Attack Skill
cn:
蒸汽枪部位被破坏时，消耗所有部位的[Breath]强度
蒸汽枪部位被破坏后，使自身增加[Breath]强度时，对自身施加层数相当于增加的[Breath]强度的[Vulnerable]
蒸汽枪部位被破坏后，自身使用攻击技能时，使自身失去1级[Breath]强度

en: When Steam Blaster is hit, lose 1 [Breath] and 1 [Breath] Count
cn: 蒸汽枪部位受到攻击时，使自身失去1级[Breath]强度与1层[Breath]

en:
If the [AccumulatedPastMirror] is an odd number, gain 3 [Vulnerable] and [AttackDmgUp]
If it is an even number, gain 3 [Protection] and [AttackDmgDown]
cn:
[AccumulatedPastMirror]层数为奇数时，对自身施加3层[Vulnerable]并使自身获得3层[AttackDmgUp]
层数为偶数时，使自身获得3层[Protection]并对自身施加3层[AttackDmgDown]

en: Turn End: Heal 5 HP for every Raw Chicken on the field
cn: 回合结束时，根据参战的生鸡数量，使自身恢复(生鸡数量×5)的体力

en: Turn End: Deal 5 SP damage to all enemies for every Raw Chicken on the field
cn: 回合结束时，根据参战的生鸡数量，使全体敌方单位失去(生鸡数量×5)点理智值

en: When a Part breaks, gain 1 [Vulnerable] every turn for every Raw Chicken that died before that Part was broken
cn: 部位被破坏时，根据直到部位被破坏为止阵亡的生鸡数量，每回合对自身施加相应层数的[Vulnerable]

en: If the Part isn’t broken, gain 1 [AttackDmgUp] every turn for every surviving Raw Chicken
cn: 未进入部位破坏状态时，每回合根据存活的生鸡数量获得相应层数的[AttackDmgUp]

en: Turn End: Deal 3 SP damage to a random enemy
cn: 回合结束时，随机使1名敌方单位失去3点理智值

en: Turn End: Apply 2 [AttackDmgUp] and 2 [Protection] to all allies next turn, including this unit
cn: 回合结束时，下回合使包括自身在内的全体友方单位获得2层[AttackDmgUp]与2层[Protection]

en:
If this unit has [BloodPocket]:
- The Body's Wrath Resist. -50%
- The Body's Gloom Resist. +50%
cn: 若自身带有[BloodPocket]，则使躯干的暴怒抗性-50%，忧郁抗性+50%

en: If this unit has [WaterPocket], heal its Core by (Stack x 20)
cn: 若自身带有[WaterPocket]，则使本体恢复(该效果层数×20)点体力

en: Once the Body is broken, on Clash Win, activate the enemy's [Laceration] once and reduce [Laceration] Count by 1
cn: 躯干部位被破坏后，拼点胜利时，触发敌方单位的[Laceration]1次，并使其[Laceration]层数减少1层

en:
Apply 1 [PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror] on the target that Clashed against this unit's Skill using a Skill that has the same Attack Type as this unit's (once per Skill, 3 times per turn)
- If it was a Blunt Skill, apply 2 [PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror] instead
cn:
若目标使用与自身相同物理属性的技能拼点，则使目标获得1层[PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror](每个技能最多1次，每回合最多3次)
- 若该技能为打击技能，则改为获得2层[PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror]

en: If this unit has [WaterPocket], heal its Core by (Stack x 30)
cn: 若自身带有[WaterPocket]，则使本体恢复(该效果层数×30)点体力

en: Once the Body is broken, on Clash Win, activate the enemy's [Laceration] twice and reduce [Laceration] Count by 2
cn: 躯干部位被破坏后，拼点胜利时，触发敌方单位的[Laceration]2次，并使其[Laceration]层数减少2层

en:
If this unit has [BloodPocket]:
- The Body's Wrath Resist. -35%
- The Body's Gloom Resist. +35%
cn: 若自身带有[BloodPocket]，则使躯干的暴怒抗性-35%，忧郁抗性+35%

en: If this unit has [WaterPocket], heal its Core by (Stack x 35)
cn: 若自身带有[WaterPocket]，则使本体恢复(该效果层数×35)点体力

en: Once the Body is broken, on Clash Win, activate the enemy's [Laceration] thrice and reduce [Laceration] Count by 3
cn: 躯干部位被破坏后，拼点胜利时，触发敌方单位的[Laceration]3次，并使其[Laceration]层数减少3层

en:
If target does not have [PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror], gain the following effects:
- Deal +80% damage
- On Hit using a Skill's final Coin, trigger [VibrationExplosion]; then, reduce target's [Vibration] Count by 1

If target has [PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror], gain the following effects:
- Deal -50% damage
- Take +10% damage for every [PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror] Stack on target (max 100%)

If no one has [PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror], gain the following effects:
- On Hit using a Skill, inflict 5 [Laceration]
- On Hit using a Skill's final Coin, activate [Laceration] once; then, reduce target's [Laceration] Count by 1
cn:
若目标未带有[PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror]，获得以下效果：
- 造成的伤害+80%
- 自身技能的最后一枚硬币命中时，使目标[VibrationExplosion]，并使目标的[Vibration]层数减少1层

若目标带有[PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror]，获得以下效果：
- 造成的伤害-50%
- 目标每带有1层[PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror]，使自身受到的伤害+10%(最多+100%)

若没有单位带有[PlayingWithWaterTogetherMirror]，获得以下效果：
- 自身的技能命中时，使目标增加5级[Laceration]强度
- 自身技能的最后一枚硬币命中时，触发目标的[Laceration]1次，并使目标的[Laceration]层数减少1层

en: Upon entry, heal 30 SP
cn: 登场时，使自身恢复30点理智值

en:
Every 3 turns, select a random enemy, reduce their Speed to 1, and target it with all of this unit's Skills
(If this effect could not be activated due to Stagger, activate it next turn)
cn:
每3回合，随机指定1名敌方单位，使其速度值变为1点，自身所有技能指定其为目标
(若该效果因陷入混乱而无法触发，则改为下回合触发)

en: Encounter Start: Gain Shield equal to 20% of max HP (remains throughout this Encounter) Turn Start: - Gain [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] based on [UnlockBuff_Base] stage on self - Inflict [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] to a random enemy and prioritize attacking that enemy Deal +2.5% damage to [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 20%) - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], deal +30% damage to all targets instead
cn: 关卡开始时，使自身获得体力上限20%的护盾(该护盾在本场战斗期间维持) 回合开始时 - 根据自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段，使自身获得[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] - 随机对1名敌方单位施加[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]并优先攻击该单位 自身每带有1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]造成的伤害+2.5%(最多+20%) - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则改为对全体目标造成的伤害+30%

en:
Turn End: At 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] or at 90%-/70%-/50%- HP,
- Gain [UnlockBuff_1]/[UnlockBuff_2]/[UnlockBuff_3]
- Heal to 45 SP
- Consume all [PressureOfPrescript] and recover from Stagger
- Gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] in the turn after [UnlockBuff_Base] was gained for the first time

If [UnlockBuff_Base] was gained based on HP conditional above,
- Gain [KarmaOfIndexStudent] by (sum of healed SP / 15)
- Increase [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] to 3/6/9 if this unit had less than 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]; gain 1 [DefenseDown] and 2 [KarmaOfIndexStudent] next turn for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] Stack gained
cn:
回合结束时，若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为3层/6层/9层或现存体力不高于90%/70%/50%，
- 使自身获得[UnlockBuff_1]/[UnlockBuff_2]/[UnlockBuff_3]
- 使自身理智值恢复为45点
- 消耗所有[PressureOfPrescript]并解除自身的混乱
- 首次获得[UnlockBuff_Base]的下回合，使自身获得[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]

通过体力条件获得[UnlockBuff_Base]时
- 对自身施加(恢复的理智值/15)层[KarmaOfIndexStudent]
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数低于3层/6层/9层，则使其层数变为3层/6层/9层，
每获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，下回合开始时对自身施加1层[DefenseDown]与2层[KarmaOfIndexStudent]

en:
At [UnlockBuff_3], apply the following effects:
- [BlandishmentShinEnemyDelete], gain Shield equal to 50% of max HP (lasts for the rest of this Encounter)
- Intensify [PressureOfPrescript] to [PressureOfPrescript_2nd] and max out its Stack
- Turn Start: Gain 1 [PressureOfPrescript_2nd]
cn:
获得[UnlockBuff_3]后，触发以下效果
- 使自身获得[BlandishmentShinEnemyDelete]与体力上限50%的护盾(在本场战斗期间维持)
- 使自身的[PressureOfPrescript]转化为[PressureOfPrescript_2nd]并获得至最大值
- 回合开始时，使自身获得1层[PressureOfPrescript_2nd]

en:
- Turn Start: Gain 3 [SupportProtect]
- When the Thumb Nursefather wins a Clash, and uses an Attack against the target, follow up with "Colpi Sottani" as an Unopposed Attack against the same target (2 times per turn)
cn:
- 回合开始时，使自身获得3层[SupportProtect]
- 拇指 父辈拼点胜利后，在其攻击后对相同目标使用“纵斩”进行单方面攻击(每回合最多2次)

en: Take -50% final damage if "The Thumb Apprentice - Lucio" is on the field
cn: 若“拇指 子辈 - 卢西奥”在场，则使自身受到的最终伤害-50%

en:
When this unit enters the Encounter, gain 30 [FutureEyeOnMirror]
At 0 [FutureEyeOnMirror] Stack, convert [FutureEyeOnMirror] to [FutureEyeOffMirror]
cn:
在战斗中登场时，使自身获得30层[FutureEyeOnMirror]
若自身的[FutureEyeOnMirror]层数为0层，则使自身的[FutureEyeOnMirror]转化为[FutureEyeOffMirror]

en: In a Clash, gain 1 [LookingFuture] with every Clash Can gain up to ([FutureEyeOnMirror] Stack at Turn Start / 3) [LookingFuture] per turn While this unit has [FutureEyeOnMirror], getting attacked by Unopposed Attacks or losing a Clash activates the "Precognition" Skill
cn: 进行拼点时，每次拼点使自身获得1层[LookingFuture] 每回合最多获得(回合开始时自身的[FutureEyeOnMirror]层数/3)层[LookingFuture] 自身带有[FutureEyeOnMirror]时，受到单方面攻击或拼点失败时，使用技能“预知”

en:
The following causes this unit to lose [FutureEyeOnMirror] Stack:
- If this unit fails to gain [LookingFuture], lose 1 [FutureEyeOnMirror] with every Clash
- When this unit is attacked by an Unopposed Attack, lose 1 [FutureEyeOnMirror]
- On Clash Lose, lose 3 [FutureEyeOnMirror]
cn:
满足以下条件时，使自身的[FutureEyeOnMirror]层数减少
- 若自身未获得[LookingFuture]，则每次拼点使自身的[FutureEyeOnMirror]层数减少1层
- 受到单方面攻击时，使自身的[FutureEyeOnMirror]层数减少1层
- 拼点失败时，使自身的[FutureEyeOnMirror]层数减少3层

en:
Deal +15% more damage against Shields for every Burn on the main target (max 300%)
On Skill Use, if target's Attack Skill is either a Slash or a Pierce Skill, Clash Power +1
If this unit's Skill effects triggered [VibrationExplosion], gain 2 [AttackDmgUp] next turn (3 times per turn)
If this unit hit Critically with its Skill effects, heal 5 SP
cn:
主要目标每带有1级烧伤 强度，使自身对护盾造成的伤害+15%(最多+300%)
使用技能时，若目标的攻击技能为斩击技能或突刺技能，则使自身的拼点威力+1
自身的技能效果触发[VibrationExplosion]时，下回合使自身获得2层[AttackDmgUp](每回合最多3次)
自身的技能效果触发暴击时，使自身恢复5点理智值

en:
Take -30% HP, SP damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Burst], [Sinking]; -30% to Stagger Threshold raised by [Vibration]
At 1+ [AccelBullet], Skills that spend [AccelBullet] deal +30% damage and deal +150% damage against Shields
Gain 4 [Breath] for every [AccelBullet] spent
When flipping a Coin that spends [AccelBullet], does not cancel the attack even if this unit does not have Acceleration Round
cn:
受到的[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]的体力伤害、理智伤害与混乱阈值前移量-30%
若自身的[AccelBullet]数不低于1发，则使自身消耗[AccelBullet]的技能造成的伤害+30%，对护盾造成的伤害+150%
每消耗1发[AccelBullet]，使自身增加4级[Breath]强度
掷出消耗[AccelBullet]的硬币时，即使自身消耗了所有加速弹 ，攻击也不会取消

en: When hit, or when "The Thumb Apprentice - Lucio" is defeated, gain [ObsessionAndGreed] next turn
cn: 受到攻击或“拇指 子辈 - 卢西奥”失去战斗能力时，下回合使自身获得[ObsessionAndGreed]

en: When "The Thumb Apprentice - Lucio" is defeated, activate "Time to Hunt" Passive
cn: “拇指 子辈 - 卢西奥”失去战斗能力时，启用被动“狩猎时刻”

en:
Turn Start: If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger

Select a random Sinner and inflict [TeachersPrey]
- Activates every 4 turns after the initial activation
- If this unit kills the target with the Skill "Disposal," activate it again next turn
cn:
回合开始时，若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

随机指定1名罪人，对其施加[TeachersPreyMirror]
- 此后，每4回合触发1次该效果
- 技能“处置”击杀目标时，下回合触发该效果

en:
Takes -30% damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], and [Burst] (rounded down)
-50% to the amount of Stagger Threshold raised (rounded down)
cn:
受到的[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]与[Burst]伤害-30%(向下取整)
受到的混乱阈值前移量-50%(向下取整)

en:
Encounter Start: Inflict [VengeanceBookSpider] on all Sinners

If this unit hit with more than 3 Skills this turn, gain 1 [ReinforcedTattooSpider] next turn for every excess Skill that hit
cn:
关卡开始时，对全体罪人施加[VengeanceBookSpider]

若本回合自身命中的技能数高于3个，则每超出1个，下回合使自身获得1层[ReinforcedTattooSpider]

en:
On Clash Win, gain 1 [DaughterEducationSpider]

On Hit with a Skill, gain 1 [DaughterEducationSpider] (once per Skill; this effect does not activate for Cracked Coins)

On Clash Win with the first-used Skill in a turn, gain 1 more [DaughterEducationSpider] and the Skill gains Coin Power +1
cn:
拼点胜利时，使自身获得1层[DaughterEducationSpider]

技能命中时，使自身获得1层[DaughterEducationSpider](每个技能最多1次，被摧毁的硬币不会触发)

每回合首个使用的技能拼点胜利时，使自身额外获得1层[DaughterEducationSpider]并使该技能的硬币威力+1

en:
When hit by 2 Skills, gain 1 [ResentmentSpider] and lose 1 [DaughterEducationSpider] (number of hits taken is always tracked)

At max [ResentmentSpider] Stack, use a powerful attack

Turn End: At less than 90% / 60% / 40% HP, max out this unit's [ResentmentSpider] Stack
cn:
每当自身被2个技能攻击时，使自身获得1层[ResentmentSpider]并使自身的[DaughterEducationSpider]层数减少1层(受到攻击次数累计计算)

若自身的[ResentmentSpider]层数为最大值，则使用强力攻击

回合结束时，若现存体力低于90%、60%或40%，使自身的[ResentmentSpider]层数变为最大值

en: When [MiddleFatherSwordFour] is unsealed, this unit gains [MiddleFatherGutsMirror]
cn: [MiddleFatherSwordFour]解放时，使自身获得[MiddleFatherGutsMirror]

en:
Begins Encounter with [HeatingWireOffSpider]

Turn Start: At 3+ [GotACompliment], gain [HeatingWireOnSpider] and also inflict [Combustion] with Skills that inflict [Laceration]
- Turn End: At less than 3 [GotACompliment], convert this unit's [HeatingWireOnSpider] to [HeatingWireOffSpider]

If "The Middle Nursefather - Matthias" has [MiddleFatherSwordFour], this unit does not enter [HeatingWireOffSpider] state
cn:
关卡开始时带有[HeatingWireOffSpider]

回合开始时，若自身的[GotACompliment]层数不低于3层，则使自身获得[HeatingWireOnSpider]，令施加[Laceration]的技能额外施加[Combustion]
- 回合结束时，若自身的[GotACompliment]层数低于3层，则使自身的[HeatingWireOnSpider]转化为[HeatingWireOffSpider]

若中指 父辈 - 马蒂亚斯带有[MiddleFatherSwordFour]，则自身不会进入[HeatingWireOffSpider]状态

en: Take -50% damage from Unopposed Attacks Take -50% damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking] When healing SP from [UnlockBuff_Base], if this unit's SP is below 15, heal SP up to 15 Encounter Start: Gain [BurningWoundRien_Mask] and heal SP up to 30 At 55%- HP, end the turn and gain a new pattern - Remove all effects other than those exclusive to this unit - At less than 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill], change [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stack to 9
cn: 受到单方面攻击的伤害-50% 受到来自[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]的伤害-50% 通过[UnlockBuff_Base]恢复理智值时，若自身的理智值低于15点，则使自身的理智值恢复至15点 关卡开始时，对自身施加[BurningWoundRien_Mask]并使自身理智值恢复至30点 若现存体力不高于55%，则结束本回合并改变自身模式 - 解除除自身固有状态以外的所有状态 - 若自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数低于9层，则使自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数变为9层

en: A random weapon is assigned to every Coin. Each weapon has a unique effect. - [RienWeapon01Hatchet] - [RienWeapon02Stiletto] - [RienWeapon03Greatsword] - [RienWeapon04Rapier] - [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer] - [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword] - [RienWeapon07Lance] - [RienWeapon08Chain] - [RienWeapon09Scythe] When using an Attack Skill, gain 1 [StackRienSpecialSkill] (max 9) - Can be gained once per Skill; does not gain Stack from the same Skill twice Turn Start: At 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stacks, use a powerful Skill - Attack End: After using the powerful Skill for the first time, gain [Shin_Rien] - Reset the per-Skill [StackRienSpecialSkill] cap - Min & Max Speed +15 - Turn End: Gain 1 [Vulnerable] and 2 [ResultReduction] next turn Turn 3 Start: At less than 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill], bring its Stack to 9; then, gain (Stack gained x 3) [KarmaOfIndexRien] - Then, activate this effect every 3 turns
cn: 自身每枚硬币的武器均会随机决定，且带有特殊效果 - [RienWeapon01Hatchet] - [RienWeapon02Stiletto] - [RienWeapon03Greatsword] - [RienWeapon04Rapier] - [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer] - [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword] - [RienWeapon07Lance] - [RienWeapon08Chain] - [RienWeapon09Scythe] 使用攻击技能时，使自身获得1层[StackRienSpecialSkill](最多9层) - 每个技能仅可获得1次(相同技能不能获得2次) 回合开始时，若自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数为9层，则使用强力技能 - 首次使用的攻击结束后，使自身获得[Shin_Rien] - 重置每种技能获得[StackRienSpecialSkill]的上限 - 最小与最大速度值+15 - 回合结束时，下回合对自身施加1层[Vulnerable]与2层[ResultReduction] 第3回合开始时，若自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数低于9层，则使自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数变为9层并对自身施加(获得的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数×3)层[KarmaOfIndexRien] - 此后，每3回合触发一次该效果

en: Turn Start: - Gain [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] based on [UnlockBuff_Base] stage on self - Apply [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] against a random Sinner, and prioritize attacking them - When using a Skill against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality], convert all Coins on that Skill to [SuperCoin]s When attacking, if [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] is killed, or if this unit can no longer attack that target, use the remaining Skills against a random other Sinner - Prioritizes targets with the least current HP, unless they have 1 HP - When the randomly chosen Sinner is killed, or if the said Sinner's HP is brought down to 1, repeat this effect on another Sinner Deal +2.5% damage against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 20%) - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], deal +30% damage against all targets
cn: 回合开始时 - 根据自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段，相应使自身获得[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] - 随机对1名罪人施加[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]并优先攻击该罪人 - 使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]使用的技能的所有硬币转化为[SuperCoin] 攻击时[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]阵亡或自身无法攻击目标时， 随机对1名罪人使用剩余的技能 - 优先指定现存体力最低的目标(不包括体力为1点的单位) - 随机指定的罪人阵亡或体力降至1点时，对其他罪人重复该效果 自身每带有1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]造成的伤害+2.5%(最多+20%) - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则改为对全体目标造成的伤害+30%

en: Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn, heal 10 SP and gain 3 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (once per turn) Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed this turn, gain 8 [KarmaOfIndexRien] - If this unit does not have [UnlockBuff_Base], gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] at Turn End - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], does not gain [KarmaOfIndexRien]
cn: 若本回合自身执行了[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时使自身恢复10点理智值并获得3层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy](每回合最多1次) 若本回合自身未执行[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时对自身施加8层[KarmaOfIndexRien] - 若自身未带有[UnlockBuff_Base]，则回合结束时使自身获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则不会施加[KarmaOfIndexRien]

en:
Turn End: At 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] or at 95%-/85%-/75%- HP,
- Gain [UnlockBuff_Rien1]/[UnlockBuff_Rien2]/[UnlockBuff_Rien3]

Turn 1 End: At lower than [UnlockBuff_Base] stage 1, gain [UnlockBuff_Rien1]
Turn 2 End: At lower than [UnlockBuff_Base] stage 2, gain [UnlockBuff_Rien2]

When gaining [UnlockBuff_Base] for the first time, if this unit's SP is below 15, heal up to 15 SP

When [UnlockBuff_Base] is activated due to HP or Turn conditionals:
- At less than 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] Stack, raise the Stack to 3/6/9 and gain 5 [KarmaOfIndexRien] at the next Turn Start for every Stack gained
cn:

- 使自身获得[UnlockBuff_Rien1]/[UnlockBuff_Rien2]/[UnlockBuff_Rien3]

第1/第2回合结束时，若自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段低于1/2，
则使自身获得[UnlockBuff_Rien1]/[UnlockBuff_Rien2]

首次获得[UnlockBuff_Base]时，
若自身理智值低于15点，使自身理智值恢复至15点


通过体力或回合条件获得[UnlockBuff_Base]时
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数低于3层/6层/9层，则使其层数变为3层/6层/9层，
每获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，下回合开始时对自身施加5层[KarmaOfIndexRien]

en: Take -75% damage from Unopposed Attacks Take -75% damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking] When healing SP from [UnlockBuff_Base], if this unit's SP is below 15, heal up to 15 SP When this unit enters a new phase at 55% HP, gain the following effects: - Remove all effects other than those exclusive to this unit - Gain [IndexPrescript_RienSecondPhase] - Convert [BurningWoundRien_Mask] to [BurningWoundRien] - Convert [KarmaOfIndexRien] to [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase]; then gain 10 Stacks of that effect - If this unit does not have [Shin_Rien], immediately gain that effect At 25% or lower HP, gain a new pattern and greatly enhance a certain Skill
