en: When this unit takes damage that brings their HP down to 0, nullify that damage; then, this unit is healed back to 100% HP and SP, and gains a new pattern (once per Encounter)
cn: 受到使自身体力降至0点的伤害时，无视该伤害，并使自身的体力与理智值恢复至最大值，改变自身模式(每场战斗最多1次)

en: Turn Start: gain 1 [AttackUp] for every enemy with [ColdAirDOQ]
cn: 回合开始时，每有1名敌方单位带有[ColdAirDOQ]，使自身获得1层[AttackUp]

en: Turn Start: if there are 6+ enemies with [ColdAirDOQ], gain 2 [ParryingResultUp]
cn: 回合开始时，若带有[ColdAirDOQ]的敌方单位不低于6名，则使自身获得2层[ParryingResultUp]

en: Encounter Start: gain [WeakenDOQ]
cn: 关卡开始时，对自身施加[WeakenDOQ]

en: This unit's Skills deal +1% damage for every 1 [NervousImpairment] on target
cn: 目标每带有1层[NervousImpairment]，使自身的技能造成的伤害+1%

en:
Encounter Start: gain 5 [SeaTerrorCell]
Instead of [AttackDown] and [DefenseDown] effects of [SeaTerrorCell], gain [AttackUp] and [DefenseUp]
cn:
关卡开始时，对自身施加5层[SeaTerrorCell]
[SeaTerrorCell]改为使自身获得[AttackUp]与[DefenseUp]，而非施加[AttackDown]与[DefenseDown]

en:
Turn End: if there are 2 or fewer surviving allies, consume 10 SP on self to summon 2 "Shell Sea Runner" units to the battlefield

Turn End: if [NetherseaBrandUnit] exists in this Stage, apply 2 [Enhancement] next turn to all Sea Terror units
- Apply 1 [AttackUp] as well for every Stage of [NetherseaBrandUnit]
cn:
回合结束时，若存活的友方单位不高于2名，则消耗自身的10点理智值并召唤2只“壳海狂奔者”

回合结束时，若当前关卡存在[NetherseaBrandUnit]，则下回合使属于恐鱼的全体单位获得2层[Enhancement]
- [NetherseaBrandUnit]每有1阶段，额外获得1层[AttackUp]

en:
Take -90% damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], [Sinking]
Turn Start: gain 10 [Protection]

Turn End: consume [AbyssalVitality] to summon Sea Terror horde
- If there are fewer than 3 Shell Sea Runners or Deep Sea Sliders on the battlefield, randomly summon either of those units until there are a sum of 3 of them next turn and consume (# of summoned units x 4) [AbyssalVitality]
- If Nethersea Founder isn't on the battlefield, consume 8 [AbyssalVitality] to summon it next turn
- If Nethersea Spewer isn't on the battlefield, consume 12 [AbyssalVitality] to summon it next turn
- If Basin Sea Reaper isn't on the battlefield, consume 20 [AbyssalVitality] to summon it next turn
cn:
受到的[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]伤害-90%
回合开始时，使自身获得10层[Protection]

回合结束时，消耗[AbyssalVitality]并召唤恐鱼群
- 若战场中壳海狂奔者或底海滑动者少于3只，则下回合随机召唤该单位直至共计3只并消耗(召唤单位数×4)层[AbyssalVitality]
- 若战场中没有深溟奠基者，则下回合消耗8层[AbyssalVitality]并召唤该单位
- 若战场中没有深溟喷溅者，则下回合消耗12层[AbyssalVitality]并召唤该单位
- 若战场中没有钵海收割者，则下回合消耗20层[AbyssalVitality]并召唤该单位

en: Every time a Sea Terror this unit summoned is killed, take fixed HP damage equal to the unit's max HP
cn: 自身召唤的恐鱼阵亡时，使自身受到阵亡单位体力上限100%的固定体力伤害

en:
At 50%- HP, immediately ends combat phase and gains a new pattern
- Disable the Phototaxic Procession Passive
- Gain 100 [AbyssalVitality]
- When gaining this Passive, or when recovering from Stagger, gain Shield equal to the amount of HP lost (once per turn)
- When gaining Shield, activate the effects of [IndelibleGoodwill]

Turn Start:
- Apply 5 [NervousImpairment] to all enemies with less than 15 [NervousImpairment]
- Gain [Vulnerable] equal to double the number of times ("Before the compassion they believe in loses its worth.") was used during this Encounter. (max 6)

After gaining a new pattern: reduce this unit's Skill Slots by the number of Staggered enemies every turn (by 6 max; does not apply to turns when this unit uses a powerful Skill)
cn:
体力不高于50%时，立即结束战斗并改变自身模式
- 禁用被动“趋光队列”
- 使自身获得100层[AbyssalVitality]
- 获得本被动或解除混乱时，使自身获得相当于已失去体力的护盾(每回合最多1次)
- 获得护盾时，触发[IndelibleGoodwill]的效果

回合开始时
- 对[NervousImpairment]层数低于15层的全体敌方单位施加5层[NervousImpairment]
- 对自身施加(本场战斗中使用“在他们所笃信的善意失去价值之前”次数×2)层[Vulnerable](最多6层)

改变自身模式后，每回合根据陷入混乱的敌方单位数，使自身的行动槽数相应减少(最多减少6个；不适用于使用强力技能的回合)

en: When on top of [NetherseaBrandUnit]: gain Final Power +3 and Coin Power +3, and double the amount of [NervousImpairment] inflicted On Hit
cn: 自身位于[NetherseaBrandUnit]上时，使自身的最终威力+3，硬币威力+3，并令自身攻击命中时施加的[NervousImpairment]层数变为2倍

en: When hitting a Basin Sea Reaper with this unit's Skill, convert it from [WaitingforCommandMod] to [ParticipationMod]
cn: 自身的技能命中钵海收割者时，使钵海收割者从[WaitingforCommandMod]转化为[ParticipationMod]

en: If this unit has remaining Shield after getting hit, inflict 2 [Sinking] against the target
cn: 若自身受到伤害后带有护盾，则使目标增加2级[Sinking]强度

en: Turn End: if this unit's [LimitedTime] is evenly divisible by 60, gain 2 [SlashDamageUp] and 2 [PenetrateDamageUp] next turn
cn: 回合结束时，若自身的[LimitedTime]层数可被60整除，则下回合使自身获得2层[SlashDamageUp]与2层[PenetrateDamageUp]

en: If this unit is in [TimeAcceleration] state, deal 10% of the damage it dealt On Hit as bonus damage in the Skill's Sin Affinity (2 times per turn)
cn: 若自身处于[TimeAcceleration]状态，则命中敌方单位时，对该敌方单位额外造成伤害量10%的当前使用技能的罪孽属性的伤害(每回合最多2次)

en: Turn End: if this unit's [LimitedTime], or the sum of [OwnTime] is evenly divisible by 60, gain 2 [SlashDamageUp] and 2 [PenetrateDamageUp] next turn
cn: 回合结束时，若自身的[LimitedTime]层数或[OwnTime]层数之和可被60整除，则下回合使自身获得2层[SlashDamageUp]与2层[PenetrateDamageUp]

en: If this unit is in [EquitableDistribution] state, deal 10% of the damage it dealt On Hit as bonus damage in the Skill's Sin Affinity (2 times per turn)
cn: 若自身处于[EquitableDistribution]状态，则命中敌方单位时，对该敌方单位额外造成伤害量10%的当前使用技能的罪孽属性的伤害(每回合最多2次)

en: Turn End: if this unit is alive, apply 1 [Protection] next turn to a random Part on The Time Ripper.
cn: 回合结束时，若自身存活，则下回合随机使时间杀人魔的1个部位获得1层[Protection]

en: Have 1000 [LimitedTime] at the start of the Encounter
cn: 战斗开始时，带有1000层[LimitedTime]

en: Turn End: If a Part is broken, spend 100 Time from that Part to recover from Part Broken state next turn.
cn: 回合结束时，若有部位被破坏，则消耗该部位带有的100时间并在下回合解除该部位的破坏。

en: At 75% HP, enter the second phase. Upon phase change, recover SP up to 30, and divide the [LimitedTime] between all Parts as [OwnTime].
cn: 体力降为75%时进入第二阶段。阶段变换时，使自身理智值恢复至30点，并使[LimitedTime]变为[OwnTime]并均等分配至所有部位。

en: Turn End: gain [EquitableDistribution].
cn: 每回合对自身施加[EquitableDistribution]。

en: Turn Start: All Parts gain 5 [Protection].
cn: 回合开始时，使所有部位获得5层[Protection]。

en: At 60%- HP, convert [EquitableDistribution] into [UnfairDistribution].
cn: 体力低于60%时，使[EquitableDistribution]变为[UnfairDistribution]。

en: Turn Start: Gain 2 [Protection] for every allied Fauvist Student of the Ring - If this unit used "Critique" in this Encounter, gain 2 [Protection] and heal 5 SP instead starting from the next turn (At lower than -15 SP, double the SP-healing effect) - If there are no allied Fauvist Students of the Ring, gain 2 [Vulnerable] and reduce this unit's SP down to 0 instead Immediately Before Getting Hit by a Skill that has 1 Atk Weight, if there is an allied Student of the Ring, have the said unit take the attack instead (2 times per turn, excluding Assist Units) Turn End of the turn this unit used "Critique": If an allied Fauvist Student of the Ring was defeated in this Encounter, refill its vacancy with the same Student unit - Every Turn Start: The Student that refilled the vacancy due to this effect gains (# of allies defeated in this Encounter) [Vulnerable] and [AttackDown] (max 10 each)
cn: 回合开始时，每有1名属于环指 野兽派 学徒的友方单位，使自身获得2层[Protection] - 若本场战斗中自身使用了“批评”，则从下回合起改为获得2层[Protection]并恢复5点理智值 (若自身理智值低于-15点，则使恢复的理智值变为2倍) - 若没有属于环指 野兽派 学徒的友方单位，则改为对自身施加2层[Vulnerable]并使自身的理智值变为0点 受到攻击容量为1的技能攻击前，若有其他属于学徒的友方单位， 则令其代替自身受到攻击(每回合最多2次，不包括援助单位) 自身使用“批评”的回合结束时，若本场战斗中有属于环指 野兽派 学徒的友方单位阵亡，则在对应位置以相同的学徒单位填补空缺 - 每回合开始时对以该效果登场的属于学徒的单位施加层数相当于本场战斗中阵亡的友方单位数的[Vulnerable]与[AttackDown](分别最多10层)

en: Turn Start: Randomly apply [AttackUp] and [DefenseUp] to allied Fauvist Students of the Ring equal to the number of turns (including the current turn) each unit has survived, respectively (max 5) Turn End: If an allied Student is Staggered, recover them from Stagger - All Attack Type and Affinity Resistance for the Students who recovered from Stagger due to this effect becomes "Fatal" for the next turn Turn End: If a Student is in Panic, heal their SP up to 45
cn: 回合开始时，使属于环指 野兽派 学徒的友方单位 随机获得层数共计相当于其存活回合数(包括本回合) 的[AttackUp]或[DefenseUp](最多5层) 若有属于学徒的友方单位陷入混乱，则回合结束时解除其混乱 - 下回合使因该效果而解除混乱的属于学徒的单位所有物理属性与罪孽属性的抗性变为“致命” 若有属于学徒的单位陷入恐慌，则回合结束时使其理智值恢复至45点

en: Combat End: Inflict 1 [IntenseColors] next turn to Sinners that have [BearClawWound], [EagleClawWound], and [BoldBrushstrokes] simultaneously - If target has 3+/6+/9+ [BearClawWound] and [EagleClawWound] each, inflict 2/3/4 [IntenseColors] instead (amount inflicted is based on the effect that has the least Stack)
cn: 战斗结束时，对同时带有[BearClawWound]，[EagleClawWound]与[BoldBrushstrokes] 的罪人在下回合施加1层[IntenseColors] - 若目标带有的[BearClawWound]与[EagleClawWound] 各不低于3/6/9层，则改为施加2/3/4层[IntenseColors](以层数更低的效果为基准)

en: Gain the effects of [PanicChangeLock] Turn End: If this unit is in Panic, reset SP to 20 At 70%- HP, gain a new pattern - Remove all effects other than those exclusive to this unit - First Turn Start of the new pattern: Gain [FaubismWolfMask] and heal up to 45 SP
cn: 适用于[PanicChangeLock]效果， 回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则使自身的理智值变为20点 若现存体力不高于70%，则改变自身模式 - 解除除自身固有状态以外的所有状态 - 该回合开始时，使自身获得[FaubismWolfMask]并使自身的理智值恢复至45点

en:
In the turn this unit uses a powerful attack, Min & Max Speed +15

Take -30% damage from Unopposed Attacks
Deal +30% damage with Unopposed Attacks
- If the Slot targeted by this unit's Unopposed Attack has 2+ [Aggro], reduce the increased damage from this effect by 5% per [Aggro] Stack (min 0%)

On Clash Lose, gain 1 [AttackDmgUp] (5 per turn)
- At Turn End, or at Attack End of a Skill that hit a Sinner, the [AttackDmgUp] effect gained with this effect expires
cn:
使用强力攻击的回合使自身的最小与最大速度值+15

受到单方面攻击的伤害-30%
单方面攻击造成的伤害+30%
- 若攻击的行动槽的[Aggro]不低于2，则每带有1点[Aggro]，使增加的伤害减少5%(最低0%)

拼点失败时，使自身获得1层[AttackDmgUp](每回合最多5次)
- 回合结束时或使用技能攻击罪人时，在该技能攻击后解除该效果获得的[AttackDmgUp]

en: Turn Start: Gain 8 [Protection] - Gain 2 fewer [Protection] at Turn Start for every type of negative effect on this unit - On Clash Lose using "Burst Forth the Pulsing Crimson under Your Skin" Skill, gain 2 [Vulnerable] from this effect instead for the next turn Gain 1 Defense Level each time this unit is hit by a Skill Coin (max 20 per turn) - Turn End: Defense Level gained due to this effect expires - On Clash Lose using "Burst Forth the Pulsing Crimson under Your Skin" Skill, lose 1 Defense Level each time this unit is hit by a Skill Coin instead for the next turn (max 20; expires at Turn End)
cn: 回合开始时，使自身获得8层[Protection] - 每带有1种负面状态，回合开始时使自身获得的[Protection]层数减少2层 - “令你皮肤下搏动着的那赤红色彩更加狂野。”拼点失败时，该效果在下回合改为施加2层[Vulnerable] 每次受到技能硬币攻击时，使自身增加1级防御等级(每回合最多20级) - 回合结束时，解除该效果增加的防御等级 - “令你皮肤下搏动着的那赤红色彩更加狂野。”拼点失败时，该效果在下回合改为每次受到技能硬币攻击时，使自身减少1级防御等级(最多20级，回合结束时解除)

en: Combat End: Inflict 1 [IntenseColors] next turn to Sinners that have [BearClawWound], [EagleClawWound], and [BoldBrushstrokes] simultaneously - If target has 3+/6+/9+ [BearClawWound] and [EagleClawWound] each, inflict 2/3/4 [IntenseColors] instead (amount inflicted is based on the effect that has the least Stack)
cn: 战斗结束时，对同时带有[BearClawWound]，[EagleClawWound]与[BoldBrushstrokes] 的罪人在下回合施加1层[IntenseColors] - 若目标带有的[BearClawWound]与[EagleClawWound] 各不低于3/6/9层，则改为施加2/3/4层[IntenseColors](以层数更低的效果为基准)

en: Gain the effects of [PanicChangeLock] Turn End: If this unit is in Panic, reset SP to 30 At 35%- HP, convert [FaubismWolfMask] into [FaubismWolfMaskBlooded], and heal up to 45 SP
cn: 适用于[PanicChangeLock]效果， 回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则使自身的理智值变为30点 若现存体力不高于35%，则使自身的[FaubismWolfMask]转化为[FaubismWolfMaskBlooded]并使自身的理智值恢复至45点

en: On death, give +2 E.G.O resource of the least-owned Affinity
cn: 阵亡时，获得2个持有量最少的E.G.O资源

en:
At 10+ Clashes against the same enemy, randomly gain or lose Clash Power by (Clash Count/10) in a Clash (rounded down)

Max Potency cap for [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking]: 30
Max Count cap for [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking]: 10
cn:
若与同一目标拼点不低于10次，则随机使自身的拼点威力增加或减少(拼点次数/10)(向下取整)

en:
When the Telephone Pole is hit, inflict 2 Shock on the attacker this turn.
At 5+ Lightning, all Parts will inflict 3 Shock on the attacker, starting next turn.
(Lasts until Lightning reaches 0.)
When hit by a Sloth attack, the amount of Shock inflicted is halved. (Rounded up.)
cn:
电线杆受到攻击时，对攻击者施加2层感电 
若自身的雷电 层数不低于5层，下回合起改为所有部位受到攻击时，均对攻击者施加3层感电 
(持续直到雷电 层数降至0层)
受到怠惰属性的攻击时，对攻击者施加的感电 层数减半(向上取整)

en:
While the telephone pole isn’t broken, gain 1 Lightning after an attack.
Whenever the telephone pole is hit by an attack, lose 1 Lightning.
cn: 电线杆未被破坏时，攻击结束后使自身获得1层雷电 。电线杆受到攻击时，消耗1层雷电 。

en:
When the telephone pole is Staggered or Broken, lose all Lightning.
All attacks of Alleyway Watchdog will then be canceled for the turn.
cn: 电线杆陷入混乱或被破坏时，使雷电 层数变为0层。本回合巷头恶犬的攻击技能全部取消。

en: At the end of the turn, deal 3 SP damage to a random enemy.
cn: 回合结束时，随机使1名敌方单位失去3点理智值。

en: At the end of the turn, apply 2 Damage Up and 2 Protection to all allies next turn.
cn: 回合结束时，下回合使包括自身在内的全体友方单位获得2层伤害强化 与2层守护 。

en: At the end of the turn, heal 5 HP for each Raw Chicken in battle.
cn: 回合结束时，根据参战的生鸡数量，使自身恢复(生鸡数量×5)的体力。

en: At the end of the turn, deal 5 SP damage to all enemies for each Raw Chicken in battle.
cn: 回合结束时，根据参战的生鸡数量，使全体敌方单位失去(生鸡数量×5)点理智值。

en: When a Part breaks, gain 1 Fragile every turn for each Raw Chicken that died before the Part was broken.
cn: 部位被破坏时，根据直到部位被破坏为止阵亡的生鸡数量，每回合对自身施加相应层数的易损 。

en: If the Part isn’t broken, gain 1 Damage Up for each living Raw Chicken.
cn: 未进入部位破坏状态时，每回合根据存活的生鸡数量获得相应层数的伤害强化 。

en: At the end of the turn, if the unit has 3+ Unresolved Sorrow, generates a head next turn and changes behavior.
cn: 回合结束时，若尚未释怀的哀伤 不低于3层，则下回合生成头部并改变自身的行为。

en: At the end of the turn, if the unit has 3+ Unresolved Sorrow and the head is broken, becomes staggered next turn.
cn: 回合结束时，若尚未释怀的哀伤 不低于3层且头部被破坏，则下回合使自身陷入混乱。

en: When the head is staggered, all parts become staggered next turn.
cn: 头部陷入混乱时，下一回合所有部位陷入混乱。

en: When the head is broken, all parts become staggered next turn. Afterwards, all parts have 3 Attack Power Down for the duration of the battle.
cn: 头部被破坏后，下一回合所有部位陷入混乱。此后的战斗中，对所有部位施加3层虚弱 。

en:
Upon death, all Skills are cancelled for the turn.
Doubles currently owned Self-charge.
cn:
本单位垂死时，取消本回合的所有技能。
使自身的自体发电 层数变为2倍。

en:
After dying, attack skills spend 1 Self-charge.
Attacks enemies until Self-charge runs out.
cn:
本单位垂死之后，每个攻击技能都会消耗1层自体发电 。
直到自体发电 全部耗尽为止会一直攻击敌方单位。

en: Every 5 turns, gains a Shield equal to the head's HP.
cn: 每5回合，获得相当于头部体力的护盾。

en:
After using 'Coil Up', if the Shield is exhausted, spend Self-charge.
All parts become staggered next turn.
cn:
在“盘绕”后，护盾耗尽时，将消耗自体发电 。
下回合所有部位陷入混乱。

en: After the back is broken, gain 3 Fragile every turn. Inflict +2 Rupture.
cn: 背部被破坏时，每回合对自身施加3层易损 。自身额外增加2级破裂 强度

en: After the head umbrella is broken, gain 5 Offense Level Down every turn. Inflict +2 Sinking.
cn: 头部的伞被破坏时，每回合对自身施加5层攻击等级降低 ，自身额外增加2级沉沦 强度

en:
At 15% HP, the unit's Speed is fixed at 1, and gains 1 Attack Power Down.
Newly spawned Old Umbrellas have 30% more HP. Uses 'Cries Seeking Something' every turn.
cn:
剩余15%体力时，每回合速度值固定为1。对自身施加1层虚弱 
新召唤的旧伞体力增加30%。每回合使用技能“寻找某物的哭声”

en: At the end of the turn, if this unit has Burn, inflict the same amount to all units with Entangled Curse Talisman next turn
cn: 回合结束时，若自身带有烧伤 ，则下回合根据自身带有的烧伤 强度，使带有纠缠的咒符 的全体单位增加相应的烧伤 强度

en: When the arm is broken, it deals -20% damage
cn: 手臂部位被破坏时，手臂所造成的伤害-20%

en: After using 'I'll Have This!' on enemies with 5+ Tipsy and successfully landing the attack, become staggered.
cn: 对带有不低于5层醉意 的敌方单位使用“这个我吃了！”并命中后，陷入混乱。

en:
A mysterious smell from within boosts the spirit.
A random Sinner gains 5 Morale Boost at the start of the wave.
cn:
由内而外散发的莫名的香气使人兴致昂扬。
波次开始时，随机使1名罪人获得5层昂扬 。

en:
When this unit is defeated, the Sinner that defeated it gains 2 Haste next turn.
All parts of Drifting Fox are inflicted with 2 Bind and 1 Umbrella Splinters.
cn:
自身被击杀时，下回合使击杀本单位的罪人获得2层迅捷 。
对流浪狐狸的所有部位施加2层束缚 与1层雨伞碎片 。

en: At the end of each turn, lose 10 SP.
cn: 回合结束时，失去10点理智值。

en: While in low morale, gain 2 Attack Power Up and 3 Bind.
cn: 士气低落状态时，获得2层强壮 ，3层束缚

en: In panic, become staggered.
cn: 若自身陷入恐慌则使自身陷入混乱。

en: When recovering from panic, fully heal SP, and gain 2 Haste and 2 Attack Power Up.
cn: 解除恐慌时，使自身理智值恢复至上限，并获得2层迅捷 ，2层强壮 。

en: Starts the battle with 1200 Shield HP
cn: 关卡开始时，获得1200点护盾。

en: Whenever this unit is broken, Dongbaek is inflicted with +5 Sinking Count, and all Sinners lose 2 Sinking Count; all Sinners gain 1 Protection and 2 Attack Power Up next turn.
cn: 每当本单位被破坏时，对冬柏施加5层沉沦 ，使全体罪人减少2级沉沦 强度 。下回合使全体罪人获得1层守护 ，2层强壮

en: At the start of Turn 5, spawn 4 Soon-to-bloom Flowers with 3 Growing
cn: 第5回合开始时，生成4朵带有3层生长 的即将绽放的花 。

en: When HP drops to 50%, proceeds to the next phase. HP does not go below 50% until the phase changes.
cn: 体力低于50%时，进入第2阶段。在进入第2阶段前自身体力不会低于50%

en:
When HP falls below 50%, uses a special skill to target 1 unit, then becomes immune to Stagger and Panic for the next 2 turns.
If Yi Sang has 'Dueling', Dongbaek gains 1 Attack Power Up.
If Yi Sang wins the duel, all allies gain 3 Damage Up next turn.
If Dongbaek wins the duel, Dongbaek fully heals SP.
cn:
若体力不高于50%，则指定1名特定单位使用特殊技能
从本回合起，2回合内自身不会陷入混乱或陷入恐慌。
若李箱带有对决 ，则使冬柏获得1层强壮 
若李箱赢得对决，则下回合使全体友方单位获得3层伤害强化 
若冬柏赢得对决，则使冬柏的理智值恢复至最大值

en: If 'Magnificent Spring Breeze' loses in a clash, lose 10 SP
cn: 技能春风烂漫 拼点失败时，失去10点理智值

en: Spawns with 1 Growing
cn: 生成时带有1层生长

en: 나오면 안되는 텍스트 (번역 x)
cn: 不该出现的文本(翻译 x)

en: 나오면 안되는 텍스트 (번역 x)
cn: 不该出现的文本(翻译 x)

en: All skills target indiscriminately. With each skill used, this unit loses 2% of Max HP.
cn: 所有技能变为无差别攻击。每使用一次技能就失去体力上限2%的体力

en: HP healing effects heal twice as much.
cn: 体力恢复效果变为2倍。

en: While this unit is present, Dongrang gains 1 Protection and 1 Attack Power Up at the start of each turn.
cn: 回合开始时，若本单位存活，则使东朗获得1层守护 与1层强壮

en:
While this unit has Earnest Accomplishment, the following effects apply:
- Can only be defeated with Dongrang's attacks.
- If a Sinner drops this unit's HP to 1, the Sinner heals HP, and this unit gains Empty Honor.
- If Dongrang defeats this unit, Dongrang heals HP and powers up next turn.
cn:
本单位带有恳切的成就 时，将适用以下效果。
- 只能被东朗的攻击击杀
- 本单位被罪人攻击至1点体力时，恢复罪人的体力，并使本单位获得空虚的荣誉 
- 东朗击杀本单位时，恢复东朗的体力，下回合使其获得强化

en:
While this unit has Empty Honor, the following effects apply:
- Can only be defeated with Dongrang's attacks.
- If Dongrang defeats this unit, Dongrang loses HP, gains 1 Emptiness, and is weakened next turn
cn:
本单位带有空虚的荣誉 时，将适用以下效果。
- 只能被东朗的攻击击杀
- 东朗击杀本单位时，失去部分体力并对自身施加1层空虚 ，下回合被削弱

en: The unit that defeated this unit heals by 5% of Max HP, and gains 1 Haste and 1 Attack Power Up next turn
cn: 使击杀本单位的目标恢复其体力上限5%的体力，下回合使该目标获得1层迅捷 与1层强壮

en: When the HP is brought to 85% and 50% of Max HP, respectively, spawns 2 Trees of Desires and changes behavior.
cn: 现存体力达到体力上限的85%，50%时，生成两株欲望之树 且更改技能模式

en: While this unit is present, Dongrang gains 1 Damage Up and 1 Protection at the start of each turn.
cn: 回合开始时，若本单位存活，使东朗获得1层伤害强化 ，1层守护

en: If 'Time of Harvest' loses in a clash, lose 5 SP
cn: 技能丰收时间 拼点失败时，失去5点理智值

en: When in panic, gain 2 Protection and reset SP to 0 at the start of the next turn.
cn: 陷入恐慌时，下回合开始时获得2层守护 且理智值恢复为0

en: When recovering from stagger, gain 1 Attack Power Up.
cn: 解除混乱时，使自身获得1层强壮

en: After using the skill Please Be My Nutrient 3 times, become staggered next turn.
cn: 使用技能请成为我的养分 3次后，下回合陷入混乱

en: When the HP is brought to 85% of Max HP, spawns 2 Trees of Desires and changes behavior.
cn: 现存体力达到体力上限的85%时，生成两株欲望之树 且更改技能模式

en: When the HP is brought to 50% of Max HP, spawns 2 Trees of Desires and changes behavior.
cn: 现存体力达到体力上限的50%时，生成两株欲望之树 且更改技能模式

en: When the fairy is attacked, only that part loses HP.
cn: 精灵部位受到攻击时，只有该部位会失去体力。

en:
When the fairy part is broken, the roots can be attacked next turn.
All parts gain 1 Attack Power Up, 2 Bind, and 3 Fragile next turn.
cn:
若精灵部位被破坏，则下回合使根部可受到攻击。
下回合对所有部位施加1层强壮 ，2层束缚 与3层易损 。

en:
The fairy regenerates the turn after the roots are exposed. (One time only)
After the roots are exposed 3 times or destroyed, the unit is enraged.
cn:
根部暴露时，下回合使精灵部位再生。(最多1次)
根部暴露3次或被破坏后，进入狂暴状态。

en: If the fairy has Tremor, it takes damage by its Potency at the end of the turn. (Max 20)
cn: 回合结束时，若精灵带有震颤 ，则其受到与震颤 强度相同的伤害(最多20点)

en: If the part has Burn, it takes more damage based on its Potency. (Max +15%)
cn: 若部位带有烧伤 ，则根据烧伤 强度相应使其受到的伤害增加(最多+15%)

en: If the giant clover is present, this unit heals 30 HP at the end of the turn.
cn: 生成巨大的四叶草后，回合结束时使自身恢复30点体力

en: When the arm is broken, the unit gains 2 Attack Power Down every turn.
cn: 手臂部位被破坏后，每回合对自身施加2层虚弱

en: When the head is broken, the unit gains 4 Defense Level Down and 1 Fragile every turn.
cn: 破坏头部后，每回合对自身施加4层防御等级降低 与1层易损

en: At the start of the turn, give 1 HP Healing Boost and 1 Attack Power Up to Fairy-Long-Legs.
cn: 每回合开始时，长腿精灵获得1层体力恢复提升 与1层强壮 。

en: At the start of the turn, give 1 HP Healing Boost and 1 Attack Power Up to Fairy-Long-Legs.
cn: 每回合开始时，长腿精灵获得1层体力恢复提升 与1层强壮 。

en: Turn End: If the ally with [PreparedMeat] is at 1 HP, kill the ally; then, all Parts gain 5 [Vulnerable], [Reduction], and [Disarming].
cn: 回合结束时，若带有[PreparedMeat]的友方单位体力为1点，则击杀该单位并在下回合对全部部位施加5层[Vulnerable]，[Reduction]与[Disarming]。

en:
Turn Start: If there are surviving allies at 25%- HP, kill all allies.
Heal (# of allies killed x 5)% of max Core HP.
Turn End: If there are no surviving allies, gain 20 [Enhancement] next turn.
cn:
回合开始时，若现存体力不高于25%，则击杀全体友方单位。
使本体恢复体力上限(击杀的友方单位数×5)%的体力。
回合结束时，若没有友方单位存活，则下回合使自身获得20层[Enhancement]。

en: When an Arm is broken, the Body gains 5 Bleed at every Turn Start.
cn: 手臂部位被破坏后，每回合开始时使躯干部位增加5级流血 强度。

en: Turn End: All Sinners heal 10 SP, and gain +1 E.G.O resource for all Affinities
cn: 回合结束时，使全体罪人恢复10点理智值并使所有E.G.O资源+1

en: Turn End: If the ally with [PreparedMeat] is Staggered, kill the ally.
cn: 回合结束时，若带有[PreparedMeat]的友方单位陷入混乱，则将其击杀。

en: After defeating an ally, heal 20 Core HP; then, gain 1 [Vulnerable] next turn.
cn: 击杀友方单位后，使本体恢复20点体力，下回合对自身施加1层[Vulnerable]。

en:
Turn End: If this unit failed to defeat an ally with Prepared Meat, gain 1 [Hunger]. At 75%- HP, gain 2. At 50%- HP, gain 3.
Turn Start: If this unit defeated an ally with Prepared Meat, lose 1 [Hunger].
cn:
回合结束时，若自身未能击杀带有储备粮 的友方单位，则对自身施加1层[Hunger]。若现存体力低于75%，则改为施加2层。若现存体力低于50%，则改为施加3层。
回合开始时，若自身击杀带有[PreparedMeat]的单位，则减少1层[Hunger]。

en: Turn End: At 0 [Hunger], gain (allies defeated this turn x 3) [AttackDown] and [DefenseDown].
cn: 回合结束时，若自身的[Hunger]层数为0层，则下回合对自身施加(本回合阵亡的友方单位数×3)层[AttackDown]与[DefenseDown]。

en: Turn End: At 4 [Hunger], gain a stronger pattern.
cn: 回合结束时，若自身[Hunger]层数为4层，则下回合变为强化的技能模式

en: If at 50+ [AccumulatedPastMirror], and if Core's HP is less than or equal to 80%, Core gains 200 HP by spending 50 [AccumulatedPastMirror] at Turn End
cn: 若自身的[AccumulatedPastMirror]层数不低于50层，且本体体力不高于80%，则在回合结束时消耗50层[AccumulatedPastMirror]，并使本体恢复200点体力。

en:
When the body is broken, spend all Accumulated Past.
When the body is broken, all Attack Types and Affinities become ineffective(0.5) against the body starting next turn until the end of this encounter.
cn:
躯干部位被破坏后，消耗所有累积的过去 。
躯干部位被破坏后，下回合起使躯干部位的所有罪孽抗性与物理抗性在本场战斗中全部变为“抵抗”(0.5)。

en:
If the [AccumulatedPastMirror] is an odd number, gain 3 [Vulnerable] and [AttackDmgUp]
If it is an even number, gain 3 [Protection] and [AttackDmgDown]
cn:
[AccumulatedPastMirror]层数为奇数时，对自身施加3层[Vulnerable]并使自身获得3层[AttackDmgUp]
层数为偶数时，使自身获得3层[Protection]并对自身施加3层[AttackDmgDown]

en: Turn Start: Heal 15% of max HP
cn: 回合开始时，使自身恢复体力上限15%的体力

en: HP does not drop below 1
cn: 体力不会降至1点以下

en:
When this unit gets attacked, take -70% Skill damage, and transfer that Skill's damage to a random ally.
(Prioritizes allies with [PreparedMeat]; does not activate if there are no allies; this damage does not kill the affected allies)
cn:
自身受到攻击时，无视该技能70%的伤害。每个技能随机指定1名友方单位，对其造成相应的伤害
(优先指定带有[PreparedMeat]的友方单位，没有友方单位时不会触发，友方单位不会因该伤害而阵亡)

en: When the head is broken, the part has -2 Skill Final Power
cn: 若头部部位被破坏，则使该部位技能的最终威力 -2

en: When the shell is broken, the part has -2 Skill Final Power
cn: 若外壳部位被破坏，则使该部位技能的最终威力 -2

en:
After this unit defeats its ally, heal by 5% of Max HP.
At the end of the turn, if this unit has healed 15% of Max HP with the above effect, restore the shell.
cn:
自身击杀友方单位时，恢复体力上限的5%
回合结束时，若本效果恢复了体力上限的15%，则下回合使外壳部位再生。

en:
At less than 70% HP, Brutal Pummelling, Powerful! Pummel, and Foaming skills target another ally with the least current HP.
When attacking an ally, heals HP by the damage dealt.
When defeating an ally, heals HP by double the damage dealt.
cn:
若现存体力低于70%，则使技能“胡乱刺击”、“强力！刺击”、“吐泡”指定除自身以外现存体力最低的友方单位
攻击友方单位时，使自身恢复造成伤害量的体力。
击杀友方单位时，使自身恢复造成伤害量2倍的体力。

en: Turn Start: All enemies lose 10 SP
cn: 回合开始时，使全体敌方单位失去10理智值

en: At the start of the turn, if at less than 50% HP, heal 20% of Max HP.
cn: 回合开始时，若现存体力低于50%，则使自身恢复体力上限20%的体力。

en: After losing a clash, gain 1 Fragile.
cn: 拼点失败时，对自身施加1层易损 。

en: When an Eye Part breaks, the enemy with the least SP loses 35 SP.
cn: 眼睛部位被破坏时，使理智值最低的1名敌方单位失去35点理智值

en: At the start of the turn, gain 3 Fragile if the Part is broken.
cn: 回合开始时，若处于部位破坏状态，则获得3层易损 。

en: At the start of the turn, if Charge Count is at 10+, change behavior.
cn: 回合开始时，若自身的充能 层数不低于10层，则改变自身模式。

en:
When this unit is defeated, Kqe-1j-23 takes 100 damage and becomes Staggered next turn.
It then loses arm-related skills for the rest of the battle.
cn:
本单位阵亡后，Kqe-1j-23受到100点伤害并在下回合陷入混乱。
在此之后的战斗中，使其无法使用需要手臂的技能。

en: At the start of the turn, if below 60 HP, enter a powered-up state.
cn: 回合开始时，若现存体力不高于60点，则进入强化状态。

en: At the start of the turn, gain 2 Damage Up and 2 Fragile.
cn: 回合开始时，获得2层伤害强化 并施加2层易损 。

en: At the start of the turn, if an ally is present, gain 10 Protection.
cn: 回合开始时，若有友方单位存活，则获得10层守护 。

en: NOT FOR SEEING OR LOOKING AT
cn: 不该出现的文本

en:
All units transfer 10 of their Karma to their targets after a successful attack.
(5 more Karma is transferred per Clash count.)
Karma is not transferred to My Form Empties as long as its allies are alive.
cn:
全体单位的攻击命中时，都将向目标转移10层业报 。拼点次数越多，转移的业报越多。(1次拼点增加5层)
友方单位存活时，业报 无法转移给无我入定。

en:
At the start of the turn, if the Mūrti is broken, apply 30 Karma and 3 Fragile to a random other ally, then enter a mode of Anatman (Non-Self).

- Gain 1 [Vulnerable]

[Breath]效果的暴击率×1.5

en: At 10+ Clashes against the same target, randomly gain or lose Clash Power by (Clash Count / 10) in a Clash (rounded down) Encounter Start: - Begin Encounter with the same HP as Butterfly[TabExplain] of Entangled Lives::The Pupa (excluding Shield) - Gain 10 Stacks each of [StackPastActivate] / [StackPresentActivate] / [StackFutureActivate] At less than 66%/33% HP, gain new Slot patterns - When this unit's HP drops below 66%/33% for the first time in this Encounter, gain 10 Stacks each of [StackPastActivate], [StackPresentActivate], and [StackFutureActivate] next turn
cn: 若与同一目标拼点不低于10次，则随机使自身的拼点威力 增加或减少(拼点次数/10)(向下取整) 关卡开始时 - 以与第1区段登场的罗生蝶::蛹相同的体力开始战斗(不包括护盾) - 使自身分别获得10层[StackPastActivate]/[StackPresentActivate]/[StackFutureActivate] 若现存体力低于66%/33%，则改变自身模式 - 本场战斗中现存体力首次低于66%/33%时， 下回合使自身分别获得10层[StackPastActivate]/[StackPresentActivate]/[StackFutureActivate]

en: Turn Start: Activate the highest-Stacked state of time between [StackPastActivate], [StackPresentActivate], and [StackFutureActivate] and use a special Skill - If multiple states of time share the highest Stack, the currently active state of time does not change - Inactive states of time become [StackPast], [StackPresent], or [StackFuture], respectively - When the currently active state of time changes, gain 1 [TimeGap] Every time Illusory Butterfly[TabExplain] of Entangled Lives::The Past / The Present / The Future are hit as main targets, Butterfly[TabExplain] of Entangled Lives::Imago loses [StackPastActivate] / [StackPresentActivate] / [StackFutureActivate] Stack Higher [StackPastActivate] / [StackPresentActivate] / [StackFutureActivate] Stacks lead to Butterfly[TabExplain] of Entangled Lives::Imago's Skill Power and damage output becoming greatly enhanced, and greatly increase the amount of status effects it inflicts or gains
cn: 回合开始时，激活层数最高的状态并使用特殊技能 - 层数相同时，维持当前状态 - 使禁用的状态转化为[StackPast]/[StackPresent]/[StackFuture] - 状态改变时，对自身施加1层[TimeGap] 罗生蝶 幻影::过去/现在/未来作为主要目标受到攻击时， 使罗生蝶::蝶的[StackPastActivate]/[StackPresentActivate]/[StackFutureActivate]层数减少 [StackPastActivate]/[StackPresentActivate]/[StackFutureActivate]层数越高， 罗生蝶::蝶的技能威力与造成的伤害会大幅增加 对自身与其他单位施加的异常状态会大幅增加

en:
Encounter Start: Gain 3 [YesdragonSelfRefraction]
Turn End: Gain 1 [YesdragonSelfRefraction] next turn
Gain +1 more [YesdragonSelfRefraction] from this effect every time the "Thundering Wrath" Passive triggers
cn:
关卡开始时，使自身获得3层[YesdragonSelfRefraction]
回合结束时，下回合使自身获得1层[YesdragonSelfRefraction]
每当被动效果“震怒”触发时，令自身通过本效果获得的[YesdragonSelfRefraction]额外+1层

en:
The Inverted Scale Part takes damage only from Skills that it is the main target of; does not take damage from any other sources
When the Inverted Scale Part is hit, remove the Inverted Scale Part from the Skill Slots next turn; gain 1 [AttackUp] and 1 [DefenseDown] for every [YesdragonSelfRefraction] Stack consumed by the "Wrath of the Inverted Scale" Skill
cn:
逆鳞部位仅受到以自身为主要目标的技能的伤害，而不会受到其他伤害
逆鳞部位受到攻击时，下回合从行动槽中移除逆鳞部位，且每通过技能“逆鳞之祸”消耗1层[YesdragonSelfRefraction]，使自身获得1层[AttackUp]并对自身施加1层[DefenseDown]

不受[Agility]与[Binding]影响
受到[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]的体力伤害与混乱阈值前移量-50%

When the Shield is broken, enter a new phase

所有部位变为可破坏和不可截除状态
被破坏的部位3回合后以体力上限30%的体力<noparse>再生</noparse>

逆鳞部位被破坏时，使所有部位获得3层[AttackUp]并对所有部位施加6层[DefenseDown]

Turn Start: Gain Shield equal to 300% of the Core's max HP
- This effect does not trigger when Attack Skills are equipped
Turn Start: When Staggered, recover from Stagger

回合开始时，获得本体体力上限300%的护盾
- 该效果在装备攻击技能时不触发
回合开始时，若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱

en:
When hit, apply [YesdragonPower] on the attacker next turn

On death, immediately apply [YesdragonPower] on all Sinners
cn:
受到攻击时，下回合使攻击者获得[YesdragonPower]

自身阵亡时，立即使所有罪人获得[YesdragonPower]

en:
When this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, this unit's HP does not drop below 1 for the turn; recover from Stagger due to damage
For the rest of the turn, this unit cannot be Staggered or killed due to damage; then, use "Impale the Self, Impurity[TabExplain] to Purge" at the very end of that turn
cn:
受到使自身体力降至0点的伤害时，本回合自身体力不会低于1点，解除自身因受到伤害而陷入的混乱
该回合自身不会因受到伤害陷入混乱或阵亡，并在该回合最后使用技能“自穿灭污”

Take damage only from Skills that this unit is the main target of; does not take damage from any other sources

自身不会成为恢复或援护防御效果的目标
仅受到以自身为主要目标的技能的伤害，而不会受到其他伤害

cn: 无法撤退

cn: 被应龙的技能“落雷”命中时，自身立即阵亡并使应龙获得1层[YesdragonSelfRefraction]

en: Take -50% damage from Unopposed Attacks Take -50% damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking] When healing SP from [UnlockBuff_Base], if this unit's SP is below 15, heal SP up to 15 Encounter Start: Gain [BurningWoundRien_Mask] and heal SP up to 45 At 55%- HP, end the turn and gain a new pattern - Remove all effects other than those exclusive to this unit - Change [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stack to 0
cn: 受到单方面攻击的伤害-50% 受到来自[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]的伤害-50% 通过[UnlockBuff_Base]恢复理智值时，若自身的理智值低于15点，则使自身的理智值恢复至15点 关卡开始时，对自身施加[BurningWoundRien_Mask]并使自身理智值恢复至45点 若现存体力不高于55%，则结束本回合并改变自身模式 - 解除除自身固有状态以外的所有状态 - 使自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数变为0层

en: A random weapon is assigned to every Coin. Each weapon has a unique effect. - [RienWeapon01Hatchet] - [RienWeapon02Stiletto] - [RienWeapon03Greatsword] - [RienWeapon04Rapier] - [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer] - [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword] - [RienWeapon07Lance] - [RienWeapon08Chain] - [RienWeapon09Scythe] When using an Attack Skill, gain 1 [StackRienSpecialSkill] (max 9) - Can be gained once per Skill; does not gain Stack from the same Skill twice Turn Start: At 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stacks, use a powerful Skill - Attack End: After using the powerful Skill for the first time, gain [Shin_Rien] - Reset the per-Skill [StackRienSpecialSkill] cap - Min & Max Speed +15 - Turn End: Gain 1 [Vulnerable] and 2 [ResultReduction] next turn Turn 4 Start after entering the field: At less than 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill], bring its Stack to 9; then, gain (Stack gained x 3) [KarmaOfIndexRien] - Then, activate this effect every 4 turns
cn: 自身每枚硬币的武器均会随机决定，且带有特殊效果 - [RienWeapon01Hatchet] - [RienWeapon02Stiletto] - [RienWeapon03Greatsword] - [RienWeapon04Rapier] - [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer] - [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword] - [RienWeapon07Lance] - [RienWeapon08Chain] - [RienWeapon09Scythe] 使用攻击技能时，使自身获得1层[StackRienSpecialSkill](最多9层) - 每个技能仅可获得1次(相同技能不能获得2次) 回合开始时，若自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数为9层，则使用强力技能 - 首次使用的攻击结束后，使自身获得[Shin_Rien] - 重置每种技能获得[StackRienSpecialSkill]的上限 - 最小与最大速度值+15 - 回合结束时，下回合对自身施加1层[Vulnerable]与2层[ResultReduction] 自身登场后的第4回合开始时，若自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数低于9层，则使自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数变为9层并对自身施加(获得的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数×3)层[KarmaOfIndexRien] - 此后，每4回合触发一次该效果

en: Turn Start: - Gain [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] based on [UnlockBuff_Base] stage on self - Apply [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] against a random Sinner, and prioritize attacking them - When using a Skill against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality], convert all Coins on that Skill to [SuperCoin]s When attacking, if [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] is killed, or if this unit can no longer attack that target, use the remaining Skills against a random Sinner - Prioritizes targets with the lowest current HP, unless they have 1 HP - When the randomly chosen Sinner is killed, or if the said Sinner's HP is brought down to 1, repeat this effect on another Sinner Deal +2.5% damage against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 20%) - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], deal +30% damage against all targets
cn: 回合开始时 - 根据自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段，相应使自身获得[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] - 随机对1名罪人施加[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]并优先攻击该罪人 - 使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]使用的技能的所有硬币转化为[SuperCoin] 攻击时[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]阵亡或自身无法攻击目标时， 随机对1名罪人使用剩余的技能 - 优先指定现存体力最低的目标(不包括体力为1点的单位) - 随机指定的罪人阵亡或体力降至1点时，对其他罪人重复该效果 自身每带有1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]造成的伤害+2.5%(最多+20%) - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则改为对全体目标造成的伤害+30%

en: Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn, heal 10 SP and gain 3 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (once per turn) Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed this turn, gain 8 [KarmaOfIndexRien] - If this unit does not have [UnlockBuff_Base], gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] at Turn End - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], does not gain [KarmaOfIndexRien]
cn: 若本回合自身执行了[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时使自身恢复10点理智值并获得3层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy](每回合最多1次) 若本回合自身未执行[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时对自身施加8层[KarmaOfIndexRien] - 若自身未带有[UnlockBuff_Base]，则回合结束时使自身获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则不会施加[KarmaOfIndexRien]

en:
Turn End: At 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] or at 95%-/85%-/75%- HP,- Gain [UnlockBuff_Rien1]/[UnlockBuff_Rien2]/[UnlockBuff_Rien3]

Turn 1 End after entering the field: At lower than [UnlockBuff_Base] stage 1, gain [UnlockBuff_Rien1]
Turn 3 End after entering the field: At lower than [UnlockBuff_Base] stage 2, gain [UnlockBuff_Rien2]

When [UnlockBuff_Base] is activated due to HP or Turn conditionals:
- At less than 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] Stack, raise them to 3/6/9
Gain 5 [KarmaOfIndexRien] at the next Turn Start for every Stack gained
cn:
回合结束时，若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为3层/6层/9层或现存体力不高于95%/85%/75%，
- 使自身获得[UnlockBuff_Rien1]/[UnlockBuff_Rien2]/[UnlockBuff_Rien3]

自身登场后的第1回合结束时，若自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段低于1，则使自身获得[UnlockBuff_Rien1]
自身登场后的第3回合结束时，若自身的[UnlockBuff_Base]阶段低于2，则使自身获得[UnlockBuff_Rien2]

通过体力条件或回合条件获得[UnlockBuff_Base]时
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数低于3层/6层/9层，则使其层数变为3层/6层/9层，
每获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，下回合开始时对自身施加5层[KarmaOfIndexRien]

en:
Apply the [PanicChangeLock] effect
Turn End: If this unit is in Panic, raise SP to 15
cn: 适用于[PanicChangeLock]效果，回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则使自身的理智值变为15点

en: Take -75% damage from Unopposed Attacks Take -75% damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking] When healing SP from [UnlockBuff_Base], if this unit's SP is below 30, heal up to 30 SP When this unit enters a new phase at 55% HP, gain the following effects: - Remove all effects other than those exclusive to this unit - Reset [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stack to 0 - Gain [IndexPrescript_RienSecondPhase] - Convert [BurningWoundRien_Mask] to [BurningWoundRien] - Convert [KarmaOfIndexRien] to [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase]; then gain 10 Stacks of that effect - If this unit does not have [Shin_Rien], immediately gain that effect At 25% or lower HP, gain a new pattern and greatly enhance a certain Skill
cn: 受到单方面攻击的伤害-75% 受到来自[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]的伤害-75% 通过[UnlockBuff_Base]恢复理智值时，若自身的理智值低于30点，则使自身的理智值恢复至30点 现存体力不高于55%并改变自身模式时，触发以下效果 - 解除除自身固有状态以外的所有状态 - 使自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数变为0层 - 使自身获得[IndexPrescript_RienSecondPhase] - 使自身的[BurningWoundRien_Mask]转化为[BurningWoundRien] - 使自身的[KarmaOfIndexRien]转化为[KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase]并对自身施加10层该状态 - 若自身未带有[Shin_Rien]，则使自身获得[Shin_Rien] 现存体力不高于25%时，改变自身模式并大幅强化特定技能

en: A random weapon is assigned to every Coin. Each weapon has a unique effect. - [RienWeapon01Hatchet2phase] - [RienWeapon02Stiletto2phase] - [RienWeapon03Greatsword2phase] - [RienWeapon04Rapier2phase] - [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer2phase] - [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword2phase] - [RienWeapon07Lance2phase] - [RienWeapon08Chain2phase] - [RienWeapon09Scythe2phase] When using an Attack Skill, gain 1 [StackRienSpecialSkill] (max 9) - Can be gained once per Skill; does not gain Stack from the same Skill twice - Does not gain Stack from a Skill used only in a special pattern Turn Start: At 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stacks, use a powerful Skill - Reset the per-Skill [StackRienSpecialSkill] cap - Min & Max Speed +15 - Turn End: Gain 2 [Vulnerable] and 3 [ResultReduction] next turn Activate the following, starting from the turn in which the phase changed - Every 3 turns, at less than 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill], bring its Stack to 9; then, gain (Stack gained x 5) [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase]
cn: 自身每枚硬币的武器均会随机决定，且带有特殊效果 - [RienWeapon01Hatchet2phase] - [RienWeapon02Stiletto2phase] - [RienWeapon03Greatsword2phase] - [RienWeapon04Rapier2phase] - [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer2phase] - [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword2phase] - [RienWeapon07Lance2phase] - [RienWeapon08Chain2phase] - [RienWeapon09Scythe2phase] 使用攻击技能时，使自身获得1层[StackRienSpecialSkill](最多9层) - 每个技能仅可获得1次(相同技能不能获得2次) - 仅在特殊模式使用的技能不会获得 回合开始时，若自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数为9层，则使用强力技能 - 重置每种技能获得[StackRienSpecialSkill]的上限 - 最小与最大速度值+15 - 回合结束时，下回合对自身施加2层[Vulnerable]与3层[ResultReduction] 从改变模式的回合起触发效果 - 每3回合，若自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数低于9层，则使自身的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数变为9层并对自身施加(获得的[StackRienSpecialSkill]层数×5)层[KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase]

en: Turn Start: - Apply [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] against a random Sinner, and prioritize attacking them - When using a Skill against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality], convert all Coins on that Skill to [SuperCoin]s - Gain [Protection] equal to [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 9) - Lose 1 Stack for every 20 [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase] When attacking, if [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] is killed, or if this unit can no longer attack that target, use the remaining Skills against a random other Sinner - Prioritizes targets with the lowest current HP, unless they have 1 HP - When the randomly chosen Sinner is killed, or if the said Sinner's HP is brought down to 1, repeat this effect on another Sinner Deal +5% damage against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 40%) - At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], deal +50% damage against all targets Starting from the first turn after the phase change, activate the following effects: - Turn Start: Gain [BlackNightmare] · If this unit used a powerful attack in the previous turn, lose [BlackNightmare] for that turn
cn: 回合开始时 - 随机对1名罪人施加[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]并优先攻击该罪人 - 使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]使用的技能的所有硬币转化为[SuperCoin] - 使自身获得层数相当于自身[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数的[Protection](最多9层) - 自身每带有20层[KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase]，使获得的[Protection]减少1层 攻击时[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]阵亡或自身无法攻击目标时， 随机对1名罪人使用剩余的技能 - 优先指定现存体力最低的目标(不包括体力为1点的单位) - 随机指定的罪人阵亡或体力降至1点时，对其他罪人重复该效果 自身每带有1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]造成的伤害+5%(最多+40%) - 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则改为对全体目标造成的伤害+50% 从改变模式的第2回合起触发效果 - 回合开始时，使自身获得[BlackNightmare] · 若上回合自身使用了强力技能，则本回合不会获得[BlackNightmare]

en: Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed this turn, heal 15 SP and gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (once per turn) Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed this turn, gain 8 [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase] and lose 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] - If this unit used a powerful Skill this turn, gain 12 [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase] and lose 2 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] instead
cn: 若本回合自身执行了[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时使自身恢复15点理智值并获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy](每回合最多1次) 若本回合自身未执行[IndexPrescript_Base_2nd]， 则回合结束时对自身施加8层[KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase]并使自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数减少1层 - 使用强力技能的回合改为对自身施加12层[KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase]并使自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数减少2层

en:
Apply the [PanicChangeLock] effect
Turn End: If this unit is in Panic, raise SP to 30
cn: 适用于[PanicChangeLock]效果，回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则使自身的理智值变为30点

en:
Apply the [PanicChangeLock] effect
Turn End: If this unit is in Panic, raise SP to 45
cn: 适用于[PanicChangeLock]效果，回合结束时，若自身陷入恐慌，则使自身的理智值变为45点

en: Turn Start: If there are no [TagGameBuff]s, this unit's 1/2/3 other allies that have the lowest Level become [TagGameBuff] for 3 turns (number of units receiving this effect increases every time this effect activates) If [TagGameBuff] effect expires while the unit that had the [TagGameBuff] effect is alive, gain the following effects: - All Sinners take fixed damage equal to 40% HP each - Reduce SP to -45 for a random Sinner who can enter E.G.O Corrosion[TabExplain] or Panic If a Sinner kills a [TagGameBuff], the said Sinner gains 1 [ResultEnhancement] for the rest of this Encounter (this effect can be gained cumulatively)
cn: 回合开始时，若没有[TagGameBuff]，则使除自身以外等级最低的1/2/3名友方单位在3回合内成为[TagGameBuff](根据该效果的触发次数相应增加人数) 若[TagGameBuff]存活时解除了[TagGameBuff]，则触发以下效果 - 全体罪人受到其体力上限40%的固定体力伤害 - 随机强制使可侵蚀或陷入恐慌的1名罪人的理智值变为-45点 若罪人击杀了[TagGameBuff]，则使该罪人在本场战斗期间获得1层[ResultEnhancement](该效果可叠加)

en: Turn End: If this unit is the only surviving ally, or if the Core is at 50%- HP, use "Let's Play Together Forever~!" next turn (once per Encounter)
cn: 回合结束时，若存活的友方单位仅剩自身或自身本体体力不高于50%，则下回合使用“永远一起玩吧~！”(每场战斗最多1次)

en: Turn Start: The "Stuffed Toy" Part gains [Protection] equal to the number of allies excluding this unit When the "Stuffed Toy" Part is destroyed, Will You Play? and its remaining allies are killed
cn: 回合开始时，使玩偶部位获得层数相当于除自身外的友方单位数的[Protection] 玩偶部位被破坏时，玩吗？与剩余的友方单位阵亡

en: HP damage taken by the Core is fixed at 0
cn: 躯干部位受到的体力伤害固定为0点

en:
Take -30% HP, SP damage from [Combustion], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking]
Take -50% damage from [Laceration]

Turn Start: If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger. Afterward, gain 2 [CrimsonTakeDamageUp] and becomes unable to use "Installation Art no. 3: Improvised Ribcage" until next turn (once per Encounter)

Turn End: Gain 1 [DefenseDown] next turn for every 4 [Combustion] on self (max 15)
cn:
受到[Combustion]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]的体力伤害与理智伤害-30%
受到[Laceration]的伤害-50%

回合开始时，若自身陷入混乱，则解除自身的混乱并使自身获得2层[CrimsonTakeDamageUp]，直到下回合自身无法使用装置艺术第3号 “简易肋骨”(每场战斗最多1次)

回合结束时，自身每带有4级[Combustion]强度，下回合对自身施加1层[DefenseDown](最多15层)

en:
Encounter Start: Apply 1 [ObservedPerson] on all enemies; then, gain [Breath] Potency and Count equal to the number of units with [ObservedPerson]

Turn Start: Apply 1 [ObservedPerson] against targets without [ObservedPerson]

For every 10 [ObservedPerson] on the target, inflict +1 more [Vibration] Potency and Count with this unit's Skills (max 3)
cn:
关卡开始时，对全体敌方单位施加1层[ObservedPerson]
根据被施加[ObservedPerson]的单位数，使自身增加相应的[Breath]强度并使自身获得相应层数的[Breath]

回合开始时，对未带有[ObservedPerson]的目标施加1层[ObservedPerson]

目标每带有10层[ObservedPerson]，令自身技能增加的[Vibration]强度与施加的[Vibration]层数额外+1(最多+3)

en: Gain 1 [Breath] Potency every time this unit inflicts damage with Attack Skill effects (15 per turn) - If the target has 15+ [ObservedPerson], gain 1 additional [Breath] Potency with every hit Gain +1 [Breath] Count every time this unit takes damage from a Sinner's Attack Skill effects (15 per turn) - If the target has 15+ [ObservedPerson], gain +1 additional [Breath] Count with every hit taken Turn Start: Inflict 3 [ResultReduction] and 5 [ObservedPerson] to the Sinner who dealt the most damage to this unit in the previous turn - If the target has 30 [ObservedPerson], inflict 5 [ResultReduction] instead
cn: 自身的攻击技能效果造成伤害时，使自身增加1级[Breath]强度(每回合最多15次) - 若目标的[ObservedPerson]层数不低于15层，则使自身额外增加1级[Breath]强度 受到罪人的技能效果造成的伤害时，使自身获得1层[Breath](每回合最多15次) - 若目标的[ObservedPerson]层数不低于15层，则使自身额外获得1层[Breath] 回合开始时，对上回合对自身造成的伤害最高的罪人施加3层[ResultReduction]与5层[ObservedPerson] - 若目标带有30层[ObservedPerson]，则改为施加5层[ResultReduction]

en: Turn Start: Gain Shield equal to 30% of missing HP (Shield HP cannot exceed 25% of the max HP) - If this unit has [Combustion], lose ([Combustion] Count x 1.5)% Shield HP - Shield takes +100% damage from [Burst] effects Turn End: If the Shield gained due to this effect is destroyed, for the rest of this Encounter, gain 1 [DefenseDown] at Turn Start for every instance the Shield has been destroyed (max 5)
cn: 回合开始时，使自身获得自身已失去体力30%的护盾(不超过体力上限的25%) - 若自身带有[Combustion]，则使自身减少(自身的[Combustion]层数×1.5)%的护盾 - 护盾受到的[Burst]伤害+100% 回合结束时，若通过本效果获得的护盾被破坏，则根据被破坏次数，按比例在本场战斗回合开始时对自身施加1层[DefenseDown](最多5层)

en: Turn End: Siphon 10 SP from Sinners (max 3 Sinners in descending order of SP; does not apply cumulatively on the same target) (Does not activate if Hohenheim is Panicked) This unit's SP does not drop below 15
cn: 回合结束时，夺取罪人10点理智值(最多3名，按理智值由高到低顺序适用，不会对同一目标重复生效) (霍恩海姆陷入恐慌时不生效) 自身的理智值不会低于15点

en:
On Turn 3: Gains a new pattern and prepares to use a powerful Skill.
After Turn 3 is over: The above effect activates when this unit has 30+ [Breath] Count at Turn End

If this unit did not take any HP damage during the preparation period before using the powerful Skill, greatly enhance the Skill (does not count damages taken by Shield HP)
cn:
第3回合改变自身模式并准备使用强力技能
后续回合中，若回合结束时自身的[Breath]层数不低于30层，则重复触发以上效果

准备使用强力技能时，若自身未受到体力伤害，则大幅强化该技能(不包括护盾体力受到的伤害)

en:
When weakened due to a Choice Event, this Passive replaces 「Adaptation」

Gain 1 [Breath] Potency every time this unit inflicts damage with Attack Skill effects (15 per turn)
- If the target has 15+ [ObservedPerson], gain 1 additional [Breath] Potency with every hit; however, reduce the target's [ObservedPerson] by 3

Gain +1 [Breath] Count every time this unit takes damage from a Sinner's Attack Skill effects (15 per turn)
- If the target has 15+ [ObservedPerson], gain +1 additional [Breath] Count with every hit taken; however, reduce the target's [ObservedPerson] by 3

Critical damage does not increase or decrease
cn:
因选择的事件效果而弱化时，被动“适应”改为以下效果

自身的攻击技能效果造成伤害时，使自身增加1级[Breath]强度(每回合最多15次)
- 若目标的[ObservedPerson]层数不低于15层，则使自身额外增加1级[Breath]强度并使目标的[ObservedPerson]层数减少3层

受到罪人的技能效果造成的伤害时，使自身获得1层[Breath](每回合最多15次)
- 若目标的[ObservedPerson]层数不低于15层，则使自身额外获得1层[Breath]并使目标的[ObservedPerson]层数减少3层

暴击时造成的伤害不会增减

en:
When weakened due to a Choice Event, this Passive replaces 「Defense Mechanism」

Turn Start: Gain Shield equal to 15% of missing HP (Shield HP cannot exceed 5% of the max HP)
- If this unit has [Combustion], lose ([Combustion] Count x 2)% Shield HP
- Shield takes +150% damage from [Burst] effects

Turn End: If the Shield gained due to this effect is destroyed, for the rest of this Encounter, gain 2 [DefenseDown] at Turn Start for every instance the Shield has been destroyed (max 10)
cn:
因选择的事件效果而弱化时，被动“防御机制”改为以下效果

回合开始时，使自身获得自身已失去体力15%的护盾(不超过体力上限的5%)
- 若自身带有[Combustion]，则使自身减少(自身的[Combustion]层数×2)%的护盾
- 护盾受到的[Burst]伤害+150%

回合结束时，若通过本效果获得的护盾被破坏，则根据被破坏次数，按比例在本场战斗回合开始时对自身施加2层[DefenseDown](最多10层)

en: When weakened due to a Choice Event, this Passive replaces 「Confirmation Bias」 Turn Start: Gain 3 [Vulnerable] and lose 15 SP Turn End: Siphon 5 SP from targets with higher SP than this unit (max 3 targets; in descending order of SP; cannot stack on the same target) (Does not activate if Hohenheim is Panicked)
cn: 因选择的事件效果而弱化时，被动“验证偏差”改为以下效果 回合开始时，对自身施加3层[Vulnerable]并使自身失去15点理智值 回合结束时，夺取理智值高于自身的目标的5点理智值(最多3名，按理智值由高到低顺序适用，不会对同一目标重复生效) (霍恩海姆陷入恐慌时不生效)

若自身通过该效果获得拼点威力，则攻击结束后对自身施加1层[Vulnerable]

en:
Turn Start: heal 3% HP
At less than 50% HP, heal 5% additional HP
cn:
回合开始时，使自身恢复体力上限3%的体力
若现存体力低于50%，则使自身额外恢复体力上限5%的体力

en: On Tails Hit, inflict 3 [Sinking]
cn: 反面命中时，使目标增加3级[Sinking]强度

en: Turn End: Lose 5 SP
cn: 回合结束时，使自身失去5点理智值

en: Turn Start: Heal 5% HP.
cn: 回合开始时，使自身恢复体力上限5%的体力

en: Turn Start: Gain 2 [AttackDmgUp] and 2 [Vulnerable]
cn: 回合开始时，使自身获得2层[AttackDmgUp]并对自身施加2层[Vulnerable]

en: At less than 25% HP, heal up to 40% of max HP (1 time max)
cn: 体力低于25%时，使自身体力恢复至体力上限的40%(最多1次)

en:
Turn End: if this unit did not take damage this turn, gain 2 [Agility] next turn
If this unit's Speed is faster than the attack target's, deal +5% damage for every 1 Speed difference (max 50%)
cn:
回合结束时，若自身在本回合未受到伤害，则下回合使自身获得2层[Agility]
若自身的速度值高于攻击目标，则速度值每相差1点，使自身造成的伤害+5%(最多+50%)

en: On Hit with an Unopposed Attack, inflict 1 [NervousImpairment]
cn: 单方面攻击命中时，对目标施加1层[NervousImpairment]

en: Turn Start: heal 3 SP for every surviving ally
cn: 回合开始时，每有1名友方单位存活，使自身恢复3点理智值

en: Inflict +1 more [Sinking] Potency On Hit against targets without [Sinking]
cn: 攻击命中未带有[Sinking]的目标时，令自身增加的[Sinking]强度额外+1级

en: Inflict +2 more [Sinking] Potency On Hit against targets without [Sinking]
cn: 攻击命中未带有[Sinking]的目标时，令自身增加的[Sinking]强度额外+2级

en: When on top of [NetherseaBrandUnit]: gain Clash Power +2 and double the amount of [NervousImpairment] inflicted On Hit
cn: 自身位于[NetherseaBrandUnit]上时，使自身的拼点威力+2，并令自身攻击命中时施加的[NervousImpairment]层数变为2倍

en:
When in [WaitingforCommandMod], does not use Attack Skills until taking damage.

When this unit takes damage while in [WaitingforCommandMod], enter [ParticipationMod] and start using Attack Skills starting next turn
cn:
处于[WaitingforCommandMod]时，直到受到伤害前不会使用攻击技能

若处于[WaitingforCommandMod]时受到伤害，则进入[ParticipationMod]并在下回合起开始使用攻击技能

en:
Turn Start in [ParticipationMod]:
- Inflict 3 [NervousImpairment] to all enemies with less than 15 [NervousImpairment]
- Min & Max Speed +3
Gain 1 [AttackUp] for every 10% missing HP (max 8)

Turn End in [ParticipationMod]: take fixed damage equal to 10% HP
cn:
回合开始时若处于[ParticipationMod]，则
- 对[NervousImpairment]层数低于15层的全体敌方单位施加3层[NervousImpairment]
- 最小与最大速度值+3
- 每失去体力上限10%的体力，使自身获得1层[AttackUp](最多8层)

回合结束时若处于[ParticipationMod]，则受到体力上限10%的固定伤害

en:
When Clashing with the target, or On Hit with an Unopposed attack, inflict 2 [NervousImpairment]
- If this unit is on top of [NetherseaBrandUnit], inflict 1 more [NervousImpairment]
cn:
与目标进行拼点或单方面攻击命中时，对目标施加2层[NervousImpairment]
- 若自身位于[NetherseaBrandUnit]上，则额外施加1层[NervousImpairment]

en: When on top of [NetherseaBrandUnit]: gain Final Power +2 and Coin Power +2, and double the amount of [NervousImpairment] inflicted On Hit
cn: 自身位于[NetherseaBrandUnit]上时，使自身的最终威力+2，硬币威力+2，并令自身攻击命中时施加的[NervousImpairment]层数变为2倍

en: -0.5 to all Affinity Resistances
cn: 所有属性的抗性-0.5

en: On death, generate [NetherseaBrandUnit] in the allied units' territory next turn.
cn: 阵亡时，下回合在友方阵营中生成[NetherseaBrandUnit]

en: When on top of [NetherseaBrandUnit]: gain Final Power +1 and Coin Power +1, and double the amount of [NervousImpairment] inflicted On Hit
cn: 自身位于[NetherseaBrandUnit]上时，使自身的最终威力+1，硬币威力+1，并令自身攻击命中时施加的[NervousImpairment]层数变为2倍

en:
Attack Skills designate the closest enemy as the main target, and select sub-targets from the front


When on top of [NetherseaBrandUnit]...
- Designates the furthest enemy as the target, and converts all coins to [SuperCoin]s
- Gain Final Power +2 and Coin Power +2; double the amount of [NervousImpairment] inflicted On Hit
cn:
攻击技能指定最近的目标为主要目标，并按由前到后指定次要目标


自身位于[NetherseaBrandUnit]上时
- 指定最远的目标，自身所有技能的硬币转化为[SuperCoin]
- 使自身的最终威力+2，硬币威力+2，并令自身攻击命中时施加的[NervousImpairment]层数变为2倍

en:
This unit's Speed is fixed to 1. Spawns in an inactive state in battles that [NetherseaBrandUnit] may appear.

When [NetherseaBrandUnit] appears on the battlefield, this unit becomes active and damageable.
- When this unit's HP drops to 1 from damage, trigger Hand of the Saint and remove all [NetherseaBrandUnit] from the battlefield. When this effect triggers, Hand of the Saint becomes inactive for the next turn.
- This unit takes damage only from Skills mainly targeting this unit, and it takes no other damage.
- When it becomes inactive, it removes all effects from self and heals back to max HP.
cn:
速度值固定为1，以未激活状态布置在可能出现[NetherseaBrandUnit]的战斗中

战场中出现[NetherseaBrandUnit]后，自身激活且可受到伤害
- 受到使自身体力降至1点的伤害后，发射圣徒之手并清洗战场中的所有[NetherseaBrandUnit]。触发该效果时，圣徒之手在下回合变为未激活
- 仅受到以自身为主要目标的技能的伤害，而不会受到其他伤害
- 进入未激活状态时，解除自身的所有状态效果并使自身体力恢复至最大值

en:
When gaining [VibrationDistribution], even if there are no surviving allies, behave as though there is 1 other surviving ally
If this unit gains [VibrationDistribution] while there are no surviving allies, gain 1 [Vulnerable] next turn
cn:
自身获得[VibrationDistribution]时，即使没有存活的友方单位，也视作有1名其他友方单位存活
没有其他友方单位存活时，若自身获得[VibrationDistribution]，则下回合对自身施加1层[Vulnerable]

en: If the target is Staggered by this unit's Attack or [VibrationExplosion], all allies heal 10 SP
cn: 若自身的攻击或[VibrationExplosion]使目标陷入混乱，则使全体友方单位恢复10点理智值

en: Turn Start: If this unit is staggered, gain +3 [TimeRentalTwo] Count.
cn: 回合开始时，若自身陷入混乱，则使自身获得3层[TimeRentalTwo]。

en: At the end of the turn, if the HP is between 16% and 20%, instantly heal up to 60% of Max HP, and recover from stagger. (One time max)
cn: 回合结束时，若现存体力为16%~20%，则立即使自身恢复体力上限60%的体力。解除自身的混乱。(最多1次)

en: After activating Golden Time, gain 2 [Vulnerable] at the next Turn Start
cn: 激活黄金时间后，回合开始时对自身施加2层[Vulnerable]

en: Turn Start: If this unit does not have [TimeRentalTwo], gain +5 Tremor Count
cn: 回合开始时，若自身未带有[TimeRentalTwo]，则对自身施加5层震颤

en: At the end of the turn, if the HP is between 10% and 20%, instantly heal up to 80% of Max HP, and recover from stagger. (One time max)
cn: 回合结束时，若现存体力为10%~20%，则立即使自身恢复体力上限80%的体力。解除自身的混乱。(最多1次)

en: After activating Golden Time, gain 3 [Vulnerable] at the next Turn Start
cn: 激活黄金时间后，回合开始时对自身施加3层[Vulnerable]

en: Encounter Start: Gain +4 [TimeRentalTwo] Count
cn: 关卡开始时，使自身获得4层[TimeRentalTwo]

en: Before hitting, if target does not have [Laceration], inflict +3 [Laceration] Count (once per turn per enemy)
cn: 攻击命中前，若目标未带有[Laceration]，则对其施加3层[Laceration](每回合每名敌方单位最多1次)

en:
On Hit with a Skill, inflict 1 [BearClawWound]

Gain 1 [Enhancement] next turn for every 4 [BearClawWound] inflicted (2 times per turn)
cn:
技能命中敌方单位时，对其施加1层[BearClawWound]

每当自身施加4层[BearClawWound]时，下回合使自身获得1层[Enhancement](每回合最多2次)

en: When this unit or an ally is hit, gain 1 [AttackUp] next turn (once per Skill, 3 times per turn)
cn: 自身或友方单位受到攻击时，下回合使自身获得1层[AttackUp](每个技能最多1次，每回合最多3层)

en: When this unit is killed, inflict 3 [BearClawWound] on 2 random enemies
cn: 阵亡时，随机对2名敌方单位施加3层[BearClawWound]

en: Before hitting, if target does not have [Sinking], inflict +3 [Sinking] Count (once per turn per enemy)
cn: 攻击命中前，若目标未带有[Sinking]，则对其施加3层[Sinking](每回合每名敌方单位最多1次)

en:
On Hit with a Skill, inflict 1 [EagleClawWound]
- If this unit has [Agility], inflict 1 additional [EagleClawWound]

Gain 1 [Agility] next turn for every 4 [EagleClawWound] inflicted (2 times per turn)
cn:
技能命中敌方单位时，对其施加1层[EagleClawWound]
- 若自身带有[Agility]，则额外施加1层[EagleClawWound]

每当自身施加4层[EagleClawWound]时，下回合使自身获得1层[Agility](每回合最多2次)

en: If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, Clash Power +1
cn: 若自身的速度值高于目标，则使自身的拼点威力+1

en: When this unit is killed, inflict 3 [EagleClawWound] on 2 random enemies
cn: 阵亡时，随机对2名敌方单位施加3层[EagleClawWound]

en:
Turn Start:
- Gain [IndexPrescriptEnemy_0]/[IndexPrescriptEnemy_1]/[IndexPrescriptEnemy_2]/[IndexPrescriptEnemy_3] based on [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] Stack on self
- Inflict [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] to a random Sinner (in Focused Encounters, attacks prioritize the Sinner that has [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality])
cn:
回合开始时：
- 根据自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数，使自身获得[IndexPrescriptEnemy_0]/[IndexPrescriptEnemy_1]/[IndexPrescriptEnemy_2]/[IndexPrescriptEnemy_3]
- 随机对1名罪人施加[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]
(若是集中遭遇战，则优先攻击该罪人)

en:
Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base] was executed this turn, heal 5 SP and gain 2 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (once per turn)
- If this unit has [IndexPrescriptEnemy_2], or if target has [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] when this unit is executing [IndexPrescript_Base], heal 10 SP and gain 3 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] instead

Turn End: If [IndexPrescript_Base] was not executed this turn, gain 10 [KarmaOfIndexEnemy]
- At less than 6 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], gain 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]
- At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], does not gain [KarmaOfIndexEnemy]
cn:
若本回合自身执行了[IndexPrescript_Base]，
则回合结束时使自身恢复5点理智值并获得2层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy](每回合最多1次)
- 若自身带有[IndexPrescriptEnemy_2]或执行[IndexPrescript_Base]时目标带有[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]，
则改为恢复10点理智值并获得3层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]

若本回合自身未执行[IndexPrescript_Base]，
则回合结束时对自身施加10层[KarmaOfIndexEnemy]
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]低于6层，则使自身获得1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则不会施加[KarmaOfIndexEnemy]

en:
Deal +2.5% damage against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] for every [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] on self (max 20%)
- At 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], deal +30% damage against all targets instead

On Hit against [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality], gain 1 [Breath] and inflict 1 [Sinking] (once per turn)
- Increases the number of times this effect can trigger per turn by 1 for every 3 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (max 2)
cn:
自身每带有1层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，使自身对[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]造成的伤害+2.5%(最多+20%)
- 若自身的[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]层数为9层，则改为对全体目标造成的伤害+30%

命中带有[IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality]的目标时，
使自身增加1级[Breath]强度并使该敌方单位增加1级[Sinking]强度(每回合最多1次)
- 自身每带有3层[BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy]，使该效果每回合可触发的次数+1(最多+2)

en: Instead of taking more damage due to [Smoke] on self, inflict more damage.
cn: 自身的[Smoke]效果不会使自身受到的伤害增加，而改为造成的伤害增加。

en: When gaining [Smoke], gain 1 additional [Smoke]
cn: 使自身增加[Smoke]强度时，额外增加1级[Smoke]强度

en: The first Coin to connect in an Encounter deals +10% damage
cn: 战斗中首个命中的硬币造成的伤害+10%

en: On Evade Skill Use: Base Power +1
cn: 闪避技能使用时，使其基础威力+1

en: When Staggered, lose all [Smoke] on self
cn: 陷入混乱时，消耗自身所有[Smoke]

en:
If there are other surviving allies, apply 1 [ParryingResultUp] and 2 [AttackDmgUp] to all allies (2 times for each ally)
If ther eare no other surviving allies, gain 8 [Smoke] at Turn Start
cn:
若有除自身以外的友方单位存活，则回合开始时使全体友方单位获得1层[ParryingResultUp]与2层[AttackDmgUp](每名友方单位最多2次)
若没有除自身以外的友方单位存活，则回合开始时使自身增加8级[Smoke]强度

en: If this unit is alive, no enemies are generated at Turn End.
cn: 若自身存活，则回合结束时不会生成敌方单位。

en: On Defensive Skill Use: Defensive Skill Base Power +1
cn: 守备技能使用时，守备技能的基础威力+1

en: When Hit: Gain 1 [LeakedOutSauce] (6 times per Encounter)
cn: 受到攻击时，使自身获得1层[LeakedOutSauce](每场战斗最多6次)

en: Turn Start: Gain 2 [Vulnerable] if this unit has no Marinade
cn: 回合开始时，若自身的酱料全部漏出，则对自身施加2层[Vulnerable]

en:
Turn Start: Heal 15 HP
At less than 50% HP, heal 15 additional HP
cn:
回合开始时，使自身恢复15点体力
若现存体力低于50%，则使自身额外恢复15点体力。

en: At the end of the turn, heal 5 HP.
cn: 回合结束时，恢复5点体力。

en: After defeating an enemy, heal 20 HP, and gain 5 Defense Power Up next turn.
cn: 击杀敌方单位时，恢复20点体力，且下回合使自身获得5层忍耐 。

en:
On hit, inflict 1-2 Bleed.
If a unit is Marked, attack them first.
cn:
攻击命中时，使目标增加1~2级流血 强度。
回合开始时，优先攻击带有标记 的角色。

en: Whenever an ally dies, permanently gain 1 Fragile.
cn: 每当友方单位阵亡时，对自身永久施加1层易损 。

en: When HP drops below 50%, gain 5 Attack Power Up next turn.
cn: 体力不高于50%时，下回合使自身获得5层强壮 。

en: On hit, target loses 10 SP.
cn: 攻击命中时，使目标失去10点理智值。

en: At the start of the turn, if at less than 50% HP, heal 1 HP.
cn: 回合开始时，若现存体力低于50%，则使自身恢复1点体力。

en: At the start of the turn, if at less than 50% HP, heal 2 HP.
cn: 回合开始时，若现存体力低于50%，则使自身恢复2点体力。

en: At the start of the turn, if at less than 50% HP, heal 4 HP.
cn: 回合开始时，若现存体力低于50%，则使自身恢复4点体力。

en: When this unit is defeated, all its allies lose 45 SP.
cn: 本单位阵亡时，使全体友方单位失去45点理智值。

en: This unit loses 15 SP whenever an ally is defeated.
cn: 每当友方单位阵亡时，本角色失去15点理智值。

en:
At the start of the turn, all allies heal 10 SP.
At 20+ SP, gain 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Defense Power Up at turn start.
cn:
回合开始时，使全体友方单位恢复10点理智值。
若自身的理智值不低于20点，则获得1层强壮 和1层忍耐 。

en: When this unit is defeated, all its allies lose 45 SP.
cn: 本单位阵亡时，使全体友方单位失去45点理智值。

en:
At the start of the turn, heal 15 HP.
At less than 50% HP, heal 15 additional HP.
cn:
回合开始时，使自身恢复15点体力。
若现存体力低于50%，则使自身额外恢复15点体力。

en: When an ally is defeated, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
cn: 友方单位阵亡时，下回合开始时使自身获得1层强壮 。

en: After defeating an enemy, gain 2 Damage Up next turn.
cn: 击杀敌方单位后，下回合开始时使自身获得2层伤害强化 。

en:
At the start of the turn, all allies heal 10 SP.
When this unit is defeated, all its allies lose 45 SP.
cn:
回合开始时，若本单位存活，则使全体友方单位恢复10点理智值。
当本单位阵亡时，使全体友方单位失去45点理智值。

en: When HP drops below 50%, remove all negative status effects next turn, and gain 4 Fanatic, 1 Attack Power Up, and 1 Defense Power Up each turn.
cn: 若体力降至50%以下，则下回合开始时解除自身的所有负面状态，并在每回合获得4层狂信 ，1层强壮 与1层忍耐 。

en: If this unit is Fanatic, deal +50% damage.
cn: 自身带有狂信 时，使自身造成的伤害+50%。

en: Sanity is fixed at 0.
cn: 理智值固定为0。

en: Take half as much damage from <sprite name="Laceration"><color=#f8c200><u><link="Laceration">Bleed</color></link></u> and <sprite name="Combustion"><color=#f8c200><u><link="Combustion">Burn</color></link></u>.
cn: 受到的<sprite name="Laceration"><color=#f8c200><u><link="Laceration">流血</color></link></u>及<sprite name="Combustion"><color=#f8c200><u><link="Combustion">烧伤</color></link></u>伤害减半。

en: This unit's stagger threshold rises by 50% more when affected by Tremor Burst
cn: 震颤引爆 对自身造成的混乱阈值前移量 +50%

en: Take +30% damage from <sprite name="Burst"><color=#f8c200><u><link="Burst">Rupture</color></link></u> (Rounded down)
cn: 破裂 效果对自身造成的伤害+30%(向下取整)

en: After being staggered, inflict 1 less Rupture and Rupture Count
cn: 陷入混乱后，此后施加的破裂 强度，破裂 层数减少1

en: After being staggered, inflict 1 less Tremor and Tremor Count
cn: 陷入混乱后，此后施加的震颤 强度，震颤 层数减少1

en: When staggering a unit with an attack, gain 3 Damage Up next turn.
cn: 自身的攻击使目标陷入混乱时，下回合使自身获得3层伤害强化

en: After being staggered, inflict 3 less Rupture and Rupture Count
cn: 陷入混乱后，此后施加的破裂 强度，破裂 层数减少3

en: After being staggered, inflict 3 less Tremor and Tremor Count
cn: 陷入混乱后，此后施加的震颤 强度，震颤 层数减少3

en: Gain Resonant by the number of heads Coins that successfully hit during a turn. (Max 10)
cn: 本回合中，根据正面命中的硬币数，获得相应层数的共振 。(最多10层)

en: Inflict more Tremor by the number of allies that have died this wave
cn: 在本波次中，根据阵亡的友方单位数量使目标额外增加相应震颤 强度

en: When alone, gain 1 Resonant and 1 Tremor Sync every turn.
cn: 单独在场时，每回合获得1层共振 和1层震颤同步 。

en: When alone, marks the last unit that attacked this character as a target next turn.
cn: 单独在场时，将最后攻击自身的目标指定为下回合的攻击目标。

en: Gain Entangled Curse Talismans by the number of clashes the unit engaged in during a turn.
cn: 根据本回合内拼点次数，获得相应层数的纠缠的咒符 。

en: At 10 Entangled Curse Talismans, raise stagger threshold by 10, then remove the status.
cn: 若带有10层纠缠的咒符 ，则消耗所有层数并使自身混乱阈值前移10。

en: At 30% or less HP, inflict +1 Reattached Curse Talisman
cn: 体力不高于30%时，令自身施加的复贴的咒符 层数额外+1层

en: At 30% or less HP, if the target has 5+ Reattached Curse Talisman after an attack is finished, inflict 2 Paralyze next turn.
cn: 体力不高于30%时，自身攻击结束后，若目标的复贴的咒符 层数不低于5层，则下回合对目标施加2层麻痹

en: Tails Coins inflict 2 Sinking
cn: 反面命中时，使目标增加2级沉沦 强度

en: At the end of the turn, lose 5 SP
cn: 回合结束时，自身失去5点理智值

en: At 5 Morale Boost, gain 5 Tipsy.
cn: 当带有5层昂扬 时，使自身获得5层醉意 。

en: At 5 Tipsy, uses a defense skill.
cn: 带有5层醉意 时，使用守备技能。

en: At the start of the turn, heal 20 HP.
cn: 回合开始时，恢复20点体力

en: At less than 25% HP, heal up to 40% of Max HP (One-time only)
cn: 体力低于25%时，使自身体力恢复至体力上限的40%(最多1次)

en: At the end of the turn, if the HP is between 12% and 24%, instantly heal up to 65% of Max HP, and recover from stagger. (One-time only)
cn: 回合结束时，若现存体力为12%~24%，则立即使自身恢复体力上限65%的体力。解除自身的混乱。(最多1次)

en: After activating Golden Time, gain 3 Fragile at turn end.
cn: 触发黄金时间后，回合结束时对自身施加3层易损

en: When an ally attacks another ally, deal 3 SP damage
cn: 友方单位攻击友方单位时，造成3点理智伤害。

en: At the start of the turn, heal 20 HP.
cn: 回合开始时，恢复20点体力

en: At less than 25% HP, heal up to 40% of Max HP (One-time only)
cn: 体力低于25%时，使自身体力恢复至体力上限的40%(最多1次)

en:
HP does not drop below 1;
If at 60- HP at the start of the turn, enter a powered-up state.
cn:
自身的体力不会低于1点。
回合开始时，若现存体力不高于60点，则进入强化状态。

en:
At less than 70% HP, targets another ally with the least current HP.
When attacking an ally, heals HP by the damage dealt.
When defeating an ally, heals HP by double the damage dealt.
cn:
若现存体力低于70%，则指定除自身以外现存体力最低的友方单位
攻击友方单位时，使自身恢复造成伤害量的体力。
击杀友方单位时，使自身恢复造成伤害量2倍的体力。

en: Encounter Start: Gain 1 Molted Shell Shot
cn: 关卡开始时，获得1枚蟹壳废料弹

en:
On Clash Win, gain +1 [Breath] Count
Coin Power +1 for every 5 [Breath] Count (max 3)
cn:
拼点胜利时，使自身获得1层呼吸法 。
每带有5层呼吸法 ，使自身硬币威力+1(最多+3)

en:
Gain +1 [Charge] Count at Attack End
A random ally gains +1 [Charge] Count at Attack End
cn:
攻击结束后，使自身获得1层充能 。
攻击结束后，随机使1名友方单位获得1层充能 。

en:
When attacked, gain +1 Charge Count. (Up to 6 times)
After losing a clash, gain +1 Charge Count. (Up 6 times, counted independently of hits taken)
cn:
受到攻击时，使自身获得1层充能 。(最多生效6次)
拼点失败时，使自身获得1层充能 。(最多生效6次，与受到攻击的情况分开计数)

en:
When an ally is defeated, lose 10 SP and gain 1 Blunt Power Up next turn.
If 4 or more surviving units in the team, including this unit, are 'N Corp. Fanatics', Coin Power +1.
cn:
若友方单位阵亡，则下回合开始时使自身失去10点理智值并获得1层打击威力提升 。
若包括自身在内队伍中属于N公司狂信徒的友方单位不低于4名，则使自身硬币威力+1

en:
The last Coin on the last skill in the chain deals +20% damage.
Whenever an ally other than this unit gains Poise Count, this unit gains +1 Poise Count at a 50% chance.
cn:
使位于连锁末尾的技能的最后一枚硬币对目标造成的伤害+20%
除自身以外的友方单位获得呼吸法 层数时，以50%的概率使自身获得1层呼吸法

en:
Combat Start: Heal 15 SP for 2 allies that have the lowest SP
If the ally is an "N Corp. Fanatic", also apply 2 [AssemblePersonality]
cn:
战斗开始时，使理智值最低的2名友方单位恢复15点理智值。
若该友方单位属于N公司狂信徒，则使其获得2层狂信 。

en:
Combat Start: Heal 15 SP for 1 ally that has the lowest SP
If the ally is an "N Corp. Fanatic", also apply 2 [AssemblePersonality]
cn:
战斗开始时，使理智值最低的1名友方单位恢复15点理智值。
若该友方单位属于N公司狂信徒，则使其获得2层狂信 。

en:
Heal 50% less SP from winning a clash or defeating an enemy.
If 5 or more surviving units, including this unit, are 'N Corp. Fanatics', they deal +10% damage.
cn:
拼点胜利或击杀敌方单位时，自身所恢复的理智值减少50%。
若包括自身在内队伍中属于N公司狂信徒的友方单位不低于5名，则使属于N公司狂信徒的友方单位造成的伤害+10%

en:
Gain (Wrath Reson.) Charge Count next turn.
At 5+ Charge Count, gain 1 Haste and Attack Power Up.
Always Activate: At the start of the stage, gain +3 Ammo.
cn:
下回合开始时，使自身获得(暴怒共鸣数)层充能 。
若自身的充能 层数不低于5层，则使自身获得1层迅捷 和1层强壮 。
常驻效果：关卡开始时，弹药 +3

en:
At the end of the turn, gain +2 Max Speed per 5 Charge Count next turn. (Max 6)
At the start of the turn, if at 5+ Charge Count, gain 3 Aggro to this unit's rightmost slot.
cn:
回合结束时，自身每带有5层充能 ，下回合使自身的最大速度值+2(最多+6)
回合开始时，若自身的充能 层数不低于5层，则自身最右侧的1个行动槽的挑衅值 +3。

en: If this unit fails to deal HP damage using attack skills in a turn, gain a Shield equal to 10% of Max HP next turn. (Max 30)
cn: 攻击技能未能对目标体力造成伤害时，下回合获得数值为自身体力上限10%的护盾(最多获得30点)

en:
At the start of the combat phase, gain (Gloom Reson. / 3) Attack Power Up.
If this unit fails to deal damage this turn, lose 15 SP at the end of the turn.
cn:
战斗开始时，使自身获得(忧郁共鸣数/3)层强壮 。
回合结束时，若本回合自身未造成伤害则失去15点理智值。

en: Upon defeating an enemy, gain +3 Charge Count (3 times per turn)
cn: 击杀敌方单位时，使自身获得3层充能 (每回合最多3次)

en: When an ally with the lowest Max HP defeats an enemy, they gain +3 Charge Count (Once per turn)
cn: 体力上限最低的友方单位击杀敌方单位时，使其获得3层充能 (每回合最多1次)

en: If at 5+ Charge Count at the start of the combat phase, gain 2 Haste. <style="highlight">At 10+ Charge Count, gain 1 additional Haste.</style>
cn: 战斗开始时，若自身的充能 层数不低于5层，则下回合使自身获得2层迅捷 。<style="highlight">若自身的充能 层数不低于10层，则使自身额外获得1层迅捷 。</style>

en: Turn Start: in Deployment Order, inflict [CandyForCharon] against 1 enemy without [CandyForCharon]
cn: 回合开始时，按编队顺序对未带有[CandyForCharon]的1名敌方单位施加[CandyForCharon]

en:
Encounter Start: Vergilius gains a certain amount of Shield that lasts for the duration of the Encounter
Turn ends when the Shield is broken
cn:
关卡开始时，维吉里乌斯获得一定量的持续整个关卡的护盾
护盾被破坏时，该回合结束

en:
When the Shield is depleted, gains a new pattern
- Fix Speed to 20
- No longer takes any HP damage
cn:
护盾被消耗后，改变自身模式
- 速度值固定为20
- 不再受到体力伤害
