en: [REFRACTION RATE: 3%] Not long after first embarking, the vehicle seems to have pulled in. Although this doesn’t feel familiar yet, things should change after a fight or three.
cn: [折射率：3%] 驶入镜中后没多久， 列车似乎便已停了下来。 虽然感觉上还有些陌生， 但经历几场战斗之后，应该会再次习惯起来吧。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 8%] They are things that we’ve met at one point. This may be another such encounter. Or, they might be beings that we will meet at some point.
cn: [折射率：8%] 那些都是我们曾经遇到过的存在。 说不定这次也是某一刻遇到过的存在。 又或者，是未来的某天我们将会接触到的存在。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 13%] A sorrowful and gloomy cry is heard. As tempting as it is to stick around and hear its cry, we can’t stay for too long. To reach the next station, there’s no choice but to face it.
cn: [折射率：13%] 传来了悲伤的哭声。 虽然想静静地聆听下去， 但我们不能停留太久。 为了前往下一站，我们必须面对它。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 19%] Those are the ones that relentlessly chased us once before. Seeing them confront us yet again… Why, it could almost make me sick.
cn: [折射率：19%] 那些人曾没完没了地追逐着我们。 看到他们再次站在我们面前， 我甚至想要干呕。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 23%] Roaring thunder shakes the air. Occasionally, the darkness is pierced by a purple bolt of lightning. The sound grows closer. The lights glow brighter. It becomes clear what awaits us.
cn: [折射率：23%] 四面八方都回荡着咆哮的雷声。 深邃的黑暗时不时被紫色的落雷所刺穿。 声音越来越接近， 光线越来越明亮。 我似乎知道了等待着我们的为何物。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 34%] It seems the thunderous hums still linger. No, that’s incorrect. The sound is similar but not quite the same. The scent of rust stains and burnt meat brushed past us.
cn: [折射率：34%] 雷鸣之声似乎仍在耳边萦绕。 不，并非如此。 这是虽然听上去相似，实则不同的声音。 锈水流淌的气味与烤焦的肉的香气，飘过我们的身边。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 42%] Many reflections and refractions were suffered. Vertigo induces the urge to tear my head off. Managing to hold in the impossible impulse to vomit, a being came into sight that made me glad that my urge stopped as a mere thought.
cn: [折射率：42%] 遭受了众多反射与折射后。 强烈的眩晕感让我产生了想把脑袋扯下来的冲动。 强忍住不应存在的呕吐感并在目的地起身时， 眼前所见之物， 让我庆幸我的冲动仅仅只停留在念头。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 51%] Those corporate drones weren’t the only beasts known for regeneration. Looking back… there was also a being that took from what it fought. It would mimic them as its own. A being that covered its existence in what belonged to others.
cn: [折射率：51%] 不论怎么斩开都会反复弥合的存在并不唯一。 回想起来……还有一些会在战斗中夺去一切， 并将其化为己有的存在。 这是一种借他人之物来掩盖自身存在的东西。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 59%] The logo of a corporation that once cornered us can be seen. Those who would heal their scrapes the instant they were inflicted… This will require some determination.
cn: [折射率：59%] 见到了那个曾让我们一时心惊胆战的公司的标志。 不论怎么斩开都会弥合…… 我们必须振奋起精神才行。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 71%] The slithering tongue is split into two. Unsure of which direction to point, it nervously extends and retracts. Both we and it are in peril. One wrong choice could mean being reflected off this plane.
cn: [折射率：71%] 蠕动的舌头分叉为两半。 仿佛是不知道该指向哪个方向， 紧张地伸出又缩回。 不论是它，还是我们。 显然，如果不慎做出错误的选择，我们就会这样被弹出去。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 84%] Those are beings that we saw several stations ago. Why they are together in one place is a complete mystery. Perhaps they were cast into the same location when they were refracted. Or, they might have joined together as naturally as water conducts electricity.
cn: [折射率：84%] 这些是我们在几站前见过的存在。 它们为何会这样聚在一起， 完全是个谜团。 或许它们在经历折射时被投射到了同一个空间。 又或者，可能是像水导电那样，自然而然的合流到了一起。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 92%] It stood there, taking the form it believed to be purest. One Sinner exclaimed that this couldn’t be possible, but in a world as warped and twisted as this, such a statement wouldn’t travel far. The only exchange allowed was that of blows—dealt with weapons and arms.
cn: [折射率：92%] 它就这样，以它所认为的最纯粹的形态站在那里。 一位罪人惊呼，“这怎么可能！”， 然而在这发言都会被弹出的严重扭曲的世界中， 那句话无法前进，也无法被传达到。 我们之间唯一被允许的交流……就是兵刃相接。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 99%] This is the limit. Even a short rest feels like it might eject us back to whence we came. A single moment’s carelessness can bring all our effort to naught. If we make it through this, we will be able to reach the terminus. Let’s empty our minds and proceed—as if nothing were ever there.
cn: [折射率：99%] 已经是极限了。这是哪怕暂时停车 也几乎要被弹回原来的空间的情况。 哪怕是一时的松懈，都会使一切化为泡影。 如果我们能突破这一关，就能抵达终点站。 仿若那里空无一物般。放空思绪，继续前进吧。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 0%] Here we go again. Memories of painful battles we've endured, the odd feeling of refraction pierces through my body. I wonder if we can adapt once more.
cn: [折射率：0%] 又一次来到了此处。 回想起过往的艰苦战斗， 全身都再次感受到了被折射的奇妙感觉。 我们这次也能适应这感觉吗？

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 14%] It was working ceaselessly. The machine has never stopped working since its pressurized, scalding hot steam turned its first gears. We must break the cycle in which it has long been trapped to continue on our path.
cn: [折射率：14%] 他还在继续工作。 从充满内部的炽热蒸汽驱动钢铁之时开始， 便一直如此。 为了通过此处， 我们必须斩断这漫长的循环。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 21%] The fox cries, sometimes. We know not if it cries for sorrow or rain. We know, however, that the umbrellas piercing its body are not there for the rain. For the fox has not once opened them for itself.
cn: [折射率：21%] 狐狸会偶尔哭泣。 那哭泣不知是由于悲伤，还是单纯唤雨的咒语。 但我们明白插在它身上的那些雨伞 不是用于挡雨的。 因为狐狸从来没有为了自己撑开那些伞。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 37%] You know what they say: time is money. I've once heard the tale of a miser who amasses a hoard of gold deep within his basement. Amassing time as one does gold is not so different, perhaps. ... Their clocks are giving me a headache for some reason.
cn: [折射率37%] 我好像听过“时间就是金钱”这么一句话。 我好像也听过一个吝啬鬼在地下深处的金库里囤积黄金的故事。 所以说不定把时间像金钱一样存起来或夺走是理所当然的呢。 ……我不明白为什么看着它们的钟表会莫名其妙地头痛。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 49%] The refraction rate rises steeply in this train. Every single Station feels like a mountain to climb. I think we can take a short rest by the stocky tree stump and the forest with the blue lights... The teal-colored light atop the branch dances from side to side, beckoning us...
cn: [折射率：49%] 列车的折射率在急剧增加。 每个站点的攻克也变得更为吃力。 那有着粗壮的大树并散发着绿光的森林看起来是不错的休息区…… 而坐落在树枝上的青绿色的光芒摇曳着，仿佛是在叫我们过去一般……

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 63%] We must sometimes become selfish things, full of animosity if it means our survival. Sometimes, we make others suffer so that we may not. For a moment, I hesitate before the two buttons in front of the Station. Am I doing the right thing...?
cn: [折射率：63%] 某些时候，我们为了生存下去，必须变得排他和自私。 只因自己不想痛苦， 便将痛苦施加于他人。 突然间，我在车站的两个按钮面前停下了脚步。 我这样做是对的吗……？

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 86%] 'Come here, come all! Take a swig!' I can smell the unpleasant stench of alcohol even before the Train door opens. 'Hurry along, all! A big swill, and you'll feel swell!' ... It doesn't even look remotely look potable. One of the Sinners begins to retch violently. Guess I'm not alone in thinking that.
cn: [折射率：86%] “喝一杯吧！” 列车门还没打开，就早早地飘来了令人不快的酒味。 “快点~噗哈！果然还是精灵酒最好啊！” ……无论从哪里看，都看不到能喝的东西。 看到一位罪人开始痉挛呕吐的样子，我明白了并不是只有我一个人这么想。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 96%] The train awaits our choice. The refraction rate is at its limits. Breach past it, or... Ricochet off and start a new Cycle? Whichever it is, we must choose carefully. We want to avoid falling off into a wayward path like that... thing outside the Station.
cn: [折射率：96%] 列车正在等待抉择。 是要突破达到极限的折射率，还是…… 要被弹出去并再一次进入这个循环。 不论是哪边，都需要做出明智的选择。 毕竟我们不能像站外的那些存在一样……迷失方向。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 37%] You know what they say: time is money. I've once heard the tale of a miser who amasses a hoard of gold deep within his basement. Amassing time as one does gold is not so different, perhaps. ... Their clocks are giving me a headache for some reason.
cn: [折射率37%] 我好像听过“时间就是金钱”这么一句话。 我好像也听过一个吝啬鬼在地下深处的金库里囤积黄金的故事。 所以说不定把时间像金钱一样存起来或夺走是理所当然的呢。 ……我不明白为什么看着它们的钟表会莫名其妙地头痛。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: 86%] 'Come here, come all! Take a swig!' I can smell the unpleasant stench of alcohol even before the Train door opens. 'Hurry along, all! A big swill, and you'll feel swell!' ... It doesn't even look remotely potable. One of the Sinners begins to retch. Guess I'm not alone there.
cn: [折射率：86%] “来一杯吧！” 列车的门尚未开启，便已经有令人不悦的酒臭味飘了进来。 “赶紧~哈！没有比精灵酒更给力的了。” ……那看起来根本不像是能喝的东西。 我们的一名罪人开始干呕，看来不止我一个人这么想。

en: [REFRACTION RATE: ∞%] The true Terminus. This is an adequate place to get off this train without getting lost. The refraction rate is already off the charts. For the first time since we embarked on this journey... I see a signpost. Maybe, this is where this railway line ends. Or maybe… this is where we meet our ends.
cn: [折射率：∞%] 这里是真正的终点站。 这是能避免迷失于此，并在这列车上正确下车的合适的场所。 折射率已经无法测量。 这是我们乘坐这趟列车以来，第一次…… 见到告示牌。 它是在说这里便是终点么？ 还是说……我们会在这里迎来终焉。

en: [Refraction Rate: 0%] I can hear the metal cogwheels turning and creaking. Something heavy and massive seems to be taking a step with every teeth that click into each other.
cn: [折射率：0%] 听到了齿轮嘎吱嘎吱转动和啮合的声音。 似乎有什么沉闷且笨重的东西，正随着这声音一步步往某处走去。

en: [Refraction Rate: 14%] An opaque, shimmering wave crashes unto us. Perhaps its countless emotions, all of it lodged into its back, is reminiscent of that shimmering. Silently yet ponderously, it crashes unto us.
cn: [折射率：14%] 密不透光的浊流向我们袭击而来。 浸透脊背的那份感情也正如这闪烁的波浪一般。 无声却沉重，向我们袭击而来。

en: [Refraction Rate: 28%] A nostalgic sight appears before us. The scene seems to beckon us—perhaps it brings out in us a faint remembrance of the past. Some Sinners appear rather distraught… This time, we’ll have to approach it with our weapons drawn.
cn: [折射率：28%] 令人怀念的场景展现于眼前。 如同在招手般摇曳的风景，仿佛唤起了心中的朦胧情感。 但有几名罪人的表情非常难看…… 接近的时候，还是拿着武器比较好。

en: [Refraction Rate: ??%] A heavy noise echoes once. The teeth on the cogwheel click into one another—tick, tock, then it comes to a stop with a heavy grating noise. The cogs will begin to turn again as soon as we exit this place. Let’s prepare ourselves before moving to the next stop.
cn: [折射率：??%] 一阵沉重的响声不断回响。 滴答、滴答运转的齿轮伴着吱呀一声缓缓停止。 离开这个空间后，齿轮将会再度运转吧。 去往下一站前，需要做好充分准备。

en: [Refraction Rate: 39%] We’ve gone through this salty scent of the sea before. The one who painfully bears the multitude of filth, salt, and other similar things within it awaits us there.
cn: [折射率：39%] 曾经闻到过的潮湿气息飘荡着。 那气味里，等待我们的是寄宿着难以计数的污秽和盐分，以及与其类似事物的东西。

en: [Refraction Rate: 51%] An odd, miasmatic scent of a burning candle fills this place. In it is the one who seeks the truth. Its massive eyes roll about to capture every little detail and knowledge. It would be best that we stop it from consuming more knowledge before the flames of truth begin burning.
cn: [折射率：51%] 蜡烛燃烧的奇妙气味遍布整个空间。 在那空间里的是探究真理之人。它仿佛不愿放过任何文字，汲取一切知识一般，巨大的眼睛炯然有神。 在真理的火焰燃烧前阻止它汲取知识比较好吧。

en: [Refraction Rate: 66%] The heat from the flaming sunset can be felt all the way from here. A mere brush against its flames will burn everything to ashes, but its fiery embrace may be a warmth that cannot be found anywhere else. The potential, born again from the flames, gently beckons us.
cn: [折射率：66%] 包裹着夕阳色彩的烟雾已经蔓延至此了。 即使炽热到似乎稍稍触碰就会被烧却，但被那火焰怀抱时或许能体会到只此一次的温暖。 浴火重生的可能性，正在缓缓引诱我们。

en: [Refraction Rate: ??%] A heavy noise echoes once. The teeth on the cogwheel click into one another—tick, tock, then it comes to a stop with a heavy grating noise. The cogs will begin to turn again as soon as we exit this place. Let’s prepare ourselves before moving to the next stop.
cn: [折射率：??%] 一阵沉重的响声不断回响。 滴答、滴答运转的齿轮伴着吱呀一声缓缓停止。 离开这个空间后，齿轮将会再度运转吧。 去往下一站前，需要做好充分准备。

en: [Refraction Rate: 14%] They crawl down and appear before us, those whose hearts were painted over. They are pallid, whiter than white. What were their colors before something painted over them and turned them into empty canvases?
cn: [折射率：75%] 那些内心被覆盖的人接近过来。 那些带着胜过纯白之白的、苍白色的人。 宛如洁净的画纸的那些人，会染上何种颜色。

en: [Refraction Rate: 83%] If there are those whose hearts are painted, then there is one who paints hearts. When the train comes to a stop, I can see from a distance a confident figure. She is flanked by her followers. She stands as though to greet us, to paint over our hearts as well. Then we will meet her with our weapons drawn.
cn: [折射率：83%] 有心被覆盖的人，自然也有覆盖其心的人。 列车尚未停止，便能远远看见被追随者簇拥的那人意气风发的身姿。 好似迎接我们一样，好似要将我们的心一同覆盖一样。 我们也拿好武器迎接他们吧。

en: [Refraction Rate: 89%] I thought we had defeated her in the previous Station, but… The one who paints hearts had only grown even more hideous. She is no longer flanked by her followers, yet… it feels as though they are now within her. We mustn’t let ourselves be distracted by the flickering, dancing flames on her weapon arm. Focus on her instead.
cn: [折射率：89%] 我们应该在前一站击败她了。 但那覆盖他人内心的人，以更加丑陋的姿态再度出现了。 追随者已经不见踪影……但能隐约感觉到追随者们就在那人体内。 不能被她手臂上闪烁着的微弱火光吸引。 必须集中在她身上。

en: [Refraction Rate: ??%] A heavy noise echoes once. The teeth on the cogwheel click into one another—tick, tock, then it comes to a stop with a heavy grating noise. The cogs will begin to turn again as soon as we exit this place. Let’s prepare ourselves before moving to the next stop.
cn: [折射率：??%] 一阵沉重的响声不断回响。 滴答、滴答运转的齿轮伴着吱呀一声缓缓停止。 离开这个空间后，齿轮将会再度运转吧。 去往下一站前，需要做好充分准备。

en: [Refraction Rate: 99%] We emerge from the long tunnel and arrive at the Terminus; there lies the land of gold. I can hear an odd, metallic noise echoing from the distance. It’s not the kind of metallic noise that makes one shudder, but the sound digs deep under our skin. We have to finish this fight before this twisted and formless sensation scrambles our brains.
cn: [折射率：99%] 通过漫长的地下隧道，终于抵达的终点站，是一片黄金乡。 远方传来奇异的金属声。 虽然并不难听……但那声音像是穿透到了深处。 必须在重重扭曲的无形感觉彻底扰乱大脑前做出了结。

en: We sail on, the incident with the green lights finally behind us. Faust approaches the helm as though she noticed something.
cn: 在绿色灯光的骚乱告一段落后，巴士船继续航行。浮士德好像发现了什么似的，朝着船舵的方向走去。

en: The engine came to a sputtering halt as Outis's seafaring lecture reached its climax. But we still have so much to go...
cn: 就在奥提斯关于航海的讲座达到高潮的时候，引擎停了。但我们还有很长一段路要走……

en:
Our busboat with a dead engine was still sailing, with every Sinner's hearts and bodies... well, not exactly every Sinner, but most Sinner's hearts and bodies working as one. Oh, and we learned a very valuable lesson about surviving in the Great Lake: that breaking its laws can have catastrophic results.
... And that's when we noticed that our busboat was getting dragged by something off course.
cn: 配合着奥提斯的命令，罪人们齐心协力……虽然实际上并不是这样，但在罪人们的团结努力下，熄火的巴士船仍在继续航行。在这种情况下，为了在这片湖中生存下来，必须知道这个事实：如果违反规则就会变成海里的海藻渣……然后，我们注意到巴士船被什么东西拽住了，偏离了航线。

en: After numerous trials and tribulations, we finally arrived at our destination. Looks like this place is called Marlin Portship of U Corp., a giant seafaring vessel made by merging together countless shipping containers.
cn: 几经险阻，劈波斩浪，我们终于抵达了目的地。那似乎是U公司的马林鱼港船，一艘由无数集装箱堆砌而成的巨轮。

en: In place of the LCCB Agent we were supposed to meet was a posse of kidnappers who demanded ransom from us. As we were discussing our plan of action, Ishmael suddenly decided to act. I could see from her eyes... that there was a mix of numerous, complex feelings. Now, we have no choice but to take these kidnappers out, even if we are yet to learn if the LCCB Agent is alive or not.
cn: 本应和我们接触的LCCB队员们并不在，取而代之的是一伙性格恶劣的绑匪在欢迎我们。在我们讨论如何应对这些索要赎金的人时……以实玛利仿佛毫不在意般地突然开始了行动。以实玛利的眼中充斥着各种各样的感情，似乎彷徨不定。即便在尚未确定LCCB队员们是否存活的情况下，我们依然必须先击退这些绑匪。

en: Maybe not everyone felt a sense of unity, a sense of belonging from this group. We headed to the boss's location that Ishmael threatened out of the kidnappers.
cn: 似乎并非所有人都在团结一致地作战。我们向着以实玛利威胁绑匪而得来的老大位置前进。

en: Following the kidnapper's directions, we found ourselves at the entrance of a club blaring with music. I wanted to do this quietly... But we broke into a fight pretty much immediately as we tried to talk to the bouncers. We had to find different ways to convince them to let us in.
cn: 绑匪老大的所在地，是一个传出嘈杂音乐的会所。我本来想安静地潜入……但我们在会所入口的时候便被卷入了战斗，好不容易才击退了门卫。

en: Following the kidnapper's directions, we found ourselves at the entrance of a club blaring with music. I wanted to do this quietly... But we broke into a fight pretty much immediately as we tried to talk to the bouncers. We had to find different ways to convince them to let us in.
cn: 绑匪老大的所在地，是一个传出嘈杂音乐的会所。我本来想安静地潜入……但我们在会所入口的时候便被卷入了战斗，好不容易才击退了门卫。

en: We trashed the club and defeated members of the Syndicate that the kidnappers were part of. Hopefully we can learn their boss's location soon...
cn: 我们在会所里四处走动，干掉了绑匪所属的帮派成员。很快就能找到他们老大所在的房间了……

en: We learned where the boss's room was, all thanks to Sinclair. She introduced herself as the first mate of the Twinhook Pirates...
cn: 多亏了辛克莱，我们找到了老大所在的房间。她自称为双钩海盗团的大副……

en: Smee, first mate of the Twinhook Pirates, told us where they were keeping the captured LCCB Team Leader. Ishmael wanted to leave no loose threads behind... But I stopped her, even if it meant putting myself in danger. I have no logical explanation for what I did, nor could I convince Ishmael... But I don't regret what I did.
cn: 双钩海盗团的大副，斯米，告诉了我们被绑架的LCCB队长的关押位置。虽然以实玛利希望不留后患……但我拼命阻止了她。虽然我没能从逻辑上解释清楚，也没能说服以实玛利，但我并不后悔。

en: Smee, first mate of the Twinhook Pirates, told us where they were keeping the captured LCCB Team Leader. When we got there, we found a whole mountain of shipping containers.
cn: 大副斯米告诉了我们被绑架的LCCB队长的关押位置。在那里能看到堆积如山的集装箱。

en: When we opened the shipping container Smee singled out, an unexpectedly tearful and youthful face of an LCCB Agent greeted us. I'm glad that he looks mostly unharmed, but... Is he really the Team Leader?
cn: 打开了名为斯米的人所说的集装箱，我们看到了一个泪流满面的年幼LCCB队员。虽然我很高兴看到他没受什么伤害，但他真的是队长吗……？

en: We met an LCCB survivor who called himself Pilot. He shared a very good news with us—that Saude was alive! It's time to listen to what he's got to say.
cn: 我们遇见了一位自称皮利托的LCCB幸存者队员。另外，他还告诉了我们索德还活着这令人高兴的事实。现在该听听他准备说什么了。

en: Pilot handed us the variable coordinates to the Lobotomy Corp. Branch where the Golden Bough was last seen. Pilot, who so far has been trying to appear nonchalant, broke into tears. I really wanted to believe that there are survivors at the upcoming Lobotomy Corp. Branch.
cn: 皮利托将最后一次目击到金枝的脑叶公司支部的变动坐标交给了我们。一直假装若无其事说着话的皮利托最终还是流下了眼泪。我十分希望接下来要去的脑叶公司支部里仍然有幸存者。

en: We have to make our way to the Lobotomy Corp. Branch based on the variable coordinates that Pilot gave us. Meanwhile, Ishmael keeps nervously checking the telescope.
cn: 基于皮利托交给我们的变动坐标，我们必须前往湖中某处的脑叶公司支部。与此同时，以实玛利一直在焦虑地看着望远镜。

en: The Twinhook Pirates were tailing us. I decided to follow Ishmael's advice and board their ship first before they did ours.
cn: 双钩海盗团正在追着我们。我决定根据以实玛利的提议，赶在他们之前抢先登陆他们的船。

en: We defeated the Pirates, but... I can't shake this uneasy feeling. Well, no choice but to continue our voyage while minding the laws of the Great Lake.
cn: 我们击退了海盗们，但还是难以摆脱不快的感觉。只能牢记着湖上的规则继续航行……

en: Outis suggested that we break the laws of the Great Lake and sail headfirst into the Waves. The sky immediately darkens, and the unknown Waves begin crashing into us.
cn: 奥提斯提议为了缩短时间而打破规则去抗击浪潮。天气很快变得阴沉，未知的波涛正朝我们汹涌而来。

en:
We finally made it out of the Waves and into calmer seas.
I briefly wondered if we can finally start smooth-sailing toward the coordinates...
... and that's when I noticed a stationary cruise ship floating in the middle of a Lake.
cn:
冲破浪潮后，稍显平静的航行开始了。
现在可以朝着坐标航行了吧，这样的念头一闪而过。
一艘独自耸立在大湖中心的游轮映入眼帘。

en: We boarded the cruise ship to gather some intel. Though it's littered with gaudy decorations, I don't see anyone on board... Something about this whole affair is creeping me out.
cn: 我们想了解情况，便登上游轮。游轮上到处是花里胡哨的精美装饰，但一个人影也没瞧见，毛骨悚然的恶寒涌上我的脊梁。

en:
I ran into the cabins of the ship in search of Sinclair, who fled from Hong Lu's scary tales. Thankfully, I was able to find him without much trouble.
But...
cn:
我跑进船舱寻找被恐怖故事吓跑的辛克莱，没花多大功夫便找到了他。
然而……

en:
The Cruise was an aftermath of a devastation. The consequences of breaking the laws of the Great Lake were severe.
... I'll have to be more careful from now on.
cn:
这游轮是灾难的牺牲品。无视大湖规则的惩罚竟如此严重。
……小心驶得万年船，也许下次我应当作出更明智的决断。

en: The elusive Lobotomy Corp. Branch of U Corp. finally appeared from beyond the veil of mist. But... it was completely covered under a layer of bizarre, white membrane. I think we're on the correct path, at least...
cn: 雾气彼岸，隐约可见的，是寻觅已久的U公司脑叶支部。只是那建筑通体覆盖在一层诡异的白色黏膜之下，令人不禁怀疑其真实性……我忖度着，起码我们没走错路。

en:
The bizarreness continued deep into the Lobotomy Corp. Branch. That white, pallid membrane was covering every inch of its interiors.
And... we found those that were shambling around, wrapped under that very same membrane.
cn:
不光是外表，这陌生的怪异现象一直延伸到脑叶公司支部的深处。苍白黏膜覆盖着内部每一寸空间。
而且……还有些浑身沾满黏膜的人摇晃着走来走去。

en: We followed the mysterious butterfly deeper into the Lobotomy Corp. Branch. A man with a flowing head was waiting for us in there.
cn: 跟着散发神秘气息的蝴蝶，我们进入了脑叶公司支部深处，有个头上碧波荡漾的人正等待着我们。

en:
Rim disappeared from our sights like a butterfly leaving its brief respite upon the water surface. It was as though we had all awakened from a dream. From him we saw that familiar red mark. 
... The Mermaids are coming back.
cn: 林好似飞过水面驻足片刻的蝴蝶，消失在视野中。我们如梦方醒，那熟悉的红色图案又一次浮现出来。……那人鱼又冲了上来。

en:
Rim was right. We could not find even a hint of the Golden Bough from within the Lobotomy Corp. Branch.
... We'll have to search for the Whale like he said, then.
cn:
那个叫林的人说得没错，我们在支部根本找不到一点儿金枝的踪迹。
……正如他所言，我们得去寻找鲸了。

en: We were waiting by the entrance when a sudden shock shook the Lobotomy Corp. Branch. We hurried out and gazed into the mists... and saw several intimidating-looking vessels emerge.
cn: 在等待与维吉里乌斯会面时，支部突然发生了震动，我们急忙跑到外边，朝雾的方向凝视……一艘令人望而生畏的船只出现了。

en: We were making relatively short work of the ambushing pirates, but I had a feeling that they were just gauging our capabilities... Now that I mention it, the largest and gaudiest vessel from their fleet has yet to hook us.
cn: 在我们与伏击的海盗周旋时，我突然意识到这只不过是战斗的前奏而已。仔细想想，他们那最大、最华丽的舰船至今仍未“钩”住我们。

en:
This is nothing short of a massacre. A humiliation. He kills Ishmael again and again. I keep bringing her back, feeling that very same pain that killed her.
... This battle is lost. Maybe Faust is right... Maybe this is where our journey ends.
cn:
这无异于一场蹂躏与欺瞒，玩弄人于股掌之间。以实玛利一次又一次死去，而后我让她复活，我也同样重温着死亡带给她的痛苦。
……胜利遥遥无期。也许真如浮士德所言……旅途将在此休止。

en: Blue embers flickered from the old man's cigar. We didn't need anyone to tell us that he was overwhelmingly powerful; we knew instinctively. Faust, who seemed to recognize the old man, led him to Vergilius after a quick exchange of pleasantries.
cn: 老人嘴里叼的香烟闪烁着蓝色的火光，高深莫测的实力，已无需多言。似乎是认出了他，几句简短的寒暄之后，浮士德把他带到了维吉里乌斯面前。

en: We rowed toward the gray Lake as we previously discussed with the Indigo Elder. We can see some rocks poking out of the pale, opaque waters of the Lake. Looks like we'll have to maneuver our way between them.
cn: 和当初跟靛蓝老人商量的好一样，我们划着桨向灰色的湖面驶去。浑浊湖水荡漾其上，远处隐约可见白色的礁石，看来我们得想办法避开并绕过那些礁石。

en:
What we thought to be a rock was a Porous Whale. When its Mermaids crawled out of the holes, we defeated them. But... This isn't the Whale we're looking for, is it? What is Ishmael thinking?
I could tell from the look on Heathcliff's face that I wasn't the only one wondering about this.
cn:
我们杀死了那些从被我们当成岩石的孔穴鲸身上爬出的人鱼。但是……那并不是我们要找的鲸，以实玛利为什么要这么做？
从希斯克利夫脸上的表情来看，好奇的并不止我一个。

en:
We waded past the ocean mist and entered the obsidian Lake.
The Lake of legends, as told by Ishmael. Within it...
... Was the Pallid Whale, pale as the midnight moon.
cn:
我们涉过海雾，进入了漆黑的湖。
以实玛利所说的，传说之湖。处于那片湖中的……
是苍白到令人胆寒的白鲸。

en:
We waded past the ocean mist and entered the obsidian Lake.
The Lake of legends, as told by Ishmael. Within it...
... Was the Pallid Whale, pale as the midnight moon.
cn:
我们涉过海雾，进入了漆黑的湖。
以实玛利所说的，传说之湖。处于那片湖中的……
是苍白到令人胆寒的白鲸。

en: In a black, dusky forest, I lost the way.
cn: 在一片幽暗的森林中，我迷失了方向。

en: When I awoke, I was on a peculiar bus. The man who introduced himself as “Vergilius” showed me to the twelve Sinners I’ll be overseeing as their new manager…
cn: 我在一辆奇怪的巴士上醒来。一个自称“维吉里乌斯”的人向我介绍了12名罪人，并表示我会成为他们的新经理……

en: I’m starting to get used to fighting alongside these Sinners. Though, whether they’re used to my presence is another story…
cn: 我多少有些习惯与这些罪人一起战斗了。只不过，他们是否习惯与我共事，就是另一回事了……

en: Various possibilities emerged from the Mirror. Faust says it’s my job to take care of them. Just who was I in the past, and how did I get myself roped into this…?
cn: 镜中映射出了许多可能性。浮士德告诉我，管理这些可能性就是我的工作。过去的我到底干了什么才会被安排做这种事……

en: The ride is awkward and intimidating. Even though I’ve been handed the title of ‘Manager’, I have no idea what to do at a time like this. I decided to ask the Sinner with a bug’s arm where we’re currently headed.
cn: 巴士内弥漫着尴尬又严峻的氛围。尽管我得到了“经理”的职位，却并不清楚现在该采取何种行动。于是我下定决心向对面那位有着昆虫手臂的罪人询问巴士的目的地。

en: After being “asked” a favor I couldn’t turn down, I was forced to bear a series of pains worse than death rewinding the clock. The bus fell quiet in a less-than-pleasant way, and I kept my mouth shut. Let’s hope nothing else happens until we reach District 4…
cn: 我听从了倒转时钟这一威胁似的请求，经历了无数次比死亡还恐怖的痛苦。巴士内部在不愉快的氛围中陷入寂静，我也打算沉默不语。真希望能就这样安安静静地到达4区……

en: A band of thugs attacks us, trying to take the bus. For some reason, we leave them barely breathing instead of killing them outright, placing them in front of Mephistopheles…
cn: 一帮后巷的地痞流氓袭击了我们，他们是冲着巴士来的。但是不知为何，我们并没有直接杀死他们，而是给他们留了一口气，并把他们拖到了梅菲斯托费勒斯的前方……

en: We watched Mephistopheles as it consumed the corpses, its maw looking more reliable than the Sinners. I knew something was up from the moment I saw this bus for the first time, but what is this thing exactly? Faust seems to have something to say.
cn: 欣赏了一番处理尸体比罪人们还可靠的梅菲斯托费勒斯。虽然我第一次见到这辆巴士的时候就觉得它不同寻常，但它到底是什么？浮士德哆嗦着嘴唇，看上去是有话要说。

en: When the bus had just about finished its “meal”, Vergilius shouted to me that we’re expecting a guest. I’m curious to see who’d be joining us on this less-than-pleasant trip.
cn: 正当巴士的“用餐”将要告一段落时，维吉里乌斯大声说道马上就会有客人来访。我好奇谁将会和我们一同踏上这场不尽人意的旅程。

en: Our guest was a Fixer named Yuri, a former employee of Lobotomy Corporation. Seeing as she showed an indifferent response to the bus devouring bodies, she must’ve gone through a lot herself. But then she grows nervous as she checks the map and looks at the driver’s seat…
cn: 来访的客人是曾在脑叶公司任职的、名叫尤莉的收尾人。她似乎对于巴士吞食尸体的场面司空见惯，看这样子她一定吃过不少苦。而这位尤莉小姐看了看地图后，突然有些不安地望向了驾驶席……

en: I was shocked to learn that… Charon has virtually no sense of direction. Though, I guess it’s fortunate that it’s come to light this early into the trip. Yuri took matters into her own hands and started teaching her how to read a map, and Sinclair joined, too. They’re rather noisy, but still… I can’t say that I hate to see it.
cn: 虽说现在才发现这件事也算得上是走运……卡戎是路痴这一冲击性的事实摆在了面前。尤莉再也坐不住了，挽起袖管说要去教卡戎怎么看地图，看不下去的辛克莱也自然地加入了其中。虽然有些吵闹……但是我觉得这样的场景也值得一看。

en: Rodya looks out through the window at the Backstreets before flinching abruptly. Her eyes fell on a group of people with the heads of bugs. Then, Gregor’s expression shifted as well. It was not out of flinching disgust like Rodya, though.
cn: 正透过巴士车窗观看后巷风景的罗佳突然浑身一颤。顺着她的视线看去，那里聚集着一群有着虫子脑袋的人。随后格里高尔的表情也瞬间僵住。与罗佳显露出的厌恶感不同，那明显是完全不同的表情。

en: After a number of scuffles and scrapes, we arrived at an old Lobotomy Corporation branch. Near the entrance, new faces were waiting for us…
cn: 几经折腾，我们最终抵达了旧脑叶公司支部。入口附近聚集了我们从未见过的人们，就好像在等着我们一样……

en: Just before we entered the LC branch facility, Vergilius stopped me all of a sudden. It seems he has something to say to me alone.
cn: 在我们即将踏入脑叶公司支部之时，维吉里乌斯突然悄悄地叫住了我。他好像要单独和我说些什么。

en: We descended into a fetid underground facility. The place was lined with corpses and critters. Just what happened here? And can we come back in one piece with the Golden Bough in our hands?
cn: 我们来到了地下。这里遍地是散发出腐臭味的尸体，还爬满了蛆虫。这里到底发生过什么？以及，我们最终能否顺利地将金枝夺回？

en:
Under the chill air, Vergilius introduces us to our upcoming destination.
Where could the next Golden Bough be?
cn:
在冰冷的空气中，维吉里乌斯对接下来的作战地点进行了说明。
这一次，金枝会隐藏在哪里呢？

en:
Faust explains what to do for this mission:
As our first step, we should pay a visit to a certain “pawnshop”.
cn:
浮士德说明了对此次作战的计划。
为了执行任务，我们要去的地方是“当铺”。

en:
Our team will join hands with a duo from the Clearance Department.
The Sinners cast a skeptical glance at their competence and comportment…
cn:
为了与我们展开联合作战，清理部门派来了新的同事。
看着与其他人不同而十分正经的他们，虽然罪人们投来了怀疑的目光……

en:
The plan that seemed so perfect took little time to go awry.
Don Quixote’s outburst runs us afoul with the Tingtang Gang…
cn:
看似完美的作战计划在实行过程中转瞬间便偏离了轨道。
堂吉诃德的暴起出手使罪人们与豆豆帮成员发生了冲突……

en: The Sinners continue to fight off the Tingtang Gang’s goons. They just keep on appearing, suggesting that we’re in their territory.
cn: 罪人们接连击退豆豆帮一次又一次的进攻。敌人却仍不断涌现出来，这意味着我们已然踏入他们的地盘。

en:
We learned from a Tingtanger that their boss is at the scrapyard housing car pagodas.
For our Plan B, we must take wishpower from the gang and borrow their clothes.
cn:
我们从豆豆帮成员那里得到了他们的帮主位于车塔上的情报。
为了进行B计划，我们必须去车塔上夺走他们的愿力，并伪装成豆豆帮成员。

en: The team searches around the car pagodas looking for the Tingtang Gang’s boss.
cn: 罪人们在汽车塔周围搜索，寻找豆豆帮的帮主。

en: After a series of scuffles, we relieved the Tingtang Gang of their outfits and made our way into the casino. This time, we’ll succeed for sure.
cn: 经过一番周折之后，我们抢走并换上了豆豆帮的服装，进入了赌场。这一次，我们的作战一定能够成功。

en: Our newfound determination is swept away in a torrent of glitter, along with our backup plan. There are plenty of obstacles to overcome—particularly the security guards who just noticed us.
cn: 我们刚燃起的决心在转瞬间消失殆尽，作战计划也完全破灭。现在有太多的问题需要解决，眼下的难关便是已经盯上我们的赌场的警卫们。

en: We reached the second floor of the casino. It makes me dizzy imagining what troubles await.
cn: 我们到达了赌场的二层。一想到有怎样的麻烦等着我们，我就感到眼前一黑。

en: We encountered another Syndicate that has a stake in this casino.
cn: 我们遭遇了另一个接管着此处的帮派。

en: The enthusiasm is in stark contrast to the atmosphere just a floor below. One can find a series of unknown musical instruments on every table. What are they for?
cn: 这里愉快的气氛与楼下形成了鲜明的对比。每张桌子上都摆放着一些不知名的乐器，它们到底是用来做什么的呢？

en: Thanks to Sinclair’s astonishing performance, we could reach the third floor. Our joy was short-lived as an imposing Syndicate was waiting for us there.
cn: 多亏了辛克莱那惊人的表演，我们才能安全到达三楼。但这快乐持续得非常短暂，另一个凶恶至极的帮派成员在那里正等着“迎接”我们。

en: Thanks to Sinclair’s astonishing performance, we could reach the third floor. Our joy was short-lived as an imposing Syndicate was waiting for us there.
cn: 多亏了辛克莱那惊人的表演，我们才能安全到达三楼。但这快乐持续得非常短暂，另一个凶恶至极的帮派成员在那里正等着“迎接”我们。

en: The Sinners were growing weary from the prolonged encounter with the Tieqiu Crew. One of them in particular…
cn: 随着与铁工会成员的不断交战，罪人们渐渐疲惫起来。但是，比这更难以忍受的是……

en: Ryōshū’s unexpected lesson in incredible violence opened a way to the top floor at the cost of our inner peace. Now we must win the Golden Bough in a game of chance.
cn: 由于良秀意料之外的交涉方式，在我们的精神也受到了相当大的打击的同时，通往顶层的道路终于打开了。现在，我们必须在一场赌局中把金枝赢回来。

en: Rodya nominated herself to play the game. The table was reaching its final round.
cn: 罗佳自告奋勇作为我们的代表参与了赌局。不知不觉中，赌局已经到了最后一轮。

en: Curious to know what was happening, we eavesdropped on the table. We barge in by accident to find a spatter of blood, the compressed remains of the Tieqiu Boss, and a man named Sonya giving us a soft smile.
cn: 大家按耐不住好奇心，于是躲在门外偷听谈话。结果却不小心闯入屋内，房间里到处都是飞溅的血迹，铁工会老大被压爆的残渣，还有一个名叫索尼亚的人，他平静地对着我们微笑。

en: Rodya emerged victorious. Now we must descend to the underground floors to lay our claim on the Golden Bough.
cn: 赌局以罗佳的胜利而告终。现在，为了开始正式寻找金枝，我们得下到地下去。

en: Vergilius informs us of where we will be going next. While everyone seems happy and energetic, one Sinner is reacting rather strangely…
cn: 维吉里乌斯向我们公布了下一次作战的目的地。当所有人都显得神采奕奕时，有位罪人却表现得十分古怪……

en: To everyone’s surprise, we’re told that our destination is K Corp’s Nest. The entry procedures one must go through to set foot in a Nest are supposedly quite complicated.
cn: 我们很惊讶，本次的目的地居然是K巢。据说，进入巢必须得经过检查站的层层盘查，需要办理的入境手续也十分繁杂。

en: We wait our turn to undergo the checkpoint official’s interview, with Vergilius and Ishmael instructing us on the process. Here’s hoping we’ll pass…
cn: 我们等着检查关口办公室的面试，并且维吉里乌斯和以实玛利正在依据程序指导我们。希望我们能通过……

en: Our Dear Don Quixote’s intolerance for injustice rears its troublesome head again. Armed staff from K Corp. surround us on all sides, all the while Vergilius watches with his arms crossed, upset at our repeated failures to behave.
cn: 我们亲爱的堂吉诃德对不义的难耐再一次捅了娄子。K巢武装成员把我们团团围住，而维吉里乌斯仅仅在那袖手旁观，对我们的再次失手感到失望。

en: The confrontation with K Corp’s guards continues. They seem to hardly take a scratch… adding to our fatigue.
cn: 与K公司保安的斗争在持续。他们看起来很难受伤……而我们越来越疲惫。

en: HP Bullets infused with K Corp’s Singularity render all damage we inflict on our foes useless. The Sinners are running out of patience.
cn: K公司奇点生产的HP弹让我们对他们造成的任何伤害无效化。罪人们正在失去耐心。

en: A man approaches from outside with tremendous speed. This exceedingly jovial and uncomfortably energetic fellow is Siegfried, who appears to have an acquaintance with Vergilius; after a friendly exchange, he rushes at our Sinners.
cn: 一个从外面来的男人以极快的速度靠近。这位极其快活且充满活力的人是齐格飞，他和维吉里乌斯有些交集。在友好的交流过后，他冲向了我们的罪人。

en: After a chaotic encounter with Siegfried, we meet with a couple of familiar faces at the exit, greeting us with the same confidence and comportment…
cn: 在与齐格飞混乱的交战后，我们和一对熟人在出口碰面了，他们俩用着与之前相同的自信和举止同我们打招呼……

en: Returning to the bus, I sense an uneasiness in the air. It looks like Vergilius isn’t going to let today’s incident go unpunished. Buena suerte, Don Quixote…!
cn: 回到巴士，我察觉到紧张的气氛。维吉里乌斯似乎不想让今天的事情轻易翻篇。祝你好运，堂吉诃德……

en: With everything sorted out, we finally resume our journey to the town of Calw. Before we can bask in our momentary peace, someone claiming to be an “inquisitor” leaves a hole in the back window of our bus.
cn: 当所有事告一段落，我们终于继续了我们在卡尔夫镇的旅程。在我们能够享受这短暂的平静之前，某个自称为“异端审判官”的人在巴士的后窗上砸了个洞。

en: The advance party contacted us at last. The mysterious voice coming from the transmitter was a telltale sign that something was up, throwing Sinclair into another fit of terror.
cn: 先遣部队最终联系了我们。从联络器中传来的神秘声音暗示了正在发生的事，让辛克莱陷入了恐慌。

en: Groups of Inquisitors continue to assail us. Who are they, and why are they so fixated on taking my head?
cn: 成群的异端审判官持续地攻击我们。他们是谁，还有他们为什么那么执着于要把我的脑袋弄下来？

en: We’ve reached the town of Calw. A familiar song welcomes us, followed by the morbid sight of trees festooned with horrifying things.
cn: 我们已经到达了卡尔夫镇。一首熟悉的歌，伴着几颗饰有惊骇之物的树木所构成的恐怖光景，迎接着我们的到来。

en: Sinclair’s hometown of Calw was a village of artisan prosthetists. Faust detailed the growing tendency of the public to avoid prosthesis users as the Distortion Phenomenon becomes more frequent.
cn: 辛克莱的家乡“卡尔夫”镇内的大部分居民都从事着义体生产的工作。浮士德详细描述了自从扭曲现象越来越频繁，公众也越来越倾向于排斥义肢使用者的情况。

en: Prosthetic bodies pile up like a landfill in a corner of the town. It brings me to think about what my “true self” is.
cn: 义体堆积在小镇的角落里，宛如一个垃圾填埋场。突然间我开始思考，我的真正的本质到底是什么。

en: I can only feel pity for Sinclair’s struggle to repress his fear. In looking at me, he is soon reminded of an old friend.
cn: 辛克莱努力压抑自己的恐惧令我深感怜悯。他看着我，想起了他很久以前的一位朋友。

en: We arrived at the Sinclair family estate. Crucified prosthetic bodies await us in the courtyard. One of them is someone we can’t bear to see straight.
cn: 我们到达了辛克莱家的宅邸前。被钉死在尖钉上的义体人在花园中等待着我们。在这些被钉死的尸体中，有一个我们无法直视的人。

en: Kromer walked inside the burning mansion. The Sinners are dismayed by Guido’s unflinching advance.
cn: 克罗默行走在熊熊燃烧的宅邸中。罪人们被圭多不可动摇的行军深深地打击到了。

en: We barely managed to defeat Guido, but Sinclair seems to be struggling to endure the immeasurable guilt weighing down on him.
cn: 我们艰难地击败了圭多，但是辛克莱看起来在尽力压抑住他巨大的负罪感。

en: Sinclair showed us to the basement with a suspicious passage. Faust assumes this tunnel was made by N Corp’s staff.
cn: 辛克莱向我们展示了有神秘通道的地下室。浮士德认为这些通道是N公司员工挖的。

en: We continue following the underground passage. The branch facility feels closer.
cn: 我们继续穿过地下通道。看起来我们越来越接近脑叶公司支部了。

en: We’ve arrived at the branch. The room we walked into was like a torture chamber, lined with devices, contraptions, and bits of flesh.
cn: 我们到达了脑叶公司支部。这地方杂乱无章地摆放着各种工具、肉块和器械，就像一间拷问室一样。

en: I found myself looking at dead and dying Sinners in the middle of the Nest, a place that's supposed to be peaceful. And in front of me is... I began tracing back my memories to figure out what happened.
cn: 刚回过神，就看到垂死的罪人们倒在本应和平的巢中心。还有我面前的那……我开始一步步回想之前都发生了什么。

en: Why are there Abnormalities in the middle of K Corp's Nest? Vergilius seemed to mean it when he said we could return to the bus after we've dealt with this commotion. Passing by frightened crowds, we head to the center of the mess.
cn: 为什么K巢中心会出现异想体？维吉里乌斯说在一切都解决之前不准我们返回——他好像是认真的。我们穿过狼狈逃窜的人群，走向哀嚎的中心。

en: Getting suspicious drones out of the way, we're dealing with the chaos. They look quite expensive at a glance, and the K Corp. logo on them makes me all the more hesitant about destroying them.
cn: 为了解决这场骚乱，不得不处理了阻挡前路的可疑无人机。它们怎么看都价值不菲，何况还印着K公司的LOGO，打坏时着实让人心里没底。

en: Getting suspicious drones out of the way, we're dealing with the chaos. They look quite expensive at a glance, and the K Corp. logo on them makes me all the more hesitant about destroying them.
cn: 为了解决这场骚乱，不得不处理了阻挡前路的可疑无人机。它们怎么看都价值不菲，何况还印着K公司的LOGO，打坏时着实让人心里没底。

en: Getting suspicious drones out of the way, we're dealing with the chaos. They look quite expensive at a glance, and the K Corp. logo on them makes me all the more hesitant about destroying them.
cn: 为了解决这场骚乱，不得不处理了阻挡前路的可疑无人机。它们怎么看都价值不菲，何况还印着K公司的LOGO，打坏时着实让人心里没底。

en: We no longer see those annoying drones. Now, it's us between the Abnormalities, the threat we actually should remove.
cn: 那些烦人的无人机终于不再出现。现在得重新集中精力，去处理我们真正要消灭的敌人，异想体。

en: We managed to defeat the Abnormalities and got back on the bus. Who could be giving us a request? I looked out the window, pretending not to hear Ishmael's faint humming.
cn: 历经千辛万苦，我们终于打败异想体并回到了巴士上。给我们委托的人究竟是谁呢。我尽量无视以实玛利的哼歌声，去观赏窗外的风景。

en: We saw someone we never thought we would see again. But, the Sinners didn't seem too thrilled about the reunion. The client, who says his name is 'Dongrang', starts a friendly conversation. This is despite the fact that no one other than the Sinners can hear what I say...
cn: 与自认为再也不会遇见的人重逢了。不过看似并没有罪人对这场重逢感到愉快。自称“东朗”的委托人亲切地向我搭话。可我说出的话没法传给罪人以外的人啊……

en: After boasting about K Corp's regeneration technology, Dongrang invited us to his lab. Disregarding Samjo's visible shock, we followed Dongrang into his workplace.
cn: 对K公司的再生技术自鸣得意的东朗，提出接下来愿意让我们参观实验室。不顾三朝惊愕的表情，我们走向了东朗的实验室。

en: Intruders broke into the lab. Samjo called them terrorists, but they rejected the notion and instead introduced themselves as the 'technology liberation alliance'. Whatever they are, we have to fight them to survive the attack and proceed with the request.
cn: 研究室有人入侵。三朝说他们是恐怖组织，但入侵者却对那种称号大表不快，并介绍自己为“技术解放联盟”。名称并不重要。要想安全逃脱这阵爆炸并继续完成委托，只能和他们战斗了。

en: As continued battles against the machines were wearing us out, I heard a confident voice.
cn: 就在我们与各种机器鏖战多轮而疲惫不堪时，某人得意扬扬的声音传来。

en: Accompanying Shrenne and Fixers from Rosespanner Workshop, we headed for the Lobotomy Corp. branch. Feels like a lot of people are involved in this mission. Are we really gonna be safe walking into a place occupied by terrorists?
cn: 与施伦妮、玫瑰扳手工坊收尾人会合后，我们前往脑叶公司支部。感觉此次任务参与人员似乎相当多。听说那里已经被恐怖分子所占领，我们能否顺利进入呢？

en: In the branch facility, we ran into the same machines we saw at K Corp. instead of terrorists. For some reason, these machines are playing a strange voice that calls us worms when we destroy them.
cn: 占领着脑叶公司支部的并非恐怖组织，而是在K公司看到过的机械。但不知为何，这些机械一旦被破坏，就会播放出来源不明的声音，把我们贬低成虫子。

en: According to Samjo, one of the technology liberation alliance's members is a former K Corp. laboratory worker. What does that organization build these machines for, and why do they attack and terrorize K Corp's labs?
cn: 据三朝说，在名为技术解放联盟的团体中，存在一名前K公司研究所所属的研究员。究竟是怎样的目的才让这个团体制造出了这些机械、又不惜制造恐怖袭击也要袭击K公司研究所呢？

en: We met Ran, who apparently used to work for a K Corp. laboratory. Before we could properly talk with her, she vanished forever, leaving mysterious words. And Shrenne looks despondent for whatever reason.
cn: 我们遇到了曾所属于K公司研究所的兰。还没来得及与她进行正常的交流，她就留下了一段难以理解的话，并在此后永远地失去了踪迹。同时，施伦妮也不知为何一直都是一副空虚的表情。

en: We met Ran, who apparently used to work for a K Corp. laboratory. Before we could properly talk with her, she vanished forever, leaving mysterious words. And Shrenne looks despondent for whatever reason.
cn: 我们遇到了曾所属于K公司研究所的兰。还没来得及与她进行正常的交流，她就留下了一段难以理解的话，并在此后永远地失去了踪迹。同时，施伦妮也不知为何一直都是一副空虚的表情。

en: Glaring at Shrenne, Outis stops on the way, having made some kind of conclusion. I couldn't begin to guess what it could be, so I decided to stay and listen.
cn: 一直瞪着施伦妮的奥提斯像是得到了某种结论，停下了脚步。因为不知道她所下的判断是什么，我决定默默地听她说话。

en: Outis and Meursault claimed that there's a traitor in our group. Niko from Rosespanner Workshop denied the accusation, but the suspicion wasn't without reason. The Sinners were now confronting the people they were talking with mere moments ago. This one is an outsider turning against us, but... it made me wonder how long "our" bond could last.
cn: 据奥提斯和默尔索所说，我们之间出了个叛徒。那个自称来自玫瑰扳手工坊的叫尼柯的男人明显在装糊涂，完全可以对他进行合理的怀疑。我望着罪人们正与刚刚还在正常聊天的人交战。虽说此次的叛变是由于外部势力所导致的……但“我们”之间的关系还能持续多久呢。我不禁这样想道。

en: It was revealed that Shrenne and Rosespanner Workshop Fixers were in cahoots with the enemy. Before we could ask the reason, one of the Fixers melted down after a forced injection of the regeneration ampule. Wasn't that... supposed to heal the body? For now, we have Niko and the remaining Fixers to deal with.
cn: 这些事情是由施伦妮与玫瑰扳手工坊的收尾人们所为的事实浮出了水面。我们还没来得及问出原因，被强制注射再生安瓿的收尾人在做出任何补救措施之前就迅速地融化掉了。再生安瓿……本来不是用于治愈身体的吗？但首先，我们得先对付尼柯和其他收尾人。

en: It was revealed that Shrenne and Rosespanner Workshop Fixers were in cahoots with the enemy. Before we could ask the reason, one of the Fixers melted down after a forced injection of the regeneration ampule. Wasn't that... supposed to heal the body? For now, we have Niko and the remaining Fixers to deal with.

Before we could ask the reason, one of the Fixers melted down after a forced injection of the regeneration ampule. Wasn't that... supposed to heal the body? For now, we have Niko and the remaining Fixers to deal with.
cn: 这些事情是由施伦妮与玫瑰扳手工坊的收尾人们所为的事实浮出了水面。我们还没来得及问出原因，被强制注射再生安瓿的收尾人在做出任何补救措施之前就迅速地融化掉了。再生安瓿……本来不是用于治愈身体的吗？但首先，我们得先对付尼柯和其他收尾人。

en: Now that the Rosespanner Workshop Fixers are defeated, it's time to question Shrenne. She stands still and watches the situation unfold without a hint of panic.
cn: 解决掉玫瑰扳手工坊收尾人后，我们是时候来追究施伦妮的责任了。她丝毫没有惊慌，始终注视着发生的一切。

en: Assassins claimed Shrenne's life. Dongrang didn't appear too shocked by her death even though they had joined the Wing at the same time. He says internal conflict is like a cycle of some kind. How much trust do I have in the Sinners, and how much trust do they have in me? With questions I won't be able to answer, we headed for the place where the Golden Bough resonated.
cn: 因不知谁派来的暗杀者，就连施伦妮也失去了性命。东朗据说与施伦妮同时进入公司，但他却一副没有受到什么打击的样子。或许对他而言，内部分裂也是一种所谓的纽带。我信任罪人们到何种程度，罪人们又信任我到何种程度？怀着这无法解答的疑问，我向着与金枝共鸣的地方走去。

en: Dongbaek's unexpected attack pierced Yi Sang's chest. Winding time would heal the wound, but will it really fill the hole in his heart? I had no way to know what dream Yi Sang could have been dreaming, resting with his eyes closed.
cn: 冬柏的意外袭击穿透了李箱的胸膛。倒转时间能治愈伤口，但心上的空洞能否被真正填满？我无从得知他合眼安眠后梦到了什么。

en: Yi Sang came back to his senses as though nothing happened. Meanwhile, Samjo's phone starts ringing incessantly.
cn: 李箱像是无事发生一样醒了过来。这时，三朝的电话开始响个不停。

en: The K Corp. laboratory was unexpectedly attacked. It seems that the technology liberation alliance has acquired the ability to revert Abnormalities to eggs. We hurried back to the building.
cn: K公司研究所被突袭。技术解放联盟似乎已经掌握将异想体变回卵的能力。我们急忙回到K公司研究所大楼。

en: Hacked by technology liberation alliance members, K Corp's ampule-distributing machines turned against us. We have to defeat K Corp. security forces and make our way through.
cn: 受到技术解放联盟成员入侵，K公司的再生安瓿无人机对准了我们。我们只能击败K公司的安保力量来继续前进。

en: Hacked by technology liberation alliance members, K Corp's ampule-distributing machines turned against us. We have to defeat K Corp. security forces and make our way through.
cn: 受到技术解放联盟成员入侵，K公司的再生安瓿无人机对准了我们。我们只能击败K公司的安保力量来继续前进。

en: The liberation alliance member was waiting for us instead of retreating. As if they have a secret weapon prepared...
cn: 技术解放联盟的成员并非撤退而是等着我们。他们好像准备好了秘密武器……

en: The liberation alliance member was waiting for us instead of retreating. As if they have a secret weapon prepared...
cn: 技术解放联盟的成员并非撤退而是等着我们。他们好像准备好了秘密武器……

en: Samjo's phone is ringing like crazy again. Maybe we can try and find useful information we couldn't get from Dongrang and Samjo while they're away...
cn: 三朝的电话铃声再次疯狂地响起来。也许我们该趁东朗和三朝不在试着找点从他们那里拿不到的有用信息。

en: While Dongrang and Samjo were away, we sent Meursault to investigate Shrenne's mailbox. Maybe we'll learn more about the technology liberation alliance.
cn: 趁东朗和三朝不在，我们派默尔索去调查施伦妮的邮箱。也许能得到更多技术解放联盟的信息。

en: While Dongrang and Samjo were away, we sent Meursault to investigate Shrenne's mailbox. Maybe we'll learn more about the technology liberation alliance.
cn: 趁东朗和三朝不在，我们派默尔索去调查施伦妮的邮箱。也许能得到更多技术解放联盟的信息。

en: Meursault has returned. Let's see what information he brought with him.
cn: 默尔索回来了。让我们看看他都带回了什么情报。

en: Hacked by technology liberation alliance members, K Corp's ampule-distributing machines turned against us. We have to defeat K Corp. security forces and make our way through.
cn: 受到技术解放联盟成员入侵，K公司的再生安瓿无人机对准了我们。我们只能击败K公司的安保力量来继续前进。

en: Hacked by technology liberation alliance members, K Corp's ampule-distributing machines turned against us. We have to defeat K Corp. security forces and make our way through.
cn: 受到技术解放联盟成员入侵，K公司的再生安瓿无人机对准了我们。我们只能击败K公司的安保力量来继续前进。

en: We see ominous-looking K Corp. staff on the other side. Dongrang and Samjo rejoined our group; it seems the talk went well enough.
cn: 我们发现另一侧有异状的K公司成员。东朗和三朝重新回到队伍中；谈话似乎进展顺利。

en: We see ominous-looking K Corp. staff on the other side. Dongrang and Samjo rejoined our group; it seems the talk went well enough.
cn: 我们发现另一侧有异状的K公司成员。东朗和三朝重新回到队伍中，谈话似乎进展顺利。

en: We met a familiar technology liberation alliance member. That's the one who was with Ran in the last laboratory raid.
cn: 我们遇到了面熟的技术解放联盟的成员。是之前和兰一起入侵研究室的人。

en: We defeated Marile. With that, we finally learned that the technology liberation alliance's goal was to return to an era where there was no technology.
cn: 我们打败了名为马里勒的人。由此，我们终于得知，技术解放联盟的目标是回到技术不复存在的时代。

en: An unhappy Ryōshū calls Yi Sang. We began talking about our reasons for joining the company.
cn: 良秀一脸不满地叫了一声李箱。于是，我们讨论起彼此入职的原因。

en: To get to the 'screening room' Dongrang mentioned, we have to defeat the foes on the way.
cn: 我们一边向东朗所说的“放映室”前进，一边被迫击退不断出现的敌人。

en: We made our way to the 'screening room'. It was dark, but we could see something at the center hanging down from above, like it was looking down at us.
cn: 终于到达了“放映室”。虽然由于太暗而看不清楚，但在这空间的正中似乎有什么正俯视着我们。

en: Past bonds thought to be severed have met again; Dongbaek showed obsessive determination to reclaim the Singularity.
cn: 与曾认为早已断绝的缘分再度相遇，冬柏表露出对于取回奇点的强烈执念。

en: An intense golden glow blinked from the Golden Bough that was stabbed into Dongbaek. Soon enough, the space in the K Corp. building around us begins to twist and morph. What could be happening?
cn: 刺穿冬柏的金枝散发出耀眼的金光，随后消失不见。随后我们所在的K公司开始扭曲变形。究竟会发生什么呢？

en: An intense golden glow blinked from the Golden Bough that was stabbed into Dongbaek. Soon enough, the space in the K Corp. building around us begins to twist and morph. What could be happening?
cn: 刺穿冬柏的金枝散发出耀眼的金光，随后消失不见。随后我们所在的K公司开始扭曲变形。究竟会发生什么呢？

en: Technology liberation alliance members we were sure were dead start attacking us. We keep moving forward in the rearranging space, looking for the Golden Bough that's still near us.
cn: 本应死亡的解放联盟成员们袭击了我们。在逐渐重组的空间中，我们继续前进，寻找着不远处的金枝的下落。

en: Technology liberation alliance members we were sure were dead start attacking us. We keep moving forward in the rearranging space, looking for the Golden Bough that's still near us.
cn: 本应死亡的解放联盟成员们袭击了我们。在逐渐重组的空间中，我们继续前进，寻找着不远处的金枝的下落。

en: Technology liberation alliance members we were sure were dead start attacking us. We keep moving forward in the rearranging space, looking for the Golden Bough that's still near us.
cn: 本应死亡的解放联盟成员们袭击了我们。在逐渐重组的空间中，我们继续前进，寻找着不远处的金枝的下落。

en: Technology liberation alliance members we were sure were dead start attacking us. We keep moving forward in the rearranging space, looking for the Golden Bough that's still near us.
cn: 本应死亡的解放联盟成员们袭击了我们。在逐渐重组的空间中，我们继续前进，寻找着不远处的金枝的下落。

en:
To receive a briefing for our next mission, we arrived downtown in K Corp’s Nest.
As a whiff of a roasty scent was about to take the Sinners for a nostalgia trip, a flock of walking raw chickens began to attack them.
Are they trying to exact revenge for all their brethren that humans fried and gobbled up…?
cn:
为了接收下个任务的简报，我们来到了K巢的商业街。
就当那股烤鸡的香气让罪人们纷纷沉沦其中时，一群行走的生鸡突然开始袭击他们。
它们是打算为被人类先煎后吞的同类们报仇吗？

en:
To receive a briefing for our next mission, we arrived downtown in K Corp’s Nest.
As a whiff of a roasty scent was about to take the Sinners for a nostalgia trip, a flock of walking raw chickens began to attack them.
Are they trying to exact revenge for all their brethren that humans fried and gobbled up…?
cn:
为了接收下个任务的简报，我们来到了K巢的商业街。
就当那股烤鸡的香气让罪人们纷纷沉沦其中时，一群行走的生鸡突然开始袭击他们。
它们是打算为被人类先煎后吞的同类们报仇吗？

en:
One idea we came up with to unravel the Distortion… was to present some “chicken-based cooking” that would appease it.
The Sinners confidently start preparing their dishes, but…
Shouldn’t they put their cigarettes out first?
cn:
我们打算解决扭曲的方法……
就是准备一些鸡肉料理来安抚它。
罪人们摩拳擦掌准备料理，不过……
他们是不是该先把烟掐掉？

en:
One idea we came up with to unravel the Distortion… was to present some “chicken-based cooking” that would appease it.
The Sinners confidently start preparing their dishes, but…
Shouldn’t they put their cigarettes out first?
cn:
我们打算解决扭曲的方法……
就是准备一些鸡肉料理来安抚它。
罪人们摩拳擦掌准备料理，不过……
他们是不是该先把烟掐掉？

en:
Split into two groups, the Sinners present their dishes.
I still don’t get how this turned into a competition…
But, in any case, they have a long way to go to sate the distorted restaurant owner’s palate.
Or anyone else’s, if I’m being honest here…
cn:
罪人们分两组呈上了自己的菜品。
我还是搞不懂为什么这就比起来了……
不论如何，他们在满足这位扭曲老板的口味之前还任重道远啊。
实话说，就算是别人的口味……

en:
Split into two groups, the Sinners present their dishes.
I still don’t get how this turned into a competition…
But, in any case, they have a long way to go to sate the distorted restaurant owner’s palate.
Or anyone else’s, if I’m being honest here…
cn:
罪人们分两组呈上了自己的菜品。
我还是搞不懂为什么这就比起来了……
不论如何，他们在满足这位扭曲老板的口味之前还任重道远啊。
实话说，就算是别人的口味……

en:
The owner’s reaction couldn’t have been worse.
We only have a few chances remaining, too.
It looks like our only option is to count on the Sinners who seem like they know their stuff, I hope…?
cn:
老板的评价不能更糟了，
留给我们的机会也不多了。
现在看来唯一选项就是相信罪人们一定能大展身手……吧？

en:
The owner’s reaction couldn’t have been worse.
We only have a few chances remaining, too.
It looks like our only option is to count on the Sinners who seem like they know their stuff, I hope…?
cn:
老板的评价不能更糟了，
留给我们的机会也不多了。
现在看来唯一选项就是相信罪人们一定能大展身手……吧？

en:
After a long, long journey through a tunnel, we finally arrived at a place called the Great Lake.
Taking in the view of the vast and turquoise waters, the Sinners begin excitedly chattering about what they want to do at the beach.
But... are we really here on vacation?
cn:
穿过长长的隧道，我们到了一个被称为大湖的地方。
看着宽阔蔚蓝的海滩，罪人们开始兴奋地谈论他们想在海滩上做什么。
但是……我们真的能在这度假吗？

en:
Of course, our destination was some squelchy, green, and fetid mudflat.
Though I can see the blue sea in the distance, it feels as far away as a dream... buried in mountains of trash from who-knows-where.
What could we possibly be here for?
cn:
最终到达的地方是一个绿色，充斥着腥臭味的泥滩。
周围堆满了不知从何而来的废料，远处蓝色大海的样子就像画里的饼一样，让人感觉遥不可及。
我们来这里干什么？

en:
From mountainous refuse, out crawled crustacean creatures covered in all sorts of scrap. According to Ishmael, they're pretty infamous in the Backstreets of U Corp.
Speaking of which... I wonder what's going on with her? She's been in the doldrums all day.
cn:
从山上的垃圾堆中，爬出来的甲壳类动物身上覆盖着各种各样的碎屑。根据以实玛利的说法，他们是U公司后巷很有名的东西。
相比之下……以实玛利的表情一直阴沉沉的，怎么回事？

en:
The pair called Mika and Rain seems to have been expecting us. I guess the LCCB already informed them of our arrival.
Looks like we're going to have to modify Mephistopheles in order to get to our next destination.
cn:
美香和雷恩这些人好像已经认识我们了。我想LCCB已经通知了他们。
为了前往下一个目的地，似乎必须在这里改造梅菲斯托费勒斯。

en: Time to salvage scrap and prepare the bus for both hell and high water.
cn: 是时候收集废料，把巴士变成船了。

en:
We finally collected enough scrap for them to start working on the bus modifications.
I wonder if we can get some time off?
If we do... then I should try talking to Ishmael.
cn:
我们终于收集到了足够多的废料用于改造巴士。
现在，我能和罪人们休息一下了吗？
那么……休息的时候找以实玛利谈谈吧。

en:
Taking Don Quixote and Yi Sang's advice to mend the growing rift between Ishmael and the other Sinners, I decided that we should all try out a few rounds of beach volleyball.
Maybe this activity can be an opportunity to build some rapport.
cn:
在烦恼着如何解决不断闹别扭的以实玛利与罪人们之间的关系时，我决定试试堂吉诃德和李箱提议的沙滩排球。
一起运动或许能让大家彼此之间增进感情。

en:
The beach volleyball plan completely backfired…
Everyone has a scowl on their face as they fight off the trash crabs.
I have to do something about this…
cn:
与预想相反，沙滩排球彻底完蛋了……
大家满脸怒容地<size=110%>和</size>废料蟹搏斗着。
果然……我觉得我该对此说点什么。

en:
The situation's bleaker than the color of this mudflat...
But, we have to keep collecting more scrap.
cn:
虽然情况比泥滩的颜色更加晦暗……
但还是要收集废料。

en:
We continued to collect scrap for a few more days.
I decided to watch as the Sinners got to work,
wondering what I could do about Ishmael and Heathcliff...
cn:
在开始收集比第一次还多的废料之后，几天时间又过去了。
这段时间我决定远远地看着罪人们工作。
想着该怎么处理以实玛利和希斯克利夫……

en:
Nothing's been resolved, but Mephistopheles' modifications are almost complete.
Mika grimly requested that everyone gather to watch the test drive.
I'm glad that the modifications are finally complete... but can we really press on in this state?
cn:
虽然还没有解决任何问题，但梅菲斯托费勒斯的改造已经接近尾声。
美香一本正经地把所有人都叫过来试车。
虽然改造结束了是好事……但这样真的可以前往下一个目的地吗？

en: Let's battle the King Trash Crab, and get us a huge piece of scrap.
cn: 让我们<size=110%>和</size>帝王废料蟹战斗，取得大块的废料吧。

en:
Our wait in the Lake grows ever longer. One by one, the Sinners begin succumbing to the tedium.
Then Heathcliff suddenly and anxiously calls over to Vergilius...
cn:
在大湖里等待的时间越来越长，罪人们因无聊而变得疲惫不堪。
这时，希斯克利夫焦急地跟维吉里乌斯搭话……

en:
Don Quixote brought us to the helm of the ship.
There it was, the monitor that Faust would analyze whenever we had a Backdoor volatility. ... And there they were again, those unknown symbols.
cn:
堂吉诃德带着意味深长的表情把我们带到了驾驶舱。
那里有着后门发生波动时，浮士德曾观察过的显示器……上面正排列着未知的文字。

en:
We entered the Backdoor Don Quixote claimed to have seen. In it was... what appeared to be a factory.
Clearly not her first time in this establishment, Don Quixote calls over to someone...
cn:
打开堂吉诃德发现的后门并进入后，发现那里有看起来像工厂一样的空间。
堂吉诃德好像已经来过了这里，她很自然地呼唤着某人……

en:
What popped out from the sack we found atop the sleigh were... several mutilated bodies and a small child.
It looks like they were kidnapped here... I wonder what happened.
cn:
从雪橇上的袋子里跳出来的是一个小家伙和四肢不全的人们。
看样子他们似乎是被绑架到这里来的，到底发生了什么事情呢。

en:
Heathcliff and Don Quixote were both out cold, but I managed to survive thanks to the Sinners who came for me.
... But I don't see the two unconscious Sinners anywhere.
cn:
在希斯克利夫和堂吉诃德晕倒的绝境中，多亏了来找我的罪人们，我得以保住了性命。
但是……被气体迷晕的那两个人不见了。

en: They must've been taken to a different sector of this factory. Crayon must be there with them... We have to find them, quick.
cn: 他们应该是被带到了这工厂的某个地方。柯蕾昂她应该也在一起吧……得快点找到他们一起回去。

en: They must've been taken to a different sector of this factory. Crayon must be there with them... We have to find them, quick.
cn: 他们应该是被带到了这工厂的某个地方。柯蕾昂她应该也在一起吧……得快点找到他们一起回去。

en: The factory was much larger and much more complicated than it first appeared. Who are the gnomes making these gifts for? And why?
cn: 工厂有着比想象中更大更复杂的结构。他们到底为了谁，为了什么在制作礼物呢。

en: The factory was much larger and much more complicated than it first appeared. Who are the gnomes making these gifts for? And why?
cn: 工厂有着比想象中更大更复杂的结构。他们到底为了谁，为了什么在制作礼物呢。

en:
The location pointed out by Meursault was the gift assembly line. The sight of them assembling gifts with the 'materials' they kidnapped was... shocking.
And the two Sinners we were searching for were also about to be turned into gifts themselves.
cn:
默尔索所指的地方是制作礼物的空间。用抓到的“材料”做成礼物的样子，实在令人震惊。
同时，终于被找到的两位罪人也快要被做成礼物了……

en: Our negotiation attempt with the beard giant Santata predictably fell through. We have no choice but to defeat him here.
cn: 似乎没有和胡子巨人桑塔塔交涉的余地。只能在这里打倒它。

en: We defeated Santata, but his body begins to expand as though it's about to explode. That's when we hear a sudden, unfamiliar voice from somewhere...
cn: 桑塔塔被打倒了，但它的身体就像是要进行自爆攻击一样开始膨胀。那时，从某处传来陌生的声音……

en: Our negotiation attempt with the beard giant Santata predictably fell through. We have no choice but to defeat him here.
cn: 似乎没有和胡子巨人桑塔塔交涉的余地。只能直接击败它。

en:
It's been a while since we entered the T Corp. Backstreets...
The deeper we go into the Backstreets, the world outside the bus becomes increasingly colorless.
Heathcliff, who's been looking out the window for a while, suddenly furrows his brow.
cn:
自我们经过T公司的后巷入口已有些时候了。
车窗外的世界已经比之前褪去了更多色彩，仿佛变成了模糊的灰色空间。
一同向窗外望去的希斯克利夫皱起了眉头。

en:
The first thing we noticed the moment we disembarked the bus was a crowd of swordsmen, all garbed in black cloaks, engaged in a fierce battle.
One side was loud and bustling, while the other side was quiet and somber. Perhaps the latter side was losing...
What could we possibly have to gain from this?
cn:
一下巴士就映入眼帘的，是一群身着黑衣，挥刀相向的人。
一方有些吵闹，另一方则似乎处于劣势，显得沉重而迟钝。
我们到底要从这些人那里得到什么呢。

en:
We brought the wounded woman aboard the bus.
Vergilius was none to happy about it, but... I'm pretty confident in my decision. I will see this through to the end.
... Looks like she's waking up.
cn:
我们把受伤失去意识的人带到了巴士上。
虽然被维吉里乌斯责备了一番……但我觉得这样做是对的，所以打算好事做到底。
……正好，她已经恢复了意识。

en:
When we returned to the bus, an oddly familiar yet previously unacquainted person was waiting for us.
If she was wearing a blue uniform, a slightly different looking vest... she would have reminded me of some people we've met before.
Why did Vergilius let her board the bus?
cn:
回到巴士时，有个虽然从未见过，但似曾相识的人在等着我们。
如果衣服的颜色换成蓝色，再穿上稍有些不同的背心……倒是能想到几个熟人。
维吉里乌斯为什么让这个人上了巴士呢？

en:
Orders came from the higher-ups of Limbus Company that we are to retrieve a Distortion-related artifact from this 'Yong-jin Building'.
I'm not sure how this is related to retrieving the Golden Boughs, but I'm starting to feel that none of us really have much say in the matter anyway.
It seemed to me that Vergilius already knew where we were headed. What was the point in not telling us and letting us go through a roundabout route?
cn:
边狱公司的高层要求我们在叫做“龙进大楼”的地方回收与扭曲有关的东西。
虽然我看不到其与找回金枝的工作的关联性，但能隐约感受到公司安排的任务中具有某种程度的强制性。
话说回来……
维吉里乌斯好像当初就知道目标是那里。为什么他非要让我们绕一圈远路呢？

en:
Orders came from the higher-ups of Limbus Company that we are to retrieve a Distortion-related artifact from this 'Yong-jin Building'.
I'm not sure how this is related to retrieving the Golden Boughs, but I'm starting to feel that none of us really have much say in the matter anyway.
It seemed to me that Vergilius already knew where we were headed. What was the point in not telling us and letting us go through a roundabout route?
cn:
边狱公司的高层要求我们在叫做“龙进大楼”的地方回收与扭曲有关的东西。
虽然我看不到其与找回金枝的工作的关联性，但能隐约感受到公司安排的任务中具有某种程度的强制性。
话说回来……
维吉里乌斯好像当初就知道目标是那里。为什么他非要让我们绕一圈远路呢？

en:
Aeng-du is cutting enemies down left and right in her desperate search for the mentor... this Bamboo-hatted Kim.
I'm pretty sure her wounds are far from healed... I suppose she's just that determined.
It makes me wonder, though. What was Bamboo-hatted Kim like?
cn:
樱桃依然在为了寻找头领……那个被叫做金笠的人物，而焦急地清理着大楼里的敌人。
她受伤的地方还没有完全恢复……这大概就是所谓的执念吧。
这位金笠，到底是什么样的人呢。

en:
Aeng-du is cutting enemies down left and right in her desperate search for the mentor... this Bamboo-hatted Kim.
I'm pretty sure her wounds are far from healed... I suppose she's just that determined.
It makes me wonder, though. What was Bamboo-hatted Kim like?
cn:
樱桃依然在为了寻找头领……那个被叫做金笠的人物，而焦急地清理着大楼里的敌人。
她受伤的地方还没有完全恢复……这大概就是所谓的执念吧。
这位金笠，到底是什么样的人呢。

en:
Thick, hazy gloom. Burning wrath. My head spins from the sheer intensity of these overwhelming sensations.
Why am I sensing the Peccatula here...?
And...
These sensations are far stronger than what I usually feel from these Peccatula...!
cn:
黏糊糊的忧郁感和像燃烧一样的愤怒感让人头晕目眩。
为什么这种地方会出现罪种的反应……？
而且……
那和我一直以来感受到的反应级别……不一样。

en:
We finally arrived at the top floor of the building, the 6th floor. There, a nervous-looking man was checking his pocket watch.
He carries a large sword and wears a nasty scowl...
This guy has to be the leader of the gang of Kurokumo Clan henchmen we've defeated along the way.
cn:
我们抵达了大楼的顶层，第6层，那里有个焦躁地俯视着怀表的人。
他的胳膊搭在巨大的剑上，一脸烦躁。
就算不问也能知道，他就是我们在上来的路上打倒的黑云会的负责人。

en:
We finally came face-to-face with Aeng-du's mentor.
Cold blue light from his eye seeps past the crack of a slanted bamboo hat.
... He won't go down without a fight.
cn:
我们终于面对了被樱桃称为头领的人。
在斜戴着的破碎斗笠的缝隙间，那冰冷的蓝色目光缓缓流淌而出。
……看来战斗是难以避免了。

en:
- Limbus Company: The place I work for.
- It’s a name that should be the most closely related to me… but it’s also the hardest to describe for me.
Cause… they won’t tell me anything. I didn’t join the company of my own accord.
At first, I thought the company’s initiative was to find and retrieve the Golden Boughs, but that only seems to be *our* department’s goal, not the entire company’s.
cn:
- 边狱公司。我所就职的公司。
- 可以说这词与我有着最紧密的联系……然而它出乎预料地也成为了我最难以言明的词汇。
因为……完全没有人告诉过我任何关于这方面的事情。入职甚至并非我的本意。
起初，我以为公司的目的就是搜集金枝。后来我才意识到，这只是我所属的名为LCB的部门的目标，说是整个公司的目的还是太片面了。

en:
- From what I can tell, each department has its own aims, and there’s no common goal shared by all of them.
- It looks like the company has substantial backing. The company’s support was never lacking whenever we got its help. (Though Rodya seems to have a lot to say about the meals.)
cn:
- 据我所知，每个部门都有自己的目标，并且彼此之间没有任何目标重合。
- 公司似乎有着充足资金堆砌而成的强大后盾。无论何时何地，公司的支援从未缺席（虽然罗佳似乎对伙食的意见很大）。

en:
- Limbus Company Bus.
- Its name comes from the fact we’re on a bus.
Feels like they didn’t put a lot of thought into the name, but the other departments aren’t far ahead in terms of sophistication.
- The team includes people like me and the ones called… Sinners(?) who’re sitting back behind. (Still not used to this word.)
The purpose is to retrieve things called “Golden Boughs” from the underground facilities of “Lobotomy” or whatever the “L” Corp. stood for.
I dunno what Golden Boughs are, but from the sound of it: some physical objects shaped like tree branches. (Will make a separate note when I learn more.)
cn:
- Limbus Company Bus。
- 似乎被称作巴士部门。
我觉得这名字有随意拟定的嫌疑，不过与其他部门相比也只是五十步与百步的区别罢了。
- 似乎指代的对象包含了我和坐在后面的那些……罪人们？（还不是很习惯这个词。）
我们的目标好像是回收L公司，也就是脑什么公司的支部的地下所埋藏的金枝。
虽然不知道所谓的金枝到底是什么，但听上去应该是什么树枝状的实体。（了解之后得再补充记录才行。）

en:
- Seems retrieving Golden Boughs isn’t the only job.
We’re sent to deal with any task on the way to the company’s objective that needs capabilities unique to me or the Sinners.
- I’m starting to wonder how this company came to be, and why it had to be me and the Sinners to do all this, but Faust won’t tell me.
She says the security level is too low for me to access the information, but she seems to know something more.
Why does a “Sinner” know more about the company when I’m the “Executive Manager”…?
cn:
- 看起来回收金枝并不是我们唯一的工作。
我和罪人们还得时刻准备着被外派，以我们独有的能力扫清挡在公司目标前的一切障碍。
- 我开始好奇这家公司到底是如何成立的，以及为什么这些任务必须要我和罪人们去完成，但浮士德从未告诉我。虽然她说我的权限等级过低而无法获知更多信息，但她自己却是一副知道得更多的样子。
为什么她这样的“罪人”会比我这“执行经理”知道的还要多……？

en:
- Limbus Company Clearance.
- Its name comes from the fact they “clear” things up and out.
It was formed to aid the bus team’s work.
Unlike the Sinners, I can’t revive them with my powers, which explains the care put into their gear and equipment.
- The department seems to be split into two teams. The Before Team (LCCB) handles scouting and preparation work, while the After Team (LCCA) handles gathering and cleaning up what we’ve done.
I haven’t met them yet, but the teams seem to be divided into several sections if Vergilius’s phone calls are anything to go by.
- Met with Effie and Saude from Preliminary Observation of the Before Team.
- I asked them a few questions when I had the time, I’ll try to write down what I learned.
- Also wanted to ask what exactly they do, but the session got interrupted by Don Quixote suddenly causing a scene.
- Effie sighed that Preliminary Observation pays the least out of all Before Team’s subsections. Judging from what I heard about the department having far more staff than the others, they might be treated as expendables.
- …Effie and Saude died during our operation.
cn:
- Limbus Company Clear。
- 被称作清理部门。
据说是为了辅助巴士部门行动而成立的部门。
与罪人们不同，这个部门的人员无法借我之手死而复生。正因如此，他们看起来对自身的武器与防具格外用心。
- 部门貌似被分成两部分，好像分别是先我们一步到达并进行侦察等战前准备的先遣部队（LCCB）以及负责对我们作战造成的残骸进行战后清理等事务的收尾部队（LCCA）。
虽然与他们未曾谋面，但根据无意听到的维吉里乌斯的数次通话内容来推测，两个队内好像也存在着许多分科。
- 与隶属于先遣部队事前观测科的埃菲、索德进行协同作业。
- 我得闲便会向他们提出一些自己所好奇的问题，之后我打算对这些了解到的事情进行整理。
- 本来还想问问他们各自负责的工作细节，但由于堂吉诃德突然闯祸，这件事也不了了之。
- 埃菲叹着气补充道，事前观测科是先遣部队里面最不受待见的。根据远多于其他科的人员数量来推测，他们可能被当成了消耗性人力资源。
- ……埃菲和索德在作战中阵亡。

en:
- Seems to be a term that refers to the 12 people on the LCB’s bus with me.
- Based on conversations I overheard, they appear to have “joined” the company similar to how I did, but they’ve been nicknamed like they’re bound here somehow.
- I asked Vergilius about the term, but he didn’t give me a clear answer.
Him and his “You’ll see in due time…” He’s shut down several questions with remarks like that.
…Looks like I have no other option here, I’ve gotta write down whatever I learn.
cn:
- LCB，看起来指代的就是跟我一起坐在巴士上的这十二个人。
- 根据其交流过程中我所听到的内容进行推测，他们似乎以与我类似的方式“加入”了这家公司，但不知为何他们好像有着被囚禁之人的名谓。
- 我向维吉里乌斯询问了这个称谓的意思，但他并没有给出明确的答复。
- 已经有好几个问题都被他用“反正你到时候就会明白……”之类的话给敷衍过去了。
……看来除了把获知的所有新信息认真记录下来之外我已别无选择。

en:
- Adding a couple new discoveries about the Sinners.
- First, it looks like “Sinner” is specifically used to refer to those who’ve formed a contract (that I had no choice for opting out of) with me.
- And it appears they’re the only people I can bring back to life with my clock.
cn:
- 在此补记一些有关罪人意义的新发现。
- 首先，“罪人”这个称谓似乎是用来特指那些与我签订了契约（虽然这并不以我的自由意志为转移）的人。
- 其次，我的钟似乎也只能让这些人死而复生。

en:
- The Sinners might be the ones who can resonate with the Golden Boughs we seek.
- When we approach one, it seems to reveal the *fathoms of the Sinner’s ego*, making us experience their past or peer into their psyche.
cn:
- 罪人说不定指的就是能与我们所寻找的金枝产生共鸣的人。
- 一旦靠近这些金枝，罪人们的“自我心道”便会展现，我们就得以从中体验他们的过往，又或窥探他们的心灵。

en:
- Seems to be a term that refers to urban centers in the City.
- The City is divided into multiple sections, and each of them comprises a “Nest” and a “Backstreets” portion.
- A Nest is basically under the management and protection of a conglomerate called a *Wing*, while the Backstreets aren’t too big of an influence. I think?
- Asked Vergilius if I came from a Nest or the Backstreets, but he ignored me.
cn:
- 似乎是用来特指都市中的各个核心区域。
- 都市被分为许多区块，但是每个区块好像总是会被分为巢和后巷。
- 巢好像是受到被称为区块实控人的大型企业——翼的管理与保护的区域。而后巷貌似没有这么大的影响力。或许吧？
- 我曾经问了一下维吉里乌斯，自己是来自巢还是后巷，但他没理我。

en:
- Companies with the most advanced and influential technology in their Districts, practically ruling over them.
Supposedly they’re corporate entities, but the more I hear about the Wings, the more they sound like governing bodies.
(Come to think of it, Limbus Company doesn’t seem to fit the conventional idea of a company, either. We’re on a bus all the time, for one.)
- Each Wing has trademarked technologies called “Singularities”, and uses the funds earned from them (and ridiculous taxes) to manage the high-class urban area inside its District, known as a *Nest*.
- People who work for a Wing seem to be nicknamed “Feathers”.
cn:
- 在一片区块上坐拥最尖端也最具影响力的技术的公司，说是统治着这一片区块都不为过。
虽以公司为名，但对于翼的说明，我越听越觉得他们是趋近于统治机构一般的存在。
（不过仔细想了想，边狱公司似乎也不符合词典上所定义的公司的概念。比如说，我们一直坐在一辆巴士上到处转悠。）
- 每片翼似乎都有被称为“奇点”的专利技术，并使用该技术的盈利（以及高到荒谬的税收）来管理其区块内被称为“巢”的高级城区。
- 为翼工作的人似乎被称为“羽”。

en:
- Located in District 11’s Nest.
- As evidenced by our nightmarish battle at the checkpoint… K Corp’s Singularity seems to give the user the capability to continuously heal—or regenerate, rather—their body.
Faust called it “Helapoiesis”, but it seems to be more commonly referred to as HP “bullets” or “ampules” by regular denizens of the City.
Thanks to that, all the Sinners died and I almost fainted bearing 12 people’s worth of pain at once…
But, those HP ampules did also help restore my melted lower half to perfectly good health.
- K Corp. seems to be utilizing this technology for a number of industries.
cn:
- 其巢位于11区。
- 记忆中挥之不去的检查站一役里，就像那些不断重伤而复愈的警卫……K公司的奇点能够对使用者进行持续不断的治疗，或者更确切的说，赋予使用者再生的能力。
- 浮士德将其称作 “海拉创生”，但其他都市居民们似乎将这种技术统称为 “HP弹”或者 “HP安瓿”。
拜其所赐，罪人们全军覆没，而我在承受他们的痛苦的过程中也差点昏厥……
但有一说一，多亏了那叫做HP安瓿的东西，我之前被融化的下半身才能复原。
- 据了解，K公司正在借此之利开展各种业务。

en: - According to Samjo, an employee we met at Eunbong’s, the Wing might also be developing food-related tech using the Singularity.
cn: - 据一名我们在银凤炸鸡酒吧遇到的、名为三朝的员工所述，奇点技术似乎在食品相关的科技研发上也有应用。

en:
- Full Name: Lobotomy Corporation. 
- Its Nest was in District 12. A fallen Wing, its spot currently vacant.
It was apparently the epicenter of a City-wide event called the *White Nights and Dark Days*, which everyone seems to know. (Except for me, or would that be the amnesia…?)
The facilities we search through for the Golden Boughs all once belonged to this now-defunct L Corp.
cn:
- 脑叶公司。
- 已折断的翼，目前翼席空缺。其巢位于12区。
都市里人尽皆知的（是只有我不知道，还是属于我丢失记忆中的一部分……？）白夜黑昼事件的中心区域。
我们所搜寻的留有金枝的支部，似乎全都曾属于旧L公司。

en:
- Nagel und Hammer: Located in District 14’s Nest. Nagel obviously means “nail”.
- Having spoken with Meursault, apparently there are *two* factions under the names of ‘Nail’ and ‘Hammer’.
According to him, the armor-clad “Inquisitors” we faced weren’t nearly as prevalent when he worked for the Wing, and they weren’t the majority faction during his time there.
- Unlike the group led by Kromer, N Corp. as a whole doesn’t appear too different from other big corporations outside some rigidness.
cn:
- Nagel und Hammer。钉与锤。其巢位于14区。
- 根据先前与默尔索的交谈来推测，公司内部实际上存在钉子和锤子两个派别。
据他所述，至少在他的任职期间内，我们曾面对过的那些身着金属盔甲的“异端审判官”并不引人注目，而且也不算主流。
- 与克罗默麾下的组织不同，N公司作为一家企业，虽然作风严苛了些许，但是除此之外似乎与一般大型企业的形象别无二致。

en:
- Not sure what its main business is, but some Sinners seem to know a couple things about the Wing.
…If only they’d speak to me at all about it.
cn:
- 虽然不知道他们公司的主营业务是什么，但有几位罪人似乎对N公司多多少少有所了解。
……但问题在于他们尽是些沉默寡言的人。

en:
- Areas of a District not included in the Nest, outside of the Wing’s domain.
The residents are mostly people who can’t afford to live in the Nest.
- Each area is stacked with restaurants, local businesses, living quarters, schools, academies, and a variety of other facilities.
As the name suggests, though, the roads tend to be twisted and intertwined, and there’s a constant air of dampness wherever you go.
Fun thing I’ve noticed is that the boundaries between the Backstreets and the Nests were clearly drawn in every District I’ve visited. (Though I’ve only been to like, three of them).
cn:
- 每个区块中不属于巢的，即不在翼管辖范围内的其他区域。
这里生活着一些因囊中羞涩而无力“归巢”的人。
- 说是巷子，里面却似乎挤满了餐厅、公司、居民区、学校和研究院等各种各样的设施。
错综复杂、蜿蜒交织着的造型配上无时无刻不阴森沉重的氛围，“后巷”这个名字当之无愧。而无论在哪个后巷，风景都别无二致。
有趣的是，无论在哪个区块（虽说我就去过三处），后巷与巢的界限都非常明确。

en:
- A Syndicate of sword-wielding ruffians and libertines roaming the Backstreets.
- Guessing from conversations with the Sinners who wore such Identities, they don’t seem to act or move in groups much despite belonging to a Syndicate.
To be more precise… they do have temporary company from time to time, but there’s no strict subgroups or pecking order.
- …It’s unfortunate that half of their answers were taking the piss, so I am unable to write proper answers here.
cn:
- 剑契组，一个由仗剑游荡于后巷的放荡鬼组成的帮派。
- 与被覆写为剑契组人格的罪人们交谈后，可以推测出他们虽隶属于该帮派，但很少与其他人共事，也几乎不随集体行动。
更准确的来说……有时候他们虽会以临时小队的形式行动，但其中并不存在任何严格的阶级差异或组织架构。
-……只可惜他们对我疑问的回答大半都是在开玩笑，所以我也没法记录什么有价值的东西。

en:
- Sorta freelancers who take care of or help with various jobs and requests in the City.
- They don’t work for free, of course. The whole society seems to be based around money. But… I don’t think I can say for sure that there are absolutely no Fixers willing to do charity work, I guess?
- The ones I’ve seen and heard about were from all walks of life, too diverse for me to neatly summarize. (If talking with mirrored identities counts, too). Maybe it’s a common career?
cn:
- 收尾人，一种自由职业者，处理或协理各种发生在都市里的事件。
- 当然，这并不是志愿活动或无偿工作。毕竟这整个世界似乎都是围绕着金钱而运转的……但也不能保证完全没有例外。（万一呢？）
- 我耳闻目睹（真的能把通过镜像人格对话称为见过面吗）过的收尾人的种类繁多到我难以明确定义。说不定是个很常见的职业？

en:
- A giant Syndicate spread deep and wide across the Backstreets.
- They seem to be characterized by long, single-edged swords with sheaths and dark/wavy clothes.
- They basically earn their keep by taking protection fees from Backstreets businesses under the pretext of offering “safety”.
- From what I heard from the Identities, they seem to be in some kind of conflict with another Syndicate called the Blade Lineage. I didn’t get to hear the reason.
- They follow some sort of hierarchy, and henchmen are generally forbidden from disobeying their superiors.
- …There do seem to be special exceptions if Hong Lu is to be believed.
cn:
- 黑云会，深深扎根于后巷的庞大帮派。
- 其特征似乎是配刀鞘的单刃长剑和飘逸的墨色衣装。
- 他们向后巷的商人们索要保护费，并提供形式上的保护，以此维持生计。
从与罪人们的人格交流中得知，他们似乎与被称为剑契组……的另一个帮派起了某种冲突，但我仍未知晓其中缘由。
- 虽说并非绝对，但其中存在着一定的阶级关系。基本上是服从上级命令的感觉。
- ……不过，通过与鸿璐的交谈推测，似乎偶有特例。

en:
- Small branch-shaped objects that emit a golden glow.
- Don’t really feel like tree branches. My head gets these tingling sensations whenever I get close to one…
- Whatever these are, they certainly aren’t your ordinary gilded twigs that we’re made to go after.
cn:
- 闪耀着金色光芒的一小截树枝形状的物体。
- 我并不觉得它是真实存在的某种树枝。每当接近，我的头都会隐隐作痛……
- 无论其本质如何，让我拼死拼活去收集的总不能只是涂着金漆的普通树枝吧。

en:
- An invention that overlays a person’s identity with a different possibility from numerous other worlds.
- I heard Yi Sang was one of its developers, but he always blabbers things I can’t wrap my head around whenever I ask, so I don’t expect to get any useful down-to-earth info out of him.
- The identities themselves are found via the engine of Mephistopheles. Not sure how it works, but it looks like you can’t just find and grab the identities you want. Trial and error can sometimes stumble upon previously unseen versions of the Sinners, too.
cn:
- 在各种可能性中叠加自己的其他可能性的技术。
- 我曾听说李箱是它的开发者之一。但无论我怎么问，他只会喋喋不休地说些我难以理解的东西，所以我已经不指望能从他那儿得到任何有用的信息了。
- 这些人格本身是通过梅菲斯托费勒斯的引擎找到的。我不确定这究竟是什么原理，但看起来你没法直接找到并提取那些你想要的人格。如果反复尝试的话，有时也能找到罪人的新人格。

en:
- Although I can’t write how exactly those identities are used in full… (Feels like attempting to makes me unsure somehow.)
Synchronizing the extracted identity with my LCB-PDA and the bus window allowed me to communicate with or feel it, in a way.
Calling forth the image of the identity in my mind, I get a sense of understanding as if I'm talking to the Sinner like usual… And once the Sinner and I make an unspoken agreement, the identity overrides the Sinner, accompanied by the sound of glass shattering.
…Can’t think of a more suitable description.
- While overlaid with an identity, the Sinner appears pretty different from usual. On top of attires and weapons, their personalities can also change pretty wildly, and sometimes make me question if they’re really the Sinners I know.
Fortunately, they seem to go back to their original selves when they’re done using an identity. But, prolonged use might cause small side effects like headaches or residual traces of the identity’s personality surfacing from time to time.
cn:
- 尽管我不能正确的用文字表述人格的使用方法……（不如说我对此根本一窍不通）
当被提取出的人格与LCB-PDA及巴士的玻璃窗同步时，我似乎能与其进行某种形式的对话或感应。
罪人的人格浮现于脑海中的感觉，仿佛与平时当面对话并无二异……当罪人与我心照不宣地应允彼此的那一瞬间，伴随着玻璃破碎的声音，罪人的人格即被覆写。
……我想不到更加合适的表述了。
- 人格被覆写的罪人与平时的模样大相径庭。服装与武器不必多说，连性格也发生了翻天覆地的变化，甚至有时在我眼中已然变成了另一个陌生人。
万幸的是，人格使用完毕后罪人就会变回原样。不过，长时间使用貌似会残留人格的痕迹，导致不同人格个性闪现的后遗症。

en:
- Seems to be what they call all kinds of gangs and organizations in the City.
- The term covers such a wide range of things, you can call pretty much any group of people together under a name a Syndicate.
cn:
- 在都市各处聚集成一股股势力的团体似乎被统称为帮派。
- 由于帮派一词指代的范围过于庞大，所以比起说是有什么特别的标准，倒不如说基本上只要以团队行动就能被称为帮派。

en: - From turning rudimentary cogs to overlaying an alternate identity via a mirror, the City has every level of technology.
cn: - 从传动齿轮彼此啮合，到窥视镜中覆写人格……这座都市里各种各样的技术应有尽有。

en:
- A railway of purple light. It was labeled 'Line 5'.
- Just like in our last railway, chains of battles continued through consecutive stations, and we even faced off against more Peccatulum Invidiae. Some of them seemed to be reflecting relatively new possibilities as well... I wonder how they work?
- This railway began with two sections, met in the middle, and converged into one. It was pretty annoying to be locked out of Identity Cards I had already used in the second Section.
- Between each section was this odd... thing that empowered the Sinners. We had to carefully choose which of them to select, as it seemed to affect not only the Sinners, but our enemies as well.
cn:
- 紫色的轨道。上面写着5号线。
- 和以前的线路一样，战斗在数个站点中连续进行，同样需要与嫉妒罪种战斗。遇到的嫉妒罪种，还反映出最近才打捞到的可能性……这到底是什么原理呢？
- 轨道是分开的两个区段在中途合二为一的结构。因为在一个区段中使用的人格卡，不能在另一个区段再使用，所以有点麻烦。
- 区段之间有着某种能赋予罪人力量的奇怪存在。然而，它不仅会影响罪人，也会影响敌人，所以必须谨慎选择。

en:
- Apparently, Associations in different cardinal regions—West, East, South, and North—each have different uniforms. It also seemed that Association Fixers working in the same region as their headquarters were considered to be stronger or higher-ranking than Association Fixers in other regions. And, sometimes, transfers between regions happened as a form of promotion as well.
- On the other end of the spectrum lies the largest Syndicates, the Fingers. Unlike the Associations, however, their outfits didn't vary much by region. They'd sometimes wear different outfits, but it's moreso due to the fact that they don't have a strict uniform code.
cn:
- 根据西部、东部、南部、北部的区分，协会的服饰似乎会有所不同。根据协会的不同，特定的区域会被视为本部，更强的收尾人会被分配到那里，同时也会有以晋升之名在区域间调动的情况。
- 与之相对，作为庞大帮派的手指的情况……与协会相比，不同区域的服装似乎没有太大差别。虽然也会有服饰不同的情况，但我认为那可能是他们并没有规定的制服，而是随喜好穿着的缘故。

en: - When declaring duels, the eastern Branch of the Cinq Association, instead of doing so by tossing their glove, do so by announcing their affiliation and name. - The biggest difference has to be their dress code and weaponry. Unlike the pretty iconic capes and large hats worn by the western Fixers, the eastern branch of the Cinq association wears a deft-looking outfit that blends in better with the general outfits of the eastern region. Also... unlike the other Cinq Fixers or Identities we've met thus far, the Sinner with the eastern Cinq Association's Identity primarily used hand-to-hand combat as their primary means of fighting. - They wear this bracelet... or bangle called 'Virescent Pyrojade' on their wrist. Looks like these can be used to melt whatever the user touches by applying high heat. - Apparently, the green flame of the Virescent Pyrojades has the power to burn only the object that the user wants it to. ... Honestly? That sounds like a Singularity-tier tech to me.
cn:
- 据说，东部Cinq协会不以投掷手套，而是通过表明自身所属与姓名来申请决斗。
- 其最大的区别在于服装和武器。与西部那身令人印象深刻的蓝色披风和宽大帽子不同，制服似乎换成了便于灵活行动的东部风格服装……虽然至今见过的Cinq协会收尾人和人格都使用刺剑，但持有Cinq协会东部人格的罪人似乎是将格斗术作为主要作战方式。
- 其手腕上佩戴着名为翠炎玉器的手镯。利用它，似乎可以用高温熔化任何以手触及之物。
- 翠炎玉器的绿色火焰似乎可以只灼烧使用者指定的目标。这样的话，翠炎玉器不也是种奇点技术吗？

en:
- This must be referring to the five particularly significant Syndicates of the Backstreets.
- It's been said that they're so powerful and influential that not even Wings or Associations can easily pick a fight with them. Rodya and Heathcliff told me that people in the Backstreets have to learn and abide by their rules if they want to survive.
- Weirdly enough, Ryōshū seems to know a lot about them. I was given a warning about Ryōshū's 'background' when I first boarded the bus... maybe that's got something to do with it.
cn:
- 是指后巷的各种帮派中，尤为庞大的5个帮派。
- 据说其势力十分强大，就连翼或是协会都无法轻易对其出手。罗佳和希斯克利夫告诉过我，要想在后巷生存，就必须了解并遵守他们的规则。
- 良秀对他们的情况异常了解。初登上巴士时，我就收到过关于良秀其背景的警告……说不定其中有什么关系。

en:
- The Ring, one of the five Fingers, values art and knowledge.
- They keep popping up in discussions regarding the Corridor.
- I haven't had the chance to meet anyone from the Ring, but we ran into some people who used to be a part of it. They sure seemed to like art.
- And when I say 'art', I mean the extremely gruesome kind. From what I could gather from the Identities and what Ryōshū told me, their art often consists of sculptures stitched together from amputated body parts... paintings made of blood... things like that.
- They seem to be internally divided into various 'factions'. I picked up names like 'pointillists' or 'fauvists' among them—maybe they're divided along the lines of artistic philosophy.
cn:
- 重视艺术与知识的手指。
- 当谈及走廊时总会被提及的帮派。
- 虽然我没有亲眼见过环指，但我们在呼啸山庄见到了曾隶属于环指之人。给人的印象是其确实非常喜爱艺术。
- 综合通过人格获取的信息和良秀的说明来看，他们所谓的艺术，似乎远非一般的残忍行为所能相提并论。像是切断人体再重新接上……或是用血来绘画……
- 其内部似乎派系林立。由于对艺术的见解不同，他们因而分成了不同的派系。点彩派、野兽派……我已经听说过有这样的派系名称。

en:
- Hongyuan Bioengineering Group. Their Nest is located in District 8.
- It's all stuffed into one big... Actually, the word 'big' does a disservice to the sheer magnitude of the megastructure that comprises the entirety of H Corp.'s District. District 8 as a whole is called 'Hongyuan'.
- Their Singularity is the creation of the 'Bolus', a type of medicine. I've been told that these things can be used not only to heal wounds but also for body modification procedures. But something about the way these medicines change your body creeps me out.
