- Those who took these Boluses or used them in procedures would gain body parts of specific creatures—or have parts of their own bodies replaced with them.
- In District 8, depending on the amount of your net worth, the size of the room allotted to you could either grow or shrink, and the buildings themselves shift around to reflect that. So it's 'space' here, huh? Using time in T Corp. to measure one's wealth was weird enough.
cn:
- 鸿园生命工程集团。其巢位于8区。
- 巨大……不，巨大这个词都无法形容这压倒性的整个庞大建筑物，其整体似乎就是H公司的区域。整个8区都被称为“鸿园”。
- 持有制作被称为“丸”的药物的奇点，据说其不仅能用于常规治疗，还能用于人体改造手术。药物渗入身体并导致身体变形……总觉得不安。
- 服用丸或接受手术的人，身体的某处大多会长出特定生物的特征性部分，或是部位直接被后者替代。
- 据说房间的面积会根据持有的财产定期变化，建筑本身也会移动。在T公司，财产决定了生存的时间，而此处则是空间啊……

en:
- They're something of a private army for various forces of Hongyuan.
- The only branch we've met so far is the Mao branch, but there are other Heishou Packs with characteristics of different animals.
- Jia Xichun told me that they wield the powers of twelve animals in a list called the 'Twelve Earthly Branches', something that most likely carries some sort of ritualistic meaning.
- I wonder if their allegiance could be traded? Conversations with the Identities revealed that they often change their masters—or, according to the Heishou, their 'lords'.
- Given that R Corp. also has 'Packs' themed after animals, I could draw some similarities between the Heishou and them.
cn:
- 似乎是鸿园势力所驱使的特殊武装团体。
- 我们遇到的只有卯，但据说也存在拥有其他动物特征的黑兽。
- 据贾惜春所说，他们能够运用被称为十二支的12种动物的特征，并且其中可能含有咒术层面的含义。
- 黑兽的所有权是可以交易的吗？通过与人格们的对话得知，其似乎频繁更换主公。
- 或许是因为R公司同样是由以动物为主题的部队组成的，我总觉得两者有些相似。

en:
- As one of the five Fingers, they prioritize loyalty.
- We first encountered them during our journey in U Corp.'s Great Lake. They refer to each other using sibling terms like 'Big Brother', 'Big Sister', 'Little Brother', and so on and so forth, and I could really feel that they had this familial bond.
- They carry these books called the 'Book of Vengeance', in which they write down their grudges and go after anyone who's had the misfortune of getting written up... Speaking of which, just how long is that guy going to chase us for? I'm starting to get worried that I might one day find him barging into Mephistopheles.
- Recalling the events at J Corp., I think Rodya also suffered from her encounter with the Middle. Did their 'grudge' regarding Rodya get resolved? It's still kind of a sensitive subject, so I couldn't really bring it up to her just yet. I'm gathering more and more questions to ask Rodya as the days go by.
cn:
- 重视忠义的手指。
- 最初在U公司的大湖与他们遭遇。他们之间以大哥、大姐、弟妹等称呼彼此相称，氛围也如同真正的家人一般。
- 他们携带着名为复仇账簿的物品，据说他们会在上面记录仇怨的对象并不停追踪……但他们究竟打算追到什么程度？一想到这样下去他们说不定会一路追到梅菲斯托费勒斯内部，我就感到害怕。
- 回想起J公司的事，罗佳过去似乎和中指有过不愉快的纠葛。罗佳的仇怨是否已被清算？因为是敏感的话题，所以我至今还未能问出口。感觉想问罗佳的事情日渐增多了。

en:
- They're... people, maybe? Anyways, they appear during the Night in the Backstreets.
- Aboard the bus, I just saw them as a vague crowd that moved past us, but... when we faced them in person outside the bus, they were truly unrelenting and numerous.
- As they sweep the streets, they melt down everything that needs to be cleansed—dead bodies in the Backstreets, unauthorized constructions, things like that. I do think it's somewhat necessary, but... I was at a loss for words when I learned that they melted down the random, unlucky people who got caught outside during the Night in the Backstreets, too.
- They can even melt down and eat their own and heal from it, which gave us quite the trouble. Really, really hoping that we won't have to fight them again.
cn:
- 后巷深宵出现的来历不明之人？
- 从巴士内观察时，只觉得有东西匆匆经过……但当我们在外面遇到清道夫时，才发现他们异常凶猛且密集。
- 从路上被遗弃的尸体到未经许可的建筑物，据说他们会将后巷中任何需要清扫的东西尽数溶解，并将其变成燃料。虽说是必要的工作……但是听到他们连好端端路过的行人也要溶解之后，我便哑口无言了。
- 他们连倒下的同伴都能溶解并吞噬，进而每次都能得到恢复，这对我们造成了极大的困扰。但愿今后……不要再与他们战斗了。

en:
- Every 3:13 in the morning, the Sweepers emerge for eighty minutes to clean up the Backstreets of the City. 
- Starting from the borders of each Nest, they simultaneously emerge from the ground, march through the Backstreets, and sweep everything in their path away. Their march consists of three waves with about ten minutes of reprieve in between. I don't want to imagine what could've happened if we didn't even have that.
- Lots of things are banned when the Night in the Backstreets begins. We can't take videos or audio, or break into or destroy someone else's domicile...
- That reminds me—Faust told me that the Head wields the Sweepers. I can't even begin to imagine how they even cooperate with each other. Maybe it's got something to do with Taboos? Who knows. I certainly don't.
cn:
- 每天凌晨3点13分。这是清道夫清扫都市后巷的80分钟时间。
- 清道夫从各个巢的边界开始，自地下同时现身，沿着后巷推进并将所有东西一扫而空。其行进共计3波，每波之间有约10分钟的休息时间。如果没有休息时间的话……简直难以想象。
- 据说后巷深宵期间有许多被禁止之事。据罪人们所说，不能录像或录音、也不允许擅自侵入或破坏他人的居住区域……
- 说起来，浮士德曾提及清道夫是为首脑工作的。我完全无法想象他们是如何达成合作关系的。这是否与禁忌有关？目前还不太清楚。

en: - A Singularity of a Wing capable of permanently erasing or destroying technologies. - Its potency and scope of effect depend on the price paid, but a reasonably powerful Concept Incinerator can erase every document related to the incinerated technology, photographs, and even memories—leaving behind nothing or, if something somehow does survive, a smudge and nothing more. Does the Concept Incinerator delete a concept like it never even existed, or does it just "smudge" our perception of it? - Faust elaborated with an example—deleting the general concept of, say, a "clock," requires literally everything even tangentially related to clocks getting chucked into the concept incinerator, but deleting only a specific model of a clock is as easy as tossing its blueprint in. In other words, a smaller scope equals easier incineration equals cheaper erasure.
cn:
- 能够永久消灭特定技术的某个翼的奇点。
- 根据价格不同，效果的强度和适用范围也会变化，但使用性能良好的概念焚化炉的话，从与焚毁的技术有关的文章和照片到人们的记忆，似乎大部分都能粉碎或消除。是概念本身消失了，还是在那人看起来概念崩溃了呢？
- 浮士德说明道，如果要消除时钟这样大范围的概念的话，需要将所有与时钟相关的事物都投入概念焚化炉，但如果只想焚毁特定时钟模型的概念的话，只需要将那个模型的设计图投入概念焚化炉就足够了。也就是说，范围越小，越容易焚毁，价格也更低。

en: - The Thumb, one of the five Fingers, is utterly obsessed with the concept of propriety. I've seen them popping people's arms out and blasting their jaws off just for questioning a superior. Though I've only met The Thumb members of the eastern branch, the Sinners tell me that they generally play by similar rules regardless of where they're based. - "Rank," or "Class," is something they're all really touchy about, which probably explains all those ridiculously detailed rules on the definitions, circumstances, types, and so on and so forth surrounding them. - According to those Soldato... Secando? Terzo? Anyways, according to those Thumb Soldatos we ran into in Daguanyuan, we apparently deserve to lose our jaws simply for invoking a Capo Quarto's—Lei Heng's—name without deference. - Hmm, I am the Manager of LCB... I wonder where I rank in their scale? Darn, I should've asked them when I had the chance...
cn:
- 近乎疯狂地执着于礼仪的手指。
- 有人只是向上级顶嘴，就被拔掉胳膊或打飞下巴。虽然目前只和东部的拇指见过面，但根据罪人们所说，无论哪个地区都有类似的风气。
- 非常重视阶级。或许正因如此，划分阶级的标准或情况、阶级的种类之类的东西相当多。
- 我们在大观园遇到的……二级还是三级士兵来着？总之从那些拇指成员的话来看……貌似我们边狱公司巴士部门的罪人们只是直呼四级指挥官雷横的名字便是无礼，应当被打飞下巴。
- 如果以拇指的标准来看，我作为LCB的执行经理是什么级别的人呢？有机会的话去问一下好了……

en:
- The Pinky is one of the five Fingers that follows the Virtue of Humanity (仁), which I'm still a bit unsure as to what it means. The point is, they're a bit more cryptic than the other Fingers when it comes to what they pursue.
- Instead of going around in their uniforms and advertising their true alignments like the other Fingers, they lurk anonymously in other organizations.
- There seems to be some condition and means of summoning the Pinkies all together, but when they're not summoned, they just lead their own lives as though they aren't even a part of this Finger. I don't know, can we even call them a real organized crime Syndicate?
cn:
- 重视仁的手指。但关于仁究竟是什么，我还不太清楚。与其他手指所追求的东西相比，感觉更加模糊一些。
- 与其他手指不同，他们隐藏着自己的身份在别的组织内活动。
- 小指似乎会以特定的标准和方法召集成员。如果没有召集，他们甚至不知道彼此的真实身份，就这样生活着。这能称之为帮派吗？

en:
- A bug that, when inserted into the human body, will share with its host the memories of the person who became its core.
- Immediately after insertion via the ear, the Anamnaworm will rapidly assimilate into the host, granting them all the memories and knowledge of the source individual used to make it. Convenient, but each Anamnaworm comes with the caveat that it cannot be removed by any other means than the conditions prescribed at its creation.
- Traditionally, all H Corp. Hierarchs were supposed to accept the "Xianhuang Worm," an Anamnaworm created from the founding Hierarch, into their bodies, but we managed to make it to the Tiekan Temple in time to prevent it from assimilating into Jia Xichun.
- In the chaotic aftermath that followed, the New League of Nine Littérateurs snatched the Xianhuang Worm away. Wei told me that, though the knowledge that once resided within the worm may be significant, the sheer time that has passed since its extraction from the previous host's body must have eroded much of it.
cn:
- 放入体内后，能继承作为材料之人的记忆的虫。
- 将虫放入耳中的瞬间就会被其同化，获得作为虫的材料之人的所有记忆和知识。但相对地，虫一旦被同化，在满足被制作时刻下的条件之前，无法用任何手段取出。
- 虽然H公司的家主必须移植由最初的家主所制成的、被称作仙皇虫的虫……万幸，我们及时到达了铁槛寺，阻止了贾惜春被仙皇虫同化。
- 新九人会趁乱拿走了仙皇虫。卫告诉我们，虽然其中的信息很珍贵，但因为它从体内被取出的时间过长，很可能大部分的信息都已经丢失了。

en:
- There seem to be these mysterious figures known only as Heishou-Xianren, each managing a Pack and the corresponding Heishou Bolus. I wonder how they're distinguished from the Xianren of the Tiekan Temple?
- The right to "own" the Heishou Packs is called a "leash," and I think it's a kind of commodity that can be traded between people. Didn't get the chance to see for myself what those "leashes" look like, though.
- There seems to be a way to "un-leash" a Heishou and free them from service. But from what information I could gather from the Heishou Pack Identities, such generosity rarely ever happens because the price of freeing even a single Heishou is far too costly.
cn:
- 似乎有管理黑兽丸、名为黑兽仙人的存在。他们与铁槛寺的仙人们有什么区别呢？
- 黑兽的所有权被称作“辔头”，似乎也可以被买卖。但尚未确认“辔头”的形态。
- 似乎按照某种标准支付一定代价，就可以解放黑兽。不过，根据从黑兽人格们那里得到的信息推测，仅解放一人付出的代价就相当沉重，因此几乎没有人愿意解开辔头。

en:
- They're "The Head." Located in... Well, I'd assume they're located in District 1.
- If anyone breaks a Taboo of the City—whenever, wherever—The Head will swoop in to punish the perpetrator.
- Normally, such infractions invite only the Claws, which are like enforcers from C Corp., but a Taboo violation of a sufficient scale might even end up summoning these beings called "Arbiters."
- I saw them in Hong Lu's memories of the Kong Family massacre. The moment the Kong Family "violated" a Taboo, the Head swooped in and destroyed all evidence that the transgression had ever occurred.
cn:
- 首脑。巢的位置……应当是在1区吧？
- 似乎只要有人在都市打破了禁忌，无论是什么情况首脑都会出现进行处罚。
- 通常只有被称作爪牙的C公司武力负责人前来，但根据禁忌的规模，似乎也会有被称作调律者的人亲自前来。
- 曾在鸿璐的记忆中见到了孔灭日。在孔家触犯禁忌之后，首脑立刻抹去了与禁忌相关的所有事物。

en:
- E.G.O Gears extracted by the LCE or N Corp. both have traits that distinguish them from Lobotomy Corporation's E.G.O.
- LCE E.G.O gears use "Attunement Boost" to surge the source Abnormality's characteristics to the forefront, and the N Corp. E.G.O gear used by Jia Huan had an extra feature that generated a shield wall of sorts to protect its user in a moment of emergency.
cn:
- LCE或N公司提取的E.G.O装备根据各自的研究成果，似乎都与脑叶公司的E.G.O有着不同的特征。
- LCE部门的E.G.O通过感应度增幅，能高度展现异想体的特性，而贾环使用的N公司E.G.O则有着在遇到危机时形成护盾、保护使用者的特性。

en:
- Jia Xichun ultimately won the Family Hierarch War and became H Corp.'s Hierarch, but had a slight stumble at the beginning of her reign due to Jia Yuanchun's machinations.
- Thankfully, as Jia Xichun managed to win the faith of the Four Families and the board of directors, the motion of no confidence Jia Yuanchun put forth failed to garner enough votes. Jia Xichun said she wishes to make Hongyuan a place where no one needs to live in fear, a place where one does not need to project fear... Perhaps H Corp. can finally leave behind its terrible past and change for the better?
- ... Speaking of which, are we ever going to leave this place? They've already held two separate farewell banquets for us, and after a few more excursions, I might need a third hand to count the number of times we'd bid our final good-byes to those guards at the gate. We're... we're not settling down here or anything, are we?
cn:
- 家主之争的结果是贾惜春坐上了家主之位。但由于贾元春的计谋，贾惜春的处境变得岌岌可危。
- 万幸，多亏了她在一个月内获得了四大家族与董事们的信任，不信任投票以失败告终。贾惜春说，她想创造一个不再令人畏惧，也不再畏惧一切的鸿园。或许那个充满可怖事物的H公司，从今往后也会有所改变吧。
- 说起来，我们什么时候离开鸿园呢？宴席已经吃了两回，和门卫告别的次数更是快要两只手都数不过来。该不会……就这么一直住下去了吧？

en: - The House of Spiders is said to have been formed by the Five Fingers with a common goal. The Fingers—at least those I've come across—hardly seem like the sort that could ever see eye to eye... Learning that they could actually come together and cooperate was a bit surprising. Makes me wonder if they've ever teamed up for anything else behind the scenes. - The organization is made up of five "Nursefathers," chosen from each Finger, and five "Apprentices" brought in to fill the gap after Ryōshū left. - They came up with grand terms for what they gathered to create—"the strongest killer," "the blade that cuts through all"... but these were really just another way to dress up the true purpose of their organization: to nurture and train someone with an aptitude to wield the Arayashiki and turn them into something akin to a living Concept Incinerator. That someone turned out to be Ryōshū, our Sinner #4... and while most of its members didn't survive to see it, the House did accomplish their objective, in the end.
cn:
- 据说是由五指怀着共同的目标而建立的组织。可我迄今为止遇到的手指们，无论哪一个似乎都与其他手指并不对付……得知他们还会互相合作，有些令人惊讶。莫非手指们还有其他合力制作的东西吗？
- 由从各个手指选出的五位父辈，以及在良秀离去后作为其替代而选出的五位子辈组成。
- 最强的杀手、斩断一切的刀……虽然有着如此夸张的名头，实际上却是培养阿赖耶识的适配者，继而制成一种可以斩断一切的概念焚化炉的团体。而那个适配者正是4号罪人良秀……事实上他们成功了。

en:
- A Finger known for its unwavering faith in the Prescripts.
- Their members follow these so-called "Prescripts" without question. I wonder who sends out the messages...
- The Index Nursefather and his Apprentice we encountered received their Prescripts on a device, but it seems the other members of The Index receive theirs on paper slips delivered by Messengers—which raises a question: can Prescripts be delivered by other methods as well? Emails... or a phone call, maybe?
- From what I've seen and heard so far, there seem to be positions within The Index called "Proselytes," "Proxies," and "Messengers"... but information on their hierarchy and exact roles is still unknown.
cn:
- 重视对指令的信奉的手指。
- 虽然听说他们会盲从所谓的指令，但那些指令是由谁下达的呢？
- 虽然食指的父辈与子辈是通过终端接收指令，但属于食指的其他人格似乎是通过传令员带来的纸条接受指令。若是这样，指令还会以其他形式被接收吗？比如电邮……或者是电话之类的……
- 综合迄今为止的见闻所得到的信息来看，食指的职位似乎有苦行者、代行者、以及传令员。而其位阶以及具体的职责则仍不清楚。

en:
- A Wing War that took place with the Old L Corp. as one of the main players—before the rise of Lobotomy Corporation.
- The horrors we experienced through Gregor's Fathoms were apparently only a tiny glimpse of the unspeakable things that actually happened during the War. Both Gregor and Outis seem extremely unwilling to talk about what exactly they witnessed back then.
- I've heard that just a record of fighting in the War can lead to exclusion from many benefits in the City—Nest residence rights, for example. And this applies not only to the losing side but to the ones who joined the victors as well... but for what reason?
- The Old G Corp., which fell apart following the War, reportedly possessed three decisive weapons that fought on the front lines—the Maggot Prince, the Moth Princess, and the Lord of Flies. Just hearing the name makes me... well, not want to encounter anything of the sort.
- Gregor metamorphosed into the Roach Emperor, a Wing's decisive weapon whose rumors are told only in urban legends. Even Vergilius found him a difficult opponent to face. I wonder if the other entities—"decisive weapons"—were that strong, too. And of course, just what kind of insane force did the winning Wings have at their disposal to emerge as victors?
cn:
- 以脑叶公司之前的L公司为中心发生的翼际战争。
- 在格里高尔的自我心道中经历的惨状，不过是实际战争中发生的众多事情的极少一部分。格里高尔和奥提斯似乎都不愿谈及曾经看见过些什么。
- 听说哪怕只是参与了烟霾战争，就会被排除出包含巢的移居权在内的众多都市福利。不仅是败方，连胜方也是一样……到底是什么原因呢？
- 在战后没落的旧G公司，据说曾有着在最前线活跃的三种决战兵器。蛆虫王子、飞蛾公主、以及苍蝇之王……光是听到名字，就让人完全不想碰见他们。
- 只存在于都市的传说之中的决战兵器。变形为蜚蠊皇帝的格里高尔，就连维吉里乌斯都无法轻易与之抗衡。其他的特殊个体……那些决战兵器们，也像他那么强吗？若是这样的话，在那些获胜的翼之中，究竟有着怎样怪物一般的家伙啊？

en:
- According to Sinclair from the future—or, perhaps, according to one of Sinclair's future possibilities—another war seems to have broken out where he came from.
- The Second Smoke War. If such a future ever becomes reality, what would it mean for us all?
cn:
- 在来自未来的辛克莱，不，在或许是未来的可能性的辛克莱的世界中，似乎又发生了战争。
- 第二次烟霾战争……如果那个未来真的到来了，我们又会变成什么样呢。

en:
- In that mansion, Faust told me to "simply do as you will—as one seeks the stars in the night sky." I still don't fully understand the whats and hows, but by resonating with the Golden Bough, I've gained access to several unusual abilities.
- I can slow down time, support the Sinners when they use E.G.O, and suppress the strength of our enemies. And now, I can even summon the Sinners' Identities from afar. Faust insists that it's not a "summoning magic," though...
- Hohenheim says the Golden Boughs we've gathered are being grafted together into a single sapling. A single Bough alone can exercise immense power—what would happen if they're all combined? And what exactly do the higher-ups plan to do with it?
cn:
- 浮士德曾说过，“只需如同在夜空中探寻星星那样，随意而行”。虽然我一如既往地没有明白其中的原理，但通过与金枝共鸣，我似乎可以使用各种各样的能力。
- 继减缓时间、支援罪人使用E.G.O、以及抑制敌方的力量之后，现在的我甚至可以远距离召唤罪人的人格。当然，浮士德坚称那并非是如同召唤那般的魔法之力……
- 霍恩海姆曾说过要将我们收集到的金枝嫁接成一株树苗。哪怕只是一根根枝条就展现出了惊人的力量，集合起来的话又会发生什么呢。以及，公司又打算用它们做些什么呢。

en: - This is "every Fixer's dream" and the reason they live for, says Don Quixote. "Individuals who have attained the complete perfection of liberty and freedom as Fixers"... is what she so enthusiastically proclaimed about these people. Though, thinking back on the Fixers we've met and the Fixer Identities we've used so far... I can't help but feel that Don Quixote's statement contains a bit of her usual hyperbole. - Even Don Quixote doesn't seem all too sure why colors are used to name them in the first place. Some of the speculations attributed are that colors are easy to remember, and that colors represent the unique way of life each Color Fixer pursues. - The Red Gaze. The Indigo Elder. The Yellow Harpoon... we've fought alongside three Color Fixers already. Perhaps we'll come to encounter others in the future, but I'd definitely prefer not to meet them as enemies.
cn:
- 那是所有收尾人的梦想、人生目标。作为收尾人实现了自由的人们……堂吉诃德如此热情地解释道。然而，根据迄今为止遇见的收尾人们以及收尾人的人格来看，诸如“所有收尾人的梦想”以及“人生目标”之类的说法，更像是堂吉诃德特有的夸张。
- 关于为什么偏偏是颜色，堂吉诃德也说不清楚。容易记住、或是作为活出自己独有的色彩的比喻……似乎有各种各样的推测。
- 猩红视线、靛蓝老人、蜜黄标枪……我们已经与三位特色并肩作战过了。或许某天我们还会与其他特色相遇，但可千万不要以敌人的身份相见……

en:
- I met Moses, LCD's On-site Investigative Reasoning Team Leader.
- Unlike me, who can only tell whether an entity is a Distortion or not through a vague sense of frequency waves, so to speak... She seems to have the ability to somehow directly perceive and witness potential Distortions within other people. It's really a mysterious power, I'll give her that.
- Aeng-du and Bamboo-hatted Kim have joined the LCD, too. Meaning, we'll be crossing paths with them more often than we think.
cn:
- 遇见了LCD部门的现场推理队长摩西。
- 与依靠像频率一般的感觉来辨别是否为扭曲的我不同，她似乎有着准确看见人身上扭曲的不可思议的能力。
- 樱桃和金笠也成了LCD的队员。今后大概也会时不时碰面吧。

en:
- Outis suggested that the "Muga," which the House tried to turn Ryōshū into, might be a kind of Concept Incinerator, too... but Faust flatly rejected the idea. The principle and nature of the Muga are entirely different from how a Concept Incinerator might work, she said.
- According to Hohenheim, a technology capable of burning away the very concept of an object or a being simply by throwing the thing you want erased into it—that alone would amount to a Singularity.
- Yi Sang added that it is because all that is tethered to what has been placed within the Muga is severed away, and that which is severed from all becomes what exists yet has been disconnected from the world, thereby its state assuming nonexistence for the universe... I might not have understood that explanation before, but now, I think... I can at least piece together a little something.
- Rien, the Index Nursefather, left a warning that Ryōshū will be the most important subject of discussion in the next Finger Bow-Bell. I have no idea how exactly a Finger Bow-Bell takes place, or how dangerous it might be... but one thing is for sure: it's coming, and I'll need to brace myself for the troubles it'll bring.
cn:
- 虽然奥提斯曾推测，蜘蛛巢试图让良秀成为的无我可能也是概念焚化炉的一种，但浮士德却断言其原理与性质与概念焚化炉并不相同。
- 霍恩海姆说，如果存在不需要放入原件、只需要放入想要消去的物品就能将其概念焚化的技术的话，仅凭这点就能将其称为奇点了。
- 李箱补充解释道，与放入的物品相连的一切都会被斩断，而那被斩断了一切的物品即便存在于此处，与世界的联系也会断开，继而变得不存在于世界上……虽然过去的我可能不太理解，但现在似乎多少明白了那是什么意思。
- 里恩警告说，在下次拉勾中，良秀的存在会变得十分重要。虽然我不知道拉勾会以什么形式进行、又会有多么危险，但为了今后会被卷入的事件，至少得事先做好心理准备。

en:
- A crimson sign or a mark that I've seen on a few people, one of them being Sinclair.
- It appears that Sinclair's Sign has the power to summon a version of himself from a period forward in time. Faust said it was a possibility of a certain future, or something akin to an offshoot event of an offshoot world. It certainly felt distinct from having him wear an Identity from a Mirror World.
- Demian's enigmatic words were the first thing that came to my mind when Sinclair first awakened the power of his Sign—that he would return when Sinclair becomes one with beautiful stars.
- Is drawing all three strokes of his Sign... not what Demian meant by "soaring into the sky, having unshakable faith in the power of the heart"? Well, what else could it be...? It hurts my head just to think about it.
- If only others could see the Signs, too... I would've asked them for their input. Hmm, that reminds me. Didn't Sonya say something to Rodya about her not having the Sign or being unable to see them?
- Other than myself, the Sinners are the only other people in the world who were there for that conversation, and it's clearly not a good idea to bring this up to Rodya, so... Hmm, who should I ask?
cn:
- 在包括辛克莱在内的数人身上看到的红色图案。
- 辛克莱的印记似乎具有召唤未来的自己的能力。浮士德将其称作未来的某种可能性，或者说是分支世界，但那和覆盖镜像世界人格的方式明显不太一样。
- 当辛克莱的印记展现力量时，我最先想到的是……德米安曾留下的像是谜题一样的话语，他说会在辛克莱成为耀眼繁星之一的那天回来。
- 难道当印记的每一画都被彻底填满，就是他所说的坚信内心的力量振翅而起吗？如果不是……越想脑海里就越是复杂。
- 如果其他人也能看到印记，或许还能寻求点建议……啊，这么一说，索尼亚似乎对罗佳说过，她既看不到也未能拥有印记什么的？
- 记得那段对话的除了我就只剩下罪人们了，但因此就去询问罗佳似乎也不太好。问谁比较好呢。

en:
- Meursault remembered that conversation. Well, of course he did.
- Anyway, I finally found the information I needed. What Sonya had said to Rodya on that day was that she didn't have what it takes to lead.
- It makes me wonder if that condition goes both ways—does having "what it takes to lead" allow one to see the Sign? ... Well, I decided to table that question until the LCE's research could make some progress, since it seemed that they were having trouble making any meaningful discoveries concerning the Sign.
- We sort of have a working theory at this moment, that the Sign may be of the same or similar origin as Singularities and Relics, but... given that I know precious little about those two subjects, this seems to be a case of questions begetting questions.
cn:
- 不出所料，默尔索记得那天的全部对话。
- 虽然那时候索尼亚说罗佳没有领导他人的能力……
- 但反过来说，也许拥有领导他人的能力就可能看得到印记……但关于印记的调查，LCE目前也没有什么特别的成果，所以我准备在哪天研究有了进展后再询问。
- 虽然姑且提出了印记可能与奇点或者遗物同源这一假设……但我对奇点或者遗物也不是很了解，所以只是徒增了疑问而已……

en:
- While we were helping Hohenheim with the Backdoor investigation, we accidentally stumbled into one of the Ring's galleries—that of the Fauvists, to be specific. If we're counting the Ring Nursefather Callisto's Corridor a "gallery," then I guess this is the second gallery of the Ring we'd seen.
- Kira seemed to be incredibly impressed by some of the taxidermied animals in there, and... I must admit, some of those were pretty cool, even for me. As for the rest... Well. I don't feel that they necessarily need to be described here.
- Each school of the Ring seems to have pretty distinct ideas on beauty or artistic philosophy. Ryōshū explained that there were minor schisms even among followers of Fauvism.
- Rufo, that Fauvist Docent, claimed that Ryōshū is taking the steps toward founding her own movement.
- So... going by how the other Schools are named, will it be something like Abbreviatists? SANGRIAists? Shortenists...? Ooh, maybe Ryōshū'll combine and acronymize it all into A.S.S.ists? ... Wait, that doesn't really work...
cn:
- 帮霍恩海姆调查后门的时候，我们曾经进入过环指野兽派的画廊。如果环指父辈……卡利斯托的走廊也算是画廊的话，这就相当于我们的第二次参观了……
- 虽然绮罗看到那些被制成标本的动物时觉得它们很酷，看上去很高兴，不过……确实有几件连我看了也觉得很帅的作品。当然剩下的部分……唔。也没有必要特意写下来吧。
- 同属于环指，不同的派别所追求的审美？或者说艺术观念？似乎也大相径庭。据良秀所说，即使同在野兽派中，各人的品味偏好也都不尽相同。
- 根据野兽派的讲解员……名为卢佛之人所说，良秀似乎正在开创属于自己的思潮。
- 那么……是要叫万短至艺派……之类的名号吗？还是叫缩略派……？既然是良秀，那或许会进一步缩略，变成“万·派”或者“短·派”……不过总觉得有点奇怪……

en:
- Curse my curiosity, because it actually compelled me to pay Ryōshū a visit and ask her if she was planning on naming her school, what it was going to be called, and various other questions that seemed to annoy her. Needless to say, I was kicked out rather unceremoniously mid-question.
- I don't know how many Schools of art and sects there are in the Ring, but... After hearing Ryōshū's philosophy on aesthetics and art, Rufo, a Docent of Fauvists, claimed that they would cultivate her until she could establish her own movement.
- If, one day, Ryōshū finally completes her own movement... will the Ring acknowledge her as a Maestro? Hm. I wonder if that means members of Ryōshū's School would speak in acronyms, just like she does...
cn:
- ……我没忍住好奇心，找良秀问了问包括关于各个思潮的名称在内的各种问题，但可能因为一连串的提问让她觉得烦躁，所以我中途就被赶走了。
- 不知道环指到底有多少思潮与派系……不过野兽派的讲解员卢佛在倾听了良秀所追求的美学与艺术之后说，会培养她直至她完成自己的思潮。
- 意思是说……如果有朝一日良秀能完成独属于自己的思潮……那环指也可能承认良秀是一位大师吗？如果真有那么一天，那良秀派系的成员们可能都会使用和良秀一样的缩写……

en:
- Wayfarer Company.
- With the recent series of incidents involving Warp Corporation, this new business entity arose to supplant its place as the new W Corp... In other words, a Wing hopeful.
- Faust explained that their core technology, called "Portals," resembles the properties of Backdoors. From my recent, unintended use of them (which has been quite frequent, truth be told), I find them incredibly convenient. The way Portals work, one door leads to another, without requiring a connection to Corridors as Backdoors do.
- I heard that Portals still have some instabilities that may cause side effects, but I don't think I've experienced or witnessed any so far. Considering what Faust and Outis have mentioned before, it might simply be because I've only been using expensive portals... but there could be another reason for it.
- Currently, it seems they are working with Limbus Company to establish forward bases throughout the Corridors at the House of Spiders and look into the Backdoors within them.
- We had the chance to work with Team Leader Alan from here. He has a bit of that corporate attitude, but he's generally amiable and seems favorably disposed toward us. Though... after seeing him straight-up socking Kira out of nowhere, not to mention that unsettling, subtle coldness hiding between his words... Can't blame myself for not wanting to see him as a decent person at the end of the day.
- Alan said Wayfarer's primary services include pathfinding, path security, and path maintenance. It doesn't seem like the "paths" he mentioned refer to Corridors, but I doubt I could've gotten a more detailed explanation, considering it's a closely guarded corporate technology.
cn:
- Wayfarer Company。
- 为了取代最近发生各种负面事件的WARP公司，正瞄准着W公司……也就是翼的位置的公司。
- 浮士德说明，虽然和后门相似，但他们使用的是不需要走廊这一过程，可以直接连接门与门的类似“传送门”的技术……我这段时间无意间使用了几次后的感想是……真的非常方便。
- 虽说目前仍然不稳定，可能会出现什么副作用，但好在就目前而言我们似乎还没有遭遇或者目睹过副作用。如今回想浮士德和奥提斯说过的话，可能单纯因为那是价格高昂的传送门……又或者有其他的原因……
- 目前他们似乎正和边狱公司一起以蜘蛛巢的走廊为据点，调查着内部走廊的后门。
- 和我们共事过的旅者公司的艾伦队长虽然很公事公办，对我们也似乎很友善……但他又是突然打了绮罗，又是说出些莫名有点冷漠的发言……似乎很难说他是个善良的人。
- 根据艾伦队长所说，旅者公司的服务似乎就是寻路、辟路、守路以及维护。虽然我觉得他们说的“路”应该不是指走廊……但既然那是公司的重要技术，想必再怎么追问也无法得到更多说明了吧……

en: - A power that strengthens the body, manifested through emotions and the mind. - ... said Vespa and Vergilius, but I'm having a bit of trouble understanding what it is from that explanation alone. That said, I don't think I can do a much better job of describing it. I just see Shin (心) users surrounding themselves with some kind of golden aura, and the next thing I know, they've suddenly become stronger. - To summarize what little I understand, Shin (心) sure seems like an incredible technique that allows people to enhance the strength and durability of their bodies without spending a single coin—and all it needs is some kind of training and meditation. - Vergilius did mention that its output varies depending on one's emotional or mental state... but, well... whatever limitations it has, I don't see why anyone would not use this power... Right? - I asked Team Leader Moses from LCD, who's apparently researching this power, and she said learning and using Shin (心) isn't always the best choice. Moses refused to elaborate further—she said she could explain only once she had properly formed a workable hypothesis.
cn:
- 经由感情与心灵而展现的，能够强化肉体的能力。
- ……虽然是这么听说的，但光靠韦斯帕和维吉里乌斯的解释也还是很难理解。就我看来，除了看上去像是缠上了什么金色的气场后就突然变强以外，别的就都不太明白了……
- 尽可能写下我姑且理解了的部分的话，那大概是一种不需要任何钱，只靠锻炼或冥想就可以强化身体的技术。
- 不过维吉里乌斯也说过它的输出会根据感情或是精神状态变化……呃……总之，学会使用心不是更好吗？
- 之后，我也问了正在研究心的LCD的摩西队长，她说不一定是那样。不过，她需要整理好一定的推测后才能说出理由，所以答案只能暂且保留。

en:
- Apparently, Sinners are unable to use Shin (心) without overlaying themselves with Identities—not while their pact with me holds.

- I was going to ask if I could learn how to use it too, but I missed my chance because Kira asked first... But if Sinners can't use it, I suppose it would apply to me as well.

- I wonder if I could use Shin (心) before I lost my memories. Vespa said that someone who had never once reflected on their sins—like the Middle Nursefather—would be incapable of even comprehending and using such a power in the first place. Makes me wonder what kind of person I was before my head was swapped for a clock.
cn:
- 没有覆盖人格的罪人们似乎在和我签订契约期间是无法使用心的。
- 我原本也很在意自己能不能使用，但因为绮罗先问出口而错过了时机……既然罪人们没办法使用，那对我来说应该也很难吧。
- 那，说不定……失忆前的我有可能会使用心呢？韦斯帕说不曾反省自身罪孽的中指父辈应该没办法使用心……那么头在变成时钟前的那个我，又是怎么样的人呢……？

en:
- I remember Lei Heng saying that "Mang (望)" is amassing Shin (心) and converting it into a ring of light around the user's body parts or weapons... But since I don't know how exactly that's done, I can only guess that the number of rings serves as a measure of how much stronger the user becomes with it.
- According to the Sinners' experience with Mang and Shin wielders, performing attacks with Mang wrapped around makes the same motion or technique a lot faster and stronger than before. Ishmael speculated with some uncertainty that the ring of light itself probably doesn't contain some superpower, but rather acts like a kind of gateway through which power is channeled.
- Outis added that the rings might function similarly to the rails of a railgun...
- Since I don't know much about even Shin myself, I wasn't able to ask detailed questions about Mang. The most I got was Vespa complaining that each additional ring nearly doubles the mental strain...
- Come to think of it, why does Mang contain emotions like resentment, dismay, and yearning? Why does Shin, the power of the heart, coalesce into Mang?
- Yi Sang said perhaps it has something to do with hopes and desires being the unseen hands that stir the heart, but I don't think that can sufficiently explain this phenomenon...
cn:
- 雷横曾经说过，把心的力量汇聚起来转化成力量，就会变成名为望的光环……到目前为止我还不知道其中要领是什么，只是产生了“难道多了几个光环就会变强吗？”这样的推测而已。
- 根据罪人们的实际体验来看，如果在缠绕着望的时候挥舞，哪怕是同样的动作和技术也会变成比以往更快更强力的攻击。据以实玛利说，虽然不太确定，但似乎并不是那份光环里储存了多大的力量……而更像是使力量通过的某种关口。
- 据奥提斯的补充来看，环的作用似乎就像是轨道炮的轨道那样……
- 反正也没办法使用心，所以关于望的问题也没有询问太多。不过我有听到LCD队的韦斯帕曾经抱怨过，每多使用一层望，精神上的负担就会成倍地增加……
- 不过为什么会叫做望呢？为什么汇聚心就能变成望呢？
- 按照李箱的说法，心是因有所期冀而动……但总觉得这并非完美的答案……

en:
- We came to N Corp. with a lot of worries on our minds... But Butter Street, our point of arrival, wasn't particularly different from the other Backstreets we'd been to.
- I'd braced myself for those fanatic Inquisitors to swarm in on us and tear my head off me... or at least to run into someone from N Corp.'s New League of Nine Littérateurs, but nothing of the sort happened.
- From what I remember, Meursault did say that the Inquisitors are not a major faction of N Corp., and it's not like we ran into the Littérateurs when we arrived in this District... so that explains it.
- Butter Street's residents don't seem to care much about what we do. I'm pretty sure as long as it doesn't directly involve their daily lives, they won't give us a second glance.
cn:
- 我们带着满心的不安抵达了N公司……但实际上，我们抵达的黄油街和之前去过的其他后巷并没有什么太大的区别。
- 原本还做好了异端审判官蜂拥而至、喊着要把我脑袋拧下来就扑过来……或者遇到新九人会的某个人之类情况的觉悟……
- 不过回想起来，默尔索说过异端审判官并不是N公司的主流。再加上我们到达其他区域时也从未立刻撞上新九人会……从某种意义上来说，或许这是理所当然的结果。
- 黄油街的大多数居民似乎对我们做什么都不太关心。只要没有直接影响到他们的生活……不管这条街上发生什么，他们大概都不会在意吧。

en: - A canned product that gives the user an experience never before had, simply by eating the contents. - From what I can tell, the raw ingredient is produced in a place called "Grand Magasin Sisyphe" and the Canneries connected to it. - Apparently there's a mass-produced version of this product, made by mixing all sorts of information with the base ingredient. They give intense and stimulating experience when consumed, and in N Corp., eating these mass-produced Canned Experiences is considered a form of entertainment like going out or dining in a restaurant. - Uh... But didn't some of the Identities we use drive Nails into people to harvest something from them and make Canned Experiences with it? And if this Sisyphe place is "producing" the raw ingredient, then... - The thought gave me the creeps, if I'm being honest. I did ask Meursault about it, but he said Kromer and her Inquisitors had an outdated way of doing things... which is apparently almost never an option these days. - Meursault read my note. The way he spoke was quite insistent—he actually emphasized that the cans don't provide any dreams or experience. Then what do they really give? Memories? What separates a memory from an experience? - There are times when I peek into the Sinner's memories, but those memories don't come from my own experience. Still, in that precise moment I glimpse a memory, can't I say I'm experiencing it too? Or... not? - ... Maybe this isn't a question I can answer now.
cn:
- 只要吃下去，就能获得至今从未有过的经验的罐头。
- 据说原料是在名为西西弗百货的地方生产的，然后在与其相连的工厂里被加工成罐头的形式。
- 其中所谓的量产型经验罐头，是在原料里混入各种信息，从而带来刺激而强烈的经验。据说在N公司的后巷，人们会像享受娱乐、外出或下馆子一样去吃经验罐头。
- 呃……可是有几个人格不是通过钉子从人身上抽取什么来制作罐头的吗？难道说西西弗百货生产原料指的是……
- 我产生了不祥的想法，于是询问了默尔索，所幸克罗默和异端审判官们的做法是老式的……现在已经几乎不再使用了。
- 看了我写下内容的默尔索，再次强调说罐头并不是提供梦或经验的东西。那么罐头提供的果然是“记忆”吗？经验与记忆究竟有何不同？
- 我偶尔会窥见罪人们的记忆，但那些记忆并不是我的经验。不过，在窥见记忆的瞬间，也许我能说自己也有了那些经验。不，应该不能这么说……？
- ……这似乎不是能立刻下定结论的话题。

en:
-  Moses, Team Leader of LCD On-site Investigative Reasoning (OSIR) Team, conducted research that suggests a Distortion phenomenon progresses through three stages: Early, Middle, and Late, like a disease. Hohenheim also once said that the fate of an Abnormality awaits at the end of the Distortion phenomenon. Does that mean that once the symptoms get worse beyond the late stage, the Distortion turns into an Abnormality?
- Ezra mentioned in passing that there's also something called an "Incubation" stage—but I don't think that distinction makes much difference if you can't directly see or feel the warning signs of a Distortion phenomenon.
- The Distortions we've encountered so far were all people turned into monstrous entities... But the Distortion phenomenon we were asked to handle this time looked more like its namesake—a "phenomenon" that covered an entire street. Ezra says it's called a "Location-type Distortion."
- After completing the contract, I was able to hear more about how a Distortion can encroach upon its environment. I think the Sinners and I have seen that happen before. There were times when the scenery around us changed even though we didn't enter the Fathoms of someone's Ego or the Dungeon of the Fathoms.
- Actually, didn't the same kind of thing happen with people who Effloresced their E.G.O...? I wonder what the difference is.
cn:
- 根据现场推理小队的队长摩西的研究结果，扭曲就像疾病的发展一样，可以分为初期、中期和末期。想起霍恩海姆说过的“扭曲的末路是异想体”这句话……那么在末期，如果病情？之类的东西恶化，就会变成异想体也说不定。
- 以斯拉还顺口提到过有潜伏期这种东西……但如果无法直接看到或感受到扭曲的前兆，那这种区分似乎也没有太大意义。
- 至今为止我们见过的扭曲都是某个人变成异形的样子……但这次委托目标的扭曲看起来像是覆盖了整条街道的一种现象。根据以斯拉的说明，这是“场所型扭曲”……
- 关于由扭曲引发的侵蚀现象，我们在委托结束后也听说了。这似乎是我和罪人们见过数次的东西。即使没有进入自我心道或心象迷宫，周围的景象也偶尔会改变，似乎指的就是这种现象。
- 但是这种现象我也在并非扭曲，而是展现E.G.O的人们身上见过……这两者之间有什么不同呢。

en:
- I learned a little more about S Corp. through Bamboo-hatted Kim and Aeng-du's memories.
- S Corp. is said to be a Wing run by three Court Circles: Sal, Pi, and Ppyeo. The "Pi" Circle, the faction Kim was part of, seems to have lost considerable influence, with the "Sal" and "Ppyeo" Circles colluding.
- Yi Sang says most of S Corp.'s scientists and technicians belonged to the "Pi" Circle. That's probably why the old League of Nine Littérateurs had to escape to T Corp.—due to an internal power struggle.
- Runaway residents are hunted down and brought back to S Corp. by Fixers called "Ch'unokkun." These refugees seem to be referred to as "Nobi," sometimes...
- I don't think the term carries the same context as the miner "slaves" we saw in the underground of J Corp. casino... but I've yet to pin down what sets them apart yet.
cn:
- 通过金笠和樱桃的记忆，我对S公司有了更多的了解。
- 据说S公司是由被称为“朋党”的肉、血、骨三个党派所运作的翼。其中金笠所属的“血”党，由于“肉”和“骨”联手，势力似乎被大幅削弱了。
- 李箱说过，大部分技术人员都属于名为“血”的党派，所以九人会不得不逃往T公司的原因，大概……也有S公司内部权力斗争的影响。
- 逃走的居民似乎会被称为“推奴人”的收尾人抓住，再带回S公司。而在这过程中，居民们似乎常被称作……“奴婢”。
- 和我在J公司赌场地下看到的奴隶……好像又不太一样……但目前我还不清楚其中的区别。

en:
- When it was involved in a Syndicate Strife against the Kurokumo Clan, the Blade Lineage was apparently split into two groups.
- One group were those who dreamed of returning to S Corp. someday—the people who had been with Bamboo-hatted Kim since back in S Corp.
- The other group was made of people who sought only the liberty to live by their sword. Kim said that returning to S Corp. was not much of a priority for Salsus who earned their keep by brandishing their swords.
- And Kim Distorted... in the middle of all that, losing both sides. Those who chose to remain with him were killed by their own leader, and with the Blade Lineage so diminished, the Salsus who had no clear purpose left him and drifted away.
- Aeng-du's the only one who stayed by him until the end. And now, she's become an official member of the LCD.
- The Mentor survives still, but calling the Blade Lineage an organized Syndicate may be a bit of a stretch now.
cn:
- 据说在与黑云会进行争斗的时期，剑契组大致分为了两类人。
- 一类是梦想回到S公司的人。据说大多是从在S公司的时期就一直与金笠同行的人。
- 另一类则是只靠挥剑为生的人。金笠说，对那些靠剑吃饭的杀手来说，回到S公司这个目标并不那么重要。
- 在那种情况下……金笠似乎因为扭曲而失去了双方。留在他身边的人都被他斩杀了，于是势力变弱，继而没有明确目标的杀手们也就四散离去了……
- 在那种情况下……最后仍留在他身边的樱桃成为了LCD的正式队员。
- 虽然作为头领的金笠还在，但现在要称之为帮派恐怕已经有些勉强了。

en:
- LCD's On-site Investigative Reasoning Team resolves the Distortion phenomenon by searching for what they call "Inflection Points"—in the process of which they reason out and investigate the cause of the Distortion, the situation around it, and the nature of the power it may have gained due to those circumstances.
- Meanwhile, the Bus Team's method is to open the Dungeon of the Fathoms to directly peer into the Distortion's past, or simply Suppress it using force until it turns back. And since this can't even be attempted without me, I suppose it can't be helped that Moses's team has to work in their own way.
- That said, finding these "Inflection Points" is, apparently, a task that requires a huge amount of time without Moses, who can observe the progress and warning signs of the Distortion phenomena with the naked eye. I'd say that's another kind of power irreplaceable for their team, though in a completely different direction from mine.
- Hmm... Now that I think about it, what would I look like through Moses's eyes? She said she saw "a glass-like sword of many edges" in Ryōshū's case. Considering the events that transpired following Moses's observation... maybe she could give me some clue about who I was before I lost my memories.
cn:
- 据说LCD部门的现场推理小队，是在寻找所谓的“反曲点”的同时，通过推理与调查扭曲的成因、扭曲的状况，以及随之产生的扭曲能力的方式来解决扭曲委托的。
- 开启心象迷宫来直接窥视扭曲的过去，或是仅凭物理手段镇压扭曲就将其恢复原样这种我们使用的方式……如果我不在就连尝试都做不到……或许摩西的小队使用他们自己的方式也是无可奈何的事。
- 只是，在作为队长的摩西不在的情况下，寻找这种“反曲点”似乎需要相当长的时间。摩西曾说过她能够用肉眼看到扭曲的进展与前兆……我认为那是与我不同方向的，不可替代的力量。
- 嗯……说起来，我在摩西的眼中会呈现出怎样的样子呢？记得她曾说过良秀看起来是如同玻璃般的刀。想到那之后发生的事……或许能获得关于失去记忆之前的我的线索呢？

en:
- E.G.O manifested by one's own self, rather than being extracted from Abnormalities.
- Moses's pipe can alleviate mental strain through white smoke, and the scabbard Araya turned into can select which of Ryōshū's memories are cut off by the Arayashiki when she uses the blade. This leads me to believe that E.G.O are not always combat-oriented.
- If anything is shared between extracted E.G.O and Effloresced E.G.O, it's that they seem to take the form of weapons, armor, or tools, without exception. This seems to be where they differ most from Distortions, which transforms and warps the human body.
- Sora, the Index Apprentice of the House of Spiders, said that one needs an "unshakable conviction about what's good and evil" to Effloresce their E.G.O. When I think of Ahab and Dongrang, though... that conviction doesn't necessarily have to be "right," I suppose.
- The E.G.O Bamboo-hatted Kim Effloresced at the end seemed somewhat unstable. Does that mean he's still lacking conviction? Then how could he even manifest one to begin with?
- Ishmael conjectured that while Kim may still lack a conviction of his own, and is mired in fear and anxiety... he's slowly taking steps toward the direction he chose, and that may have helped manifesting his E.G.O. If so... perhaps a person whose Efflorescence is unstable might someday Distort again once they are devoured by conviction and anxiety instead of mastering them.
cn:
- 并非由异想体提取而来，而是从自我中展现出的E.G.O。
- 从摩西的烟管，或变成刀鞘的阿赖耶的例子来看，用白色烟气减轻精神负担，或是筛选良秀的记忆之类……E.G.O似乎并不一定具备战斗能力。
- 硬要说共同点的话，那就是都呈现出武器或道具的形态……看来这是与身体变形的扭曲之间最大的区别。
- 曾是蜘蛛巢子辈的空说过，为了展现E.G.O，需要有坚定不移的对善恶的信念。当然，想起亚哈与东朗，那份信念似乎并不一定是正确的形式。
- 总觉得金笠最后展现出的E.G.O看起来有些不稳定。是因为他还未坚定信念吗？如果是这样，为什么在没有信念的情况下也能展现E.G.O呢。
- 以实玛利推测，是因为尽管无法摆脱不安，也没有信念……但他仍朝着自己期望的方向前进这点。若如她所说……不稳定地展现E.G.O的人，在被那份信念与不安感吞噬的那一天……也许会再次扭曲吧。

en:
- Seems to refer to the large organizations that manage Fixers.
- Each Association appears to have a specific field it specializes in to account for how free and open a Fixer’s line of work can usually be.
There’s a pretty wide variety… I’ve seen a few Associations through the identities of Sinners and their mirror worlds.
- One major difference from freelance Fixers is that they can’t choose the jobs they want to take.
cn:
- 似乎是指管理收尾人的大型团体。
- 或许是由于收尾人对待五花八门的委托过于随心所欲，每个协会好像都被规定了其专攻的领域。
协会种类好像也挺多……通过罪人的人格及其镜像世界，我曾有幸见到过几个。
- 与一般的收尾人最大的不同点是，他们似乎无法自主选择委托内容。

en:
- They seem to specialize in assassination requests.
- Should note that it doesn’t exactly mean they’re the only Fixers who ever take assassination jobs. To start, requesting an Associate Fixer is gonna cost a fortune…
Plus, the demand for assassination is awfully high in the City, so even unknown Offices on obscure streets seem to get those requests pretty often.
cn:
- 专门负责处理暗杀委托的协会。
- 虽说是专门负责，但这似乎并不代表其他收尾人就不会接受暗杀委托。说到底，想要委托协会水准的收尾人，那可是价格不菲……
不过，暗杀这类事情在都市中属实也是司空见惯，由于需求量过大，即便是一条无名街道上的事务所也时常会受理这类委托。

en:
- They seem to specialize in combat requests that involve groups of people.
- “Although few Fixers in the City go their lives without once ever embroiling themselves in battle…” (Quoted from Donqui.)
- The Liu Association seems to be unique in that each individual member is equipped to deal with multiple foes at once.
cn:
- 专门负责处理集团作战委托的协会。
- “都市里一生不与战斗打交道的收尾人能有几何……”（引自堂吉诃德）
- 六协会的特别之处在于，每位成员都有以一敌多的实力。

en:
- Term that encompasses all the corporate bodies (or any place of business, really?) that’re founded by Fixers.
- There seems to be some sorta rule that requires Fixers to be part of an authorized organization of any kind if they want to work, and setting up a *one-person Office* is apparently an option.
cn:
- 指所有由收尾人创建的企业或是事业单位。(还是说工作场所？)
- 收尾人若想承接委托，即使并未创立庞大的企业，也似乎得遵循某种规定，成为各类被授权团体中的一员，就算是建立一家只有自己的“一人事务所”也可以。

en:
- Name of the L Corp. that existed in the past. It was an energy provider.
- It transported *Abnormalities* (like those we’ve encountered) to facilities in their eggy forms, and *managed them in containment units* to produce energy in the form of *Enkephalin*.
- I’m told it once supplied energy to many other companies and Wings—pretty much all over the City, basically—so it must have been a pretty weighty enterprise…
- Then, one day, a fierce ray of light shot out of the headquarters and the company went under just like that.
I even heard that after the company was gone, some… *tower thing* appeared in its place, and then disappeared sometime after. The Wing’s spot is still vacant as I write this, which apparently has the whole District in chaos.
- With its headquarters gone, the branch facilities around the City all shut down and were *buried underground*.
cn:
- 旧L公司的名称。它是一家能源供应公司。
- 他们以“卵”的形式运输并保存异想体（如我们遇到的异想体），并在公司里的“收容单元”中对其进行管理，以“脑啡肽”的形式生产能源。
- 我听说它曾为都市中几乎所有的翼和公司提供能源，由此可见，它绝对是一家极具影响力的公司……
- 然而有一天，一道强光从本部射出，公司就这样垮台了。
我还听说在公司原址的上方……曾出现过一座“塔”，但不久之后便消失了。在我写下这篇笔记的时候，该翼的位置仍然空缺，拜其所赐，整片区域仍处于混乱状态。
- 据说随着其本部的消失，该公司在都市中的所有支部设施都被关闭并深埋地底。

en:
- According to Don Quixote (“Discerning the two may yet be a task too daunting for novice aficionados!”, she also added), while the Cinq Association covers one-on-one situations like duels, the Liu Association handles engagements between multiple combatants. Come to think of it, most of those identities did seem to value cooperation and coordination over individual action.
They also looked rather carefree, too…
- Gregor’s Liu Association identity also told me that it was common for him to take on groups of five or six at once. (He didn’t forget to proudly mention that he’d “whooped those kids’ hineys”.)
cn:
- 根据堂吉诃德的说法（她补充道：“对于涉世未深的雏儿来说，辨别两者谈何容易！”），作为决斗协会的Cinq协会一般负责处理一对一的决斗型作战，而六协会处理的则是团体型作战。仔细想来，相较于个人行动，大多数六协会人格似乎更重视团队的协调与合作。
他们看起来也相当游刃有余……
- 格里高尔的六协会人格也告诉我，同时与五六个人发生战斗是常有的事。（他还不忘自豪地提到，自己“狠狠地踹烂了那些小子的屁股”）

en:
- It looks like there’s a pretty wide variety of Offices.
- Thinking back on the time we were in the Backstreets of District 4 (D Corp’s territory), the Office Yuri and Aya belonged to might have been the most common type.
- Anyways, I guess I can say Fixers, Offices, and Associations are all entities that handle requests for a price.
cn:
- 事务所自身似乎也种类繁多。
- 回想起在4区（D公司辖区）后巷那时，我们所见到的尤莉和阿雅所属的事务所似乎就是最常见的收尾人事务所。
- 不论如何，在收钱之后依照委托人的意愿解决事务这一点上，不论是收尾人、事务所还是协会应该都相差无几。

en:
- Seems to be what the glowing green fuel originally produced by Lobotomy Corporation is called.
- Mephistopheles has a device converting humans into Enkephalin built into it, and the green liquid filling up the tubes seems to be just that.
- Enkephalin can also be stored in containers of our choice for easier transport, boxes and modules being the two vital examples.
cn:
- 似乎是指脑叶公司所生产的散发着绿色荧光的燃料。
- 在梅菲斯托费勒斯上也有将人类还原为脑啡肽的装置，所谓脑啡肽应该就是指那管中注满的液体了。
- 脑啡肽并非一定要储存在管中，也可以因事制宜选择将其移至更易于储存或运输的容器中，代表性的便是盒子与模块。

en:
- Another thing of note is the incendiary devices built into all their weapons.
- When I asked why they use fire-starting weaponry, they gave me varying answers like “harmony” or “flow”…
But those honestly felt like roundabout remarks. In my opinion, it’s probably because fire is effective as a means to strike foes around the target. Flames can spread, after all.
cn:
- 需要特别记录下来的是，他们使用的所有武器都能产生火焰。
- “五行调和”，“真气流动”……当我询问他们使用这类特殊武器的理由时，得到的回答多种多样。
说实话，我认为这些只是委婉之辞罢了。依我所见，那是因为在面对人数众多的对手时，火焰也能有效地攻击到目标周围的敌人……毕竟火焰是会蔓延的。

en:
- I still don’t think I can exactly define what an Abnormality “is”.
- So far, the ones I’ve encountered (for now, anyway) usually had an appearance unlike any human or animal and possessed extraordinary powers…
They’re beings you’d only expect to see in abnormal fantasies, both in terms of what they look like and what they can do.
cn:
- 异想体到底是一种什么东西……仍难断言。
- 大多数（起码目前我所遇到过的）都有着与人类或动物截然不同的外观，并且拥有着异想天开的能力……
正如其名，可以认为它们就是有着“异想”天开的形态和能力的东西。

en:
- The old L Corp’s logo can still be seen on the bottom of some Enkephalin boxes, which probably means the Wing used them as well.
- Reading the warning on the side, ingesting it apparently has “hallucinogenic effects”… Who would think to do that?
cn:
- 看来脑啡肽盒子也曾被旧L公司所使用，偶尔仍可以在翻过来的盒子底部看到旧L公司的标志。
- 读了读侧面的注意事项，摄入这个看来会产生“致幻作用”……脑子里到底在想些什么才会那样做？

en: - When I tried asking Faust, she’d keep saying “Abnormalities are entities of their own category; you shouldn’t attempt to define them based on any preconceived standards”, and refused to give a more detailed answer…
cn: - 当我试着询问浮士德时，她每次都只会说：“异想体就是异想体，请不要试图以任何标准去定义它们。”想要问出更为具体的答案显然十分困难……

en:
- They seem to specialize in single-combat and dueling requests.
- Though it doesn’t happen often, I hear there are still cases of people trying to settle disputes with a fair and honorable “duel”.
- When a person gets involved in a duel (or has to challenge someone to it) and figures their opponent will clearly tear them a new airway, they send this Association a request. Sounds like they stand in for the client or something.
- All I know about this Association comes from what I heard from the Seven Association identities, so I couldn’t learn much…
Since the Association doesn’t get requests too often, it seems to be in charge of holding joint conferences and events with other Associations as well.
cn:
- 专门负责处理以个人为单位的决斗相关委托的协会。
- 虽然发生得并不频繁，但在都市中似乎依旧存在以堂堂正正的“决斗”来分清黑白是非的事情。
- 总之，在已经接受了决斗（或者不得不发起决斗），却知道自己必败无疑的情况下，貌似就可以委托他们。这应该就是所谓的决斗代理人吧。
- 一切信息仅来源于Seven协会的人格口述，所以我无法了解太多……
由于工作并不多，所以他们貌似会承办诸如协会间的交流赛之类的活动。

en:
- A strangely shaped object is inside, kinda like a… bulb-like thing.
- I don’t know how I should describe it… It sometimes wiggles and twitches.
- Staring into this glimmering “thread” makes me feel rather woozy.
- Faust wouldn’t let me hold it in my hands for long, so I put it back in place and let her explain what it is.
cn:
- 形似灯泡……？的东西，里面还装着奇形怪状的物体。
- 不知道要怎么形容那个……时而扭曲，时而抽搐。
- 如果盯着这个闪烁着光芒并有着“纺锤”之称的东西看，会不自觉地发呆。
- 因为浮士德不允许我一直拿着这个，所以我决定将其归还并请她为我解说一二。

en:
- Shorthand for “Extermination of Geometrical Organ”. [sic] (Idk what this means?)
- Seems to be a byproduct of the Enkephalin generation once done by the now-collapsed L Corp.
- Reports say the Wing originally produced weapons and equipment out of the E.G.O for its employees to use, which doesn’t really seem to match what I’ve seen of it.
cn:
- “Extermination of Geometrical Organ”的缩写。（这到底是什么意思？）
- 似乎是在旧L公司通过管理异想体来提取脑啡肽的过程中额外获取的副产物。
- 据说这片翼曾利用生成的E.G.O制造武器与防具以供其员工使用，但这与我所见到的E.G.O的使用方式略有出入。

en:
- Simply put, some kind of incredible technology owned by the Wings.
- I was curious how they’re different from the other technologies in the City…
I guess it’s the fact that Singularities are monopolized by the Wings that own them.
cn:
- 简而言之，是指由翼所持有的极其卓越的技术。
- 我好奇它们和一般都市技术之间的差距到底有多大……
不过将其当作是仅限对应的翼才能使用的垄断技术会比较好。

en:
- In summary…
It’s all sorts of possibilities woven into spindles of thread… or something like that.
To be frank, I can’t really call this a summary when I just wrote down what Faust said almost word for word. I couldn’t understand what she meant exactly…
It gives me a similar feeling to looking up at the *star* that appears when I wind the clock. Sorta like awe.
cn:
- 总结下来……
可以说是将各种可能性都以丝线的形态编织成纺锤状……的东西。
坦白地说，由于我几乎是原封不动地写下了浮士德所说的话，所以这也算不上是什么总结。我并不明白她的话究竟是什么意思……
它给我一种类似于回拨时钟时那满眼星空的感觉。就好似敬畏之情一般。

en:
- The Sinners seem to experience a kind of dizziness when they get near this thing.
I hear it’s called “resonating”; it might be similar to how I get headaches.
- Once we return with a Bough, Vergilius calls people from some other department to take care of it.
When I asked him about this, he just said it’s “submitted to headquarters”.
cn:
- 当罪人们靠近这东西时，他们似乎会产生与头晕类似的异常感觉。
这种现象也被称为“共鸣”，这可能与引发我头痛的原理相似。
- 每当金枝回收完毕，维吉里乌斯便会通知其他部门的人员对其进行处理。
当我问到这件事时，他只会说“将会呈递给本部”。

en:
- Apparently, you can’t be a Fixer just cause you want to; some Fixer-related identities told me that there are tests you need to pass to earn a license.
- Looks like Fixers are graded with a number: 9 being the lowest and 1 being the highest…
- There’s also a special grade called being a *Color*. Vergilius appears to be one; he has the moniker of the “Red Gaze”. He’s supposedly pretty skilled and famous.
cn:
- 通过与收尾人相关的数个人格交谈后了解到，收尾人可不是想当就当的。似乎存在着执照考试之类的东西。
- 貌似会用数字对收尾人进行分级。似乎9阶为最低，1阶为最高……
- 还有被称为“特色”的特殊等级。维吉里乌斯似乎被称为“猩红视线”。看来他不仅实力超群，还颇为有名。

en:
- Located in District 23’s Nest.
- I haven’t visited their place yet, but I learned a thing or two about it from conversations with the identities from this Wing.
W Corp. seems to be operating a transit service advertised as “WARP Trains” that take passengers from platform to platform in mere seconds.
Tickets for WARP trains are apparently pretty costly, and I’m told the first-class ones are plain ridiculous.
- …Shouldn’t you just cut costs and drive at that point?
cn:
- 其巢位于23区。
- 尽管从未亲自造访过W公司，但通过与相关人格交谈，我还是得知了一些零散的信息。
W公司似乎正在运营着一项名为“WARP列车”的即时单向传送服务，该服务能让乘客在数秒内被运送至任意站台。
WARP列车的票价似乎相当高昂，头等舱的票价更是令人瞠目结舌。
- ……为什么不直接开车呢？

en:
- A process of synchronizing an *Identity* with this world using the *Thread* we’ve gathered.
- It’s how one brought from a different world is tuned to the Sinner in ours. (I guess it could be likened to binding the two worlds together?)
From what I can tell, a freshly extracted Identity can’t immediately transfer all of their knowledge and combat prowess to the Sinner.
That’s why Thread must be used to “uptie” the Identity and make it more effective.
cn:
- 利用收集来的纺锤，可以将人格同步至现世。
- 似乎是指将某个世界中具有“可能性”的人格，与现世人格相匹配的过程。（难道连接两个世界的媒介就是纺锤吗？）
当人格刚被提取便覆写在罪人身上时，罪人貌似不会立即获得那个世界中被提取出的人格所拥有的全部知识和战斗技法。
因此，似乎通过纺锤同步人格才可以更加高效地使用该人格。

en:
- Similar to uptying, this is a process of making the Sinners’ E.G.O more powerful using Thread.
…Though I do wonder, why *threadspinning* and not “uptying” again?
cn:
- 与人格同步类似，这是一个利用纺锤来强化罪人们的E.G.O的过程。
……不过我有些好奇为什么叫“异想解析”，而非仿效先前称之为“同步”？

en:
- Located in District 18’s Nest.
- With what I’ve heard about R Corp. from its related Sinners, it seemed a little different from the other Wings I know so far.
While most Wings provide many a convenience by utilizing their Singularities to improve people’s quality of life, R Corp. mainly deals in armed services like mercenaries.
- R Corp’s power as a Wing comes from the quality of its military services.
Outis added that as important as a troop’s size is, much of its strength in battle will come from field experience and mental fortitude.
In that sense, she says R Corp’s combatants (soldiers? employees?) are like killing machines with undaunted spirits on top of being in great health.
Gregor said it’s common for ordinary soldiers to lose their will to fight and then flee the battlefield or fall into panic, and those who don’t are the exceptions.
I wonder if R Corp. runs wargames and simulations or something.
cn:
- 其巢位于18区。
- 根据相关人格所述，R公司与我所熟知的翼之间有些不同。
翼通常会利用奇点提供各式各样的便利技术来丰富人们的生活，但R公司却并非如此，而是致力于提供类似佣兵一样的武力支援。
- R公司之所以能够跻身翼的行列，似乎是得益于他们所提供的军事服务的质量。
奥提斯补充道，战斗中士兵的数量固然重要，但士兵的实战经验以及精神状态也同样关键。
从这方面来看，R公司的战斗专员们（军人？还是说员工？）不仅数量众多，而且每个人都堪称是不会被战斗所动摇的杀人兵器。
格里高尔补充道，但凡不会因丧失战意而从前线逃跑或是陷入恐慌，就已经是士兵中的佼佼者了。
他们是有类似于战争模拟训练室一样的地方吗？

en:
- I asked if the “MAX Uptie” status, as shown on the PDA, is really the highest possible tier.
I wanted to know if that meant that the Sinner virtually becomes the same as the one from another world.
- I’ve been told it’s theoretically the case.
If an Identity brought from a certain point in time of the world from where it was extracted gains more experience (training their combat skills further, for example), a new possibility can occur that allows for additional stages of uptying.
I guess that’s to mean Identities from certain points in time could grow stronger in terms of experience and technique.
cn:
- 我曾问过，对一个人格使用所有纺锤以使其达到PDA上所显示的同步MAX状态是不是就搞定了。
我好奇如此一来罪人是否真的会变得与那个世界的罪人一模一样。
- 理论上确实如此。
据说如果从那个世界的特定时间点所提取出的人格积累了更多经验的话（例如进一步磨练战斗技术），又会产生新的可能性并且有可能追加同步进度。
我想这意味着，特定时间点上的人格可以在原有的基础上继续积累经验并提升技术。但由于人格好像会被固定在被提取的时间段，因此貌似并不能开发出新的技术或能力。

en:
- When a Sinner tears this *Identity Training Ticket*, certain experiences seem to flow into them (or the Identity they’re wearing).
These experiences can make them even stronger than how they were in their original worlds at the time of extraction. (Well, that’s what the “relevant theories” say, according to Faust).
- I get that they become better fighters with the added experience, but how does it make them physically stronger too?
cn:
- 当罪人们（或所覆写的人格）撕碎人格训练券，似乎就会有某种经验一类的东西流入四肢百骸。
借助这些经验，人格能变得比在刚从原世界中提取出来时还要强。（浮士德说理论上如此）
- 我能理解战斗技巧能随战斗经验的增加而提升，但为什么连肉体的强度和体力也会随之提升？

en:
- I got vague but somewhat sensible answers from Faust and Yi Sang.
When an Identity is “upgraded” using tickets, the Identity’s “frame” itself is enhanced.
- To summarize their explanations, upgrades exclusively improve their physical traits.
The improvements are made in ways that would have worked in the original worlds the Identities come from.
- Additionally, when an Identity with prostheses is upgraded, the materials and components of them seem to get sturdier and whatnot.
- Either way, upgrades are focused wholly on physical improvements.
cn:
- 从浮士德和李箱口中获得了模棱两可却还比较合理的回答。
使用人格训练券强化人格时，从人格到人格的“框架”都会被一同强化。
- 简而言之，强化似乎只在物理意义上进行。
强化的方式貌似是由人格原来所属世界的方式决定。
- 顺带一提，如果强化了使用义体的人格，义体的材质似乎也会随之变得更加坚固耐用。
- 无论强化方式如何，都只会使肉体而非精神获得增强。

en:
- Writing down additional details I’ve heard.
- While cars can take you anywhere, WARP trains are preferred because travel by car can get incredibly complicated.
Makes sense, considering the procedures we went through just to get into K Corp’s Nest.
- Speaking more, it seems the bigger problem is the roads are made inefficiently.
They’re so twisted and convoluted that it takes an unreasonable amount of time to travel between Backstreets areas by car.
- Even if the linear distance is short, the road to the destination will be labyrinthine.
Purportedly there are wide, open roads called highways connecting the Nests, but that comes with a set of conditions and costs as well.
cn:
- 补记一些传闻。
- 虽然开车也能前往任何地方，但因为过程太过繁琐，人们似乎大多时候会使用WARP列车出行。
没错，光是想到进入K公司巢内之前需要办理的那些手续，就觉得确实大费周折。
- 进一步分析发现，相比于这种繁琐的过程，不合理的道路规划与布局显然问题更大。
如果想要开车或者乘坐其他载具穿过后巷去往都市内的其他区域，貌似会在蜿蜒曲折的道路上耗时良久。
- 即使直线距离看起来很短，实际路线也会错综复杂。
虽然巢与巢之间似乎有名为高速公路的宽敞通途相连，但似乎也需要满足各种条件并支付相关费用才能使用。

en:
- Like Identities, the E.G.O used by the Sinners are possibilities drawn from the cores of certain Abnormalities for appropriate individuals.
However, using E.G.O to its full potential requires weaving together a deep understanding and well-read interpretation of the Abnormality, which is why it’s called “threadspinning”, sorta like the idiom of spinning a yarn.
- Threadspinning an E.G.O enriches the comprehension of the Abnormality’s mental imagery, enhancing its power and effectiveness.
- E.G.O seems to be the manifestation of some kind of mental force.
I guess it makes sense that forming thorough knowledge of the Abnormality and its E.G.O is important.
cn:
- 罪人们所使用的E.G.O和人格相似，是从异想体的核心中将可能性引导向合适的罪人。
但若想使用完整的E.G.O，就需要理解异想体并对其进行解析，这种必要的步骤被称为异想解析。
- 随着异想解析进度的推进，作为E.G.O来源的异想体的心象似乎更容易被理解，E.G.O的威力和效果貌似也会随之增强。
- E.G.O似乎是某种精神力量的展现。
如此看来，对异想体以及E.G.O的解析至关重要。

en:
- I asked if it isn’t possible to upgrade Identities beyond their current maximum level (30 as of writing) as shown on the PDA.
- These values seem to be related to the Golden Boughs we’re collecting. In addition, I was told that I’d be unable to withstand further upgrades for now.
Does that mean it will be possible to upgrade them more at a later point?
- …Come to think of it, if these “level-ups” are only for making their physical bodies stronger, then why are these things called “training tickets”? I thought that was covered by upties?
cn:
- 我曾询问过PDA上显示的人格等级能否藉由强化而突破30级。
- 后来被告知这个数值似乎与我们收集的金枝有关。最重要的是，我暂时无法承受更进一步的人格强化。
那是不是意味着，随着时间的推移，也有继续强化的可能？
- ……仔细想想，单纯只是强化肉体的话，理应与训练无关，那为什么会叫做“训练券”呢？我记得训练应该是通过人格同步进行的吧？

en:
- Learned a shocking fact while talking with Sinners done up in W Corp’s identities.
Though they didn’t tell me directly… it seems that the trips on WARP trains which take no more than a few minutes from an outsider’s perspective make their passengers perceive a terribly long amount of time, dissolving their sanity and deforming them beyond recognition once the ride is finally over.
Then, it’s the job of the cleanup agents to physically sort out the mess every time.
…Thank goodness we have a bus.
- This is all speculation based on conversations with the identities, so I’m planning to keep this information to myself.
cn:
- 在与拥有W公司人格的罪人交流的过程中，我了解到了令人震惊的事实。
虽然没有直接说明……但是貌似比起WARP列车在现实中高速行驶一趟那短短的几分钟，车内的乘客们感受到的时间反而漫长到恐怖，他们在这段时间里通常会丧失理性，最终变成奇怪的形态。
而似乎每到此时，都需要进行物理上的清扫。
……幸好我们坐的是巴士。
- 由于一切推测仅基于罪人的人格所述，因此我不打算告诉其他罪人，只是记录在这里。

en:
- Hearing what R Corp’s identities have to say, the Wing has a team called the “Fourth Pack” with three subdivisions: Rabbits, Reindeer, and Rhinos.
- The Rabbits are all-rounders deployed to a wide range of missions.
- The Reindeer have surgically gained antlers that convert mental strength into physical force.
- While I haven’t met the Rhinos yet, I’m told their specialty is wreaking havoc.
cn:
- 与R公司人格们交流后得知，有一个名为第四集团军的队伍，其中包含兔子队、驯鹿队和犀牛队。
- 兔子队能力均衡，是泛用式战斗员。
- 驯鹿队接受了某种手术使得头上长出了一对角，据说能利用那个角将精神力转为物理性的冲击。
所以他们时常被头部的剧痛困扰。
- 因为从未见过犀牛队所以我对他们没有准确的认知，不过综合一下情报，我觉得他们大致就是擅长于把所有东西尽数毁掉的特化部队吧。

en:
- I asked if events differing from our timeline happen in the worlds from where the Identities were extracted as time passes.
- I’ve been told that we can’t know for sure and that it doesn’t matter anyway.
Limbus Company is only interested in enhancing the Sinners’ capabilities in battle, so they don’t care about what happens with the Identity or its world as we uptie them.
cn:
- 我出于好奇询问过，如果时间继续流逝，被提取的人格所属的世界中是否还会发生与现世不同的事件。
- 而我得到的答案是，“并不能确定”，以及“这些事情并不重要”。
边狱公司只希望提升罪人们的战斗力，所以当人格同步进度顺利推进时，那个世界中的一切似乎已经不再重要。

en:
- While Thread’s role in uptying is to connect people between worlds, it seems to work like a wire to unravel the core of the Abnormality in threadspinning.
- Faust says we might be able to threadspin E.G.O beyond what we’re currently capable of in the future.
Similar to upgrading and uptying Identities, gathering Golden Boughs should allow us to decipher and interpret them in further detail.
cn:
- 如果说同步时所使用的纺锤是将其他世界的人们相连结的丝，那么异想解析时它们就像是探明异想体核心的线。
- 据浮士德所说，似乎还能在现有的基础上更进一步解析。
就像是人格同步以及强化一样，只要收集更多的金枝，似乎就有可能进行更加具体的异想解析。

en:
- From what I can tell, the E.G.O our Sinners use appears to work by the user making the emotions or self-identity of the Abnormality their own.
Although I haven’t experienced it myself…
- I’ve heard a few times that it feels similar to being influenced by someone else’s thoughts and reflecting it to life, walking as if in their shoes.
cn:
- 至少我们的罪人所使用的E.G.O，应该是通过将作为媒介的异想体的感情或自我据为己有来使用的。
虽然我也没亲身体验过……
- 我已耳闻多次，那种感觉，就像是被他人的想法所濡染后将其反映到自己的人生当中一样。

en:
- Another thing of note is that they almost seem to be outside the realm of logic or classical physics.
Faust says it’s unnecessary to bother thinking about the intricacies in my current state, but…
I don’t think you can brush off flesh regrowing from a severed arm or stickers that boost your luck as things that just work that way.
- …Wait, is my head a Singularity, too?
cn:
- 这到底是如何运作的呢？难以凭借逻辑或经典物理来解释这一点，似乎是它们共有的特征。
虽然浮士德说过，以我现在的状态而言，没有必要那么努力地去试图理解它们……
但我并不觉得，像什么断臂肉芽迅速生长复原、贴上贴纸就能让运气变好之类的现象，是能被轻易忽视的。
- ……等下，那我的头不会也是奇点吧？

en:
- The Sinners seem to experience a kind of dizziness when they get near this thing. I hear it’s called “resonating”
It might be similar to how I get headaches.
- Once we return with a Bough, Vergilius calls people from some other department to take care of it.
When I asked him about this, he just said it’s “submitted to headquarters”.
cn:
- 当罪人们靠近这东西时，他们似乎会产生与头晕类似的异常感觉。
这种现象也被称为“共鸣”，这可能与引发我头痛的原理相似。
- 每当金枝回收完毕，维吉里乌斯便会通知其他部门的人员对其进行处理。
当我问到这件事时，他只会说“将会呈递给本部”。

en:
- However, if you don’t stop at just being convinced and get deeply engrossed in that other sense of self, you’ll be taken over by what’s carrying it.
That killed the Sinners a good few times…
And hurt me like hell.
cn:
- ……只是，如果被过度感化，最后深深沉醉于自我之中的话，似乎也会有被该媒介侵蚀的情况。
而且因为这个原因，罪人们已经死了好几次了……
我也会痛得要死。

en:
- The old L Corp. used to classify Abnormalities into five levels.
Yuri told us that L Corp. graded them based on their energy production efficiency.
Limbus Company seems to use the same levels to categorize them.
cn:
- 据说旧L公司将异想体分为五个等级进行管理。
尤莉说，过去的L公司是根据能源提取效率来进行异想体分级的。
好像边狱公司也沿用了相同的等级分类。

en:
- It’s our mobile office, our home, and our vehicle. The Sinners and I eat, sleep, go to work, and fight here.
- It looks like a mix of a train and a bus, but everyone calls it a bus for some reason. I guess it makes sense, considering our department’s name.
- Apparently, it’s powered by an engine that Faust designed.
Everything special about Mephistopheles comes from its engine. Not only does it power the vehicle so that the bus can drive us to places, but it also lets us extract Identities from other worlds. We can also enter breakrooms or training rooms via its Backdoor, all thanks to the engine.
- It seems that Mephistopheles can be upgraded and fitted with additional functions. I think one of the Sinners said it’s like the bus itself is growing, or something. (I don’t remember who said it, though.)
cn:
- 我和罪人们所乘坐的巴士，既是我们的事务所也是我们的家。大家在这里工作、休息、吃喝、战斗。
- 虽然既像火车又像巴士，但是大家理所应当的称呼它为巴士。考虑到我们部门的命名，巴士这个名字十分合适。
- 浮士德设计的引擎似乎是梅菲斯托费勒斯的动力源。
梅菲斯托费勒斯的全部特别功能都来源于它的引擎。不仅限于为车辆提供动力从而使巴士能载我们前往各个地方，或是能让我们提取来自其他世界的人格，我们还可以从它后方的门进入休息室或培训室，而这一切都要归功于它的引擎。
- 梅菲斯托费勒斯有时候会根据情况增加和升级新的功能，我记得有位罪人说感觉巴士就像在成长一样。（是谁说的来着？）

en:
- A door… on the back end of Mephistopheles. Past it is a corridor full of doors connected to each Sinner’s private lodgings or breakrooms.
- The Sinners tell me that each room has unique looks and different interior designs. Faust explained that they may be reflections of each Sinner’s personal psyche or memories.
- There are more people on this bus than the number of doors we actually use, but the ones we do use can lead to different spaces depending on who opens them first. Two sinners could enter the same door only to end up in different rooms, for example.
- The doors are labeled with names denoting whose rooms they lead to.
- There are also doors that just lead to the other side of the walls they're on.
cn:
- 位于梅菲斯托费勒斯后方的门。进入之后出现的是连接罪人们休息房间的走廊。
- 根据罪人们的说明，似乎每个房间的装饰都是不一样的。浮士德说，这反映了他们每个人的内心和记忆。
- 这辆车上的人数要多于我们实际使用的门的数量，但我们使用的那些门会根据首先打开它们的人而通向不同的空间。举个例子，两位罪人可能进入同一扇门，但是最后却来到不同的房间。
- 每扇门上面都写了可以通往谁的房间。
- 除了通往休息空间的门，还有通往其他便利空间的门。

en:
- The door to my room opens to a corridor leading to the Mirror Dungeons and the Luxcavation Dungeons.
- I can see that the corridor past the Backdoor extends beyond the area we use, but somebody put a sign there warning us not to trespass.
We almost had a huge accident when Heathcliff tried to go past the threshold in spite of the warnings. Something tells me that there are dangerous things or territories in the deeper parts of the corridor.
Heathcliff’s panicked face is still fresh in my memory… And Faust’s uncharacteristic urgency, too.
- Ryōshū calls this endless space ‘the Corridor’. I can tell that she’s not talking about just any corridor. But what else could she possibly be talking about…?
cn:
- 穿过我房间的门，就能到达连接镜像迷宫和采光迷宫的走廊。
- 后门的走廊比我们目前使用的空间还要长而宽敞，但是那里挂上了警告我们不要往前走的牌子。
有一次希斯克利夫翻了进去，差点酿成大祸。走廊深处似乎存在很危险的东西或者是连接到危险的地方。
希斯克利夫惊恐的表情至今还在我的眼前挥之不去……还有浮士德那一反常态的急迫的样子。
- 良秀似乎把这种无穷无尽的空间称为“走廊”，但我觉得良秀口中的对象和我们通常认知中的走廊不同。她到底指的是什么呢……？

en:
- They're 'dungeons’ we can access via the Backdoor.
The corridor that leads to the Mirror Dungeon is made of cold, heavy metal. It inspires a different kind of anxiety from our usual wooden doors and corridors.
- At first, there was just a single door leading to a Mirror Dungeon while the others were shut. A second door opened at some point though, so now we’ve got two. Considering that Faust let us know when the doors would open, I’m gonna guess that there are specific conditions for them to open. Or maybe they follow a certain schedule.
- Whenever I enter a Mirror Dungeon, I emerge to a place resembling a misty cosmos. I can choose which Sinners to bring with me into each of the Mirror Dungeons.
cn:
- 通过后门可以进入迷宫。
镜像迷宫对面的走廊由冰冷厚重的金属组成，散发着与普通走廊中使用的木门截然不同的紧张感。
- 最开始只有一扇通往镜像迷宫的门开放，而其他的门保持紧闭。但如今第二扇门也打开了，所以可以去往两个地方。据浮士德所说，门开放的时机似乎取决于某些条件和时间。
- 每当我进入镜像迷宫时，我就会来到一个类似迷雾笼罩的宇宙的地方。我可以决定每次带哪些罪人进入镜像迷宫。

en:
- One of the dungeon types we can enter via the Backdoor.
- Once we enter, there’s the Training Ticket Luxcavation Dungeon to the left, and the Thread Luxcavation Dungeon to the right.
- Looks like we can gather resources to strengthen the Sinners by battling Abnormalities or enemies we’ve faced in the past.
- We have to spend Enkephalin to enter these since they also require Mephistopheles’ engine to operate.
cn:
- 通过后门可以进入的迷宫类型之一。
- 进门后，左边有一扇通向经验采光的门，右边则是一扇通往纺锤采光的门。
- 看起来我们可以通过和曾经遭遇过的异想体或者敌人重新战斗来获得培养罪人所需要的资源。
- 因为这里也是由梅菲斯托费勒斯引擎的力量所驱动，所以需要消耗脑啡肽来运作。

en:
- According to Faust, Mephistopheles’ engine actively stabilizes the Mirror Dungeons we’re allowed to enter via the Backdoor.
- Their ultimate purpose seems to be to improve mine and the Sinners’ capabilities. Faust recommended that we make frequent visits to the Mirror Dungeons of the Backdoor, even if it meant expending Enkephalin used for the engine.
cn:
- 据浮士德所言，能够通过后门接触的迷宫都经由梅菲斯托费勒斯的引擎进行控制，处于稳定状态。
- 迷宫的最终目的貌似是培养我和罪人们。也许正因如此，浮士德才提议即使是消耗作为燃料的脑啡肽，也要偶尔尝试着使用后门的迷宫。

en:
- A place we can access using the Backdoor.
- Gregor tells me that it looks a lot like the City's subway stations.
- It looks pretty dilapidated, as though it’s been here for a long time. There’s what appears to be a subway train on the rails.
- The subway train kinda resembles our Mephistopheles, except it looks like it’s been left to rot for a long time.
- The subway train didn’t budge with just one Sinner inside it. When the other Sinners joined, however, the door closed all on its own and began taking us somewhere.
- The Sinners told me that it took us to the next stop.
- What I can tell from my experience here so far is that each station led to a different environment, some of which were places we’ve been to in the past.
- The door closes behind us once we get off the subway train onto a new station. Then, an Abnormality or some enemies attack us with no rhyme or reason, leading to immediate combat.
- Once the fight’s over, the subway train door opens again. Once we’re all aboard, it takes us to the next stop. Rinse and repeat until we reach the Terminus.
cn:
- 能够通过后门进入的空间。
- 据格里高尔所说，这里似乎与都市的地铁站十分相似。
- 这车站像是久经风霜一般破旧，轨道上停着电车一样的物体。
- 电车外表与我们乘坐的梅菲斯托费勒斯形态相似，但给人的感觉像是长时间不曾管理一般老旧。
- 仅仅一人上车时电车并不会运作，但全体罪人一起乘坐时，车门会自动关闭并驶向某处。
- 根据罪人们的说法，貌似是前往了下一站。
- 从至今为止的经验判断，车站外的空间因站点不同而各有差异，似乎也会出现曾经见过的空间。
- 全员在新车站下车后，电车车门会关闭。紧随其后异想体和敌人便会袭击过来，似乎总是立刻就会展开战斗。
- 战斗结束后，紧闭的车门就会打开。全员上车后又会驶向下一站，直到终点站为止都会重复这一流程。

en:
- Faust tells me that they appear to be like… 'simulations, or a series of locations generated in order to improve our capabilities akin to the functions of Mirror Dungeons or the Luxcavation Dungeons from the Backdoor'.
That makes sense. We encountered enemies like Kromer in there, but all they did was fight us. Maybe they’re also just simulations, after all.
- Not sure if it’s putting us through a very realistic simulation, or if it’s actually taking us to where the Abnormalities reside. I still don’t know enough about this place to say for sure.
- Once we made it to the end of the subway route, we were allowed to return to the bus via one of the stations.
- One of the Sinners was furious, complaining that it sent us on a wild goose chase for absolutely nothing… until he saw Faust popping open the Lost & Found box and picking up a whole horde of resources.
cn:
- 据浮士德所说，“与后门相连的镜像迷宫、采光迷宫一类的地方是为了提升我与罪人们能力的场所，换言之就是训练场。”
确实，曾经遇到过的例如克罗默之类的敌人们在镜像迷宫里也只会和我们战斗，或许这确实是训练场。
- 目前并不清楚模拟现实的训练场是否通向会实际产生异想体的空间。情报尚且不足。
- 电车按照指定路线运行到底后，可以在能返回巴士的站点下车。
- 某位罪人总是为花费力气去探索而抱怨，直到浮士德从出口的失物招领处拿出一大堆资源时，罪人便无话可说了。

en:
- Though it’s closed now, we've been to this station before.
- The whole place had a blueish tint to it.
- We encountered and fought some familiar faces, but many of the Abnormalities in there were entities we hadn’t encountered in the Lobotomy Corp. Branches so far.
- I recall that we’ve interacted with some of these Abnormalities before in the Mirror Dungeons. Faust says that our interaction with them in the Mirror Dungeons were through some kinds of… spaces. Their mental spaces and worlds, that is.
I guess the railway happened to stop by one of those worlds?
- Then maybe it’s not a simulation? I don’t know…
cn:
- 我们曾经进入过，但如今已经关闭的车站。
- 整片区域呈现着蓝色的色调。
- 我们不单是与曾经战斗过的敌人重新交手，还遇到了没有在那些支部见过的其他异想体。
- 我记得我们之前曾经在镜像迷宫中和一些异想体有过互动。浮士德说我们在迷宫内与他们进行沟通或采取行动的……空间，是属于异想体的心象和世界。
也许这条折射轨道抵达了其中的某个世界。
- 所以，这不是模拟出来的情景……

en:
- This place has a greenish tint, unlike Line 1 with its blue hue. I bet the next one will be a different color. And so on and so forth.
- Again, we fought some more Abnormalities we’d only had glimpses of before.
- Everyone cheered when they saw that Line 2 had way fewer Stations than Line 1 did… Until Yi Sang noticed some symbols on the wall and theorized that we were supposed to run this Line multiple times.
- A new Station was added with each new Cycle, though we still had to go through the earlier stations first.
- Around the time we were on our fourth Cycle, Heathcliff began loudly complaining that he was tired of doing the same thing over and over and over and over again. Some Sinners seemed to grow increasingly restless as well, but the crisis was averted thanks to Yi Sang who said that the sign seemed to say that the fifth Cycle was the last one they had to complete.
- Once we wrapped up our fifth Cycle, we were able to find a large horde of various resources from the Lost & Found. From what I can tell, each Line’s going to have different routes and conditions to completing them.
cn:
- 与1号线不同，这个车站的色调是绿色的。大概线路的编号不同，颜色也会不一样吧。
- 我们这次也遭遇了那些虽在镜像迷宫中见过却并未战斗过的异想体。
- 大家因经过的站点数量明显比1号线少得多便能到达终点站而欢呼起来，直到李箱注意到车站内刻着的一些符号，指出这条线路似乎是需要循环多次的环线时，一部分罪人开始抱怨。
- 每次循环都会经过同样的站点，但也会出现新的站点。
- 进行第四次循环时，希斯克利夫大声抱怨道：“要转到什么时候？累死了！”听到这话，一些罪人也开始动摇了，幸亏李箱说标识上写着第五次循环大概就是最后一轮，骚动才得以平息。
- 在完成第五次循环之后，在失物招领处获得了一大批各种各样的资源。我想，每条线路的运行方式都会有所不同吧。

en:
- They seem to specialize in the collection and research of knowledge.
- They say the Association members use equipment that draws physical strength from knowledge.
- The harder to obtain and more precious the knowledge is, the greater the strength it grants its users. Looks like they lose the knowledge once they draw strength from it, however.
- Looks like they’ve got Fixers who fight with their fists and Fixers who fight with their… keys? (What?)
cn:
- 专门负责处理知识的收集及研究的协会。
- 据说，这个协会的成员通过使用专用的装备，能够将所学会的知识转换为物理上的力量。
- 越是困难而珍贵的知识，转换后能得到的力量就越强，但作为获得力量的代价，知识会挥发殆尽。
- 似乎分为用拳头战斗的派系和用钥匙战斗的派系。（这是什么意思？）

en:
- I didn’t quite understand why they were flying a bunch of drones around the city, filming scenes of death and pain… but looks like there was a reason for all that.
- I learned some things about K Corp.'s Nest while carrying out their request… But I’m not sure if it’s okay for me to leave a record of them.
cn:
- 我其实不是很确定为什么要在都市各处放出无人机，录下死亡和苦痛的景象……但这一切应该是有原因的。
- 在我们处理委托时，我也了解到了一些关于K巢的状况……但我不确定是否应该把它们记录下来。

en:
- Okay. Below are some information that I’m NOT supposed to write down… But I wanted to record it anyway. Here goes nothing.
- … Who knows. One day, even I might end up forgetting everything.
- They explained that HP ampules were actually infinitesimally tiny nanobots helping regenerate the body. Apparently, they were so small that a collection of them just happened to look like some green fluid.
But none of that was true. They weren’t anything even remotely close to nanobots. The ampules were just filled with some green fluid.
- K Corp’s HP bullets, also known as Regeneration Ampules, aren’t like ointments. It uh… returns the body of the person injected with it to a form they remember as being unhurt.
- Stephanette, K Corp.’s founder, went to the Outreaches of the Outskirts and brought back this organism they call the ‘Tearful Thing’, from which they extract the fluid.
- I think that ‘Tearful Thing’ was once a human, from what I’ve seen through resonating with the Golden Bough.
- It seems like their wish was that no one would ever suffer from pain again. And that wish was granted… in some form, anyway. Theoretically speaking, its tears can heal literally any part of a body as long as its brain is intact.
- Just like its name, the Tearful Thing sheds tears when it feels sorrow. And by processing or watering down its tears are the ampules, K Corp’s Singularity, made.
- At first, the founder Stephanette drew its tears by sharing sad or emotional stories. But once she passed away, those who seized power afterward buried it in a constant stream of violent, shocking imageries to produce its tears more efficiently.
- That’s why the drones were filming people’s deaths. So that they could force the Tearful Thing to watch those violent and shocking tragedies.
- Looks like making it watch the same tragedy over and over isn’t as efficient. They have to keep feeding it new, different scenes of violence. That’s why they’re importing similar footage from the other Nests. They were planning to use the glass window tech similar to the mirror to give it a constant supply of footage, but our involvement seems to have thwarted that.
- Considering that the ‘Tearful Thing’ is, after all, an organism, it also seems to be capable of producing offsprings. Alfonso called the one we saw… a child entity.
- I don’t know how… but if I were to hazard a guess, I’d say that they’re trying to improve their production rates by using the Tearful Thing’s children.
cn:
- 好吧，接下来的这些是我不应该写下来的信息……但我还是想记录下来，所以就这么记下来了。
- ……谁知道呢？说不定在某一天就连我也会把这些忘得一干二净。
- 他们解释说HP安瓿实际上是无限微小的，能够帮助身体再生的纳米机器人。由于它们太过微小，它们聚合在一起的样子看起来就像是一些绿色的液体。
但事实并不是这样。那些安瓿瓶里装的东西实际上和纳米机器人相差甚远，并且和看上去一样，是绿色的液体。
- K公司的“HP弹”，也被称为 “再生安瓿”，并不是我们经常想到的软膏那样的治疗剂。它……呃，能让注射者的身体恢复到在他们记忆中没有受伤时的样子。
- K公司的创始人斯蒂芬妮前往了郊区之外，从那里带回了被他们称为“落泪之物”的生物，并从中提取了那些液体。
- 通过与金枝共鸣时看见的情景，我认为“落泪之物”曾是一个人类。
- 看起来它的愿望似乎是不愿让任何人再遭受痛苦。不管怎么说，通过某种方式……这个愿望已经实现了。从理论上来讲，只要大脑没有受损，它的眼泪就能字面意义上的治愈任何身体部位。
- 就像它的名字一样，“落泪之物”在感到悲伤时就会落泪。通过对它的眼泪进行加工或稀释，那些安瓿，即K公司的奇点，就被制造了出来。
- 起初，创始人斯蒂芬妮通过分享悲伤或动人心弦的故事来获得它的眼泪。但在她逝世后，为了更有效率地制造眼泪，那些继位者开始不断地对它展示冲击性的暴力场面。
- 这就是那些无人机录制人们死亡场景的原因。这样他们就能继续迫使“落泪之物”观看那些暴力场面与冲击性的悲剧。
- 看起来让它反复观看那些同样的悲剧并不那么有效率。他们必须得不断给它提供崭新而不同的暴力场景。这就是为什么他们要从其他“巢”里购入相似的影像资料。他们本来打算使用与镜子相似的玻璃窗技术为其持续提供影像资料，但参与进来的我和罪人们似乎阻碍了这一计划。
- 考虑到“落泪之物”毕竟也算是一种生物，它似乎也有繁殖后代的能力。阿方索把我们看到的那个东西叫做……幼年实体。
- 我不知道这是怎么做到的……但如果让我做出一个大胆猜测的话，我会说他们会试图利用“落泪之物”的孩子来提高他们的生产效率。

en:
- I’m only a little curious, but I wonder what would happen if a prosthetics user were to be injected with a K Corp. Ampule?
- We learned everything about their Singularity, from its origin to its production methods, but after they put us through the memory wipe procedure, I’m the only one who remembers it. I decided to lay low and pretend that the procedure worked. Even with my limited knowledge of the City, I felt like that this information was probably pretty important.
- I usually don’t show these notes to the Sinners anyway, but… I'll have to be extra careful about it from now on.
cn:
- 我稍微有点好奇，义体使用者被注射K公司的安瓿后会发生什么事。
- 虽说看到过奇点技术的生产过程和它的起源，但因为所有人都被消除了记忆，现在只有我记得。即便是不了解都市情况的我也知道这是重要的情报，总之还是先像记忆被抹除掉一样不要声张为好。
- 虽然我并不准备给罪人们看笔记里的内容……但这段内容要更为注意。

en:
- A technology used to wipe specific memories.
- I recall that we took turns entering some room. The procedure ended when the Sinners walked out with all their relevant memories wiped.
- Odd. I remember everything that K Corp wanted me to forget, but that room… I can’t remember a thing about the memory wipe procedure itself.
- This leaves me with so many questions. Why didn’t the procedure work on me? If it didn’t work, why can’t I remember anything about the memory wipe procedure itself?
cn:
- 将特定的记忆进行消除的技术。
- 我还记得我和罪人们接受处置的流程：一个接一个地进入某个房间。从那个房间走出之后，记忆消除程序就结束了。
- 奇怪的是，我还保留着K公司想要抹去的那部分记忆，反而对那个房间里进行记忆消除的方式毫无印象。
- 为什么只有我的记忆没有被抹去，却又不记得记忆消除程序的细节？对于这件事我满腹疑团。

en:
- Located in District 20’s Nest.
- Looks like they specialize in using temporal technology.
- I’ve only experienced T Corp. through resonating with the Golden Bough. I’ve never actually been to T Corp. Nest before, so I’m not sure how true to life that experience was.
- They seem to value technology and inventions.
