- The whole Nest is literally monochromatic. I think having any color is a privilege permitted only to those with power. Black fumes constantly spewing out of numerous buildings have darkened its skies.
cn:
- 地图上，其巢位于20区。
- 似乎是精于使用时间相关技术的巢。
- 我没有真正去过T公司的巢，而只是通过与金枝的共鸣对那里的生活有了间接的体验。我不知道那时的经历与真实的T公司有多少吻合之处。
- 似乎相当重视技术与发明。
- 整个巢都在字面意义上的褪去了所有颜色。似乎只有持有特权的人才能在那里拥有颜色。由于各种建筑物一刻不停的喷吐黑烟的缘故，那里的天空也被染得漆黑。

en:
- Located in District 21’s Nest.
- They use this Singularity called the resonance tuning fork. It can meld together two items of entirely different nature into one, as though they've always been a part of each other.
- Somehow, the power of the resonance tuning fork melded guns and monstrous crabs called Trash Crabs together. They could use those melded firearms as though they were naturally born with them.
- U Corp. is scattered across the Great Lake, with most of its major institutions located on its surface.
- Which means that we’re in dire need of a ship if we want to go anywhere in U Corp. So we got Mephistopheles modified into a ship using the resonance tuning fork.
- Seems to me that it overlaps this other region called ‘the Outskirts’… Hmm.
cn:
- 其巢位于21区。
- 使用名为共鸣音叉的奇点技术。共鸣音叉可以将原本性质不同的两个物品相结合，使其看上去浑然一体。
- 名为废料蟹的怪物便是受到共鸣音叉的影响与武器融为一体，像是使用身体的一部分一样使用那些武器。
- 其横跨大湖，大部分主要设施都位于地图中的大湖上。
- 因此真正进入U公司需要船只。于是我们利用共鸣音叉进行了梅菲斯托费勒斯号的改造工作。
- 从地图上来看，总觉得其似乎与被称作郊区的地方相重合……但尚不知详细情况。

en:
- I’ve only heard it mentioned in passing, but I don’t suppose they were talking about just any old library.
- Fixers from Molar Boatworks mentioned it. They said that they went in there, something awful happened, and they… returned from a book? I don’t know enough about the City to connect these dots or make any meaningful guesses from them, so I’ll just write down what I heard and put a pin in it for now.
cn:
- 虽然我只偶尔听到过这个名词，但其指代的大概不是普通意义上的图书馆。
- 听臼齿修船厂的收尾人们说，他们去了一个名叫图书馆的地方，遇到了很严重的大事，然后又从书恢复成原样了。以我所积累下的知识还不足以理解这些描述，所以我只能先把听到的东西原样记录下来。

en: - I knew it. The Associations aren’t the only kind of organizations a Fixer might work for. Some of them also work for Offices. They all seem to specialize in different things, just like the Fixers themselves.
cn: - 不出预料，收尾人们除了从属于协会外，也能进入事务所。事务所也和收尾人一样，有着各式各样的分类。

en:
- They seem to specialize in collecting intelligence.
- Intelligence, knowledge… I thought they’d be pretty similar to the Dieci association, but one of the Identities explained their differences to me.
- While Seven Association specializes in using whatever means to collect intelligence that they have been contracted to find, Dieci Association specializes in making the found knowledge their own by analyzing and deconstructing them.
- Still, I bet they have a lot of overlap, given their similar specializations.
cn:
- 负责搜集情报的收尾人协会。
- 从情报与知识来看似乎与Dieci协会相似，但据与之相关的人格所说，两者完全不同。
- 如果说Seven协会擅于尽全力收集被委托的情报，那Dieci协会便是负责专门分析、解构情报。
- 虽说如此，但因为负责的领域相近，两方难免有不少接触。

en:
- They seem to specialize in delivery and transportation.
- The City is full of dangers around every corner, so it’s extremely difficult to deliver important items or information to the intended recipients on time without losing it in the process.
- Yi Sang told me that, “While the City may appear miniscule in the bird’s eye view that the map avails one, an approach that contemplates its surface area and not what a single surface of it shows a world vastly different. The City is tight with brimming buildings in both heaven and earth, their labyrinthine construction and the Singularities paint a picture hidden afore a screen…”. I wasn’t sure what he was talking about, so I just nodded along.
cn:
- 专门接受搬运，传输相关工作的收尾人协会。
- 都市中危险重重，因此在约定时间内保护重要的物品或信息不被偷走并交给相应的人，是十分困难的事情。
- 根据李箱的说法，虽然从地图上看来，都市只是小小一个地区，但从表面积的概念来看，都市上下紧密联系的建筑及其构造、以及各类奇点技术，就完全不是那样了……因为不是很懂他说的东西，我只能点点头。

en:
- Looks like they left behind some of the E.G.O equipment the Lobotomy Corp. Branches once used to manage their Abnormalities.
- I think there are some conditions and risks to using those E.G.O equipment like the weapons or the armor. Makes sense, since they’re extracted from the Abnormalities that Lobotomy Corp. used to manage. They also seem to affect their users’ mood or speech patterns.
- Considering that they’re made from Abnormalities… they might pose a problem during our future visits to the Lobotomy Corp. Branches.
cn:
- 作为脑叶公司支部管理异想体时使用的专用装备，E.G.O们大多都仍残留在各地的脑叶公司支部中。
- E.G.O武器和护甲是从被管理的异想体中提取、制作和使用的。因此，如果要使用它们，就需要满足某种特殊条件或者面对某些风险。而根据装备的E.G.O不同，使用者的心情和语气似乎也会受到不同的影响。
- 考虑到它们是利用了异想体的特性制作而成的，在我们今后将会频繁进行的对脑叶公司支部的探索之中，它们也有可能造成一些麻烦。

en:
- They specialize in building and modifying gears used by the Fixers.
- Technically, they go under the same umbrella as the Offices. Unlike the Fixer Offices with various specializations, though, people refer to these specifically as Workshops.
- Primarily, they craft and sell weapons, armor, and other tools that Fixers use. Sometimes they’re contracted to build custom gear as well. At least that’s the impression I got.
- Considering that they’re also run by Fixers, Workshops don’t shy away from taking contracts involving combat if they have to. Like the Rosespanner Workshop did, for example.
cn:
- 由收尾人运营的，负责将收尾人使用的武器和设备进行制造与改装的场所。
- 严格上来说，它们和其他的事务所没有太多不同之处。但与擅长领域各有不同的其他事务所不同，这些机构明确地自称为工坊，而不是事务所。
- 主要负责制作和销售收尾人使用的武器、防具等各种工具。它们有时也接受武器定制的委托。
- 因为它们同样是由收尾人进行运营的，所以像玫瑰扳手工坊一样，工坊也会根据情况来接受战斗相关的委托。

en:
- Huh... The bus really transformed into a boat.
I guess this is what the ‘additional functions’ meant…
Further modifications and performance upgrades were made possible by using both the resonance tuning fork and Mephistopheles’ engine. (That Mika person was in a constant state of astonishment, now that I think about it.)
Heck, it’s bigger on the inside than it is outside. I won’t be surprised if all kinds of fantastical functions get added to it in the future.
cn:
- 就像我之前说的那样……巴士真的变成了漂浮在水面上的船。
这就是所谓的“附加功能”吗……
共鸣音叉的能力和梅菲斯托费勒斯发动机的力量合在一起，使得对巴士更出色的改造和性能提高成为了可能。（这么说来，美香这个人好像一直都对其惊叹不已。）
除此之外，它还有在内部创造比外表更为广阔的空间的功能。今后如果再增加各种各样的功能，我想我也不会惊讶了。

en:
- Looking at the map, there is a zone outside the general area where the Nests are. That zone's called the Outskirts.
- There are ‘monsters’ at the Outskirts. Ishmael and Outis called them ‘monsters’ and not ‘Abnormalities'… Considering that they’ve encountered Abnormalities before, I’m going to guess that there are monstrous things out there that aren’t Abnormalities.
- Well, it’s not like we’ll ever have to visit the Outskirts. I doubt even Lobotomy Corp. would build a branch outside the City.
- … I just remembered that Ishmael said that the Great Lake overlaps with the Outskirts.
cn:
- 在地图上，巢所在的区域以外的空间被统称为郊区。
- 据说郊区中盘踞着怪物。从见识过异想体的以实玛利和奥提斯仍将那些生物称为“怪物”这件事来看，那里大概有着和异想体不同的某些存在。
- 我想，大概不可能有脑叶公司的支部建立在都市之外，所以我们大概没什么机会去那里了……
- ……我想起来了，以实玛利曾说过，大湖也是郊区的一部分。

en:
- A massive lake at the South end of the City. Some call it the sea or the ocean.
- The Great Lake isn’t just one big pool of water. It’s divided by straight lines into several smaller sections, all of which have unique colors. I’ve seen only a little bit of it, but it reminds me of patchwork fabric.
- According to Ishmael, looks like the Great Lake’s chock full of treacherous natural disasters and monsters.
Even if she’s right, that it might be too early for us to go to the Great Lake… It's not like we've got much say in the matter. Limbus Company ordered us to go in that direction, so we gotta.
- I guess that decision’s what got us into this mess… I’m still not sure what I’m supposed to do.
- In a way, I guess we should consider ourselves lucky. Nothing disastrous has happened yet. Maybe we’re still in the coastal area Ishmael mentioned.
cn:
- 地图上位于都市南部的巨大湖泊。也有人称之为大海。
- 虽然目前我只见过大湖的一部分，但大湖似乎并不是单纯的一片巨大水域，而是由漂亮地分割开来的各种不同颜色的湖域所构成的。那样子让我想起布满补丁的布料。
- 据以实玛利所说，大湖之中似乎布满了极为危险的自然现象与各种怪物。
但就算以实玛利是对的，现在去大湖对我们来说还为时过早……我们在这件事上也没有什么发言权。边狱公司既然将其定为我们的下个目的地，我们就必须前往那里。
- 我认为就是这个决定让我们陷入了困境……而我现在也想不出什么改善当前情况的妙计。
- 应该说是万幸，至今为止还没有发生什么恶劣的事。是因为我们还没有离开以实玛利所说的沿岸区域吗？

en:
- I thought all monsters were either Abnormalities or Distortions, but it seems like the opposite is true. All Abnormalities are monsters, but not all monsters are Abnormalities… I think.
- They say that the Trash Crabs are the prime example of monsters that aren’t Abnormalities.
- Though they’re not so prevalent, I think they're sometimes mentioned in creepy tales or legends of the City.
- Apparently, the Outskirts and the Great Lake are both brimming with these ‘monsters’…
- Still, this means there are monsters within and without the City. I’m not sure how I'll categorize them yet.
cn:
- 我曾经以为，怪物都是异想体或扭曲，但事实似乎恰好相反，“怪物”这个称呼能够囊括所有的异想体。这么看来，怪物才是范围更大的分类吗。
- 据说像废料蟹这样既具有攻击性也具有威胁性的生物，就是不属于异想体但属于怪物的生物的代表性例子。
- 虽然怪物们并不是很常见，但它们就像怪谈和传说一样，偶尔会出现在都市各处。
- 听说郊区和大湖里布满了这样的怪物……
- 那就是说怪物能够出现在都市内、也能出现在都市外。我还不知道如何将他们分类。

en:
- It seems to be a special period when we can extract Identities and E.G.O that we normally can’t.
- Though the timelines and the worlds we can access are expanded during this period, it’s not like we’ll be extracting random Identities and E.G.O from all over the place. Faust explained that whoever we end up extracting during this period will be relevant to all of us. Relevant… to Limbus Company’s current state in some way.
- Walpurgis Night seems to arrive once in a while. As usual, Faust doesn’t tell me everything, but at least I could tell that the next Walpurgis Night will be different from this one.
cn:
- 似乎是能够提取平时无法提取出的人格和E.G.O的特殊时期。
- 尽管在这段时间里，我们可以访问的时间轴与世界线的范围都在扩大，但我们并不能随机的提取出与我们毫无关系的人格或E.G.O。我们能够提取出的事物，似乎都与我和罪人们……与边狱公司的现状在某种程度上有所关联。
- 这样的时期似乎每过一段时间就会到来。但用从不把所有事情说明白的浮士德的原话来讲，下一个瓦尔普吉斯之夜可能会和现在的有所不同。

en:
- Each Abnormality is categorized into different Risk Levels, divided into five levels.
- According to the brief manual Faust gave me… the five levels seem to be ZAYIN / TETH / HE / WAW / ALEPH.
- It seems that the postmortem observation logs written by the Sinners are sent to the upper echelons of Limbus Company, which then the company uses to determine their Risk Levels.
- Apparently, there are times when some Abnormalities' Risk Levels were already rated even before we submitted the observation logs. (Heathcliff told me that when he finally got to write the observation log after putting it off for a long while, he noticed that it was already marked with a Risk Level.) Since these logs are probably connected directly to the Limbus Company headquarters, maybe they’re checking these pretty frequently?
cn:
- 异想体各自拥有自己的危险等级，似乎共被分为5级。
- 根据浮士德给我的简要手册可知……这五种等级分别为ZAYIN / TETH / HE / WAW / ALEPH。
- 罪人们遵照指示与异想体进行战斗后所写下的图鉴内容将会被传递给边狱公司高层。高层会根据这些内容决定异想体的危险等级。
- 有时也会出现图鉴尚未书写完整，危险等级就已经决定了的情况。（希斯克利夫一拖再拖终于写好了图鉴，却发现危险等级已经标在上面了。）也许图鉴本身与边狱公司本部相连接，那边能够随时进行确认？

en:
- It seems pretty obvious, but the Risk Levels are rated based on the potential amount of damage that each Abnormality can cause, and the difficulty of facing it in combat. I see… I suppose that’s why they told the Sinners to focus on the details of the combat encounter and each Abnormality’s identifying characteristics when writing the logs.
- Hm, but I also remember that some of the lower-risk level Abnormalities were harder and more complicated to fight than the higher-risk Abnormalities.
- Maybe it’s the Golden Bough suppressing the Abnormalities’ strength (I’m gonna guess that’s what ‘Qliphoth Deterrence’ means)… but it’s probably just that there are some errors in the Risk Levels.
- So I asked Faust about those possible errors, and she proceeded to clear up a few questions I had about the difference between the Abnormalities’ Risk Levels and the actual difficulty we felt when facing them.
- The standards to rating each Abnormality's Risk Levels followed Lobotomy Corporation's definition of each Risk Levels, which then the LCA used to rate them. Turns out the data from Lobotomy Corporation didn't exactly match our on-field experience against the Abnormalities.
- LCA is aware of this disparity. Sounds like they're going to announce some new standards to categorize them by.
- I was told that they were going to use our combat data and the samples collected by Limbus Company to re-organize and re-categorize the Risk Levels.
cn:
- 危险等级似乎是根据异想体的潜在破坏力以及战斗难度来评定的。怪不得要我强调……必须让罪人们在写图鉴时重点说明战斗如何进行，以及是否有特殊之处。
- 但就部分实体而言，我认为被判定为低等级的异想体会更加棘手。
- 毕竟金枝会抑制异想体的力量（是叫做逆卡巴拉抑制力来着？）……所以我觉得偏差应该会很大。
- 对浮士德询问了几个关于偏差的问题后，我大概明白了自己为什么有这种感受。
- 由于LCA目前为止一直以脑叶公司设定的基准来评定异想体的危险等级，因此时常会产生评定数据与实际数据不符的情况。
- LCA认识到这一问题后发布了新的指示。
- 他们可能是根据我们的战斗数据以及边狱公司的样本收集结果，对危险等级重新进行了调整与分类。

en: - The Sinners and I... well, the 'Bus Team' is mainly tasked with finding the Golden Boughs, but the Limbus Company is trying to grow its reputation as a company that provides Distortion suppression, capture, and prevention services.
cn: - 虽然我和罪人们……又名巴士部队的主要任务是寻找金枝，但目前对外宣传的职能则是针对扭曲目标的镇压，捕获，预防一类的事务。

en:
- The most influential department in Limbus Company.
- Not sure what the acronym stands for.
- Maybe they work in tandem with the LCD for important Distortion or Monolith retrieval missions?
- A team known as the special operations unit is a part of the LCA. Everyone in that team that we've seen were all tall, bulky, and dressed in black.
cn:
- 边狱公司中最具影响力的部门。
- 尚不清楚该简称所代表的含义。
- 他们大概是在与LCD合作，执行回收扭曲或是找回独石之类的重要任务？
- 那些身穿纯黑的服装、身材高大的人似乎作为特殊作战小组归属于LCA。

en:
- A phenomenon in which a person turns into a monstrous form after a certain trigger.
- Somehow we ended up facing several Distorted people through our journey... and I've found a throughline that connects them all together.
- I think people Distort when they're pushed to the brink of emotional breakdown.
- One question, though. From what I've seen of the City, I'm pretty sure that there are literally countless people out there who are pushed to their emotional extremes. So why aren't we seeing more Distortions?
- Maybe there's a secondary trigger, a secondary condition other than being pushed to one's emotional limits.
cn:
- 人类因一定契机变化为类似怪物形态的一种现象。
- 从我们一路上阴差阳错遇到的展现出扭曲的人身上……我发觉了一些共同点。
- 当人类的情感被逼至临近崩溃时，似乎就会发生扭曲。
- 但有一个疑点……至今见到的那些都市人中，情绪处于崩溃边缘的人数不胜数，然而扭曲并非随处可见。
- 除了情感被逼至崩溃的边缘以外，也许还有其他条件？

en:
- They give off a similar energy to the Distortions, but these entities lack much identifying characteristics between them. At least between the same types.
- We have confirmed six types of Peccatulum so far. Yi Sang says that they're even closer to beasts than the Distortions are.
- Yi Sang says that, when comparing the Peccatula to Distortions with what samples we've encountered so far, the Peccatula showed much higher levels of aggressiveness and antagonism than the Distortions did.
cn:
- 虽然感觉上与扭曲类似，但每个实体都缺乏个性。
- 目前确认到的罪种种类有6种。根据李箱所言，比起扭曲，罪种貌似更接近野兽。
- 进行样本对照后发现，罪种明显比扭曲更具有攻击性及敌对性。

en:
- The higher-ups of Limbus Company have so far categorized Distortions by the same Risk Levels they grade Abnormalities with. But with this new announcement of Abnormality Risk Level adjustments and overhauls, they decided to classify the Distortions with a different system.
- Looks like they determined the fact that Distortions can be permanently killed as the biggest differentiator between Distortions and Abnormalities. Thinking back on it, Abnormalities always reverted into an egg-like shape whenever we defeated them.
cn:
- 一直以来，边狱公司的高层为扭曲设置了与异想体类似的危险等级和编号。然而，根据本次发布的对于异想体的危险等级的调整与再编制的指示，扭曲似乎将被单独分类。
- 看来用来判断扭曲与异想体的最显著的区别，就是扭曲能被彻底杀死。这么说来，我记得每次异想体被镇压后都会变成卵一样的东西。

en:
- I'm not sure if this is thanks to the Golden Bough in my head, but I can somehow tell Abnormalities and Distortions apart just by the feelings they give off. Just like how Abnormalities and Distortions are oddly similar yet different from each other, the Peccatula appear to be oddly similar yet different from Distortions.
- Sinclair heard me and mused that if they feel similar yet different... then maybe they both come from the same source, and what failed to become a Distortion becomes one of the Peccatula.
- Yeah, that makes sense to me. Those that fail to become Distortions become Peccatula... that seems to be the most likely guess unless anything new crops up.

- Risk Level assessments and serial numbers for each Peccatulum are also getting reworked. Probably thanks to those new Peccatula we saw at Yong-jin building.
- Faust added that our encounter with the new entities and the need for the company to categorize Abnormalities, Distortions, and Peccatula separately was what brought on the overhaul of the company's categorization system. Yeah, that's pretty much what I was thinking.
cn:
- 不知道是不是因为我头中的金枝，我能凭感觉区分异想体和扭曲。异想体和扭曲既相似又迥异，罪种和扭曲的关系大概也是如此。
- 听到这些的辛克莱提出以下推测，既然氛围相似却又有些许不同……那它们的起源或许一致，罪种或许就是无法达到扭曲的人的结局。
- 说的很有道理。无法成为扭曲的人便会成为罪种……这应该是现在能做出的推测中最有可能的一个。

- 据说对罪种的危险等级与编号也已经完成改编。大概是因为我们在龙进大楼发现了新形态的罪种的缘故。
- 浮士德补充说明了改编是由于新个体的发现与出于区分异想体、扭曲、罪种的需要。这些原因和我预想的一样。

en:
- Located in District 19's Nest.
- Looks like they've got a... 'King'...? And this 'King', whatever that means, has 'retainers'.
- Okay, according to some brief explanations, it seems to be a form of governance. Kinda like the Nests and the Wings... but not exactly the same. Don Quixote's eyes were practically twinkling as she listened, so I'm pretty sure it's far from a standard governance system.
- It's really sinking in that each Nest has a distinct culture and its own way of running things.
- I still have no idea what kind of Singularity they're supporting their Nest with.
cn:
- 其巢位于19区。
- 统治巢的王……？之类的人与其臣子生活在那里。王是什么……
- 根据听取的简报来看，这似乎是统治结构的一种。与巢和翼的形式相似，但好像又不尽相同。从堂吉诃德瞪着闪闪发光的眼睛倾听的样子可以看出，这大概是相当奇异的文化。
- 对于巢之间文化以及运营方式都有所不同的这件事，我有了更为深刻的认识。
- 另外尚不清楚该巢是依靠什么奇点来运营的。

en:
- The LCCA. The After Team doesn't seem to think so highly of me and the Sinners. They look down on pretty much the entirety of LCB.
- They probably think that the company's giving us special treatment or something. They think we have it easy? Maybe they should try dying over and over again if they really think we're a bunch of spoiled babies.
- ... Or feel the pain of death again, again, and again. With no end.
cn:
- LCCA。收尾部队似乎不太看得起我和罪人们所在的LCB。
- 他们似乎认为我们被公司赋予了某种特权，但我希望他们能亲自死上几次。
- ……又或者是让他们反复感受死亡的痛苦呢。

en:
- Limbus Company Distortion.
- Looks like they're the department that specializes in dealing with Distortions.
- This department was made to expand Limbus Company's business within the City.
- An employee from the LCD called Ezra actively helped us during the Monolith retrieval operation.
- ... I imagine she's what Don Quixote would be like if her personality was a bit more... mature.
cn:
- Limbus Company Distortion。
- 似乎是边狱公司专门负责扭曲的部门。
- 边狱公司为了在都市之中拓展业务，成立了处理扭曲的部门。
- 一位名叫以斯拉的LCD部门小队成员在回收独石的时候积极地帮助了我们。
- ……她就像是个稍微谨慎些的堂吉诃德。

en:
- Yi Sang is from S Corp. I was told that S Corp. deals with much of the agriculture and the livestock industry.
- The Blade Lineage members we recently ran into were also from S Corp. From the sound of it, they left the Nest for a reason similar to Yi Sang: internal issues and the tyranny of the corrupt.
- Things seem incredibly chaotic at S Corp.... Hopefully that's not where we're headed next.
cn:
- 李箱说自己出身于S公司，这是一家负责整个农畜产业的企业。
- 最近遇到的剑契组也是从S公司出逃的帮派，同李箱一样因S公司内部的问题与其横行霸道的行径而背井离乡。
- S公司似乎处于一种非常混乱的状态。希望接下来的路不会与S公司有交集……

en:
- Saude's alive! Now, this is a correction I'm happy to make.
- Sounds like she healed up nicely after what happened and got promoted to manager. I know that what happened had been weighing heavily on Sinclair's mind. Hopefully, this will put Sinclair's heart at ease, even a little bit.
- The Before Team, like Saude and Pilot, at least worked alongside us... But that woman from LCCA, Caiman, treated us and the LCCB like we were beneath them. I felt pretty awful after that.
cn:
- 索德还活着！没想到修正信息的日子也能这么高兴。
- 索德被送到后方以后恢复得很好，好像还升到了科长的职位。虽然辛克莱一直都很痛心，但我希望这能给他些许安慰。
- 先遣部队，比如索德小姐和皮利托先生，至少是与我和罪人们一起工作的……但那个叫凯尔曼的LCCA队长似乎看不起我们和LCCB，让我感觉很不舒服。

en:
- A black stele that 'forces people to distort'. I think Limbus Company internally calls it the 'Monolith'.
- I think it does something similar to the Golden Boughs: causing or amplifying Distortions. But unlike the Golden Boughs, it seems that that's all it's good for.
- I've been around enough Golden Boughs to know that the Monolith and the Golden Boughs are different, despite some similarities.
cn:
- 能够强行引发扭曲的黑色石碑。边狱公司将其称为独石。
- 它和金枝类似，能够诱发或是增幅扭曲。但与金枝不同的是，它是尤其强化了诱发和增幅能力的物体。
- 以我多次与金枝接触的经验可以推测出，独石与金枝既相似，又拥有不同的性质。

en:
- We encountered an entity that seemed to be a more mature version of the Peccatula we have encountered so far.
- Sounds like the higher-ups at Limbus Company are trying to categorize them by something like 'stages'.
- It can't be a coincidence that, after so many encounters with these Peccatula, we've only now run into a Stage 2 Peccatula.
cn:
- 我们和与迄今为止见到的罪种有所不同，形态进一步成长了的实体进行了对峙。
- 听说根据边狱公司高层的指示，此后将会依照阶段之类的分类法对其进行管理。
- 过去遭遇了那么多次罪种，直到现在才遇到2阶罪种，这应该不仅仅是单纯的偶然吧。

en:
- The Golden Bough amplifies and releases every feeling, from the hottest emotions to the warmest emotions. But the Monolith makes people face what's boiling in the deepest abyss of one's self.
- Unlike the Golden Bough, though, it seems to have some mechanism to it. Like it's a device of sorts. The control mechanism alone was so complicated that whatever interaction I did with it felt like I was navigating through a maze puzzle.
cn:
- 如果说金枝给人的感觉是能将炽热乃至温暖的感情进行增幅和解放，那么独石感觉起来则是能迫使人面对其内心深渊中的沸腾之物，使其满溢而出并最终爆发。
- 和金枝不同，其或许是某种装置，可以通过操作开启或是关闭。操作方法像是走迷宫一样，十分困难。

en:
- A railroad glowing with orange light. Says it's "Line 3" inside.
- Just as I predicted, each new railway seems to come with a different color. I'm sure the next one will be different, too.
- The subway train followed a circular track, and it stopped by every Station it passed by. There were rest stations along the way, so this wasn't as bad as the one we suffered through the last time.
- Again, we found Abnormalities we'd never seen before. If it really is as Faust said... if the subway trains are really stopping by the world of Abnormalities... maybe we can go even further?
cn:
- 橙色的轨道。上面写着3号线。
- 和之前猜想的一样，每条线路确实拥有不同的颜色。
- 列车顺着圆形轨道通过沿途的各个站点。和此前的轨道不同，因为中途能让罪人们休息，因此不会太过困难。
- 这次也遭遇了首次交战的异想体。如果按浮士德所说，列车已经到达了异想体的世界，那么这班列车也许能去往更远的地方。

en:
- The Sinners have really grown stronger through our bus journey... but the Peccatula have also grown powerful.
- I've been thinking, and I've come to the conclusion that maybe these new types of Peccatula are showing up because of the Golden Bough. This probably has something to do with the fact that collecting the Golden Boughs powers up our Identities, too.
- If we continue to collect the Golden Boughs... the types of Peccatula will grow as well.
- Golden Boughs, Sinners, and... the Peccatula. And there's a Golden Bough in my head, too. I'm sure they're all connected to me in some way... There's no other way to look at this.
cn:
- 在乘坐巴士经历的旅途之中，随着罪人们的不断成长变强，罪种似乎也变强了。
- 思来想去，出现的罪种种类增加果然应该是受到了金枝的影响。这与人格的成长是通过回收金枝进行的同理。
- 因为之后也要继续收集金枝……罪种的种类当然也会增加的吧。
- 金枝，罪人……以及罪种。还有，我脑袋里的金枝。我最终只能认为它们和我有某种联系。

en:
- Going through the Mirror Dungeons kind of feels like we're wading through an abstract ocean of a world... but the Refraction Railways have a more detailed appearance, kind of like a corridor of sorts.
- So many unknowns. Who built the Stations? Who puts those rewards in the Lost & Found? Where's this subway train, that looks a bit like Mephistopheles, coming from? How did it even get placed on the subway tracks?
cn:
- 镜像迷宫给人一种穿越抽象世界之感，折射轨道则有着更具体的形态。就如同走廊一样。
- 折射轨道的站点是谁建造的，失物招领处的报酬是谁准备的，那辆与梅菲斯托费勒斯有些相似的列车是从何处而来，而又是如何被放置的呢……我还不清楚的事情实在太多了。

en:
- There seems to be more than one way to get stronger in the City. Prosthetics and augmentation procedures, for example.
- But a physically strong body isn't all there is to being powerful; combat experience and techniques matter, too.
- Fixer Offices, Associations, Syndicates... they each have their unique way of fighting, which sometimes evolves into swordplay styles, martial arts styles, dojos, and things like that.
- Heathcliff tells me that an untrained, inexperienced body enhanced by surgeries just turns you into a slightly sturdier punching bag. Ryōshū chimed in to add that the type of procedure, choice of weapon, and style of martial arts matter, too.
cn:
- 都市中使人变强的方法形形色色。义体和强化手术之类的似乎就很流行。
- 和拥有一具强大的身体一样重要的是，在战斗之中如何作战。
- 收尾人事务所或协会……又或是帮派，都有各自使用的战斗方法，磨练那些方法的人们将会发展出剑法、武术、门派等等。
- 根据希斯克利夫所说，仅仅接受了强化手术的身体往往会成为沙包。良秀则说，接受了什么样的手术，以及训练了什么样的武器和什么样流派的武艺都很重要。

en:
- I overheard some identities with a lot of combat experience chatting... and they were saying that investing money in your body will take you only so far.
- Sure, it can make your body sturdier and physically stronger, but you need the right experience and training to actually use that body.
- But Rodya clarified to me that while more money doesn't automatically mean more power, we should be ready to shell out some cash if we do want to get stronger.
cn:
- 我无意中听战斗经验丰富的人格说过，想要在都市中变强，单靠投资重金的身体是不行的。
- 虽然可以制造出结实且输出功率强大的身体，但如何在战斗中使用那具身体却是需要经验和努力的领域。
- 但罗佳说，归根结底，做什么都需要花很多钱才是真理。有钱不一定能变强，但没有钱是万万不能变强的。

en:
- Thanks to Heathcliff and Don Quixote, I recently and involuntarily came to learn that there are villages in the Outskirts. Human villages, at that...
- I don't really remember when it was, but I remember hearing that there are 'Monsters' in the Outskirts that are separate from Abnormalities or Distortions. Seems like they're just about as intent on killing humans, though.
cn:
- 郊区有人类居住的村庄。这并非是因为预定的探索，而是多亏了希斯克利夫和堂吉诃德，我才知道……
- 好像是在哪里听到过，郊区有着和异想体以及扭曲都不同的怪物，似乎想要杀害人类。

en:
- Gnomes and Giants... Intelligent non-human beings. They were definitely different from the Abnormalities.
- We only stopped by a factory in the Outskirts, so I don't really have a grasp on what the rest of the 'Outskirts' is really like. Other than the Great Lake part of it, that is. But if they had a whole factory all the way out there... I guess I shouldn't even know what to expect from a place like that.
- Sinclair did say that, like Demian said, it might be a nicer place than we think. Ishmael immediately rebutted that no place, no matter how beautiful and rich, can be described as 'nice' if it's filled to the brim with things that are full of nothing but hatred for humans.
cn:
- 小矮人和巨人……我们遇到了并非人类的知性体。它们与异想体明显不同。
- 因为我们只去过郊区的某个工厂，所以还难以想象大湖以外的郊区区域内的情况。但是从工厂的样子来看，也许不仅仅只有我们常识以外的存在。
- 辛克莱说，就像德米安所说的那样，这里可能真的很适合居住，以实玛利则反驳道，即使这里是适合居住的好地方，只要有对人类怀有巨大敌意的存在，就不能一概而论地将其称之为宜居之处。

en:
- Don Quixote explained that they are Fixers signed onto long-term contracts, bound by individuals, families, or estates.
- Due to the wide range of their responsibilities, their pay is often decently lucrative, so a lot of high-Grade Fixers often take on Butler contracts after retirement.
- … Huh. So these Fixers are retiring to… become a different brand of Fixers?
- Butlers bound to families or estates sometimes even forget what their initial contracts used to be. But apparently quitting is also a risky decision, given that Taboo hunters or contract-related Offices might come after them looking for bounty.
- It’s unfair, but it’s not like they have an abundance of options. It’s one of those rare, guaranteed long-term tenure jobs in the City that pays a decent wage, so most of them settle for staying as Butlers instead of risking unemployment.
cn:
- 据堂吉诃德所说，他们是隶属于特定个人、家族或土地，执行长期任务的收尾人。
- 由于他们要完成各种各样的工作，所以报酬很不错，因此高阶收尾人引退后转行而来的情况似乎很多。
- ……哦，那岂不是收尾人引退后重新成为收尾人？
- 似乎有很多隶属于家族或土地的管家在不清楚签订了什么合同的情况下就在工作。所以，如果随便辞职的话，可能会被禁忌猎人或合同事务所派来的人处理……
- 虽然有些不太公平，但似乎并没有什么办法。尽管如此，这可是能在都市里让人衣食无忧，且终身任职的职业之一，所以几乎没有人会辞职离开。

en:
- It seems that Fixers in each cardinal direction of the City differ in outfits and practices. 
- Though I haven’t had much of a first-hand experience with them as of now… Now that I’m up north, I’m sure we’ll have plenty of chances to observe the differences.
cn:
- 都市东西南北不同的区域中，收尾人的服装和手段似乎略有不同。
- 因为我没有好好体验过所以并不清楚……不过由于我们一直在南部，而现在到了北部，应该可以多体验一下其中的差异了吧。

en:
- I still have no clue how these Golden Bough work. But if it really can grant people’s wishes… it’s got to be something incredible.
- Thinking back on it, resonating with a Golden Bough would create a sort of dungeon of the fathoms… or fathoms of ego, which we had to battle through.
- Perhaps the power of Golden Boughs is to realize the… thoughts or imaginations of people. I know it barely makes any sense… but when has anything, in this adventure?
- Whichever is the case, these Golden Boughs sure are something. So what is Limbus Company trying to achieve by collecting them? Some say that the Golden Boughs have something to do with the Mirror technology, but… how? Every little thing I learn seems to lead only to more questions…
cn:
- 金枝的具体功能仍不明确。但如果它真的能实现愿望的话，那就是了不起的物品了。
- 回想起来，与金枝共鸣会形成心象镜像迷宫……自我心道，我们在那里彷徨并战斗着。
- ……也许金枝就是能将某人在内心描绘的事物具象化的东西。虽然我说的话可能莫名其妙，但这本来就是个充满着莫名其妙的冒险……
- 总之，我知道这确实是个了不起的物品……但是边狱公司收集所有金枝，到底打算实现什么愿望呢？金枝似乎与镜子技术有关，但它们之间究竟有着怎样的关系呢……知道得越多反而越不明白了。

en:
- Well, I do understand that I accidentally manipulated a lot of time. But I asked Yi Sang, out of pure curiosity, how we ended up saddled with more than ten-billion Ahn of Time Tax.
- Yi Sang explained that each person has a different Time Tax rate, and how having more ‘time’ means that one would have more Time Tax to pay. He continued to elaborate with various mathematical formulas, but I didn’t understand even half of what… I mean, not even a quarter of what he said.
- No matter how much time someone has, they can’t put it to use unless they withdraw a time balance the day before. With that withdrawn time, they can use them all at once to make their days longer… or save the time to invest them in a different occasion. Not that poor people would have the financial leeway to even think about doing the latter.
- T Corp.’s Chief Executive Director was this guy called ‘Herbert’. Don’t think I’ve ever met the actual head of an entire Wing before…
- Herbert helped the Sinners, pretending to be our ‘assistant’. He used to strive to make the City a better place, or so he says… Honestly, given the state T Corp. is in, I'm not sure if I buy that.
- He appeared somewhat resigned, at first. Letting the League of Nine Littérateurs go, ignoring the presence of Yurodiviye in his Nest… But something about me seemed to have motivated him again. The question is… why?
- He also gave me an ominous warning that… turning back time always comes with a cost.
- … But how could I not turn the clock?
cn:
- 虽然我明白自己已经操纵了相当多的时间，但还是好奇超过100亿眼的时间税是如何计算出来的，便询问了李箱。
- 据李箱所说，时间税似乎因人而异，拥有的时间越多，需要缴纳的时间也越多。除此之外，他还解释了一些运用各种公式的计算方法，但我连其中一半的一半都搞不懂。
- 不管拥有多少的时间，若是没有事先在前一天提取，当天就无法使用。提取的时间可以全部消耗掉，用来度过漫长的一天，也可以选择在特定的时间使用，但至于后者的使用方式，我猜穷人们可能想都不敢想吧。
- 代表是名叫赫伯特的人。虽然这还是我第一次见到翼的代表……
- 赫伯特假称自己为助手并帮助了罪人们。虽然他过去似乎为了使都市变得更好而努力过……但从T公司内部的情况来看，实在令人难以相信。
- 他故意放走了九人会，看到圣愚也只是置之不理。他看起来总有种放弃的样子，但在看到我时又好像重新下定了决心。为什么呢……？
- 倒转时间一定伴随着代价，他给过我这样一个可怕的忠告。
- ……但是我无法不倒转时钟。

en:
- After I found myself plenty of W Corp. employee Identities, and learned quite a bit about WARP trains from them, I felt comfortable enough to share that information with the Sinners. Which turned out to have been a good move in hindsight. It would’ve been a disaster to have to explain WARP trains to them at that moment.
- Other than letting us cryosleep through the WARP train journey, we were also given complimentary snacks as a part of the First Class package. Rodya(who took my portion as well, as I had no mouth to eat them with)’s blissful expression made it pretty clear that it was quite the delicacy.
- I did find it kind of unusual that a train that, as far as the public knows, runs only for ten seconds, bothered to sell package items or in-train meals. When I asked Faust, she explained that their purposes were less practical and more thematic to give its passengers the impression of going on a trip.
- Another thing: I definitely remember seeing that employee crawl into an emergency escape pod. So where’d he go?
- So why don’t the WARP trains specialize in shipping cargo? If they have to go through so much trouble and manpower to transport people, wouldn’t it be much more efficient if they just transported cargo?
- Wait, I think I’ve sparked a debate—
- Heathcliff said that it was because transporting people was the whole point of the train. That suggestion seemed to have given Yi Sang an idea.
- Yi Sang noted that, from W Corp.’s cooperation with T Corp., it is likely that they need ‘time’ to operate their trains. Moreover, the T Corp. Chief Executive Director said that emotions don’t change with time; instead, time changes with emotions. It was something to that effect, at least.
- Based on what everyone has said, we came to a pretty plausible conclusion. That a state of emotionally transformative consciousness in an effective infinity of time is what moves, or powers, the WARP trains. Either that, or that state of consciousness is precisely what WARP trains are built to induce. Some Sinners and I applauded Yi Sang and Heathcliff for this hypothesis.
cn:
- 随着拥有W公司人格的罪人数目的增加，对WARP列车有了一定了解后，我向全体罪人共享了相关情报，因此得以在混乱发生前防患于未然。
- 除了可以在旅途中保持冬眠状态以外，还获得了迎宾餐点作为头等舱的特殊服务。罗佳拿走了由于没有嘴而不能吃的我的那一份食物，从她的反应来看，真的很美味。
- 注意到在运行时长只有10秒的列车内销售成套商品和车内食品显得很奇怪，因此询问了浮士德。得到的解释是这并非为了实际使用而运营，而是为了营造旅行氛围才如此。
- 确实见到那个员工进入了员工逃生用的冬眠舱，但他却消失了。他去了什么地方？
- 为什么WARP列车不运送货物呢？客运会花费很多时间的话，只进行货运不是更有效率吗？也询问了李箱和浮士德，但只得到了模糊不清的回答。
- 等等，好像有什么讨论开始了……
- 希斯克利夫说对于列车而言最重要的是使人移动。这句话似乎给了李箱一些灵感。
- 李箱表示，从W公司与T公司有合作这一点上来看，无论是因为什么理由，列车的运营都需要时间。另外，T公司代表之前说过，时间不会自行流逝，正因为情感在变化，所以时间才会流逝。
- 综合两人的意见，我们得到了一个相当合理的推论。在度过无止境的时间时，处于感情会发生变化的意识状态的人的存在本身推动着WARP列车，或者其本身就是列车运行的目的。身边的几位罪人听到推测后，开始给李箱和希斯克利夫鼓掌。

en:
- A blue-ish station themed after a banquet hall.
- Several stations arrived one after another without a break, and we even had Peccatula that looked just like the Sinners’ Identities and E.G.O, attacking us. No wonder the Sinners were exhausted by the end of it. Faust called them Peccatula of Envy… or Peccatulum Invidiae.
- Thankfully, this railway was kind enough to give us breaks between every few waves of enemies. And because we managed to blast through multiple stations at once, some Sinners expressed that this one was preferable to the previous ones as it at least ended quickly.
- This makes me wonder, though. What happened to all those Peccatula Invidiae who first boarded the train? Did they get killed at the banquet of the King in Binds? Or maybe they're still roaming somewhere within the stations? Who knows.
cn:
- 一座被装饰为蓝色宴会厅的车站。上面写着4号线。
- 在数个车站发生了连续战斗，遭到了模仿罪人人格和E.G.O的罪种的袭击，罪人们感到非常疲劳。浮士德将其称之为嫉妒罪种。
- 幸运的是，这条轨道线给了我们足够的休息场所。并且因为一次能够突破多个车站，所以能够在短时间内走出很远，意外地也有罪人表示这次的折射轨道比较好。
- 这么说来，最开始乘坐电车的嫉妒罪种们都去哪里了呢？是死于受缚之王的宴会之中，还是仍然存在于车站中的某处呢？现在还有许多事情仍然无从得知。

en:
- It’s my company-issued device. I write journal entries on it like I’m doing now, and I sometimes communicate with the Sinners’ Identities, too. There probably was some of that Mirror technology involved in the making of this device.
- I used this device to converse with Catherine. It must’ve been the Golden Bough’s powers that allowed me to talk directly to her. Did they stick a Golden Bough inside this device or something? Or… maybe the presence of that Golden Bough allowed me to communicate with her through some supernatural channel, even with a mundane device like this.
cn:
- 由公司所提供的终端。使用终端像现在这样写日记，以及与罪人的人格进行沟通。在其中似乎也使用了镜子技术。
- 曾通过这台终端与凯瑟琳交谈。与她的沟通大概是通过金枝的力量实现的。是这台终端内部存在金枝吗？还是只要拥有金枝，用任何机器都能实现超自然的沟通？

en:
- The Mirror shows possibilities that may or may not have been. When Catherine, Nelly, and Heathcliff from the Mirror World gazed into the Mirror, they only saw all kinds of tragedies in their futures. If there really are worlds of infinite possibilities, then… there must be an infinity of time they have to observe, right? So, can we really say that they saw every possible future? In other words, is it even possible to do something like that? It makes me wonder if we can actively interact or something with the Mirror Worlds.
- We make use of these Mirror technologies almost daily, but we know so little about it. Yi Sang also said that Mirror Worlds are like a terribly tangled knot of mysteries we must carefully unravel.
cn:
- 镜子映照出的是也许存在也许并不存在的可能性。凯瑟琳、耐莉和镜像世界的希斯克利夫都只在镜子中看见了不幸的未来。如果镜子中真的存在无限的话，那么他们看完所需的时间也是无限的，所以他们真的看完了所有的可能性吗？话说回来，所有的镜子真的能被看完吗？难不成我们也可以积极地与镜像世界相互作用，或者做到与之相似的事情吗？
- 虽然经常使用镜子技术，但我们仍对其知之甚少。李箱也表示，与镜像世界有关的事情还有很多尚未解明。

en: - T Corp.’s Chief Executive Director offered to purchase the Monolith from Limbus Company. Now we’re selling artifacts that can induce Distortions? It doesn’t make sense—our main business, at least on the surface, is Distortion Management… but we’re selling items that can make Distortions? … Maybe we’re just building our reputation as Distortion experts so we can guarantee safety even with these artifacts. Well… if we’re selling artifacts that create Distortions, and take care of Distortions when it inevitably causes someone to Distort… I guess that makes a business model with a cycle of profit.
cn: - T公司的代表说要从边狱公司购买独石。边狱公司现在甚至在售卖这种能促进扭曲的物品。明明表面上的业务是解决扭曲，我们却在售卖生产扭曲的物品……或者，正是因为我们能熟练地解决扭曲，所以才放心地从我们这里购买？如果独石产生的扭曲也是由边狱公司收费处理的话，似乎确实就这样构成了一个不断盈利的业务结构。

en: - The unique powers of each Distortion are somewhat like Singularities… or sometimes, even surpass them. Even the T Corp. Chief Executive Director said that he saw a new possibility through the Distortion called the Time Ripper. What’s their true potential, I wonder.
cn: - 扭曲拥有的各种特殊能力类似于奇点，甚至更甚于此。连T公司的代表都说，他在名为时间杀人魔的扭曲身上看到了新的可能性。而其又能达到何种程度呢。

en:
- Their Nest is located in District 16. 
- It’s full of extremely tall skyscrapers and spires that I have to bend my neck to see how tall they really are.
- Their specialty is… canned items of sorts. Meursault listed off all kinds of canned items, and I was able to learn that there were a lot of them.
- Various flyers covered the train station walls and pillars from top to bottom. Is something awful going on here, I wonder?
cn:
- 其巢位于16区。
- 有很多需要抬头到极限才能勉强看见顶部的高层建筑。
- 据说其特产是许许多多的罐头，我问了默尔索，似乎有各种各样的罐头。
- 车站里贴满了传单。是不是发生了什么不好的事件？

en:
- They seem to specialize in protecting and upholding the public peace of the zone requested by their clients.
- They often call themselves your(as in, the clients’) shield.
- I learned from conversations with Zwei Identities that they specialize in protecting things. But only if they are contracted to do so, of course.
cn:
- 专门负责保护委托人所要求的区域，以及维持其中治安的协会。
- 似乎打着“您的盾牌”的标语在进行活动。
- 我曾经和来自Zwei的人格进行过对话，他们确实像是专门守护什么的协会。但也只会在被委托的时候才会进行守护。

en:
- Apparently, they make deliveries using dimensional bags equipped with an AI ‘Poludnitsa’, called ‘Courier Trunks.’ To be more exact, it seems like the Association assigns the type of Poludnitsa most appropriate for the contract and the path each Devyat’ Fixer.
- Faust explained that they embed the core, or a module, installed with AI to each individual Courier Trunk and… The point is, they install the AI on the bag and use it to deliver stuff.
- Any items in each trunk are often well-preserved and their deliveries are rarely late, making them a vital Association in the City. Maybe we can make use of their services one day? Sounds pretty convenient.
- After a brief conversation with the Identity, I learned that Poludnitsa, the AI, greatly empowers its users if they determine that it may be difficult to make the delivery on time. Failure to make punctual deliveries could result in death… no wonder they rarely ever miss the deadline.
cn:
- 显然，他们在装有AI“波鲁德尼察”的次元包，也叫“派送箱”中放入货物来进行配送。更准确地说，似乎会根据委托与路径为每位收尾人分配最适合的波鲁德尼察型号。
- 浮士德解释说，是将搭载了AI的核心或模块嵌入到每个派送箱中，然后……总之，他们使用搭载了AI的包来运送货物。
- 箱子里的物品通常都保存完好，而且他们很少迟到，这使他们成为了都市中至关重要的协会。或许有一天我们也可以利用他们的服务？听起来很方便。
- 经过与人格的简短交谈，我了解到，若判断认为可能难以按时交付，AI波鲁德尼察会大幅强化其持有者的力量，之后如果不准时交货也可能会导致死亡……难怪他们极少错过最后期限。

en:
- A Syndicate founded by Sonya. Rodya once told me that they used to help the downtrodden of the Backstreets, but eventually devolved into armchair revolutionaries who did nothing but sit around talking about how they’re going to change the city.
- They’ve been slowly spreading their influence through the Nests. We even ran into the Yurodiviye terrorists using various inventions to cause trouble in the T Corp. Nest.
- The Yurodiviye, who venerate Sonya as their ‘Saint’, said they’re waiting for the ‘right moment’. I don’t know why they’re calling Sonya the Saint, or what moment they’re talking about… but something about it rubs me the wrong way.
- From what I gathered from listening to the Dieci Identities, Sonya is not the same kind of ‘Saint’ as the Dieci Association’s.
cn:
- 由索尼亚创立的帮派。据罗佳所说，虽然一开始他们在帮助后巷中的穷人，后来却变成了只会重复纸上谈兵如何改变都市的团体。
- 据说他们的影响力正在巢的各处扩大。我们甚至在T公司里偶然遇见了使用各种发明果断实施袭击的圣愚。
- 他们称索尼亚为圣者，等待着时机。虽然我并不知道为什么要称索尼亚为圣者，时机又是指什么时候……但有什么让我感到不安。
- 从Dieci协会人格所说的话推测，那和Dieci协会的圣者显然是不同的概念。

en:
- We encountered Peccatula, which can mimic not only the Sinners’ appearances but also their identities and E.G.O. I asked Faust how the Peccatula, which are just things that failed to even Distort, were able to use E.G.O… but Faust shut the entire discussion down by saying that it was still classified information.
- How did they even mimic Sinners from Mirror Worlds if they don’t have the Identity Cards pulled through the Mirror tech?
cn:
- 遭遇了不仅可以模仿罪人的外表，甚至连人格和E.G.O都可以原封不动地模仿的罪种。我问浮士德，作为扭曲的失败产物的罪种是如何能够使用E.G.O的，但她中止了讨论，说这仍然是机密信息。
- 如果不是使用镜子技术打捞的人格卡，那它们是怎么模仿镜像世界中的罪人的呢？

en:
- The bags that Butlers carry are called ‘dimensional cases’, or dimensional attache cases. It seems pretty convenient, being able to store things greater than its external appearance may suggest. Maybe it’s kinda like the Backdoor of Mephistopheles.
- The size and capacity of each dimensional case depend on the make. The more expensive it is, the bigger its capacity, and smaller its external size.
- We can’t stuff a person into these dimensional cases, apparently. Maybe it’s like the WARP trains where it needs to differentiate between people and items.
cn:
- 管家所携带的包被称作“次元包”。它似乎相当便利，能够储存比外观看起来更多的东西。也许有点像梅菲斯托费勒斯的后门。
- 根据其型号，次元包的大小和容量都有所不同。次元包的价格越昂贵，内部容量就越大，其外观尺寸也就越小。
- 显然，不能把人类装进次元包里。或许和WARP列车需要区分人和货物是同样的道理？

en:
- Limbus Company Enkephalin
- They're Limbus Company's research and energy generation department.
- Under the Chief Researcher Hohenheim, this department conducts various studies and research.
- They study the Abnormalities, Distortions, and even the Peccatula—isolating and studying them. Its interiors are designed somewhat similarly to those of the former L Corp., Lobotomy Corporation.
- The employees were all wearing E.G.O gears extracted from Abnormalities. According to them, their gear is distinguished from Lobotomy Corporation's E.G.O gear because it exhibits more of each source Abnormalities' idiosyncrasies.
- From what I could hear from the Mirror World Identities about these LCE gears, that doesn't entirely seem to be a positive thing. Apparently their minds could easily become corroded by the gear they're wearing... I feel like this technology's got some room to grow.
cn:
- Limbus Company Enkephalin
- 边狱公司的研究及能源生产部门。
- 以首席研究员霍恩海姆为首，进行着各种各样的研究。
- 异想体自不必说，扭曲与罪种也是其隔离、研究的对象。内部设施的样貌，看起来与瓦尔普吉斯之夜时见到的旧L公司——脑叶公司相近。
- 其成员均穿着从异想体中提取的E.G.O装备。与脑叶公司的E.G.O装备不同，其异想体的特性展现得更为明显。似乎一旦使用者与装备进行感应，展现的幅度也会增加……
- 从镜像世界的人格那里得知的关于LCE装备的事来看，似乎其并不是只有好的一面。考虑到精神被装备侵蚀的情况也很多这一点……我认为目前这项技术可能还不完善。

en:
- We learned more about the new Classification codes and Risk Levels.
- Until now, it was kind of difficult for us to immediately know whether WAW or HE was supposed to be the more dangerous one, and... there was an entity that was weirdly powerful for a TETH-level entity, as well... Well, now that we have the 'expected damage scale' in addition to the scale based on their energy production levels, we should be able to tell that HE-5 presents more potential dangers than WAW-4 in a fight.
- Hohenheim told us not to think of this as a single numerical scale of power, but... it feels more intuitive to have these alongside the Risk Levels system previously used by Lobotomy Corporation. Anyways, this technically means that there could be ZAYIN-10 entities as well... I wonder what that would be like.
cn:
- 在LCE听到了关于新的编号与危险等级的事情。
- 在此之前，我们很难判断WAW和HE中哪个会更危险……甚至还有明明等级标的是TETH实际上却异常强大的实体……但现在除了能源提取量之外，还有伤害能力预期，据此就能判断出HE-5有可能比WAW-4更危险。
- 虽然霍恩海姆说过其并非单纯的战斗力衡量，但比起之前使用的脑叶公司的危险等级系统，这样能更直观地感受到危险度。那么这也就意味着理论上可能存在像是ZAYIN-10之类的实体……我目前还无法想象那究竟是怎样的存在。

en:
- Their Nest is located in District 24... or so I've been told.
- Haven't been there, don't know if we have any plans to go there, but I remember hearing that the Indigo Elder's skiff was made from X Corp.'s alloy.
- According to the Identities, you can excavate all kinds of stuff from their excavation sites like microwaves or car tires. So do they just uncover these finished products and... immediately put them to use? How's that even possible?
cn:
- 其巢位于24区……至少听闻是如此。
- 虽然还没去过那里，也不知道以后会不会有去那儿的打算，但听说靛蓝老人的船就是用X公司的合金制造的。
- 根据人格们所言，在开采区可以挖掘出从微波炉到汽车轮胎等等各种各样的东西。所以是直接挖出埋藏着的成品，然后立即就能投入使用？这究竟是怎么做到的？

en:
- Their Nest is located in District 13.
- They seem to have control over a Singularity called the 'Moonlight Stones'. They're said to allow people to focus solely on a singular subject or eliminate all distracting thoughts... And given that they have this facility called 'Abyss Trauma Correctional Facility', maybe they specialize in psychological healthcare or relaxation businesses.
- Hey, maybe we should buy these Moonlight Stones for the Sinners to prevent E.G.O Corrosions or help them calm down and relax when their 'turn' comes up?
- I relayed this seemingly good idea to Faust, but it was summarily denied. She didn't even give me an explanation as to why—she just told me that it wasn't the time to discuss them just yet. Given that pretty much every technology of the City has these different sides to them... maybe these things also have some kind of side effects.
cn:
- 其巢位于13区。
- 似乎持有名为“月长石”的奇点。据说其能令人的精神集中于特定事物，或是摒除一切杂念……考虑到存在名为“深渊心灵创伤矫正室”的设施，也许是在精神治疗与稳定方面有独到见解的翼。
- 那如果能给罪人们买这种叫月长石的东西……或许就能在使用E.G.O时避免侵蚀，或者在因轮到自己而焦虑的时候给予其一些安全感？
- 我以为这是个好主意，便向浮士德提议，但她甚至未阐述理由便将其驳回了，只说是“现在还不是讨论的时候”。据说都市的技术总是有另一面……或许这东西同样也有副作用。

en: - Their motto has something to do with creating a very safe home, and their Singularity can either expand or warp the space itself. - I was told that structures built using P Corp.'s Singularity are all very... elastic. That turned out to be surprisingly literal, as when La Manchaland began to manifest, I could see the buildings touching La Manchaland bending outward like rubber. They said that it's completely safe inside even if the building's exterior bends and twists like that, but... I can't imagine how that could be true. - Many space expansion technologies in the City allow things to be bigger on the inside, but P Corp.'s version specifically focuses on safety. - This is just my speculation, but... recalling our conversation with Cesara, it seems that La Manchaland heavily influenced P Corp.'s Singularity. I wonder if it's possible to develop a Singularity inspired by something else?
cn:
- 以“安全的住所”为座右铭，持有能够扩展或扭曲空间的奇点。
- 据说应用了P公司奇点的建筑物具有很强的伸缩性。实际上，拉·曼却领显现时，可以看到外侧的建筑如同橡胶般弯曲。虽然从外面看建筑物是扭曲变形的模样，但内部是完全安全的……真的安全吗？
- 虽然许多空间扩张技术都能够让内部比外面看上去要宽阔，但P公司的奇点似乎特别注重安全。
- 虽然只是推测……回想起与切萨拉的对话，P公司的奇点似乎很大程度上受到了拉·曼却领的影响。以某种东西为基础研发出奇点是可能的吗？

en:
- First encountered at the Wuthering Heights manor, these are entities that have progressed past Stage 2 of their growth.
- LCE categorized them into 'Classes'—Class 1, 2, and 3 respectively—and it seems that these Stage 3 Peccatula are the final stage of their evolution. But Hohenheim told us that he wasn't entirely certain of that just yet.
- Hohenheim called the Peccatula 'mediocre shells'. If the Peccatula are nothing but empty shells, then... what distinguishes their stages?
cn:
- 在呼啸山庄首次遭遇到已成长为2阶以上的实体。
- LCE将其成长阶段分为1型、2型和3型。根据目前的研究，似乎3阶罪种是其最终的成长阶段。但霍恩海姆表示这一点还不能完全确定。
- 霍恩海姆称罪种为“半吊子的空壳”。倘若罪种只是空壳……那其成长阶段又是如何区分的呢？

en:
- They're neither Abnormalities nor monsters. If I had to put a label on them, I'd say they're closest to Distortions, but that's a tenuous connect at best. The LCD Team Leader Moses also said they're fundamentally different beings, so... yeah, probably not.
- All Bloodfiends possess red eyes. But it's not the easiest method of distinguishing them from humans, as it's also the most common color for ocular combat augmentations. And it'd be entirely useless if they replaced their entire head with a prosthetic like I did.
- They have strong regenerative capabilities, so it's extremely hard to kill them if they have enough blood to consume. One way to stop them from regenerating, though, is to crush their heads... We had a hell of a time aboard the WARP train, thanks to the train's environmental uniqueness that sorta made that a non-option for us.
- The head really seems to be the core element in making these 'regeneration' methods work. The head had to be intact for Life Insurance to work, K Corp.'s ampules to work, so on and so forth. ... Well, the brain, to be specific.
- They all have an overpowering desire for blood. Bloodfiends of La Manchaland seemed to have tried consuming Hemobars with artificial or animal blood additives as a substitute, but... looks like only flowing blood can really sate their hunger and deprivation.
- They could overcome it if the urge itself is forgotten, but... finding the waters of the river Lethe, which serves that exact function, doesn't seem to be the easiest task. Where in the world did the Fixer from Don Quixote's memories, Bari, find such a thing?
- Alongside this desire for blood, they also seem to have strong feelings to propagate their 'Family' as well. Seems like... 'Sancho' was the odd one out for not creating a Family of her own. Kindred generations are distinguished by their separation from the First Kindred, and once embraced as a part of the Family, they begin to really care about and treat each other like, well... family.
- Rocinante disguises Don Quixote's more obvious Bloodfiend features and partially suppresses her bloodthirst. But there's still much we don't know about Rocinante—like how it works, or if it has anything to do with the body of 'Don Quixote' still at P Corp....
- But it still can't fully suppress her natural instincts, like the desire for blood and propagation of her Family, so Don Quixote's been enduring it all with her sheer willpower. Makes me wonder, though... what's so different about our Don Quixote and the First Kindred Don Quixote that they have such strong resilience against bloodthirst compared to the other Bloodfiends?
- Limbus Company headquarters has been sending Don Quixote a steady supply of high-quality blood packs. When I asked why they couldn't have just done the same thing at La Manchaland, she replied that it was simply an issue of demand vastly outweighing the supply—there were simply too many Bloodfiends to feed compared to the amount of blood they could draw from willing visitors. Which is precisely the reason they had to develop Hemobars to meet the demand with as little blood as possible. Besides... I have a feeling that it probably wouldn't have worked out anyway... even if they had enough blood packs...
cn:
- 既非异想体，也非怪物的存在。非要说的话应该与扭曲更为相似，但又感觉不太一样。LCD部门的摩西队长也说过他们本质上是不同的存在……那应该确实是不一样的吧。
- 其共同点是有着血红色的眼睛。但由于红色是最常见的战斗型义眼的颜色，因此很难仅凭这点对其作出区分。更不用说像我这样整个头部都替换为义体的情况，根本分不清吧。
- 其再生能力相当优越。只要有充足的血液可供摄取，就很难通过寻常手段将其杀死。不过据说只要破坏其头部就能阻止再生。但在WARP列车里是不可能做到这点的，害我们吃了不少苦……
- 无论是K公司的安瓿还是生命保险，头部似乎都是对再生而言最为关键的身体部位。但准确而言应该不是头，而是大脑。
- 其对血液抱有强烈的欲望。即使拉·曼却领的血魔们为了克服这一点选择食用由人工血液和动物血制成的血棒……可那终究不是流动的鲜血，因此似乎无法正常地给予饱腹感与满足感。
- 如果能连那份冲动本身都一并忘却就没关系……但想得到能使人忘记一切的勒忒河水也并非易事。堂吉诃德记忆中时常出现的那位名叫巴里的收尾人，究竟是如何获得此物的呢？
- 除了对血液的欲望，其对家族的渴望也十分强烈。从未创造家人的桑丘……似乎是特例。其貌似是按血脉相连的世代划分眷属，并将彼此视为真正的家人般呵护。
- 驽骍难得不仅隐藏了堂吉诃德身为血魔的外貌特征，也一定程度抑制了她的吸血冲动。其原理为何，又是否与留在P公司的堂吉诃德……的遗体有关，目前仍尚无定论。
- 但即便如此，抑制也并非完全制止吸血冲动或增加血魔眷属的本性，堂吉诃德似乎是在靠自身的意志力忍耐着。话说回来……与其他血魔不同，为什么唯独我们的堂吉诃德和一代眷属堂吉诃德尤其能忍耐吸血冲动呢？
- 堂吉诃德会定期接受边狱公司本部提供的优质血包。我曾经询问过浮士德，为什么拉·曼却领的血魔们不使用血包这种直接提供血液的方法……她的回答是，拉·曼却领的血魔实在是数量众多，仅靠自愿献血恐怕无法满足需求。因此只能制作血棒，尽可能用少量血液来尽可能多地喂饱血魔。最重要的是……恐怕血包也不是完美的解决方案……
